11100424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11100424.value: 探究組胺H4受體在創傷性視神經病變中的作用並將其作為青光眼新的治療靶點應用

11100424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11100424.value: 中樞神經系統(CNS)損傷，如視神經損傷和脊髓損傷，是在全球範圍內致殘或致死的主要原因，仍是臨床醫生面臨的重大挑戰。由機械損傷（車禍）或青光眼（眼內壓升高）導致的創傷性視神經病變會引起視神經的退化，視網膜神經節細胞的死亡，進而導致不可逆的失明。越來越多的證據表明，視神經損傷的動物模型於臨床的青光眼病患有著相似的病理生理學機制，因此此類動物模型多用於研究青光眼的新療法。 於無法再生的中樞神經系統不同，外周神經系統(PNS)具有再生能力，儘管速度緩慢（1mm/天）。神經系統的損傷會誘發由調節因子精準調節的細胞反應，包括适应的（細胞生長）或適應不良（細胞死亡）的。先前研究發現，大部分參與外周神經系統軸再生的關鍵信號通路都在中樞神經損傷後失活。而對於外周神經系統的軸再生過程和機制的進一步了解，有助於我們拓展現階段對中樞神經系統再生的認知，更重要的是，這有助於我們探索潛在的青光眼新療法。因此，人們目前迫切需要鑒定出負責内在生長程序的關鍵調節因子，並用小分子化合物靶向這些調節因子作爲可用的治療方法。 為了解決這些問題，我們進行了深入的信息學分析，從測序數據庫中確定了H1-4R在受傷的背根神經節(DRG)中的表達，其中，H4R在受損DRG中的表達高度上調，我們也通過qPCR分析證實了這一發現。之後，我們通過CRISPR/Cas9技術建立了H4R完全敲除的轉基因小鼠模型。Hrh4基因的缺失，不僅促進了DRG 外植體的神經突生長，還加速了小鼠在外周神經損傷後的軸再生和功能性恢復。更引人關注的是，我們使用了視神經壓迫損傷模型， 發現不論是Hrh4基因的敲除還是選擇性H4R拮抗劑VUF6002，都可以有效地促進創傷後軸再生和提高視網膜神經節細胞存活率。在青光眼的小鼠模型中，Hrh4基因的敲除和VUF6002也展現出相似的神經保護作用。在本篇提案中，我們將基於現有發現進行視覺功能測試等動物實驗，並通過多細胞批量測序或單細胞測序等生物信息學分析闡明Hrh4缺失對於神經系統創傷後的保護作用的潜在机制。

11100524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11100524.value: 運用整合神經細胞和回路模型解碼秀麗隱桿線蟲的嗅覺感知

11100524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11100524.value: Animals interact with a constantly changing environment and must adapt their behavior accordingly to survive. How does a nervous system make sense of the outside world to generate appropriate behavioral output? In particular, how are external and internal stimuli encoded into patterns of neuronal activity and computed at the neuronal, circuit, and system levels? We will address these fundamental questions using the nematode worm Caenorhabditis elegans as a model organism. C. elegans is a powerful genetic model with an anatomically small and well-defined nervous system that enables the unraveling of the entire circuitry with single-cell resolution. Through a combination of electrophysiology, in vivo calcium imaging, and behavioral analysis, we aim to match single-neuron biophysics to their intrinsic computational functions and emergent circuit properties. Guided by this empirical data and the available connectome information, we propose to construct a circuit-level model that can simulate information flow, network dynamics, and motor output in the olfactory circuit in C. elegans. By computational ablation validated through experimental observation, such a model would allow us to eventually understand how a simple circuit generates a well-defined chemotaxis behavior. Since biophysical and molecular mechanisms underlying neuronal function and mathematical algorithms used by neural computation are often conserved between species through evolution, we expect that the knowledge gained from the worm will help us understand more complex nervous systems like the human brain. 動物與不斷變化的環境互動，必須適應地調整行為以求生存。神經系統如何感知並理解外界並產生適當的行為反應？特別是，外部和內部刺激如何編碼成神經元活動模式，並在神經元、神經回路和系統層面進行計算？我們將以線蟲模式生物秀麗隱桿線蟲來探討這些神經科學的基本問題。秀麗隱桿線蟲是一個功能強大的遺傳模型，其解剖結構小而明確，使得我們能夠以單個細胞的分辨率解析整個神經回路。通過電生理學、體內鈣成像和行為分析的結合，我們的目標是將單個神經元的生物物理特性與其內在的計算功能和湧現的回路特性相匹配。在這些實證數據和現有的完整連接組信息的指導下，我們計畫構建一個能夠模擬秀麗隱桿線蟲嗅覺回路中的信息流、網絡動態和運動輸出的回路級模型。通過計算消融並通過實驗觀察驗證，這樣的模型將最終使我們理解一個簡單回路如何產生明確的嗅覺趨化性行為。由於神經元功能的生物物理和分子機制以及神經計算中使用的數學算法通常在物種進化中得以保留，我們期望從線蟲中獲得的相關知識將有助於我們最終了解更加複雜的神經系統，如人類大腦。

11101324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11101324.value: 基於多孔金屬微針陣列的齦溝液擷取與分析測試

11101324.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11101324.value: Prof Deng, Ke Dr Ye, Zhou

11101324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11101324.value: Periodontal disease is a chronic inflammatory condition that affects the gum tissue and other structures supporting the teeth. Without treatment, it can destroy the alveolar ridge and lead to tooth loss. Gingival crevicular fluid (GCF), as a diagnostic fluid, has been extensively explored in search for potential biomarkers of periodontal disease. Traditionally, GCF is collected using paper strips and then analyzed for its compositions through methods like proteomics or immunoassay. However, paper strip easily loses mechanical strength in the fluid and the collection also takes minutes that often leads to contamination by saliva and blood. In addition, while proteomics and immunoassays can provide a full spectrum of the GCF composition, these methods require professionals and tedious procedure. Therefore, there is a great need to have a technology that can collect GCF with minimal contamination and provide timely analysis of the contained biomarkers. Inspired by the emergence of POC diagnostic devices, we plan to develop a disposable and convenient system that permits the interference-free collection and real-time analysis of GCF. Specifically, the system has the appearance of a test strip, composing of a porous and metallic microneedle array and a biosensing component. When the microneedle array is inserted into the periodontal pocket, GCF will be absorbed via capillary force and flow through the porous microneedle array to the biosensing section. The biosensing component then converts the concentration of a specific biomarker (by taking MMP-8 as a model biomarker) in the GCF to colorimetric signal, which is quantified through a smartphone app. The device will be tested on a rat model of diabetes periodontitis. 牙周病是一種慢性炎症，會影響牙齦組織和其他口腔組織。如果不進行治療，牙齦病會破壞齒槽嵴並最終導致牙齒脫落。儘早檢測有利於防止和治療牙周病。 目前臨床上一般是透過分析齦溝液（存在於牙周齦溝或牙周袋內的組織滲透液）來檢測和診斷牙周病。通常，醫務工作者會先使用試紙條收集齦溝液，然後透過蛋白質體學或免疫測定等方法分析其成分。但是，試紙條在接觸液體時很容易失去機械強度，而且收集過程比較緩慢從而導致齦溝液被唾液和血液污染。此外，雖然蛋白質體學和免疫測定可以提供齦溝液成分的全譜，但這些方法需要專業人員的操作且流程繁瑣複雜。因此，臨床上迫切需要一種無污染的齦溝液收集方法並能及時分析其所含生物標記。 本計畫計畫開發一種即拋型的齦溝液採集及即時分析醫療器材。該系統具有試紙條的外觀，由多孔金屬微針陣列和生物感測組件組成。當微針陣列插入牙周囊袋時，齦溝液在毛細管力作用下沿著多孔微針陣列流到生物感測部分。然後，生物感測組件將齦溝液中特定生物標記（基質金屬蛋白酶-8，MMP-8 ）的濃度轉換為比色訊號，並透過智慧型手機應用程式進行量化。我們將透過糖尿病牙周炎大鼠模型來對此器械進行測試。

11101624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11101624.value: 透過誘導多能神經幹細胞的移植來研究肌萎縮側索硬化症相關FUS突變對人類腦神經元突觸連結的影響

11101624.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11101624.value: Prof MA, Eddie Chi Him Prof Yang, Sungchil

11101624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11101624.value: Because of species differences, rodent animal models may not recapitulate all the essential pathological features in disease. Human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs) provide an alternative cellular model to study various inherited disorders of the nervous system. These include amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), a lethal neurodegeneration that involves axonal degeneration and death of motor neurons in the spinal cord. Familial ALS is caused by gene mutations that affect a number of RNA-binding proteins. One of them is FUS, which is essential for the formation of neuronal connections by controlling its target mRNAs. When protein synthesis in the cell is arrested under stress conditions, FUS is prone to form aggregates that can lead to neuronal toxicity. Increasing evidence indicates that ALS patients not only suffer motor deficits but also defects in cognitive functions, and alterations in brain areas other than those responsible for motor function have been detected. Nonetheless, there is little information on how ALS-related gene mutations adversely affect the connections of human brain neurons. We have applied CRISPR/Cas9-based genome editing to introduce a specific point mutation on the FUS gene in hiPSCs. Interestingly, after differentiation into cortical neurons the FUS mutant neurons show defects in the growth of dendrites and the formation of neuronal connections (synapses) when stress hormone receptor is activated, suggesting that the ALS-FUS mutation can indeed affect human brain neurons and may increase vulnerability to stressful experience. To study the pathology in a more physiological environment, the hiPSC-derived neural stem cells are transplanted into mouse brain. Unlike the diffuse distribution in cultured neurons, we observe the characteristic pathological FUS aggregates inside the transplanted mutant hiPSC-derived neurons in the mouse brain. In this proposal, we will employ this xenograft model to investigate how the function of grafted human brain neurons is disrupted by the FUS mutation through imaging the neuronal connections and electrophysiological recording. We will further explore the intriguing possibility that chronic stressful experience imposed on the transplanted mice might aggravate damage on the human mutant FUS neurons in vivo, and delineate the underlying mechanism that may involve the RNA-binding protein HuD. Our study will address the important yet understudied question of how specific FUS mutations disrupt synapses of human stem cell-derived brain neurons. Through their transplantation into mouse brain, we also develop a novel approach to investigate how risk factors such as behavioral stressful experience affect progression of neurodegeneration in a human cellular context. 由於物種的差異，囓齒動物模型可能無法概括人類疾病的所有基本病理特徵。人類誘導多能幹細胞(hiPSCs)為研究神經系統的各種遺傳性疾病提供了一個替代性的人類細胞模型。這些疾病包括致命的，以脊髓軸突變性和運動神經元死亡為特徵的神經退化性疾病，肌萎縮性脊髓側索硬化症(ALS)。家族性ALS是由多種會影響RNA結合蛋白的基因突變引起的。 Fused in Sarcoma (FUS)是其中之一。 FUS對其標靶mRNA的調控在形成神經元的連接至關重要。當細胞中的蛋白質合成在壓力條件下被抑制時，FUS容易形成可以導致神經元毒性的聚集體。越來越多的證據表明，ALS患者不僅表現出運動缺陷，而且還表現出認知功能的缺陷，以及非運動相關的大腦區域的改變。然而與ALS相關的基因突變如何損傷人類腦神經元的機制仍有待研究。透過基於CRISPR/CAS9的基因組編輯，我們向hiPSCs中的FUS基因敲入特定的點突變。有趣的是，在將hiPSCs分化為皮質神經元之後，壓力激素受體的活化會使帶有FUS突變的神經元表現出樹突生長和神經元連接（突觸）形成的缺陷。這表明ALS相關的FUS突變確實會影響人類腦神經元，並且可能增加其對壓力事件的易感性。為了在更接近生理條件的環境中進行ALS的病理學研究，我們將hiPSCs分化所獲得的神經幹細胞移植到小鼠大腦。與體外培養的神經元中觀察到的彌散性分佈的FUS不同，我們在移植到小鼠腦中的突變hiPSCs分化皮質神經元中觀察到人類神經元內的特徵性病理FUS聚集體。本研究將在這種外源移植模型的基礎上，透過電生理記錄以及突觸連接顯微成像來研究FUS突變如何損傷移植的人類腦神經元的功能。此外，我們還將進一步探討一種有趣的可能性，即對被移植小鼠施加的慢性行為壓力可能會加劇移植的帶有突變型FUS的人類神經元的損傷。而我們也將闡述導致這種損傷的可能涉及RNA結合蛋白HuD的分子機制。我們的研究將解釋特定的FUS突變如何損傷人類幹細胞分化所獲得的腦神經元突觸這個重要問題。透過將它們移植到小鼠大腦中，我們還開發了一種新的方法來研究諸如行為壓力之類的風險因素，如何在人類腦細胞背景下影響神經退化性疾病的進展。

11101724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11101724.value: 低劑量消毒劑導致水產養殖環境中細菌產生抗藥性

11101724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11101724.value: Low dose disinfectants such as ChloramineT, Ozone and Hydrogen Peroxide, are commonly used in aquaculture to treat surface bacterial infections on fish, and to reduce the bacterial levels in the water to avoid systemic infections, which need to be treated with antibiotics. The use of disinfectants has been advocated as a means of reducing the use of antibiotic drugs, but research is suggesting that these biocides may select for co- resistance to antibiotics in bacterial populations. The mechanism(s) for this co-resistance may be multifold. In some cases it may be driven by the selection and or up regulation of genes involved in efflux pump modulation or cell wall permeability. In one of our studies, we incidentally found bacteria with these genes were observed to dominate the microbial population after low ozone treatments; however, we did not evaluate the population for antibiotic resistance after the treatment. Given the frequency of the use of low dose disinfectants in aquaculture it is important to determine if this practice is exacerbating the issue of antibiotic resistance. We proposed to evaluate the impact of disinfectants on the resistance of a fish pathogen (Aeromonas hydrophila). We will use a laboratory model with this bacteria and oxytetracycline, a commonly used antibiotic in aquaculture, to understand the underlying mechanisms for the co-resistance. As well we propose to assess the effect of disinfectant treatments on the broader microbial community in fish farms in Hong Kong. The findings of this research may highlight a significant issue with a very common management strategy in aquaculture, which needs to be address if we are to improve the sustainability of fish farming in Asia. 低劑量的消毒劑, 如氯、臭氧和過氧化氫, 在水產養殖中常用於治療魚類體表細菌感染, 並降低水中細菌水平, 以避免需要抗生素治療的全身性感染。儘管使用消毒劑被提倡成減少使用抗生素藥物的一種手段, 研究顯示這些生物殺滅劑可能會在細菌群體中選擇出對抗生素的耐藥性。 這種耐藥性的機制可能是多方面的。在某些情況下, 可能是由於選擇和/或上調參與外排泵調節或細胞壁滲透性的基因。在我們的一項研究中, 我們意外發現帶有這些基因的細菌在低臭氧處理後成為優勢菌群; 然而, 我們沒有在低臭氧處理後評估細菌的抗生素耐藥性。 鑑於低劑量消毒劑在水產養殖中的使用頻率, 確認這種做法會否加劇抗生素耐藥性問題是很重要的。我們擬評估消毒劑對魚類病原體(Aeromonas hydrophila)耐藥性的影響。我們將使用這種細菌和一種常用於水產養殖的抗生素−四環素作為實驗模型, 以了解耐藥性的基本機制。同時, 我們還擬評估消毒劑處理對香港魚場更廣泛微生物群落的影響。 這項研究的結果可能會突出水產養殖中一個非常常見的管理策略存在的重大問題 。如果我們要改善亞洲的魚類養殖的可持續性, 這個問題就必需得到解決。

11103224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11103224.value: ALDOB通过胰岛素受体通路影响beta细胞胰岛素分泌

11103424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11103424.value: 激活内皮细胞抑制低氧誘發的肺动脉高压的机制研究

11103424.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11103424.value: Dr He, Lei Dr Wang, Li

11103424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11103424.value: 肺動脈高壓是一種血管性疾病，影響所有年齡層的人，其中老年人的發病率較高。全球約有 2,500萬名肺動脈高血壓患者，他們大都患有慢性阻塞性肺病、睡眠呼吸暫停或間質性肺病。在美國，每位患者的治療費用估計為 8 萬美元，這筆費用對於許多發展中國家的患者來說是無法負擔的，對個人和社會都造成重大的經濟負擔。 內皮功能障礙、收縮力增加、肺動脈進行性不良重塑是肺動脈高壓發展的主要特徵。臨床上用於治療肺動脈高壓的藥物大多都是血管擴張劑，主要為輕度或中度肺動脈高壓患者提供不同程度的療效，對於晚期血管狹窄和嚴重肺動脈高壓患者的療效較差。因此，了解介導血管內皮功能障礙和肺血管狹窄的詳細機制，以找出新的標靶來開發更有效的治療肺動脈高血壓的藥物是非常重要的。 最近的證據顯示，轉錄因子EB (TFEB)在維持心血管功能上扮演著重要的角色。我們的初步研究結果顯示，在特發性肺動脈高血壓患者或缺氧誘發肺動脈高血壓小鼠的肺組織動脈內皮細胞以及在缺氧暴露的人類肺動脈內皮細胞中，TFEB表達均降低。因此，TFEB有可能是治療肺動脈高壓的潛在治療目標。基於這些觀察，我們假設內皮細胞TFEB 的活化有助於維持肺血管的健康功能和結構。在肺動脈高壓的發生與發展過程中，TFEB的缺乏在造成內皮功能障礙方面扮演了重要角色。為了驗證這個關鍵性的假設，我們的研究目標是：(1) 內皮TFEB在缺氧誘發的肺動脈高壓中的發病機理中的作用；(2) TFEB調節內皮素1和eNOS表達的機制；(3 ) TFEB乳酸化對其表現和功能的影響，以及其對缺氧誘發的肺動脈高壓中的發病機制的影響。 本研究旨於研究肺血管內皮細胞中TFEB表現與活性調控機制，並探討這些機制如何有助於維持肺動脈的正常功能與結構。此外，我們的目標是將TFEB發展為藥物篩選的潛在目標，以找出預防和治療肺動脈高壓的新候選藥物。

11103524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11103524.value: 了解人工耳蜗刺激中脈衝率和脈衝幅度調變之間的相互作用

11103524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11103524.value: Severely deaf patients who had their hearing restored with cochlear implants (CIs) perform substantially worse at pitch discrimination than their normally hearing peers, which impairs their ability to appreciate music, or to understand tonal languages like Chinese. Pitch is a perceptual quality created by the brain which is informed by two types of cues collected by the ear: place cues derive from the distribution of activity along the tonotopic array of the ear, while timing cues derive from an analysis of the precise distribution of auditory nerve action potential intervals. Current clinical CIs are very limited in delivering either cue. Place cues are limited by the fact that stimulating current spreads easily laterally along the tonotopic array, and this is hard to improve upon. Timing cues are limited because currently available CI stimulation strategies link the timing of electrical stimulus pulses to a fixed system clock instead of allowing it to vary smoothly to reflect the pitch period of incoming sounds. This limitation could more easily be lifted with better algorithms, but how much that might improve pitch perception remains unclear, because experiments on current CI users are necessarily performed on patients who have been desensitized by many months of stimulation in which pulse timing is uninformative. Experiments involving a gradual desensitization through prolonged training of volunteers indicate that significant gains are possible, but how far this could go remains unknown. Furthermore, experiments on temporal pitch coding are confounded by the fact that faster, and therefore higher-pitched, pulse trains also deliver more stimulus energy per unit time, and are therefore louder. Disambiguating pitch effects from loudness effects can be very difficult. Here we aim to overcome these limitations in two ways: firstly, by working on naive experimental animals who do not need to unlearn the effects of countless hours of stimulation with uninformative fixed pulse rates, and secondly, by using a novel experimental design in which we vary (modulate) both pulse rate and pulse amplitude simultaneously and independently, both in and out of phase. This enables us to characterize the effect of pulse rate changes on both pitch and loudness separately, and to isolate the pitch effects. In addition, we will perform recordings from the auditory midbrain of our animals to characterize the neural basis of the sensory discriminations made by our animals. Our results will be very valuable to designers of better CI stimulation strategies of the future. 透過人工耳蝸（CI）恢復聽力的重度耳聾患者在音高辨別方面的表現比聽力正常的同齡人明顯較差，並損害了他們欣賞音樂或理解中文等聲調語言的能力。音高是由大腦創造的感知元素，它受到耳朵收集的兩種類型線索的影響：位置線索源自耳蝸的音位陣列中活動的分佈，而時間線索源自於對聽神經動作電位間隔的精確分析。目前的臨床 CI 在提供任何一個線索的能力都非常有限。位置線索受限於刺激電流沿著音位陣列的橫向傳播，並且很難改進。時間線索受到限制則因為目前可用的 CI 刺激策略將電刺激脈衝的時間與固定的系統時鐘連結在一起，而不能讓它漸變以反映傳入聲音的音波週期。這種限制可以透過更好的演算法消除，但是因為對當前 CI 用戶的實驗必然是在因經過長期無資訊的脈衝計時刺激而脫敏的患者身上進行的，新演算法可以在多大程度上改善音調感知仍不清楚。透過對志願者進行長期培訓來逐步提高敏感性的實驗表明，這有可能取得顯著的成果，但可以進展的程度尚不明確。此外，關於時間音高編碼的實驗受到一個混淆因素的影響，即更快、因此更高音高的脈衝列也會在同一單位時間內提供更多的刺激能量，因此聲音更大。區分音高效應和響度效應可能非常困難。在這裡，我們的目標是透過兩種方式克服這些限制：首先，透過對無CI聽覺經驗的實驗動物進行研究，因為這些動物不需要消除無數小時的無資訊固定脈衝頻率刺激的影響，其次，透過使用一種新穎的實驗設計，在這個設計中，我們同時且獨立地同相和異相改變（調製）脈衝速率和脈衝幅度。這使我們能夠辨別脈衝率變化對音高和響度的影響，並單獨分離出音高效應。此外，我們將對我們的動物的聽覺中腦進行記錄，以建立我們的動物所做的感知辨別的神經基礎。我們的結果對未來CI刺激策略的設計者將非常有價值。

11104124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11104124.value: 添加原隻黑水虻幼蟲飼料對中國黃羽雞生長效率、腸道健康和新陳代謝的影響

11104124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11104124.value: Black soldier fly (BSF) farming offers an environmentally responsible solution to the food waste challenge Hong Kong and several other regions are facing because BSF larvae are highly efficient in upcycling waste into valuable protein-rich insect biomass. Dried larvae and larvae meal intended for animal feeding are currently available on the Hong Kong market, however, the local production volume and marketability of products are yet to be scaled up to make use of the waste recycling potential of the BSF farming sector. BSF larvae meal inclusion in the diet of Western broiler chicken enhanced the growth performance and feed efficiency and improved intestinal health due to their bioactive compounds. Chinese yellow-feather chicken, a dominant broiler breed in East Asia, could also benefit from BSF-based diets, however, this breed has a different digestive physiology and the effects of BSF-based diets on the growth performance, intestinal health, and metabolism in this native slow-growing breed have not yet been evaluated. Provisioning of whole larvae in addition to a basal diet seems to be the most practicable solution on local farms in this region. While increasing rates of whole larvae provisioning may improve intestinal health owing to an increasing supply of antimicrobial peptides and lauric acid, excessive amounts of chitin and fat can potentially hinder protein digestion and feed intake, respectively. Hence, this research hypothesizes that there is an optimal rate of whole larvae provisioning in yellow-feather chicken; and the objectives are to identify this optimal rate and characterize its effects on growth performance, intestinal health, and metabolism. The chicken will be fed increasing amounts of whole larvae in addition to a basal diet and serum markers of intestinal barrier integrity, liver function, protein metabolism, and oxidative stress will be measured. In a follow-up trial, an equivalent amount of larvae meal-based diet will be fed and in addition to the serum markers, the intestinal microbiome and the serum metabolome will be characterized. The outcome of this research will be the evaluation of the intestinal health effects and the maximum optimal larvae provisioning rate in yellow-feather chicken. Documenting beneficial production or health effects will encourage farmers to adopt alternative BSF-based nutritional strategies, supporting the demand-driven growth of the local BSF farming sector. Further, the outcomes of this research will benefit the local poultry producers and will help achieve sustainability, carbon neutrality, and circular economy goals. 黑水虻（BSF）養殖為香港和其他地區面臨的廚餘問題提供了一個環保的解決方法，因為BSF幼蟲能高效地將廢物轉化為有價值及富含蛋白質的昆蟲生物質。現時，香港市場上有用於動物飼料的幼蟲乾和幼蟲粉，然而，產品的本地產量和適銷性仍有待擴大，從而有效利用BSF養殖業的廢料回收潛力。在西式肉雞飼料中加入BSF幼蟲粉可提高生長和飼料效率，其生物活性化合物亦有助改善腸道健康。中國黃羽雞，是東亞地區一種主要肉雞品種，可以受益於BSF為主的飼料，然而，該品種具有不同的消化生理機能，基於BSF的飼料對這種本地生長緩慢品種的生長性能、腸道健康和新陳代謝的影響有待評估。基礎飲食上額外提供原隻幼蟲是可行的方案。雖然由於抗菌肽和月桂酸的含量隨額外提供的原隻幼蟲增加有助改善腸道健康，但過量的幾丁質和脂肪可能會阻礙蛋白質消化和採食量。因此，本研究假設黃羽雞存在最佳的原隻幼蟲及飼料比例;目標是確定最佳比例並辨明其對生長性能、腸道健康和新陳代謝的影響。除基礎飲食外，雞隻會被餵食越來越多的原隻幼蟲，並測量腸道屏障完整性、肝功能、蛋白質代謝和氧化應激的血清標誌物。在後續試驗中，將餵食等量的幼蟲粉飼料，除了血清標誌物外，亦會研究腸道微生物組和血清代謝組。這項研究將評估黃羽雞的腸道健康在最大及最佳黑水虻幼蟲飼料含量下的影響。有利生產或有益健康的記錄將鼓勵農民採用基於BSF的替代營養策略，支持本地BSF農業的發展。此外，這項研究的結果有助本地家禽養殖戶、實現可持續性、碳中和和迴圈經濟目標。

11104524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11104524.value: 膽囊收縮素在基底外側杏仁核 GABA 能和谷氨酸突觸可塑性中的作用

11104524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11104524.value: Memories are stored in the neuronal network through synaptic plasticity, e.g., long-term potentiation (LTP). Emotional memories formed after an aversive event are one of the major forms of learning and memory formation that are necessary for the survival of animals and humans. However, chronic re-experiencing of aversive events can trigger emotion-related states, including anxiety, post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), and depression. Continuous neuroplasticity in the basolateral amygdala (BLA) is pivotal in regulating emotion-related states. We understand cholecystokinin (CCK) and its receptors are critically implicated in emotion-related conditions (1-3). We disclosed that CCK mediates LTP in both excitatory synapses (eLTP) and inhibitory synapses (iLTP) in the auditory cortex (4) (5-7). However, whether and how CCK facilitates the synaptic plasticity of both GABAergic and glutamatergic synapses in the BLA remains unclear. We have recently discovered that CCK-positive (CCK+) glutamatergic neurons in the entorhinal cortex (EC) project to BLA and facilitate the formation of eLTP in the BLA (8, 9), and that GABAergic and glutamatergic neurons showed opposite roles in regulating emotion-related behaviour (10). Further investigation of how CCK+ EC neurons project to glutamatergic or GABAergic neurons in the BLA is required. We hypothesize that 1) the CCK-positive EC neurons strongly project to CCKBR-expressing glutamatergic neurons in the BLA and mediate the eLTP, which facilitates emotion-related states. 2) the local CCK-GABA neurons in the BLA mediate iLTP through CCKCR (GPR173). 3) CCKCR antagonist impairs the iLTP formation, while CCKBR antagonist impairs eLTP formation in the BLA. Preliminary fiber photometry recording results revealed that stimulation of CCK+ EC neurons activates both glutamatergic and GABAergic neurons in the BLA but the glutamatergic neurons showed rapid and strong activation compared with GABAergic neurons. In this project, we aim to reveal the modulatory mechanism of the CCK+ EC projection on both glutamatergic and GABAergic neurons in the BLA and the role of local CCK-GABA neurons in iLTP induction in the BLA. Other preliminary results have shown high-frequency stimulation (HFS) of GABAergic neurons in the BLA inhibits the glutamatergic neurons. Activation of CCK-GABA neurons at high frequency triggers the iLTP in the BLA. CCK-facilitated iLTP and eLTP are novel mechanisms of neuroplasticity. A deep understanding of the related mechanism will lead to clinical applications. Induction of iLTP formation, suppression of eLTP formation, or both in the BLA may benefit patients suffering from emotion-related disorders. 記憶透過突觸可塑性儲存在神經元網路中，例如長時程增強（LTP）。其中厭惡類事件刺激後形成的情緒記憶是學習和記憶形成的主要形式之一，這對動物和人類的生存起著至關重要的作用。但長期重複經歷厭惡事件的刺激可能會導致情緒類相關疾病，包括焦慮、創傷後壓力症候群（PTSD）和憂鬱。值得注意的是，基底外側杏仁核（BLA）的神經持續可塑性對於調節情緒相關疾病至關重要。另外我們已經發現膽囊收縮素(CCK)及其受體與情緒疾病有密切關係(1-3)。在聽覺皮質中，CCK對興奮性LTP (eLTP)和抑制性LTP (iLTP)的形成都發揮重要的調控作用(4-7)。然而，CCK在BLA中是否能夠以及如何調控GABA能和谷氨酸能的突觸可塑性尚不清楚。 在我們的近期研究中發現，內嗅皮質(EC)中的CCK陽性(CCK+)谷氨酸能神經元投射到BLA，且能夠促進BLA中eLTP的形成(8, 9)，另外GABA能和谷氨酸能神經元在調節情緒疾病中發揮完全相反的作用(10)。因此，對於CCK+神經元從EC投射到BLA中的谷氨酸能神經元或GABA能神經元的機制需要進一步深入研究。據此，我們作出以下假設：1) EC的CCK+神經元主要投射到BLA中表達CCKBR的谷氨酸能神經元，並介導eLTP的形成，從而緩解情緒類相關疾病。 2） BLA局部的CCK-GABA神經元透過作用於CCKCR（GPR173）介導iLTP的形成。 3) 在BLA中，CCKCR拮抗劑能夠抑制iLTP形成，而CCKBR拮抗劑抑制eLTP的形成。初期光纖記錄結果表明，特異性刺激EC中的CCK+神經元時，BLA中的谷氨酸能和GABA能神經元都能夠被激活，但與GABA能神經元相比，谷氨酸能神經元表現出快速且強烈的活化反應。在本計畫中，我們旨在揭示EC中的CCK+神經元投射到BLA的谷氨酸能和GABA能神經元的調節機制，以及BLA局部的CCK-GABA神經元在iLTP形成中的作用。另外，我們的早期研究發現，特異性高頻刺激(HFS) BLA局部的GABA能神經元會抑制谷氨酸能神經元，特異性高頻刺激BLA局部的CCK-GABA神經元能夠誘發iLTP的形成。 CCK促進iLTP和eLTP的形成是神經可塑性的新機制。深入了解相關機制將有助於其在臨床上的應用。在BLA中誘導iLTP的形成或抑制eLTP形成或兩者同時，都將可能有益於情緒相關疾病的患者。

11104724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11104724.value: 納米和微塑料对海洋雙殼類的挑战：免疫反應和單細胞RNA測序

11104724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11104724.value: 塑膠污染在水環境中無處不在，已成為世界上最嚴重的環境問題之一。目前，海洋表面有超過 5 萬億個塑膠碎片，聯合國已將海洋中的塑膠污染列為全球十大日益嚴重的環境問題之一。此外，香港海域亦受珠江口影響，受到微塑膠污染，塑膠占都市固體廢物總量的21%。貽貝和牡蠣等海洋雙殼類動物是河口和沿海強大的濾水器。因此，它們將不可避免地面臨微塑膠和納米塑膠（MNPs）的挑戰，這些微塑膠和納米塑膠很容易被攝入、積累並沿著食物鏈進一步轉移。這些雙殼類具有開放的循環系統，其特定的血細胞具有對環境挑戰的免疫反應，並表現出顯著的差異反應。雖然人們對MNPs與海洋生物的相互作用存在相當大的擔憂，但仍然存在許多緊迫的問題，例如血細胞參與對MNPs的免疫反應的作用。對於不同的血細胞亞群這些問題變得更加緊迫。新技術的最新發展使我們能夠解決這些緊迫的問題。在這個项目中，我们將新型生物成像技術與尖端分子技術相結合，研究海洋雙殼類動物對MNPs的免疫反應。本項目的具體目標是：1）研究不同條件下MNPs的生物積累和血細胞組成反應;2）研究血細胞的亞細胞運輸和免疫反應及毒性;3）研究血細胞的分子反應和細胞通訊。我們將在急性和慢性暴露下進行體內和體外研究，在雙殼類暴露期間使用環境相關的 MNP 濃度。合成的不同性質的聚集誘導發光MNPs可以通過共聚焦顯微鏡（用於細胞成像）或高解析度近紅外成像系統（用於雙殼類組織）直接觀察，對 MNP 挑戰的細胞反應進行成像。此外，我們將首次通過進行單細胞RNA序列分析來揭示細胞和分子對MNPs的反應。該项目將能夠揭示在環境現實條件下雙殼類對MNPs的免疫反應。研究結果將有助於我們理解海洋生物對MNPs引起的環境壓力的免疫反應和適應性，並確定MNPs暴露的潛在特異性生物標誌物。

11105524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11105524.value: 通過兩種近源線蟲的性染色體重組品係定位雄性不育相關基因

11105524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11105524.value: Speciation is the process of formation and maintenance of species through the evolution of reproductive isolation. Intrinsic postzygotic barriers are built from hybrid defects like sterility or inviability which can result from the conflict between haplotypes. The pair of Caenorhabditis briggsae and C. nigoni are among the most closely related species within the nematode genus Caenorhabditis. Wild-type C. briggsae and C. nigoni can produce fertile F1 hybrid females, but the male progenies are either inviable or sterile. By replacing a small proportion of C. nigoni X chromosome to the syntenic region in C. briggsae, we got a homozygous introgression strain (LRS129) to break the hybridization barrier by rescuing the F1 male fertility. This model gave us an opportunity to monitor the competition of two interspecies haplotypes during long-term hybridization, which will help us understand the mechanism of speciation in diploid animals. In the meantime, another introgression strain, LRS134, which only holds a slightly different introgression region from LRS129, can not rescue the F1 male sterility. The comparison of the two strains gives us a model to study the mechanism of hybrid male sterility. In this study, we propose delineating the hybridization landscape of C. briggsae and C. nigoni using the F1 hybrid from C. briggsae male and X-linked LRS129 female. We will also map and validate the X-linked gene responsible for F1 hybrid male sterility. The findings will provide mechanistic insights into hybrid incompatibility related speciation and genome evolution after hybridization.

11200124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11200124.value: 低運行複雜度的交流潮流方程神經網絡求解方案：高電壓解與潮流方程平衡性

11200124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11200124.value: 可再生能源的不断并网和需求侧的创新使现代电力系统成为一个复杂且动态的系统，需要持续平衡发电和用电需求。交流潮流方程是维持这种平衡的核心，它描述了电力系统在正常稳态运行时的电力流动，求解这些方程对于电力系统的运行和规划至关重要。然而，这些方程的高维性和非线性特征使得传统的迭代求解方法计算成本高昂，难以满足实时电力系统运行（如故障分析和状态估计）的需求，进而影响电网的效率和可靠性。 近年来，神经网络作为一种强大的工具，已被应用于求解各种交流潮流方程。其基本思路是利用神经网络强大的函数逼近能力，学习从输入到解的映射关系，从而快速生成针对新输入的高质量解。与传统的迭代求解器相比，神经网络方法在速度方面表现出显著优势。然而，在开发基于神经网络的潮流方程求解方案时，仍面临着一些独特的挑战： 高电压解的缺失： 对于相同的输入，非线性交流潮流方程通常会产生多个数学上有效的解，但只有一个解与实际电网的稳态平衡相匹配，被称为“高电压”解。现有的神经网络方法往往难以区分这些多重解，无法始终如一地生成具有物理意义的高电压解，这限制了其实际应用。 潮流方程不平衡： 由于神经网络预测的固有误差，其生成的解可能无法严格满足潮流方程，特别是在零注入的内部节点处，这在物理上是不合理的。在电网运行中使用这些不平衡的解可能会导致系统不稳定或巨额经济损失。 本项目旨在解决上述两个挑战，开发出能够准确高效地求解交流潮流方程的神经网络方案。 理论基础： 我们将从理论上证明从输入到高电压解的映射是唯一的且具有良好的数学性质。在此基础上，我们将设计高效的神经网络架构，有效地学习这种高维但单值的映射关系，并提供理论上的性能保证。 算法设计： 我们将利用交流潮流方程自身的结构特征来改进神经网络的设计，确保最终的解在关键的内部节点处满足潮流平衡方程。此外，我们将结合先进的嵌入式训练方法，使神经网络能够处理灵活的电网拓扑结构，包括线路或发电机开关等情况。 实际应用： 我们将与领先的人工智能企业和大型电力公司合作，利用真实世界的电力系统数据对所开发的方案进行评估，推动研究成果的实际应用。 目前，我们已经取得了一些初步成果，包括在一定条件下证明了从输入到高电压交流潮流方程解的映射的唯一性，并确定了一种高效的神经网络架构。我们将继续努力，为快速准确地求解交流潮流方程建立更加稳固的理论基础，并开发出高效的神经网络算法，为现代电力系统的可持续发展贡献力量。

11200624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11200624.value: 建立用於聚光太陽能應用的二元熔融氯化物鹽的熱力學性質數據集：使用機器學習策略

11200624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11200624.value: 太陽能已經取代了部分目前電網中使用的化石燃料。配備高溫熔鹽再加熱裝置的聚光太陽能發電（CSP）可以持續產生過剩電力。然而它們的性能在很大程度上取決於熱傳遞流體的熱力學性質，包括密度、熱容量和熱導率等熱性能，以及粘度和自擴散係數等傳輸性能。硝酸鹽混合物是應用於全規模CSP的商業熱傳遞流體，其主要缺點是分解溫度相對較低，通常不高於550℃。熔融氯化物鹽及其混合物是第三代CSP中有前途的熱傳遞流體候選者，具有低成本和高熱穩定性的優勢；準確的熔融氯化物鹽的熱力學性質數據集對於開發第三代CSP工廠和運行熔鹽核反應堆至關重要。儘管文獻中報告了大量數據，但由於固有的實驗困難，文獻結果的可靠性值得懷疑。基於第一原理的分子模擬方案是一種有前途的預測工具，但在準確描述氯化物鹽的分子相互作用方面因為經常缺乏勢函數也面臨障礙。 這個項目旨在通過機器學習策略，建立可靠的鹼金屬氯化物鹽及其混合物的熱力學性質數據集，以解決上述挑戰。主要研究課題如下：(1)使用分子動力學的機器學習來構建感興趣的二元熔融氯化物鹽的勢能函數，從而進行直接模擬；(2)應用主動學習框架來比較和驗證文獻數據與數值結果；(3)將這兩種方案應用於建立一個平台，以設立第三代聚光太陽能（Gen 3 CSP）應用所需的熔融氯化物鹽的熱力學性質數據庫。擴展機器學習能力以納入添加納米顆粒和外部電場的影響。本項目旨在推進熔融氯化物鹽熱力學性質的知識前沿，並提供一個包括主動學習在內的框架，用於探索不適合實驗探索的其他熔鹽。 計畫的成功將為第三代 CSP 技術的開發以及將如此開發的框架應用於其他感興趣的熔鹽系統做出重大貢獻。此外，計畫將產生的長期影響包括：（1）促進再生能源現場應用急需的先進儲熱技術發展；（2）加速低成本、高效熔鹽材料和系統科學的發展，帶來巨大的社會效益和經濟效益；（3）展示如何應用人工智慧技術有效設計新型熔鹽傳熱和儲存材料。

11201024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11201024.value: 具有解耦陣列單元和輻射方向圖保形的 MIMO 貼片天線陣列研究

11201024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11201024.value: The advent of the Internet of Things (IoT) and the proliferation of mobile devices have precipitated an unprecedented surge in the data capacity demands on wireless communication systems. To address this, Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) antenna systems have been widely implemented, enhancing the signal-to-noise ratio of the channel and, consequently, the channel capacity. This technology is pivotal not only in current 5G but also in the anticipated 6G wireless networks. A paramount challenge in MIMO antenna design lies in mitigating the mutual coupling between antenna elements, a phenomenon that often leads to suboptimal system performance. Existing decoupling techniques, while effective to a degree, typically result in a distortion of the radiation pattern. This distortion, in turn, affects the performance of the MIMO system, leading to a diminished channel capacity. This project aims to pioneer innovative port-decoupling methodologies that not only address mutual coupling but also preserve the broadside radiation pattern of the patch antenna elements. Termed “Preserved Broadside Radiation Pattern” (PBRP), this technique is applicable to a general two-dimensional (m×n) patch antenna array. In its implementation, a layer of non-active (dummy) patch elements will be incorporated to envelop the outermost array elements, equilibrating radiation characteristics across all active array elements. The patch shape and array parameters will undergo optimization to achieve optimal performance. The inclusion of dummy elements inherently enlarges the footprint of the MIMO antenna. To avoid this problem, a second PBRP patch array is proposed. This method employs shorting walls to suppress element couplings, ensuring minimal interference between adjacent antenna elements. Finally, the project will investigate a third PBRP array, utilizing a shared-element strategy. This approach strategically reuses certain antenna elements for different sub-arrays, resulting in a highly compact MIMO antenna array. Guidelines will be provided to facilitate designs of the proposed arrays. 物聯網(IoT)的出現以及移動設備的普及使得用戶對無線通信系統的信道容量需求空前增長。為應對這一挑戰,多輸入多輸出(MIMO)天線系統被提出並廣泛使用以提高信道的信噪比，進而提升通信信道的數據容量。這項技術不僅在當前的5G網絡中至關重要,在未來的6G無線網絡中也同樣重要。 MIMO天線設計中的一個關鍵難題是在於抑製天線單元之間的耦合，而不理想的耦合效應通常會導致系統的通信性能下降。現有的解耦技術雖能在一定程度上緩解此類耦合,但通常也會導致單元輻射方向圖的畸變。天線單元的輻射方向圖畸變反過來會影響MIMO天線系統的輻射性能，從而使通信系統的信道容量惡化。 本項目旨在研究新穎的天線端口解耦方法，既能解決天線單元間互耦問題，也能確保貼片天線單元的天頂輻射方向圖保形。這種稱為“天頂輻射方向圖保形”(PBRP)的解耦技術可推廣到一般的二維(m×n)貼片天線陣列。在具體設計中，最外圍的寄生天線單元被用來包裹最邊緣的陣列單元，使所有單元的輻射環境保持一致。本項目也將對貼片形狀和陣列結構參數進行優化，以實現最佳的MIMO天線輻射性能。 寄生天線單元的引入會不可避免的增大MIMO天線的口徑尺寸。為了解決這一問題，本項目將提出第二種PBRP貼片天線陣列解耦方法。該方法將利用短路墻來抑製天線單元的互耦，從而在不使用寄生單元的基礎上確保相鄰天線單元之間的耦合最小。 最後，本項目將研究第三種PBRP解耦天線陣列，該天線陣列將采用共享單元結構的設計策略。這種設計通過巧妙地重復利用天線單元的部分結構於不同的子陣列，從而獲得具有高度緊湊性的MIMO解耦天線陣列。 本項目將提供具體的設計引導以獲得上述各個MIMO天線陣列。

11201524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11201524.value: 構網及跟網功率變換器的複雜行為與失穩機制

11201524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11201524.value: The penetration of renewable energy sources (RES), driven by global efforts to mitigate global warming, has been increasing in recent power system developments. The power generated from RES is converted and delivered to the grids through grid-connected converters. However, these converters have a significant impact on the grids' dynamics and stability, leading to power interruptions, oscillations, and instability in connected subsystems. Grid-connected converters can generally be classified as grid-following and grid-forming converters (GFLCs and GFMCs). To facilitate the integration of distributed RES, these converters can cluster together to form an islanded microgrid. The behavior of grid-connected converters and multi-converter islanded microgrids can have a significant impact on system stability. To better understand the complexity of GFLCs and GFMCs, several critical challenges need to be addressed. Firstly, the impact of dc-link controls and non-smooth components on the transient stability of GFLCs and GFMCs has not been thoroughly studied, and the similarities and differences in their nonlinear behaviors remain unexplored. Secondly, the small-signal and transient stability of an islanded microgrid with multiple GFMCs and GFLCs is not fully understood. Thirdly, the use of distributed secondary control in multi-converter islanded microgrids and coordination of multiple microgrids as a large islanded system using a two-layer distributed control have not been extensively studied in terms of their impact on the system's nonlinear dynamics. This limits the development of more effective methods to enhance system stability. Lastly, future power grids will be dominated by GFLCs and GFMCs, and the complex behavior of these converters is the root cause of all instability events. However, the current classical framework does not adequately consider this complex behavior. Therefore, it is crucial to develop a new framework for studying the complex behavior and stability of converter-based systems. Based on these considerations, our proposal has four objectives. The first objective begins with a study of the complex behavior of a GFLC/GFMC connected to an infinite bus. The second objective is to investigate the complex behavior of a multi-converter islanded microgrid using only primary control. The third objective is to analyze the complex behavior of multi-converter islanded microgrids and multi-microgrid islanded systems using distributed controls. Finally, the fourth objective is to propose a new framework for comprehensive analysis of the complex behavior of GFMCs and GFLCs. 這個專案的首要目標是研究單個轉換器與無限總線相連時的複雜行為，這將有助於識別慢尺度不穩定現象的物理起源。接著，我們將探討具有主控制的多轉換器孤島微電網的複雜行為和失穩機制。此外，此專案還探索了具有分散次級控制的多轉換器孤島微電網以及具有雙層分散控制的多微電網孤島系統的複雜行為。最後，此專案旨在制定一個框架，用於研究構網轉換器和跟網轉換器的複雜行為。

11201624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11201624.value: 微流控细胞淋浴装置分選固有耐藥肿瘤细胞

11201624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11201624.value: 癌症復發的主要原因之一是腫瘤內的異質性。這意味著，腫瘤中不同的細胞群體對化療和針對性藥物的反應各不相同。特別是在口腔鱗狀細胞癌和結腸直腸癌中，我們還沒有足夠了解這些異質性，無法確定最佳的治療標誌物。在這些癌症中，雖然有藥物可以初步抑制腫瘤生長，但這些效果通常是短暫的，而且總會有少量抗藥性細胞存活下來，導致癌症復發。這些細胞對多種藥物產生抗藥性，最終導致患者死亡。目前，缺乏一種高通量的設備來長期培養單個細胞並分析其對藥物的反應。傳統的單細胞測試方法，如多參數流式細胞術，無法隔離細胞進行培養，使得測量細胞的固有抗性變得困難。最近，有研究利用微流體技術封裝單個細胞進行短期培養，但由於不能長時間提供營養和排除廢物，這種技術的應用受到限制。 我們計劃開發一種新型的微流控細胞淋浴裝置，利用多階段側向位移陣列來交換滴液中的液體，這將使單個細胞能在滴液中長期培養，並進行高通量的藥物抗性分析。這一設備將在三個階段進行開發：首先，細胞和藥物將被共同封裝入滴液中；然後，滴液中的介質和藥物將定期更新；最後，利用流式細胞術從滴液中提取並篩選固有抗藥性細胞。這項研究將有助於我們理解口腔鱗狀細胞癌和結腸直腸癌的腫瘤異質性，開發出一種能夠有效分選固有耐藥性細胞的技術，從而為精確癌症提供支持。

11201924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11201924.value: 高階複雜網路同步、控制與穩健性

11201924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11201924.value: 複雜網絡研究在過去的二十年裡得到了快速的發展，取得了豐碩的成果，為網絡科學及其應用做出了貢獻，並且正在快速發展到今天更高層次的研究水平。系統工程領域複雜動態網絡研究的典型主題包括網絡控制、網絡同步和網絡魯棒性研究。 本項目的 PI 是上述領域重點研究主題的少數先驅之一。更準確地說，PI 及其同事建立了第一個網絡同步標準，並且最早以最佳同步性來描述複雜網絡的最佳結構； PI及其同事是最早研究複雜網絡牽制可控性的人之一，並獲得了MIMO網絡可控性的充要條件，也為MIMO牽制控制器的設計提供了一種示意性方法； PI 牽制是透過破壞節點和/或刪除邊的方式研究複雜網絡的可控性魯棒性和抵禦惡意攻擊的先驅，並為評估網絡魯棒性提出了彈性方法。 儘管取得了成功，但上述研究成果是使用經典圖論工具針對傳統複雜網絡取得的。本項目進一步將當前高階複雜網絡的研究推向更高水平，這需要代數拓撲理論和涉及高階單純形的方法等更強大的工具，使用基於歐拉特徵指標和佩蒂數等技術。 具體來說，本項目有三個目標： 目標1：開發高階網絡同步準則與方法 目標2：發展高階網絡牽制可控性判據與方法 目標3：研究高階網絡的結構與可控魯棒性 基於PI成熟的分析技術和計算方法，本計畫基礎紮實，前景廣闊，完成後將對網絡科學與工程領域做出重大貢獻。

11202124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11202124.value: 透過射頻能量收集的非接觸式側通道攻擊：隱私洩漏與防禦

11202124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11202124.value: 射頻能量收集 (Radio Frequency Energy Harvesting, RFEH) 是一項新興可利用環境電磁波發電的技術，很快就會部署在數百萬個物聯網設備中。然而我們的初步研究表明，它可以被利用作為一種新的側通道來損害用户隱私。背後原理是，使用者的行動裝置活動（例如觀看 YouTube 和 Netflix）會產生影響周圍環境中的電磁無線電訊號的無線流量，因此可以在收集的訊號（即電壓）中留下可區分的指紋。如果訊號被惡意攻擊者獲取，使用者的隱私資訊就會被洩漏。因此，RFEH 技術是一把雙刃劍。從能量收集的角度來看，收集到的能量可用於為低能耗物聯網設備供電，因此無需更換電纜和電池。相反，從隱私角度來看，收集的能量包含用户的敏感訊息，為推斷用户的行動裝置活動創造了可能性。這帶來了巨大的安全和隱私風險，為此，本項目將首次系統性地研究針對新側通道的資訊外洩和相應對策。首先，我們將研究一個理論模型來解釋使用者的行動裝置活動與收集的能量之間的數學關係。基於這些理論結果，我們將設計一個全面系統的旁路攻擊框架，以瞭解新攻擊的威脅。利用這些發現，我們將設計有效的防禦技術來抵擋新的攻擊。最後，我們將對系統進行原型設計並進行廣泛的實驗來評估理論模型的有效性、攻擊框架的性能以及防禦措施的有效性。這個項目是非常重要的因為安全管理智慧空間和保護用户隱私的需求是迫切的。許多配備RFEH的現成物聯網產品已經滲透到日常生活中，而且這種情況還在不斷升級。此項目將為探討RFEH資訊外洩問題奠定理論基礎，提供有效對策，推動網路安全科學前沿發展。它還將提高公眾對新側通道攻擊的認識，為配備RFEH的安全物聯網系統普及鋪平道路。

11202224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11202224.value: 邁向智慧運維：一種基于故障知識圖譜學習框架

11202224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11202224.value: Operations and Maintenance (O&M) optimization involves the analysis of historical failure data and corresponding maintenance actions to enhance the performance of engineering systems. This process fundamentally relies on the quantity and quality of failure data gathered over time. Knowledge Graph—a tool that graphically represents semantics by articulating entities and their relationships—has been recently suggested to encapsulate failure information and associated maintenance actions derived from the failure data, thereby creating Failure Knowledge Graphs (FKGs) for engineering systems. FKGs serve as the foundation of O&M investigation because the breadth and depth of understanding of engineering systems’ failures and maintenance hinge on the thoroughness of failure data analysis and the precision of failure information extraction. However, the rapid accumulation of failure data, particularly textual maintenance logs pertaining to failures and maintenance, presents a significant challenge to the traditional approaches for manual construction of the FKG. To this end, the project aims to propose an intelligent FKG learning framework powered by Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques for decision support during routine O&M activities of engineering systems. The proposed framework will be able to extract critical failure and maintenance information automatically and intelligently from field-collected failure data, accompanied by an effective online updating mechanism. A series of intelligent NLP-based algorithms will be first proposed to extract failure and maintenance information automatically. They will be able to fulfill the full demand for element identification and relationship reasoning, including FKG initialization, extension, and updating. Subsequently, a mirrored Bayesian Network (BN) mapping concept and its solving algorithms will be presented, including the mapping algorithm from FKG to BN and the causal-based inference algorithm for BN reasoning. The proposed mapping concept and its corresponding algorithms enable information inferences, updating, and transformation to the FKG, recommending the most appropriate maintenance actions, in response to failures. The feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed intelligent FKG-based learning framework will be validated by failure data collected from operating wind farms. A systematic FKG for both onshore and offshore wind turbines will be issued from this project. The outcomes of this project will benefit both industry and academia, providing a novel systematic framework and operational procedure for failure data analysis and FKG construction. The proposed framework exhibits high-level intelligence, which will further advance the field of O&M optimization. 运维优化涉及对历史故障数据及相应维修措施的分析，以此提高工程系统的可靠性。这个过程依赖故障数据的数量和质量，近年来学者们利用知识图谱（一种以图形的方式通过阐明实体及其关系来表示语义的工具）为工程系统创建故障知识图谱（FKG）。随着故障数据的快速积累，特别是与故障和维护相关的文本维护日志的快速积累，FKG构建的传统方法面临着重大挑战。为此，该项目旨在提出一种基于自然语言处理（NLP）技术的智能FKG学习框架，所提出的框架能够从现场收集的故障数据中自动智能地提取关键故障和维护信息，用于工程系统日常运维活动中的决策支持。在这个框架中，我们提出基于自然语言处理的智能算法来自动提取故障和维护信息，它们能够满足实体识别和关系推理的全部需求，包括知识图谱的初始化、扩展和更新。随后，提出镜像贝叶斯网络（BN）映射概念及其求解算法，包括从FKG到BN的映射算法以及用于BN推理的基于因果的推理算法。所提出的映射概念及其相应的算法可以对FKG进行信息推断、更新和转换，从而针对故障推荐最合适的维护操作。该项目的成果将惠及工业界和学术界，为故障数据分析和FKG构建提供新颖的系统框架和操作流程，具有实际意义。

11202724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11202724.value: 适用于先进反应堆稠密栅燃料棒束的两相流两群漂移流与相界面浓度模型开发

11202724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11202724.value: Thermal power generation burns fossil fuels such as coal, oil, and natural gas and uses their thermal energy to generate electricity, which emits carbon dioxide in the process. On the other hand, nuclear power generation uses the heat generated when uranium fuel undergoes nuclear fission to generate electricity. It does not emit carbon dioxide during the power generation process, just like solar and wind power generation. Nuclear power generation is one of the best approaches for power generation in terms of preventing global warming. One of the challenges in nuclear power generation is the accumulation of transuranium elements (TRU) as a byproduct of burning uranium fuel. It takes about 100,000 years for the radio-toxicity of nuclear waste containing TRU to decay to the same level as that of uranium ore, which is a natural resource. (Radio-toxicity is an index of radiation intensity weighted by the effect of each radioactive isotope on the human body.) An advanced nuclear reactor concept that uses a tight-lattice fuel bundle has been proposed to solve this problem. The tight-lattice fuel bundle design increases the neutron energy in the reactor core, thereby decreasing the amount of TRU for the same level of power generation. Coolant channels between fuel rods are narrowed to reduce the volume fraction of coolant in the core. Additionally, by utilizing the characteristics of boiling water reactors, in which the coolant water boils to steam and the density of hydrogen nuclei decreases, calculations show that even in light water reactors, neutron energy can be increased, and plutonium breeding is possible. Design and licensing processes require extensive numerical simulations of gas and liquid dynamic behaviors in the tight-lattice core fuel bundle, which directly impact the nuclear reactor safety and performance. Numerical simulation codes are based on theoretically derived mass, momentum, and energy conservation equations. Constitutive equations need to match the number of variables with the number of equations in the simulation codes. Constitutive equations are used to estimate two-phase flow parameters, which cannot be determined purely theoretically. The accuracy and robustness of constitutive equations significantly impact the fidelity of numerical simulation capability. The proposed project aims at developing key constitutive equations: the two-group drift-flux model and the interfacial area model for a tight-lattice fuel bundle in a square channel box. The developed models will substantially improve the fidelity of numerical simulation codes, which significantly contributes to safe and economical nuclear reactor design. 传统火电厂将诸如煤炭、石油和天然气等化石燃料燃烧所产生的热量转化为电能，在电力生产过程中向大气排放大量二氧化碳。核电厂将铀燃料裂变所释放的热量转化为电能，与风能、水力发电一样，在电力生产过程中零碳排放。核能是缓解温室效应最佳的电力生产方式之一。 核能发电面临的挑战之一是铀燃料燃烧所产生的副产物—超铀元素(TRU)的积累。含有TRU的核废料放射性毒性大约需要10万年才能衰减到与自然铀矿石相同的水平(放射性毒性是一种辐射强度指数，按每种放射性同位素对人体的影响加权计算)。在先进反应堆的概念设计中，通过使用稠密栅燃料组件来解决这一问题。稠密栅燃料组件可以增加反应堆中子能量，从而可以在相同功率条件下显著降低TRU的生成量。 相比于常规燃料组件，稠密栅燃料组件内冷却剂流道更窄，从而降低了堆芯内冷却剂的体积份额。此外，冷却剂在沸水堆中沸腾，生成的蒸汽-水混合物降低了氢核密度。计算表明，即使在轻水堆中，稠密栅燃料组件所增加的中子能量都足以使钚的增殖成为可能。 使用先进燃料组件可以提高反应堆性能，增强反应堆安全性。稠密栅燃料组件在设计和授权过程中，需要开展大量组件内的气液两相流动特性数值模拟。模拟代码基于质量、动量和能量守恒方程的理论推导建立。模拟需要使用本构方程封闭守恒方程，本构方程的数量等于待求解变量数量减去守恒方程数量。用来计算两相流参数的本构方程无法使用纯理论推导的方式获得。本构方程的精度和鲁棒性显著影响数值仿真结果的保真度 该项目旨在开发关键的本构方程： 适用于方形排列稠密栅燃料棒束流道内两群漂移流和相界面浓度模型。本项目所开发的模型将显著提高数值模拟代码的保真度，有助于更安全、更经济的先进反应堆的设计研发。

11202824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11202824.value: 数字孪生边缘计算中的移动感知智能服务

11202824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11202824.value: Mobile edge computing (MEC) is envisioned as a promising paradigm for delay-sensitive service provisioning. With billions of IoT devices being connected to the Internet, more and more services provided by MEC networks are intelligent services that are machine-learning based inference services. It thus becomes crucial to provide accurate inference services while meeting stringent user service delay requirements. Orthogonal to the MEC, digital twin (DT) is another enabling technology to revolutionize many fields, including autonomous driving, healthcare, education, and smart city. The global DT industry is forecast to grow to $73.5 billion in 2027 and $125.7 billion in 2030. Empowered by the DT technology, intelligent services will become more accurate through continuous training on their inference models, using the updated DT source data of the inference models. The study of intelligent services in DT-empowered MEC networks now is growing interest. However, existing methods and techniques of service provisioning are not applicable to intelligent services due to lack of continuous training on inference models. New theories, algorithms and techniques thus are urgently needed. This project will investigate mobility-aware intelligent services in a DT-empowered MEC network under the mobility of objects and users. Since the quality of each intelligent service is determined by the accuracy of its inference model, while the accuracy of each inference model is determined by the freshness of its source DT data that is achieved through synchronizations between the DTs and their objects. Considering the mobility of both objects and users, accurate inference service provisioning poses several challenges: (1) how to develop a metric to capture the accuracy of inference models? (2) Due to limited bandwidth resource, should which objects upload their updates to maximize the accumulative accuracy of inference models? (3) How to strive for nontrivial trades-off between the accumulative freshness of inference models and the cost to achieve the freshness? (4) should which resolution of an inference model be chosen to meet the service delay requirement of its user? (5) how to develop effective prediction mechanisms to accurately predict the volume of the update data generated by each object, and the number of containers of different resolutions for each inference model needed? This project will develop a suite of novel solutions to mobility-aware intelligent services in DT-empowered MEC networks. It will contribute substantially to enhance our understanding on core technologies and challenges of inference services. It will also contribute to devise performance-guaranteed algorithms and innovative prediction mechanisms. 移动边缘计算 (MEC) 被认为是延迟敏感的有前途的范例 服务提供。随着数十亿物联网设备连接到互联网，更多 MEC网络提供的更多服务是机器学习的智能服务基于推理的服务。因此，提供准确的推理变得至关重要服务，同时满足严格的用户服务延迟要求。正交于MEC、数字孪生（DT）是另一种能够彻底改变许多领域的使能技术，包括自动驾驶、医疗保健、教育和智慧城市。全球DT预计该行业到 2027 年将增长到 735 亿美元，到 2030 年将增长到 1,257 亿美元。DT技术赋能，智能服务将变得更加精准使用更新的 DT 源数据对其推理模型进行持续训练推理模型。 DT赋能的MEC网络智能业务研究现状兴趣日益浓厚。然而，现有的服务提供方法和技术由于缺乏持续的推理训练，不适用于智能服务模型。因此迫切需要新的理论、算法和技术。该项目将研究 DT 赋能的移动感知智能服务 物体和用户移动性下的MEC网络。因为每一个的品质智能服务取决于其推理模型的准确性，而每个推理模型的准确性取决于其源DT数据的新鲜度这是通过 DT 及其对象之间的同步来实现的。兼顾物体和用户的移动性，精准推理服务配置带来了几个挑战：（1）如何开发一个指标来捕获推理模型的准确性？ (2) 由于带宽资源有限，应对象上传其更新以最大化推理模型的累积准确性？(3) 如何在累积的新鲜度之间争取重要的权衡推理模型和达到新鲜度的成本？ (4) 应该采取哪种决议选择一个推理模型来满足用户的服务延迟要求？ (5)如何开发有效的预测机制来准确预测交易量更新每个对象产生的数据，以及不同容器的数量每个推理模型所需的分辨率？该项目将为移动感知智能服务开发一套新颖的解决方案在DT赋能的MEC网络中。它将大大有助于增强我们的了解推理服务的核心技术和挑战。它还将有助于设计性能保证的算法和创新的预测机制。

11202924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11202924.value: 設計具有卓越高溫性能的強韌扭曲的高熵金屬間化合物

11202924.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11202924.value: Prof Pao, Chun-Wei Dr Song, Wenli

11202924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11202924.value: Intermetallic alloys are renowned for their remarkable strength, exceptional creep resistance, superior corrosion resistance, and intriguing functional properties like shape memory effect and superconductivity. Among these alloys, B2 (or ordered BCC) intermetallics have found extensive applications in shape memory actuators and aerospace structures. However, they suffer from a trade-off between strength and plasticity due to various factors, such as limited slip systems, a low relative mobility between screw and edge dislocations, and a lack of effective hardening mechanisms. Despite significant efforts invested in this area, little progress has been made to overcome these challenges, and the fundamental problem of developing intermetallic alloys that are both strong and plastic remains unresolved. In this proposal, we aim to tackle this issue by embracing the concept of high entropy alloys (HEAs). Specifically, we will focus on developing a specific B2 intermetallic system with multiple principal elements, incorporating the principles of HEAs. Unlike conventional intermetallic alloys, our approach involves creating highly distorted lattices. Our preliminary results indicate that such alloys may promote the activation of multiple slip systems, mitigate discrepancies in the movement of dislocations, and even trigger local structural transitions during deformation, resulting in exceptional mechanical properties across a wide temperature range. The outcome of our research will not only shed light on the fundamental mechanisms underlying the synergy between plasticity and strength in B2 high entropy alloys but also pave the way for the development of strong-yet-plastic intermetallic alloys with broad engineering applications. By exploring this innovative approach, we anticipate significant advancements in the understanding and application of intermetallic alloys, opening new avenues for designing materials with superior mechanical properties. 金屬間化合物合金以其卓越的強度、優異的抗蠕變性、出色的耐腐蝕性以及引人入勝的功能特性，如形狀記憶效應和超導性而聞名。在這些合金中，B2（或有序BCC）金屬間化合物已在形狀記憶致動器和航空航天結構中找到廣泛應用。然而，由於諸如有限的滑移系統、螺旋位錯和邊緣位錯之間的低相對移動性以及缺乏有效的硬化機制等各種因素，它們在強度和塑性之間存在著一種折衷關係。儘管在這一領域投入了大量努力，但在克服這些挑戰方面進展甚微，開發既強又塑的金屬間化合物的基本問題仍然沒有得到解決。在這份研究計劃中，我們旨在通過採納高熵合金的概念來解決這個問題。具體來說，我們將專注於開發一種具有多個主要元素的特定B2金屬間化合物系統，並融入高熵合金的原則。與傳統金屬間化合物合金不同，我們的方法涉及創建高度扭曲的晶格。我們的初步結果表明，這種合金可能促進多個滑移系統的激活，減輕位錯移動的差異，甚至在變形過程中觸發局部結構轉變，從而使其在廣泛溫度範圍內具有卓越的機械性能。我們的研究結果將不僅揭示B2高熵合金中塑性和強度之間協同作用的基本機制，還將為開發具有廣泛工程應用的強韌金屬間化合物鋪平道路。通過探索這種創新方法，我們預計將在理解和應用金屬間化合物方面取得重大進展，為設計具有卓越機械性能的材料開辟新途徑。

11203924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11203924.value: 使用基於物理的熱帶氣旋模型對中國東南沿海地區在氣候變化下設計風速的預測

11203924.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11203924.value: Dr Chan, Pak-Wai Dr He, Junyi

11203924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11203924.value: 熱帶氣旋，亦稱為颶風或颱風，是具毀滅性的自然災害，對沿海地區甚至內陸地區都可能造成重大影響。當前研究表明，氣候變化顯著影響了熱帶氣旋的行為，導致其發生頻率改變、強度增強、路徑移動發生變化以及快速增強。為應對熱帶氣旋行為可能發生的變化，做好準備以降低風險並保護脆弱群體至關重要。雖然現有的數據驅動熱帶氣旋模型已應用於預測這些風暴的行為，但它們可能不足以應對氣候變化帶來的固有複雜性和非平穩性。此外，基於對稱壓力模型的線性風場模型無法準確表現真實的熱帶氣旋事件，這些模型未考慮風場的非線性以及登陸後地表條件的不均勻性。因此，這些模型提供的極端風速估算和路徑預測往往與觀測數據有較大偏差。 本研究的目標是提高基於物理的熱帶氣旋模型的性能，以便在潛在氣候變化下，為中國東南沿海地區提供更可靠的設計風速預測。研究將包括四項具體任務：（1）利用嵌入物理知識的神經網絡重構三維熱帶氣旋風場；（2）研究熱帶氣旋渦旋結構以改進路徑預測；（3）考慮地形效應的熱帶氣旋強度演變建模；（4）在氣候變化背景下，進行大範圍區域和城市尺度的設計風速繪圖。在任務（1）中，將使用天氣研究與預報模型對熱帶氣旋進行全面的數值模擬，這些模擬將與全球定位系統投落送探測數據和香港天文台運營的50多個氣象站的常規觀測數據進行驗證。三維風場將利用觀測數據和空氣的動量方程進行重構。任務（2）涉及在熱帶氣旋登陸時識別三維風場中的不對稱性，建立與方位角相關的壓力模型，並探討不同壓力層次下路徑運動與風速之間的關係，以確定控制熱帶氣旋運動的關鍵壓力層。關於路徑預測，將測試並比較典型渦旋結構與在渦度方程中的不對稱風場模型。在任務（3）中，將提出兩個強度模型。第一個是混合模型，使用兩個耦合的常微分方程模擬海洋上的強度，並使用一個隨地形變化的數值模型模擬陸地上的強度。第二個是修訂的去噪擴散模型，該模型提供強度演變的概率時空預測。在任務（4）中，將使用全球氣候模型預測環境條件，並探討在氣候變化影響下熱帶氣旋行為的變化。隨後，將完成區域（如中國東南沿海地區）和城市尺度（如香港）的設計風速繪圖，以便為未來的風工程應用提供參考。

11204024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11204024.value: 機器學習加持的污水管網實時通風控制

11204024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11204024.value: Sulfide-induced sewer corrosion is a critical issue faced by water utilities with a worldwide annual cost of many billions of US dollars. With a warm and humid climate and seawater toilet flushing, Hong Kong is most susceptible to sewer corrosion. Ventilation is among the key technologies widely used to mitigate sewer corrosion. It draws fresh air into, and foul air out of sewers, thus reduces the humidity and hydrogen sulfide levels in sewer air thus mitigating sewer corrosion. However, constant airflows are typically used, resulting in inadequate airflows in some periods and excessive airflows in others, leading to ineffective corrosion mitigation and/or waste of energy. Real-time control of sewer ventilation, based on rapidly changing in-sewer and atmospheric conditions, is required to address these limitations. The recent rapid development in low-cost Internet-of-Things sensors have made network-wide in-sewer monitoring possible, supporting a data-driven approach to real-time sewer ventilation control. The overarching objective of this project is to develop the framework and advanced data analytics to achieve real-time sewer ventilation control towards effective corrosion mitigation with minimised energy consumption. Adopting a novel model predictive control architecture, we will develop (1) predictive data analytics, by combining the traditional statistical models with the contemporary Recurrent Neural Networks, to predict key disturbance variables in the control horizon; (2) descriptive data analytics, using the Graph Neural Networks (GNN) making use of the structural similarity between a GNN and a sewer network, to predict the effect of control actions and predicted disturbance variables on the controlled variables and hence on the control objectives; (3) prescriptive data analytics, based on a combination of evolutionary algorithms and reinforcement learning, to generate and optimise the control policies. We will develop mechanistic-model-based digital twins of sewer networks to generate data, complementary to those collected from collaborating industry partners and from a pilot sewer, to support the above-described analytics. We will demonstrate the methodology, the models and the control algorithms using the pilot sewer and the digital twins. This is, to the best of our knowledge, the first study internationally on real time control of sewer ventilation, and involves the development of innovative descriptive, predictive, and prescriptive data analytics. The project outcomes will enable water utilities to achieve better corrosion control outcomes with reduced economic and environmental costs. With strong backgrounds in both sewer management and control engineering, the PI and Co-I are well positioned to lead the project to success. 硫化物引起的污水管網腐蝕是水務公司面臨的一個關鍵問題，在全球範圍內每年造成數十億美元的損失。香港氣候溫暖濕潤，使用海水沖廁，污水管網最容易受到腐蝕的影響。 通風是廣泛用於減輕污水管網腐蝕的關鍵技術之一。它將新鮮空氣吸入下水道，將污濁的空氣排出下水道，從而降低下水道空氣中的濕度和硫化氫水平，進而減輕下水道腐蝕。然而，現有通風系統通常使用恆定的氣流，導致某些時期氣流不足，其他時期氣流過多，從而導致無效的腐蝕緩解和/或能源浪費。 為了解決這些限制，需要根據快速變化的下水道和大氣條件對污水管網通風進行即時控制。最近低成本物聯網感測器的快速發展使得全網監測成為可能，為數據驅動的即時污水管網通風控制方法提供支持。該項目的首要目標是為污水管網通風控制開發框架和先進的數據分析方法，從而有效緩解腐蝕，同時將能耗降至最低。 我們將採用一種新穎的模型預測控制架構，（1）通過結合傳統的統計模型和現代的迴圈神經網路，開發預測數據分析，以預測控制區間內的擾動變量變化;（2）利用圖神經網路（GNN）與污水管網之間的結構相似性，預測控制動作和擾動變量對受控變量和控制目標的影響;（3）用進化算法和強化學習相結合的方法生成和優化控制策略。我們將開發基於機理模型的污水管網數位孿生，以生成數據，補充從行業合作夥伴收集的數據，以支援上述分析。我們將利用數位孿生方法演示模型和控制演算法。 據我們所知，這是國際上第一個關於污水管網通風即時控制的研究。開發的描述性、預測性和規範性數據分析方法具有創新意義。該項目的成果將使水務公司能夠實現更好的腐蝕控制結果，同時降低經濟和環境成本。 憑藉在污水管網管理和控制工程方面的強大背景，PI 和 Co-I 完全有能力帶領項目取得成功。

11204224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11204224.value: 開發用於砂土試樣全場離散顆粒追蹤的 X 射線顯微層析成像法

11204224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11204224.value: In this proposed project, groundbreaking interdisciplinary research spanning the fields of experimental geomechanics, artificial intelligence, and computer vision will develop novel pattern-recognition techniques based on in-situ X-ray microtomography (µCT), a non-destructive radiographic testing technique for examining the microstructures of materials. These techniques will allow tracking of the full-field movement of discrete particles within a sand specimen. The major thrust of this proposed project is to extend and adapt a series of well-developed object-recognition and image-matching techniques to realize feature detection, recognition, and matching of intact or crushed sand particles via µCT-based analysis of a sand specimen during its deformation process. These techniques will include ID-Track, spherical harmonics invariant of particle morphology, three-dimensional (3D) signature of histograms of orientation, 3D fast point feature histograms, 3D shape context, point-cloud registration, and convolutional neural networks. These image-matching techniques will be appropriately evaluated and integrated according to the particle-scale morphological and microstructural characteristics of sands with various kinds of geological origins. This will establish a powerful, efficient, and robust system for discrete particle tracking in any type of sand. This proposed project will generate important impacts in fundamental and applied research in a variety of fields, such as geotechnical engineering, construction materials, biomedical engineering, powders and grains, computer vision, and artificial intelligence, and will have concomitant high economic and societal impacts. The research impacts will include a newly established hybrid feature-aided tool for discrete particle tracking that will enable accurate, efficient, and robust computation of the full-field displacement and strain of any type of granular soils. Furthermore, this proposed project will advance frontiers of knowledge on object recognition and image matching, thereby laying the foundation for future interdisciplinary research in these areas. Economic and societal impacts will be achieved through the application of the novel tool for discrete particle tracking in geotechnical engineering activities, such as site investigation, design, and infrastructure construction and maintenance, or in the manufacturing, handling, and processing of other kinds of particulate materials in industry. The results will contribute to the development of optimized engineering activities and processes, leading to improvements in geotechnical infrastructure, construction management, hazard mitigation, and living environments in Hong Kong and worldwide. 在這個擬議的項目中，我們將進行跨學科的創新研究，涵蓋實驗巖土力學、人工智能和計算機視覺領域。計劃開發基於原位X射線微斷層掃描（μCT）的新型模式識別技術，這是一種用於檢查材料微結構的無損放射性測試技術。這些技術將能夠追蹤沙樣本中單個顆粒的全場運動。項目的主要目標是擴展和改進一系列成熟的物體識別和圖像匹配技術，以實現在沙樣本變形過程中，通過μCT分析實現完好或破碎沙粒的特征檢測、識別和匹配。這些技術包括ID-Track、顆粒形態的球諧函數不變量、三維方向直方圖簽名、三維快速點特征直方圖、三維形狀上下文、點雲配準和卷積神經網絡。我們將根據不同地質起源的沙粒的微觀形態和微觀結構特征，適當評估和整合這些圖像匹配技術。這將建立一個強大、高效且穩健的系統，用於跟蹤任何類型沙粒中的離散顆粒。 這個提議的項目將在基礎研究和應用研究的多個領域產生重要影響，包括巖土工程、建築材料、生物醫學工程、粉體與顆粒學、計算機視覺和人工智能，同時也會帶來顯著的經濟和社會效益。研究成果將新開發一個具有混合特征輔助的工具，用於離散顆粒的追蹤，能夠準確、高效、穩健地計算任何類型顆粒土壤的全場位移和應變。此外，這個提議的項目將推動物體識別和圖像匹配知識的前沿發展，從而為未來在這些領域的跨學科研究奠定基礎。這項新工具在離散顆粒跟蹤方面的應用，將對經濟和社會產生深遠影響。它可以用於土木工程的各種活動，比如現場調查、設計、基礎設施建設和維護，以及工業中其他顆粒物料的製造、處理和運輸。這些成果將促進工程活動和流程的優化，從而完善地質基礎設施、增強施工管理、提高災害防範，改善香港和全球的生活環境。

11204724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11204724.value: 用於被動隔振的仿生非線性慣性系統：建模、分析、設計與實現

11204724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11204724.value: 在行走、跑步、跳躍時，人體可以發揮非常好的振動隔離作用，有效防止腦損傷。由於腿部的彈性肌肉和可折疊的腱骨結構，膝蓋適當彎曲，可以實現峰值頻率遠低於 3 Hz。值得注意的是，手臂擺動也在步態控制中起著至關重要的作用，因為它不僅可以維持身體穩定又能夠抑制振動傳遞。更有趣，手臂可以伸展或收攏，達到改變槓桿比，能更好控制身體穩定；還可以有目的地調整手臂肌肉的張力以獲得變化的剛度，使得手臂擺動時可以更好地保持身體平衡；定期握拳或伸出手掌也可以在快速運動的動態身體控制過程中實現身體等效質量的有利變化；另外，身體跳躍的時候，通過在空中頻繁揮舞手臂或腿可以延長向前移動的慣性（比如跳遠運動員）。然而，所有這些慣性特徵從未在工程振動控製中被很好研究和利用。 我們的初步研究表明，透過適當的機構設計，非線性慣性非常有利於平衡振動週期期間的相互作用力。然而，在什麼頻率範圍和什麼非線性慣性函數/模式以及可以為振動控制帶來什麼樣的優勢等等，還遠遠沒有被完全理解。因此，更詳細的分析設計和建模工作仍有待完成。本課題旨在探索更有效的非線性慣性機制，開發系統的建模、分析和設計方法，以便更深入地了解慣性非線性帶來的非線性影響，最終必將帶來創新的振動控制技術，並走向廣泛的工程應用。可交付成果包括非線性慣性系統的全新設計與相關分析方法（頻域和時域），揭示有益非線性慣性的獨特且明確的數學模型，並提供對慣性非線性有利方面的重要見解或理解。 這些結果，將適用於各種工程振動控制，包括隔振支架和土木工程（建築物、橋樑、海洋平台）、航空航天系統中的吸波器，製造工廠、各種運動機械的噪音和振動控制（例如手持式手提鑽、車輛座椅、懸吊），並具有高效能和低成本的優勢。

11204824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11204824.value: 高熵焊料顆粒表面抗氧化性能研究

11204824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11204824.value: While the scaling of Si technology is slowing down, the miniaturization in packaging technology is becoming increasingly crucial for advancing computational performance. One of the critical challenges in scaling the packaging technology is the manufacturing of micronized or even nanosized solder joints. As the size of traditional Sn-based solder joints shrinks below 5 μm, issues related to yield and reliability start to become inevitable. High entropy alloy (HEA) solder presents a possible solution for manufacturing solder joints under 5 μm. However, the complex composition of high entropy alloys makes traditional electroplating methods impractical for industrial applications. The most promising approach involves using high entropy alloy solder paste for bonding, necessitating the use of solder nanoparticles (NPs). Nevertheless, Sn-based nanoparticles are highly susceptible to oxidation, making them unsuitable for bonding purposes. The high-entropy feature of HEA solder nanoparticles offers a potential solution to slow down the oxidation rate of nanoparticles, while the mechanism is not clear yet. Therefore, it is essential to investigate the surface oxidation resistance of high entropy solder particles to enable their application in high-density bonding technology. This proposal first aims to develop a novel method for synthesizing high-entropy solder nanoparticles with varying compositions. The process begins with creating five-element high entropy nanoparticles through ultrasonic treatment of the corresponding five-element alloy bulk. Subsequently, we will explore the oxidation resistance of nanoparticles with different compositions using ex-situ transmission electron microscope (TEM) studies and on-chip electrochemical microdevices (OCEM). Then, the soldering performance of different composition HEA NP will be studied. By correlating the results of oxidation resistance investigations by OCEM and ex-situ TEM between NP composition and soldering performance, we intend to develop a novel methodology for assessing the oxidation resistance of high entropy solder particles. Meanwhile, the oxidation resistance mechanism will be clarified for these HEA nanoparticles, enabling us to optimize NP compositions and develop high entropy solder particles with superior oxidation resistance and soldering performance. Finally, these oxidation-resistance solder particles will be explored for high-density, ultra-fine pitch bonding technology applications. 由于硅基器件小型化发展放缓，封装技术的小型化对于提高系统算力越来越重要。封装技术小型化面临的一个关键挑战是制造微米级甚至纳米级的互连凸点。当传统锡基焊点尺寸缩小到 5 微米以下时，良率、产量、以及可靠性相关的问题将面临严重挑战。高熵合金 (HEA) 焊料有望为制造 5 微米以下的焊点提供一种可行方案，值得系统深入研究。其中，通过HEA 焊料纳米颗粒高熵特性来减缓纳米颗粒氧化速度的程度和机理尚不清楚，研究高熵焊料粒子的表面抗氧化性对于将其应用于高密度键合技术至关重要。 本项目首先将研发一种合成不同成分的高熵焊料纳米粒子的新方法，并使用片上电化学微装置（OCEM）探索不同成分纳米粒子的抗氧化性。然后，研究不同成分HEA 纳米粒子的焊接性能。通过将OCEM和非原位TEM的抗氧化研究结果与高熵组分和焊接性能相关联，我们将开发一种评估高熵焊料颗粒抗氧化性的新方法，同时，阐明这些HEA纳米粒子的抗氧化机理。这项研究将使我们能够优化纳米粒子成分，开发具有优异抗氧化性和焊接性能的高熵焊料颗粒。最后，我们将探索这些抗氧化焊料颗粒在高密度、超细间距键合技术中的应用。

11205024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11205024.value: 拒绝服务攻击下多智能体系统的固定时间分布式控制及其应用

11205024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11205024.value: 由于在无人机编队控制、多移动机器人会合、传感器网络部署等众多领域都有广泛应用, 多智能体系统的协作控制在控制和机器人领域引起了广泛的研究兴趣。相比传统的单智能体系统,多智能体系统具有能更高效完成复杂任务、更强鲁棒性和更好扩展性的潜力。在假设多智能体系统的通信网络能正常工作且不存在任何网络攻击的前提下, 许多关于多智能体系统协同控制的理论、技术和工具已经形成。然而在现实中, 多智能体系统的通信网络除了存在常见的通信限制如时延外也常常遭受网络攻击。网络攻击这一通信限制的存在将对相关多智能体系统的性能产生很大的负面影响,甚至可能破坏其原本的功能。其中一种典型的网络攻击是拒绝服务攻击。这种攻击通常通过阻塞或破坏网络连通性来影响信息传输的及时性。于是，在过去几年中，研究者们针对拒绝服务攻击下的多智能系统，设计了具有弹性的协同控制方法。近期的文献综述表明现存的大多数关于拒绝服务攻击下多智能系统的协同控制方法是渐近地或指数地完成其期望的协同任务。换言之，只有当时间趋近于无穷时，它们才能实现所期望的协同任务。然而,许多关于多智能体系统协同控制的工程应用，即使在遭受拒绝服务攻击的情况下，也要求有限时间收敛或固定时间收敛, 而不是指数收敛或渐近收敛。换言之，协同任务被期望在有限时间或者固定时间完成。由于有限时间收敛的上界依赖于相关系统的初始条件, 而固定时间收敛的上界不依赖于其初值。这意味着后者更为理想。因此,本项目将研究拒绝服务攻击下多智能体系统的固定时间分布式控制。具体而言，我们将研究以下三个问题：（i）无向通信图中拒绝服务攻击下多智能体系统的固定时间分布式控制问题；(ii)有向通信图中拒绝服务攻击下多智能体系统的固定时间分布式控制问题；以及 (iii) 同时存在拒绝服务攻击和通信延迟下多智能体系统的固定时间分布式控制问题。通过解决以上问题，本项目将针对无向/有向通信图中拒绝服务攻击下多智能体系统的固定时间分布式控制探索并设计新理论和新方法。本项目的预期成果是为拒绝服务攻击下多智能体系统的固定时间分布式控制提供新的理论和方法，这将在实际工程应用中为工程師提供更多有效的设计工具。

11205224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11205224.value: 通過調節晶格畸變設計抗輻照多組元固溶體合金

11205224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11205224.value: High-entropy alloys (HEAs) comprised of multiprincipal elements have attracted extensive attention due to their excellent mechanical properties and promising irradiation resistance. It has been well established that the irradiation response of HEAs depends highly on the alloy compositions contributed by the extreme chemical disorder, which includes chemical complexity and site-to-site displacement. On the one hand, chemical disorder enhances carrier scattering, resulting in delayed energy dissipation. On the other hand, disorder induces a rough energy landscape for defect motion, suppressing defect aggregation and defect reactions. Nonetheless, these correlations are not directly related to the alloy compositions, and it is difficult to guide elemental selection and HEA design experimentally. In HEAs, the current theory suggests that their mechanical strength can be dictated by lattice distortion. By maximizing the lattice distortion effects by choosing elements with distinct atomic sizes, high-strength HEAs can be achieved due to the enhanced interactions between constituent elements and dislocations. Therefore, lattice distortion is a critical parameter in HEAs to affect defect properties. Unexpectedly, our preliminary simulations in our developed concentrated alloys with unprecedently high lattice distortions suggest that maximizing lattice distortion may not be beneficial to improve irradiation resistance. Leveraged on these findings, in this proposal, we intend to study the role of lattice distortion on the irradiation resistance HEAs, revealing the correlation between defect evolution and atomic size mismatch. To achieve this goal, we will combine atomistic simulations with experiments to study the irradiation response of a series of single-phase concentrated alloys with tunable lattice distortion. We would like to address the following critical issues if the project could be funded: (1) How does lattice distortion affect thermal and mass transport properties in HEAs? (2) How does lattice distortion determine the irradiation response of HEAs in the primary damage stage and long damage evolution phase? (3) Is there a systematic way that helps us identify irradiation-resistance HEAs by targeting desired lattice distortion, which is a fundamental property of HEAs? In the long run, we envision that our research may stimulate further interest in the design of irradiation-tolerant HEAs through tangible factors for structural materials applications. The outcome will also provide new understandings behind the irradiation performance of a wide range of conventional alloys, such as stainless steel. 由多種主要元素組成的高熵合金 (HEA) 因其優異的機械性能和良好的抗輻射性能而受到廣泛關注。HEA的輻射性能在很大程度上取決於複雜成分引起的極端化學無序特性，其中包括化學複雜性和晶格位元點間的位移。一方面，化學無序增強了載流子散射，導致能量耗散延遲。另一方面，無序原子排布抑制缺陷聚集和缺陷生長。儘管如此，這些特性難以直接和合金成分建立直接關係，從而很難通過實驗指導元素選擇和HEA設計。對於HEA來說，目前的理論表明它們的機械強度可以由晶格畸變決定。通過選擇具有不同原子尺寸的元素來最大化晶格畸變效應，可以增強組成元素和位元錯之間的相互作用，實現高強度的HEA。因此，晶格畸變是影響 HEA 缺陷特性的關鍵參數。然而，我們的初步模擬表明，最大化晶格畸變不一定能提高抗輻照性能，儘管晶格畸變可以強烈影響缺陷之間的相互作用。基於這些發現，在本項目中，我們打算研究晶格畸變對 HEA 抗輻照性的作用，揭示缺陷演變與原子尺寸失配之間的相關性。為了實現這一目標，我們將結合原子模擬和實驗，研究一系列具有可調晶格畸變的單相濃縮合金的輻照回應，解決以下關鍵問題：（1）晶格畸變如何影響 HEA 中的傳熱和品質傳輸特性？（2）晶格畸變如何決定 HEA 在初級損傷階段和長期損傷演化階段的輻照回應？ (3) 是否有一種系統的方法可以説明我們通過針對所需的晶格畸變（這是 HEA 的基本特性）來識別耐輻照 HEA？

11205324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11205324.value: 一种用于太空醫學關節軟骨修復材料的特性及機制研究：微重力和宇宙輻射的影響

11205324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11205324.value: Advances in human spaceflight leads to an increasing demand for repairing articular cartilage in space as microgravity and cosmic radiation during long-duration space missions pose threat to joint health of space travellers. This project aims to investigate the impact of microgravity and cosmic radiation on the repair efficiency of a tissue-engineered cartilaginous graft (dLhCG) in traumatic and articular cartilage defects (ACDs) for space medicine. Preliminary data has indicated that dLhCG engraftment facilitated successful traumatic ACD regeneration in ongoing clinical trials and excellent osteoarthritic ACD regeneration in rat knees. dLhCG was found to promote rejuvenation of hyaline cartilaginous phenotype through inhibition of Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway via dLhCG-integrin α5 ligation. These superior outcomes endow dLhCG with promising prospects for space medicine in ACD regeneration. Motivated by this, dLhCG scaffolds were delivered to the China Tiangong Space Station for an over 6-month exposure test inside (In-dLhCG) and outside (Out-dLhCG) the spacecraft in May 2023, with corresponding dLhCG scaffolds remained on the ground (G-dLhCG) as a control. The ACD regeneration potential of returned dLhCGs will be subsequently assessed on Earth. Accordingly, the Specific Objectives are listed as follows. The Objective 1 is to investigate whether exposure to microgravity and cosmic radiation in space alters the physical, chemical, and biological characteristics of dLhCG. For this sake, mechanical properties, structural properties, chemical composition, quantitative proteomics, and in vitro cytotoxicity will be evaluated for three groups of dLhCG. Alterations in these properties of dLhCGs are expected to influence their regeneration capacity. The Objective 2 is to investigate the repair efficiency among G-dLhCG, In-dLhCG, and Out-dLhCG for traumatic and osteoarthritic ACDs in vivo. The three groups of dLhCG will be implanted into traumatic and osteoarthritis critical-sized ACDs followed by the examination of histological structure, subchondral bone morphology, biochemical composition, and biomechanical properties of regenerated and surrounding native tissue. The Objective 3 is to explore mechanisms of three groups of dLhCG for ACD regeneration and identify whether differences exist in mechanisms among three groups of dLhCG. To achieve this, an integrative multi-omics approach will be exploited, including RNA sequencing, 4D-DIA proteomics, and single-cell sequencing. Importantly, the pivotal genes and proteins in involved signaling pathways will be verified using quantitative polymerase chain reaction and western blotting. Overall, the contribution of this study lies in conducting the first space experiment on cartilage repair scaffolds and laying the foundation for fulfilling future requirement of repairing articular cartilage in space. 隨著人類太空航天的進步，修復太空中關節軟骨的需求日益增加，因為長期太空任務中的微重力和宇宙輻射對太空旅行者的關節健康構成威脅。本項目旨在研究微重力和宇宙輻射對組織工程軟骨移植物（dLhCG）在創傷性和關節軟骨缺損（ACD）中的修復效率的影響，以用於太空醫學。初步數據表明，dLhCG移植在正在進行的臨床試驗中促進了創傷性ACD的成功再生，並在大鼠骨關節炎膝蓋中顯示出優異的ACD再生效果。研究發現，dLhCG通過與整合素α5的結合抑制Wnt/β-catenin信號通路，從而促進透明軟骨表型的再生。這些卓越的結果使dLhCG在ACD再生方面展現出良好的空間醫學前景。受此啟發，dLhCG支架於2023年5月被送往中國天宮空間站，在航天器內部（In-dLhCG）和外部（Out-dLhCG）進行為期超過6個月的暴露測試，同時有相應的dLhCG支架留在地面作為對照（G-dLhCG），隨後在地球上評估返回的dLhCG的ACD再生潛力。具體目標如下。目標1是研究太空中微重力和宇宙輻射是否改變dLhCG的物理、化學和生物特性。為此，將對三組dLhCG進行機械性能、結構特性、化學成分、定量蛋白質組學和體外細胞毒性的評估。預期這些dLhCG特性的變化將影響其再生能力。目標2是在體內研究G-dLhCG、In-dLhCG和Out-dLhCG對創傷性和骨關節炎性ACD的修復效率。將三組dLhCG植入創傷性和骨關節炎臨界尺寸的ACD中，隨後評估再生組織和周圍天然組織的結構、軟骨下骨形態、生化成分和生物力學特性。目標3是探索三組dLhCG在ACD再生中的機制，並確定三組dLhCG在機制上是否存在差異。為此，將採用綜合多組學方法，包括RNA測序、4D-DIA蛋白質組學和單細胞測序。重要的是，將使用定量聚合酶鏈反應和免疫印迹驗證參與信號通路的關鍵基因和蛋白質。總體而言，本研究的貢獻在於進行首次關於軟骨修復支架的太空實驗，並為未來實現太空中修復關節軟骨的需求奠定基礎。

11205424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11205424.value: 基於大視覺語言模型和語義的無參考視覺質量評價

11205424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11205424.value: Visual quality assessment has been a long-standing problem, playing an important role in monitoring, assessing, and optimizing multimedia systems. Traditional quality assessment models, which rely on structural-level or feature-level modeling, face challenges such as a lack of meticulously labeled data, a limited capability to capture high-level semantics, and an unsatisfactory accuracy in correlating with human opinions. Furthermore, these models are typically trained using scalar mean opinion scores (MOSs), lacking interpretability in quality prediction and optimization. The evaluation of visual quality is a complicated process shaped by both perception and comprehension. However, cognitive understanding is typically lacking in existing quality assessment models, leading to biased predictions. This project aims to address this grand challenge by extracting, modeling, and utilizing semantics for quality assessment. The proposed solution paves the way toward incorporating knowledge encoded in these large vision-language models (LVLMs) for quality assessment, greatly benefiting accuracy, adaptability, and interpretability. First, an LVLM-aided quality assessment dataset is created. Instead of one MOS score for one image, the dataset is featured with multi-modality quality labeling based on both human opinions and semantic interpretations by LVLMs. In particular, heuristic dialog rules inspired by the human quality rating process are specifically explored to mimic human interactions with LVLMs. Second, the semantic-driven quality assessment model is developed and grounded on LVLMs, which can be customized according to individual preferences. Instead of providing only one score, the quality information represented in the scalar value, distortion map, and textual descriptions are generated from the assessment model, enriching the interpretability and robustness. Third, adaptable quality-driven optimization schemes are developed, by which the semantically prioritized and quality-optimized images can be selected or generated. The proposed research could significantly advance the frontier of visual signal processing and provide a paradigm shift in image quality assessment from distortion identification to semantic cognition. The potential applications of the proposed research extend beyond the scenarios supported by traditional assessment models. We demonstrate how the proposed assessment model can optimize image restoration, recommendation, and generation. We also show that incorporating individual preference into model learning can be supported, resulting in high personalization potential. The proposed research can be feasibly extended beyond images to more realistic visual data (e.g., omni-directional representation and point clouds), creating a comprehensive and systematic research ecology for quality assessment of visual data from both real-world and artificial intelligence. 視覺品質評估是一個長期存在的問題，在監測、評估和優化多媒體系統方面發揮重要作用。傳統的品質評估模型依賴結構層面或特徵層面的建模，面臨缺乏細緻標註資料、捕捉高階語意的能力有限、與人類意見相關的準確性不理想等挑戰。此外，這些模型通常使用標量平均意見分數（MOS）進行訓練，在品質預測和最佳化方面缺乏可解釋性。視覺品質評估是一個複雜的過程，由感知和理解共同決定。然而，現有的品質評估模型通常缺乏對認知的理解，導致預測結果有偏差。本計畫旨在透過提取、建模和利用語義進行品質評估來應對這一巨大挑戰。所提出的解決方案為將已編碼在這些大型視覺語言模型（LVLM）中的知識納入品質評估鋪平了道路，從而大大提高了準確性、適應性和可解釋性。首先，建立一個 LVLM 輔助品質評估資料集。此資料集的特點是根據人的意見和 LVLM 的語義解釋進行多模態品質標註，而不是對一幅影像進行一個 MOS 評分。特別是，受人類品質評級過程啟發，特別探索了啟發式對話規則，以模擬人類與 LVLM 的互動。其次，開發了語意驅動品質評估模型，並以 LVLM 為基礎，可根據個人喜好進行客製化。評估模型不再只提供一個分數，而是產生標量值、失真圖和文字描述所代表的品質信息，從而豐富了可解釋性和魯棒性。第三，開發了適應性強的品質驅動優化方案，透過該方案可以選擇或產生語義優先和品質優化的圖像。所提出的研究可大幅推動視覺訊號處理的前沿發展，並實現影像品質評估從失真識別到語義認知的範式轉變。建議研究的潛在應用範圍超過了傳統評估模型所支持的場景。我們將展示所提出的評估模型如何優化影像修復、推薦和生成。我們也將展示如何將個人偏好融入模型學習，從而實現高度個人化。建議的研究可以從影像擴展到更現實的視覺資料（如全向表示和點雲），為現實世界和人工智慧的視覺資料品質評估創建一個全面系統的研究生態。

11205624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11205624.value: 新興移動人工智能設備上深度神經網絡的搶佔式GPU推理

11205624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11205624.value: GPUs become the primary executor and accelerator for running DNN tasks on emerging mobile artificial intelligence (mAI) devices, e.g., Nvidia Jetsons and more. In addition to accelerating inference on a single task, its significance also begins to be reflected more in the efficient execution of multiple DNN tasks required by recent applications, in which many tasks often have strict latency requirements. Preemption is the main technology to ensure the timeliness of multitasking, by allowing high-priority tasks to interrupt ongoing low-priority tasks. It ensures that a processor can fully exploit its inherent computing capability, as the hardware undergoes huge investment in improvements every year, but the achieved task timeliness can be easily compromised due to inefficient scheduling. Existing mAI GPUs have only two levels of priority in device queue, and state-of-the-art methods can thus achieve coarse-grained preemption merely by dividing DNN tasks into two types: real-time and best-effort, and allowing a real-time task to preempt best-effort tasks. However, the efficacy drops significantly when other real-time tasks run concurrently (as additional high-priority contenders), but this is already common on mAI devices for autonomous-vehicles, robots, UAVs, etc. Can we use solutions from other platforms or processors? Due to different workload and hardware features, they are not applicable. First, mAI is a new form of mobile device, but traditional mobiles usually have only one dominant front-end application and simply follow FIFO in GPU scheduling. Other platforms (e.g., clouds) support preemption for concurrent tasks, but they focus on allocating one or more GPUs to each complex model, whereas on mAI devices, multiple DNNs mainly compete for one GPU. Second, preemption has matured on CPU. Due to hardware differences, CPU preemption only requires saving task’s context from dozens of registers to memory, but such overhead increases significantly to hundreds/thousands of registers on GPUs, which slows down context-switching and thus increases DNN-inference latency. In this project, we propose a middleware design to work directly with commodity mAI GPUs to provide general and fine-grained preemption, allowing both real-time tasks to preempt each other, and real-time tasks to preempt best-effort tasks. Our main finding is that efficient preemption can be achieved through software designs by carefully pruning decision space, in-depth analysis of DNN structure and innovative model adaptation. Overall, enabling fine-grained GPU-preemptive DNN inference for mAI devices is inherently novel. It provides a crucial service to accommodate the important trend of more concurrent DNNs in emerging applications. GPU 已成為執行和加速新興移動人工智能（mAI）設備上深度神經網路（DNN）任務的主要執行者和加速器，例如 Nvidia Jetsons 等。除了加速單一任務的推理外，其重要性也開始體現在高效執行最近應用所需的多個 DNN 任務上，其中許多任務往往有嚴格的延遲要求。搶佔是確保多任務及時性的重要技術，允許高優先級任務中斷正在進行的低優先級任務。這確保了處理器能充分發揮其固有的計算能力，因為工業界每年都進行巨額投資以進行硬件改進，但由於調度效率低下，實現的任務及時性可能會輕易受到影響。現有的GPU 在移動人工智能設備上通常只有兩個優先級，最先進的方法因此只能通過將 DNN 任務分為兩種類型來實現粗粒度搶佔：即時任務和盡力而為任務，並允許即時任務搶佔盡力而為任務。然而，當其他即時任務同時運行時（作為額外的高優先級競爭者），其效能顯著下降，但這在自動駕駛車輛、機器人、無人機等 mAI 設備上已經很常見。我們能否使用其他平台或處理器的解決方案？由於工作負載和硬體特性不同，它們並不適用。首先，mAI 是一種新型的移動設備，但傳統的移動設備通常只有一個主要的前端應用，並且在 GPU 調度中通常遵循先進先出（FIFO）原則。其他平台（如雲端）支持並行任務的搶佔，但它們側重於將一個或多個 GPU 分配給每個複雜模型，而在 mAI 設備上，多個 DNN 主要競爭一個 GPU。其次，搶佔在 CPU 上已經成熟。由於硬件差異，CPU 搶佔只需要將任務的上下文從幾十個寄存器保存到記憶體，但這種開銷在 GPU 上顯著增加到數百/數千個寄存器，這會減慢上下文切換速度，從而增加 DNN 推論延遲。在本項目中，我們提出了一種中介軟件設計，可直接與商品化 mAI GPU 一起工作，以提供通用和細粒度的搶佔，允許即時任務相互搶佔，以及即時任務搶佔盡力而為任務。我們的主要發現是通過仔細修剪決策空間、深入分析 DNN 結構和創新的模型調整，可以通過軟件設計實現高效搶佔。總體而言，為移動人工智能設備啟用細粒度的 GPU 搶佔式 DNN 推論具有新穎性。它為應對新興應用中更多並發 DNN 的重要趨勢提供了關鍵服務。

11205724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11205724.value: 具有信息傳輸約束的多智能體系統的NASH均衡搜尋

11205724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11205724.value: In the non-cooperative game, each player(agent) has a local private cost function, which depends on the actions of all players. The goal of each player is to minimize its cost function by choosing its actions based on the information received from neighboring players. In seeking Nash equilibrium (NE) with multi-agents, each agent's strategy is optimal when considering other agents' decisions. NE is the stable and desirable solution to the non-cooperative game that has wide applications in many areas, such as smart grids, social networks, and sensor networks. Thus, highly efficient NE-seeking algorithms are essential for the analysis and design of non-cooperative games. Communication among players is critical for seeking NE of non-cooperative games.
