However, in real-world scenarios, communication links may fail or be re-established occasionally, resulting in changes in the network topology. Nevertheless, time-varying networks that satisfy the B-strongly-connected assumptions are suitable models to capture these phenomena. Hence, this motivated us to study NE-seeking algorithms in this proposal for non-cooperative games over time-varying networks under imperfect communication. In recent years, many well-known NE-seeking algorithms have been proposed for non-cooperative games, assuming each player can receive precise information from neighboring players. However, the transmitted data in complicated networks can only sometimes be perfect due to various limitations of communication channels for technical or economic reasons in realistic applications. This proposal considers time-varying delays and limited data rates as sources of imperfect communication. Investigating new NE-seeking algorithms under communication constraints and adjusting their convergence performance is highly desirable. If well accomplished, the theoretical results generated in this proposal will lay a solid foundation for NE-seeking methods of non-cooperative games in practical applications. 在非合作博弈中，每個玩家（智能體）都有一個私有成本函數，該函數取決於所有玩家的行動。每個玩家的目標是根據從相鄰玩家收到的信息選擇其行動，從而最小化其成本函數。在尋求多智能體的NASH均衡時，每個智能體在考慮其他智能體的決策時，都将采用其最優策略。NASH均衡是非合作博弈的穩定且理想的解決方案，在智能電網、社交網絡和感測器網絡等許多領域具有廣泛的應用。因此，高效的NASH均衡搜尋算法對於非合作博弈的分析和設計是必要的。玩家之間的信息溝通對於尋求非合作博弈的NASH均衡至關重要。然而，在現實場景中，通訊線路可能偶爾會失敗或重新建立，從而導致網絡拓撲發生變化。滿足 B 強連結假設的時變網絡是捕捉這些現象的合適模型。因此，這促使我們研究不完善通訊下時變網絡上的非合作博弈的 NASH均衡 搜尋算法。近年來，許多著名的NASH均衡 搜尋算法被提出來用於非合作博弈，这些算法都基于每個玩家都能從相鄰玩家那裡接收精確信息的假設。然而，在實際應用中，由於技術或經濟原因，通訊通道有各種限制，从而複雜網絡中傳輸的信息不总是完美的。該提案將時變延遲和有限的數據速率視為不完善通訊的根源。在通訊約束下研究新的NASH均衡 搜尋算法並調整其收斂性能是非常必要的。如果該提案順利完成，所產生的理論結果將為非合作博弈的NASH均衡搜尋方法在實際應用中奠定堅實的基礎。

11206024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11206024.value: 基于梯度的分布式优化算法的频域分析和综合：鲁棒控制方法

11206024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11206024.value: Distributed optimization plays an essential role in large-scale engineering systems and complex networks, and is held as a key enabler to civil infrastructures and industrial systems. Driven by its widespread applications, in this project we launch a comprehensive investigation into the analysis and synthesis of distributed optimization algorithms. We aim to develop a general, systematic theory built on a novel frequency-domain framework, which has the unique, unequal advantage that allows us to exploit the insights and the varieties of time-honored frequency-domain techniques, in particular those of robust and optimal control, for the characterization, analysis, and design of fast, efficient, and robust distributed algorithms. Central to our development are four synergistic objectives, each of which contains a set of tasks, consisting of (1) developing a systematic analysis and synthesis approach centered at a frequency-domain characterization of distributed optimization algorithms; (2) quantifying algorithm robustness and developing robust distributed optimization algorithms; (3) developing distributed optimization methods and algorithms for the training and optimization of machine learning models; (4) conducting benchmark simulations to validate the theoretical developments. The objectives target key issues and fundamental challenges facing distributed optimization, which together constitute a conceptual as well as a technical leap beyond the current state of the distributed optimization research. Built on the PI’s prior projects and ongoing work on networked control, multi-agent systems, and distributed optimization, a coherent technical approach has been carved out, which consists of concrete, realistic solution strategies that are believed to be both theoretically significant and practically feasible, and which has the promise to deliver measurable results of significance. We hold the viewpoint that the results generated from this project will lead to new and better understanding of distributed optimization problems, and to their improved design methods and algorithms, thus contributing to the advance and application of optimization theories and benefiting researchers and practicing engineers in broad engineering fields. 分布式優化在大規模工程系統和複雜網路中發揮重要作用，是民用基礎設施和工業系統的關鍵使能技术。基于其廣泛應用，在本项目中我們對分布式優化算法的分析和綜合展開全面的研究。我們致力于系統性地發展一種基於新穎頻域框架的通用理論，該框架具有獨特的、无与比拟的優勢，使我們能夠利用歷史悠久的頻域方法，其丰富的手段和知识，特別是鲁棒最優控制的方法和成果，使其用于快速、高效及鲁棒分布式算法的分析和设计。本项目的核心包括四個相辅相成的目標，每個目標都包含一組具体任務，即（1）系统性地開發以分布式優化算法的頻域表徵為中心的分析和綜合方法； (2)量化算法鲁棒性並開發鲁棒分布式優化算法； （3）针对於機器學習模型的訓練和優化，開發分布式優化方法和算法； (4) 進行基準式模擬以驗證理論成果。這些目標針對分布式優化面臨的關鍵問題和基本挑戰，共同構成了在现有分布式優化研究基础上的概念和技術飛躍。基於我们前期和正在進行中的網络控制、多智能体系統和分布式優化工作，本项目制定了一套連貫的技術方法，其中包括具體、現實的解決方案策略，這些策略被認為具有理論意義和實踐可行性，有望提供可量化的重要成果。我們認為，本项目的成果將帶來對分布式優化問題新穎的、更好的理解，推动其設計方法和算法的改進，從而促進優化理論的進步和應用，使廣大研究人員和實踐工程師受益。

11206224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11206224.value: 不同室內環境條件下住宅建築中病毒組的時序變化及其與微生物宿主的交互作用

11206324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11206324.value: 多階段收縮微通道進行單細胞表面蛋白生物感測的無標記和高通量流式細胞術

11206324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11206324.value: Flow cytometry (FCM) can measure various characteristics of single cells in a fast and efficient way. However, FCM relies on fluorescent labeling, which may alter cell behaviors. This may raise concerns about safety and efficacy of the cell therapies using the sorted labeled cells. There is apparently a need for innovative label-free solutions that overcome the constraints of traditional FCM and enable a new paradigm in cell analysis. The recent advancements in microfluidics enable quantitative measurements of cell properties which have been difficult for the traditional cell research techniques. For instance, the biochemical properties of floating cancer cells with molecular labels can be measured by multiple microfluidic techniques with improved biosensing performance. There are also label-free microfluidic techniques based on cell-solid or cell-flow interactions, such as the deformability microcytometry for quantifying biomechanical properties of tumor cells, which have been proven to reflect their metastatic tendency and cancer status. Nevertheless, there is still great demand for the microfluidic label-free and high-throughput FCM techniques for cell phenotyping, classification and screening, and the associated clinical applications. Our aim is to develop a label-free, high-throughput, and fully automated electrokinetic flow micro-cytometry system for multiparametric characterization in biophysical and biochemical domains. It is combined with chip antibody coupling and sensing microelectrodes, to detect the properties of single cells, including cell size, cell deformability, dielectric constant, and cell surface antigen expressions, to perform cell typing and cell subpopulation identification in a label-free manner. The automated system elimination of microscopic imaging and fluorescence sensing such that the unit cost can be largely reduced, inducing its value toward commercialization as a new generation of FCM. The core element for the success of this research is a representative theoretical model to promisingly convert the measured cell signals to the cell properties. We have a strong background and have performed solid preliminary study for this research, which includes a theoretical model describing the cell size and elasticity and the measured signals. We plan to further develop such a model to further consider the interaction between cell surface proteins and antibody-coated channel walls for achieving the cell surface protein quantification. This system can overcome the existing flow cytometry paradigm and can be applied to many fields where conventional FCM cannot be used, such as label-free detection and sorting of rare cells (such as circulating tumor cells, hematopoietic stem cells), and various stages of cell therapy drug manufacturing (such as CAR-T therapy). 流式細胞術 （FCM） 可以快速有效地測量單細胞的各種特性。然而，FCM 依賴於螢游標記，這可能會改變細胞行為。這可能會引起人們對使用分選標記細胞的細胞療法的安全性和有效性的擔憂。顯然，需要創新的無標記解決方案來克服傳統 FCM 的限制，並實現細胞分析的新範式。微流體技術的最新進展使細胞特性的定量測量成為可能，這在傳統細胞研究技術中是難以實現的。例如，具有分子標記的漂浮癌細胞的生化特性可以通過多種微流體技術進行測量，從而提高生物感測性能。還有一些基於細胞、固體或細胞、以及流動相互作用的無標記微流控技術，例如用於量化腫瘤細胞生物力學特性的變形性微細胞術，這些特性已被證明可以反映其轉移趨勢和癌症狀態。儘管如此，對於細胞表型、分類和篩選以及相關的臨床應用，對微流控無標記和高通量 FCM 技術的需求仍然很大。 我們的目標是開發一種無標記、高通量和全自動電動流式微細胞術系統，以用於生物物理和生化領域的多參數表徵。它與晶元抗體偶聯和感測微電極相結合，檢測單細胞的特性，包括細胞大小、細胞變形性、介電常數和細胞表面抗原表達，以無標記方式進行細胞分型和細胞亞群鑒定。自動化系統消除了顯微成像和螢光感感，從而可以大大降低單位成本，使其具有作為新一代 FCM 商業化的價值。這項研究成功的核心要素是一個具有代表性的理論模型，該模型有望將測得的細胞信號轉換為細胞特性。

11207424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11207424.value: 再生碳纖維增強鹼激發水泥基複合材料的防火性能研究

11207424.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11207424.value: Prof Kodur, Venkatesh Kumar R. Prof Sun, Jinhua

11207424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11207424.value: 在土木工程中，建築材料在火災中的結構完整性是一個重要的考慮因素。水泥基複合材料的物理性能、機械性能和耐久性會因爲火災發生退化。以混凝土為例，當暴露在火災中時，會迅速失去強度，導致結構失效，造成人員傷亡和經濟損失。2010年11月15日，中國上海發生建築火災，混凝土結構倒塌造成129人傷亡，直接經濟損失達1.58億元人民幣。當前，水泥行業正面臨減少碳足跡的嚴峻挑戰，而鹼激發水泥 (AAC) 作爲一種可持續的解決方案，有望以較低成本將行業碳排放減少80%。然而，由於缺乏富含鋁矽酸鹽的前驅體材料，限制了AAC的廣泛應用。針對該問題，回收退役太陽能電池板中的廢玻璃 (WG)作為 AAC 前驅體材料是一個潛在的解決方案。然而，與傳統的波特蘭水泥複合材料相比，WG衍生AAC複合材料在高溫下強度損失更大。來自報廢風力渦輪機葉片的再生碳纖維 (rCF) 具有提高WG衍生AAC 複合材料防火性能的潛能。然而， rCF增強AAC複合材料 (rCFAC) 在高溫下可能表現出複雜的結構變化與耦合機制。因此，需要精心設計實驗，並建立精確的數值模擬框架來闡明其火災條件下的結構響應。在火災期間，水泥基複合材料表現出複雜的多物理場現象，涉及傳熱、水分傳遞與機械變形過程的耦合。如何準確表徵由材料退化導致的強非線性本构關係，以及多次開裂和剝落引起的強烈不連續性，是此項目面臨的重要挑戰。為此，本項目將通過系統的實驗研究，開發一個全面耦合的熱-濕度-機械 (THM) 模型，用於研究rCFAC復合材料在高溫下的THM耦合行為。並將開發多尺度多物理場無網格計算框架，通過實驗驗證其有效性和準確性，進而預測rCFAC複合材料在火災中的結構響應與失效行爲。此外，本項目還將進行一系列計算與實驗研究，以評估新開發的rCFAC複合材料在不同設計變量下的防火性能。最後，將進一步開展rCFAC複合材料的多目標優化，以改進其火災安全性、經濟成本和可持續性綜合設計。

11207724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11207724.value: 稀疏地勘数据与填海现场监测数据的物理驱动机器学习

11207724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11207724.value: Machine learning (ML) has achieved tremendous successes in many fields and attracted increasing interest in geotechnical applications, e.g., analysis of soil consolidation induced by reclamations. However, ML development and applications in geotechnical practice are challenging, because extensive training databases are a key to the success of ML, but not available in geotechnical practices. Geotechnical data are often project-specific and limited, leading to a difficulty of developing a suitable database required for training ML. In addition, ML is frequently criticized for its black-box nature. A lack of suitable database and model interpretability are two major obstacles for ML development and applications in geotechnical engineering. This proposed project will address these two obstacles and develop physics-informed and interpretable ML methods for analysis of soil consolidation induced by reclamation. In the proposed ML methods, a project-specific database is generated for each reclamation project through finite element analyses. This database encompasses both project-specific data collected at various project stages (e.g., sparse site investigation data, construction sequences such as preloading) and domain knowledge (e.g., soil mechanics, numerical analysis principles, and engineering judgment). Subsequently, the project-specific database is combined with field monitoring data under a sparse dictionary learning framework to provide accurate, real-time, and interpretable predictions of soil consolidation responses at locations without monitoring data or for future time steps. The PI has developed a preliminary ML method using settlement monitoring data and obtained promising results. In the proposed project, the ML methods will be further developed to incorporate multi-source monitoring data and consider various soil constitutive models and parameters. The interpretability of the ML methods will be enhanced using a game theory-based approach. The proposed methods will be calibrated using real data from reclamation projects, and a software package will be developed to facilitate their applications. This proposed project aims to accelerate a paradigm shift in geotechnical practices towards digital transformation and intelligence. The research outcomes will provide effective and interpretable ML methods and software that may revolutionize geotechnical (e.g., reclamation) practice worldwide. Reclamation-induced soil consolidation responses are spatiotemporally varying, and their accurate prediction is critical for successful delivery of reclamation projects, particularly for shortening project duration and saving cost. This will have tremendous economic and societal impacts, particularly in Hong Kong, where several large-scale reclamation projects are in progress, including the “Lantau Tomorrow Vision” project, which aims to create approximately 1700 hectares of new lands to address the pressing land shortage issue. 机器学习在许多领域（如计算机视觉、自然语言处理等）取得了巨大成功，并在岩土工程实践引发了广泛关注，例如填海诱发的土体固结分析。大规模的训练数据库是机器学习成功的关键，但岩土工程数据通常是典型的小数据，这使得机器学习在岩土实践的发展与应用极具挑战性。岩土工程数据通常针对某特定项目且数量有限，无法构建合适的训练数据库。此外，机器学习常被批评为“黑箱”模型。缺乏合适的训练数据库与模型可解释性差是机器学习在岩土工程领域发展的两大障碍。 为解决该两大障碍，本项目提出物理驱动且可解释的机器学习方法，分析填海诱发的土体固结响应。所提方法拟通过有限元模拟生成特定填海项目的训练数据库。该数据库同时映射不同项目阶段的数据（如稀疏地勘数据、预加载等施工序列）和领域知识（如土力学、数值分析原理及工程判断）。随后，将特定项目的训练数据库与现场监测数据相结合，利用稀疏字典学习框架，提供准确、实时、可解释的土体固结响应预测，特别是针对未知测点与后续时间步的响应预测。项目负责人已通过沉降监测数据开发了初步的机器学习方法。本项目拟进一步扩展该方法，融入多源监测数据，并考虑各种土体本构模型和参数。所提机器学习方法的可解释性将通过博弈论方法予以实现。以填海项目的真实数据校准所提方法，并开发工程软件以促进所提方法在填海项目的实际应用。 本项目旨在加快岩土工程实践向数字化与智能化的范式转变。填海诱发的土体固结响应具有时空变化特性，其准确预测对填海项目的成功实施至关重要，特别在缩短项目周期和节省成本方面。这将产生巨大的经济和社会效益，特别是香港正在进行多个大型填海项目，如“明日大屿愿景”等项目，以应对紧迫的土地短缺问题。

11207924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11207924.value: 基於有序單調性信息的用於雙保真度計算機實驗的改進仿真器

11207924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11207924.value: This project will develop a Gaussian process (GP) model-based statistical emulator for bi-fidelity simulations (i.e., simulations at two levels of fidelity called the high-fidelity (HF) level and low-fidelity (LF) level) that exploits ordered monotonicity information to improve its prediction quality. The term ordered monotonicity information refers to information that both the HF and LF outputs increase/decrease with an input (i.e., they increase/decrease when the input increases), and the HF output increases/decreases either faster or slower than the LF output as the input increases. In other words, the derivatives of the HF and LF outputs with respect to the input are not only known to be nonnegative/nonpositive but are also known to be ordered. Due to advances in computing technology and modeling software, simulators (i.e., computer models) are increasingly employed in engineering work. Many simulators numerically solve partial differential equations (PDEs) with boundary and initial conditions, which we call PDE models. Simulators based on PDE models with different fidelity (i.e., accuracy) levels are frequently available. In bi-fidelity simulations, the HF simulator gives more accurate predictions but incurs longer run times than the LF simulator. To reduce simulation time for tasks that require many HF simulator runs, one can predict the HF output with a bi-fidelity emulator, i.e., an emulator of the HF and LF simulators built with data from both simulators. A popular bi-fidelity emulator is the autoregressive GP (AGP) emulator, which combines information in HF and LF simulation data by modeling the correlation between the HF and LF outputs. However, the AGP emulator does not incorporate ordered monotonicity information. Because ordered monotonicity information significantly narrows the set of functions known to contain the true paired input-output relationships of the HF and LF simulators, imposing ordered monotonicity constraints on a bi-fidelity emulator can yield substantially improved prediction accuracy and shortened prediction intervals with good coverage. This project will develop an emulator for deterministic bi-fidelity simulations that simultaneously incorporates ordered monotonicity information and captures the correlation between HF and LF outputs by modifying the AGP emulator. Computationally efficient methods for constructing the proposed bi-fidelity emulator will be developed. Additionally, prediction performance improvements attained by the proposed emulator over the AGP emulator and emulators that incorporate monotonicity information only will be investigated. The proposed emulator is expected to become a valuable tool for bi-fidelity simulations as it will allow practitioners to exploit ordered monotonicity information to obtain high-quality and physically meaningful emulator predictions. 該項目將開發一個基於高斯過程 （GP） 模型的統計仿真器，用於雙保真度模擬（即，在稱為高保真（HF）水平和低保真（LF）水平的兩個保真度水平進行模擬）。該仿真器利用有序單調性信息來提高其預測質量。術語有序單調性信息是指 HF 和 LF 輸出都隨輸入而增加/減少的信息（即，當輸入增加時，它們會增加/減少），並且隨着輸入的增加， HF 輸出比 LF 輸出增加/減少得更快或更慢。換句話說，HF 和 LF 輸出相對於輸入的導數不僅已知為非負/非正，而且還已知為有序的。 由於計算技術和建模軟件的進步，模擬器（即計算機模型）在工程工作中的應用越來越廣泛。許多模擬器以數值方式求解具有邊界和初始條件的偏微分方程 (PDE)，我們稱之為 PDE 模型。通常可以使用基於具有不同保真度（即準確度）水平的 PDE 模型的模擬器。在雙保真模擬中，HF 模擬器的預測更準確，但運行時間比 LF 模擬器更長。為了減少需要多次運行 HF 模擬器的任務的模擬時間，可以使用雙保真仿真器預測 HF 輸出，即基於HF 和 LF模擬器的數據構建的 HF 和 LF 模擬器的仿真器。一種流行的雙保真仿真器是自回歸 GP (AGP) 仿真器，它通過對 HF 和 LF 輸出之間的相關性進行建模，將 HF 和 LF 模擬數據中的信息結合起來。然而，AGP 仿真器並不包含有序單調性信息。 由於有序單調性信息顯著縮小了已知包含 HF 和 LF 模擬器的真實成對輸入輸出關係的函數集，因此對雙保真度仿真器施加有序單調性約束可以顯著提高預測精度，縮短預測間隔，同時實現良好的覆蓋率。該項目將開發一種用於確定性雙保真度模擬的仿真器，該仿真器同時結合有序單調性信息並通過修改 AGP 仿真器來捕獲 HF 和 LF 輸出之間的相關性。用於構建所提出的雙保真度仿真器的計算效率高的方法將被開發。此外，還將研究所提出的仿真器相對於 AGP 仿真器和僅包含單調性信息的仿真器所實現的預測性能改進。所提出的仿真器有望成為雙保真度模擬的寶貴工具，因為它將允許從業者利用有序單調性信息來獲得高質量且具有物理意義的仿真器預測。

11208324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11208324.value: 體育影片評估：結合3D人體姿勢的深度學習方法

11208324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11208324.value: Action Quality Assessment (AQA) is emerging as a significant tool in sports analytics, aiming to provide more objective evaluations of athletic performances. This research aims to enhance the methodologies of Action Quality Assessment (AQA) by using both skeletal and visual data in sport videos. Contemporary AQA techniques primarily utilize either pose-based or vision-based inputs. However, pure vision-based methods often falter when exposed to complex environmental variables and may miss out on crucial aspects of human mobility. Pure pose methods ignore details in the scene, such as the splash of diving, and traditional 2D key points cannot fully encapsulate the intricacies of human motion. To address these shortcomings, we propose to implement 3D skeletal-data-based methods and combine the RGB videos. We plan to extract 3D human posture information from videos to better gauge action quality. This involves a modular two-stream network that combines the 3D pose with appearance features from RGB videos. Moreover, we will look into another related problem that is to enhance AQA for long sports videos. Long videos often have complex motion sequences which necessitate a thorough understanding of both local and global spatio-temporal relationships. We propose a systematic segmentation approach for long videos to divide them into multiple atomic actions. Besides, we will introduce an attention mechanism to prioritize specific sections of the video that carry more weight in terms of assessment. Afterwards, we plan to explore the research issue for transferring AQA to new domains. Recognizing that some aspects of action quality are consistent across various sports, we will investigate how the principles of AQA can be extended to the general public, for instance in evaluating exercise form. We propose to adopt a multi-action based AQA model and subsequently fine-tune it using data from public exercise videos. Our research, backed by extensive evaluations using diverse datasets, holds the potential to change the way we understand and evaluate sports and exercise videos, promising more accurate, comprehensive, and adaptable action quality assessments. Our work can assist athletes to identify ways to improve their performance. Besides, it can also help the general public to hav a better understanding of sports activities, since many people are excited to watch professional sports escpecially in major events such as Summer and Winter Olympics or Asian Games. 動作品質評估正逐漸成為體育運動分析的一個重要工具，旨在提供更客觀的運動員表現評估。這項研究旨在通過使用體育影片中的骨架和視覺數據，提升動作品質評估的方法。當前的動作品質評估技術主要基於姿勢或視覺輸入，但是純粹基於視覺的方法在面對複雜的環境變數時往往表現不佳，可能會忽略人類移動的重要詳情，然而純粹基於姿勢的方法則忽略場景中的細節，如跳水運動的水花，此外傳統的2D關鍵點無法完全捕捉人體動作的細微之處。為解決這些缺點，我們提議實施基於3D骨架數據並結合RGB影片的方法，我們計劃從影片中提取3D人體姿勢信息，以更有效地評估動作品質，這涉及一個將3D姿勢與影片中的外觀特徵相結合的模組化雙流網絡。此外，我們還將研究另一個相關問題，即如何提升長運動影片的動作品質評估，長影片通常包含複雜的動作序列，所以需要對局部和全域時空關係進行徹底的理解，我們建議使用系統性的分割方法，將長影片分為多個原子動作，另外我們將引入一個注意機制，以優先考慮在評估方面具有更重要的特定影片部分。我們的研究利用多種數據集進行廣泛的評估，具有改變我們理解和評估體育影片的潛力，更有希望提供更準確、全面和適應性強的動作品質評估。

11208724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11208724.value: 面向6G無線系統中通信、感測和學習的網路化智能反射面

11208724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11208724.value: 在過去的幾十年中，無線網路的快速發展，到2020年5G的出現，已經深刻地重塑了我們的日常生活。高通公司預計，到2035年，5G將為全球數字經濟帶來高達13.2萬億美元的貢獻。這一驕人的成就點燃了學術界和產業界對6G無線網路的探索。為了支持眾多令人興奮的應用，例如萬物互聯、大數據分析和擴增實境，除了通信之外，6G 還將擴展其功能，將感知和學習作為服務涵蓋其中。要滿足這些雄心勃勃的要求，就必須開發演進和轉換技術，以實現多功能 6G 網路的演進。 可重構超材料的最新進展引進了智能反射面，由於其具有定制智能無線環境的非凡能力，因此成為未來無線系統的基石。人工薄膜形式的智能反射面可以無縫連接至現有的基礎設施，這大大降低了運營開支和實施的複雜性，促進了 智能反射面的廣泛部署。然而，部署網絡化智能反射面並不僅僅是智能反射面數量的增加，更重要的是現代無線系統模式的轉變。特別是，網路化智能反射面為未來 6G網路中涵蓋通信、感知和學習的獨特應用場景提供了獨特的機會，同時也提出了新的挑戰。 首先，網路化智能反射面能夠繞過障碍物，並透過光束路由為無線通信提供虛擬視距鏈路。然而，我們面臨的挑戰在於如何有效地大規模部署這項技術。為了應對這個難題，我們將利用圖形神經網路的高延展性來開發高效率的網路層級波束路由方法。其次，對於無線感測應用，網路化智能反射面可從不同角度觀察目標，而無需安裝額外的耗電接入點，從而實現了網絡級感知。然而，如何有效地利用網路智能反射面的感測信息是最重要的。在這方面，我們將分別比較主動式與被動式智能反射面的感知效能，並為網路化智能反射面感測系統提供寶貴的系統啟示。最後，在依賴於無線網路的分散式學習系統中，例如聯盟式學習，網路化智能反射面可透過為邊緣使用者配備專用智能反射面來提高學習效能。為了充分發揮智能反射面的潛力，我們的研究將著重於設計具有網路化智能反射面的通信-學習框架，包括收斂分析和優化通信以及計算資源分配。

11209024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11209024.value: 跳躍飛行機器人：基於推力和並聯彈性體驅動達到新跳躍高度

11209024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11209024.value: 近些年，机器人及自主系统的发展取得了显著进展。微型飞行机器人的应用横跨包括基础设施检查及灾害响应的多种领域。然而，其有限的载重能力和续航限制了它们的功能性和部分应用的可行性。另一方面，地面机器人虽然可以携带更重的负载，但缺乏克服障碍物和进入高处空间的能力。 为了解决这些限制，近期的研究开始转向探索既能飞行又能在地面运动的平台。大多数混合机器人设计都依赖于直接结合其每种运动模式的独立机制，导致总体性能较低。驱动其腿或轮子的机构带来了额外的质量和复杂性，影响了它们的移动能力和飞行效率。为克服这些挑战，我们团队最近开发了Hopcopter——一种能够单腿连续跳跃的四旋翼飞行器。通过将一个被动弹性腿集成到无人机上，现有的飞行平台可转变为跳跃机器人，其自带的螺旋桨可作为两种运动模式的共享的驱动器。这种协同运动方式最大限度地减少了重量和功耗，不再牺牲效率。 本研究旨在通过以下三个步骤探索推力驱动和并联弹性驱动机器人在不同尺度上的潜力，以扩展Hopcopter的能力。第一个任务是通过将被动适应性的腿与现有的昆虫尺度扑翼飞行器平台结合，创造出第一个能够连续跳跃的亚克级机器人。这是通过利用被动腿在机械结构上的简单性和推力驱动跳跃的较低功率需求来实现的。第二个任务旨在提升推力驱动跳跃机器人的载重能力。利用双向推力的螺旋桨，将弹跳机器人的载重能力提升至数倍于其最大推力的水平。预计一架无人机可以通过跳跃携带数倍于自身重量的载荷。此外，当携带一套视觉传感器和用于执行惯性里程计的计算单元时，该机可实现自主导航。最后，我们提出了具有能量和跳跃高度调节能力的并联弹性体跳跃驱动器。该机构可延长驱动器的做工时间，从而增加弹跳能量和高度。该系统具备一个可在接触地面时被动触发的锁定机构，使其可连续跳跃。该任务旨在是开发一种100克级别的机器人，并实现3米的连续跳跃，超越现有记录。 项目完成后，这项研究有望显著推进多模态机器人的发展，为高效、多功能和高跳跃能力的机器人的发展做出贡献。主要的科学贡献将来自于（i）展示亚克级昆虫尺度机器人的连续跳跃，这是微型机器人领域的开创性成就；（ii）跳跃运动带来的飞行机器人有效载荷限制的大幅提高；以及（iii）设计和实现能够调节储存能量的并联弹性体驱动器，从而达到跳跃高度的新纪录。

11209224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11209224.value: 透過深共晶效應增強鋅金屬電池動力學性能的電解質和界面策略

11209224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11209224.value: Zinc-based batteries (ZMBs) have been thrust into the spotlight once more, being particularly appealing for large-scale energy storage due to their abundant availability, eco-friendliness, and inherent safety. Unlike other metals like lithium, sodium, or potassium, zinc isn't easily affected by elements such as oxygen or moisture. This trait not only makes a wider variety of electrolytes available but also cuts down on the associated costs. Yet, challenges like the formation of dendritic structures and undesired reactions at the zinc-electrolyte juncture limit the potential of ZMBs. Recently, there's been a shift towards using deep eutectic solvents (DES) as a substitute for the typical aqueous electrolytes by uniquely combining zinc salts with neutral ligands. This pairing reduces the connection between zinc ions and water, fostering stronger hydrogen bonds between water and the eutectic materials. A key factor here is the tight bond between zinc ions and ligands, which raises the desolvation energy of zinc ions, ensuring a more uniform zinc deposition. Building on this foundational knowledge, researchers are keen on exploring ligands with varied molecular characteristics to balance the relationship among zinc ions, water, and eutectic elements. Such an approach is seen as a potential game-changer in enhancing the durability and performance of the zinc anode. Furthermore, the concept of the Solid Electrolyte Interphase (SEI) brings a novel solution to the table, aiming to overcome inherent challenges linked to zinc anodes. One way to achieve this is by altering the solvation structure in DESs, paving the way for modifying the reduction potentials of the electrolyte's components. This modification can be pivotal in creating an optimal SEI layer. Such advancements can unlock enhanced functionalities, notably in stymieing dendrite growth and promoting consistent, efficient performance for ZMBs. In this project, we propose the development of linear amide-based deep eutectic electrolytes with cyclic amide additives, a strategic approach intended to regulate the solvation structure while limiting water activity, thus promoting smooth and stable Zn deposition. Moreover, we plan to incorporate electrolyte diluents to attain DES electrolytes with higher ion conductivity and limited water activity. In addition, the F-rich species as additives in DES electrolytes will be explored meticulously, which is designed to establish high-fluoride content SEI with enhanced ionic conductivity. Benefiting from the highly reversible and stable zinc interface, efforts will be dedicated to the development of ampere-hour (Ah) level high-voltage, high-capacity, long-cycle zinc metal full batteries utilizing the developed DES electrolytes. 鋅基電池（ZMB）再次成為人們關注的焦點，由於其豐富的可用性、環保性和固有的安全性，對於大規模儲能特別有吸引力。與鋰、鈉或鉀等其他金屬不同，鋅不易受到氧或水分等元素的影響。這項特性不僅使電解質的種類更加豐富，也降低了相關成本。然而，枝晶結構的形成和鋅-電解質接合處的不良反應等挑戰限制了 ZMB 的潛力。 最近，透過將鋅鹽與中性配體獨特地結合，人們開始轉向使用低共熔溶劑 (DES) 作為典型水性電解質的替代品。這種配對減少了鋅離子和水之間的聯繫，促進水和共晶材料之間更強的氫鍵。這裡的一個關鍵因素是鋅離子和配體之間的緊密結合，這提高了鋅離子的去溶劑化能，確保更均勻的鋅沉積。基於這些基礎知識，研究人員熱衷於探索具有不同分子特徵的配體，以平衡鋅離子、水和共晶元素之間的關係。這種方法被視為增強鋅陽極的耐用性和性能的潛在遊戲規則改變者。 此外，固體電解質界面（SEI）的概念帶來了一種新穎的解決方案，旨在克服與鋅陽極相關的固有挑戰。實現這一目標的一種方法是改變 DES 中的溶劑化結構，為改變電解質成分的還原電位鋪路。這種修改對於創建最佳 SEI 層至關重要。這些進步可以釋放增強的功能，特別是在阻止枝晶生長和促進 ZMB 一致、高效的性能方面。 在這個項目中，我們建議開發帶有環醯胺添加劑的線性醯胺基深共晶電解質，這是一種旨在調節溶劑化結構同時限制水活度的策略方法，從而促進平穩穩定的鋅沉積。此外，我們計劃加入電解質稀釋劑以獲得具有更高離子電導率和有限水活度的DES電解質。此外，還將仔細探索富氟物質作為DES電解質中的添加劑，旨在建立具有增強離子電導率的高氟含量SEI。受益於高度可逆且穩定的鋅介面，利用所開發的DES電解質，將致力於開發安時（Ah）級高電壓、高容量、長循環的鋅金屬全電池。

11210024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11210024.value: 分散式網路控制系統的隱私意識設計：定向信息方法

11210024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11210024.value: 分散式網絡化控制系統(networked control system，NCS)具有高可擴展性、容錯性和靈活性的特點。因此，它們已與許多工程系統緊密整合，例如，智慧電網、智慧交通系統和智慧建築。儘管NCS具有顯著的優勢，但由於 (i) 它們與信息和通訊技術的整合以及 (ii)第三方運算服務（例如雲端運算）的廣泛使用， NCS也存在隱私洩露的風險。隱私泄露可能會給NCS的營運商和用戶帶來嚴重後果，例如聲譽下降和收入損失。 本項目將解決有關分散式NCS隱私保護的兩個重要問題：（i）如何量化分散式 NCS的隱私等級？ (ii) 如何在保障隱私的要求下設計最優的分散式NCS？我們首先提出定向信息（directed information）作為一種新穎的隱私度量來量化分散式 NCS 的隱私等級。定向信息是一個信息論概念，用於測量隨機過程之間的信息流。通過使用這個指標，我們可以量化分散式 NCS 中的隱私信息流，並研究系統參數（例如通訊拓撲）對其隱私等級的影響。這些結果可用於評估各種分散式NCS的隱私等級。 接下來，我們開發計算框架，用於分散式 NCS中隱私滤波器、估計器和控制器的聯合最佳化設計。我們將分散式 NCS 的隱私保護設計視為去中心化最優控制問題，其中目標是根據定向信息評估的隱私等級來優化閉環性能（估計損失）。我們將使用兩種不同的技術來研究最優去中心化隱私濾波器、估計器和控制器的結構特性：共有信息方法和逐人方法（person-by-person approach）。然後，我們開發有效的數值算法來實現最優具有隱私保護的分散式 NCS 設計並研究隱私和閉環性能（估計損失）之間的最佳權衡。 最後，我們整合所有開發的結果，並使用真實的樓宇自動化應用程式驗證框架。佔用（不同建築物區域的佔用人數）是高度敏感的信息。因為佔用人數可以根據暖氣、通風和空調 (heating, ventilation and air conditioning, HVAC) 系統的感測器測量值準確推斷佔用率。通過使用定向信息，我們首先描述 HVAC 系統中隱私信息流的特徵。然後，我們研究 HVAC 系統隱私濾波器和控制器的最佳化設計。最後，我們使用建築模擬器將該項目的成果與最先進的隱私保護解決方案進行對比

11210424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11210424.value: 非線性多智能體系統分佈式事件觸發協同控制及其應用

11210424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11210424.value: Distributed cooperative control of multiple dynamic systems, also called multi-agent systems (MASs), has been a central topic in the control and robotics community over the past two decades due to its great potential in real-world applications. Common application examples include search and rescue by a team of unmanned aerial vehicles and environmental monitoring by multi-robot systems. To achieve cooperative control, communication between agents is often needed for information exchange and continuous communication has been widely adopted. However, continuous communication often leads to excessive and unnecessary consumption of energy and communication resources. In real-world scenarios, such resources are always limited. Therefore, event-triggered control strategies have emerged as an effective solution to this issue. As a fundamental topic in the cooperative control of MASs, distributed cooperative robust output regulation of MASs has been widely studied via various control strategies including event-triggered control strategies. Nevertheless, most existing works on the cooperative robust control problems of MASs with event-triggered strategies still rely on continuous communication to monitor event-triggering conditions. In addition, communication between agents is often subject to communication delays and time-varying communication topologies, which are known to have an adverse impact on the performance of the concerned MASs, and even worse, to hinder the accomplishment of cooperative control tasks. Recent literature reveals that when communication delays and time-varying communication topologies are considered, the distributed cooperative robust output regulation of nonlinear MASs with event-triggered communication has not been well studied yet. This project will investigate the problems of cooperative robust output regulation for nonlinear MASs using event-triggered control in which not only the controller updates but also the communication between agents is triggered by events. The main challenges of these problems lie in the complexity of nonlinear agent dynamics, communication constraints, as well as the hybrid dynamics nature arising from the occurrence of events. This project will develop new distributed control strategies with both event-triggered communication and event-triggered control updates to solve the cooperative robust output regulation problem for a typical class of nonlinear MASs under communication delays and switching topologies. The anticipated outcomes of this project are expected to offer solutions to numerous fundamental and critical obstacles encountered in cooperative control problems. These solutions will greatly facilitate the practical application of cooperative control in real-world scenarios. 由於巨大的實際應用潛力，多智能體系統的分布式協同控制已經成為控制理論和機器人學領域內的核心研究課題。常見的應用案例包括無人飛行器集群搜索與救援任務和多機器人系統環境監測。為了實現協同控制目标，智能體間的通信至關重要，現有的研究成果通常採用連續通信。然而，連續通信往往導致資源的過度消耗，包括通信能源和通信資源。 在現實世界中，這些資源一般是極為稀缺的。因此，事件觸發控制策略作為解決此問題的有效方法而逐漸興起。在多智能體系統的協同控制領域，分布式魯棒協同輸出調節已經被廣泛研究。但大多數現有研究在應用事件觸發策略時，仍然依賴連續通信來監測觸發條件。此外，通信延遲和時間變化的通信拓撲等因素對多智能體的協同控制性能有顯著影響，甚至可能阻礙協同控制任務的完成。當這些因素被納入考量時，非線性多智能體系統的分布式魯棒協同輸出調節問題尚未得到充分研究。 本項目將採用事件觸發控制策略，解決非線性多智能體系統的魯棒協同輸出調節問題。該控制策略不僅基於事件觸發條件更新控制器，也基於事件觸發條件決定智能體間的通信。该問題的主要挑戰在於非線性智能體動力學的複雜性、通信限制，以及由事件觸發所帶來的系統混雜動力學特性。本項目將開發採用事件觸發通信和控制更新的新型分布式控制策略，解決在通信延遲和时變拓撲下的非線性多智能體系統的魯棒協同輸出調節問題。所預期的研究成果能夠解決多智能體系統協同控制領域面臨的诸多基本且關鍵的難題，促進其實際應用。

11210524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11210524.value: 透過長者友善的城市公園設施管理改善社區長者的生活質素

11210524.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11210524.value: Prof CHONG, Ming Lin Alice Prof SINNETT, Danielle

11210524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11210524.value: Increasing life expectancy and reduced mortality are leading to significant growth of the aging population in Hong Kong (HK). The proportion of older people, defined as those aged over 65 years, is projected to rise from 18% in 2019 to 35% in 2035 (Census and Statistics Dept. (CSD) 2023). More than 95% of older people are living in domestic households (CSD 2023). With various physical issues (e.g., poor balance, vision impairment, hearing disability, etc.), it is not easy for older people to go far from their homes. Unfortunately, most of them are living in accommodations with limited space (<41m2 for whole household). This ultimately further detracts from their holistic quality of life (QoL), including physical health, social relationships, and psychological health. Urban parks located close to residential buildings provide convenient spaces for the older people to enjoy leisure activities, which support their QoL particularly in a high-density environment such as HK. The government re-enacted its ‘aging in place’ policy in 2022 (Gov.HK 2022) and has provided additional subsidies to non-governmental organizations for the special needs of older people, but these were mainly used to increase manpower rather than improve the physical environment. The existing policy in HK still lacks detailed guidance on designing parks for older people, and unsuitable park environments reduce their QoL and lead safety issues. There is extensive literature on landscaping, facilities management, caring environmental design, post-occupancy evaluation, physical/psychological health, and QoL for adults and older people in general, but little research integrates all these aspects into urban parks for older people in particular. The purpose of this study is to improve the QoL of older people in the community through an age-friendly facility management in urban parks (FM(UP)). This study aims to develop an integrated FM(UP)–QoL model for older people in the community. Its objectives are: 1) to identify the urban park FM components (space management, supporting facilities, building services) and the overall QoL of older people in the community; 2) to establish relationships between FM(UP) components and QoL of older people as identified; 3) to develop an integrated FM(UP)-QoL model for older people; 4) to verify the FM(UP)-QoL model with case studies; and 5) to propose urban park FM guidelines for older people. The findings will promote the development of a proactive holistic assessment of FM in urban parks and, finally, enhance the QoL of older people in the community. 隨著各種身體問題的出現（如平衡力差、視力受損、聽力障礙等），老年人很難遠離家。位於住宅區附近的城市公園為老年人提供了便捷的休閒活動空間。然而，香港現有政策仍缺乏針對老年人設計公園的詳細指導，不適宜的公園環境降低了他們的生活質量，並引發安全問題。 本研究旨在透過在城市公園中實施老年友好設施管理(FM(UP))，改善社區老年人的生活質量(QoL)，並為社區中的老年人開發一個綜合的城市公園設施管理-生活質量(FM(UP)–QoL)模型。具體目標包括：識別城市公園設施管理的組成部分以及社區老年人的整體生活質量；為老年人開發一個綜合的FM(UP)–QoL模型；並為老年人提出城市公園設施管理的指導原則。本研究結果將推動城市公園設施管理的主動全面評估的發展，最終提升社區中老年人的生活質量。

11211624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11211624.value: 對抗攻擊在社會友善應用的創新：圖像隱形水印技術

11211624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11211624.value: 图像生成模型（例如，Midjourney）可以生成逼真的合成图像，即生成式图像（Generative Images，GenIm）。由於這些圖像在網絡上可以被用作虛假圖像來欺騙他人，所以建立一個驗證GenIm內容來源的方法可以有效提高網絡圖像用戶的信任度。同時，隨著越來越多的畫家喜歡在網絡媒體平台創作和分享自己的繪畫作品，一種保護電子畫作知識產權的方法也是至關重要的。而圖像水印技術可以同時解決這兩個問題，即在原始圖像中加入一些畫面修改信息作為水印。這種畫面上的像素修改是人眼不可見到的，從而維持添加水印後的圖片與原始圖片的畫面一致性。當GenIm被加入水印後，用戶可以通過檢測圖像中的水印來判斷該圖像是否是生成式的。另外，畫作的創作者可以在網絡公開自己畫作之前添加上反映自己身份信息的水印，並通過提取出水印來主張自己對圖像的所有權。現有的大多數水印方法一是基於傳統方法，即用相關的理論明確水印的檢測準確率的下界。但由於這類方法使用公開的線性嵌入函數，所以水印的安全性較低。二是基於深度學習，這些方法使用非線性嵌入函數來提高水印的檢測準確率和安全性，但這類方法缺乏理論上的支撐。本項目提出一個新的水印框架「對抗攻擊水印（Adversarial Attack for Watermark，AA4W）」。此方法結合了傳統方法和深度學習的優勢，為水印的檢測率提供理論上的下界和更高的安全性。具體來說，首先，該框架使將用深度神經網絡（Deep Neural Network）訓練出一個作為密鑰的網絡（Secret Key Network, SKN），然後在這個SKN上使用對抗攻擊算法產生的噪聲作為水印嵌入圖像中。同時這個SKN還可以作為水印檢測模型提取出圖像中的水印信息。提取出來的水印信息將接受假設檢驗，並在理論上為檢測模型的水印檢測誤報率提供上界。其次，AA4W將被用於進行隱寫術，即框架採用實數向量作為水印信息嵌入圖片中，而更改掉之前工作中使用的比特串向量作為水印。這需要先對水印空間的容量進行擴充並利用圖像/文字編碼模型來獲得上此實數向量。最後，本框架將在多方使用場景下進行安全測試。例如測試於一張圖片中使用不同SKN嵌入多個水印造成的衝突，以及非對稱密鑰方法的可用性。本研究試圖將用於攻擊或破壞DNN系統的對抗攻擊算法轉變為對社會有益的圖片水印方法，即為電子畫作創作者提供知識產權保護方法，並為網絡用戶和GenAI公司提供判斷圖像來源真偽的鑑定手段。

11212524.value: 众多現實應用涉及重複解決不同範例的優化問題，例如工程設計、化學過程控制、生產計劃和智能代理設計。這些不同的範例可以用描述每個問題特徵的參數來表示，而解決所有此類問題實例的任務稱為參數化優化。在過去的幾十年裡，人們提出了許多算法來解決參數化優化問題。然而，這些算法有兩個主要缺點：（1）它們需要單獨解決每個單獨的優化問題，這可能導致非常高的計算開銷，特別是當可能的問題參數的基數很大時，（2）許多現實應用可能會需要對新問題實例進行即時求解，而這些算法並不支持這一點。 本項目將開發新穎且高效的基於模型的演化參數化優化算法。透過利用解決具有不同問題參數值的問題實例所獲得的信息，我們提出建立一個數學模型，如高斯過程或神經網路模型，用於近似參數化優化問題的整個解集。這樣，我們可以以零樣本的方式，不經過任何優化步驟，直接獲得具有不同新問題實例的近似最優解。此外，从參數化優化的角度，我們將把我們的方法推廣到同倫優化和平滑優化，並開發新的基於模型的算法來解決非凸和非平滑優化問題。我們將在電子設計自動化問題上測試我們提出的演化參數化優化方法。

11214924.value: 推進宏基因組中質粒蛋白註釋和宿主範圍識別

11214924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11214924.value: Experts refer to antibiotic resistance as “the slow-moving pandemic”, which underlines three things: the high mortality rate, the extensive scope of its impact, and the long duration of its influence. Antibiotic resistance happens when bacteria become immune to antibiotics. They can do this in two ways: 1) inherit antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) from their parent bacteria; 2) get these genes from other bacteria through a process called horizontal gene transfer (HGT). Key players in HGT are plasmids, self-replicating molecules found within many bacterial cells. They can pass on their ARGs to other bacteria in the same environment, making those bacteria resistant to antibiotics too. Because plasmid can disseminate ARGs, monitoring plasmids is important for assessing the risk of antibiotic resistance. Many plasmids have been sequenced via advanced sequencing technologies. However, plasmid characterization falls far behind the sequencing efforts. There are two fundamental needs: 1) Many proteins in plasmids have not been annotated, meaning we don't know their functions; 2) Many newly sequenced plasmids lack host range information, so we don't know which organisms they affect. The central goal of this proposal is to develop domain knowledge-guided deep learning models for understanding plasmid-mediated gene transfer. To address this, we have three objectives: 1) annotating the functions of plasmid proteins; 2) predicting hosts of plasmids; and 3) deriving plasmid-mediated ARG transfer network in collaboration with two microbiologists. Lacking protein annotation poses a significant challenge for plasmid characterization and host prediction. Traditional methods, like sequence alignment, have limited success due to the high diversity of plasmids. In our approach, we will leverage the modular structure of proteins in plasmids. Correspondingly, our methodology will capitalize on the large protein model and the modern natural language models to enhance feature representation and context-aware learning. With the annotated functions, we will select proteins involved in the plasmid transfer process and design a host prediction algorithm integrating diverse features: the key proteins involved in plasmid transfer, plasmid similarity, plasmid vs. chromosome similarity, and protein structure binding. Finally, we will apply our designed algorithms to two types of samples: those from wild rats in Hong Kong, and those from wastewater treatment plants. Given the close association of these samples with human habitats, their microbiomes may harbor pathogens of interest. Moreover, these ecosystems exhibit intricate dynamics, making them ideal testbeds for investigating potential transfer of ARGs to pathogens via plasmids. 專家稱抗生素抗性為「緩慢蔓延的流行病」，這強調了三點：高死亡率、影響範圍廣泛以及影響持續時間長。抗生素抗性發生在細菌對抗生素產生免疫時。細菌可以通過兩種方式做到這一點：1）從親代細菌繼承抗生素抗性基因（ARGs）；2）通過一種稱為水平基因轉移（HGT）的過程從其他細菌獲得這些基因。HGT 的關鍵角色是質粒，這些是存在於許多細菌細胞中的自我複製分子。它們可以將其 ARGs 傳遞給同一環境中的其他細菌，使這些細菌也對抗生素產生抗性。由於質粒可以傳播 ARGs，監測質粒是評估抗生素抗性風險的關鍵部分。 許多質粒已經通過先進的測序技術進行測序。然而，我們缺乏用於理解這些質粒如何轉移其基因的計算工具。這種缺乏主要有兩個問題：1）許多質粒中的蛋白質尚未被註釋，意味著我們不知道它們的功能；2）許多新測序的質粒缺乏宿主信息，因此我們不知道它們影響哪些生物體。 這項提案的核心目標是開發基於領域知識指導的深度學習模型，以推導質粒介導的基因轉移。為此，我們有三個目標：1）註釋質粒蛋白的功能；2）預測質粒的宿主；3）與兩位微生物學家合作推導質粒介導的 ARG 轉移網絡。 缺乏蛋白質註釋對質粒特徵分析和宿主預測構成了重大挑戰。傳統的方法，如序列比對，由於質粒的高度多樣性而成功有限。在我們的方法中，我們將利用質粒中蛋白質的模塊結構。因此，我們的方法將利用大型蛋白質模型和現代自然語言模型來增強特徵表示和上下文感知學習。通過註釋的功能，我們將選擇參與質粒轉移過程的蛋白質，並設計一種整合多樣化特徵的宿主預測算法：參與質粒轉移的關鍵蛋白質、質粒相似性、質粒與染色體相似性以及蛋白質結構結合。最後，我們將把設計的算法應用於兩種類型的樣本：來自香港野生大鼠的樣本和來自廢水處理廠的樣本。由於這些樣本與人類棲息地密切相關，它們的微生物群可能攜帶感興趣的病原體。此外，這些生態系統展現出複雜的動態，使其成為通過質粒研究 ARGs 向病原體潛在轉移的理想試驗場。

11215024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11215024.value: 非線性光子器件能在不同頻率間生成、轉換和互聯光信號，是各類經典與量子光學應用的重要組成單元。例如，光通信信號的相位敏感放大理論上可以突破傳統放大器中固有的3dB噪聲極限；自發下轉換的光子可為量子信息處理提供糾纏光子對來源；光學頻率梳得益於其等間距的頻率分量和相位鎖定的重複時間脈衝，可望為波分復用光通信系統提供緊湊光源，以及在天文學、光譜學和計量學中作為超精密的標尺。 在各種非線性平臺中，薄膜周期性極化鈮酸鋰（PPLN）因其強大的材料非線性和薄膜波導中優良的光束縛而特別具有吸引力。然而，目前的薄膜PPLN器件通常使用電子束曝光等芯片級工藝製造，限制了其產量、可擴展性和一致性。這對於需要在同一芯片上集成多個性能一致的非線性器件的大規模非線性光子系統應用是一個重要挑戰。 在本項目中，我們旨在通過開發基於紫外步進光刻和自動化極化工藝的晶圓級鈮酸鋰非線性光子平臺來解決這一挑戰。為了補償由於晶圓上薄膜厚度變化引起的不均勻展寬效應，我們將設計並製造分段熱光調諧模塊，以便在每個部分局部調整和對齊準相位匹配光譜以實現最佳波長轉換。基於這一可擴展製造和調諧方案，我們最終將展示一個大規模的非線性光子線路，該線路包括多個PPLN和其他功能性光子元件，以實現高效的高速光通信信號相位敏感放大。項目負責人團隊在鈮酸鋰器件加工工藝上的豐富經驗和前期在鈮酸鋰晶體周期極化方面的初步成果是實現本項目目標的重要支撐。 此項目的成功完成不僅將開發一個與現有鈮酸鋰光子器件和代工工藝兼容的晶圓級非線性光子平臺。更重要的是，該平臺將實現具有前所未有功能的大規模非線性光子線路的集成。這將為未來需要可擴展、高性能和可調諧非線性光子器件的量子和經典光子應用開辟新的可能性。

11215524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11215524.value: 通過多元素摻雜策略開發高性能無鈷和超高鎳層狀正極

11215524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11215524.value: Lithium-ion batteries as an energy storage system attract much attention because of their high energy density and broad application spectrum in many fields, such as portable electronic devices, electric vehicles (EVs), and stationary energy storage. Driven by the ever-increasing demand of the EVs and clean energy storage market, many works have been done to increase performance and reduce the cost of Li-ion batteries. Cathode materials are the core component of batteries and account for nearly one-third of the total battery cost. To reduce the cost and improve the performance of the batteries, Mn, Ni, and other elements were used to substitute Co in LiCoO2, the first commercialized cathode. In recent years, the nickel-rich LiNixCoyMnzO2 (x≥0.8, referred to as Ni-rich NCMs) layered cathodes have been the focus of research and development worldwide, because substituting Co with Ni could significantly reduce the cost and deliver a higher capacity in the commercial electrolyte working window. However, increasing the Ni content in the cathode is accompanied by structural instability, especially when the Ni content exceeds 80%. Achieving a higher Ni content and long-term high performance simultaneously remains challenging. Based on our previous success in dual-element doped LiCoO2 and inspired by the recent works on cation-disordered rock salt-type high-entropy cathodes and compositionally complex doped Ni-rich layered cathodes (Ni content of 80%), here we propose using a multi-element doping strategy to develop high-performance Co-free and ultra-high nickel (CFUHN) layered cathodes. The targeted cathodes will have a Ni concentration higher than 95% with long-term stable cyclic performance. Recently, our preliminary work using this strategy has shown very promising results, as detailed in the main text. In this proposal, we will design and develop multi-element doped CFUHN cathodes that will exhibit reversible capacity ≥ 200 mAh g-1 with a retention rate higher than 92% after 200 cycles. In addition, the underlying mechanisms of doping effects on structural stability and performance improvement will also be investigated and clarified. The final objective of this project is to seek optimal combinations of doping elements, investigate the thermal stability and realize the practical application of high-performance CFUHN cathodes.

11215624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11215624.value: 抗菌藍光在醫院環境中對多重耐葯微生物表面的高效消毒研究

11215624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11215624.value: Healthcare-associated infections (HAIs) are a serious global public health issue. The threat associated with the high occurrence of multidrug-resistant organisms (MDRO) has high rates of morbidity and mortality. In the United States, 1.7 million HAIs develop each year, resulting in over 98,000 deaths. A study in China showed that HAIs increased hospital stays by 8.2 to 12.6 days. There is solid evidence showing that a contaminated hospital environment contributes to HAIs. Although chemical disinfectants are commonly used, increasing evidence suggests the ineffectiveness of cleaning and decontaminating surfaces in hospitals. Furthermore, the recurrence of contamination on surfaces after disinfection poses a significant challenge, particularly for high-touch surfaces. Photodynamic inactivation has been demonstrated to be highly effective against a wide range of microorganisms. Antimicrobial blue light (aBL) as a non-touch disinfection approach has the benefit of minimal cytotoxicity to mammalian cells, being much safer than ultraviolet C for human cell lines as demonstrated by the existing literature. aBL has the potential to be used in the presence of people and be operated continuously, which is a huge operational advantage. In addition, aBL penetrates deeper into surfaces and thus might give higher surface disinfection than UVC for porous materials like fabrics. Nonetheless, in the literature, almost all aBL studies have focused on water or food processing. In the proposed project, we will investigate the surface disinfection efficacy of 405-nm aBL using light-emitting diodes as the light source. Different MDRO will be selected from the threat list of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. MDRO in the forms of adhered cells and biofilms will be tested. We will conduct experiments to pursue multiple goals. The first goal will be to enhance the disinfection efficacy of aBL. To this end, the efficacy of pulsed operation and the exogenous photosensitizers will be examined. The second goal will be to study the aBL effectiveness for decontaminating fabrics and non-porous surfaces commonly found in hospital wards. The final goal will be to test aBL in a full-scale chamber to evaluate the disinfection performance in practical scenarios. No study has systematically investigated methods using aBL for enhancing surface disinfection on various surfaces in hospital environments, which is very relevant to mitigate the HAIs. The successful completion of this project will have a number of profound impacts on public health and contribute to a multifaceted approach that combines aBL with conventional healthcare hygiene protocols to further reduce HAIs.

11216324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11216324.value: 擴散和聚焦: 基于多RIS網路的無線環境增强技术

11216324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11216324.value: 無線通信設計通常假設傳輸環境是給定的，在發射器和接收器之間除了兩端之外，不能主動增強和調整。可重構智能表面（RIS）的出現改變了這種情況。通過操縱 RIS 元素及其在傳輸環境中的部署，電磁波可以以定制的方式自適應地重塑和重定向，以顯著提高網絡性能。儘管如此，當前的 RIS 設計主要集中在單跳通信上，通常只涉及單個 RIS 或單跳 RIS，缺乏全面的網絡層面設計。因此，這些方法無法充分利用RIS 的潛力來協作增強無線通信環境。 在這個項目中，我們充分利用 RIS 的潛力來創造更豐富的鏈路和路徑多樣性，以增強無線網絡性能。我們的總體目標是建立一個全面而智能的多 RIS 框架，即擴散和聚焦，以實現6G通信無線傳輸環境的智能定制。該設計涵蓋以下關鍵方面：1) 考慮成本和環境限制等實際因素進行多 RIS 佈局；2) 通過高效的協作和控制策略協調基站和 RIS協作；3) 探索在MIMO 等傳統無線技術輔助的RIS 網絡，以改善鏈路多樣性；4) 利用無線 RIS 網絡（例如無人機輔助 RIS 網絡）來增強端到端路徑多樣性。在此框架下，我們設計策略以有效利用 RIS 提供的豐富的鏈路及路徑多樣性，顯著提高網絡性能。為了嚴格驗證我們提出的方案，我們建立了實驗測試平台。該項目預計將開辟一個新的研究方向，即利用 RIS 模擬網路和多 RIS 系統中的網路層面設計來大幅提高通訊容量。 該項目將加強無線通訊和網路、系統管理和控制、機器學習、優化和物聯網應用的多學科研究工作，從而推動無線通訊的創新並促進經濟發展。在工程方面，擬議的研究為無線電信建立了一個重要範式，大大豐富了資訊和通訊技術的科學知識，並為 6G 中 RIS 的創新使用做出了貢獻。在教育領域，實驗測試平台可以訂製化以支援特定應用，例如用於老年人護理的智慧家庭解決方案和工業物聯網，作為吸引本科生參與研究的平台。

11217124.value: Wireless ranging is the estimation of the distance between two wireless nodes and is a core component of localization and tracking systems. Ranging measurements from multiple reference points to an object are combined to estimate an object’s current position, and to reliably do localization requires accurate ranging measurements. Time-of-flight(ToF) ranging with Ultrawideband(UWB) has received renewed attention due to growing prevalence of this technology, e.g. increased availability of chipsets supporting the IEEE 802.15.4a standard for UWB ranging, and the introduction of UWB in Apple iPhones and AirTags. However, UWB has long been considered a prominent wireless ranging technology, which has distinguished itself from other wireless ranging approaches, with its ability to achieve highly accurate and precise distance estimates. The expected accuracy of UWB ranging, however, is generally achieved in line-of-sight(LOS) ranging cases, with distance error increasing significantly in non-line-of-sight(NLOS) cases, i.e. when there is an obstacle in the ranging path that forces the signal to travel around or through. The impact of these ranging errors can be reduced if we can 1) detect if ranging was done under NLOS conditions (NLOS identification), and 2) correct the ranging distance (NLOS mitigation). Existing methods for NLOS identification and mitigation are built on classification and regression models, respectively, which are trained using channel impulse responses(CIRs) gathered from extensive measurement campaigns, i.e. characterization of each site where the ranging system will be deployed. This complicates system deployment to new sites, even if the environment is similar to previous sites, i.e. if we have characterized an office environment and we deploy the system to another office with different dimensions and layout, we would need to characterize the new site. It is also not ideal in dynamic environments, i.e. if a site layout changes, then it needs to be characterized again. We address this problem by developing methods for NLOS identification and mitigation that can allow adaptation to uncharacterized environments. Specifically, we will design and evaluate new classification and regression models that can be trained with measurements from one environment, but can then also be used in other environments with little to no additional measurement and retraining. Developing environment-independent models for NLOS ranging is a largely unexplored topic in related literature. Our project therefore has scientific merit, initiating early formative work on machine learning(ML) models designed specifically for NLOS identification and mitigation in uncharacterized environments, and the potential to improve current industrial UWB ranging systems. 無線測距(Wireless Ranging)是定位和追蹤系統的核心部件，其目標是去估算兩個不同的無線節點之間的距離。通過合併某個目標節點到多個參考測試點的距離就可以用作估計該目標節點在係統中的位置，同時可靠的定位需要精確的距離測量。隨著超寬帶(Ultrawideband, UWB)技術的日益普及，基於UWB的飛行時間測距技術(Time-Of-Flight, ToF)再次受到了廣大關注，例如支持IEEE 802.15.4a標準的超寬帶測距可用性增加，同時還有超寬帶測距技術在Apple iPhones以及AirTags的使用。長期以來，超寬帶無線測距技術一直被認為是一種突出的無線技術，它以能够實現高度準確和精確的距離估計而與其他無線測距技術區分開來。 超寬帶測距技術的期望精度通常在可視距(line-of-sight, LOS)測距案例中可以達到。然而，在非視距(Non-Line-Of-Sight, NLOS)案例中，即當測距路徑中有障礙物迫使信號繞過或者穿過時，測試距離誤差會顯著增加。這種測試距離誤差的影響可以根據如下兩種情況進行降低： (1) 識別測距是否在非視距情況下完成；(2) 修正測距距離(NLOS抑制)。 現有的非視距識別和抑制方法主要分別基於分類和迴歸模型，這些模型的訓練使用來自於廣泛測量活動的信道脈衝響應(Channel Impulse Responses, CIRs)，即將測距系統實際部署位置的測量數據進行特徵化。這種做法的難點在於：當測距系統被安裝在一個新的環境中時，即使這個新的部署環境和之前的環境類似，該系統的環境特徵需要被重新測試。例如，我們已經特徵化了某個辦公室的環境同時部署了測距系統，如果我們需要把該係統部署在其他的某個擁有不同尺寸和佈局的辦公室，這個新的辦公室的環境需要被重新特徵化。並且動態的環境變化也通常不是理想化的，即如果環境的佈局發生了變化，那麼特徵化也需要重新進行。 為了解決上述問題，我們設計了一種可識別和抑制NLOS誤差的方法，使得超寬帶測距系統可以適應動態變化的環境。特別的是，我們將設計和評估新的分類以及迴歸模型，而這些模型可以使用來自某一個環境的特徵數據進行訓練，同時該環境的特徵數據可以在其他環境中使用，並且幾乎不需要額外的測量以及再訓練。開發與環境無關的非視距測距模型在現有相關文獻中是一個很大程度上未被探索的話題。我們的項目也因此具有較強的科學價值，並且專門為非特徵環境中的NLOS識別和抑制而設計的機器學習模型形成啟發工作，同時也具有改進當前工業超寬帶測距系統的潛力。

11217524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11217524.value: 小腦靶向低強度經顱脈衝超聲刺激神經調控作用的研究 小腦靶向低強度經顱脈衝超聲刺激神經調控作用的研究

11217524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11217524.value: The cerebellum, despite its small volume, houses approximately 80% of the neurons in the central nervous system. Traditionally, it has been regarded as a region related to motor function, but recent studies suggest its functionality extends well beyond that. The cerebellum maintains extensive connections with numerous brain regions, either directly or indirectly. For instance, it has been shown that electrical and optogenetic stimulation can modulate hippocampal neural activities and alter object-location processing mediated by the hippocampus. Furthermore, electrical stimulation at cerebellum can potentially suppress seizures of temporal lobe epilepsy primarily originating from the hippocampus. This suggests that the cerebellum is an attractive target for neuromodulation, both for neuroscience study and clinical application. However, the invasive nature of electrical stimulation and the need for genetic modification in optogenetic stimulation make them less desirable for translational application. In contrast, low-intensity transcranial focused ultrasound stimulation (tFUS) has recently emerged as a promising neuromodulation technique due to its non-invasive nature, ability to penetrate deeply, and high spatial resolution. Does cerebellum-targeted tFUS also generate a diverse range of neural responses, akin to other neuromodulation methods? Can it also result in beneficial clinical applications, such as seizure suppression in epilepsy? To our knowledge, these questions have not yet been systematically addressed. New findings in these areas could shed light on how tFUS impacts our neural system and could also enhance the immediate translational value of tFUS. In our proposed study, we aim to delve into how tFUS targeting the cerebellum can modulate neural activities in the hippocampus and other broad brain regions, using a wide array of stimulus parameters. Our preliminary results suggest the potential to alter the strength or even direction of the neural spike response in non-target sites. We plan to further characterize the effect of different stimulus parameters and identify parameter sets that can provide more predictable excitatory or inhibitory responses in the non-target areas. We will then apply these findings to a rat model of epilepsy to test the effectiveness of cerebellum-targeted tFUS on seizure suppression. We believe our proposed study could unveil the cerebellum's potential as a new target for non-invasive neuromodulation intervention. 小腦儘管體積小，但容納了中樞神經系統中大約 80% 的神經元。傳統上，它被認為是一個與運動功能相關的區域，但最近的研究表明，它的功能遠遠超出了這個範圍。小腦與許多大腦區域保持著廣泛的聯繫，無論是直接還是間接的。例如，研究表明，電刺激和光遺傳學刺激可以調節海馬體神經活動並改變由海馬體介導的物體位置處理。此外，小腦電刺激可以潛在地抑制主要起源於海馬體的顳葉癲癇的發作。這表明小腦是神經調控的一個有吸引力的靶點，無論是神經科學研究還是臨床應用。 然而，電刺激的侵入性以及光遺傳學刺激中對基因改造的需求使其不太適合轉化應用。相比之下，低強度經顱聚焦超聲刺激（tFUS）因其非侵入性、深度穿透能力和高空間解析度而最近成為一種很有前途的神經調控技術。小腦靶向的tFUS是否也會產生多種神經反應，類似於其他神經調控方法？它是否也會導致有益的臨床應用，例如抑制癲癇的癲癇發作？據我們所知，這些問題尚未得到系統解決。這些領域的新發現可以揭示tFUS如何影響我們的神經系統，也可以提高tFUS的即時轉化價值。 在我們提出的研究中，我們旨在深入研究靶向小腦的tFUS如何使用廣泛的刺激參數來調節海馬體和其他廣泛大腦區域的神經活動。我們的初步結果表明，有可能改變非目標位點神經尖峰反應的強度甚至方向。我們計劃進一步表徵不同刺激參數的影響，並確定可以在非目標區域提供更可預測的興奮性或抑制反應的參數集。然後，我們將這些發現應用於癲癇大鼠模型，以測試小腦靶向 tFUS 對癲癇發作抑制的有效性。我們相信，我們提出的研究可以揭示小腦作為非侵入性神經調控干預新靶點的潛力。

11217824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11217824.value: 鐵路交通營運抵禦惡意攻擊的動態策略

11217824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11217824.value: Rail transit plays an important role in sustainable urban development. In Hong Kong, more than 10 million passenger trips are taken daily on the public transport system, and over 4 million, or 40%, of these trips are served by the local rail transit network operated by the MTR Corporation. In recent years, rail transit systems have been vulnerable under different disruptions. In particular, with the advances in information and communication technologies, malicious physical and cyberattacks now pose a real threat to our transport systems. We have seen various physical interruptions and attacks during the social unrest in 2019 that caused serve disruptions to MTR network in Hong Kong. These incidents could disrupt our transport systems and hence the smooth functioning of society. Following the Smart City Blueprint issued in 2020, several initiatives have been launched to improve the effectiveness and robustness of transit systems by using emerging technologies. Real time transit demand and operational data have now become increasingly available through automatic fare collection and vehicle positioning systems. Nevertheless, an effective computational framework is still lacking that can unlock the full potential of using these new data sources and technologies for improving the robustness of rail transit systems against malicious disruptions. This project will aim to develop a dynamic optimisation framework for modelling and optimising the operational decisions for rail transit systems with disruptions induced by malicious attacks. We first consider there is a system attacker aiming to impose disruptions that increase passengers’ travel times and operator’s costs. We then consider the system operator would seek the best corresponding actions to counteract the disruptions imposed by the attacker. The interaction and decisions of the attacker and system operator will be modelled through a dynamic attacker-defender game theoretic framework. Considering the computational complexity involved in the optimisation problem, the game theoretic framework is to be calculated and solved by using a reinforcement learning solution technique. The proposed reinforcement learning method reduces the computational complexity by making appropriate approximations during the calculation process of the original problem. The proposed models and algorithms will be implemented and tested using real-world scenarios generated from the Hong Kong MTR rail transit network. The effectiveness, robustness, and vulnerability of the underlying rail transit system under disruptions of different scales will be studied. This project will contribute to the development of advanced analytics and computational techniques for rail transit operations. Rail transit plays an important role in sustainable urban development. 11218624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11218624.value: 薄膜铌酸锂电光调制器

11218624.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11218624.value: Prof Zhu, Ning-Hua Prof Zhu, Sha

11218624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11218624.value: 高时间稳定性、低相位噪声的微波信号在现代科学研究和应用中极其重要，分频器是实现低噪声微波信号的关键技术。在通讯系统的各种应用中，分频器扮演着非常重要的角色，早期的分频器主要由不同的电子元器件构成。随着技术的发展，电子分频器可以实现高速和宽动态范围的分频，但仍具有高功耗、相位噪声性能差等问题。为解决这些问题，人们引入了光子技术。然而传统的光学分频器只能划分特定的频率，无法满足精密测量的要求，且装置复杂、体积庞大。在基于光频梳的各种光学分频器中，电光分频器应运而生，其操作方式简单, 易于集成。 该项目针对现存的光学分频技术在集成度、可调性、宽带宽和低噪声等方面的科学挑战提出了全面的解决方案。该工作旨在利用薄膜铌酸锂平台的优势去开发一种低相位噪声宽带可调电光分频器。在本项目中，通过利用级联分布式布拉格反射激光器和薄膜铌酸锂电光调制器来产生光学频率梳。 本项目将创新电光分频器的结构框架，改进薄膜铌酸锂波导器件的制备工艺，探索提高薄膜铌酸锂电光调制器调制效率和能量转换效率的先进技术，并提高其集成稳定性以最终大幅提高电光频率梳的性能。实验方法采用分布式布拉格反射激光器实现波长可调和稳定的功率输出，薄膜铌酸锂调制器以级联方式来产生光频率梳，两个必不可少的组件可以高度集成为一个微型芯片。 提出的芯片级电光分频器具有体积小、集成度高、功耗低、功能强大等优点，利用光学分频技术进行信息复用，可以大大提高信息传输速度和通信效率，满足现代和未来通信系统的需求。本项目提出的电光分频器具有巨大的发展前景，并为现代信息传输系统中遇到的挑战提供了创新的解决方案。

11219324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11219324.value: 利用2D視覺模態強化3D點雲的深度建模

11219324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11219324.value: 三維點雲數據在自動駕駛和虛擬/擴增現實等各種應用中被使用。在基於深度學習的三維點雲處理方法已經引起了學術界和工業界的廣泛關注。然而，三維點雲數據的不規則結構和缺乏對應關係在設計有效和高效的深度建模架構方面帶來了巨大技術困難。此外，獲取和標註點雲是費時費力且昂貴的，導致大規模和高質量數據集的匱乏。這種匱乏進一步阻礙了用於點雲處理的強大深度學習框架的發展。 相比之下，由於它們具有規則網格結構，對於二維視覺數據（如圖像和視頻）的深度學習模型取得了顯著進展，這些數據在傳達現實世界三維信息時是三維幾何結構的不可或缺補充。此外，大規模2D數據集的可用性促進了訓練強大的視覺模型。鑒於這些觀察，我們預見利用2D視覺模態來增強對3D點雲的深度建模代表了一個極具潛力影響的研究方向。 本項目旨在通過利用三維動態/靜態點雲數據的二維表示模態來研究創新框架，以加強對其進行深度建模。在學習機制層面，我們將專注於三維幾何和二維視覺領域之間的跨模態交互。具體而言，我們將構建強大的三維自監督學習框架，通過點到圖像的轉換來預先訓練深度點雲特徵編碼器。這種學習機制增強了骨幹編碼器學習更具有區分性和可轉移性的特徵的能力，從而促進下游靜態點雲處理和分析。從上游特徵嵌入到下游點雲理解，我們進一步試圖利用現成的二維大型視覺基礎模型，通過設計有效的二維到三維知識傳播和轉移學習策略，來提高各種三維點雲分析和識別任務。 從靜態點雲轉向動態點雲序列，這帶來了額外的挑戰，因為在空間和時間領域中都存在不規則性，我們採用數據結構化的方法，提出了一種稱為“點幾何視頻”（PGV）的新表示，考慮了在三維點雲序列和二維視頻之間適應跨模態學習的困難。通過一個自監督網絡，該網絡以基於新型距離場的距離度量為驅動，PGV將序列的時空點的坐標編碼為二維彩色視頻的像素值，具有空間平滑性和時間一致性，從而可以直接應用現有成熟的二維視頻處理技術，無縫實現動態點雲序列處理。 在我們堅實的基礎和初步結果基礎上，我們預期我們提出的研究將通過利用二維-三維跨領域學習範式的廣闊潛力，為二維視覺輔助三維幾何信號建模提供創新和實用的解決方案。我們的開創性發現將對基於學習的三維點雲處理產生基本貢獻，從而促進下游應用的發展。

11219524.value: 面向加密數據庫查詢在動態更新場景下的隱私風險量化、評估、與防範策略的研究

11219524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11219524.value: Encrypted databases promise to safeguard against increasing threats of data breaches and privacy infringements. Despite the progress, recent research highlights a notable concern: the seemingly harmless leakage patterns, officially allowed within the encrypted search algorithms, can be exploited to uncover queries and compromise the system's privacy assurances. Although various countermeasures have been proposed, almost all prior studies are centered around static databases, leaving the understanding of leakages in more challenging dynamic settings, where operations like addition and deletion are allowed, largely underexplored. Our preliminary results show there are inherent structural limitations in dynamic encrypted search constructions, making encrypted databases in dynamic operations also susceptible to leakage-abuse vulnerabilities previously found only in static scenarios. These insights introduce entirely new perspectives for rethinking the security of encrypted databases, particularly in dynamic settings. In this project, we will revisit the leakages in dynamic encrypted databases, with new theories, algorithms, and schemes on leakage exploitation, privacy risk quantification, and the corresponding mitigation strategies. Our plan includes three tasks: 1) Investigating why leakages in current dynamic encrypted search schemes are fundamentally exploitable. We will review cutting-edge dynamic constructions and assess the severity of leakages therein under various threat models. Given our insight on the inherent structural limitations, we expect to bridge the security gap between dynamic encrypted search and static constructions and further reconstruct the relationships between keywords and queries. Following this roadmap, we hope to lay a solid groundwork to understand the privacy risks of dynamic encrypted database and establish effective countermeasures. 2) Quantifying the privacy risks of leakage exploitation. Our initial findings highlight the inadequacy of conventional security notions: only capturing revealed leakages in dynamic encrypted databases is insufficient, as it does not convey any privacy exposure risks. Accordingly, we will develop a quantifiable privacy estimator using information theory to not just capture leakages from dynamic encrypted databases but further assess their potential privacy risks. We will then utilize this estimator to build a revamped security notion for dynamic encrypted databases. 3) Establishing provably secure mitigation strategies. With findings from previous two tasks, we will focus on developing tailored countermeasures and security enhancements for dynamic encrypted databases. These include both proactive leakage obfuscation strategies measured by the privacy estimator, and more reactive strategies with on-demand database reconstructions under the continuous privacy risk monitoring. We believe our research will ultimately contribute to more robust and resilient encrypted database systems that support data dynamics. 加密數據庫承諾保護數據免受日益增加的洩露和隱私侵犯的威脅。儘管取得了一定進展，近期的研究突顯了一個顯著問題：在加密搜尋演算法中正式允許的看似無害的洩漏模式可以被利用來揭示查詢內容，從而破壞系統的隱私保證。儘管已經提出了各種對策，但幾乎所有先前的研究都集中在靜態數據庫場景，對於更具挑戰性的動態環境（如新增和刪除操作）的洩漏模式的理解仍然有限。我們的初步結果表明，動態加密搜尋結構中存在固有的結構性限制，使得動態操作中的加密數據庫也容易受到以前僅在靜態場景中發現的洩漏濫用漏洞的影響。這些見解為重新思考加密數據庫的安全性，特別是在動態環境中，引入了全新的視角。 在本項目中，我們將重新審視動態加密數據庫中的洩漏，提出關於洩漏利用、隱私風險量化及相應緩解策略的新理論、演算法和方案。我們的計劃包括三個任務：1）調研當前動態加密搜尋方案中的洩漏為何從根本上是可被利用的。我們將審查最前沿的動態結構，並在各種威脅模型下評估其中洩漏的嚴重性。鑑於我們對固有結構性限制的洞察，我們期望彌合動態加密搜尋和靜態結構之間的安全差距，並進一步重構關鍵詞和查詢之間的關係。按照這一路線圖，我們希望為理解動態加密數據庫的隱私風險並建立有效的對策奠定堅實的基礎。2）量化洩漏利用的隱私風險。我們的初步發現突顯了傳統安全定義的不足：僅捕捉動態加密資料庫中的洩漏是不夠的，因為它並不傳達任何隱私暴露風險。因此，我們將基於信息論角度出發，提出一個可量化的隱私估算器，不僅捕捉動態加密數據庫中的洩漏，還進一步評估其潛在的隱私風險。然後，我們將利用這個估算器為動態加密數據庫建立一個改進的安全定義。3）建立可證明安全的緩解策略。基於前兩個任務的發現，我們將專注於為動態加密數據庫開發定制的對策和安全增強措施。這些措施包括由隱私估算器衡量的主動洩漏混淆策略，以及在持續隱私風險監控下按需進行的資料庫重建的主動防禦策略。我們的研究將有助於打造支持數據動態更新的更安全的加密數據庫系統。

11219624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11219624.value: 實時地圖建構與利用：自動駕駛的端到端框架

11219624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11219624.value: In recent years, the convergence of advanced sensor technologies and machine learning algorithms has propelled autonomous driving (AD) closer to large-scale deployment, heralding a safer, more efficient, and accessible era of urban mobility. The architecture of AD, pivoting around critical modules such as perception, prediction, and planning, can have its efficacy significantly augmented with accurate map information. However, this brings forth two main challenges: 1) ensuring the availability of real-time accurate maps for AD modules, and 2) optimizing the utilization of map information across these modules. Concerning availability, map information can be sourced from offline maps provided by map providers or generated online by the perception task. While offline High-Definition (HD) maps offer detailed geometric and semantic insights, their generation and maintenance are expensive and labor-intensive. Conversely, online maps provide real-time solutions but may lack accuracy due to occlusions and perception limitations. The dynamic urban environments further challenge the sole reliance on either map type for achieving the desired accuracy in AD tasks. Regarding optimal map information usage, existing AD approaches often treat maps as auxiliary inputs across various modules, lacking a unified map-centric representation for different AD tasks. This fragmented approach leads to separated optimization of map information utilization for each AD task, potentially compromising the system-level driving performance. To address the two major challenges, we propose a map-centric framework, embodying an end-to-end approach from encoding offline map data to motion planning. Specifically, we tackle the first challenge by developing advanced machine learning algorithms for a sequence of tasks: 1) encoding the offline map into a graph representation, 2) merging this graph with real-time sensing inputs to generate a real-time scene graph, and 3) further utilizing both graphs to construct an accurate and real-time online map graph. For the second challenge, we propose to develop a unified map-centric graph representation for different AD tasks, ensuring consistent and coherent map information utilization across the perception, prediction, and planning modules. This unification fosters a holistic optimization of system-level driving performance, aiming to significantly enhance each module's accuracy, efficiency, and safety towards achieving safe, efficient, and rule-compliant autonomous vehicles (AVs). In conclusion, our proposal presents a robust framework to address fundamental challenges in AD technology. By fostering seamless interaction and real-time updates among the mapping, perception, prediction, and planning modules, we plan to enhance AVs' accuracy, efficiency, and safety, accelerating the transition towards smart urban mobility and contributing to smart city initiatives. 近年來，先進傳感器技術與機器學習算法的融合，使得自動駕駛（AD）向大規模部署邁進，預示著一個更加安全、高效和可達的城市出行新時代。自動駕駛的架構圍繞感知、預測和規劃等關鍵模塊展開，精準的地圖信息可以顯著提升其效率。然而，這也帶來了兩個主要挑戰：1）確保自動駕駛模塊實時準確地圖的可用性；2）優化各模塊之間地圖信息的利用。 關於可用性，地圖信息可以來自地圖提供商提供的離線地圖，或通過感知任務在線生成。雖然離線高清（HD）地圖提供了詳細的幾何和語義信息，但其生成和維護成本高且勞動密集。相對而言，在線地圖提供了實時解決方案，但由於遮擋和感知限制，可能缺乏準確性。動態的城市環境進一步挑戰了僅依賴某一類型地圖以實現自動駕駛任務所需的準確性。 在優化地圖信息使用方面，現有的自動駕駛方法通常將地圖視為各個模塊的輔助輸入，缺乏針對不同自動駕駛任務的統一地圖中心表示。這種碎片化的方法導致每個自動駕駛任務的地圖信息利用的獨立優化，可能會影響系統級的駕駛性能。 為了解決這兩個主要挑戰，我們提出了一個以地圖為中心的框架，體現了從編碼離線地圖數據到運動規劃的端到端方法。具體而言，我們通過開發先進的機器學習算法來應對第一個挑戰，處理一系列任務：1）將離線地圖編碼為圖形表示；2）將該圖與實時傳感輸入合併，生成實時場景圖；3）進一步利用這兩個圖構建一個準確的實時在線地圖圖。針對第二個挑戰，我們提議為不同的自動駕駛任務開發統一的地圖中心圖形表示，確保在感知、預測和規劃模塊之間一致且連貫的地圖信息利用。這種統一促進了系統級駕駛性能的整體優化，旨在顯著提高每個模塊的準確性、效率和安全性，從而實現安全、高效、遵守規則的自動駕駛車輛（AV）。 總的說來，我們提出了一個強大的框架，以解決自動駕駛技術中的基本挑戰。通過促進地圖、感知、預測和規劃模塊之間的無縫互動和實時更新，我們計畫提升自動駕駛車輛的準確性、效率和安全性，加速向智能城市出行的轉型，並為智慧城市做出貢獻。

11220024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11220024.value: 單細胞編碼的高通量小幹擾RNA基因敲除技術的研究和應用

11220024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11220024.value: Since the discovery of RNAi and the demonstration of siRNA in post-transcriptional gene silencing, there has been tremendous interests and efforts in harnessing siRNAs for biomedical research and drug development. Thus far, the success has been limited. One of the major issues is that effective gene silencing by siRNA is often hindered by the presence of complementary signal transduction pathways, which may counteract the action of a single siRNA and substantially offset the therapeutic silencing effects. Alternatively, the use of cocktail siRNAs has been suggested as a feasible and promising drug discovery route. However, the identification of the most safe and efficient siRNA combination remains challenging and a crucial bottleneck. This proposal aims to address the unmet needs by developing a high-throughput technology for screening siRNA-based cocktail therapeutics. Technically, as one of the key innovations, we propose a multilayer functionalization of hierarchical assembled nano-/micro composite carriers (Knock-beads) with responsiveness to near infrared light and magnetic field, to facilitate photoporation-induced cellular transfection of RNAs with single cell encoding capability. So that randomized gene silencing by different siRNA variants in a large number of individual cells could be performed, recorded, and analyzed in a highly parallel manner. Depends on the operation scale, using this system, hundreds or even thousands of siRNA cocktail formulations could be assayed in just a single well of cell culture, which would be tremendously useful for accelerating the testing of siRNA combinations. Such benefits are not just limited to reducing the time and cost associated with siRNA screening by power of magnitude, but also rely on the capability to answer fundamental siRNA questions that are not addressable by existing methods. In addition to the technical advancement, as a proof-of-concept, we will further perform a small of screen of six cell apoptosis or proliferation related siRNAs to test all the possible 64 combinations in seeking for the most effective cocktail for potential inhibition of cancer cell growth. We believe that the success of this project will lead to a systematic and high-throughput platform technology that is greatly useful to accelerate further development of siRNA-based therapeutics and enhance their clinical adoption. 自從發現 RNAi 並證明小幹擾RNA（siRNA） 在轉錄後基因敲除中的作用以來，人們對基於siRNA的生物醫學研究和藥物開發產生了巨大的興趣並進行了不懈的努力。到目前為止，siRNA 的臨床使用仍然十分有限。主要問題之一是利用siRNA的基因敲除常常受到互補生物信號傳導途徑的阻礙，這可能會抵消單一 siRNA 的基因敲除作用並大大降低相關的治療效果。使用混合的siRNA組合藥物已被認為是一種可行且有前途的藥物研發途徑。然而，如何發現最安全、最有效的 siRNA 組合仍然具有挑戰性，也是一個關鍵瓶頸。該項目旨在透過開發用於篩選siRNA雞尾酒藥物的高通量技術來解決這一問題。我們將研發單細胞編碼的高通量小幹擾RNA基因敲除的關鍵技術，並用於大規模的高效篩選小幹擾RNA組合藥物。

11220224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11220224.value: 基於模型人在回路語義導向的多任務深度偽臉檢測

11220224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11220224.value: 深度生成模型的出現极大地簡化并自動化了逼真偽臉圖像和視頻的生成過程。這些模型對數字視覺信息的可信性和真實性構成了重大威脅。為應對這一挑戰，研究人員設計了大量DeepFake檢測工具，旨在自動識別偽臉圖像和視頻。然而，這些檢測工具仍面臨一些基本問題。首先，目前的DeepFake檢測器只針對特定的人臉生成編輯算法，泛化能力有限。其次，在處理DeepFake視頻時，它們主要採用基於圖像的方法，缺乏有效的時空分析，且計算效率低。最後，現有的DeepFake檢測器是在靜態環境中設計的，這使得它们很难应对具有挑戰性的真實世界示例。 在本項目中，我們首先基於不同面部屬性建立了一系列DeepFake檢測任務，進而確立了基於語義導向的多任務DeepFake檢測學習範式。在該範式下，任務之間的參數共享可通過聯合嵌入自動化完成；其主任務（即判斷圖像是真實還是偽造）可以使用雙層優化來優先考慮。接下來，我們通過使用可學習的時空查詢線性化視覺Transformer，將DeepFake圖像檢測器擴展到DeepFake視頻。同時，我們提出了一種高效的剪輯採樣器，從長視頻中識別出具有區分性的片段，從而提高DeepFake視頻檢測效率。最後，我們打算通過最大化差異原則來挖掘所提出的DeepFake檢測器的真實世界反例。這些示例將由人類參與者進行註釋，並用於微調，從而實現模型和人類迴圈的動態訓練。

11220324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11220324.value: 推荐算法的可解释物品价值评估：框架、加速和可解释性

11220324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11220324.value: 个性化推荐系统因其能够减轻信息和选择过载、满足个人用户偏好以及提高服务和产品提供商的收入而在现代社会获得了广泛关注。尽管有帮助且有价值，但训练工业级的推荐系统仍然困难，这需要大量高质量的数据和繁琐的训练过程。 尽管最近的研究已经成功地在推荐模型中识别出高质量且有价值的用户-物品交互，但仍然存在一些挑战：1）缺乏与模型无关的评估框架来衡量用户-物品交互的重要性； 2）缺乏有效的方法来加速评估进程； 3）缺乏解释生成的数据假值的通用方案。 为了解决上述挑战，我们将对推荐算法的物品价值评估进行系统研究。总体来讲，我们的项目包括三个主要任务。 1）我们计划为推荐算法设计一个通用的物品价值评估框架。我们将构建一个双层优化框架，为用户访问的每个物品分配连续/离散值。由于展开反向传播的复杂性，我们将借助隐函数定理来简化计算。 2）我们计划通过有效技术加速价值评估。双层优化通常涉及巨大的Hessian矩阵的计算，这在真实计算中是繁琐且不现实的。为了加快这一过程，我们将为离散物品价值设计基于策略梯度的方法，为连续数据值设计均衡传播算法。 3）我们计划将可解释性纳入生成的数据价值中。我们将使用Shapley值构建一个与模型无关的方案来解释生成的数据值。此外，我们将研究训练代理模型以促进Shapley值的计算。 在业界合作者的支持下，我们的成果将为推荐系统中的数据评估分析奠定实践基础，提供有效的项目评估技术，提高推荐系统的训练效率，并推动该研究领域的科学前沿。

11220524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11220524.value: 緊湊型脈衝空心錐像差校正掃描透射電子顯微鏡系統的設計製造

11220524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11220524.value: Radiation sensitivity and low contrast are the main bottlenecks for high-resolution biological imaging in electron microscopy. Recently, pulsed electron source has been recognized as one of the most viable techniques for reducing radiation damage, while hollow-cone dark-field imaging has been proved to enhance contrast as much as four times that that of bright field. However, pulse electron gun and hollow cone electron beam have only been implemented individually into separate floor models of an electron microscope. The integration of a pulse source with hollow-cone illumination into an electron microscope is expected to minimize radiation damage and enhance contrast simultaneously so that it may offer a new route for protein 3D imaging as compared with the cryo-EM approach. The main goal of this proposed project is to design/manufacture a compact scanning transmission electron microscope for 3D protein reconstruction at room temperature. This compact electron microscope is equipped with four key components. 1) pulse electron gun to modulate the radiation damage 2) hollow cone illumination system to maximize contrast. 3) low Cs (~1mm) objective pole piece for 15keV-30keV to improve the resolution. 4) Cs/ Cc aberration corrector to improve spatial resolution. In our laboratory, a compact electron microscope has been built and officially announced in a press release on 21 April 2023. A pulse electron gun and Cs corrector have also been built and demonstrated under a mega project supported by Shenzhen government. In this proposed project, we develop 2) a hollow cone generator and 3) improve objective lens as well as 4) Cs/ Cc corrector. Ultimately, the designed electron microscope is expected to be operated at transmission mode to observe the three-dimensional structure of proteins and molecules, as well as at scanning mode to observe nanomaterials and for semiconductor and chip detection. There is no similar system found in the commercial market. In addition to providing an advanced update for the electron optics research community, our research results will be pushed for commercial market via a high-technology company in the future, which may create more employment opportunities for society in Hong Kong 輻照敏感和低對比度是電子顯微鏡在高分辨率生物成像的主要瓶頸。最近，脈衝電子源被認為是減少輻照損傷的最可行技術之一，而空心錐暗場成像已被證明可以將對比度提高到明場的四倍。然而，脈衝電子槍和空心錐電子束僅在不同的電子顯微鏡模組中分別實現。將脈衝電子光源與空心錐照明集成到電子顯微鏡中，預期可以同時最小化輻照損傷並增強對比度，從而為蛋白質三維成像提供一條不依靠冷凍電子顯微鏡的新方法。 本提案項目的主要目標是設計/製造一台用於室溫下蛋白質三維重建的緊湊型掃描透射電子顯微鏡。這台緊湊型電子顯微鏡配備了四個關鍵組件： 1. 脈衝電子槍以調節輻照損傷 2. 空心錐照明系統以提高對比度 3. 低Cs（約1毫米）物鏡，用於15-30 keV以提高分辨率 4. Cs/Cc 像差校正器以提高空間分辨率 在我們的實驗室中，一台緊湊型電子顯微鏡已經建成，並於2023年4月21日正式在新聞發布會上公開。脈衝電子槍和Cs校正器也已在深圳政府支持的一個大型項目中建成並展示。在本提案項目中，我們將開發2) 空心錐生成器和3) 改進物鏡以及4) Cs/Cc校正器。最終，設計的電子顯微鏡預期將在透射模式下運行，以觀察蛋白質和分子的三維結構，以及在掃描模式下觀察納米材料並用於半導體和芯片檢測。 目前在商業市場上沒有類似的系統。除了為電子光學科研領域提供技術更新外，我們的研究成果將通過一家高科技公司推向商業市場，這可能為香港社會創造更多的就業機會。
