12203124.value: 用於醫療資料處理的量子機器學習

12203124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12203124.value: The advent of quantum computing holds great potential for enhancing the computational efficiency of machine learning algorithms through quantum machine learning theories and algorithms. Although the deployment of quantum computers is still in an early development stage, we can get access to many cloud-based services that provide accessible quantum computing environments to run quantum machine learning applications, such as IBM Quantum Experience, Google Quantum AI platform, and Microsoft Quantum Development Kit. Besides, we can conduct a classical simulation of quantum machine learning using quantum programming toolkits like Pennylane and Torch Quantum on classical CPU/GPU platforms. Quantum machine learning (QML) refers to an emerging interdisciplinary field that integrates the principles of quantum mechanics and machine learning. With rapid advances in quantum computing, we have witnessed the noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) era that admits as many as a few hundred qubits available for implementing many QML algorithms on real quantum computers to enhance the efficiency and speed of machine learning applications. Despite the limitations of the NISQ era, which is characterized by a small number of qubits and high levels of quantum noise, we exploring the potential of quantum computing for machine learning. This proposal focuses on the use of quantum machine learning for healthcare data processing, which supports a diverse study field including several applications, i.e., medical specifications and related diseases. Some of these diseases are well-known and mastered by physicians, while others are not. Healthcare practitioner's technical and scientific advancements with healthcare data have become increasingly diverse, including a wide variety of clinical analyses and metrics, biological parameters, and medical imaging modalities. Healthcare data are generally asymmetrical, non-stationary, and classified by a high degree of sophistication due to the volume of data and the completeness of some unusual conditions. Thus, the deployment of quantum machine learning can benefit many physicians and patients in healthcare domains, such as medical imaging, clinical diagnostics, e-healthcare Records, and associated diseases. To emphasize the potential advantages of quantum machine learning for healthcare data processing, in this proposal, we concentrate on three typical healthcare applications: (1) Leveraging quantum generative neural networks and quantum variational eigensolver for the application of drug discovery; (2) Building up a quantum kernel learning (QKL) and quantum-classical hybrid neural networks to better represent multi-model features of biomedical data like Schizophrenia and Schizo-affective Disorder; (3) Setting up a quantum federated learning architecture for concerning privacy-preserving of healthcare data. 量子計算的出現為透過量子機器學習理論和演算法提高機器學習演算法的計算效率提供了巨大的潛力。儘管量子電腦的部署仍處於早期開發階段，但我們可以存取許多基於雲端的服務，這些服務提供可存取的量子運算環境來運行量子機器學習應用程序，例如 IBM Quantum Experience、Google Quantum Al 平台和 Microsoft量子開發套件。此外，我們也可以在經典CPU/GPU平台上使用Pennylane和Torch Quantum等量子程式設計工具包對量子機器學習進行經典模擬。量子機器學習（QML）是指整合了量子力學和機器學習原理的新興跨學科領域。隨著量子運算的快速發展，我們見證了嘈雜的中尺度量子（NISQ）時代，該時代允許多達數百個量子位元用於在真正的量子電腦上實現許多QML 演算法，以提高機器學習應用的效率和速度。儘管 NISQ 時代存在量子位元數量少和量子雜訊水平高的局限性，但我們仍在探索量子運算在機器學習方面的潛力。該提案重點關注使用量子機器學習進行醫療保健數據處理，以支持多種研究領域，包括多種應用，即醫療規範和相關疾病。其中一些疾病是醫生所熟知和掌握的，而有些則不然。醫療保健從業者在醫療保健數據方面的技術和科學進步變得越來越多樣化，包括各種臨床分析和指標、生物參數和醫學影像模式。醫療保健資料通常是不對稱的、非平穩的, 由於資料量大和一些異常情況的完整性，分類的複雜程度很高。因此，量子機器學習的部署可以使醫療保健領域的許多醫生和患者受益，例如醫學影像、臨床診斷、電子醫療記錄和相關疾病。為了強調量子機器學習在醫療保健資料處理方面的潛在優勢，在本提案中，我們將重點放在三種典型的醫療保健應用:（1）利用量子生成神經網路和量子變分本徵求解器進行藥物發現應用;（2）建立量子核學習（QKL）和量子經典混合神經網絡，以更好地表示精神分裂症和精神分裂情感性疾患等生物醫學資料的多模型特徵；（3）建立涉及醫療保健隱私保護的量子聯邦學習架構。

12300424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12300424.value: 使用載流子傳輸測量方法提取有機半導體的奈米級形態參數

12300424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12300424.value: Abstract: Charge carrier transport measurements are commonly used to study electronic materials. For organic electronic devices including LEDs, photovoltaic cells and photodetectors, such measurements are used to probe charge carrier mobilities in the organic semiconductors involved. The extracted mobilities bear important relevance to device performance. In OLEDs, knowledge of mobility allows the estimation of the light-emitting recombination zone, and in OPV cells to determine whether both electron and hole mobilities are balanced or not. Charge transport data, however, carry rich information about the material under investigation beyond mobility values. As carriers migrate inside a material, they sample not only the energetic landscape but also the nanoscale environment and connectivity of conducting domains. Thus, the mobility must be influenced also by the nano-scale chemical structure and morphology. Here, we propose that by conducting a table-top temperature dependent transport measurements on organic semiconductors and analyzing the data with desired transport model, one will be able to acquire not only the standard mobility data, but also two additional metrics which are related to (i) the packing distance information between adjacent molecules, and (ii) the positional / geometric randomness of the molecules or polymers in the organic semiconducting films. The theoretical machinery that enables us to do such delineation originates from the well-known Gaussian Disorder Model (GDM). Several model systems involving small molecules will be tested to demonstrate the data extraction process. The results will be cross-validated against structural characterization using X-Ray techniques for (i), and highly sensitive EQE characterization technique for (ii). Additional validation will be provided by X-ray techniques and computationally by molecular dynamic simulations via our collaborators. Applications of transport measurements to some semiconducting polymers and high-performance non-fullerene acceptors will be discussed. The outcome of this proposal will provide a table-top alternative to characterize organic semiconductors and simply material characterization process. 載子傳輸測量通常用於電子材料的研究。對於包括 LED、光伏電池和光電探測器在內的有機電子元件，此類測量可直接獲取所涉及的有機半導體中的載流子遷移率。提取的遷移率與裝置效能有重要相關性。在 OLED 中，遷移率知識可以估計發光複合區，而在 OPV 電池中，遷移率知識可以確定電子和空穴遷移率是否平衡。然而，電荷傳輸資料除了遷移率值之外,還包含有關所研究材料的豐富資訊。當載子在材料內部遷移時，它們不僅感受到週維的能量變化，還受到遷移時的奈米級環境和連接性的影響。因此，奈米級化學結構和連接會干擾遷移率的值。在這裡，我們建議透過對有機半導體進行溫度依賴性傳輸測量，並利用傳輸模型分析數據，除了獲取標準遷移率數據之外，還可以提取兩個附加指標： i)相鄰分子之間的距離訊息，以及(ii) 有機半導體薄膜中分子或聚合物的位置/幾何隨機性。使我們能夠進行這種劃分的理論機制源自於著名的高斯無序模型（GDM),我們將測試幾個小分子的模型系統以演示資料提取過程的可行性。又會利用 (i) X 射線技術和 (ii) 高靈敏度 EQE 表徵技術進行交叉驗證。此外,我們的合作者將透過 X 射線技術和分子動力學模擬進行計算來提供額外的驗證。以上實驗及分析設計,將會應用於一些富有代表性的半導體聚合物和高性能非富勒烯受體。此計劃的結果將為表徵有機半導體供一個簡便及實用的新方案。

12301424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12301424.value: 一些典型Banach空間上的分佈式鏡像下降的學習理論及相關課題

12301424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12301424.value: 近年來,分佈式學習在統計學習理論、計算優化、網路控制系統和數據挖掘等領域取得了顯著的成功。在實際計算中,許多經典算法(如SGD)最初是為單節點計算而設計的。然而,在現代學習理論中,由於極其龐大的訓練數據以及結構複雜的神經網絡,以單處理器為基礎的算法通常效率低下。因此,基於多智能體(-處理器)網絡的分佈式學習算法逐漸成為學習理論的主流。 分佈式鏡像下降(DMD)算法是現代分佈式計算中最先進的算法之一。其靈活性在於至其關重要的鏡像映射和相關的Bregman散度,使得它能夠捕捉幾何信息並開發利用稀疏性等數據結構。DMD型方法已在多智能體網絡上得到了快速發展。然而,現有的DMD方法仍在傳統的Euclid底空間上進行,其收斂性分析深度依賴於Euclid結構。相比之下,學習理論通常要求在某些空間，比如基於Mercer核的再生核Hilbert空間(RKHS)或全變差範數的測度空間等潛在無窮維的底空間中進行基於數據的逼近。遺憾的是,現存工作尚未建立任何形式的以這些典型的Banach空間作為底空間的DMD學習理論。此外,很少有關於在RKHS中基於DMD的監督學習的研究。因此,完全發揮DMD在學習理論中的潛力是十分值得期待的。 在這個項目中,我們首先考慮了一些典型Banach空間上的複合泛函最小化(CFM)模型。我們建立一種使用局部泛函偽梯度的分散式偽鏡射下降方法,用於解決與CFM相關的著名正值函數學習問題。我們進一步提出了一種基於核的DMD算法,可用於解決正則化的CFM問題,以及基於在測度空間上引入局部方向導數的全新DMD學習理論方法。我們還提出了一種去中心化的分佈式DMD核監督學習算法來解決監督學習問題。為了更好地處理重尾和非高斯脈沖性數據噪聲,我們提出了一種分佈式魯棒DMD監督學習算法。此外,我們將方法擴展到處理概率分佈型數據的場景中。需要注意的是,現有的去中心化核學習理論深度依賴於雙隨機通信假設。我們通過建立一種具有局部處理器間一般有向信息傳輸的新全新分佈式核學習算法,從根本上放鬆了這一假設。我們將對這些方法進行嚴格的收斂和逼近分析。

12301624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12301624.value: 功能性魯棒性為複雜網絡的結構可預測性提供新範式

12301624.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12301624.value: Prof Liu, Jiming Prof ZHOU, Tao

12301624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12301624.value: 在複雜網絡中，一個重要的研究問題是鏈接預測，這大大推動了生物系統、社會關係挖掘、移動軌跡預測和推薦系統的發展。該領域的大量研究努力集中於開發各種鏈接預測算法，但很少有工作深入探討給定網絡的鏈接預測難度。量化複雜網絡的可預測性，即鏈接預測的最高準確度，有助於我們理解網絡本身的規律性程度。以前的方法從熵的角度衡量網絡的可預測性，其中高隨機性意味著低可預測性。然而，這些方法受制於精度有限、算法方法區分不足，最重要的是，對為什麼網絡可以被預測的理解不完整等挑戰。 在這項提案中，我們旨在從網絡功能穩健性的角度量化網絡的可預測性。我們假設功能穩健性越高的網絡對結構擾動的抵抗力越強，則其可預測性越高。儘管以前關於網絡可預測性的研究通常源於信息理論或數據挖掘的角度，我們的方法將基於網絡功能，並旨在理解網絡可預測性的基本原因。 具體而言，我們將首先建立功能穩健性與結構參數空間之間的聯繫。更大的參數空間表明功能對結構擾動的敏感度較低，即面對鏈接中斷時，參數的微小變化不會導致網絡功能的顯著變化。其次，我們將深入探討為什麼網絡可以被準確預測的基本原因，探索網絡功能穩健性與預測性能之間的內在聯繫。第三，我們將量化個別鏈接的可預測性，以更細緻地衡量網絡的可預測性並可控地操作網絡的可預測性。最後，基於所提出的網絡可預測性範式，我們將提出具有更高預測性能的新鏈接預測算法。 這一系列研究將為我們提供新的理論和綜合工具，推動複雜網絡科學領域的發展。

12301824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12301824.value: 發展針對高維流形上雙曲守恆律的無網格方法

12301824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12301824.value: 高維流形上的雙曲守恆律在理解各種物理現象方面至關重要。這些數學結構幫助我們描述和預測不同系統的行為,例如交通流量、流體動力學和波傳播。提高我們在這一領域的知識和計算方法可能會導致工程、氣象學和物理學的進步,這是我們項目的核心動機。 我們通過推廣用於求解一維流形上雙曲守恆律的嵌入方法來開始我們的研究。我們面臨的一個重大挑戰是理解雙曲特性如何與流形的形狀以及保守變量的小尺度和大尺度結構相互作用,同時仍然保持理想的性質。 接下來,我們計劃基於內蒙的公式開發一個替代求解器。目標是通過在參數空間中工作來降低計算複雜性。然而,這需要使用流形的分塊。我們的首要目標是調整本質非振盪格式,以處理存儲在分塊中的數據點。我們將探索高梯度和精細解在這些分塊之間的放置如何影響我們解的準確性和數值穩定性。然後,我們將確定一個有效的數據結構,用於在局部參數空間中存儲雙曲守恆律的解。 認識到沒有真實世界的表面是完全光滑的,而且粗糙度是自然和人造環境中的一個共同特徵,我們的最終研究計劃集中在研究具有固有粗糙度的表面如何影響標量雙曲守恆律的解。 我們的目標是測試我們開發的嵌入和內在方法在捕捉這些變化方面的有效性,並深入了解雙曲解隨著粗糙度振幅增加而產生的行為。通過在粗糙流形上模擬更複雜的雙曲守恆律,例如歐拉方程、納維-斯托克斯方程和淺水波方程,我們預計我們的結果將提供一個更加紮實和可靠的理解,關於所研究的物理現象。這些模擬還將用於測試我們的模型,並提高它們模擬與現實世界預期和基本物理原理相一致的結果的能力。

12302624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12302624.value: 重尾误差下的高维灵活建模中的高效回归方法

12302624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12302624.value: Technological advances have made high-dimensional data ubiquitous in many scientific fields. Driven by applications in fields such as biology, public health, genomics, medicine, social sciences, economy and finance, statisticians have made tremendous contributions to the development of high-dimensional statistical methods and theory. Existing works for high dimensional regression are mostly based on least squares approach and they mainly focus on light-tailed data. However, in real applications, heavy-tailed distribution commonly exists in high-dimensional data, which has been confirmed by many studies. Meanwhile, many methods were developed in the context of linear model, which restricts the applicability of the method. The overall target of this research project is to develop valid and efficient regression methods that utilize flexible semiparametric regression approaches to handle heavy-tailed high dimensional data. In the first project of this proposal, we study the convoluted rank regression for high dimensional partially linear additive model. We study the rate of convergence of oracle estimators and variable selection consistency for nonconvex penalized estimators. We also propose methods for tuning parameter selection. In the second project, we focus on sparse convoluted rank regression with varying coefficient structure. Rates of convergence for oracle estimator and L1 penalized estimator are investigated, and we also study the variable selection consistency for nonconvex penalized estimator. In both projects, we impose no condition on any moments of error and establish the theory. We will develop efficient algorithms for our method, and we will conduct simulation studies and apply the proposed methods to analyze some high-dimensional datasets concerning genomics, climate study, econometrics and finance. 科技进步使得高维数据在许多科学领域中无处不在。在生物学、公共卫生、基因组学、医学、社会科学、经济和金融等领域的应用推动下，统计学家为高维统计方法和理论的发展做出了巨大贡献。现有的高维回归工作大多基于最小二乘法，主要关注轻尾数据。然而，在实际应用中，高维数据中常常存在重尾分布，这一点已被许多研究所证实。同时，许多方法是在线性模型的背景下发展起来的，这限制了方法的适用性。本研究项目的总体目标是发展有效的回归方法，利用灵活的半参数回归方法来处理重尾的高维数据。在本提案的第一个项目中，我们研究高维部分线性可加模型的卷积秩回归。我们研究神谕估计量的收敛速率和非凸惩罚估计量的变量选择一致性。我们还将提出选择调整参数的方法。在第二个项目中，我们关注具有变化系数结构的稀疏卷积秩回归。我们研究神谕估计量和L1惩罚估计量的收敛速率，并研究非凸惩罚估计量的变量选择一致性。在这两个项目中，我们不假设误差具有任何矩条件，并建立理论。我们将为我们的方法开发高效算法，并将进行模拟研究，并将提出的方法应用于分析某些关于基因组学、气候研究、计量经济学和金融的高维数据集。

12302824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12302824.value: 基于代谢组学的组学整合技术研究三氯生在小鼠结肠中的代谢扰动及毒性分子机制

12302824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12302824.value: Triclosan, as man-made antimicrobial agent, has been widely used as additives in personal care and household products for decades. There is ample evidence that triclosan was frequently detected in human bodily fluids and tissues, causing adverse effects on human health, such as increasing risks of allergies and asthma, altering immune responses, and disrupting endocrine functions. Our recently studies demonstrated that triclosan could exacerbate colitis and colitis-associated colorectal tumorigenesis in mice colon with the presence of gut microbiota. However, the molecular mechanisms and metabolic perturbations involved in the process remain unclear. In this study, we propose to utilize our experience gained from metabolomics investigations on liver toxicity associated with triclosan exposure, and to develop approaches of metabolomics-based omics integration, particularly the novel spatial metabolomics and mass spectrometry imaging for studying complex molecular events involved in triclosan induced colon toxicity. Firstly, we will investigate of triclosan induced metabolic perturbations in mice colon. The perturbed metabolites and metabolic pathways between the control and exposed group will be determined using nontargeted metabolomics and targeted metabolomics. Secondly, MALDI-TOFMS imaging method will be developed and applied for in-situ detection of the perturbed metabolites in colon tissues from mice exposed with triclosan. Thirdly, 3D intestinal cell spheroids that are physiologically and functionally close to the organs in the living body will be used to examine the joint toxic effects of triclosan and its downstream metabolites based on their appearance in mice colon tissues. Finally, the perturbed metabolic pathways in both in vitro and in vivo samples upon triclosan exposure experiments will be verified using metabolomics-based proteomics. The obtained results are expected to provide a comprehensive view of metabolic perturbations and correlation between triclosan exposure and the development of colon diseases and promote the better understanding of the colon toxicity induced by triclosan exposure. 三氯生作为人造抗菌剂几十年来一直被广泛用作个人护理和家用产品的添加剂。三氯生经常在人体体液和组织中检测到，对人类健康造成不利影响，例如增加过敏和哮喘的风险、改变免疫反应和破坏内分泌功能。我们最近的研究表明，三氯生可以加剧小鼠结肠结肠炎和结肠炎相关的结直肠肿瘤发生，并存在肠道微生物群。然而，该过程中涉及的分子机制和代谢扰动仍不清楚。在这项研究中，我们将开发基于代谢组学的组学整合方法，特别是用于研究三氯生暴露中涉及的复杂分子事件的新型空间代谢组学和质谱成像，用于研究三氯生诱导的结肠毒性。首先，我们将研究三氯生诱导的小鼠结肠代谢扰动。其次，开发MALDI-TOFMS成像方法并应用于三氯生暴露小鼠结肠组织中受干扰代谢物的原位检测。第三，3D 肠细胞球体将用于根据三氯生及其下游代谢物在小鼠结肠组织中的外观来检查三氯生及其下游代谢物的关节毒性作用。最后，将使用基于代谢组学的蛋白质组学验证三氯生暴露实验中体外和体内样品中受干扰的代谢途径。所获得的结果有望帮助全面了解三氯生暴露与结肠疾病发展之间的代谢扰动，更好理解对三氯生暴露引起的结肠毒性。

12303024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12303024.value: 深度神经网络算子學習的泛化分析

12303024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12303024.value: Deep learning methods based on neural networks have demonstrated remarkable practical success in various domains, such as computer vision and natural language processing. Concurrently, operator learning has emerged as a widely adopted framework for addressing the challenge of learning nonlinear continuous mappings between infinite-dimensional function spaces. However, theoretical investigations in this area are still in their early stages. There is a pressing need for a comprehensive learning theory that specifically focuses on deep neural networks and their ability to learn nonlinear operators. In this project, our primary objective is to conduct rigorous mathematical analyses and establish a learning theory for deep operator neural networks, with a particular emphasis on functional data analysis. We shall first propose a novel functional neural network architecture that combines a discretization map and a deep neural network to approximate nonlinear and Fréchet smooth functionals. By deriving explicit rates of approximation, we aim to enhance our understanding of the approximation capabilities of the proposed functional neural network and highlight its advantages over conventional methods. Next, we plan to develop the learning theory of functional neural networks by investigating the consistency and error bounds of the deep functional learning algorithms they generate, particularly in the presence of heavy-tailed noises. Our goal is to explore how these networks can handle challenging data scenarios and provide robust learning guarantees. Then, we shall introduce a novel operator neural network designed for learning operators between high-dimensional input spaces and infinite-dimensional output spaces. By leveraging deep convolutional neural networks and a reconstruction map, we aim to mitigate the curse of dimensionality inherent in such learning tasks. Finally, we shall establish error bounds and convergence rates for the learning process of operators between infinite-dimensional function spaces using deep operator neural networks. These networks are composed of three key components: a discretization map, a neural network, and a reconstruction map. These analyses will contribute to our understanding of the performance and limitations of these networks when applied to operator learning problems. 基於神經網絡的深度學習方法在計算機視覺和自然語言處理等取得了顯著的成功。與此同時，算子學習已經成為一個廣泛採用的框架用於學習無限維函數空間之間的非線性連續映射。然而，在這個領域的理論研究仍處於早期階段。我們迫切需要針對深度神經網絡及其學習非線性算子能力的數學理論。在這個項目中，我們的主要目標是通過嚴格的數學分析建立一個針對深度算子神經網絡的學習理論，並應用於函數型數據分析。我們將首先提出一種結合離散映射和深度神經網絡以逼近非線性和Fréchet光滑泛函的神經網絡架構。通過推導逼近速率，我們旨在加強對所提出的泛函神經網絡逼近能力的理解，並比較其相對於傳統方法的優勢。另外，我們計劃研究基於深度神經網絡的泛函學習算法的一致性和誤差界，特別是在存在重尾噪聲的情形下。我們的目標是探索這些網絡如何應對具有挑戰性的數據情況並提供學習理論保證。然後，我們將引入一種新型的算子神經網絡用於學習高維輸入空間和無限維輸出空間之間的算子。通過利用深度卷積神經網絡和重構映射，我們旨在剋服這些學習任務中固有的維度災難問題。最後，我們將針對使用深度算子神經網絡學習無限維函數空間之間的算子的學習過程建立誤差界和收斂速率。這些網絡由三個關鍵部分組成：離散映射、神經網絡和重構映射。這些分析將有助於我們理解這些神經網絡應用於算子學習問題時的性能和限制。

12303724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12303724.value: 高維度數據的非參數變量選擇和半參數模型結構辨識

12303724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12303724.value: High-dimensional data are increasingly common in biology, finance, genetics, medicine and others, thanks to the rapid advancements in the data collection, storage and preprocessing techniques. There has been a fast growing literature on semiparametric and nonparametric statistical modeling of such kind of data, and the conclusions and inference based on them play important roles in the subject areas. One example is a recent dataset concerning environmental risks and genetic factors, and their interactions on adult asthma. We focus on nonparametric variable selection and semiparametric structure identification problems when we are interested in modeling the relationship between a response variable and a large number of candidate covariates. The unknown regression function of such high dimensional data are often complex. Semiparametric regression models are parsimonious, flexible, interpretable and efficient. Feature selection and structure identification are crucial steps in semiparametric modeling. When the dimensionality is large, these become challenging problems. Existing literature specifies a particular semiparametric regression model, such as additive model, varying coefficient model and semivarying coefficient model, and assume it is sparse, and then build variable selection and structure identification procedures to come up with the final low-dimensional semiparametric regression model. However, such an approach may not be feasible in practice due to the unknown complex structure; the asthma data is an example. On the other hand, variable selection under a parametric model may not work because of mis-specification of the parametric form. And, variable selection under the fully nonparametric regression model is a notoriously difficult problem, and available methods are shown to only scale to dimensions that grow logarithmically in the sample size. In this research project, we investigate nonparametric variable selection using a functional analysis of variance model with only main effects and two-way interactions as a working model, and develop nonparametric variable selection and semiparametric structure identification procedures. For these purposes, we introduce new, efficient Gaussian process regression estimators. Theoretical justifications for the proposed methods will be derived. Monte Carlo simulation studies will be conducted to examine their finite sample performance. The proposed methods will be applied to the asthma dataset and some other datasets arising from econometric, environmental and genetic studies. In particular, the results from application to the asthma data will shed some light on further research on treatment and even personalized medicine for asthma, a disease phenotypically heterogeneous with unclear etiology. 由於數據收集儲存與處理技術的快速發展，高維度數據在許多研究領域中越來越常見，例如生物財務基因醫學等。高維度數據的非參數變量和半參數統計模型的相關文獻因此也在快速發展中，並且這類統計分析推論方法在各研究領域數據分析中扮演著重要角色，一個實際的數據例子是關於成人氣喘疾病研究中環境基因風險因素和它們的交互作用。我們專注於高維度數據分析中一個因變數和很多個自變數建相關性建模的非參數變量選擇和半參數模型結構辨識問題。這種高維度數據的未知真實迴歸函數通常非常複雜，半參數模型同時俱有精簡有彈性有效率的好處。其中變量選擇和結構辨識是半參數模型建構的兩個關鍵步驟。傳統的作法是在給定一個半參數迴歸模型並且在稀疏的假設下，如相加模型變異係數模型和半變異係數模型，建立變量選擇和結構辨識程序以構造最終的低維度半參數模型。但是，由於高維度數據迴歸函數本身的複雜度高，這種作法在應用中並不切實際，成人氣喘疾病研究數據是一個例子。另一方面，在給定一個參數迴歸模型假設下的變量選擇方法可能因爲參數迴歸模型假設錯誤而變得不可靠。而在非參數迴歸模型假設下的變量選擇方法只能達到極慢的收斂速度。我們考慮在非參數函數變異分析假設下，以含有主效應函數和二階交互作用函數作為工作模型，使用韓數高斯過程迴歸方法建立有效的非參數變量選擇和半參數模型結構辨識方法。我們將推導這個新方法的大樣本理論性質。我們也將執行大量的模擬實驗用以檢視它的有限樣本表現跟和現存的方法做比較，並且將它應用前面提到的實際數據分析。特別是在應用到成人氣喘資料分析可以對治療這個疾病的研究提供一些線索。

12304024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12304024.value: 多偏振態敏感的有機光電探測器

12304024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12304024.value: Detection of polarization states of the polarized light is critical for a plethora of applications in areas such as image sensors, environmental monitoring, light communications, security monitoring, health monitoring, bio/medical analysis, military reconnaissance, artificial vision, remote sensors, digital cameras, mobile phones, and polarimetric information displays. Different polarization states of the incident light are determined using multiple photodetectors incorporating polarizers having different polarization sensitivities. For example, a conventional polarimetric imaging system uses an array of discrete photodetectors having polarizers/compensators with a rotated polarization position relative to their nearest neighbors, combining multiple discrete photodetectors with an array of micro polarizers/retarders, or employing polarization beam splitters. However, the polarimetric imaging system with a photodetector array has limitation in spatial resolution. The use of a photodetector array for polarization detection has technical limitations, as it is difficulty to integrate the optical components, such as the polarization beam splitters and micro polarizers/retarders, with electronics for compact system at low cost. This project proposes to develop a novel multi-polarization sensitive organic photodetector (OPD) using a back-to-back stacked anisotropic P-polarization/S-polarization sensitivity double heterojunction structure. For example, the front P3HT:Y6-based anisotropic polarization sensitive junction, prepared using floating film transfer method, is aligned for responding to the P-polarized light, whereas the rear P3HT:Y6-based anisotropic polarization sensitive junction is aligned for responding to the S-polarized light. The use of a back-to-back stacked anisotropic P-polarization/S-polarization sensitive double heterojunction in the OPD allows a multi-polarization sensitive detection that is controlled by the polarity of a bias voltage applied between the two contacts in the device. The polarization sensitive photodetection technology will be critical for development of advanced computer vision in robotics, automated manufacturing, health monitoring, bio/medical analysis, and other applications across various industries. 探測偏振光的偏振狀態在圖像感測器、環境監測、光通信、安全監控、健康監測、生物/醫學分析、軍事偵察、人工智慧視覺、遠端感測器、數碼相機、手機、偏振資訊顯示等諸多領域的應用中至關重要。通常來說，不同偏振狀態的入射光由光電探測器結合具有不同偏振靈敏度的偏振片來確定。例如，傳統的偏振成像系統使用具有相對于其最近鄰居旋轉偏振位置的偏振器/補償器的分立光電探測器陣列，將多個分立光電探測器與微偏振器/延遲器陣列組合，或者採用偏振分束器。然而，此類光電探測器陣列的偏振成像系統在空間解析度方面存在局限性。並且，使用光電探測器陣列進行偏振檢測具有技術限制，其難點在於使用低成本條件將光學元件（例如偏振分束器和微偏振器/延遲器）與電子器件高度集成為緊湊系統。 本專案提出開發一種新型的多偏振態敏感的有機光電探測器，該探測器使用背對背堆疊P型偏振和S型偏振敏感的雙異質結結構。例如，使用浮膜法製備的前端P3HT:Y6各向異性偏振敏感異質結針對P型偏振光產生響應，而後端的P3HT:Y6各向異性偏振敏感異質結針對S型偏振光產生響應。在此探測器中使用背對背堆疊的P型偏振光敏感/S型偏振光敏感雙異質結可以通過在在探測器兩端施加不同偏壓來實現對多種偏振態光的檢測。該多偏振態敏感有機光電探測技術對於機器人高級電腦視覺、自動化製造、健康監測、生物/醫學分析等各行業的應用開發至關重要。

12500124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12500124.value: 線上健康社群已普遍成為個人尋求資訊和情感支持的平台。這個平台特別給予群體帶有可隱藏的污名化身份一個理想空間揭露自身的身心經歷。可隱藏的污名化身份範指一些可以隱藏，卻又被普遍被社會貶低、負面、刻板的身心狀況、背景或取向。隱瞞這些污名化身分會對受苦的人產生不利影響，例如延遲診斷和治療。然而，暴露被污名化的身份也可能引發工作和社交的問題，令這些人受到歧視或不公平對待。管理這些可隱藏的污名化身分是日常壓力的來源。雖然在線上健康社群自我揭露污名化身份與經歷能減輕這些壓力，亦能讓其成員提供適當的建議並對污名化經驗表現出同理心，但並非每個線上健康社群都適合我揭露污名化身份與經歷。 有見及此，本項目建立在自我揭露流程模型和線上社群框架的基礎上去探討兩個議題圍繞群體成員帶有可隱藏的污名化身份：（1）線上健康社群設計的關鍵組成部分（即人員、目的、政策和軟體）如何影響可用性和社交性，以及如何使用它們來支援這個群體的自我揭露過程，(2)自我揭露如何促進這個群體的社會連結、自我接受和社會訊息交換，以及對他們身心健康的長違影響。 我們將利用多種資料收集和分析方法，包括網絡志研究（研究1）和縱向調查（研究2），來驗證假設。我們提出的項目將透過以下方式推進文獻的發展：(1) 為線上健康社群文獻提供理論解釋和經驗證據去證明社交科技促如何改善帶有可隱藏的污名化身分的個人福祉，(2)為線上健康社群文獻提供一個新的視角來理解其成員的參與行為。此外，所學到的經驗教訓將提供行動方案和措施旨在改進線上健康社群。

12500424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12500424.value: 這個計畫將加深我們對為什麼某些政府官員可以比其他官員少承擔責任的理解。這項研究是對現有文獻的補充而不是競爭，現有文獻關注的是如何阻止政府官員迎合公眾輿論。它增加了關於為什麼民主在其最簡單和最純粹的形式下效果不佳的文獻。它為許多新生民主國家帶來了有毒的組合提供了新的線索：(1)選民受教育程度較低，(2)制度較弱，為現任者提供了比憲法規定更多的優勢。它有可能提供一種新的保守主義理論來補充現有的文獻。從長遠來看，我們期望我們的研究將有助於在政治經濟學和資訊經濟學文獻中產生新穎的見解和研究問題。

12502124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12502124.value: 小組會議中的中斷對女性參與的影響

12502124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12502124.value: A recent meta-analysis study revealed that women are less likely than men to emerge as leaders due to their low participation in group discussions (Bandura, Grijalva, Newman, Yan, & Jeon, 2018). But why do women participate less in group meetings? Previous research has mainly focused on employees’ agency vs. communion traits and gender stereotypes (Heilman, 2012; Weiss, et al., 2014; Wiggins, 1991). We believe that an important oversight is the role of leaders, as they have a significant influence on employees’ work behaviors and outcomes (Castilla, 2011). While there is ample knowledge about leaders’ differential evaluations during selection processes for career progression (Heilman & Chen, 2005; Quadlin, 2018; Stuhlmacher & Walters, 1999), little is known about leader behavior during actual interactions with women that may intentionally or unintentionally further reinforce gender barriers at work. To address this deficiency, we investigate leaders’ interruption as a key factor contributing to women’s low participation in group meetings. Drawing on expectation states theory (Berger, Conner, & Fisek, 1974; Berger, Fisek, Norman, & Zelditch, 1977) and social role theory (Eagly, 1987), we propose that group leaders are more likely to interrupt female group members compared to their male counterparts. First, gender operates as a salient status characteristic in mixed-gender groups wherein men are expected to be more competent than women. Second, participation in group meetings, often taking agentic forms, is more likely to be resisted if initiated by women, who are expected to be communal. We corroborate our logic by theorizing that leaders are more likely to interrupt women in group discussions when team workload demands are high because high workload demands are more likely to activate leaders’ gendered expectations of members’ competence. Drawing on social role theory, we propose that leaders’ interruption may cause female members to perceive it as disapproval of their participation, on the one hand, and lower their confidence in engaging in agentic behaviors, on the other hand; both resulting in reduced participation in future group meetings. Furthermore, we theorize that gender-blindness (i.e., the ideology of downplaying gender differences, Martin & Phillips, 2017) may buffer the deleterious effects of leaders’ interruption. Consequently, even when faced with leaders’ interruptions, women high on gender-blindness may continue to participate in group meetings. We will test our model progressively in Study 1 (a field observation study) and Study 2 (a four-wave longitudinal survey study). 最近的一項元分析研究表明,由於在小組討論中參與度較低,女性較男性更難脫穎而出成為領導者(Bandura, Grijalva, Newman, Yan, & Jeon, 2018)。但是為什麼女性在小組會議中的參與度較低?以往的研究主要集中在員工的代理性與共融性特質以及性別刻板印象(Heilman, 2012; Weiss, et al., 2014; Wiggins, 1991)。我們認為一個重要的疏漏是領導者的作用,因為他們對員工的工作行為和結果有重大影響(Castilla, 2011)。雖然我們已經充分了解領導者在職業晋升過程中對不同性別員工的評價差異(Huffman, 2013; Heilman & Chen, 2005; Quadlin, 2018; Stuhlmacher & Walters, 1999),但對於領導者在實際互動過程中有意或無意地進一步加強工作場合性別壁壘的行為卻知之甚少。 為了解決這一缺陷,我們將研究領導者的中斷作為導致女性在小組會議中參與度低的關鍵因素。基於期望狀態理論(Berger, Conner, & Fisek, 1974; Berger, Fisek, Norman, & Zelditch, 1977)和社會角色理論(Eagly, 1987),我們提出小組領導者更可能打斷女性成員而不是男性成員。首先,在男女混合小組中,性別是一個顯著的地位特徵,人們預期男性比女性更有能力。其次,小組會議參與,通常採取主動形式,如果由女性發起,更可能遭到抵制,因為女性被期望應該更加親和。我們通過理論分析,在小組工作負荷較重時,領導者更可能打斷女性,因為較重的工作負荷更有可能激發領導者對成員能力的性別化預期。 根據社會角色理論,我們提出領導者的中斷可能會導致女性成員感到自己的參與受到反對,進而降低她們從事主動行為的自信,從而減少未來小組會議的參與。此外,我們認為性別盲視(即忽略性別差異的意識形態,Martin & Phillips, 2017)可能會緩解領導者中斷的不利影響。因此,即使面臨領導者的中斷,高度性別盲視的女性也可能繼續參與小組會議。我們將通過研究1(現場觀察研究)和研究2(四波縱向調查研究)逐步檢驗我們的模型。

12502724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12502724.value: 民粹主義与跨國企業經營風險

12502724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12502724.value: Liberal democracy is currently facing an unprecedented crisis as populism gains traction worldwide, with populist leaders governing over 25% of nations. Countries like Brazil, Hungary, India, Poland, Turkey, the UK under Boris Johnson, and the US under Trump have all been directly governed by populist leaders. Populist parties, particularly those on the right, have also seen increasing vote shares in recent elections. While populism is widely recognized as detrimental to the economy, little scholarly attention has been given to the specific risks it poses to multinational corporations (MNCs) and their investments. This proposed study aims to fill this gap by empirically exploring the impact of populist leaders on the MNCs who have investment or supply chain exposure to these countries, and their responses to such risks, utilizing large, proprietary firms, job postings, and work history data from sources like Orbis, Revenpack, and Lightcast etc. Anecdotal evidence suggests that the threats to MNCs are substantial, with examples such as expropriation attempts and increasing regulation pressure by the Law and Justice (PiS) government of Poland and Viktor Orbán’s Hungary, which illustrate the anti-globalization sentiment and economic nationalism often associated with the rise of right-wing populism. MNCs may employ various strategies to mitigate such risks, by selling shares, spinning off subsidiaries, or completely exiting the country. Apart from the existing investment, bad experiences with populism exposure could also change MNCs' future investment in countries with similar political trends. Each of the MNCs’ responses could have different economic implications for the host countries and firms, as well as for the future of globalization. Upon confirming the positive effect on MNCs’ capital flee, I will further explore the aforementioned channel of increasing economic nationalism and anti-globalization sentiment in the host countries. Additionally, populism may lead to a brain drain of valuable human capital from MNC subsidiaries, resulting in significant costs for firm controls and future human capital investment. I plan to adopt two identification strategies to alleviate the endogeneity concern, first is a standard difference-in-differences design with extensive parent MNC firm, and subsidiary firm-level controls, and the second is to further limit the comparison among a subsample of close-call election to capture the effect of surprising wins of populists. Through these endeavors, this study contributes to burgeoning economic research on the causes and consequences of populism and the increasing political and economic uncertainty faced by the MNCs. 自由民主目前正面临前所未有的危機，因為民粹主義在全球範圍內獲得支持，由民粹主義領導者治理的國家佔了25%以上。巴西、匈牙利、印度、波蘭、土耳其、英國（在鮑里斯·約翰遜任內）和美國（在唐納德·特朗普任內）等國都曾直接由民粹主義領導者統治。民粹主義政黨，尤其是右翼政黨，在最近的選舉中也獲得了更多的選票。 雖然民粹主義被廣泛認為對經濟有害，但學術界對其對跨國公司及其投資具體風險的關注相對較少。本研究提案旨在填補這一空白，通過實證方法探討民粹主義領導者對在這些國家有投資或供應鏈曝險的MNCs的影響，以及他們對這些風險的應對策略，利用Orbis、Revenpack、Lightcast等來源的大數據、專有公司、招聘廣告和工作歷史數據。 事例證據表明，民粹主義對跨國企業的威脅重大，例如波蘭法律與正義黨（PiS）政府對跨國企業加徵特別稅的嘗試及其日益增強的監管壓力，匈牙利的維克多·奧班政府針對跨國德企的各種針對性舉措，都體現了與右翼民粹主義崛起相關的反全球化情緒和經濟民族主義。跨國企業可能通過出售股份、分拆子公司或完全退出該國等策略來應對這些風險。除了現有的投資外，民粹主義曝險的不良經歷也可能改變跨國企業對具有相似政治趨勢國家的未來投資。跨國企業的每種應對方式都可能對主辦國和公司以及全球化的未來產生不同的經濟影響。在確認民粹主義對跨國企業資本外流的積極影響後，我將進一步探討主辦國中經濟民族主義和反全球化的增強效應。此外，民粹主義可能導致跨國企業子公司中寶貴人力資本的流失，對公司控制和未來人力資本投資產生重大成本。 我計劃採用兩種識別策略來緩解內生性問題的關注，首先是標準的差異在差異設計，並配備廣泛的母公司跨國企業和子公司公司的控制，其次是進一步限制在接近選舉結果的子樣本中的比較，以捕捉民粹主義意外勝利的影響。通過這些努力，本研究將對民粹主義的成因和後果以及跨國企業面臨的日益增加的政治和經濟不確定性的經濟研究做出貢獻。

12503324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12503324.value: Pollution activities, known to produce negative externalities, necessitate effective regulation. However, the practice of outsourcing pollution undermines the effectiveness of nationwide controls. While policymakers often discuss pollution relocation and carbon leakage, firm-level evidence remains limited due to data constraints. This study aims to bridge the gap by providing systematic, firm-level evidence of pollution outsourcing driven by financial market mechanisms. U.S. firms are subject to strict environmental regulations by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) and financial market participants, as evidenced by the Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) trend. However, US firms can offshore production to countries with less stringent environmental policies, like China. This creates an incentive for firms to reduce domestic production of toxic emission-generating products and source them from firms operating in regions with more lenient environmental standards. Firms function to maximize shareholder value, and when shareholders prioritize the environment, they can influence management. However, they may only consider the domestic environmental impact, overlooking the international effects of corporate decisions. This bias could stem from the fact that shareholders bear the environmental consequences within their own country, but are insulated from the polluting activities in a remote country. In this proposed study, we plan to use detailed US import transaction data to estimate the impact of environment-related proposals submitted by shareholders on a firm's pollution outsourcing activities. We hypothesize that firms adjust their productions and source products that require toxic emissions from countries with lenient environmental standards. To investigate the resultant pollution activities of global suppliers, we focus on the major trade partners, US and China. We aim to match the rich suppler information in the US import transaction data with China’s firm census and pollution database. We further gauge the health risks induced by these outsourcing activities for local residents in the regions where the suppliers are located. This study represents a contribution to the discourse on environmental policy and global climate change. It explores how financial market mechanisms can drive pollution outsourcing, a largely unexplored topic. If U.S. firms are found to be outsourcing pollution to countries with more lenient environmental standards, it could necessitate a reassessment of what it truly means for a firm to be 'green' within the ESG trend. The study highlights the need for environmental rules that cover both domestic and international issues effectively. 污染活動已知會產生負面外部性，因此需要有效的監管。然而，將污染外包的做法削弱了全國性控制的效力。雖然政策制定者經常討論污染遷移和碳洩漏問題，但由於數據限制，關於企業層面的證據仍然有限。本研究旨在通過提供系統性的、企業層面的污染外包證據來彌合這一差距，這些證據是由金融市場機制驅動的。 美國企業受到美國環保署（EPA）和金融市場參與者的嚴格環保規定的約束，正如環境、社會和治理（ESG）趨勢所證明的那樣。然而，美國公司可以將生產外包到環保政策較為寬鬆的國家，例如中國。這為企業創造了一個激勵機制，即減少國內生產會產生有毒排放的產品，並從環保標準較為寬鬆的地區的企業採購這些產品。 企業的功能是最大化股東價值，當股東重視環境時，他們可以影響管理層。然而，他們可能只考慮國內的環境影響，忽視企業決策的國際效果。這種偏見可能源於股東承擔本國的環境後果，但對遙遠國家的污染活動則保持隔離。 在這項擬議的研究中，我們計劃使用詳細的美國進口交易數據來估計股東提交的與環境相關的提案對企業污染外包活動的影響。我們假設企業調整其生產，並從環保標準寬鬆的國家採購需要有毒排放的產品。為了調查全球供應商的污染活動，我們專注於主要貿易夥伴美國和中國。我們目標是將美國進口交易數據中豐富的供應商信息與中國的企業普查和污染數據庫匹配。我們進一步評估這些外包活動對供應商所在地區居民的健康風險。 這項研究代表了對環境政策和全球氣候變化論述的貢獻。它探討了金融市場機制如何推動污染外包，這是一個很少被探索的話題。如果發現美國公司將污染外包給環保標準更寬鬆的國家，這可能需要重新評估一個企業在ESG趨勢中真正意味著'綠色'的含義。研究強調了需要有效涵蓋國內外問題的環境規則的必要性。

12503524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12503524.value: 基于主观信念下的最优货币政策

12503524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12503524.value: 货币政策的有效性在很大程度上受到个体消费者如何形成通胀预期的影响。传统经济模型通常假设经济主体具有完全的信息获取和响应能力，即符合完全信息理性预期（FIRE）框架。然而，实证证据对于FIRE的支持有限，并且消费者的主观信念存在显著的异质性。诸如接受的日常价格和经历的通胀历史等因素会影响消费者对未来通胀的看法，从而导致通胀预测的响应性和准确性存在差异。因此，在评估货币政策效果时，考虑预期异质性与消费边际倾向之间的互动是至关重要的。 本项目首先研究了预期形成如何依赖于个体特征，如收入和年龄。我们选择了密歇根消费者调查（MSC）和消费者预期调查（SCE），而不是专业预测者调查（SPF），重点关注公众的预期形成。我们的目标是记录以下有关通胀预期的几个方面：（1）不同消费者群体在无条件下对经济状况变化的反应程度，即是否存在过度反应或反应不足；（2）不同子群体的信念对特定经济冲击（如货币政策冲击或全要素生产率（TFP）冲击）的条件动态反应。 项目的第二部分旨在考察在消费者预期形成的异质性背景下的最优货币政策。我们将结合异质性收入和多样化的主观信念，将其纳入模型分析。模型还可以进一步扩展，包含一个交叠代际结构，以直接探讨年龄效应对通胀预期的影响。最优货币政策的设计将取决于这一不完美预期与收入异质性之间的互动。

12503724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12503724.value: 傳播可見性對工作投入感的悖論式影響：通過混合方法探究香港僱員職場社交技術平台的使用

12503724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12503724.value: 工作投入感往往會在組織和僱員層面帶來積極效果，例如提高生產力和工作滿意度。儘管如此，全球的研究表明，僱員的工作投入水平普遍較低。新冠疫情通過切斷員工與工作場所的聯繫，使工作投入狀況進一步惡化。社交技術平台（例如社交媒體、協作平台）是支持員工之間溝通、協調和合作的在線服務或軟件。使用這些平台可以增強員工的聯結性。新冠疫情之後，社交技術平台在組織中變得無處不在，理解如何通過利用它們在新常態下促進工作投入感至關重要。 研究發現，使用社交技術平台對僱員既帶來積極的影響（例如，促進知識分享和僱員社會資本的構建），也帶來消極的影響（例如，打斷工作和增加工作時間以外的辦公的要求）。我們把這些影響總結為聯結悖論。為了更好地理解社交技術平台的使用和所帶來的效果，基於傳播技術使用的悖論的視角（Büchler等人，2020）、傳播可見性理論（Leonardi，2014）和工作要求與資源模型（job demands and resources model; Demerouti等人，2001），我們將理論化並驗證一個在社交技術平台使用中的邊界跨越悖論。具體而言，我們關注社交技術平台提高工作相關活動可見性的能力，為員工創造了瞭解誰與誰相識（即網絡透明度）以及誰知道什麼（即信息透明度）的機會。我們預測，提高傳播可見性將促進員工的額外角色行為和額外時間行為。最後，我們假設額外角色行為會提升工作投入，而額外時間行為可能會導致工作投入下降。 本研究將採用混合研究方法探究以上研究問題和假設，研究對象為在香港的使用社交技術平台進行工作的全職公司僱員。研究一將通過定量的追蹤問卷調查，探索傳播可見性對工作投入的長期影響。研究二是後續研究，我們將通過質性訪談的方式，具體了解社交技術平台的使用體驗，探索研究一的中意外發現，並揭示未來研究的方向。 該研究項目將揭露傳播可見性所帶來的的長期的、悖論式的影響，有助於我們反思日益數字化的工作場所對員工的影響，並激發關於在可見性時代增強工作投入實踐的討論。

12600324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12600324.value: 電影業與海峽華人 - 陸佑夫人家族與香港、新加坡和吉隆坡的國泰機構(1920-70 )

12600324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12600324.value: 這研究計劃旨在：1）重溯國泰機構的跨國歷史，當中涉及其創辦者陸林淑佳女士及其子陸運濤如何經營機構旗下的各項投資；2）詮釋陸氏家族如何在香港、馬來亞及新加坡經營電影業務，並探索機構在星港各地聯繫人/中介人所扮演的商業角色 ; 3) 評估國泰機構與其他電影公司（特別是來自寧波的邵氏兄弟）及英商在亞洲電影業務上的競爭與合作。

12600824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12600824.value: 為改善社區長者之多維虛弱狀態的綜合干預方法

12600824.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12600824.value: Prof Hassel, Holger Prof Lippke, Sonia Prof LO, Ka Hei Kenneth Prof Man, Wai-kwong, David Prof Tam, Bjorn Tsz-King

12600824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12600824.value: 虛弱是一種在全球老齡化人口中日益引起關注的常見臨床綜合症狀，它反應了長者衰老的情況。虛弱個體面臨著較高的出現不良後果的風險，例如跌倒、殘疾、住院和死亡等。近年來，對虛弱的定義從一個簡單的身體虛弱的概念演變為一個涉及生理、心理、認知和社會領域的複雜、多維結構的虛弱概念，以反映醫療、心理和社會等因素的負面效應。另外，研究表明虛弱的狀態是動態和可轉換的，所以針對前期虛弱的長者進行早期干預有較高可能逆轉其虛弱程度，使早期的干預顯得尤其重要。然而，虛弱的臨床研究因為此領域的研究缺乏共識而受到阻礙。並且，虛弱相關的研究既未強調不同因素之間的互相影響，也未設計出有效的多元化的綜合干預措施。 在醫學上，綜合的干預方法強調了理解人類健康和疾病完整背景的重要性，即在理解健康、疾病和醫療服務時考慮了生理、心理和社會因素及它們之間的相互作用（Engel, 1977）。由於將生理心理社交模型應用於虛弱干預的應用仍然有限，因此需要開展更多的干預研究來涵蓋上述虛弱影響因素。 拟议的研究將採用將虛弱視為多維的狀態，並使用多元化（包括生理心理社交）的框架來了解多維虛弱狀態下多種因素間的相互關係。该研究将設計為一項四組、雙盲、群集隨機對照試驗。將從香港32個隨機選擇的老年社區中心招募308名60-80歲的前期虛弱長者，並將其分為四種虛弱缺陷模式（多虛弱、生理到心理/社交、非生理到心理/社交，及穩健控制）。根據虛弱三個因素的相互關係的假設生理心理社交框架，我們將提出四種干預策略（生理/心理社交/營養、生理/營養、心理社交/營養和非活躍對照組），以改善他們在9個月的干預及隨訪期間的整體虛弱程度，包括其身體功能，心理狀態，社交情況，營養狀況和生活方式的變化。我們的主要目標將是評估干預策略對每個虛弱缺陷模式組的參與者改善虛弱狀態的效果，並確定最有效的干預策略。 新的多維虛弱干預方法將有助於改善參與者在生理心理社交方面的虛弱狀態。研究結果將對醫護專業人員、照顧者和政策制定者具有實際意義，從而改善對社區居住的長者的支持及護理。

12600924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12600924.value: 兒童的跨域移動：蒸汽船在殖民海域內的流動性，1869-1950

12600924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12600924.value: Children’s transoceanic transits across the seas which connected the territories and outposts of the British Empire shaped the socialities of travelling, interacted with the state management of mobilities in particular ways, and produced distinctive textual accounts of the on-board experience. Working at the interface between global maritime history and the history of colonial childhoods, this project will explore how children experienced and negotiated on-board environments and the ways in which their journeys were propelled, managed, and discussed by institutional and state forces. Underpinned by a conviction that sea voyages were active historical spaces rather than merely conduits between port cities, the proposed research will shed new light upon children’s bodily and emotional experiences of colonial voyaging in the age of steamship travel, while also considering their interactions with global steamship companies and processes of mobility. Focusing mostly – but not exclusively – on routes between Britain and Asia after the opening of the Suez Canal in 1869 and regional sailings which linked together multiple Asian outposts of the British empire, the project will foreground the positions of Hong Kong, Shanghai, and Singapore as key transit points and destinations for child passengers. The proposed research will add an important component to the limited number of existing studies of floating social spaces by applying age as a category of analysis which can enhance understanding of the socialities of maritime travelling. By foregrounding the experiences of child passengers, it will demonstrate how children negotiated, contributed to, and understood ship-board hierarchies, procedures, social worlds, and cultural productions. Beyond considering processes of change over time, this research will also consider how children understood the temporal and spatial dimensions of sea voyages in distinctive ways. The PI will compile extensive materials from physical and digital archival repositories and will disseminate the project findings in a monograph. The investigators will facilitate visualisation of the spatialities of childhood mobilities by collating details of childhood sea voyages into a GIS dataset and and a related interactive digital map. 兒童在大英帝國領土與前哨的跨洋航行塑造了旅行的社會性，以特定方式與國家對流動的管理互動，並産生獨特的船上經歷和記述。通過把全球海洋史和殖民地兒童史結合，本項目將探討兒童如何體驗和應對船上環境，以及他們的旅程如何被機構和國家力量推動、管理，以及討論。建基於海上航行是活躍的歷史空間而不只是連接港口城市之間的通道，本研究將為蒸汽船旅行時代中兒童在殖民地之間航行時的身體和情感經歷提供新的見解，同時也關注兒童與全球蒸汽船公司的互動和流動的過程。本研究主要聚焦（但不限於）1869年蘇伊士運河開通後，英國與亞洲之間的航綫以及連接大英帝國多個亞洲前哨區域的航行，突顯香港、上海和新加坡作爲兒童乘客的重要中轉點和目的地的角色。 這項研究將年齡作爲分析類別，補充現有關於流動社會空間有限的研究，提升對海上航行社會性的理解。透過突顯兒童作爲乘客的經歷，研究將展示兒童如何應對、理解並對於船上等級制度、程序、社會世界和文化産物的貢獻。除了考慮因時間而變化的過程外，本研究也會探討兒童如何以獨特的方式理解海上航行的時間和空間維度。項目負責人將從檔案和數位典藏中彙集素材，並將研究成果撰寫成專著。研究人員亦將通過收集兒童海上航行詳情，利用地理資訊系統（GIS）數據集和相關互動數字地圖，展示兒童流動的空間。

12601024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12601024.value: 文化、溝通媒介與談判中的情緒：運用心理模型解析憤怒與同情對談判的影響

12601024.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12601024.value: Prof Liu, Meina Prof Liu, Wu

12601024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12601024.value: 談判通常是一個情緒化的過程。談判者可能會事先對各種談判策略和結果進行理性分析。然而他們的許多願望會在與對方的互動中受挫，從而產生各種情緒。越來越多的研究揭示了不同情緒對談判者自身或對方的談判結果的影響（參見 Hunsaker, 2017; Olekalns & Druckman, 2014）。但許多研究結果不一致，而我們在理論上仍無法充分解釋這些影響是如何發生何時的。 不一致的一個來源在於，許多有關談判者情緒的研究是通過電腦媒介（CMC）進行的。儘管研究者認識到情緒的體驗和表達因溝通渠道有所不同，但很少有人實際評估情緒在面對面（FtF）談判與 CMC谈判效果之間的差異。由於大多數研究使用西方樣本，我們對這些模式是否在不同文化中有廣泛影響的程度知之甚少。 本研究的主要目的是探討憤怒和同情這兩種雖然具有相反情感價值，但共享相同的認知評估（即責任歸因，Weiner，1995）的情绪如何在不同文化（美國與中國）和不同情境下（FtF 和 CMC），讓談判雙方產生不同程度的共享心理模型 (SMM)、進行不同程度地心理模型調整 (MMA)，以及產生不同程度的“固定餅”認知偏差，從而導致不同的談判結果。我們認為，情緒的影響不是靜態的，而是一個動態的認知過程。談判者根據與對方的互動不斷修正和調整他們對談判情境的既有理解，反過來影響他們對談判整合潛力的判斷準確性以及談判結果。談判心理模型的研究表明，SMM 和 MMA 是可以作為消除談判者固定餅認知偏誤的有效理論機制（Liu et al., 2016）。因此，心理模型方法可以幫助解釋情緒如何在不同的談判情境中（如通信媒介和文化）對談判行為與結果產生不同影響。 具體來說，我們認為感受到的憤怒會通過限制談判者的 SMM 和 MMA 並加劇固定餅偏誤來損害整合結果，因為憤怒的談判者往往會減少信息交換並將注意力集中在分配方面的談判；這種效應在 FtF 談判中會比在 CMC 中更為明顯。另一方面，感受到的同情會通過增加談判者的 SMM 和 MMA 並減少他們的固定餅偏誤來改善整合結果，因為它促進信息交換和以他人為中心的注意力集中；這種效應在 CMC 中比在 FtF 中更為明顯。我們還認為，憤怒的效應對美國談判者來說會更加顯著，而同情的效應對中國談判者來說會更加顯著，因為他們調整其文化典型心理模型的能力受情緒和通信媒介的影響。 我們的試點研究提供了支持我們理論框架的初步證據。我們將進行一項包含約 400 名參與者（每個條件下 50 名參與者）的 2 x 2 x 2 實驗設計，以評估文化如何與通信媒介相互作用，從而放大或減弱憤怒和同情對談判者在談判前後在個人和雙邊層面上的心理模型以及談判結果的影響。

12602724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12602724.value: 冷戰期間的新界：駐軍與內部治安

12602724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12602724.value: During the Cold War (1947-1991), the New Territories of Hong Kong was turned into a garrisoned space to secure and sustain British colonial rule. In the context of global strategic contraction and cuts in military spending, the British invested considerably in the defence of the New Territories until the 1980s. The situation in Hong Kong, to a large extent, however, was decided by the larger contexts of the Sino-Russo-Anglo-American relationship and the People’s Republic of China’s policy towards Hong Kong. Given the unlikelihood of a PRC attempt to take over Hong Kong by force and the garrison was never expected to defend the colony in such an eventuality after the Korean War, this study asks if it was justified to invest a significant amount of money and resources in maintaining a military presence in the New Territories. It also explores such a presence’s techniques, effectiveness, and impact. To tackle these questions, this proposed study adopts the approaches of archival study and Spatial History to discuss the security and policing dimensions of the New Territories during the Cold War, especially from the end of the Chinese Civil War in 1949 to the conclusion of the Sino-British Joint Declaration in 1984. Using archival and other sources from different sides, it assesses the role and effectiveness of the British military investment in stabilising the situation and the responses from different sides. It looks at the complex international context, the discussions over Hong Kong’s defence policy, and the changing situation in the New Territories during the post-war decades, during which parts of the area witnessed rapid transformation and modernisation, as well as turmoil such as during the 1967 Riots. The Spatial History approach supplements archival-based research by creating historical data layers about the British garrison’s experience in the New Territories that can be collated and analysed. It maps the British military and other operations in the New Territories as well as the related infrastructures, discuss how natural and human geography factors shaped the garrison’s physical presence and its operations, and ascertain the impact of security considerations and the garrison’s presence on the social-economic landscapes of the New Territories. Using the Spatial History method highlights the importance of local variations and spatial contexts in understanding the complexity of colonial military history and the history of policing during the Cold War. 在冷戰期間（1947-1991），香港新界成為一個駐軍地區，以確保和維持英國在香港的殖民管治。在全球戰略收縮和軍事開支削減的背景下，英國一直到1980年代仍在新界有一定的防衛投入。然而。香港的局勢在很大程度上是由中、蘇、英、美關係以及中華人民共和國對香港的政策所決定。鑑於中國大陸不太可能以武力接管香港，且該駐港英軍在朝鮮戰爭後也不被指望能夠捍衛殖民地，這項研究旨在探問投入大量金錢和資源來維持在新界的軍事存在之必要性。它還探討了這種存在的技術層面、效果，以及影響。 為了回答這些問題，研究計畫採用檔案研究和空間史的方法，討論冷戰時期新界的安全和治安層面，尤其是從1949年中國內戰結束到1984年中英聯合聲明簽訂的時期。項目負責人將利用不同方面的檔案和其他資源，評估英國軍事投資在穩定局勢方面的作用和效果，以及各方的反應。計畫亦要論複雜的國際背景、香港防務政策的討論，以及戰後數十年內新界局勢的變化，特別有些地區經歷了急劇的轉型和現代化，也出現了如1967年暴動等動盪。 空間史方法補充了基於檔案的研究，通過創建有關英軍在新界經歷的歷史數據層來進行整理和分析，計畫把英軍在新界的行動以及相關基礎設施收入地理資訊系統，以討論自然和人文地理因素如何塑造了駐軍的實際存在及其行動，並探索安全考慮和駐軍存在對新界社會經濟的影響。採用空間歷方法突出了本地差異和空間背景在理解殖民軍事史和冷戰時期駐軍歷史複雜性中的重要性。

12604124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12604124.value: 標題：以中國水墨畫為目標領域開發精細觸控機器人路徑

12604124.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12604124.value: Prof Koon, Wai Bong Prof Yao, Fenghui

12604124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12604124.value: This study proposes to teach a robotic arm the art of Chinese brush painting, guided by an expert engineer and a highly trained ink painter. The goal is not to automate human art, but to understand the differences between human and robotic motion using this artistic challenge as a target domain. This research will require us to interpret the movements of this art form in a new way. Traditional methods of teaching painting transfer knowledge from teacher to student via an implicit sharing of bodily experience, whereas training these movements in robotics will require a new understanding and perspective on this cultural legacy. The IBA Global Employment Institute identified automation as a key opportunity for economies like Hong Kong and Singapore, where highly educated populations can benefit from fusing creative and cybernetic systems, providing that creative professionals can gain a fundamental grasp of technological matters (Wisskirchen et al, 2017). Studies in engineering have used Chinese brush painting as a target domain, however, none have worked with trained artists to program or evaluate the results. Chinese brush painting is a deep cultural art form that records fine movements expressed via the motion of ink, brush, and water on paper. A new generation of programmable robots (‘Cobots’) and sophisticated non-specialist software have made it cheaper and easier for engineers and artists to collaborate on designing new approaches to robotic motion based on their mutual expertise. In collaboration with an engineer experienced in robotic ink painting (Co-I Yao) and a highly trained brush painting artist (Co-I Koon), this project will begin by scrutinising prior engineering studies in robotic pathing for brush painting and devising new approaches, led by a PI trained in painting, creative technology, and art history. Our goal is not to replicate human artistry but to identify differences between human and robotic movement using one of the most nuanced art forms for the study of fine-touch motion, and publish these differences as catalysts for a deeper exploration into how robots become physically integrated into human lives. This project encapsulates the potential of interdisciplinary collaboration in deciphering and shaping the evolution of human-technology relationships. Through conference presentations, peer-reviewed publications, public exhibition, and teaching enhancements, this research will address philosophical questions in the future of art and automation alongside potential insights for new approaches to robotic pathing. 摘要：本研究建議在專家工程師和訓練有素的水墨畫家的指導下，向機器手臂傳授中國水墨畫藝術。計畫目標不是使人類藝術自動化，而是利用這項藝術挑戰作為目標領域來理解人類和機器人之間運動的差異。這項研究將要求我們以新的方式解讀這種藝術形式的運動。傳統的繪畫教學方法透過隱性的身體經驗的分享將知識從教師傳授給學生，而對於機器人，訓練這些動作將需要對這一文化遺產有新的理解和視角。 國際律師協會全球就業研究所（IBA GEI）認為，自動化對以香港和新加坡為例的經濟體來說是一個關鍵機遇，只要創意專業人士能夠對技術問題有基本的掌握，受過高等教育的人口就可以從融合創意和控制論系統中受益（Wisskirchen 等，2017 ）。有工程研究以中國水墨畫為目標領域，但均未曾與訓練有素的藝術家合作來編程或評估結果。中國水墨畫是一種深厚的文化藝術形式，透過墨、筆和水的動作在紙上記錄了細緻的動線。新一代可程式機器人（「Cobots 協作機器人」）和先進的非專業人士軟體已使得工程師和藝術家能夠以更加低成本及容易的方式，根據彼此的專業知識合作設計新的機器人運動路徑。該計畫將與一位在機器人水墨作畫方面經驗豐富的工程師（共同研究員 Co-I Yao）和一位訓練有素的毛筆繪畫藝術家（共同研究員 Co-I Koon）合作，首先仔細審查先前有關毛筆繪畫機器人路徑的工程研究，然后設計新方法，并由接受過繪畫、創意技術和藝術史培訓的首席研究員（PI）領導。我們的目標不是複製人類藝術，而是使用最微妙的藝術形式之一來識別人類和機器人運動之間的差異，以研究精細觸控運動，並將這些差異發布，成为更深入地探索機器人如何實現物理整合進入人類生活的催化剂。該計畫體現了跨學科合作在破解和塑造人類與技術關係演變方面的潛力。透過會議演講、同行評審出版物、公開展覽和教學改進，這項研究將解決未來藝術和自動化的哲學問題，以及對機器人路徑新方法的潛在見解。
