12606124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12606124.value: 移民機會對社會態度的影響

12606124.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12606124.value: Prof Hong, Ying Yi Prof Koo, Ching Hua Anita

12606124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12606124.value: Do emigration opportunities alleviate or deepen citizens’ dissatisfaction with domestic affairs? This question is important as global competition for quality migrants intensifies, leading to an unprecedented diffusion of emigration opportunities. Extensive research has examined the relationships between emigration and overt political activities. However, we know very little about how public attitudes may change in the face of expanded emigration opportunities. Theoretically, the presence of options may remind people of missed opportunities and lead them to set expectations that are more difficult to fulfill. Yet, by reducing people’s confidence in the potential for improvement through political participation or other collective actions, it may also, ironically, induce satisfaction with the status quo—a phenomenon known as “system justification” in psychology. Empirically, existing opinion surveys on migration do not distinguish between issue satisfaction and importance, even though they represent distinct aspects of attitudes and likely respond to emigration opportunities differently. These lacunae leave a great deficiency in our understanding of the profound implications that global mobility may have on domestic politics. This project will exploit the abrupt surge in migration pathways in Hong Kong since 2020. Using a theoretically-grounded panel survey and a pilot-tested experiment, supplemented by in-depth interviews, it will disentangle the complex relationships between the availability of exit options and public attitudes. The panel survey will track, in three waves, changes in emigration opportunities, perceived likelihood of improvement through voice, and attitudes toward public issues within individual respondents over the course of two years. The experiment will manipulate perceived emigration opportunities and estimate their causal effects on people’s attitudes toward the status quo. Using a validated news consumption choice task, we will be able to, for the first time, measure and compare the importance people attach to domestic issues in the context of changing emigration opportunities. 移民機會如何影響市民對本地事務的態度？透過追蹤調查和實驗，並輔以深入訪談，本項目將解開移民選擇與社會態度之間複雜的關係。追蹤調查將分三個階段追蹤個人受訪者在兩年內的移民機會以及對公共問題的態度的變化。實驗將進一步評估兩者之間的因果影響。

12606424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12606424.value: 南宋戰爭書寫與元代文學中懷古遊覽文化的形成

12606424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12606424.value: 本計畫聚焦南宋戰爭書寫，考察與此相關的由宋至元的創傷記憶文本，探討宋元文人對忠烈及戰亂的價值省思，如何由此建構文化英雄典範和形塑地方文化。作為隱喻及座標的南宋戰爭人物，在後續書寫裡具有相當的嚴肅性，元人記念和哀悼南宋忠烈，以此對照當世的英雄和奸臣。由無數戰爭書寫建立的集體受難記憶，漸次促進元代懷古遊覽文化的形成。這樣一個進程，得力於元代官方、地方、民間祭祀南宋戰爭人物的行為，諸如遊覽古蹟、舉行祭祀、修建祠廟等等。基於此現象，本計畫擬探討以下問題：第一，南宋戰爭人物及其事跡的創傷書寫，例如描寫戰爭人物及事件始末、地點拜訪 (戰爭發生地、祭祠場所、陵墓憑弔訪古等等)、耳聞目睹的經驗，是以怎樣的文學語言和方式表述此段血淚史？創傷理論所說的回憶模式—重複、再現、刪減等等—在文學創作裡有否呈現如此規律和變化軌跡？第二，南宋戰爭人物及其事跡的創傷書寫，形成兩條線索，一為莊嚴的血淚史書寫，一為地方古蹟探索的旅遊書寫，兩條線索的交匯最早在元初時已經出現，並持續發展，前者的文本積澱成為後者的書寫來源，對南宋國難的叩問在蒙元中後期驟增，原因是否與當時官、民對南宋戰爭的記念模式改變以及當世內亂頻仍相關？準此，本計劃把宋元文學中的南宋戰爭書寫，放在懷古文學傳統和遊覽文化的交叉研究上，探索創傷書寫、文化英雄典範、地方古蹟文化形成的互動關係，期以指出嚴肅教化之遊是元代士人的共識。

12606824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12606824.value: 評估針對有遊戲成癮症狀的中國青少年的綜合動機和認知行為治療模型：三臂研究

12606824.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12606824.value: Dr Ji, Yinan Prof KAN, Wing Shan Prof Wang, Jianping

12606824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12606824.value: 背景 遊戲成癮症在全球和中國的青少年中是一個嚴重的問題。作為一種相對新近被認可的心理障礙，目前對於遊戲成癮症的干預研究存在概念和方法論問題。概念上，缺乏一個基於實證的框架來理解遊戲成癮症現象。儘管動機因素被確定為遊戲成癮症的重要預測因素，但它們尚未被有意義地整合到任何用於處理患有遊戲成癮症的青少年的干預模型中。現有研究存在顯著的方法論缺陷，如：非隨機分配、缺乏適當的對照組和樣本量小，這些都妨礙了對於其治療效果的任何有意義的結論。 目的 這是一項為期兩年的結果研究，旨在：（1）為中國患有遊戲成癮症的青少年開發一種整合的動機和認知行為治療，（2）檢驗整合動機和認知行為治療（IMCBT）和認知行為治療（CBT）對於緩解中國青少年遊戲成癮症症狀的效果，（3）檢驗兩種方法導致結果變化的潛在機制。該研究將檢驗兩種干預的即時和長期效應以及參與者變化的潛在機制。 方法 將採用隨機對照設計，包括基線、干預後、3個月和6個月的跟進。在中國三個城市中，將隨機分配150名年齡在14-18歲的高中生到IMCBT和CBT組以及一個支持組作為對照條件。每組將包括八名學生，這些學生已被評定為超過由陳氏網路成癮量表評估的網路遊戲症狀閾值。每個組的干預將由學校輔導員進行八次干預會話，他們將接受中國大陸和香港的認知行為治療專家提供的一年培訓和監督。假設IMCBT和CBT組的參與者在干預後和跟進評估中將表現出明顯更好的改善，並且IMCBT組的參與者在所有測量變數中的結果將顯著優於CBT組的參與者。 意義 這將是一項首次在中國社會中嘗試解決關於患有遊戲成癮症的青少年不斷上升的心理健康問題的概念驅動和嚴謹設計的研究之一。如果被證實有效，這些干預模型可以用於中國青少年在世界各地的應用。

12607124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12607124.value: 應對全球價值鏈中的社會衝突

12607124.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12607124.value: Dr Chen, Ting Prof QIU, Dongxiao Larry

12607124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12607124.value: 隨著全球社會衝突的升級，如俄烏衝突、敘利亞戰爭等重大爭端日益增多，地方性的社會衝突也在不斷增加。根據2011年世界發展報告，全球約15億人，即五分之一的人口生活在受衝突或暴力影響的地區。2016年暴力衝突的國家數量也達到了近三十年來的最高點。這些社會衝突對於在受影響地區運營的企業帶來了巨大的經濟後果，而這些後果可能會擴展到遠離衝突地區的其他企業，影響廣泛。 2018年全球價值鏈（GVC）中的國際貿易已超過全球貿易總量的50%。當國際企業與受衝突影響的供應商合作時，其負面影響可能波及到和平地區。因此，社會衝突帶來的經濟成本遠超局部範圍，對整個全球經濟構成了巨大負擔。在衝突影響足夠強烈的情況下，可能會重塑各地區的比較優勢，進而影響全球生產和貿易格局。 為全面探討這一現象，本研究首先試圖量化2007年至2019年期間社會衝突對於與國際供應商合作且這些供應商受衝突影響的美國企業業績的影響。此分析是通過整合多個專有的公司級數據集來完成的，包括Panjiva、EventRegistry以及D&B個別企業數據。在確立了基準效應之後，我們的研究深入探討了社會衝突通過哪些具體渠道影響美國企業。我們首先研究了供應減少、價格上漲或產品質量變化對美國企業的影響。此外，由於國際交易的特殊複雜性，如高昂的調整成本和合同執行困難，國際供應商受到社會衝突影響的負面效果尤為嚴重。 在應對這些挑戰時，企業可以採取多種採購策略，包括將進口重新分配給類似的國際供應商、終止與受影響供應商的合作關係，或為相同產品尋找新供應商。選擇新供應商涉及關鍵決策，如地理上的接近（近岸外包）、政治上的一致性（友岸外包）或在美國國內採購（回岸外包）。這些決策可能會顯著重新配置全球生產和貿易動態，推動其朝向區域化而非全球化發展。本研究的本質在於通過分析企業面對全球價值鏈中社會衝突所採取的戰略反應，來闡明這些複雜的問題。

12608324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12608324.value: 音系狀況對語音變異的影響：漢語方言中咝音的聲學和發音性質

12608324.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12608324.value: Dr Berkson, Kelly Harper Dr Faytak, Matthew Prof Qi, Haifeng Dr SHAO, Bowei Dr Wu, Shengyi

12608324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12608324.value: 本研究用語音實驗的方法考察漢語方言不同語音系統中的噝音，探討聲音的音系狀況對其聲學和發音變異的潛在影響。參考前人的研究，本研究關注兩個主要研究問題： 研究問題1：音系對立是否會減少噝音聲學和發音方面的變異？ 研究問題2：語音性質的變異和其對音系對立的重要性之間是否存在權衡？ 本研究就漢語方言中不同語音系統中咝音的聲學和發音性質，假設研究問題1中的影響存在，假設研究問題2中的權衡存在。 為回答這兩個研究問題，本研究計劃對八種漢語方言中的噝音進行聲學和發音研究。這些方言代表不同的噝音系統（例如寧德的/s/、江永的/s ɕ/和祁門的/s ɕ ʂ/）和不同的音系對立模式（例如，江永的[si-ɕi]中有對立而紹興的[sɹ̩-ɕi]沒有對立）。語音數據的採集包括聲學數據和發音數據，聲學數據的測量包括頻譜測量和倒譜測量，發音數據的測量包括舌位超聲成像和唇部發音姿勢。本研究將使用統計模型來分析實驗結果數據，以檢查（i）音系對立是否會導致咝音的聲學和發音變異的減少，以及（ii）某個語音維度在音系對立中的重要性是否和其變異程度之間有權衡。 本研究預計將產生至少三篇同行評審的期刊文章和兩篇高質量學術會議上的報告。就學術影響而言，本項研究預計填補語言類型學和音系對立研究中的重要空缺，加深對音系狀況和語音性質之間關係的理解；就其社會影響而言，本研究所涉及的漢語方言屬於瀕危方言，對這些方言語音性質的發掘記錄，會為這些方言的文化保護做出貢獻。

12609024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12609024.value: 山西煤炭公正轉型的實踐與願景

12609024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12609024.value: As the world’s largest coal producer and consumer, China’s rapid transition away from coal is essential for securing a global climate-safe future. However, this transition has been slow and immensely challenging. The coal sector provides a reliable and cheap energy source; it is an engine for regional economic growth and a significant source of employment. The transition beyond coal-based economies demands strategies of fairness and inclusivity, in other words, a just transition. A just transition rapidly moves toward carbon neutrality without disproportionately affecting certain regions or communities. This project will deliver rigorous empirical data exploring the relationship between social justice and low-carbon transitions in Shanxi, China’s largest coal-producing province. Shanxi’s regional economy relies on coal mining, making it an ideal place to study the politics and policies of just transition. The two key research objectives are (1) to examine the practices and visions of just transition in coal mine closures and the post-coal transition, and (2) to develop a deeper understanding of the just transition through an analysis from three political-economic perspectives: central-local relations, state-corporate relations, and state-civil society relations. This project will develop a critical and contextualized understanding of ongoing and envisioned transition strategies and identify hurdles to achieving a rapid and just transition away from coal. The empirical study will be underpinned by stakeholder interviews from four coal cities in Shanxi. We will conduct 160 interviews and 4 deliberative workshops with government officials, managers and workers from state-owned and privately owned coal companies, local residents, and civil society actors involved in coal mine closure and transition. Furthermore, we will comprehensively map the various forms of policy support for the coal transition in 43 major coal cities across China. The research team has conducted preliminary fieldwork and established contact with local stakeholders. This groundwork has facilitated deeper understandings of local contexts and informed the research design. The main contributions include: (1) policy impact: to enhance the policy relevance of just transition studies by building knowledge on concrete practices and policies promoting the just coal phase-out; (2) geographical expansion: to broaden the geographical scope of just transition research by reimagining just transitions beyond Western settings; and (3) theoretical advancement: to align just transition theory with political economy perspectives, to offer a deeper and more nuanced understanding of the underlying power dynamics, economic structures, and social reconfigurations required to achieve a just transition. 中國作為世界上最大的煤炭生產國和消費國，迅速擺脫煤炭對確保全球氣候安全至關重要。然而，由於煤炭產業提供可靠且廉價的能源，經濟成長引擎，和就業來源，這種轉變是緩慢且極具挑戰性的。煤炭經濟的轉型需要公平和包容性的策略。公正轉型可以迅速實現碳中和，而不會過度影響某些地區或社區。本研究將提供嚴謹的實證數據，探討中國最大產煤省份山西的社會正義與低碳轉型之間的關係。山西的區域經濟以煤炭為主，是研究轉型政治和政策的理想地點。兩個關鍵研究目標是（1）檢視煤礦關閉和煤炭轉型中公正轉型的實踐和願景；（2）透過對政治經濟領域的分析，加深對公正轉型的理解。本研究將對正在進行的和設想的轉型策略形成批判性和情境化的理解，並找出實現快速、公正地擺脫煤炭轉型的障礙。實證研究將以山西四個煤炭城市的利害關係人訪談為基礎。我們將對參與煤礦關閉和轉型的政府官員、國有和私營煤炭公司的管理人員和工人、當地居民以及民間社會參與者進行 160 次訪談和 4 場審議研討會。此外，我們也將全面調査全國43個主要煤炭城市對煤炭轉型的多種形式的政策支持。研究團隊進行了初步實地考察，並與當地利害關係人建立了聯繫。這項基礎工作促進了對當地情況的更深入了解，並為研究設計提供了資訊。本研究主要貢獻包括：（1）政策影響：透過累積促進公正煤炭淘汰的具體實踐和政策的知識，增強公正轉型研究的政策相關性； （2）地域擴展：透過重新構想西方背景以外的公正轉型，拓寬公正轉型研究的地理範圍； （3）理論進步：將公正轉型理論與政治經濟學觀點結合起來，對實現公正轉型所需的潛在權力動態、經濟結構和社會重構提供更深入、更細緻的理解。

12609524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12609524.value: 冷戰時期香港廣播與文學的跨媒體敘事, 1949-1969

12609524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12609524.value: This project studies radio literature and transmedia storytelling in Cold War Hong Kong. It looks into the enormous production of radio novels during the 1950s and 60s as an under-researched transmedia phenomenon. It scrutinizes the cultural network connecting radio storytelling, airwave fiction, and film adaptation to reveal how radio literature nurtured popular print and audiovisual media. The study examines the cultural politics and aesthetics of radio narratives and adaptations to throw light on the geopolitical significance of Hong Kong during these decades. It considers the bridging roles of radio literature in Sinophone studies and the history of Cantonese cinema. Researchers will examine the interplay between oral tradition, acoustic technology, print, and visual culture to reassess the legacy of transmedia radio storytelling in popular cinema. Radio wars and ideological competitions over the airwaves have remained underestimated in Cold War studies. The British established Radio Rediffusion (RDF) in Hong Kong in 1949 at a time when they were alert to propagandistic radio content. The project interrogates and goes beyond the political paradigm to reveal the functions and cultural politics of airwave novels that inspired intermedial adaptations between radio, print, and film. Adopting archival research and textual-sociocultural analysis, researchers will trace RDF’s institutional histories to understand the Cold War factor, and examine the cultural network connecting radio storytelling, airwave fiction, popular literature, and film adaptation to reassess radio literature’s connection with Cantonese cinema. Exemplary adaptations and influential radio personalities are scrutinized to understand the generic, textual and sonic features, the role of women in the works, the influence of cultural politics, and international reverberations of radio narratives. The project reconceives Sinophone studies and the history of Cantonese cinema by reconsidering radio literature as intermediary cultural forms, popular storytelling, and transnational mobility. It renews our understanding of radio literature not only as part of film and media studies, but also the history of Hong Kong and its geopolitical role. It will fill the gaps between the study of traditional literary canons, sound culture, transmedia storytelling, Cold War history, and Hong Kong media and film studies, providing a lens with which to examine the affective, sonic, and transnational significances of radiogenic works and intermedial adaptations. The research outcome will be several refereed publications as well as public knowledge transfer in the forms of exhibitions, forums and screenings to help the public understand the heritage of radio literature in urban everyday life. 本計畫研究冷戰時期香港的廣播文學和跨媒體敘事，並聚焦於20 世紀 50 年代和 60 年代的空中小說和電影改編的跨媒體流行文化現象。該研究考察廣播文學在華語研究和粵語電影史中的橋樑作用，並涉及口頭說故事傳統、聲學技術、印刷品和視覺文化之間的相互作用，及其與電影和通俗文學的密切關係。 在冷戰研究中，無線電廣播和電波上的意識形態競爭仍然被低估。研究人員將透過檔案研究、文本分析、和社會文化入手，爬梳資料，從而了解冷戰地緣政治等因素，結合文化和美學分析，並將鈎沉空中小說、廣播故事、通俗文學和電影改編的文化網絡，以重新評估廣播文學與粵語電影的聯繫。 該計畫將填補傳統文學研究方法、聲音文化、媒體技術轉變、跨媒體敘事、冷戰歷史以及香港電影研究之間的空白。研究成果將出版論述著，並以展覽、論壇、放映等形式幫助大眾了解廣播文學在城市日常生活中的歷史和傳承。

12610824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12610824.value: 歲月盈虛：清代文人對年老之取態

12610824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12610824.value: It is commonly believed that the longer individuals have lived, the more aware they become of their age. Furthermore, many people tend to view milestone birthdays as indicators of aging progression. With each passing decade, men and women become increasingly mindful of their own aging process and the proximity to death. This heightened age awareness is shaped by culture, which is universal but also influenced by factors such as race, class, gender, temporality, and geography. This proposed project aims to conduct original research by exploring previously under-tapped source materials to investigate how older adults in the final dynasty of China, which had the largest aged population during the imperial period, responded to the experience of continuous aging. The extensive collections of writings from men and women in the Qing Dynasty will serve as a major resource for conducting a historical study on various approaches to aging, as reflected in the authors’ choices of either counting up or counting down, reflecting on the years or decades that have passed or looking ahead to their remaining days, depending on individual life expectancy. By contrasting the mindsets of “time passed” and “time remained,” this project aims to analyze the inner emotions of numerous writers, shed light on the ways in which individuals in the Qing Dynasty grappled with the concept of aging, give a voice to the elderly individuals whose stories have often been overlooked in historical narratives, and provide a historical context for discussions on the current demographic landscape in China. 一般相信，人們活得愈久，對年嵗增長的自覺愈強，所以不少人將十年當作一個里程碑，並將逢十的生辰視爲邁向老年以至死亡的重要指標。雖然年歲增長的自覺有其普遍性，但其程度的深淺廣狹亦受到種族、階級、性別及時地等文化因素影響。清代是中國歷史上老年人口最多的朝代，本研究項目旨在發掘及整理清代詩文集中未廣為人知的素材，從而探討末代王朝男女文人對年老的取態，包括他們對往昔的回顧與眷戀，以及對餘生的期盼與規畫。希望透過上述兩種心態的研究與比照，能展現清代老年文人的心路歷程，藉以為既有之歷史敘述補識未受正視的老年聲音，並為中國當代老年人口問題的討論提供歷史背景。

12612624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12612624.value: 當眼見不再為實：探索香港深度偽造的處理、影響和幹預策略

12613024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12613024.value: 香港南亞裔社區對照顧年長家庭成員的準備情況

12613024.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12613024.value: Prof Bai, Xue Prof LEE, Wan Ping, Vincent Prof Shankar, Janki Dr Surood, Shireen Prof Yan, Elsie Chau Wai

12613024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12613024.value: 隨著人口老化，越來越多的年長人士會需要依賴家庭成員進行照顧。考慮到年長人士的身心脆弱性，護理需求可能會突然出現，這對年輕家庭成員的生活可能造成重大的干擾和壓力。先前的研究已經指出，預先對家庭護理有一定準備對於護理者本身及其年長家庭成員的福祉都具有重要的意義。 作為香港最大的少數族裔群體之一，南亞家庭護理者的支持及需求並未受到足夠的關注。與其他亞洲文化一樣，南亞社群深重孝道，這促使他們傾向於為年長家庭成員提供家庭照顧。然而，作為少數民族，他們在護理過程中不僅要面對種族歧視、語言障礙，還有財務限制等多重挑戰。這項研究不是在一個人已經成為家庭護理者之後才開始，而是採取一種預防性的上游策略，專注於對“潛在”護理者進行研究，以確定如何更有效地提升未來護理者的準備和應對能力，應對年長家庭成員的護理需求，從而防止對主要護理系統造成過度負擔。 本研究受計劃行為理論的指導，將深入探討香港南亞裔潛在護理者準備情況的預測因素。資料收集將包括與45名南亞裔成年人、45名中國籍年長人士和15名服務於南亞社區以及社區領袖的服務提供者進行質性敘事訪談，以捕捉他們對南亞裔潛在護理者所需準備和支持的看法。此外，將對390名南亞裔成年人（包括印度人、巴基斯坦人和尼泊爾人）以及390名35歲及以上的香港成年人進行定量問卷調查，這些人至少有一位55歲以上的老年家庭成員居住在香港，以檢視這些潛在護理者的準備程度。 研究結果將確定香港南亞裔潛在護理者在未來照顧年長家庭成員時面臨的挑戰。這項研究將對制定針對少數族裔家庭護理的準備和支持干預措施有所助益。透過揭示南亞和中國潛在護理者準備情況的相關因素差異，本研究將為未來在香港以及全球其他文化多元的社區中，針對更廣泛的少數族裔社區進行的研究奠定堅實的基礎。

12613224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12613224.value: 洞悉長者聽覺交流障礙: 一項關於說話人信息感知的研究

12613224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12613224.value: 語音信號包含多種信息類型，涵蓋了語言內容、情感及說話者的身份。大量研究已證明，這些信息在語音感知過程中相互影響、相互作用。然而，目前的研究多集中於語言內容和情感信息的加工，對於年長群體在聽覺交流中如何有效加工說話者的信息，卻仍缺乏深入探討。本項目的主要目標是全面了解可能導致長者說話者信息感知缺陷的影響因素。具體研究目標包括：(a) 探討語言熟悉度對長者加工說話人信息的影響；(b) 研究情感線索對说話者嗓音感知的影響；(c) 探討認知功能在這些過程中的作用。 為達成這些目標，本項目將招募三組被試, 即正常聽力的長者、有听力損失的長者和正常聽力的年輕人。實驗一將主要研究語言熟悉度的影響。首先會比較被試在母語條件下 (廣東話) 和陌生語言條件下 (阿拉伯語) 對說話者進行區分的能力。接著會評估被試在接受訓練後，在這兩種語言條件下對說話者進行識別的能力。與此同時，被試還需進行三項認知測試，即Stroop測試、數字記憶測試和聽覺序列添加任務，來評估選擇性注意力、工作記憶和聽覺處理速度在說話者區分和識別任務中的作用。實驗二主要研究語音信號中情感線索對說話人感知的影響。被試將在包含三種不同情感 (快樂、悲傷和中性) 的刺激音中區分說話者的身份。與實驗一相同，被試也需完成三組認知測試, 以評估說話者信息感知與認知功能之間的關係。 此項目將深入揭示老齡化、老年性聽力損傷、語言熟悉度與情感線索等因素如何影響對說話者的感知。研究結果將有助於開發更有效的診斷工具和康復策略，從而緩解老齡化和老年性聽力損傷帶來的各種負面影響。此外，這些發現還能為優化針對長者的助聽器設計提供重要依據，提升他們的聽覺體驗和生活品質。

12613324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12613324.value: 參考點在交通滿意度中的作用

12613324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12613324.value: Travel satisfaction has emerged as a hot topic in transportation and travel behavior research over the past few years. As the transport domain specific subjective wellbeing, travel satisfaction is people’s affective and cognitive assessment about their daily travel. Studies have investigated a wide range of factors that may influence travel satisfaction including transport, the built environment, and people’s socioeconomic factors. Research efforts to conceptualize travel satisfaction are relatively scarce. One important issue is what reference points (i.e., the points which people compare their own travel behaviors to) people use to evaluate travel satisfaction. This research project addresses this research gap by investigating how different reference points, including travel preference/attitude, alternative travel choices, past travel behavior, and peers' travel behavior, influence people's assessment about their travel experiences. We are particularly interested in the direct, indirect, mediating, and moderating effects of different reference points on travel satisfaction and how these effects are manifested in different societal and transport system contexts. We propose to conduct the empirical study in Hong Kong and Shenzhen, two neighboring cities but different in the built environment, transport system, and mobility culture, among others. The research is expected to make important theoretical and empirical contributions to the travel satisfaction literature. The research findings would be useful for policy makers to evaluate transport development and policies in terms of their impacts on people’s subjective wellbeing and to develop transport policies that may enhance citizen’s quality of life. 近年來，在交通行為研究領域，交通或出行滿意度已成為熱門話題。作為特定於交通領域的主觀幸福感，出行滿意度是人們對其日常出行的情感和認知評價。以往的研究著重分析了可能影響出行滿意度的因素，包括交通輸、建成環境和人們的社會經濟因素。但是對於出行滿意度的理論研究相對較少。一個重要問題是人們用什麼參照點（即，人們用來比較自己的出行行為的點）來評估出行滿意度。本研究計畫透過調查不同參照點如何影響人們對其出行體驗的評估來解決這個研究空白。這些參考點包括出行偏好/態度、可能的出行選擇、過去的出行行為和同儕的出行行為。我們特別感興趣的是不同參照點對出行滿意度的直接、間接、中介和調節效應，以及這些效應在不同社會和交通系統背景下的表現。該研究預計將對出行滿意度文獻作出重要的理論和實證貢獻。研究結果將對政策制定者評估交通發展和政策對人們主觀幸福感的影響以及製定可能提高公民生活品質的交通政策很有幫助。

12613824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12613824.value: 《我的飲食失調康復故事》——社交媒體上由患者構建的飲食失調康復敘事：康復敘事對內容創作者和觀眾的健康影響

12613824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12613824.value: The emerging popularity of social media use for recovery among people with chronic mental illnesses has challenged the existing research paradigm that depicts social media as the ultimate villain in mental health care. Evidently, people with chronic mental health concerns have been using social media to document their struggles and recovery process online, in a hope to provide valuable first-hand health information, tips coming out of personal experiences, support and validation to those with similar concerns. The growing trend has shed a shimmering light to the possibility that social media could create a positive impact on one’s mental health, especially those who’re already suffering from mental health conditions. In the specific context of eating disorders (ED), a fatal mental illness impacting nearly 9 million people worldwide and 3% of population in Hong Kong, researchers also noted the trend of patients sharing personal recovery stories on social media to help both themselves and others understand the condition and treatment, seek and provide social support, and make sense of their experiences. Despite the proliferation of ED recovery content posted by actual patients on social media, less is known about the construction of a recovery narrative from the patient’s perspective and less is understood about the impact of such recovery narrative on the general audience. Thus, in this project, I’ll first define the self-constructed narrative consisting of personal experience recovering from an illness as a recovery narrative, and then further evaluate the impact of the recovery narrative on both the creating and receiving end of it. The project consists of 2 separate studies. Study 1 employs the method of qualitative interview to investigate the narrative construction process from the patient’s perspective, evaluating the health benefits and risks associated with social media narrative construction for ED patients. Study 2 uses an online experiment to examine the effect of patient-constructed narrative effect on the general public, in terms of raising awareness of ED, reducing ED stigma, forming positive food attitudes and subsequently promoting healthy eating habit. 社交媒體在慢性精神疾病患者康復過程中的新興流行使用，挑戰了將社交媒體描繪為精神健康護理中罪魁禍首的既有研究範式。顯然，患有慢性精神健康問題的人們一直在使用社交媒體記錄他們的掙扎和康復過程，希望提供寶貴的一手健康信息、個人經驗中的建議，以及為有相似困擾的人提供支持和認同。這一增長趨勢為社交媒體對精神健康產生積極影響的可能性帶來了微光，尤其是對那些已經在精神健康狀況中掙扎的人來說。在特定的飲食失調（ED）背景下，這是一種影響全球近 900 萬人以及香港 3% 人口的致命精神疾病，研究人員也注意到患者在社交媒體上分享個人康復故事的趨勢，藉此幫助自己和他人了解這種疾病及其治療，尋求和提供社會支持，並理解他們的經歷。儘管在社交媒體上由實際患者發布的飲食失調康復內容不斷增多，但對於患者視角下康復敘事的建構及其對一般受眾的影響仍知之甚少。因此，在本項目中，我將首先將個人康復經驗構成的自我敘事定義為康復敘事，並進一步評估此類康復敘事對於創作者和接收者的影響。該項目包含兩個獨立的研究。研究 1 採用質性訪談的方法，從患者的角度調查敘事建構過程，評估社交媒體敘事建構對於飲食失調患者的健康益處和風險。研究 2 則使用線上實驗來檢驗患者構建的敘事對於公眾的影響，包括提高對飲食失調的認識、減少飲食失調污名、形成積極的飲食態度，並隨後促進健康飲食習慣。

12614124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12614124.value: 敘事的力量：隨機對照試驗中SHARE干預對心理健康的促進作用

12614124.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12614124.value: Prof Mak, Winnie Wing-Sze Prof Shapiro, Michael A.

12614124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12614124.value: 香港大學生相比其他國家的年輕人，面臨著更普遍且更嚴重的心理健康挑戰。本研究探討閱讀同儕的心理康復故事能否以及如何促進香港大學生的心理健康。儘管已有證據支持敘事的方法在臨床心理學和公共健康宣傳中的有效性，但針對個人故事如何影響讀者心理健康狀態的研究仍比較有限。 為填補這一空白，我們將進行三項研究。先導研究將從曾經經歷過抑鬱、焦慮等心理挑戰的大學生中收集他們關於心理康復的真實故事，並將其作為『希望與韌性的故事』（Stories for Hope And Resilience Empowerment—SHARE）干預項目的內容。第一項主研究將對這些故事進行改進，通過被試間設計實驗檢驗故事人物的心理健康恢復狀況（仍在持續或已完成的康復目標）以及理解故事的方式（角色認同或自我中心投射）如何影響讀者的自我關愛、韌性、社會連結感和希望。第二項主研究將選取最佳的敘事策略融入SHARE干預項目中，通過長期的隨機對照試驗檢驗故事對改善讀者心理健康水平的即時和延遲效果。 在理論層面，本研究將通過整合臨床心理學中的敘事療法範式和健康傳播中的敘事勸服範式，闡釋敘事對心理健康的作用機制和效果。在方法層面，本研究探討了通過閱讀他人與心理疾病抗爭的經歷而提高年輕人心理韌性和希望的可能性。如果證實有效，這將是一種創新的、成本效益較高的促進心理健康的方法。在實踐層面，作為少數將敘事方法應用在香港語境的研究，它不僅致力於緩解當地的心理健康危機，且為敘事相關的研究提供了獨特的文化視角和實證基礎。此外，釐清敘事方法的機制和效果將有助於優化未來心理健康促進干預措施的設計。 研究結果將為未來SHARE干預項目的更大規模隨機對照試驗奠定基礎。我們的長期目標是建立一個在線故事庫，包含來自世界各地的人物故事，涵蓋多種形式（如音頻/視頻、互動敘事），涉及廣泛的心理健康主題，並為不同高風險群體和有需要的人士提供具有針對性的、可持續性支持。故事庫將作為一個重要的社會資源，以提升人們整體的心理健康水平。

12614424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12614424.value: 香港社區衝突、傳媒話語建構及公眾觀念：一個水平解釋理論的視角

12614424.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12614424.value: Prof Guo, Steve Zhongshi Prof ZHOU, Shuo

12614424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12614424.value: 本研究的主要目標是提出一個關於傳媒建構現實的理論模型。以香港為背景，本研究提出了一套與概念闡釋相對應的操作定義，二者系統地將香港傳媒對內容於公眾觀念連結起來，對現有知識體系有顯著貢獻。研究結果會深化現有信息生產與效果理論，培養活躍的公民社會，並促進一個對社區民主過程至關重要的負責任的傳媒制度。 項目的第一部分將媒體表現與公共利益相連接。在這裡，我們將媒體表現概念化為七個維度，每個維度都涵蓋新聞生產和資訊傳播的一個關鍵方面。在理論框架下，構建了一個內容測量模型。我們計劃對香港目前發行的收費或免費的日報進行大規模分析，分析時間跨度從2013年1月1日至2014年12月。 項目的第二部分則通過受眾調查數據來構建理論，探究個人從媒體新聞內容中尋求並獲得的信息。在探討所求與所獲之間的差距時，我們的研究擴展了既有的二元對立關係，涉及不滿的來源以及集體認知失調減緩的社會心理過程。內容分析中使用的七個測量尺度轉化為七個與受眾感知相匹配的領域，在這些領域中檢視一致性和差異性。尤其與我們的思考相關的是各種類型的讀者感知作為對新聞報導的认知反應，作為媒體機構的形象構建，以及作為媒體使用和其他行為意向的態度啟發式。此調查預計在2014年下半年進行，以驗證內容分析的數據。 本研究在理論貢獻上通過擴展使用與滿足理論進行認真的嘗試，在方法論上通過內容與受眾數據的交叉驗證實現創新。一系列學術出版物，包括期刊文章、一本關於香港傳媒的書籍，以及研究專著正在規劃中。分析結果也將提供給公眾和傳媒業界，以促進香港充滿活力的公民社會。

13100124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13100124.value: 香港瘰螈河豚毒素的來源

13100124.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13100124.value: Dr Bucciarelli, Gary Prof Ip, Chi Ho Dr Sin, Yung Wa

13100124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13100124.value: 河豚毒素（TTX）是一種最初在河豚中發現的強效神經毒素，主要因其致命效果而聞名。有趣的是，TTX並不僅限於海洋環境，還在一些陸地生物中被用作防禦及獵食的武器。我們的工作已經證明香港瘰螈（Paramesotriton hongkongensis）體內的TTX水平在時間和空間上都存在變化，但對驅動這種變化的因素知之甚少。理解驅動這種變化的機制之所以困難，部分原因是對蠑螈中TTX起源尚未達成共識。 最近對北美蠑螈物種的研究證實，從蠑螈皮膚上分離出的四種共生細菌能產生TTX。在香港瘰螈的皮膚中已鑑定出至少25種屬於相同四個屬的細菌，這使我們假設共生細菌也是香港瘰螈TTX的來源。 在本研究中，我們將：i）確認從香港瘰螈分離出的共生細菌是否能夠產生TTX；ii）識別香港瘰螈中產生TTX的細菌的潛在來源，特別是這些細菌是從環境中獲得還是從同種個體獲得；iii）確定香港瘰螈皮膚微生物組的變化是否可以解釋其皮膚毒性水平的變化；以及iv）研究改變皮膚微生物組群落結構（通過使用廣譜抗生素）對香港瘰螈的TTX水平的影響。 我們將在香港瘰螈自然棲息地採集樣本，以量化TTX水平並表徵微生物組。我們還將培養瘰螈皮膚上的細菌，並評估它們產生TTX的能力。此外，我們將進行一系列實驗，通過施用廣譜抗生素來操縱瘰螈的皮膚微生物組，以評估其對TTX水平的影響。 我們的研究代表了對微生物組在香港瘰螈中TTX產生和獲取中的作用的全面調查。通過這項研究，我們希望提升對TTX生態學的理解及發現其變化的因素。這些發現可能有助於解決長期爭論的蠑螈中TTX起源問題，建立一個用於測試兩棲動物皮膚微生物組功能作用假說的模型系統，並識別具有潛在醫療保健和生物技術應用的新型細菌。

13501124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13501124.value: 競爭者指涉條件定價合同

13501124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13501124.value: Conditional pricing practices have been a long-standing concern in antitrust. In many recent antitrust cases worldwide, a dominant upstream supplier in an intermediate-goods market is alleged to be using conditional pricing contracts with its downstream buyers to fully or partially foreclose its competitor(s). Most of the conditions involved in these conditional pricing contracts can be classified into two types. One type, which we call own-referencing, is those referencing only the transactions between the contracting supplier and buyer, e.g., traditional nonlinear pricing. The other type, which we call rival-referencing, is those referencing the potential transactions between the contracting buyer and her alternative suppliers, e.g., exclusive dealing, market-share-based discounts, price-matching guarantees. Compared with own-referencing contracts (i.e., contracts involving only own-referencing conditions), rival-referencing contracts (i.e., contracts involving both own-referencing and rival-referencing conditions) typically raise greater antitrust concerns. To better understand the incentives and antitrust implications of dominant suppliers adopting rival-referencing conditional pricing contracts, we propose studying a sequential price competition game with the following timing. First, a dominant firm offers a conditional pricing contract (in a feasible set to be specified below) to a downstream buyer; second, a competing minor firm makes its price offer; finally, the downstream buyer, provided she accepts the dominant firm's offer, chooses her purchases from both firms. We assume the dominant firm has a competitive advantage over the minor firm due to a superior product and/or lower production cost, while the products of the two firms are imperfect substitutes. We plan to examine four variants of the game, differing in the dominant firm's feasible set of conditional pricing contracts. One of the variants focuses on own-referencing contracts, i.e., the dominant firm may offer a pricing scheme specifying the buyer's payment contingent only on the buyer's purchases from the dominant firm. The other three variants consider rival-referencing contracts, i.e., the buyer's payment may also be contingent on the buyer's purchases from the minor firm and/or the minor firm's price offer. Our objectives are to solve for the dominant firm's optimal pricing scheme that arises in equilibrium under each variant, and to compare the profit and welfare implications across the four variants. This study contributes to the literature on nonlinear pricing with competition between asymmetric firms. By deepening our understanding of the motivations and consequences of different contract contingencies, our findings will benefit not only academia, but also antitrust practitioners and policy makers. 條件定價行為在反壟斷領域中一直以來備受關注。在近年世界各地的反壟斷案件中，就有許多是牽涉一個在中間產品市場中佔主導地位的上游供應商被指控與其下游買家簽訂條件定價合同，來完全或部分排擠其競爭對手。 這些條件定價合同中所使用的條件，通常可以分為兩類。一類是我們稱之為自我指涉的條件，即該條件僅指涉簽約雙方之間的交易，例如傳統的非綫性定價。另一類是我們稱之為競爭者指涉的條件，即該條件指涉簽約買家與其他供應商之間的潛在交易，例如排他條款、市場份額折扣、價格匹配保證。與自我指涉合同（即僅涉及自我指涉條件的合同）相比，競爭者指涉合同（即不僅涉及自我指涉條件而亦涉及競爭者指涉條件的合同）通常更易惹起反壟斷方面的關注。 為了更好地理解主導供應商採用競爭者指涉條件定價合同的動機及其反壟斷含意，我們建議研究如下的序貫價格競爭博弈模型。首先，主導公司向下游買家提出一個條件定價合同；然後，另一小公司提出其價格報價；最後，下游買家，如果她接受主導公司提出的合同，選擇分別從兩家公司購買的數量（如果她拒絕主導公司提出的合同，她不能從主導公司購買）。我們假設主導公司由於產品優勢或較低的生產成本而具有競爭優勢，而兩家公司的產品是非完全替代品。 我們計劃研究上述博弈模型的四個變體，這些變體的分別在於主導公司所能採用的條件定價合同的形式的不同。其中一個變體專注於自我指涉合同，即主導公司可以提供一個定價方案，其中買家的付款僅能取決於買家從主導公司購買的數量。其他三個變體考慮競爭者指涉合同，即買家的付款也可能取決於買家從小公司購買的數量或小公司的價格報價。 我們的目標是求解在每個變體中主導公司的最優定價方案，並比較這四個變體的利潤和福利影響。這項研究將為非綫性定價與不對稱競爭的文獻有所貢獻。通過加深我們對不同合同條件的動機和後果的理解，我們的研究成果將不僅有助於學術界，還將有利於反壟斷實務者和政策制定者。

13502124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13502124.value: 超越健康福祉：通勤改善如何重塑消費者行為與家庭生活

13502124.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13502124.value: Prof Agarwal, Sumit Prof He, Jia

13502124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13502124.value: Workers' daily commutes are progressively becoming more time-consuming. In 2019, the average one-way commute in the United States reached a record high of 27.6 minutes. Many global metropolises, such as Beijing, New York, Hong Kong, and Seoul, have long suffered from lengthy daily commutes, often exceeding 44 minutes. Consequently, enhancing public transit has become essential to foster the wellness and work performance of commuters. The proposed study will examine a critical but underexplored question: What are the compelling benefits of reduced commuting beyond improving commuters' wellness and productivity? Specifically, we will investigate the effects of reduced commute time, resulting from better access to subway stations close to work, on private consumption, a key driver of demand growth, and on the well-being of consumers and their families, such as by facilitating after-work shopping, broadening shopping options, promoting work–life balance, and enriching family activities. We will examine three mechanisms. First, we will test whether the labor income growth channel through which reduced commute time leads to improved work performance and higher bonuses reshapes consumption patterns. Second, we will examine whether enhanced work–life balance resulting from shorter commutes changes the allocation of time between work, leisure, and family activities, influencing spending on leisure goods and services. Finally, we will investigate whether improved commuting reduces the perceived distance of shopping centers, increasing after-work shopping and expanding the shopping radius. Leveraging the rapid and staggered expansion of China's subway system as a natural experiment, this study will address common challenges in identifying the causal effect of improved commuting on consumer behavior. Exploiting a novel transaction-level credit card dataset providing the addresses of more than 290,000 cardholders' residences, workplaces, and merchants, we will rule out alternative mechanisms such as the housing wealth effect and enhancement in supply. Using this high-frequency data and the advanced staggered difference-in-differences approach, the study will address selection issues. This study will contribute to a greater understanding of the multifaceted impacts of public transit and the resulting enhancement in commuting on consumption, individual well-being, and consumer responses to income gains. From a policy standpoint, it sheds light on the broader benefits of subway construction beyond subjective well-being, income, wellness, and improved productivity. Notably, stimulating private consumption and fostering household welfare gains are compelling arguments in favor of subway construction, providing new insights into the ongoing debate over whether such infrastructure investments are a valid policy object. 在2019年，美國民眾的平均單程通勤時間攀升至創紀錄的27.6分鐘，而全球範圍內如北京、紐約、香港、首爾等大都市的通勤者，更是普遍承受著單程超過44分鐘的漫長通勤挑戰。鑒於此，優化公共交通系統效率，不僅關乎通勤者的身心健康與職業表現提升，更成為亟待解決的重大議題。本研究，聚焦於一個關鍵卻鮮被深究的問題：縮短通勤時間，除了直接增益於通勤者的健康與生產效率外，還如何在更廣泛的層面上帶來顯著的正向效應？我們將探討因工作地點附近開通地鐵而帶來的通勤時間縮減，如何重塑消費者的行為模式，包括其支出習慣、購物偏好以及工作時間以外對家庭親子時間的重新分配。 本研究將分析通勤時間縮短對消費模式重構的三大核心機制：其一，縮短通勤時間提升工作效率，從而提高了員工的績效獎金。這一收入衝擊將帶來更高的消費支出；其二，通勤時間的縮短轉化為更多休閒時光，這些新增的閒暇時間極大地豐富了家庭消費活動的多樣性，如親子互動、家庭出遊等，進一步拉動了家庭消費支出；其三，工作地附近地鐵網路的便捷接入，心理上拉近了消費者與購物中心的距離，不僅提升了下班後購物的便利性，還拓寬了消費者的購物選擇範圍。 為了精准捕捉通勤改善對消費者行為的因果性影響，本研究利用了2012至2016年間中國地鐵系統迅速且廣泛擴張這一自然實驗背景，並依託一套詳盡的交易級信用卡資料集，該資料集覆蓋了超過29萬名持卡人的精確居住、工作及消費地點資訊，有效排除了住房財富變動、市場供應增加等潛在干擾因素，確保了研究結論的純粹性與可靠性。

13502424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13502424.value: 利用网红社交圈打造成功的活动营销

13502424.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13502424.value: Prof Kim, Jisu Prof Palmatier, Robert W.

13502424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13502424.value: The past decade has witnessed an exponential rise in influencer marketing, with its value projected to hit 21.1 billion U.S. dollars by the end of 2023. Marketers have come to recognize the value of partnering with influencers to expand customer base and build customer trust. However, like all industries, influencer marketing is evolving. As the partnership between firms and influencers continues to deepen, firms are no longer mere observers, but active collaborators in shaping customer reach and engagement. This gives rise to a modern influencer-event marketing strategy: leverage social media influencers to create an event aimed at expanding the reach and enhancing the engagement with customers. Despite the prevalence of influencer events in the industry—Paris Women’s Fashion Week, for instance, regularly features influencers like Zendaya, Rihanna, and Kim Kardashian to broadcast and capitalize the event online—there is still a lack of adequate knowledge on this exciting field. As soliciting numerous influencers (instead of just one or a few) enables firms to tap into a larger follower network, and enhance the event’s credibility through consistent endorsements from multiple influencers, we posit that influencer events are effective in improving customer spending. Yet a more critical question is: What specific strategies can an event employ to leverage influencers? This boils down to a comprehensive understanding of influencers’ social network, as events essentially present a unique networking and relationship-exchanging opportunity. Drawing on social network theory, we propose to delineate the multifaceted effects of social network, from its nodes (network degree), ties (relational and structural embeddedness), to structure (network density), on the effectiveness of influencer events. Here we employ a quasi-experimental difference-in-differences (DID) approach to provide a proof of concept, utilizing broadcast data of 1,000 random influencers from a major video streaming company in South Korea and a naturally-occurring online esports event. Our preliminary analyses demonstrate that influencer events boast great potential for achieving higher sales performance, such that firms can enhance events’ effectiveness by targeting influencers with a higher level of network degree, relational embeddedness, and network density. However, structural embeddedness exerts an inverted U-shaped effect on influencer-event effectiveness, highlighting a unique tension for marketers: When soliciting influencers on the basis of structural embeddedness, more is not always better. Eventually, the proposed research forges a robust foundation and provides multi-disciplinary implications for researchers and practitioners in fields including influencer, event, and social network marketing. 在過去的十年裏，網紅營銷經歷了爆發式增長，預計到2023年底，其價值將達到211億美元。營銷人員已經認識到，與網紅合作可以擴大客戶群體並建立客戶信任。然而，與所有行業一樣，網絡營銷也在不斷向前發展。隨著企業與網紅之間的合作不斷加深，企業不再只是旁觀者，而是積極與網紅協作，深度提升客戶覆蓋面和參與度。這催生了一種新興的網紅活動營銷策略：利用社交媒體網紅舉辦一個旨在提升客戶覆蓋面和參與度的活動。盡管網紅活動營銷在行業中很普遍——例如巴黎時裝周，定期邀請像Zendaya、Rihanna和Kim Kardashian這樣的知名網紅來對時裝周活動進行在線宣傳和變現——但學術界對這個有趣的領域仍然缺乏足夠的了解。由於邀請眾多（而不僅僅是一個或幾個）網紅可以使企業接觸到更大的粉絲網絡，且多位網紅的一致認可往往可以提高活動內容的可信度，我們認為網紅活動能有效促進客戶消費。然而，一個更關鍵的問題是：活動可以采用哪些具體策略來利用網紅的影響力？回答這個問題就需要對網紅的社交網絡有一個全面的了解，因為這些網紅活動本質上為網紅及其粉絲提供了一個獨特的社交與交流的平臺。基於社交網絡理論，我們提出要從網絡的節點（網絡度）、連線（關系嵌入和結構嵌入）到結構（網絡密度），來描繪社交網絡對網紅活動的多角度影響。我們采用準實驗的差異中的差異法（DID），透過韓國一家大型視頻直播公司的（一個自然發生的）在線電子競技活動中的1000個隨機網紅的直播數據，來量度這些影響。初步分析表明，網紅活動在實現更高銷售業績方面具有巨大潛力，企業可以通過邀請擁有較高網絡度、關系嵌入和網絡密度的網紅來提高活動的有效性。然而，結構嵌入對網紅活動的有效性具有倒U型影響，彰顯了營銷人員面臨的一種獨特的困境：在基於結構嵌入邀請網紅時，（結構嵌入）越緊密不一定越好。最終，我們的研究將為包括網紅、活動和社交網絡營銷領域在內的研究人員和從業者提供堅實的基礎和多學科的啟示。

13602124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13602124.value: 英治時期香港的犬隻生活

13602124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13602124.value: 本研究探討二十世紀香港狗隻的生命故事，以及它們的生活、塑造和管制如何反映香港作為一個充滿活力的社會。二十世紀出現了一系列與犬科動物相關的議題，涉及動物福利、法規、娛樂、公共衛生和城市發展等：例如防虐畜協會（RSPCA）成立、頻發的狂犬病恐慌導致社會對犬隻活動的限制、食狗肉問題備受爭議、德國牧羊犬開始在香港擔任警犬、流浪狗被槍擊以淨化街道。在這些發展過程中，狗隻被貼上了各種社會標籤，從滋擾、伴侶、健康威脅、服務犬、身份象徵，到拯救犬等廣泛範疇。這些標籤反映了香港不同區域的人類活動所產生的社會轉變。香港社會對狗隻看法和塑造的變遷，展現了香港應對動物福利、公共衛生和城市發展等新潮流的回應，以及這些趨勢對社會關係、跨種族公民社會、政策變革和空間轉型的影響，而這些歷史往往被以人為中心的視角所忽視。 本研究藉著研究複雜的人犬關係，偏離將動物置於英國統治框架中的既有認知，提供了一個更全面的理解，將香港的生活世界視為人與動物共同分享和影響的空間。狗隻與人類在家中或街頭密切共處，推動了官方、媒體和居民發展新的思想、文化規範、政策倡議和利益，挑戰和重新訂定人與動物的界限。當香港政府因應公共衛生危機和動物愛好者日益增長的壓力而制定了新政策時，二戰前後大眾對狗隻的認知便顯現著城市中有關種族、階級和公民身份的變遷。本研究藉著在香港多元文化群體中重現動物的痕跡，不但重塑了超越人類經驗的香港社會生活，更跨越了動物研究、社會史、城市研究和文化史，以建構了一幅更生動的畫面一描述狗隻作為公共生活的一部分，以及香港作為人與動物共同爭奪的空間。

13603724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13603724.value: 史學外編：美國影業雜誌的中國 (1908-1948)

13603724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13603724.value: This project aims to publish Chinese translations of entries on the Chinese film market and industry in three American trade journals during the Republican period, specifically, from 1908 to 1948. The three journals are Moving Picture World (1908–1927), Motion Picture News (1914–1930), and Film Daily (1918–1948). Unlike other similar journals, such as Photoplay (1916–1962) and Motion Picture Daily (1931–1958), these three magazines frequently covered China and many of the articles were written by diplomats stationed there. The periodization follows the publication dates of these journals, which coincides with the entire period of Republican China. These journals reported a wide range of topics, including the Chinese film market, industry and censorship, film production (fiction and non-fiction), foreign cooperation, and film activities in overseas Chinese communities. The trove of information compiled will expand the current scope of Chinese film historiography prior to the founding of the People’s Republic of China. Our plan is to make available the translation of these rare materials in Chinese for researchers on early Chinese film history. We have collected over 5,000 articles and reports (600,000 words) from the three trade journals, and with funding support, we will be able to compile, edit, and translate our current collection, as well as uncover more data. Compilation of these English-language materials will reorient our research methods on film distribution, exhibition, and reception in the early era. Moreover, by making these foreign source materials accessible to Chinese scholars in Chinese film, modern Chinese history, and China–US trade, we hope to sustain the project outcome in the longer term within academia and beyond. 本計畫旨在整理、翻譯並出版民國時期三份美國電影影業雜誌中有關中國電影市場和電影產業文章的中文譯文。這三份雜誌分別是《電影世界》（The Moving Picture World，1908-1927）、《電影新聞》（Motion Picture News，1913-1930）和《電影日報》（The Film Daily，1918-1948）。與其他同類期刊如《影戲》（Photoplay，1916-1962）和《每日電影》（Motion Picture Daily，1931-1958）不同的是，這三本雜誌經常報導中國電影，而且許多文章都是由駐華外交官撰寫的。這些雜誌的發刊期大致與整個民國時期相吻合。這些雜誌報導的主題廣泛，包括電影市場、產業和審查制度、電影製作（劇情片與紀錄片）、中外合作以及海外華人區的電影活動等。 本計畫擬定與中國早期電影史研究者分享這些豐富資料的中文翻譯，進一步擴展目前民國電影史論的範疇。目前我們已收集了约60萬字，涵蓋5000多篇文章和報告。在優配基金的資助下，我們除了計劃發掘更多資料之外，並會著手編輯和翻譯已收集的素材。這些英文資料有助於重新定位早期電影發行、放映和收視的研究方法。通過向中國電影、中國近現代史和中美貿易領域的中國學者提供這些外文資料，我們希望本計畫的成果在學術界內外都能產生長期的效應和影響。

13603924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13603924.value: 老齡化、管理與零散性：以質性縱向研究探討延長工作生活的勞動過程

13603924.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13603924.value: Prof CHAN, Chak Kwan Dr Chan, Chris, King-Chi Dr Foster, Liam

13603924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13603924.value: 延長工作生活，可理解成透過再就業或留任工作延遲退休，日益受到學術界及政策制定者的關注。在全球勞動力老齡化及養老金改革的壓力下，在什麼程度上延長工作生活可以解決相關問題，至今還是未知之數。香港政府近年在勞動市場及社會保障制度中，亦引入了不同的政策改變。就目前急速轉變的社會環境，究竟延長工作生活對於較弱勢老年工人，以及整體社會意味著什麼? 雖然相關的文獻近來時常出現在社會學、社會政策學及社會老年學中，但以年齡及工作為本的理論化發展仍然不足。許多量化研究聚焦於延長工作生活的社會決定因素，而質性研究則多強調延長工作生活對老年工人產生的意義及價值。因此，其中一個理論空隙，體現在延長工作生活是如何鑲嵌於年齡特定的勞動過程及僱傭關係中，特別是關於工作管理及就業零散性。而以研究方法而言，常見的橫向研究可能會導致較靜態的分析。由於權力關係及制度化對延長工作生活十分相關，檢視企業如何管理低收入及低技術工人的工作，以及晚年工作生活在不同方面受到社會結構塑造，對於認識延長工作生活至關重要。 是項研究將勞動過程理論連繫至延長工作生活，並提出一個年齡特定的框架以理解在就業與退休轉變中，持續發生的職場動力。以香港作為案例，這研究將使用質性縱向方法探討：(1)老齡化與生命歷程如何影響年長工人在延長工作生活及勞動過程的權力；(2)老年工人為何及怎樣被制度及觀念導向至工作；(3)年齡相關的管理策略、機構文化、職場理性在什麼情況下鑲嵌於僱傭關係中；(4)低收入工人如何在香港的剩餘福利體制及自由主義勞動市場中，實踐延長工作生活；(5)長者工人在延長工作生活中經驗到什麼面向的零散性。研究將會長開兩輪的深入訪談，追蹤64位來自清潔及保安業的65歲或以上受訪者，如何準備及實踐延長工作生活。 透過發展延長工作生活的勞動過程理論，這研究計劃可對工作社會學及社會政策學作出理論及實證的貢獻。而研究的資料及分析，亦可響應國際勞工組織及世界衛生組織，關於尊嚴工作及健康老齡化的政策議程，啟發本地及國際關於長者就業、老年福利及勞工保障的政策制定。

13604124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13604124.value: 清代文學的海洋異托邦

13604124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13604124.value: 本研究項目將延續我的第一本專著《書寫海盜：晚明中國白話小說與海洋》（密歇根大學出版社2021年出版）的思路從海洋的視角探討三類清代文學作品。1）在越南海邊城市河仙居住的華人越南領袖撰寫的華語詩歌；2）兩部中國文人創作的在中國南海海域沈船以及海洋探險的長篇小說；3）兩部關於南中國海、海港城市廣州、以及海盜的小說。 近年來最令學界激動的學術潮流是 “藍色人文”文學批評全球性的崛起。海洋在人類文明和社會裡的重要性不言而喻，而對海洋認知的覺醒卻姍姍來遲。可惜的是，現階段的對於古代中國海洋文學的學術批評尚處於以中國為中心的階段。我們急切需要一個更加微妙的有彈性的分析批評模式，以此來了解海洋在中國歷史和文學作品裡的複雜性和多樣性。為了彌補明清文學作品裡的海洋視角的空白，本研究項目會聚焦在中國南海區域集中探討上述三類清代文學作品裡的“海洋異托邦”—差異地帶；媒介地帶；以及實效地帶。本研究項目指出清代文學裡的“海洋異托邦“相較於明代海洋文學而言，具有主觀化和個人化的特點。海洋認知已經與清代文人的知識結構的擴展融為一體。本研究項目會為加深了解清代文學與海洋的關係提供一個全新的、犀利的、重要的研究視角。

13604324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13604324.value: 逝去風景——測繪香港視覺藝術古蹟

13604324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13604324.value: Using archival sources and visual evidence, this project proposes to reconstruct how historic places and communities associated with the visual arts tell a story about Hong Kong through cultural and historical memories. This project begins with the present and works back to the late nineteenth century to explore a heritage discourse for historic sites closely tied to traditional Chinese art and culture in Hong Kong to better understand their socially constructed heritage value. This project focuses on artistic venues in the first half of twentieth-century Hong Kong. It raises questions about the sustainable preservation and development of arts-related historic sites. How can we remember lost places? How should we build a knowledge base to address the artifacts and values associated with historic places and their corresponding communities? Historic buildings are generally described as immovable cultural property with physically remarkable visual and tangible value, such as Hong Kong City Hall and archaeological remains at the Sacred Hill. Yet scholars have not given many Hong Kong historic places the attention they deserve. Aside from Sung Wong Toi on Sacred Hill, many other vanished Hong Kong landmarks, such as Lee Garden Hills in Causeway Bay, underwent social and cultural transformations in the twentieth century but were destroyed by socioeconomic development. Exploration of these issues will shape our knowledge and understanding of overlooked local heritage, identity, community, and sustainable development. As a multidisciplinary study, this project builds on a wide body of scholarship on Hong Kong art and history, encompassing public history, heritage preservation, and sustainability. Sung Wong Toi, Lee Garden Hills, and other vanished cultural landmarks are used as case studies to illuminate neglected and understudied environments used for artistic gatherings and exhibitions. This research also shows female agency in the arts and exhibition development. This project investigates the role of arts, people, events, associations, and stories that are both inherent and situational in the cultural landscapes and communities in Hong Kong. It is expected that the research output of this project will stimulate current art and curatorial practices and contribute to a revisionist account of the concurrent grand narratives of Hong Kong art history. The destruction of historic places and the aging of those who remember this period make it crucial to record their hidden stories and recollections. Documentation would help promote awareness and appreciation for historic places that are underrepresented in conventional narratives but exist, are being demolished, or have disappeared.

13604624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13604624.value: 香港南亞及東南亞少數族裔年青一代的「少眾」身份位處，集體意識及歸屬感

13604624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13604624.value: This project examines the politics of ‘minority’ identity formation among younger generations of South and South East Asian ethnic minorities in Hong Kong, through their tactical creative collective engagement (both online and offline), and implications on (multi-ethnic) collectivity and belonging in Hong Kong. South/ South East Asian communities have been persistently subjected to variegated forms and layers of discrimination, stemming from structural inequalities in education, employment opportunities, working conditions. In recent years, we witnessed an increase in collectives (both online and offline) formed by these younger generation persons, having been born and/ or educated in Hong Kong, to realize diverse purposes and goals. Having developed considerable social and cultural resources as a ‘hyphenated local’, they opt to steer away from the conventional means that their previous generations adopted, to service fellow compatriots, express themselves through various creative texts, and to struggle for their rightful place in the mainstream society. As such, they also engage in co-constitutive relationship with local Chinese NGOs, including capitalizing on recent public discourses on, and resources amassed under directives such as ‘social innovation’, while demand to be recognized as a new generation of ‘ethnically diverse youths’. Do these emerging and collective practices signal a new form of minority participation as ‘united while diverse’ force? What are the conditions for such developments? How would that inform newer models of intra- and inter-ethnic collaboration and negotiations with the mainstream society? With a continued aim to explore ‘minority subjectivity', the PI will employ intersectional and interdisciplinary approaches to delve into and articulate the complex interplay between (social) media use, racial minority identity-positioning, multi-ethnic collectivity, and belonging in the context of Hong Kong. This project is also seen as a timely one, as it would capture the width and extent of racial minority engagement in the here and the now. Apart from its scholarship, this project hopes to inspire further research and more importantly policy, advocacy, and educational interventions that could more accurately pitch the needs but also ‘talents’ of these emerging ethnic minority initiatives. As importantly, through working with these groups, the research could shed light on more effective models of ethnic minority empowerment and multi-ethnic co-constitutive relationship in the continued quest for social and racial inclusion in Hong Kong. 本研究旨在探討香港跨族裔集體性和歸屬感，透過新一代居港南亚及东南亚少数族裔 (線上及線下)的創新集體參與，思考他們政治身份認同的形成。不平等的社會狀況令少數族裔人仕飽受歧視，近年，越來越多香港出生或受教育的少數族裔年青人組成不同團體，用創新方式服務族群，爭取平等權利。因此，他們和本地華人的非牟利機構合作，受認可為新「跨族裔年青人」。這些新興的集體實踐是否預示少數族裔人仕「多元合作」的新參與方式呢？這是如何形成的呢？它將如何為族裔群體內、不同族裔群體之間，以及和主流社會構建合作和談判提供新的模式？ 調查以「少數族裔」為目標，運用交叉及跨學科方法，探討使用社群媒體、少數族裔群體身分定位、多民族集體性與歸屬感之間的互動。本調查不僅是學術研究，還希望適時捕捉當下少數種族群體的參與情況，推動政策、倡導和教育幹預，通過與新「跨族裔年青人」合作，更準確地滿足他們的需求，並發揮他們的才能，同時，本研究也將揭示更有效的少數族裔群體賦權，促進香港社會和種族的包容。

13605524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13605524.value: 當數字化遇上金融化：中國地方政府在平臺就业者社會政策改革中的不同策略

13605524.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13605524.value: Prof LIN, Ka Prof MA, Yin Prof NGOK, Kinglun

13605524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13605524.value: 近年來，數字平臺經濟在全球範圍迅速崛起，却也産生大量缺乏社會保護的平臺就業工人，面臨「不平等-增長」的挑戰。儘管「爲平臺就業者提供充足和可持續的社會保護」（ILO, ISSA, & OECD, 2023）已成爲一項緊迫政策議題，但對各國政府來說仍是一個難題。除了現有法律框架的限制，追求經濟增長的內在激勵、全球化-福利國家關係下的「逐底競爭」、財政考量以及福利國家日益金融化的趨勢等因素都會影響平臺工人的社會政策改革。然而，鮮有實證研究探討這個重要問題，特別是在分權制的發展中國家。本研究將調查中國地方政府在平臺工人社會政策改革中所采取的不同策略。本研究構建了一個綜合性框架，納入財政條件、發展型地方政府、平臺工人的勞動抗爭以及制度性嵌入等因素，旨在尋求對中國各地改革差异化現象進行全面解釋。本研究采用創新的比較方法來探討社會經濟因素對政策選擇的影響。此外，本研究還將通過深度訪談和焦點小組討論與各種政策參與者和利益相關者進行交流，旨在更深入細緻地瞭解他們的關切點，幷評估和比較不同策略下的政策效果。研究完成後，將會深化對數字平臺工人社會政策改革和福利國家金融化的理論闡釋，也對中國及其他發展中國家在勞動數字化轉型時代進行福利改革具有重要的政策意涵。

13606024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13606024.value: 工人媒體/文化向何處去？農民工、平台化的文化生產與中國工人階級的形成

13606024.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13606024.value: Prof Chen, Anfan Prof Florence, Eric Prof PUN, Ngai

13606024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13606024.value: 本研究探討媒體/文化生產的快速平台化對建構進步的中國工人文化帶來的機遇和挑戰。後2008中國經濟升級的過程中，技術 – 和由此帶來的產業轉移、平台化還是自動化 - 為產業升級和持續的經濟增長提供了動力，但也強化了工人的經濟和社會脆弱性；制度改革上，勞動規製的改革和勞工運動停滯，進一步削弱了工人的制度力量；文化和意識形態上，主流的民族主義情緒遮蔽工人的階級利益和主體性的表達。换言之，工人在經濟、社會、制度和文化層面上面臨新一輪的系統性削弱。因此，討論如何建構進步的中國工人文化顯得尤為迫切，是保留工人阶级集体力量、争取更多有利于工人的社会变化的为数不多的可行路径之一。 本研究突出了平台化的因素，因為它是重塑中國文化生產的一個關鍵的新趨勢。研究文化生產的平台化是如何發展以及會產生什麼影響，對建構工人文化的志業而言十分緊迫。此外，平台化 – 尤其是其用戶中心的技術特性 - 還為文化生產提供了豐富多樣的話語、情感和連接的可能性。到目前為止，這已經在普通工人中產生了大量的媒介自我呈現和通過媒介參與社會事務的各種實踐，這為挑戰主流社會關係和意識形態、思考有助於推動社會公平的替代性方案提供了豐富的資源和潛力。 強調平台化帶來的機遇和潛力，並不意味著我們盲目樂觀。相反，我們認為，平台化本身是一個充滿權力鬥爭和協商的過程，對建構進步的工人文化而言，機遇和挑戰並存。因此，我們採用一種關係性和情景化的路徑，把建構進步的工人文化的實踐，與在這個過程中以各種各樣的身份參與到這一過程中的利益相關方 （如政府、平台公司、受眾、MCN機構等等）都考慮進來，考察他們如何互動、協商。本研究提出以下問題：1）知識分子、關心工人問題的行動者和普通工人如何利用數字平台建構進步的工人文化？2）這些實踐、策略和效果是如何被不斷變化的平台制度所中介的？3）他們如何應對這種動態？ 4）這在多大程度上有助於建立進步的工人文化？ 本研究採用混合方法設計。主要的數據收集方法包括1）線下和數字民族誌、2）深度訪談、和3）焦點小組訪談。我們也採用社會網絡分析的定量方法作為補充，來繪製工人依託數字平台建立的各種社群的複雜關係圖譜。我們一共計劃研究20個項目和社群。在項目後期，我們將舉行一次關於中國工人文化的“平台與社會創新“研討會，潛在的合作夥伴為騰訊的“科技向善”計劃，以向社會展示研究成果，聆聽從業者和專家的意見，從而產生更廣泛的社會影響。

13607224.label: Project Objectives
13607224.value: To give a clear recapitulation of the different accounts of luck in the literature, for example, control, modal, and probability-based theories. To show that extant accounts of luck are deeply flawed. To develop my own skill-based account of luck based on my criticisms of existing theories. To apply my account of luck to resolve puzzles in epistemology and ethics, for example, what is the relationship between luck and moral responsibility and does luck in belief preclude knowledge? To gain a better understanding of the importance of luck in our everyday lives both in terms of fortune and misfortune and blame and praise.

13607224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13607224.value: Luck is one of our most important concepts. This is, in part, because of the predominant role that the concept plays in otherwise disparate philosophical debates as well as in our everyday lives. Questions about luck are irrevocably tied to cross-disciplinary issues concerning skill, what people deserve, risk, and value that we all care about. But what is luck? Until recently, philosophers have had little to say on this pivotal question. What I am asking for in this grant is teaching relief for two classes over the next 24 months so that I can write a book on the nature of luck. This book will be split into three parts. In part 1, I will critique extant accounts of luck, for example, control, modal, and probability-based theories. In part 2, I will develop my own skill-based account of luck. In part 3, I will use my account of luck to resolve puzzles in epistemology and knowledge, for example, what is the relationship between luck and moral responsibility and does luck in belief preclude knowledge? 运气是我们最重要的概念之一。这在一定程度上是因为占主导地位的 这个概念在不同的哲学辩论以及我们的研究中所扮演的角色 日常生活。关于运气的问题不可避免地与跨学科问题联系在一起 关于我们都关心的技能、人们应得的、风险和价值。但什么是 运气？直到最近，哲学家们对这个关键问题还没有发表什么言论。 我在这笔补助金中要求的是在接下来的 24 年里减轻两个班级的教学负担 几个月，这样我就可以写一本关于运气本质的书。本书将分为 三个部分。在第 1 部分中，我将批评现有的运气解释，例如控制、模态、 和基于概率的理论。在第 2 部分中，我将开发自己的基于技能的帐户 运气。在第三部分中，我将利用我对运气的描述来解决认识论和 知识，比如运气和道德责任之间的关系是什么 信仰的运气会妨碍知识吗？

13607324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13607324.value: 中國的2019新冠疫情，集結效應與反封控抗議

13607324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13607324.value: China’s epic endeavor to dynamically eradicate the Covid-19 virus in the country raises three important questions. How did the zero-Covid policy affect political trust in the country? What factors contributed to the outbreak of small but impactful anti-lockdown protests? Did the demands of anti-lockdown protesters signify a rights consciousness, or were they only indicative of a rules consciousness? The project aims to answer the three questions. First, the research will explain the fluctuation of political trust in the country during the pandemic, drawing on a multi-wave survey, an event history in domestic and global contexts, and a textual database on political communications. Substantively, it will investigate how people’s perception of the threat posed by the pandemic and the necessity and feasibility of the zero-Covid policy evolved and adjust their assessment of the central leadership’s trustworthiness accordingly. Conceptually, the project aims to contribute to a better understanding of the occurrence and duration of the rally-around-the-flag effect. The project’s theoretical goal is to correct a liberal bias inherent in the concept of political trust by showing how a government can extort trust from people by using the pandemic as a pretext for subjecting them to dependence and censorship. Second, the study will investigate how fluctuating political trust affected people’s behavioral propensities throughout the pandemic. In particular, it will analyze the consequence of the disappearance of the rally effect. By definition, the rally effect does not last long. Consequently, its disappearance does not have much impact on the policy process and people’s political behavior. However, the disappearance of the rally effect in late 2022 seems to have contributed to the outbreak of anti-lockdown protests. The project will test this hypothesis. Lastly, the project will explore the political ramifications of the demands of anti-lockdown protesters in Beijing, Shanghai, Nanjing, Wuhan, and Guangzhou. Specifically, it will analyze whether these protesters questioned the constitutionality of the zero-Covid policy when challenging local authorities to provide a legal basis for lockdown measures that limit individual freedoms. Through this analysis, we aim to nudge the ongoing discussion about whether Chinese people have a rights consciousness or are driven primarily by a rules consciousness. The project will run from January 1, 2025, through December 31, 2027. It aims to produce research articles in peer-reviewed academic journals and a university press book.

13608124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13608124.value: The project handles a key aspect of the “nobody knows” puzzle in economic sociology. This puzzle is perhaps best illustrated by: how can we value, evaluate, and buy now an expensive house while expecting that a year from now it is either going to collapse in a sinkhole or increase its value tenfold, without being able to calculate the probabilities of these mutually exclusive outcomes? To put it differently, how can we value and evaluate under uncertainty future uncertain states and attributes? While the problem might seem outlandish, it is what venture capital (VC) does when evaluating and deciding to invest in tech startups. The project addresses this puzzle by an ethnographic investigation of venture capital (e)valuation practices within blockchain and AI. The case at hand is provided by Hong Kong-, Shenzhen- and Singapore-based VC and startups. Hong Kong is a global hub of both venture capital (probably one of the most important after Silicon Valley) and blockchain and AI startups. Shenzhen and Singapore are competitors/ collaborators. The project investigates three research subquestions (each with corollaries): (1) how do VC firms and startups legitimate expectations of extreme asymmetric outcomes (extreme because either total loss or large value increases, and asymmetric because many more losses than value increases are expected)? (2) How do they build and exercise the expertise to value under such expectations? (3) How do they process ignorance (“nobody knows”) and uncertainties into future projections of value? These subquestions are investigated on three interrelated levels: those of technological, financial, and regulatory uncertainties and expectations, respectively. In examining these three subquestions, the project's objectives are: (A) to contribute in a significant fashion to solving the “nobody knows” puzzle in economic sociology; (B) to contribute to the sociology of technology by illuminating the interactional mechanisms through which uncertain technological innovation receives or is denied (accepts or denies) private capital streams, potentially contributing to its viability or failure, respectively; (C) to contribute to the sociology of valuations and evaluation by examining VC valuations as a boundary case for existing explanatory models. The research strategy I adopt is that of ethnographic interviews within VC firms and startups, supplemented with ethnographic observations in informal settings and, as far as possible, in internal formal meetings as well. This research strategy is justified by the focus on valuation practices that cannot be reconstructed from documents or questionnaires. 本項目處理經濟社會學中「無人知」難題的一個關鍵方面。以下的例子或許最能說明這個難題：當我們預期一年之後，一棟昂貴的房子不是倒塌在天坑裡，就是升值十倍，但卻無法計算出這些互斥結果的概率時，我們該如何評價、評估並買下這棟房子？換句話說，在不確定的情況下，我們該如何評估未來的不確定狀態和屬性？儘管這個問題看起來很離譜，但卻是風險投資 (VC) 在評估和決定投資科技新創公司時所面對的問題。本專案透過對區塊鏈和人工智能領域內風險資本（e）評估實踐的人類學調查來解決這一難題。香港、深圳和新加坡的風險投資公司和初創企業提供了當前的案例。香港是風險投資（可能是繼硅谷之後最重要的風險投資中心之一）以及區塊鏈和人工智能創業公司的全球樞紐。深圳和新加坡則是競爭對手/合作夥伴。本項目探討三個研究子問題（每個問題都有推論）： (1) 風投公司和初創企業如何將極端不對稱結果的預期合法化（極端是指完全損失或價值大幅增加，不對稱是指預期損失多於價值增加）？(2) 他們如何建立並運用專業知識，在這樣的預期下進行估值？(3) 他們如何將無知（「沒有人知道」）和不確定性轉化為未來的價值預測？我們將從三個相互關聯的層面來探討這些子問題：分別是技術、財務和法規的不確定性與預期。在研究這三個子問題時，本研究專案的目標為 (A)為解決經濟社會學中「無人知道」的困惑做出重大貢獻；(B)透過闡明不確定的技術創新接受或被拒絕（接受或拒絕）私人資金流的互動機制，分別對其可行性或失敗做出潛在貢獻，從而對技術社會學做出貢獻；(C)將風險投資公司的估值作為現有解釋模型的邊界案例進行研究，從而對估值和評估社會學做出貢獻。我採用的研究策略是在創投公司和新創公司內部進行人種學訪談，並輔以非正式場合的人種學觀察，以及盡可能在內部正式會議中進行觀察。這種研究策略的理由是，我將重點放在無法從文件或問卷中重建的評估實務上。

13609024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13609024.value: This proposed book-length study will provide the first global and comprehensive history of the Peking Rape case, in which Shen Chong, a nineteen-year-old student from Peking University, was raped by an intoxicated American Marine in 1946. Although the initial trial by the court-martial in China found the Marine guilty, the verdict was overturned by military authorities in Washington. The case led to the largest anti-American movement in China thus far and remains a watershed in Sino–U.S. history. Existing studies have investigated student protests, diplomatic exchanges, and political struggles and emphasized the incident’s impact in accelerating the final defeat of the Nationalist Party in the civil war. This study, in contrast, centers around the injured Chinese woman, a figure who has suffered a particular type of historical erasure and political distortion. Rather than merely expose the familiar American imperialism and Chinese propaganda, I set out to reexamine the infamous Peking Rape case by asking a different question: What were the particular mechanisms through which injustice towards a Chinese woman was perpetuated in Sino–U.S. politics? In other words, how did the system of justice fail on both fronts, the expanding U.S. empire and the renewed Chinese nation, after the victory in World War II? In particular, this study focuses on the Chinese woman’s body in three types of actual and representational space: the microlevel of the American military courtroom in Peking, the transpacific arena of media and politics, and the global ideologies of race, gender, and justice that underpinned the construction of the American military empire and Chinese nationalism. Delving into the archives in both countries and languages, this project will show how the Chinese woman was first victimized by the U.S. military’s hypersexualized and racist culture and then further injured by China’s patriarchal party politics. Moreover, I hope it will shed light on the intricate and pivotal links between sex, race, and Sino–U.S. relations at a turning point in history and foreground the centrality of Chinese women’s bodies within larger ideological and national struggles, especially during war and occupation. 1946年12月24日，年僅19歲的北京大學女生沈崇被美國海軍陸戰隊士兵強姦，隨即在各大城市的學生和左翼知識分子中，引發了一場聲勢浩大的抗議美軍暴行運動。本研究依據美軍和國民政府檔案，將焦點從傳統政治史與外交史轉移至女性身體，試圖以一“小女子”的經驗來解碼“大歷史”。沈崇案，是法律問題，也是政治問題，更是一個關乎女性的問題，它集中體現了中美社會對於性、種族和階級的態度與偏見。發生在歷史轉折點的北平強姦案，既反映了中國內戰和全球冷戰背景下的國共鬥爭，又凸顯了女性在現代醫學、法律、道德和軍事系統內被壓迫與漠視的不公。

13609524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13609524.value: 重新評估和解釋香港的認同變化：機器學習分類和實驗設計

13609524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13609524.value: Identity politics is a major topic in Hong Kong studies. The existing literature has provided valuable insights into the evolving national-subnational identities in Hong Kong since the handover of sovereignty in 1997. However, the measurement and statistical methods in previous literature cannot estimate the prevalence of different combinations of national-subnational identities within the population. Moreover, given the political change in recent years, conventional survey research on identity politics may be susceptible to social desirability bias. Finally, the identity-policy preference link has received limited attention in the literature. This project builds on and contributes to the literature through four interrelated studies. First, Study 1 reassesses the identity shift since 1997 by a semi-supervised machine learning analysis, which accurately estimates the proportions of various national-subnational identity combinations and the shift of such patterns. Second, Study 2 aims to explain the rise of predominant Hong Kong identity by investigating the impact of collective fear of the future through a survey experiment. Third, Study 3 adopts a conjoint experiment to measure the multidimensional identities, addressing social desirability bias and enhancing measurement accuracy. Lastly, Study 4, utilizing the data generated in Study 3, examines whether these identities are associated with distinctive policy preferences. This study contributes to the academic literature in several ways. Firstly, as identity is a social construct marked by fluidity, multiplicity, and contingency, measuring identity is a challenging task worldwide. The methods employed in this project, such as semi-supervised machine learning on multiple identity indicators and the conjoint experiment in estimating individual-level identities, have the potential to be applied beyond the context of Hong Kong to examine the multidimensional identities in other regions and countries. Therefore, this study contributes to the literature on measuring identities. Secondly, in the context of Hong Kong, by accounting for the multiplicity of identities, this study presents a new picture of the identity shift in Hong Kong, particularly by fully considering mixed identities patterns. Thirdly, this study offers a novel explanation of the identity shift by examining the influence of collective fear of the future through a survey experiment. This study will provide policymakers and the general public with novel insights regarding the identity shift in Hong Kong. The evidence generated by this project can inform policymakers in designing important public policies, which help to mitigate conflicts among groups having different identities.
