14205824.value: 算法合謀和競爭：基於多智能體強化學習的研究

14205824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14205824.value: AI-powered algorithms have been extensively adopted in online marketplaces to price goods and services, yielding significant efficiency gains. However, both regulatory bodies and academia express deep concerns about the potential of these algorithms to learn and engage in collusive practices to charge supracompetitive prices at the expense of customers. Mounting evidence, experimental and empirical, demonstrates that sophisticated algorithms possess the ability to uncover profit-enhancing strategies that coordinate on prices significantly higher than those observed under market conditions of full competition. Moreover, they exhibit a tendency to impose punishments on any defectors from the collusive price, which is consistent with the definition of collusive behaviors accepted by many economists. Notably, pricing algorithms neither receive explicit instructions to collude nor engage in direct communication with each other when they learn these "coordination-punishment" pricing strategies. Instead, they achieve this outcome through self-guided exploration with minimal human intervention. This tacit collusion poses a remarkable challenge to current regulatory frameworks, as it raises questions about how to effectively detect, monitor, and mitigate the associated risks. The existing academic studies predominately employ Q-learning based simulation to investigate algorithmic collusion. Nevertheless, Q-learning, being a popular algorithm for single-agent reinforcement learning, does not inherently account for the influence of other agents, a crucial factor in the formation of algorithmic collusion. This limitation gives rise to non-convergence problems in these approaches, casting doubts about the robustness of insights derived from existing studies. In addition, varying levels of technological adoption render market participants with diverse information structures and learning speeds. Empirical studies show that such heterogeneity crucially impacts market competition. Technical gaps still remain for traditional Q-learning approaches to capture this feature. The objective of this research is to develop a novel framework based on a two-timescale evolutionary game to address the aforementioned challenges. The new framework explicitly incorporates the inter-agent interaction among pricing algorithms. Through pilot investigations, the PI has observed promising convergence guarantees by leveraging the stochastic approximation theory in analysis. This demonstrates the potential of the proposed approach to significantly advance the study of general-sum multi-agent reinforcement learning. Furthermore, the new framework offers sufficient flexibility to model the heterogeneity among agents, allowing the PI to closely calibrate it to real-world market data. As a result, the project is expected to yield a simulation platform for assessing intervention policies, which will offer a scientific basis for policy and regulation developments in the age of AI. 基於 AI 演算法的定價策略已在線上市場廣泛應用，市場效率因此取得了顯著的提升。 然而，監管機構和學界都對這些演算法可能學會並參與合謀行為，以消費者的利益為代價收取超競爭價格表示了深切的擔憂。 大量的實驗和經驗證據表明，複雜的演算法能夠發現提高利潤的策略，並達成遠高於完全競爭市場水準的價格協調行為。 此外，它們還表現出懲罰任何背離串謀價格的行為者的傾向，這與許多經濟學家公認的合謀行為定義是一致的。值得注意的是，這些定價演算法在學習到“協調-懲罰”的定價策略時，既沒有收到明確的指令要進行合謀，也沒有與其他演算法進行直接溝通。 相反，它們是通過自主探索，在最小人工干預的情況下實現了這一結果。 這種隱性合謀給當前的監管框架帶來了巨大挑戰，引發了如何有效檢測、監控並緩解相關風險的問題。 目前學界主要採用基於Q學習的仿真方法來研究演算法串謀行為。 然而，Q學習作為單智能體 強化學習的一種流行演算法，卻無法內在地考慮形成演算法合謀的關鍵因素---其他智能體的影響。這種局限性導致了這些方法存在無法收斂的問題，從而也引發了對現有研究洞見穩健性的質疑。 此外，技術採用水平的差異也造成了市場參與者資訊結構和學習速度的多樣性。 實證研究表明，這種異質性也對市場競爭產生了關鍵影響。 傳統的Q學習方法在捕捉市場參與者異質性這一 特徵方面仍存在技術缺口。 本研究的目標是基於兩個時間尺度的進化博弈開發一個新的理論框架來解決上述挑戰。 這個新框架明確地納入了定價演算法之間的互動。 通過初步研究，研究人員觀察到利用隨機近似理論進行分析可以獲得收斂保證。 這表明所提出的方法有潛力大幅推進一般和非零和多智慧體強化學習的研究。 此外，這個新框架具有足夠的靈活性來建模智慧體之間的異質性，使研究人員能夠緊密校準到現實市場數據。 因此，該項目預計將產生一個用於評估干預政策的類比平臺，為人工智慧時代的政策和監管發展提供科學依據。

14206124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14206124.value: 高性能片上鈣鈦礦集成激光器的開發

14206124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14206124.value: This proposal aims to develop high-performance perovskite integrated lasers on a chip, which pave the way for the development of a perovskite-based integrated photonic platform. Since the discovery of perovskites by Russian scientists in 1839, perovskites have proven to be unprecedentedly successful in many areas in the past decade as a game changer in optoelectronic areas, such as solar cells, light-emitting diodes, transistors, and photodetectors. Perovskites are direct-bandgap semiconductors, with high absorption coefficient and high photoluminescence quantum yield, flexible tunability in the visible range, low synthesis cost, and high output with solution processing methods. They can be integrated with different types of CMOS-compatible substrates. Actually, perovskites are an excellent type of optical functional material for integrated photonics, which can be used for both passive and active devices. However, the exploration of perovskites on an integrated photonic platform is still at the primitive stage. The performance of on-chip perovskite integrated lasers is still limited, especially in the aspects of material and device stability, laser linewidth, and laser threshold. New material synthesis methods and device nanofabrication techniques should be developed to overcome these challenges and achieve enhanced performance. In this project, we will develop new material synthesis methods and device nanofabrication techniques for achieving high-performance perovskite integrated lasers on a chip. We will investigate solution-phase synthesis of Dion–Jacobson phase perovskite thin films on a chip, then develop and optimize the nanofabrication processes for realizing perovskite integrated lasers, with high stability, narrow linewidth, low threshold, and various functionalities. This proposal has far-reaching significance to both fundamental research and practical applications. On the fundamental aspect, the development of a new synthesis method to obtain stable perovskite thin films with better crystalline quality and higher photoluminescence efficiency will bring the material research of thin-film perovskites to the next level. The developed high-performance perovskite lasers can be used as a testbed for exploring novel mechanisms of light confinement and manipulation on a chip, such as bound states in the continuum and topological photonics. On the practical aspect, the developed high-performance perovskite integrated lasers can be used as an efficient on-chip light source, enabling all the functionalities of light generation, transmission, processing, and detection in photonic integrated circuits. 本提案旨在開發芯片上的高性能鈣鈦礦集成激光器，為開發基於鈣鈦礦的集成光子平台鋪平道路。 自俄羅斯科學家於 1839 年發現鈣鈦礦以來，在過去十年中，鈣鈦礦在許多領域都取得了前所未有的成功，為太陽能電池、發光二極管、晶體管和光電探測器等光電領域帶來變革。鈣鈦礦是直接帶隙半導體，具有高吸收係數和高光致發光量子產率，在可見光範圍內靈活可調，合成成本低，用溶液處理法可獲得高產出。它們可集成在不同類型的 CMOS 兼容的襯底上。實際上，鈣鈦礦是一種優秀的光學功能材料用於集成光子學，既可用於無源器件，也可用於有源器件。然而，在集成光子平台上對鈣鈦礦的探索仍處於初級階段。片上鈣鈦礦集成激光器的性能仍然有限，尤其是在材料和器件穩定性、激光線寬和激光閾值等方面。人們應開發新的材料合成方法和器件納米制造技術，以克服這些挑戰並實現更高的性能。 在本項目中，我們將開發新的材料合成方法和器件納米制造技術，以實現高性能的芯片上的鈣鈦礦集成激光器。我們將研究在芯片上液相合成 Dion-Jacobson 相鈣鈦礦薄膜，然後開發和優化納米制造工藝，以實現具有高穩定性、窄線寬、低閾值和多種功能的鈣鈦礦集成激光器。 本提案對基礎研究和實際應用都具有深遠意義。在基礎研究方面，開發一種新的合成方法來獲得結晶質量更好、光致發光效率更高的穩定的鈣鈦礦薄膜會將薄膜鈣鈦礦的材料研究推向更高一層。所開發的高性能鈣鈦礦激光器可用作探索芯片上光約束和操縱的新機制（如連續域束縛態和拓撲光子學）的試驗平台。在實用方面，所開發的高性能鈣鈦礦集成激光器可用作高效的片上光源，實現光子集成迴路中光的產生、傳輸、處理和檢測等所有功能。

14206324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14206324.value: 隱私驅動的憲法人工智能：基於人工智能反饋的對比强化遺忘學習和進化

14206324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14206324.value: The recent breakthrough of large language models (LLMs) has had a significant impact across a wide range of fields, transforming how we communicate, create content, and solve problems. Current research efforts in LLMs primarily focus on training LLMs to embody the qualities of being helpful, honest, and harmless. However, a significant oversight exists in these efforts, as they overlook the potential for LLMs to generate sensitive content from internet-sourced data that includes contributions from individuals. Meanwhile, the "right to be forgotten" has been legislated in many countries, such as the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) in the European Union and PIPEDA privacy legislation in Canada. This right mandates companies to erase personal data as users require. Removing data from back-end databases is straightforward, but it's challenging for machine learning models like LLMs to do so because their parameters encode personal information and its derivatives permanently. One intuitive unlearning method is to retrain the model with datasets excluding the "to-be-forgotten" data. However, such a retraining method is expensive and inefficient as the training of large models can take weeks or even months; and it is impractical to keep retraining as data removal requests are frequent in practice. In light of the above identified necessities and challenges surrounding unlearning in the context of large language models, we develop a method we refer to as Privacy-Infused Constitutional AI and use it to train a privacy-respecting and relatively harmless AI assistant without any human feedback labels. Specifically, we integrate constitutional principles/instructions into the training of large language models, where unlearning related principles are first adopted to guide the models to unlearn specific data. This framework aims to ensure the ethical use of AI by guiding the model's behavior to prioritize user privacy, honesty, and harmlessness while generating text. In brief, the contributions of this research proposal are: (1) Pioneering Exploration: We are the first to delve into the concept of unlearning within the context of large language models, integrating privacy constitutional principles to guide the model's behavior. (2) Innovative Method: We present a pioneering contrastive reinforcement learning method to achieve our goal of developing AI systems that are not only helpful, honest, and harmless but also respect user privacy. It seamlessly incorporates unlearning into the evolution of LLMs, eliminating the need for additional training costs. (3) Benchmark and Evaluation Scheme: We contribute systematic benchmark and comprehensive evaluation schemes. 近期大語言模型（LLMs）的突破性進展對廣泛領域產生了重大影響，改變了我們交流、創作內容和解决問題的管道。 現時對大語言模型的研究主要集中在訓練LLMs以具備有用、誠實和無害的品質。 然而，這些努力存在一個重大疏漏，即忽視了LLMs可能從包含個人貢獻的互聯網數據中生成敏感內容的潛在風險。 與此同時，許多國家已經立法確立了“被遺忘權”，如歐盟的《通用數據保護條例》（GDPR）和加拿大的《個人信息保護與電子文檔法》（PIPEDA）隱私立法。 該權利要求公司在用戶提出需求時删除個人數據。 從後端資料庫中删除數據是相對簡單的，但對於像大語言模型這樣的機器學習模型來說，這是一個挑戰，因為它們的參數會永久性地編碼個人資訊及其衍生內容。 一種直觀的遺忘學習方法是使用不包含“待遺忘”數據的數据集重新訓練模型。 然而，這種重新訓練方法成本高且效率低，因為大模型的訓練可能需要數周甚至數月的時間； 而且在實踐中，頻繁的數據删除請求使得持續重新訓練變得不切實際。 鑒於上述在大語言模型背景下遺忘學習所面臨的必要性和挑戰，我們開發了一種名為“隱私驅動的憲法人工智慧”的方法，並利用它來訓練一個尊重隱私且相對無害的AI助手，而無需任何人工反饋標籤。 具體而言，我們將憲法原則/指令融入大語言模型的訓練中，首先採用與遺忘學習相關的原則來指導模型忘卻特定數據。 該框架旨在確保AI的倫理使用，通過指導模型行為優先考慮用戶隱私、誠實和無害性來生成文字。 綜上，本研究提案的貢獻包括：（1）開創性探索：我們首次在大語言模型背景下深入探討遺忘學習的概念，結合隱私憲法原則來指導模型行為。 （2）創新方法：我們提出了一種創新的對比强化學習方法，旨在開發不僅有用、誠實和無害且尊重用戶隱私的AI系統。 它將遺忘學習無縫融入LLMs的演進中，消除了額外訓練成本的需要。 （3）基準與評估方案：我們貢獻了系統性的基準和全面的評估方案。

14207224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14207224.value: 基於3D神經表示的大規模虛擬世界生成

14207224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14207224.value: 該項目旨在通過利用從大量自然數據中學習到的3D神經表示，推動大規模虛擬世界生成的發展。與從多視角數據重建特定數字資產（需要高端設備）或通過物理引擎和繁重的藝術設計創建合成世界的範式不同，我們將充分利用自然數據的內在多樣性和3D神經表示的物理特性來學習3D生成模型。這一創新轉變有望在無需任何努力的情況下，顯著提升數字內容生成的多樣性、規模和質量。 近年來，生成模型和3D神經表示技術在從2D觀測中合成逼真物體方面取得了成功。然而，這些方法面臨著挑戰：生成模型缺乏3D一致性，而3D神經表示在創建新場景時困難重重。實現3D一致性對於打造逼真的現實世界數字複製品至關重要，而生成新場景的能力對於大規模數字內容創作而言必不可少。因此，將這些方法應用於大規模虛擬世界生成仍是一項艱鉅的挑戰。 在本項目中，我們將在大規模虛擬世界生成領域做出系統性的新貢獻。我們將在幾何和外觀兩個維度展開研究：(1) 我們將引入一種佔據感知的3D生成模型，利用顯式佔据信息生成城市場景。我們的模型可以通過結合生成模型和3D神經表示，在3D空間佔據條件下生成具有無限長度幾何結構的城市場景。(2) 然後，通過引入級聯3D擴散框架，我們將展示一種生成具有高質量細節的多樣化房間3D幾何結構的新範式。該框架展示了創建多樣化且高質量房間網格的可行性。(3) 為確保外觀的多樣性，我們將創新性地提出一種文本引導的3D場景生成框架。通過專門調整文本到圖像模型以適應3D場景，我們的框架在生成具有多種風格和高質量紋理的自然場景方面表現出強大的能力。(4) 此外，我們還將引入一種組合式3D生成模型，將場景幾何簡化為組合式3D佈局表示，確保在生成具有無限排列變化、逼真紋理和合理幾何一致性的城市場景時的表現力。 本研究的成果將產生深遠的影響，並為機器人技術、自動駕駛等相關領域的數字內容生成任務提供強大的工具。

14207324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14207324.value: 面向自主逆行性腎臟內視鏡手術的實時外科視頻理解

14207324.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14207324.value: Dr Liu, Alex Qinyang Prof Ng, Chi-fai

14207324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14207324.value: Retrograde Intrarenal Surgery (RIRS) is a minimally invasive surgical technique employed for addressing kidney stones and specific kidney ailments. Typically administered by urologists, it entails the utilization of a flexible ureteroscope to gain access to the interior of the kidney via the urinary tract. This procedure holds substantial importance and is conducted routinely, with hundreds of patients receiving treatment daily in Hong Kong hospitals. The rising frequency and the increasing number of patients, partly due to the aging population, have placed considerable demands on urologists. Therefore, there is a heightened need for the procedure to be executed with greater efficiency and effectiveness. Aiming at a more efficient solution, in this project we will develop a real-time surgical video understanding system for autonomous RIRS with efficiency and guaranteed safety under the supervision of the surgeon. The technical challenges in developing such a perception system include real-time phase recognition of surgical procedures, tracking and segmenting stones and tissues, and prediction of soft tissue movement. This project will tackle those challenges by carrying out the following tasks: 1) developing a general framework for real-time surgical phase recognition, applied particularly in RIRS; 2) designing a robust algorithm for tracking and segmenting stones and tissues using ureteroscopy images for autonomous laser dusting; 3) predicting the soft tissues motion caused by respiratory accurately so as to compensate robot motion during autonomous surgery. We will validate our algorithms on a prototype of an autonomous flexible ureteroscopy platform and conduct cadaver experiments. As the developed perception system has the potential to be directly employed within local hospitals, its outcomes will undoubtedly make meaningful contributions to the advancement of technology and healthcare services at the local level. 逆行性腎臟內視鏡手術（RIRS）是一種應用於治療腎結石及某些腎臟疾病的微創技術。該手術通常由泌尿科專科醫生操作，利用柔性輸尿管鏡經由尿道進入腎臟內部進行治療。此手術具有顯著的臨床意義，並已成為常規醫療程序，每日有數百名患者在香港的醫療機構接受此項手術。隨著人口老齡化導致的患者數量增加，泌尿科專科醫生面臨的壓力日益增大，急需提高手術的效率和效果。本研究旨在開發一個用於自主RIRS的實時手術視頻理解系統，以在外科醫生監督下實現更高效且安全的手術操作。開發此系統所面臨的主要技術挑戰包括手術過程中各階段的實時識別、結石及組織的追蹤與分割、以及軟組織運動的預測。本項目將通過以下研究任務來應對這些挑戰：1) 開發一個通用框架，用於RIRS手術過程中實時階段識別；2) 設計一種穩健的算法，通過輸尿管鏡影像追蹤並分割結石及組織，用於自主激光碎石術；3) 準確預測由呼吸引起的軟組織運動，以便在自主手術過程中對機器人的運動進行補償。我們將在自主柔性輸尿管鏡平台的原型機上驗證所開發的算法，並進行屍體實驗。由於該系統具有在本地醫療機構直接應用的潛力，預期其成果將為本地科技與醫療服務的進步作出重要貢獻。

14207424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14207424.value: 基於液滴微流控的單細胞全長RNA和染色質可及性共分析

14207424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14207424.value: The landmark completion of human genome mapping in 2003 provided a wealth of genomic information and opened avenues for the identification of individual cells through their unique spatiotemporal gene expression profiles. The transcriptome, an array of messenger RNA (mRNA) transcripts, is considered a unique molecular fingerprint in which gene activity serves as a readout of cell functions, developmental stages, and disturbances caused by internal or environmental stimuli. When genomic information is transcribed into gene expression, the epigenome, a collection of epigenetic marks on genomic DNA in a single cell, contains information of how the single cell genome is modified and locations in which chromatin is “accessible” for transcription and RNA processing. Consequently, identifying the connection between epigenetic and transcriptomic profiling is essential for understanding the mechanisms governing gene expression regulation, developmental decisions, disease progression, and responses to therapeutic interventions. Recent advances in single-cell multi-omics have provided valuable insights into complex biological systems ranging from cancer genomics to diverse microbial communities. Nevertheless, co-profiling of single cell mRNA and chromatic accessibility remains challenging, particularly when the throughput, sequencing cost, and coverage of a single cell are collectively considered. The proposed project will be aimed at developing a novel droplet-microfluidics-based platform that can effectively isolate single nuclei for simultaneous identification of mRNA and open chromatin within a single cell. None of the existing techniques possess the combined capabilities of extensive sequencing coverage, high throughput, and time and cost efficiency. Upon the successful establishment and validation of this platform, it will allow researchers to clarify the molecular mechanisms of rare cell types, especially plant cells, which are markedly responsive to environmental changes during development. We have collaborated with a plant biologist to formulate protocols suitable for genetically modified plant cells and biomass crops, while working on the technological aspects. This combined effort will expedite the dissemination of the proposed technology to the identified beneficiaries, both locally and globally. If successful, the proposed project will provide a valuable opportunity to translate scientific excellence in Hong Kong into societal impacts in the near future, thus helping transform the Greater Bay Area into an international powerhouse for improved biomass valorisation and the development of tangible bioenergy products. 在2003年完成的人類基因組圖譜具有里程碑意義、提供了豐富的基因組訊息，同時透過時空基因表現譜開拓了鑑定單一細胞的獨特途徑。轉錄組是信使RNA (mRNA)轉錄本集合，亦被認為是一種獨特的分子指紋，其中基因活性可以作為細胞功能、不同發育階段、內部或環境刺激引起的干擾等的讀數。當基因組訊息被轉錄成基因表現時，表觀基因組，即單細胞基因組DNA上的表觀遺傳標記的集合，包含了單細胞基因組如何被修飾以及染色質「可接近」的轉錄和RNA作動位置等資訊。因此，確定表觀遺傳和轉錄組譜之間的關聯對於理解基因表現調控、發育決定、疾病進展和對治療介入的反應機制等至關重要。 單細胞多組學的最新進展為從癌症基因組學，到不同微生物群落的複雜生物系統等，提供了豐富的信息，然而，單細胞mRNA和染色質可及性的共同分析仍然具有挑戰性，特別是當同時考量通量、定序成本和單細胞的覆蓋範圍。本計畫旨在開發一種基於液滴微流控的新型平台，提出的平台可望能有效分離單一細胞核，同時鑑定單一細胞內的mRNA和開放染色質。目前現有的技術裡，沒有能同時具備廣泛的定序涵蓋範圍、高通量及兼顧時間和成本效率的技術，因此，本計畫期能建立的平台與驗證將使研究人員能夠闡明罕見細胞類型反應的分子機制，特別是植物細胞在發育過程中因環境變化所做出的調控。我們已建立與植物生物學家的合作，制定了適用於基因改造植物細胞和生物質作物的方案。本項目的實現期能加速向當地和全球傳播所建置的技術，並且，將提供一個寶貴的機會，在不久的將來將香港的卓越科學成果轉化為社會影響，從而將大灣區轉變為一個促進生物質價值增值和開發有形生物能源產品的國際中心。

14207524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14207524.value: 配電網拓撲結構和非線性潮流的聯合優化

14207524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14207524.value: We consider a combinatorial optimization problem to find a minimum-cost topology of a networked system, where the cost of each feasible topology is defined by an underlying continuous optimization of network resource allocation and flows. We focus on such a problem, called optimal topology and power flow (OTPF), in power distribution networks, which jointly optimizes the on/off status of switches on power lines and the generations, loads, and power flows, for more reliable, economical, and sustainable operation. The essential tradeoff between scalability (by which we mean a mild increase of computational burden with the network size) and optimality (a lower cost without violating physical and operational constraints) makes it hard to improve both attributes of an algorithm to solve OTPF, especially considering the practical three-phase unbalanced nonlinear alternating-current (AC) power flow models, the uncertainties of renewable generations and loads, and the key reliability indices, e.g., voltage stability, that do not have closed-form expressions. We will tackle these challenges to develop OTPF solution algorithms with improved scalability and optimality. The proposed research is planned as three tasks: (1) Develop a topology-informed switch opening and exchange algorithm based on convex relaxation to AC power flow, to solve deterministic OTPF problems with provable suboptimality bounds. (2) Extend the algorithm in (1) with a topology-informed scenario clustering method, to solve stochastic and robust OTPF problems under uncertainties of renewable generations and loads, with improved computational efficiency. (3) Merge deep-learning-based prediction of voltage stability indices into the topology-informed algorithms, to solve OTPF problems considering voltage stability enhancement. We shall validate scalability and optimality of the proposed algorithms through software simulations of practical power distribution network models with up to 11,000 nodes. 我們考慮一類組合優化問題來找到網絡化系統的最小成本拓撲結構，其中每個可行拓撲結構的成本由其底層的網絡資源分配和流量的連續優化來定義。我們關注配電網中的這樣一個問題，稱為最優拓撲和潮流（OTPF），對電力線路上的開關狀態以及發電、負載和功率流動進行聯合優化，以實現更可靠、經濟、可持續的運行。可擴展性（這裡意為計算負擔隨著網絡規模溫和增加）和最優性（在不違反物理和運行約束的情況下降低成本）之間的基本權衡關係使得同時改進一個OTPF算法的這兩種屬性變得十分困難，特別是考慮到實際的三相不平衡非線性交流潮流模型、可再生能源發電和負載的不確定性以及沒有閉式表達的關鍵可靠性指標（如電壓穩定性）。我們將應對這些挑戰，開發具有更高可擴展性和最優性的 OTPF 算法。我們提出的研究計劃分為三個任務：（1）開發一種基於交流潮流凸鬆弛的拓撲知情的開關斷開和交換算法，以求解確定性 OTPF 問題並證明次優邊界。（2）利用拓撲知情的場景聚類方法擴展（1）中的算法，以更高的計算效率求解可再生能源發電與負載不確定性下的隨機及魯棒OTPF問題。（3）將基於深度學習的電壓穩定性指標預測融入上述拓撲知情的算法，以解決電壓穩定性增強的OTPF問題。我們將通過對多達 11,000 節點的實際配電網模型進行軟件仿真來驗證所提出算法的可擴展性和最優性。

14207624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14207624.value: 多天線系統中的任務導向通信：模塊化的物理層設計

14207624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14207624.value: 無線網絡的迅猛發展，尤其是2020年推出的第五代（5G）無線系統，極大地改變了我們的日常生活。高通公司預測，到2035年，5G價值鏈將創造3.8萬億美元的總產值。這一非凡的增長，加上諸如萬物互聯和自動駕駛網絡等人工智慧應用的興起，推動了對新一代6G無線系統的探索。然而，這些智能應用依賴於大量的數據生成和交換，給通信系統帶來了前所未有的負擔。 任務導向通信已成為6G的關鍵組成部分，任務導向通信通過僅傳輸與高效執行任務相關的信息減輕信負擔。現有的任務導向通信研究主要集中在設計用於特定任務特徵提取的機器學習模塊。這種設計方法往往忽視了機器學習模塊與物理層通信模塊之間的相互作用，採用為傳統物理層標準（如吞吐量最大化和延遲最小化）優化的通信模塊。通信和學習模塊設計目標之間的不一致阻礙了任務導向通信優勢的充分發揮。另一方面，最近的端到端學習方法通過為學習和通信提供一致的設計目標，潛在地解決了這一問題。然而，端到端深度神經網絡需要基於任務數據集和整個無線信道分佈進行訓練，從而導致過高的訓練複雜性。 在本項目中，我們將研究一種不同於現行端到端方法的模塊化設計。與端到端方式訓練通信和學習模塊相比，我們提出的模塊化設計顯著降低了訓練複雜性。更重要的是，我們提出了一種通信模塊設計目標的範式轉變。我們的方法摒棄了傳統的物理層設計標準，使通信模塊的設計目標與學習模塊的設計目標一致。這種一致性能顯著提高任務導向通信的效率和效果。 任務導向通信是6G無線系統的一個重要主題。所提出的模塊化和統一設計通過對齊通信和學習模塊的目標、降低訓練複雜性，並實現高效利用MIMO信號處理，重新塑造了任務導向通信的格局。

14207924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14207924.value: 用於新型超小直徑多模光纖內窺鏡成像系統的多模光纖中模式分佈的集成光學控制

14207924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14207924.value: Endoscopic imaging is widely used clinically but is limited by the relatively large diameters, of the order of millimeters, of even the thinnest endoscopes currently available, that prevent the endoscope from accessing difficult to reach organs like the brain or inner cochlea. The development of endoscopes which are one order of magnitude smaller in diameter than the ones available today can increase the clinical applications of endoscopes, such as for deep brain imaging, while reducing the damage and pain experienced by patients in more conventional applications such as transnasal and transoral endoscopy. The use of multimode optical fibers for imaging has the potential to reduce the diameter of endoscopes by an order of magnitude, to less than 0.2mm diameter. Multimode optical fibers for endoscopic imaging have therefore attracted much research in recent years and impressive imaging performances have been demonstrated using bulk optical components and spatial light modulators at the proximal end of the fiber in order to engineer the wavefront of light at the distal end of the multimode fiber and achieve high resolution imaging. However such demonstrations are unsuited for clinical applications because they rely on bulk optics and free-space aligned beams which are sensitive to mechanical vibrations that perturb the position of mirrors or lenses, so that the demonstrations are typically built on vibration-free optical benches. In this project we propose the development of a photonic integrated circuit (PIC) which integrates all the necessary components for the multimode fiber imaging system on a silicon chip. We shall implement the system using the silicon photonics chip fabrication services offered by commercial foundries for the integration of phase shifters, mode multiplexers and photodetectors. Our proposed approach will realize a robust, vibration insensitive and high-resolution multimode fiber imaging system. We shall tackle the basic challenge of how to couple light between the multimode fiber and the photonic integrated circuit using grating based optical nanoantenna array, and we shall develop the algorithms for the control of the high-speed phase shifters on the PIC and the compressive imaging reconstruction algorithms using the light reflected back into the multimode optical fiber to achieve high-resolution imaging. The proposed development of the PIC for multimode fiber imaging systems will enable a robust and ultra-small (less than 0.3mm diameter) high-resolution endoscopic imaging system, which will reduce the diameter of endoscopes by more than an order of magnitude and expand the possible applications of endoscopic imaging. 內窺鏡成像在臨床上具有廣泛的應用。但是，目前即使是最細的內窺鏡，其直徑也在毫米級別，這限制了內窺鏡在體內難以到達的器官，例如大腦或內耳蜗，中的應用。開發比現有內窺鏡直徑小一個數量級的新型內窺鏡可以增加其臨床應用，例如深部腦成像。同時在更傳統的應用，如經鼻或經口內窺鏡檢查中，可以減少病人的損傷與疼痛。使用多模光纖進行成像有可能將內窺鏡的直徑減小一個數量級，最小可以到達0.2毫米。因此，近年來湧現了許多關於多模光纖內窺鏡成像的研究。研究人員們利用空間光學元件以及空間光調制器在光纖的近端進行波前整形，以實現在多模光纖的遠端實現高分辨率的成像。然而，這些演示並不適用於臨床應用，因為他們依賴於空間光學以及自由空間中光束的對準。這樣的系統對會擾動反射鏡與透鏡位置的機械振動十分敏感，因此這些演示通常在無震動的光學平台實現。在這個項目中，我們提出開發一種光子集成電路（PIC），將多模光纖成像系統所需的所有組件集成在一個硅芯片上。我們將利用商業晶圓廠提供的硅光子芯片製造服務來集成相移器、模式復用器和光探測器。我們提出的方法將實現一個穩定的、對震動不敏感的高分辨率多模光纖成像系統。我們將著力解決關於如何使用基於光柵的光學納米天線陣列實現多模光纖和PIC之間光學耦合的基本問題，並將開發用於驅動PIC上的高速相移器的控制算法和利用反射回多模光纖的光進行壓縮成像的圖像重建算法，以實現高分辨率成像。我們提出的用於多模光纖成像系統的光子集成電路的開發，將實現一個穩定且超小（直徑小於0.3毫米）的高分辨率內窺鏡成像系統，將內窺鏡的直徑減小超過一個數量級，並拓展內窺鏡成像的可能應用。

14208424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14208424.value: 用於提高手術機械人軟組織操作自動化水平的感知、建模和基於示範數據的策略學習方法研究

14208424.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14208424.value: Prof Liu, Yun-hui Prof Ng, Chi-fai

14208424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14208424.value: 隨著手術機械人在臨床應用的日益普及，提高其智能化水平以降本增效是下一步的研究熱點。軟組織操作自動化是微創手術中最為常見的場景之一，從簡單的組織抓取到復雜的組織解剖乃至吻合術都涵蓋其中。然而，現有方法仍針對特定任務而設計，故而解決方案往往缺乏通用性，無法有效處理不同的操作任務和場景。近期隨著機器學習和大模型技術的快速發展，使機器人有望通過觀察大量的人類演示數據來學習復雜多樣的操作技能。該數據驅動的學習範式也適用於手術機械人場景，特別是考慮到內鏡視頻和運動學數據在日常手術中本就會被錄製下來。此研究頗具挑戰性，復雜的患者數據涵蓋各種手術場景、動態操作行為、和長距離運動，研究方法需要在機器人感知、軟組織建模、控製策略學習等各方面同時取得突破，才能整體實現數據驅動的軟組織操作自動化。本項目針對該研究目標，旨在提供一種基於手術機械人內鏡視頻和運動學示範數據的新型學習框架。首先，我們將提出一個多模感知新方法，可以穩健地從演示數據中識別手術工具--軟組織相互作用點及其 3D 運動軌跡以自動提取手術動作。其次，我們將結合數據驅動和物理建模的方法來表征軟組織狀態，以理解操作時軟組織的表面幾何形變及估計其內在屬性。然後，基於提取的手術動作和對應的組織狀態表征，我們將開發基於擴散模型的控製策略學習新方法，以捕獲演示數據中狀態--動作對的復雜分布。我們將利用團隊現有的具身智能模擬器 SurRoL 進行數據擴充，以保障機械人交互環境的多樣性從而提升強化學習模型的魯棒性。最後，我們將整合上述數據驅動的自主軟組織操作的一系列技術，利用香港中文大學醫療機械人創新技術中心的平臺在前列腺切除術的典型場景中進行實驗驗證。總而言之，該跨學科項目的研究團隊由機械人、人工智能和臨床專家組成，我們已經利用現有數據集獲得了擬研究任務的初​​步結果以確認其可行性。本項目所鉆研的創新技術旨在提供數據驅動的通用解決思路，其不僅面向軟組織操作應用案例，更重要的是為充分利用未來各種手術機械人相關數據提供啟發，從而為普遍提高手術機械人的智能化水平和自主性做出貢獻。

14208524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14208524.value: 非正交矩陣預編碼以優化高容量光傳輸系統中的高效頻分複用

14208524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14208524.value: 現今的大數據應用和雲端運算不斷增長，極需要一個大容量和高效能的光纖網路基礎設施來支援所有網路應用。先進的數位處理技術是進一步提高高速光纖傳輸的容量和性能的使能技術。頻譜高效頻分複用 (SEFDM) 是一種訊號處理技術，可以實現更佳的頻寬利用率和增強的訊號傳輸性能。在產生SEFDM訊號的各種方法中，基於非正交矩陣預編碼(NOM-p)的技術作為新提出的概念，具有更好的兼容性和靈活性，並增強光纖傳輸系統的性能。首先，我們將其應用於傳統的基於離散傅立葉變換擴展（DFT-S）的正交頻分複用（OFDM）系統，以對抗位於SNR曲線兩側邊緣的信噪比（SNR）下降，從而實現優越的傳輸性能。 NOM-p之後的預編碼子載波將被分配到中間部分用於後續的DFT-S，NOM-p的頻寬壓縮特性可以保持整體頻譜效率不變，從而大大提高系統性能和容量。其次，我們將提出一種新的多頻段SEFDM系統，並進一步研究自適應頻段調變以最大化通道容量。根據通道回應，高級調變格式的不同階數將被仔細分配給不同的子帶。這樣可以充分利用它們各自的信噪比，從而在不犧牲頻譜效率的情況下實現最佳的傳輸性能和計算複雜度。該專案的成果將帶來具有最佳傳輸性能的高容量光纖通訊的實用支援技術。

14209024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14209024.value: 用於微小管腔分支區域定向遞送的微集群動態特性和可控三維延展

14209024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14209024.value: 本研究項目的總體目標是從以下幾個方面來了解磁控微集群的可控動態形變：（i）複雜微小分支管腔中微集群的可控二維和三維擴展形變； (ii) 基於管腔分支區域中微集群的可控制三維擴張來進行影像/治療劑的區域遞送。 (iii) 使用離體模型驗證微小管腔分支中微集群的動態交互作用和可控制三維擴張。我們設想這項工作是磁性微集群發展過程中具有開創性的一步，也就是說，使微集群能夠在微小管腔的分叉區域進行有針對性的定向遞送，以用於體內應用。該研究項目的先進技術和成果將為醫療微機器人和微創醫學的發展做出貢獻。

14209124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14209124.value: 大語言模型在代碼智能上的可靠性工程

14209124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14209124.value: 大型語言模型 (LLM) 最近變得非常流行，在許多 NLP 任務上取得了相當好的表現。受到代碼自然性的啟發，研究人員正在努力利用LLM來完成許多與代碼相關的任務。程式碼智能任務，例如程式碼摘要、程式修復和錯誤檢測。本項目旨在對LLM在理解代碼的三個組成部分（標識符、代碼結構和類型信息）時所表現出的表現進行系統和全面的檢測。此外，我們努力提出創新的解決方案，旨在提高LLM在程式碼預測和理解方面的可靠性。 標識符保證了代碼的自然性。好的標識符能夠體現程式碼語義，方便人類開發人員理解程式碼。如果標識符命名不正確，它們反而會成為程式碼理解的障礙。程式碼理解在程式碼智能中起著至關重要的作用，其目的是學習程式碼語義並將其嵌入到高維度特徵向量中。適當的標識符可以幫助LLM理解代碼，而與代碼語義衝突的不適當標識符可能會誤導模型給出錯誤的預測。我們的目標是研究它們對LLM在代碼理解方面的影響，並減少不適當標識符的負面影響，以提高LLM的可靠性。 程式碼中的識別碼對於人類理解程式碼很重要，但它們實際上並不影響程式碼的執行。相反，程式碼結構所體現的程式碼語意才是執行結果的關鍵。與標識符重命名不同，考慮到代碼的離散性質，代碼結構的變化受到突變空間的限制。代碼混淆是評估LLM可靠性的常用方法，但它並不實用，因為混淆的代碼很少出現在現實世界的程序中。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一個自適應變異測試框架。自適應演算法允許根據測試結果進行動態調整，從而提高測試過程的效率和有效性。它透過執行語義保留程式碼突變來改變程式碼結構，這些突變由演算法中的自適應突變策略引導。 類型信息是開發和維護可擴展軟件的關鍵。缺乏類型程式碼中的信息會帶來漏洞和維護問題。作為動態語言刪除類型信息以方便快速原型設計，類型推斷對於提高他們編寫的軟件的可靠性是必要的。傳統的靜態類型推斷方法是合理的，但只能推斷非常有限的變數集。數據驅動的方法，尤其是最近基於LLM的方法，已被證明在預測類型方面非常有效，但它們不能保證預測的正確性。因此，以前的方法無法同時實現高性能和保證正確性。為了解決這個限制，我們提出了協同類型推論來模擬靜態類型檢測器和LLM之間的合作。我們將它們視為不同的代理，以便類型檢測器可以驗證類型預測的正確性，並且 LLM 可以學習根據錯誤訊息糾正錯誤的預測。 總之，我們建議評估和提高LLM在理解和預測代碼三個組成部分方面的可靠性。有了可靠性保證，LLM就可以實際參與軟件開發。

14209424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14209424.value: 面向智能海洋的空海協同異構多智能體系統與數字孿生技術

14209424.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14209424.value: Prof CHEN, Xi Dr Wang, Xinyi

14209424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14209424.value: Multi-robot systems have increasingly become instrumental in tackling search and coverage problems. The integration of aerial-marine collaborative heterogeneous multi-agent systems with digital twin (DT) technology presents a groundbreaking direction for marine environmental conservation. However, the challenge of optimizing task efficiency without compromising task success persists, particularly in expansive, unstructured environments with dense obstacles and limited communication resources. This project propose an innovative, decentralized Voronoi-based approach for search and coverage to reactively navigate these complexities while maintaining safety. This approach leverages the active sensing capabilities of multi-robot systems to supplement DT model, offering a more comprehensive and real-time understanding of the environment. Based on point cloud data, which is inherently non-convex and unstructured, this method efficiently generates collision-free Voronoi regions using only local sensing information through spatial decomposition and spherical mirroring techniques. Then, deadlock-aware guided map integrated with a gradient-optimized, centroid Voronoi-based coverage control policy, is constructed to improve efficiency by avoiding exhaustive searches and local sensing pitfalls. In addition, dynamic connectivity maintenance method is designed, aiming to enhance multi-robot coordination, maximize coverage efficiency, and hasten marine target detection. Most importantly, incorporating aerial-marine multi-robot systems, these DT models can interact in real-time with robots, and other sensing devices, offering immediate data updates and feedback. This integration further supports intricate tasks such as tracing pollution sources, and biodiversity assessments. As a result, it provides a powerful and versatile tool for marine environmental conservation, fostering a superior understanding, monitoring, and protection of our invaluable marine assets. We are expecting the integration of collaborative heterogeneous aerialmarine systems together with DT technology presents a groundbreaking direction for maritime environmental conservation. The proposed research, if funded, will provide an excellent platform for us to work with environmental protection organizations, such as Hong Kong Environmental Protection Department and Hong Kong Ocean Park Conservation Foundation, for analyzing environmental information and recommending corresponding conservation measures. We will try to implement the developed technologies for more real-life applications. 多智能系統在解決搜索和覆蓋問題方面發揮著越來越重要的作用。海空協作異構多智能體系統與數字孿生 (DT) 技術的結合為海洋環境保護提供了一個開創性的方向。然而，在不影響任務成功率的情況下優化任務效率的挑戰依然存在，特別是在廣闊非結構性的環境中，這些環境存在密集的障礙物和有限的通信資源。該項目提出了一種創新的、基於 Voronoi 的分散式搜索和覆蓋方法，以在保持安全的同時積極地應對這些覆雜情況。這種方法利用多機械人系統的主動感知能力來補充 DT 模型，提供對環境更全面、更實時的理解。基於本質上非凸和非結構化的點雲數據，該方法通過空間分解和球面鏡像技術，僅使用局部感知信息即可有效地生成無碰撞的 Voronoi 區域。然後，構建了感知引導地圖，結合梯度優化、基於質心 Voronoi 的覆蓋控制策略，通過避免窮舉搜索和局部感知陷阱來提高效率。此外，還設計了動態連接維護方法，旨在增強多機械人協調、最大化覆蓋效率並加快海洋目標檢測。 最重要的是，結合空中-海上多智能系統，這些 DT 模型可以與機械人和其他傳感設備實時交互，提供即時數據更新和反饋。這種集成進一步支持追蹤汙染源和生物多樣性評估等覆雜任務。因此，它為海洋環境保護提供了一個強大而多功能的工具，促進了對我們寶貴海洋資產的更好理解、監測和保護。我們期待協作異構空中-海上系統與 DT 技術的結合為海洋環境保護提供了一個突破性的方向。這項研究將為我們提供一個絕佳的平台，讓我們與香港環境保護署、香港海洋公園保育基金等環保組織合作，分析環境信息，並建議相應的保育措施。我們將努力將所開發的技術應用於更多實際生活中。

14209624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14209624.value: Routing in VLSI design is a key step in the physical synthesis process that affects performance on timing and design rule compliance directly and is also one of the most time consuming steps. For a complex system today with billions of nets and cells, the routing process, that includes global routing and detailed routing, can take up days to finish. The complexity, not only comes from the huge size of the problem, but also brought by the very detailed and complicated design rules and corner cases under different design technology nodes. A lot of efforts have been made to improve routing from sophisticated CPU based routing algorithms to GPU accelerated routing, but there is still a lot of room for further improvement. With the advancement of AI technology, it is exciting to explore if learning based methods can shift the routing paradigm to new heights. In this project, we will explore innovative ways to perform routing on CPU and GPU, and to build learning based router that is adaptive to new design rules and technologies. This learning based approach will solve the routing problem once for all by learning and may greatly shorten the runtime for VLSI routing. With the increasing complexity of VLSI circuits and systems, the success of this project will be impactful to both academia and industry. VLSI設計中的佈線是物理綜合過程中的關鍵步驟，直接影響時序效能和設計規則合規性，也是最耗時的步驟之一。對於當今擁有數十億網路和單元的複雜系統來說，包括全局佈線和詳細佈線的佈線過程可能需要數天才能完成。複雜性，不僅來自於問題規模的巨大，還來自於不同設計技術節點下非常詳細和複雜的設計規則和極端情況所帶來的。從複雜的基於CPU的路由演算法到GPU加速的路由，人們已經做出了很多努力來改進路由，但仍然有很大的進一步改進的空間。隨著人工智慧技術的進步，探索基於學習的方法是否可以將路由範式提升到新的高度是令人興奮的。在這個專案中，我們將探索在CPU和GPU上執行路由的創新方法，並建立適應新設計規則和技術的基於學習的路由器。這種基於學習的方法將透過學習一次解決路由問題，並且可以大大縮短VLSI路由的運行時間。隨著VLSI電路和系統的複雜性日益增加，該計畫的成功將對學術界和工業界產生影響。

14209824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14209824.value: 三氧化鉬納米帶中表面聲子極化子介導的熱傳輸研究

14209824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14209824.value: 理解納米尺度熱傳輸以及開發調節固體能量傳輸的新策略對於改善電子元件的熱管理至關重要。晶格振動（聲子）是非金屬材料中主要的熱載體。眾所周知，在低於聲子平均自由程的長度尺度上，由於經典尺寸效應，晶格熱導率可能遠低於塊體熱導率，這對納米固態元件的散熱提出了重大挑戰。研究者對於發現能夠對固體熱傳導做出重大貢獻的新型熱載體有持續的興趣。表面聲子極化子是由光學聲子和紅外光耦合產生的倏逝表面電磁波，由於它們在極性介電薄膜表面的傳播距離比聲子的平均自由程高幾個數量級，被認為是一種有前途的能量載體。理論上預測表面聲子極化子可以將厚度小於100納米的非晶極性薄膜的熱導率提高約100%，但迄今為止，直接的實驗證明仍然有限。 在本項目中，我們提出研究斜方三氧化鉬納米帶中表面聲子極化子介導的熱傳輸。三氧化鉬由透過范德華力結合在一起的二維層組成，最近有報告指出三氧化鉬支持面內各向異性表面聲子極化子，這是由其強結構各向異性引起的。三氧化鉬薄膜中的表面聲子極化子及其異質結構已在紅外光電子學領域得到廣泛研究，然而，它們對於熱傳輸的貢獻尚未被探索。本項目旨在從根本上研究表面聲子極化子對機械剝離的三氧化鉬納米帶面內熱導率的影響。為了指導實驗研究，我們將理論上計算不同厚度和不同溫度下三氧化鉬薄膜的表面聲子極化子色散關係、傳播長度及其對熱導率的貢獻。我們將對不同尺寸（厚度、寬度和長度）的三氧化鉬納米帶的熱導率進行廣泛的測量，以區分表面聲子極化子在面內熱傳輸中的作用並驗證理論預測。基於所獲得的理論和實驗結果，我們將進一步探索有效的策略，包括金屬塗層和調節表面聲子極化子吸收以增強其熱傳輸性能。本項目將加深我們對表面聲子極化子對極性納米結構熱傳輸貢獻的理解，並為納米電子元件的散熱提供新策略。

14210024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14210024.value: 高性能低成本回收玻璃碎片輻射冷卻塗料的研發及其實際應用

14210024.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14210024.value: Prof Lai, Dayi Prof Xu, Dongyan

14210024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14210024.value: Climate change has increased the demand for space cooling as the earth continues to become warmer. Radiative cooling is a renewable technology that reflects solar radiation and dissipates heat through the atmospheric window to outer space. To facilitate practical applications, it is worthwhile to develop high-performance low-cost radiative cooling materials for sustainable cooling harvesting. Various radiative cooling materials have been reported in the literature. Among them, radiative cooling paints made by mixing glass bubbles with a polymer are among the most practical because of their simple fabrication processes. A major challenge of the existing glass bubble-based radiative cooling paints is the high raw material cost, because fabrication of the glass bubbles is technically difficult. Our previous study found that breaking glass bubbles into fragments is effective in increasing the solar reflectivity and thus enhancing the cooling performance of radiative cooling paints. The broken glass bubbles are essentially glass fragments with certain sizes and shapes. Such glass fragments can potentially be fabricated from a variety of low-cost sources, such as recycled glass bottles which are very cheap and sometimes even free with government support for sustainability. Cheap glass fragments made from recycled glass bottles can replace the expensive glass bubbles in order to lower the raw material cost for the radiative cooling paints. Therefore, this project aims to develop high-performance recycled glass fragment-based radiative cooling paints with reduced raw material cost. We will first experimentally and numerically investigate the mechanisms of enhanced cooling with the use of recycled glass fragments. The effects of glass fragment size, shape, and color on the solar reflectivity and thermal emissivity of the paints will be studied. Based on the understanding of the mechanisms, the project will then optimize the design and fabrication processes to obtain high-performance recycled glass fragment-based radiative cooling paints with minimized raw material cost. The optimized radiative cooling paints will be applied to buildings and outdoor shelters, and the performance will be evaluated by means of long-term field tests and life cycle analysis. The proposed project will enhance our understanding of the mechanisms of enhanced cooling with the use of recycled glass fragments. The development of recycled glass fragment-based radiative cooling paints will improve the cooling performance, reduce the raw material cost, and contribute to sustainability by reducing carbon emissions and waste glass in landfills. The findings will advance the development of this novel cooling technology for sustainable cooling harvesting. 氣候變化使得對空間冷卻的需求隨著地球持續變暖而增加。輻射冷卻是一種可再生技術，它反射太陽輻射並通過大氣窗口將熱量散發到外太空。為了促進實際應用，開發高性能低成本的輻射冷卻材料以實現可持續的空間冷卻至關重要。 文獻中報導了各種輻射冷卻材料，其中，由玻璃空心小球與聚合物混合製成的輻射冷卻塗料是最實用的，因為它們的製造過程簡單。然而，現有基於玻璃空心小球的輻射冷卻塗料的原材料成本過高，因為製造玻璃空心小球在技術上較為困難。我們之前的研究發現，將玻璃空心小球打碎成碎片可以有效地增加太陽反射率，從而提高輻射冷卻塗料的冷卻性能。破碎的玻璃空心小球本質上是具有一定大小和形狀的玻璃碎片。這種玻璃碎片可能可以通過各種低成本原料進行製造，例如回收的玻璃瓶。而這些玻璃瓶非常便宜，有時甚至在政府支持可持續發展的政策下是免費的。由回收玻璃瓶製成的便宜玻璃碎片可以替代昂貴的玻璃空心小球，以降低輻射冷卻塗料的原材料成本。 因此，本項目旨在開發高性能原材料成本低的回收玻璃碎片輻射冷卻塗料。我們將首先通過實驗和數值模擬研究回收玻璃碎片增強冷卻的機理。我們將研究玻璃碎片的大小、形狀和顏色對塗料的太陽反射率和熱發射率的影響。基於對機理的理解，該項目將優化設計和製造過程，以獲得原材料成本最低的高性能回收玻璃碎片輻射冷卻塗料。優化的輻射冷卻塗料將應用於建築物和戶外結構，並通過長期實地測試和全生命週期分析評估其性能。 該項目將增強我們對回收玻璃碎片增強冷卻機理的理解。開發回收玻璃碎片輻射冷卻塗料將提高冷卻性能，降低原材料成本，並通過減少碳排放和垃圾填埋場的廢玻璃來促進可持續發展。這些發現將推動這種新型冷卻技術的發展，以實現可持續的空間冷卻。

14210124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14210124.value: 用於心血管建模和無袖動態血壓監測的多模態體表傳感平台

14210124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14210124.value: Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) are a leading cause of death worldwide. For early diagnosis, intervention and management of CVDs, it is highly desirable to frequently monitor blood pressure (BP), a vital sign closely related to CVDs, during people's daily life, including sleep time. Towards this end, wearable cuffless BP monitoring devices have been extensively researched in recent years as part of the mobile healthcare initiative. Despite the vibrant development of new device technologies, cuffless BP measurements still face a few critical challenges in practice. Firstly, the widely used arterial pulse transit time-based method for BP monitoring relies primarily on simplified vascular BP models and typically exhibits degraded performance over time or upon change of application scenarios. Secondly, each type of sensors (i.e., optical, mechanical and ultrasound sensors) utilizes one or a set of unique cardiovascular parameters to extract BP; the correlations among these different sensed parameters are unclear, and a direct comparison on how different sensors respond to different type of hemodynamic changes is lacking. Thirdly, there is a trade-off between power consumption and measurement accuracy. Recent studies have shown evidently that increasing the sensing pixels or sensing modalities can improve the BP estimation accuracy; however, this approach may largely increase the power consumption and system footprint, if not carefully designed. In this project, we propose to develop a highly integrated wearable platform combining ultrasound, photoplethysmography, impedance plethysmography and pulse pressure sensors for establishment of a comprehensive cardiovascular model. Through this platform, local cardiovascular parameters including arterial diameter, arterial blood flow, blood volume pulse and pulse wave velocity can be real-time and synchronously measured, which will allow us to compare the interplay and correlations among these parameters at different scenarios, including rest, sleep, and after medical treatment. A cardiovascular model based on the sensor inputs will be established for long-term and accurate BP estimation. To evaluate the impact of measurement locations, two wearable devices, namely arm-worn and neck-worn devices, will be developed and separately modeled. The devices will be applied to both healthy subjects and CVD patients to evaluate the sensor and model performances on different cardiovascular systems. Finally, based on the clinical dataset we will explore a machine-learning guided sensor reduction strategy to realize new sensor platforms with significantly reduced power consumption. This research brings together innovations in flexible sensing devices, wearable platforms and physiological modelling, generating new knowledge both at a fundamental level and in terms of new applications. 心血管疾病（CVD）是全世界死亡的頭號起因。為了對CVD進行早期診斷、介入和管理，我們非常需要在人們的日常生活（包括睡眠時間）中經常監測血壓（BP）這一與CVD密切相關的生命體徵。為此，作為行動醫療計劃的一部分，可穿戴式無袖血壓監測設備近年來得到了廣泛的研究。儘管新設備技術蓬勃發展，無袖血壓測量在實踐中仍面臨一些關鍵挑戰。首先，廣泛使用的基於動脈脈搏傳導時間的血壓監測方法主要依賴簡化的血管血壓模型，並且通常會隨著時間的推移或應用情境的變化而表現出表現下降。其次，各類單一模態的傳感器（即光學、機械和超聲傳感器）利用一個或一組獨特的心血管參數來提取血壓；這些不同感測參數之間的相關性尚不清楚，並且缺乏對不同傳感器如何響應不同類型的血流動力學變化的直接比較。第三，功耗和測量精度之間需要權衡。最近的研究明顯表明，增加感測像素或感測模式可以提高BP估計精度；然而，非最佳化的設計方案將大大增加功耗和系統佔用空間。 在這個專案中，我們將開發一個高度整合的可穿戴平台，結合超聲、光電體積描記法、阻抗體積描記法和脈壓傳感器來建立全面的心血管模型。透過這個平台，可以即時同步測量包括動脈直徑、動脈血流量、血容量脈搏和脈搏波速度在內的局部心血管參數，這將使我們能夠比較這些參數在不同場景（包括休息）下的相互作用和相關性。我們還將建立基於傳感器輸入的心血管模型，以進行長期、準確的血壓估計。為了評估測量位置的影響，將開發兩種穿戴式設備，即臂戴式設備和頸戴式設備，並分別建模。這些設備將應用於健康受試者和心血管疾病患者，以評估傳感器和模型在不同心血管系統上的表現。最後，基於臨床資料集，我們將探索由機器學習引導的傳感器模組縮減策略，以實現功耗顯著降低的新傳感器平台。這項研究匯集了靈活傳感設備、穿戴式平台和生理建模方面的創新，在基礎層面和新應用方面產生了新知識。

14211224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14211224.value: 基於線照明時間聚焦的高通量 3D 奈米加工

14211224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14211224.value: This proposal aims to develop a high-throughput line-illumination-based laser fabrication platform for (1) two-photon lithography (TPL) and (2) dye-free implosion fabrication. To achieve the goal, a programmable line pattern is generated by spatially and temporally focusing a femtosecond laser via a digital micromirror device (DMD). As the DMD can be rapidly updated at a speed up to 22.7 kHz, high-speed 3D printing can be realized with a target printing speed of 24.5M voxels/sec with substantially improve axial resolution and grayscale control. Nanoscale 3D printing has been realized via TPL. The implosion fabrication method (i.e., deposition of nanoparticles via linking dye molecules that are bound to water-swellable hydrogels via two-photon reactions, followed by volume shrinkage) further expands the material library with improved resolution. However, both processes are limited by the point-by-point serial scanning procedure, which is inherently slow and expensive. While parallel processing methods have been proposed, e.g., use of microlens arrays or spatial light modulators, they are often limited to fabricating periodic structures or have compromised resolution. Accordingly, there is a compelling need to develop new fabrication methods with improved throughput and flexibility without compromising the fabrication resolution. To realize high precision and high-throughput 3D laser patterning, we will first develop a line-illumination laser fabrication platform, where the laser intensity can be precisely controlled along a spatially and temporally focused line via a DMD. During printing, an XYZ stage moves continuously in synchronization with the DMD, which rapidly switches the designed patterns at 22.7 kHz. To optimize and study the nanofabrication process, we will (1) develop parametric models to deterministically link the performance to important laser and system parameters, (2) custom-synthesize two-photon resins as well as hydrogel scaffolds, and (3) develop a new 3D pump-probe spectroscopy system to investigate the laser patterning process in-situ. Lastly, we will fabricate and characterize different 3D metamaterial structures and nanoscale functional devices, e.g., coaxial nano-laser array, to demonstrate the material generality, function and resolution of the nanofabrication platform. The result of this work will substantially improve the axial resolution and grayscale control of parallel TPL as well as enhance the fundamental understanding of laser patterning and material deposition processes in the hydrogel-based nanofabrication platform, which presents tremendous advantages for fabricating large-scale complex structures and generates impact in the nanomanufacturing industry. In addition, the PPS system may find important applications in studying materials and structures with ultrahigh resolution and sensitivity. 該提案旨在開發一種基於高通量線照明的雷射製造平台，用於（1）雙光子光刻（TPL）和（2）無染料內爆製造。為了實現這一目標，透過數位微鏡裝置 (DMD) 在空間和時間上聚焦飛秒雷射來產生可編程線條圖案。由於DMD可以以高達22.7kHz的速度快速更新，因此可以實現高速3D列印，目標列印速度為24.5M體素/秒，並大幅提高軸向解析度和灰階控制。 奈米級3D列印已透過TPL實現。內爆製造方法（即連接染料分子沉積奈米顆粒，這些分子透過雙光子反應與水膨脹水凝膠結合，然後體積收縮）進一步擴大了材料庫，並提高了分辨率。 然而，這兩個過程都受到逐點串行掃描過程的限制，該掃描過程本質上是緩慢且昂貴的。雖然已經提出了並行處理方法，例如使用微透鏡陣列或空間光調製器，但它們通常僅限於製造週期性結構或具有妥協的分辨率。因此，迫切需要開發具有改進的產量和靈活性而不損害製造解析度的新製造方法。 為了實現高精度和高通量的3D雷射圖案化，我們將首先開發一個線照明雷射製造平台，其中可以透過DMD沿著空間和時間聚焦線精確控制雷射強度。在列印過程中，XYZ 平台與 DMD 同步連續移動，以 22.7 kHz 快速切換設計圖案。為了優化和研究奈米製造過程，我們將（1）開發參數模型，以確定性地將性能與重要的雷射和系統參數聯繫起來，（2）定制合成雙光子樹脂以及水凝膠支架，以及（3 ）開發新型 3D 泵浦探針光譜(PPS)系統用於研究原位雷射圖案化過程。最後，我們將製造並表徵不同的3D超材料結構和奈米級功能元件，例如同軸奈米雷射陣列，以展示奈米製造平台的材料通用性、功能和解析度。 這項工作的結果將大大提高並行TPL 的軸向分辨率和灰度控制，並增強對基於水凝膠的奈米加工平台中雷射圖案化和材料沉積過程的基本理解，這對於製造大規模複雜結構具有巨大的優勢並對奈米製造業產生影響。此外，PPS系統可能在研究具有超高解析度和靈敏度的材料和結構方面有重要的應用。

14211324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14211324.value: SLOAN: 先進封裝的基板佈局優化

14211324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14211324.value: 技術節點的進步為半導體產業在維持系統單晶片 (SoC) 設計的摩爾定律方面帶來了挑戰。為了解決這個問題，系統級封裝（SiP）技術已成為一種有前途的解決方案，允許透過異構整合來整合不同的晶片，以優化整體系統性能。台積電、三星和英特爾等領先代工廠正在積極開發各種先進的晶圓級封裝技術，以利用這一趨勢。在先進的晶圓級封裝中，多個重新分佈層(RDL) 用於將多個晶片組合在一個封裝內，在重新組織晶片和I/O 焊盤之間的互連方面發揮著至關重要的作用。在這個專案中，我們引入了 SLOAN，這是一種用於高級封裝的基板佈局最佳化框架，旨在解決與佈線效率和可靠性相關的挑戰。 在這個專案的第一個方面，我們專注於優化 SiP 內大規模重新分佈層 (RDL) 的佈線。為了有效地將 RDL 資源用於緊湊型佈線解決方案，我們採用不規則的過孔結構，使過孔能夠放置在任意位置。隨著問題規模大幅升級，充分利用路由資源成為一項複雜的任務，挑戰隨之而來。此外，許多先前的方法在考慮佈線之前確定過孔位置，這可能導致佈線效率較低。為了克服這些缺點，SLOAN 採用了一種基於分層分區的演算法，該演算法透過規劃和佈線結合了不規則的 RDL。 我們專案的第二個面向涉及超大型 2.5D 晶圓級封裝，這是一種將大量先進晶片整合到大型矽中介層上的流行解決方案。由於掩模版的限制，這些中介層需要使用多個掩模來製造，從而需要針對由不同掩模創建的相鄰子區域的對準技術。現有演算法很難處理掩模拼接區域的特殊設計規則，通常無法產生高品質的佈線解決方案。為了彌合標準封裝和超大型封裝之間的差距，SLOAN 引入了專為掩模拼接區域設計的快速佈線演算法，確保基於精心規劃的網路端點的最佳佈線。 最後，隨著晶圓級封裝的尺寸不斷增大以容納更多晶片，出現了兩個重大問題：金屬密度不平衡以及製造過程中因氣泡導致的金屬表面不均勻。 SLOAN 透過引入「脫氣形狀」來解決這些挑戰，「脫氣形狀」是帶有許多孔的大型金屬部件，旨在促進蒸汽逸出，而不干擾電線和通孔等其他金屬部件的放置。傳統的設計流程常常難以在 RDL 佈線後插入脫氣形狀，從而導致違反設計規則，需要耗時的手動調整。為了簡化這個過程，SLOAN 引入了一種稱為脫氣和 RDL 佈線協同優化 (DRCO) 的方法來簡化設計和優化過程。

14211524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14211524.value: 應用於未來相干光接入網的神經網絡多參數監測技術

14211524.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14211524.value: Prof Huang, Chaoran Prof Tsang, Hon Ki

14211524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14211524.value: The advent of optical access networks has revolutionized the capabilities of wired and wireless communications, enabling bandwidth-intensive applications to flourish. However, the increasing number of users and transmission capacity pose unprecedented challenges in network management and operation, necessitating more complex and flexible approaches. Effective monitoring is crucial for detecting impairments that can degrade the quality of service, identifying bottlenecks, and ensuring smooth functioning of the network while optimizing the use of resources. Conventional monitoring methods rely on either analytic approaches or added prior information, but they are limited in tolerance requirements and complexity. As an alternative, machine learning aided methods have gained popularity due to their high performance, flexibility, and adaptability. However, existing monitoring methods struggle to meet the fine-grained flexibility requirements and handle the growing number of parameter variations in complex dynamic networks. To address these limitations, we propose leveraging the power of deep learning to develop a regressor that combines deep learning with transfer learning, ensuring high efficiency and low complexity. Our primary objective is to achieve higher resolution monitoring in fine-grained rate flexible access networks. For the next generation access network based on wavelength-division multiplexing, optical frequency combs offer a promising solution as carrier sources due to their ability to support numerous channels. However, many existing comb generation approaches suffer from insufficient output power due to different constraints. To overcome this challenge, we have proposed an all-optical Talbot amplifier. This amplifier not only addresses the power issue but also supports dynamic networking by providing enhanced flexibility in controlling the mode spacing and output carrier wavelengths. The increased flexibility results in simultaneous changes in optical and electrical system parameters, necessitating efficient monitoring of these changes. In this project, we develop a comprehensive joint monitoring system by integrating numerical methods and experimental measurements into a multi-label neural network solution. This approach enables efficient monitoring of the changes in system parameters. Additionally, to achieve multi-parameter monitoring at intermediate network nodes with limited hardware complexity, we propose using photonic reservoir computing, a special type of photonic neural network. We will investigate the implementation methods of photonic reservoir computing and characterize crucial hardware parameters to ensure effective monitoring in the network. Overall, this project aims to address the limitations of conventional monitoring methods by leveraging deep learning and photonic reservoir computing. By developing efficient monitoring solutions, we can enhance the management and operation of adaptive and flexible communication networks. 光接入網的來臨徹底改變了有線和無線通信的能力,讓需要大頻寬的應用得以蓬勃發展。然而,用戶數量和傳輸能力的增加,給網路管理和運營帶來了前所未有的挑戰,需要採用更複雜和靈活的方法。有效的監測對於發現可能影響服務質量的故障、識別瓶頸並確保網路順利運行而優化資源使用至關重要。 傳統的監測方法依賴分析方法或先驗信息,但對於容忍度要求和複雜性有限制。相反,機器學習輔助的方法由於其高性能、靈活性和適應性而受到歡迎。然而,現有的監測方法難以滿足細粒度靈活性要求,也無法處理複雜動態網路中日益增長的參數變化。為了解決這些局限性,我們提出利用深度學習的力量開發一個結合深度學習和遷移學習的回歸器,確保高效率和低複雜度。我們的主要目標是在細粒度可變速率接入網中實現更高分辨率的監測。 對於基於波分多路複用的下一代接入網,光頻梳作為載波源是一個有前景的解決方案,因為它們能夠支持大量信道。然而,許多現有的梳子產生方法由於各種限制而存在輸出功率不足的問題。為了解決這一挑戰,我們提出了一種全光塔博特放大器。這個放大器不僅解決了功率問題,而且通過提供對模式間距和輸出載波波長的控制,支持動態網路。靈活性的增加導致光學和電氣系統參數的同步變化,需要有效的監測這些變化。 在本項目中,我們通過將數值方法和實驗測量集成到多標籤神經網路解決方案中,開發了一個全面的聯合監測系統。這種方法可以有效地監測系統參數的變化。此外,為了在中間網路節點實現低硬件複雜度的多參數監測,我們提出使用光子儲備計算,這是一種特殊的光子神經網路。我們將研究光子儲備計算的實現方法,並表征關鍵的硬件參數,以確保網路中的有效監測。 總的來說,本項目旨在通過利用深度學習和光子儲備計算來克服傳統監測方法的局限性。通過開發高效的監測解決方案,我們可以增強自適應和靈活通信網路的管理和運營。

14211824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14211824.value: 機器學習驅動的電路時序預測與優化

14211824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14211824.value: As an important drivers of technology innovation and economic progress, integrated circuits (ICs) are making our lives more convenient in every aspect. Electronic design automation (EDA) is essential for designing such ICs with billions of transistors and wires. As one of the core performance metrics, timing is used to reflect how fast ICs can operate. In digital ICs, the timing performance can determine their clock frequency. For several decades, the timing performance enhancement in the IC design has been driven by the improvement of manufacturing technology and the increasing number of pipeline stages. As manufacturing technology advances into the nanometer era, the shrinking transistor size results in undesirable challenges in timing optimization. On one hand, the timing prediction is more challenging due to the increasing manufacturing deviations. On the other hand, the timing optimization has been increasingly difficult due to larger and larger solution space and the time-consuming signoff tool. In this project, we will leverage our knowledge on machine learning, to help circuit timing prediction and optimization in the advanced EDA flow. The proposed framework adopts three key factors to address the challenge. Firstly, the framework integrates an accurate timing predictor into the traditional logic synthesis stage. Secondly, the framework can predict restructure-tolerant timing performance in the physical synthesis stage. Last but not least, our framework will explore how we can further optimize timing in the EDA flow. We will partner with mainland leading hardware design company Huawei HiSilicon on this topic. The academia-industry collaboration promises innovative and high-risk academic research coupled with realistic industry data/benchmarks, and timely technology transfer through the companies can benefit the EDA community and the 300 billion semiconductor industry. The project will also contribute to the education plan, including curriculum development, undergraduate/-graduate student training, and research mentoring. 作為技術創新和經濟進步的重要驅動力，集成電路（IC）在各個方面使我們的生活變得更加便利。電子設計自動化（EDA）對於設計擁有數十億個晶體管和導線的集成電路至關重要。作為核心性能指標之一，時序用來反映集成電路的運行速度。在數位集成電路中，時序性能可以決定它們的時鐘頻率。在過去幾十年中，集成電路設計中的時序性能提升主要依賴於製造技術的改進和管線階段數量的增加。隨著製造技術進入納米時代，晶體管尺寸的縮小導致了時序優化方面的挑戰。一方面，隨著製造偏差的增加，時序預測變得更加困難。另一方面，由於解決方案空間越來越大以及耗時的簽核工具，時序優化變得越來越困難。 在本項目中，我們將利用機器學習的知識，幫助在先進的EDA流程中進行電路時序預測和優化。提出的框架採用三個關鍵因素來應對這些挑戰。首先，該框架將準確的時序預測器集成到傳統邏輯綜合階段。其次，該框架可以預測物理綜合階段中對重構的容忍時序性能。最後但同樣重要的是，我們的框架將探索如何進一步優化EDA流程中的時序。 學術界和產業界的合作承諾將創新和高風險的學術研究與現實的行業數據/基準相結合，並通過公司的及時技術轉移來使EDA社區和3000億美元的半導體行業受益。該項目還將有助於教育計劃，包括課程開發、本科/研究生培訓和研究指導。

14211924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14211924.value: 具有可重構推進器的混合繩索驅動並聯機器人

14211924.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14211924.value: Prof Carricato, Marco Prof CHIRARATTANANON, Pakpong

14211924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14211924.value: Cable-driven parallel robots (CDPRs) are a type of parallel mechanism that has attractive advantages over traditional parallel and serial mechanisms, including high payload to weight ratio, large potential workspace, ease of reconfiguration and setup. This has led to a wide range of applications within building construction, service maintenance, agriculture, and even off-shore works. However, the widespread deployment of CDPRs in the real-world is restricted by its limited workspace. The tension constraint in cables and the pose-varying cable direction vectors limit the wrenches that a CDPR can produce. Hence, to maintain a required wrench-feasible workspace, the cable attachment points need to be very carefully designed and additional cables are typically preferred or even required. However, an increased number of cables inevitably increases the possibility of cable interferences, hence also limiting the CDPR’s workspace. In this project, a new type of hybrid CDPR that combines reconfigurable thrusters (RT) with CDPRs (RT-CDPRs) is proposed. RT-CDPRs consist of three primary components: 1) a set of cables that to actuate the end-effector in parallel; 2) a set of one or more thrusters like the propellors that actuate unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) mounted on the end-effector; and 3) reconfiguration mechanisms that allow the thrusters to be dynamically positioned and oriented. The uniqueness of the project include: 1) the hybrid cable-thruster setup combines the advantages of CDPRs (higher payload and quicker response) and UAVs (increased compactness, mobility and actuation efficiency); 2) the reconfiguration of thrusters further enhances the robot workspace while reducing the number of thrusters; 3) the proposed design and synthesis aims to explore the different types of configurations within the family of RT-CDPRs; and 4) the study of the practical issues related to RT-CDPRs for future real-world applications, including modelling, calibration and hardware implementation. The following major challenges will be addressed in this project: 1) increased complexity of RT-CDPR system model introduced by the reconfiguring thrusters and cables; 2) the design and realisation of suitable mechanisms for the reconfiguration of thrusters for CDPRs; 3) the design of the entire arrangement of RT-CDPRs, including the synthesis of the family of RT-CDPRs and location of reconfiguring thrusters and cable attachments; 4) the planning and control of the new type of RT-CDPRs, including the thrusters and reconfiguration; and 5) the hardware demonstration of practicality of RT-CDPRs to show the potential for future real-world applications. 繩驅並聯機器人（CDPRs）採用並聯機構方式，與傳統的並聯和串聯機構相比，具有諸多優勢，包括較高的負載自重比、較大的工作空間、易於重建和安裝。這些優點使其在建築施工、服務維護、農業甚至海上作業等領域中得到了廣泛應用。然而，CDPRs 在實際應用中的廣泛部署受限於其有限的工作空間。並且，驅動繩索中的張力約束以及隨姿態變化的繩索方向向量限制了CDPR能夠產生的力和力矩。因此，為了維持所需的力可行工作空間，需要非常謹慎地設計繩索的連接點，並且通常需要或更傾向於使用額外的繩索。然而，繩索數量的增加不可避免地增加了繩索互相干擾的可能性，也限制了CDPR的工作空間。在本計畫中，提出了一種新型的混合CDPR，該機器人將可重建推進器（RT）與CDPR結合（RT-CDPRs）。 RT-CDPRs 由三個主要組件組成：1）一組用於驅動末端執行器的並聯繩索；2）一組一個或多個類似於無人機（UAV）推進器的推進器，這些推進器裝置在末端執行器上；3）允許推進器動態定位和定向的重構機制。此專案的獨特性包括：1）混合的繩索-推進器結構結合了CDPRs（更高的負載能力和更快的響應）與UAVs（更高的緊湊性、移動性和驅動效率）的優點；2 ）推進器的可重構性進一步擴展了機器人工作空間，同時減少了繩索的數量；3）提出的設計方法能夠探索RT-CDPRs系列中的不同配置類型；4）研究與RT-CDPRs相關的實際問題，包括建模、校準和硬體實現。本計畫將解決以下主要挑戰：1）包含可重構推進器和繩索的RT-CDPR系統模型的複雜性增加；2）設計和實現適合CDPRs的推進器重構機制；3）RT-CDPRs的整體佈局設計，包括RT-CDPRs系列的整合以及可重構推進器和繩索的定位；4）新型RT-CDPRs的規劃和控制，包括推進器和重構機制；5）RT-CDPRs的硬體實際演示，旨在展示其在未來實際應用中的潛力。

14212424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14212424.value: 基於2D材料器件的低功耗雙目3D立體視覺和運動預測

14212424.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14212424.value: Dr Chen, Chunsheng Prof Zhou, Peng

14212424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14212424.value: 隨著半導體微型化達到物理極限，摩爾定律已經走到盡頭。 傳統材料難以滿足日益增長的計算需求，二維 （2D） 材料憑藉其超薄的厚度和優異的電子特性，已成為继傳統硅基半導體材料后有希望的候選材料。 超薄二維半導體有利於實現高效的靜電柵極調製和陡峭的亞閾值擺幅，從而实现利用低功耗場效應晶體管 （FET）進行類腦計算。 二維材料的大表面體積比使其能夠對外部刺激做出更快速的反應。 此外，二維材料具有可調的能帶和強烈的電子-光子相互作用，使其非常適合多種色彩感測。 二維光電晶體管具有有效地類比三個腦葉的潛力。 枕葉主要控制視覺皮層的視覺感知，而頂葉負責處理 3D 空間資訊和導航。 此外，額葉在高級認知和邏輯預測中起著至關重要的作用。 基於二維材料的視覺系統發展迅速，能夠有效提高信息處理能力，減少了串擾，實現了超快响應。 最近，研究人員成功地將感知、記憶和計算整合在一起，實現了對運動的動態感知。 然而，大多數研究都局限於二維運動平面，極大地限制了它們的適用性。為了克服這一限制，引入雙目視覺來建立三維立體視覺，從而能夠獲取三維空間位置、完整的結構圖和更高的解析度。 本项目目標是開發能夠實現雙目立體視覺的低功耗視覺二維感測器陣列。利用雙目立體視覺，可以輕鬆實現三維空間定位、車輛識別甚至短期運動預測。我們已經制定了技術上可行的三步計劃。 首先，我們將重點開發一種使用二維材料的光電浮柵陣列。 二維材料通道同時受到電和光刺激調控，實現類似枕葉功能的圖像記憶和計算。其次，利用兩個視覺陣列類比雙目視覺，基於雙目視差構建三維立體視覺，利用三角測量原理確定物體的三維座標。 將雙目資訊與輕量級卷積神經網路（CNN）融合，與類似頂葉功能的單目視覺相比，識別準確率更高、功耗更低。 最後，雙目感知陣列將實現類似額葉功能的即時運動感知和短期運動預測。 利用二維異質結構複製三個腦葉的功能，可以增進我們對大腦機制的理解，促進人工智慧的發展。

14212924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14212924.value: 透過波束成形報告實現無所不在的 Wi-Fi 感測：從測量到系統

14212924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14212924.value: 近年來， Wi-Fi 感測系統有了廣泛的應用。 這些系統將利用 Wi-Fi 訊號實現無所不在的感測，適用於室內定位、人類活動識別等應用。然而，目前的 Wi-Fi 感測系統嚴重依賴基於頻道狀態資訊（CSI）來了解訊號傳播特性。 然而，CSI 的可用性在商業 Wi-Fi 裝置中極為有限， 嚴重限制了基於 CSI 的 Wi-Fi 感測應用在 現實世界的應用。 為了應對這些挑戰，我們提出了一種新的方法來實現無所不在的 Wi-Fi 感測。這項研究將對壓縮波束形成報告（CBR）進行深入分析並在各種商用硬體平台上進行四個應用案例驗證，包括 Wi-Fi 裝置定位、人體軌跡追蹤、 手勢識別和阿茲海默症監測。

14213324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14213324.value: 人形機械人學習類人全身操作技能至今仍是一項極具挑戰的任務。本研究提出了一種創新的從人類語言-具身（言傳身教）示教中學習和微調人形機械人類人全身操作技能的方法。該方法利用多模態人類示範數據，不僅將人類視為數據源，還將其視為異構人形機械人的數字人基準模型。提出了三項關鍵技術：（1）協同先驗學習：降低高冗餘高自由度人形機械人的動作空間維度，以生成真實的全身操作運動數據，用於進一步的技能學習。（2）技能學習和跨具身遷移：學習將分配的任務分解為基於數字人模型的協同先驗組合，並考慮人類與人形機械人協同先驗間的差異，將此策略遷移到特定人形機械人。（3）在線互動反饋微調：利用預訓練大語言模型（LLM），通過人類語言和具身反饋在線微調技能策略。該技術和系統將在實驗室和實際環境中，通過廚房場景的典型任務進行測試和驗證。

14300024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14300024.value: 偶極稠環芳烴的設計、合成與應用

14300024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14300024.value: The proposed study aims to create novel dipolar π-systems by incorporating a five-membered ring and a seven-membered ring at the two ends of a polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon (PAH). These unique π-systems promise to yield organic materials with intriguing electronic properties and molecular packing arrangements. This proposal builds upon our previous research, which focused on utilizing seven- and five-membered carbocycles as electron donors and acceptors, respectively, in polycyclic aromatic frameworks to develop organic semiconductors. The basic designing concept for this proposal is that when both a five-membered ring and a seven-membered ring are simultaneously introduced to a PAH, dipolar π-molecules can be formed, with the positive charge localized on the seven-membered ring and the negative charge localized on the five-membered ring. This unique charge distribution gives rise to electronic properties that are not found in the hexagonal analogs of these molecules. The best-known example of dipolar PAH molecules containing both five and seven-membered rings is azulene, which possesses a significant dipole moment and exhibits intense absorption of light with much longer wavelength than its isomer, naphthalene, and anti-Kasha fluorescence. Incorporation of azulene units in larger π-systems results in functional π-molecules that harness the unique electronic properties of azulene for a wide range of applications. However, dipolar PAHs beyond azulene-containing π-systems are still rare. Unlike azulene, where the five and seven-membered rings are directly fused, the proposed dipolar PAHs feature a separation of these rings by six-membered rings. This arrangement increases the distance between the positive and negative charges in the dipolar ionic resonance form. The presence of multiple aromatic six-membered rings stabilizes the dipolar ionic resonance forms. As a result, the proposed PAHs have greater dipole moments and narrower HOMO-LUMO gaps than azulene as indicated by DFT calculations. We plan to develop organic semiconductors based on these PAHs because their large dipole moments can enhance π-π interactions with dipole-dipole interactions. Additionally, their narrow HOMO-LUMO gaps make them promising candidates for near-infrared (NIR) dyes, with potential applications in biomedical imaging, optical sensing, and solar energy conversion. The proposed dipolar PAHs will be synthesized on the basis of the reported synthesis of structurally related compounds, and their electronic properties and π-π interactions will be investigated using various techniques. Furthermore, we plan to fabricate organic field-effect transistors using these organic semiconductors and explore their potential for NIR light sensing. 我們提出的研究計劃旨在通過在稠環芳烴的兩端分別引入五元環和七元環，創造新型的偶極π體系。這些獨特的π體系具有有趣的電子性質和分子堆積方式，有望產生新穎的有機功能材料。此計劃以我們之前的研究為基礎。該研究通過向稠環芳香族骨架中引入七元和五元碳環分別作為電子給體和受體，以開發有機半導體材料。 本研究計劃的基本設計理念是，當稠環芳烴中同時引入五元環和七元環時，可以形成偶極π分子，其中正電荷集中在七元環上，負電荷集中在五元環上。這種獨特的電荷分佈產生有趣的電子性質，是這些分子的六元環類似物所不具備的。包含五元和七元環的偶極稠環芳烴分子中最著名的例子是薁，它具有顯著的偶極矩。與其同分異構體萘相比，它強烈吸收更長波長的光，並表現出反卡莎規則的螢光特性。將薁單元引入更大的π體系中，可以得到功能性π分子，這些分子利用薁的獨特電子性質，在多種應用中發揮重要作用。然而，除了包含薁的π體系外，其他偶極稠環芳烴仍然很少見。 與薁當中五元環和七元環直接相連不同，擬研究的偶極稠環芳烴通過六元環將二者分隔開。這種排列增加了偶極離子共振式中正電荷和負電荷之間的距離。同時多個芳香六元環的存在又能穩定偶極離子共振式。因此，根據密度泛函理論計算，擬研究的稠環芳烴具有比薁更大的偶極矩，其最高佔據分子軌道與最低空分子軌道之間的能隙也更窄。我們計劃基於這些稠環芳烴來開發有機半導體材料。它們的大偶極矩可以通過偶極-偶極相互作用來增強π-π相互作用。此外，它們的窄能隙使它們成為近紅外染料的理想候選分子，在生物醫學成像、光學傳感和太陽能轉換等領域具有潛在應用。根據結構相關化合物的已報導的合成方法，我們為擬研究的偶極稠環芳烴設計了合成路線。我們將實施這些合成路線，並使用各種技術對其電子性質和π-π相互作用進行研究。此外，我們還計劃利用這些有機半導體來製備有機場效應晶體管，並探索它們在近紅外光傳感方面的潛力。

14300524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14300524.value: 結構不同的有機硫酸鹽的物理特性：氣溶膠的表面張力和有機硫酸鹽在氣溶膠表面與液體中的分布

14300524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14300524.value: Organosulfates (OSs) have been identified as significant constituents of atmospheric aerosols, potentially influencing aerosol physiochemical properties. Comprising a sulfate ester group with diverse carbon numbers and functional groups, OSs exhibit varying affinities for the air-water interface. Depending on their surface activities and concentrations, OSs can effectively reduce surface tension compared to that of pure water droplets, thereby affecting the water uptake and cloud condensation nuclei activity of atmospheric aerosols. Beyond chemical structure influencing surface activity, recent experimental and modelling studies highlight the role of aerosol size and concentration in governing the surface tension of aerosols. This implies that surface tension obtained from bulk solution measurements may differ from observations in aerosols characterized by large surface-to-volume ratios, where bulk-surface partitioning prevails. This proposed study aims to investigate how the structural features of OSs, along with aerosol size and concentration, contribute to surface tension and bulk-surface partitioning in aerosols, explaining differences observed between bulk solutions and aerosols. This study adopts a laboratory-based bottom-up framework, where we will measure the surface tension of a variety of atmospherically relevant OS aerosols, consisting of a single OS and water, at different sizes and concentrations using a single-particle levitating method. This involves coupling a linear quadrupole electrodynamic balance (EDB) to a quasi-elastic light scattering (QELS) technique. Comparative analysis with bulk solution measurements using a pendant drop tensiometer will examine size and concentration dependencies of surface tension in OS aerosols. Complementary to experimental work, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and a group contribution-based thermodynamic model will be employed to offer molecular-level explanation and insights into how OSs, particularly the sulfur ester group, modulate the surface tension and partitioning of species in aerosols across varying sizes and concentrations. Integrating experimental with modelling efforts, this proposed study aims to understand the interplay among OS structural features, aerosol size, and concentration that governs the surface tension of aerosols and to quantify the contribution of each of these factors to the surface tension. The research outcomes will also help assess the applicability of surface tension data obtained from bulk solutions to aerosols, and refine model predictions related to the surface tension of atmospheric aerosols, especially those containing OSs and diverse chemical species. 有機硫酸鹽（OS）已被確定為大氣氣溶膠的重要成分，能影響氣溶膠的物理和化學性質。 OS 具有不同的碳數和硫酸酯基團，能對空氣-氣溶膠界面表現出不同的表面張力。根據其表面活性和濃度，與純水滴相比，OS可以有效低降氣溶膠的表面張力，進而影響氣溶膠的吸水性和雲凝結性。最近的實驗和建模研究還強調了氣溶膠的大小和濃度在控制氣溶膠表面張力方面的作用。這意味著從溶液測量中獲得的表面張力可能與以大表面與體積比為特徵的氣溶膠中的觀察結果不同。這項研究旨在研究氣溶膠的大小和濃度如何影響氣溶膠的表面張力和體表分配，解釋溶液和氣溶膠之間觀察的差異。這項研究從採用基於實驗室的自下而上的框架，我們將使用單粒子懸浮方法測量各種與大氣相關的OS氣溶膠的表面張力，這些氣溶膠由單一OS和水組成，具有不同氣溶膠的大小和濃度。這涉及將電動天平 (EDB) 與準彈性光散射 (QELS) 光譜儀結合。將檢查 OS 氣溶膠中表面張力的大小和濃度依賴性。作為實驗工作補充，分子動力模擬(MD)和熱力學模型將用於提供分子水平的解釋，了解OS（特別是硫酯基團）如何調節氣溶膠中的表面張力和物質分配。這項研究將實驗與模型工作相結合，旨在了解 OS 結構特徵、氣溶膠大小和控制氣溶膠表面張力的濃度之間的相互作用，並量化不同的因素對氣溶膠的表面張力的貢獻。研究成果也將有助於評估從溶液獲得的表面張力數據對氣溶膠的適用性，並完善與大氣氣溶膠表面張力相關的模型預測，特別是那些含有有機物和多種化學物質的氣溶膠。

14300724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14300724.value: 高地植被甲基汞的產生和降解的生態控制機制

14300724.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14300724.value: Prof Chow, Alex Tat-shing Prof Li, Xiangdong

14300724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14300724.value: Global mercury emission is currently increased due to various anthropogenic activities (e.g. coal-burning and gold mining). Mercury is of global concern because this volatile metal can be transported over long distances in the atmosphere and deposited onto the landscapes as air or rain, essentially contaminating all earth’s surface, especially vegetated landscapes because foliage can take up mercury gas directly through stomatal opening. Importantly, a small fraction of deposited inorganic mercury can be microbially transformed into a highly toxic organic form called methylmercury under oxygen-depleted conditions such as lake, wetland, and coastal sediments. Upon its production, methylmercury can efficiently accumulate in the natural food webs and go up with the food chain, often leading to an unsafe level in high trophic level animals, posing a health risk to humans and wildlife through dietary consumption. In the past four decades, many studies have investigated methylmercury production and bioaccumulation in aquatic ecosystems but there is a paucity of information on the environmental controls on methylmercury in the terrestrial vegetated ecosystems (e.g., forest, shrubland, grassland) where they are a major sink of atmospheric mercury while soils are relatively oxic and well-drained. The proposed work will tackle this important scientific question in an upland vegetated ecosystem in Hong Kong, China, where our team has recently observed relatively high methylmercury levels in soil as well as efficient methylmercury bioaccumulation and biomagnification in the terrestrial food webs. However, a large, yet not fully understood, variation of methylmercury among the upland sites prompted us to ask what would be the major factors controlling the methylmercury production and degradation in these upland forest ecosystems. The proposed project will reveal novel mechanisms on methylmercury production and degradation in upland ecosystems through (i) extensive sampling and mercury analyses to examine the distribution of biogeochemical hotspots, (ii) molecular measurements of key mercury-related genes and microbial community analysis to reveal the major microbial players in mediating mercury cycling in uplands, and (iii) stable mercury isotope determination to assess the degree of methylmercury photodegradation among upland sites. The results will demonstrate the key factors on the methylmercury production and degradation and how methylmercury enters the natural food webs, and the results can be applicable to other forested ecosystems around the subtropics and tropics. The findings allow us to devise future plans and guidelines to reduce the uptake of methylmercury by terrestrial animals (e.g., birds and mammals) in these ecologically valuable environments. 現代世界全球汞排放量增加主要是由於各種原因人類活動（例如燃煤和金礦開採）。汞可以運輸在大氣中長距離傳播並以空氣或雨水的形式沉積到景觀上，基本上污染了整個地球表面。重要的是，一小部分無機汞可以透過微生物轉化為劇毒的有機物汞，在湖泊、濕地等缺氧條件下，會形成甲基汞。一旦產生，甲基汞就可以有效地積聚在天然食物網並隨食物鏈上升，往往導致高濃度的不安全水平，透過飲食對人類和野生動物構成健康風險。在過去的四十年中，許多研究調查了甲基汞在水生生態系中的生產和生物累積，但很少研究關於陸地植被中甲基汞環境生態控制（例如森林、灌木叢、草地），它們是主要的匯大氣中的汞含量較高，而土壤的含氧量相對較高且排水良好。 擬議的工作將在高地植被中解決這一重要的科學問題，我們的團隊在中國香港的高地植被生態系統最近觀察到相對較高的土壤中的甲基汞含量以及甲基汞生物累積性和這些陸地食物網中的生物放大作用。然而，規模雖大但尚未完全了解，高地地區甲基汞的變化促使我們思考什麼是控制甲基汞產生和降解的主要因素。 擬議的項目將闡明甲基汞生產的新機制和透過(i) 廣泛採樣和汞造成高地生態分析以檢查生物地球化學熱點的分佈，（ii）分子測量與汞相關的關鍵基因和微生物群落分析以揭示介導高地汞循環的主要微生物參與者，以及 (iii) 穩定汞同位素測定評估甲基汞光降解程度高地站點之間。結果可以證明影響甲基汞的關鍵因素生產和降解以及甲基汞如何進入天然食物網，以及研究結果可適用於亞熱帶周圍的其他森林生態系統熱帶。研究結果還使我們能夠制定未來的計劃和指導方針，以減少陸生動物（如鳥類和哺乳動物）對甲基汞的吸收。

14300824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14300824.value: Climate change leads to more frequent wildland fires worldwide. Prolonged drought and hot temperature increase the likelihood of high-severity wildfires. Low-severity prescribed burn is an economical and effective forest management practice to reduce the susceptibility of forests to disastrous wildfire. In either high-severity wildfire or low-severity prescribed burn, wildland fire modifies the chemical composition and quantity of the natural organic matter (NOM) in forest ecosystems, converting polysaccharide and lignin rich and labile carbon pools to polycyclic aromatic and charcoal rich and relatively recalcitrant pyrogenic organic matter (PyOM). Yield, characteristics, and fate of pyrogenic organic carbon (PyOC) and nitrogen (PyON), including black carbon (BC) and black nitrogen (BN), play important ecological roles in the forest ecosystem recovery from wildland fires, as well as for constraining landscape-to-global C and N cycles. The overarching goal is to identify the environmental controlling factors that influence the abundance and distributions of these carbon pools in disturbed forest ecosystems. To determine the severity of a wildland fire, and the intensity and frequency of post-fire rainstorms on the characteristics of PyOM in forest ecosystems, our team at CUHK will collaborate with scientists from wildfire hotspot regions including US, Canada, Spain, Turkey, and Australia to conduct a systematic study integrating watershed-scale burning experiments, wildfire sampling, and mesocosm and laboratory studies with ultrahigh-resolution molecular-level characterization. With supports from our collaborators and our previous works, ash samples from different wildland fires have been collecting and will be used to compare PyOM generated from controlled burning conditions for identifying biogeochemical markers of BC and BN. Temporal dynamics of PyOM, in both vertical (i.e., infiltration) and lateral flows (i.e., runoffs), under different rainstorm patterns and hillslopes will be determined through mesocosm experiments. The stoichiometry and relative abundance of functional moieties of PyOM will be determined using Fourier-transform ion cyclotron resonance mass spectrometry and 1H liquid and 13C solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopies. Data obtained from these experiments will be synthesized to create a box model that can describe the production, distribution, and fate of PyOC, PyON, and nutrients in wildland fires. Results of this study will provide solid evidence illustrating contrasting effects of the climate-change induced high-severity wildfire and low-severity prescribed burn forest management practices on the biogeochemistry of PyOM. A better understanding C and N cycles in disturbed forest ecosystems is important for policy makers and resource managers to develop proactive strategies to protect our forest resources under the changing climate. 氣候變化導緻全球範圍內的野火頻率增加，長期乾旱和高溫增加了高強度野火發生的可能性。低強度的計劃性燃燒是一種經濟有效的森林管理實踐，有助於降低森林對災難性野火的易感性。無論是高強度的野火還是低強度的計劃性燃燒，野火都會改變森林生態系統中天然有機質（NOM）的化學組成和豐度，將富含多糖和木質素的易降解碳庫轉化爲富含多環芳香和木炭的相對難降解的熱解有機質（PyOM）。熱解有機碳（PyOC）和熱解有機氮（PyON）的産量、特徵和命運，包括黑碳（BC）和黑氮（BN），在森林生態系統從野火中恢復的過程中發揮着重要的生態作用，並在區域乃至全球的碳氮循環中起到約束作用。本研究的總體目標是識別影響這些碳庫在受擾森林生態系統中豐度和分佈的環境控製因素。 爲了確定野火的強度以及火後暴雨的強度和頻率對森林生態系統中PyOM特徵的影響，我們在香港中文大學（CUHK）的團隊將與來自美國、加拿大、西班牙、土耳其和澳大利亞等野火熱點地區的科學家合作，開展系統的研究。研究將結合流域尺度的燃燒實驗、野火採樣以及基於超高分辨率分子級表徵技術的中尺度和實驗室分析工作。在合作夥伴的支持以及團隊之前研究的基礎上，我們已收集了來自不同野火的灰燼樣本，這些樣本將用於比較在控製燃燒條件下生成的Py以識別BC和BN的生物地球化學標誌物。通過中尺度實驗，研究團隊將確定不同暴雨模式和坡度條件下PyOM的時間動態變化，包括垂直（如滲透）和水平流動（如徑流）。PyOM的化學計量學和相對豐度將通過傅裡葉變換離子回旋共振質譜和液體核磁氫譜及固體核磁碳譜進行測定。 基於上述實驗獲得的數據將被綜合起來，創建一個箱式模型，用於描述野火中PyOC、PyON及營養物質的生成、分佈和命運。該研究結果將爲氣候變化引發的高強度野火與低強度計劃性燃燒森林管理實踐對PyOM生物地球化學的相反效應提供有力証據。更好地理解受擾森林生態系統中的碳氮循環，對政策製定者和資源管理者製定積極的策略，以在氣候變化的背景下保護我們的森林資源具有重要意義。

14301724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14301724.value: 發展高效、精確的分子模擬模型來研究冷媒

14301724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14301724.value: The escalating dependence worldwide on air-conditioning has intensified the strain on our power grid infrastructures and exacerbated the challenges associated with global warming. A 2018 report by the International Energy Agency (IEA) projects the power consumption for air-conditioning to triple by 2050. The projected rise in the usage of these systems has significant implications for environmental impact including greenhouse gas emissions and ozone layer protection. In this context, the need for more environmentally friendly and energy-efficient refrigerants becomes paramount. The properties of refrigerants in their gaseous and liquid states, along with their coexistence properties, are exploited continuously in a cycle for the cooling process. Historically, the study of these properties has relied on experimental methods, which can be time-consuming, costly, and offer limited chemical details at the molecular level. Fortunately, molecular simulations present a complementary approach, allowing for atomistic-level understanding of refrigerant properties, especially when the experimental data is scarce or not yet available. The quality of a molecular simulation, however, depends on the accuracy and computational efficiency of the interactions between and within the refrigerant molecules (also collectively called the force field). While the previous molecular simulations have made notable contributions to our understanding of refrigerants on molecular scales, we believe our team can further improve the accuracy of the molecular models by explicitly including electronic polarizability, which is known to be important for the gas-liquid interfacial properties. The polarizability is most naturally described in quantum mechanical calculations, but these calculations are so computationally demanding that only small length/time scales are accessible. Our team possesses the expertise required to bridge the existing gap in the methodology for modeling refrigerants with polarizable force fields. We aim to develop “multi-scale” models in which reference data from expensive quantum calculations are utilized to parameterize more efficient but still accurate models. We also aim to integrate Gaussian process regression, a machine learning algorithm, with our simulation results to predict the properties of refrigerant blends more efficiently. Our preliminary results and experience in modeling different physical systems by molecular simulations have given us the confidence to make meaningful contributions to the molecular understanding of refrigerants, which may lead to fine-tuning or even breakthroughs in this important class of materials. Equally important, we are committed to sharing our simulation techniques, results, and reference data with the broader research community to facilitate collective progress in this area. 全球範圍內對空調的依賴不斷升級，這加劇了電網基礎設施的壓力，並使得全球暖化帶來的挑戰愈發嚴峻。國際能源總署 (IEA) 2018 年的一份報告預測，空調能耗預計到2050年將增至三倍。這些系統使用量的可預見性上升對環境具有重大影響，包括溫室氣體排放和臭氧層保護。在此背景下，對更環保、更節能的冷媒的需求變得更為迫切。 冷卻的循環過程中需要被不斷地利用冷媒在氣態和液態下的特性以及它們的共存特性。過去，這些特性的研究主要依賴於實驗方法，這些方法耗時長、成本高，而且在分子層面上提供的化學細節有限。幸運的是，分子模擬提供了一種補充方法，可以從原子層面了解冷媒的特性，特別是當實驗數據稀缺或尚未可用時。然而，分子模擬的品質取決於對冷媒分子之間和內部相互作用（也統稱為力場）描述的準確性和計算效率。 雖然先前的分子模擬對我們在分子尺度上理解冷媒做出了顯著貢獻，但我們相信我們的團隊可以透過顯式地加入電子極化來進一步提高分子模型的精確度，因為考慮電子極化對於氣液界面性質至關重要。極化率可以在量子力學計算中得到最自然地描述，但這些計算對運算要求極高，以至於只有對較小的長度或時間尺度才有可能進行。 我們的團隊擁有所需的專業知識，可以彌補現有利用可極化力場對冷媒進行建模的方法上的差距。我們的目標是開發「多尺度」模型，利用來自昂貴的量子化學計算的參考數據，來參數化更有效率但仍然精確的模型。我們還旨在將高斯過程回歸（一種機器學習演算法）與我們的模擬結果相結合，以更有效地預測冷媒混合物的特性。我們在透過分子模擬對不同物理系統進行建模方面的初步結果和經驗，使我們有信心為冷媒的分子層面理解做出有意義的貢獻，這可能會導致這一類重要材料的微調甚至突破。同樣重要的是，我們致力於與廣泛的研究界分享我們的模擬技術、結果和參考數據，以促進該領域的共同進步。

14302124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14302124.value: Asymptotic theory serves as a unifying theme in probability and statistics. The central limit theorem (CLT), a renowned classical result in this realm, states that the distribution of a sum of n independent and identically distributed random variables, when n is large, can be approximated by a normal distribution. Finite-sample error bounds for the CLT exist across various distributional distances. Similar approximation results extend to sums of independent random vectors in d-dimensional Euclidean space. These results play a pivotal role in approximate computations of large-sample probabilities from unknown populations, forming the basis for statistical inferences. In practical scenarios, data often exhibit dependence. One of the most powerful tools for establishing the asymptotic normality of dependent data is the martingale CLT. The martingale CLT provides a Lindeberg-type sufficient condition for the asymptotic normality of martingales with finite second moments. Under higher moment or boundedness conditions, researchers have established non-asymptotic error bounds in various distributional distances for the martingale CLT.
