To address those questions, we develop a multi-country multi-industry dynamic equilibrium model incorporating trade and capital accumulation to quantify the impact of trade cost reduction on economic growth by using various counterfactual experiments. This quantitative assessment aims to delineate the significant contribution of globalization to worldwide economic growth during the hyper-globalization era prior to the GFC and elucidate its importance in light of the emerging trend of de-globalization on the causes of post-crisis economic stagnation. In the contemporary global economic landscape, where globalization is at a crossroads due to protectionist policies and geopolitical tensions, understanding the nexus between globalization and economic growth assumes paramount significance. Our empirical evidence will substantiate the impact of globalization on economic growth, offering valuable insights for policymakers navigating trade complexities in the post-pandemic and post-GFC world. The project aligns with a broader literature addressing the sluggish productivity growth and economic stagnation after the GFC, pinpointing the role of slowed globalization in this context. 從 1980 年代中期到 2008 年全球金融危機爆發，全球化經歷了快速發展的階段，同時，已開發國家和大多數發展中國家在這一高速全球化時代經歷了強勁的經濟成長。然而，自全球金融危機以來，全球化逐漸失去動力，世界經濟成長也面臨停滯的風險。 本研究探討了全球化在塑造經濟成長的關鍵角色。該研究首先建立了全球金融危機前後全球化和經濟成長的典型性事實。我們的實證證據表明，主要經濟體的經濟成長率在高速全球化時代較高，但在全球金融危機後全球化放緩時大幅下降。 因此，高速全球化對全球金融危機前二十年的高經濟成長貢獻有多大？過去十年全球化放緩對全球經濟失速的貢獻有多大？如果貿易自由化維持與超全球化時期類似的速度，那麼全球金融危機後的全球經濟成長將會如何？ 為了解決這些問題，我們開發了一個包含貿易和資本累積的多國多產業動態均衡模型，透過各種反事實實驗來量化貿易成本降低對經濟成長的影響。這項定量評估旨在描述全球金融危機前高速全球化時代全球化對全球經濟成長的重大貢獻，並闡明其在去全球化趨勢對危機後經濟停滯原因的重要性。 在當代全球經濟格局中，由於保護主義政策和地緣政治緊張局勢，全球化正處於十字路口，了解全球化與經濟成長之間的關係至關重要。我們的實證證據將顯示全球化對經濟成長的影響，為政策制定者在後疫情時代和後全球金融危機時代應對貿易複雜性提供寶貴見解。該計畫與更廣泛的文獻一致，這些文獻探討了全球金融危機後生產力成長緩慢和經濟停滯的問題，並指出了全球化放緩在這種背景下的作用。

14500824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14500824.value: 一般交互固定效應多維面板數據模型的估計與推理

14500824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14500824.value: We consider a heterogeneous multi-dimensional (MD) panel data model with a general form of multi-level interactive fixed effects. In this model, the slope coefficients are allowed to be heterogeneous across the cross-sectional dimensions, and the multi-level interactive fixed effect is modeled through a latent factor structure consisting of both global factors and local factors. This model includes many commonly used MD panel data models as special cases. The parameter of interest is the expected value of the heterogeneous slope coefficients, which measures the average effects of the covariates on the dependent variable. We find that the mean group (MG) estimator's bias term is not asymptotically negligible in many cases and its convergence rate depends on the unknown truth. To address these two issues, we propose an efficient bias-corrected (BC) estimator and a uniformly valid inference procedure. The BC estimator is oracle efficient in the sense that it is asymptotically equivalent to that based on the true factors. The inference procedure is uniformly valid for a large class of data-generating processes (DGPs), including both homogeneous and heterogeneous cases. Preliminary simulations suggest that the new methods perform remarkably well in finite samples. In this project, we will systematically study the asymptotic properties of our new method. Monte Carlo simulations will be conducted to show the finite sample performance of our methods. Empirical applications will be provided to demonstrate the usefulness of our new methods. 我們考慮了一個異質性多維面板數據模型，該模型含有多層次交互固定效應。在此模型中，斜率系數允許在橫截面維度上具有異質性，交互固定效應是通過兩類不可觀測的潛在因子結構進行建模：全局因子和局部因子。該模型包括許多常用的多維面板數據模型作為特例。我們感興趣的參數是異質斜率系數的期望值，用於衡量協變量在因變量上的平均效應。我們發現均值估計量的偏差項在許多情況下不是漸近忽略的，而且其收斂率取決於數據如何產生。為了解決這兩個問題，我們提出了一種有效的偏差校正估計方法和一致有效的統計推斷方法。新的偏差校正後的估計量是有效的。從某種意義上說，它漸近上等同於潛在因子可觀測的情況。新的推理過程能適用於各種數據生成過程，包括同質性和異質性情況。初步模擬表明新方法在有限樣本中表現非常出色。在這個項目中， 我們將系統地研究我們新方法的漸近性質。蒙特卡洛模擬將用於展示我們方法的有限樣本性能。 我們並將提供實證應用來證明我們的新方法。

14500924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14500924.value: 即期流動性衡量及其在金融市場中的應用

14500924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14500924.value: Our research investigates liquidity - the ease with which assets are bought or sold without affecting their prices - a crucial element of financial market stability. Using high-frequency data, we're developing real-time liquidity measurement tools to understand the behaviour of liquidity providers and the systemic risk posed by high-frequency trading (HFT) algorithms, particularly during financial stress. To achieve this, we propose a model that separates an asset's observed price into fundamental values and deviations, using the latter to indicate liquidity. Despite challenges in estimation, such as small sample sizes and complex dynamics, we employ a method that creates a localized liquidity measure, which has shown promising results in preliminary simulations. Additionally, we explore the liquidity risk premium - the extra return investors demand for illiquid assets. Early findings indicate that extreme premiums coincide with major economic announcements, suggesting market stress during these periods. 我們的研究調查了流動性——資產在不影響其價格的情況下被買賣的容易程度——這是金融市場穩定的關鍵要素。利用高頻數據，我們正在開發實時流動性測量工具，以了解流動性提供者的行為以及高頻交易（HFT）算法所帶來的系統性風險，特別是在金融壓力期間。為實現這一目標，我們提出了一個模型，將資產的觀察價格分解為基本價值和偏差，使用後者來指示流動性。儘管在估計過程中存在諸如樣本量小和動態複雜等挑戰，我們採用了一種創建局部流動性衡量的方法，該方法在初步模擬中顯示出了有希望的結果。此外，我們探討了「流動性風險溢價」——投資者對風險較高資產要求的額外回報。初步發現表明，極端的溢價與主要經濟公告同時出現，表明在這些時期市場壓力加劇。

14501024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14501024.value: 帶有潛在無效工具變量的高維度分位數處理效應的估計與統計推斷

14501024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14501024.value: The quantile treatment effect, defined as the difference in the quantiles of the latent outcome distributions, is important for academic research and policy-making. Studying inequality is one of the most critical tasks in economics, but identifying how to perform this task is difficult in a heterogeneous environment where the same policy intervention affects people differently. Understanding the distributional impacts of economic policies such as employment, health care, and market regulation policies is essential for comprehensive program evaluation and welfare analysis. This project aims to develop econometric methods to infer the quantile treatment effect with endogeneity issues and a rich set of covariates. In the literature, quantile treatment effects have drawn intensive research interest (Abadie et al., 2002; Chernozhukov and Hansen, 2006). However, existing approaches that acknowledge endogeneity issues use instrumental variables that are known to be valid and that are often conditional on a relatively small list of covariates. In studies using observational data (Maynard and Qiu, 2009; Gallagher et al., 2020), this requirement is often too strong. The empirical literature on quantile treatment effects is still in its infancy, partly because the instrumental variable (IV) validity requirements are too strong. This proposal is dedicated to improving the estimation of quantile treatment effects under endogeneity using instrumental variables, addressing potential validity issues in two ways. First, our methods allow the researcher to not know whether the IVs are valid or not. Second, they allow the researcher to include large sets of controls, thus increasing the likelihood that the IV is conditionally valid. To facilitate practitioners’ adoption of our methods, we will illustrate our methodology in two empirical applications examining the effect of Medicaid on household savings and the presence of women on executive boards on firm performance. Additionally, to make implementation as user-friendly as possible, we will develop R packages in line with naivereg and hdcate, as well as other GitHub resources that the PI has contributed. 分位數處理效應對於學術研究和政策制定至關重要。研究收入不平等現像是經濟學中最關鍵的任務之一，但在同一政策幹預對不同人群產生不同影響的異質環境中，要確定如何執行此任務則非常困難。理解就業、醫療保健和市場監管政策等經濟政策的分佈性影響（而非只是平均影響），對於全面的項目評估和福利分析至關重要。本計畫書旨在開發新的計量經濟學方法，以推斷存在內生性問題和豐富協變量的分位數處理效應。 在文獻中，分位數處理效應已經引起了大量的研究興趣(例如Abadie等，2002年；Chernozhukov和Hansen，2006年)。然而，現有處理內生性問題的方法使用的是已知有效的工具變量，而且這些方法通常是基於相對較小的協變量清單。在使用觀測數據的研究中(Maynard和Qiu，2009年；Gallagher等人，2020年)，這種要求往往過於嚴格，可能會導致「假陽性」的研究結果。關於分位數處理效應的實證文獻仍處於起步階段，部分原因便是工具變量(IV)有效性要求過於嚴格。 本項目致力於改進使用工具變量處理內生性問題下的分位數處理效應估計，透過兩種方式解決潛在的有效性問題。首先，我們的方法允許研究者不知道IV是否有效。其次，允許研究者使用大量的控制變量，從而增加IV有效的可能性。 我們將在兩個實證應用中展示本方法的實用性，分別是檢視醫療補助對家庭儲蓄的影響，以及女性高管在執行董事會中的存在對公司績效的影響。此外，為了讓本方法盡可能用戶友好，我們將開發相關軟件包，以及整合PI已經貢獻的其他GitHub公開資源。

14501324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14501324.value: 人工智能下的團隊形成與團隊動態

14501324.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14501324.value: Prof Huang, Wei Prof Liang, Yingzhi Prof Zheng, Jie

14501324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14501324.value: How does Artificial Intelligence (AI) impact team formation and collaboration? We explore this question using a lab experiment in Hong Kong and mainland China, with a particular emphasis on how task-assisted AI influences the formation and group dynamics of student teams when they are given a specific assignment. In the experimental setup, students are randomly assigned access to an AI tool before deciding on whether to collaborate in a group to complete the task. We investigate three primary outcomes arising from this setup: group formation and group dynamics. Our first focus is on group formation under AI. We hypothesize that access to AI tools reduces the size of group work, as AI acts as a reliable teammate who consistently contributes without the risk of free-riding. Additionally, we hypothesize that AI can substitute for human teammates when students perceive them as lacking skills or prone to free-riding, especially for less competent or free-riding teammates. Our second focus is on AI as a complementary tool. Individually, AI has the potential to enhance worker performance by compensating for deficiencies and offering support, which is why students often express a willingness to continue using AI even after the experiment concludes. Regarding group dynamics, AI can indeed enhance team productivity, but it's important to note that there may be instances where students exhibit excessive reliance on AI. Our third focus is on when AI's substitution or complementary effects have the most impact, considering the capabilities of the AI. Advanced AI, which emulates human-like interaction and generates innovative ideas, is likely to have a greater substitutional and complementary impact as it closely mimics a genuine teammate. In contrast, classic AI primarily offers input-based corrections, limiting its influence. Furthermore, apart from group-level outcomes, we also evaluate the influence of AI on individual-level outcomes to examine its potential to modify students' subsequent behavior. In conclusion, integrating AI into a team can have a substitution or complementary effect based on the strengths and weaknesses of team members. Understanding and harnessing AI's influence on team dynamics is crucial for ensuring that it augments human capabilities, promotes diversity and inclusivity, and ultimately leads to more effective and equitable collaboration in the evolving workplace landscape. This research enhances our understanding of AI integration in student study groups and provides insights into the potential benefits and limitations of AI in education. 人工智能（AI）如何影響團隊形成和協作？我們通過在香港和中國大陸的實驗室實驗來探討這個問題，特別強調任務輔助AI在學生團隊完成特定任務時對團隊形成和團隊動態的影響。 在實驗設置中，學生在決定是否以小組形式完成任務之前，會被隨機分配使用AI工具。我們研究了這一設置下的三個主要結果：團隊形成和團隊動態。 我們的第一個重點是AI下的團隊形成。我們假設訪問AI工具會減少小組工作的規模，因為AI作為一個可靠的隊友，能夠持續貢獻而沒有搭便車的風險。此外，我們假設當學生認為人類隊友缺乏技能或傾向於搭便車時，AI可以替代人類隊友，特別是對於能力較差或搭便車的隊友。 我們的第二個重點是AI作為一種補充工具。單獨來看，AI有潛力通過彌補不足和提供支持來提高工作表現，這也是為什麼學生在實驗結束後通常願意繼續使用AI的原因。關於團隊動態，AI確實可以提高團隊生產力，但需要注意的是，有時學生可能會過度依賴AI。 我們的第三個重點是AI的替代或補充效果何時最具影響力，考慮到AI的能力。高級AI模擬人類互動並生成創新想法，可能具有更大的替代和補充影響，因為它更接近於真正的隊友。相比之下，經典AI主要提供基於輸入的糾正，限制了其影響。此外，除了團隊層面的結果，我們還評估了AI對個體層面的影響，以考察其改變學生後續行為的潛力。 總之，將AI整合到團隊中可以根據團隊成員的優缺點產生替代或補充效果。理解和利用AI對團隊動態的影響對於確保其增強人類能力、促進多樣性和包容性以及最終實現更有效和公平的協作至關重要。這項研究增強了我們對學生學習小組中AI整合的理解，並提供了關於AI在教育中潛在優勢和局限性的見解。

14501424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14501424.value: 股票期權交易行爲研究：來自投資組合的視角

14501424.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14501424.value: Prof Jeon, Yoontae Prof Kan, Raymond

14501424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14501424.value: The proposed project explores optimal asset allocation with options under an analytical framework and analyzes equity options trading activity empirically. Theoretical models such as Black and Scholes (1973) show that options are redundant if investors can hold continuously rebalanced portfolio of underlying stocks and risk-free bonds, as they can be perfectly replicated. However, the argument fails to hold when investors cannot continuously trade the underlying assets. Consequently, in practice, options are not redundant and they generate substantial utility gains for investors. Nevertheless, existing literature on options has extensively focused on the study of option pricing and only few studies were conducted on using options in investment problems. As an example, introductory textbooks in financial derivatives discuss covered call (an investment strategy of buying underlying stocks while simultaneously selling call options) as one of the most popular options trading strategies, which is also heavily advocated as a yield-enhancing strategy in practice. In contrast to this conventional wisdom, we show both analytically and empirically that such a position is not optimal for a rational investor with reasonable utility function most of time. We ask two main questions in this project. First, given a specification of an investor’s utility function, what is the optimal asset allocation of her portfolio consisting of stocks and options? For example, although a rational investor without any constraints will never choose to take covered call position, it is not the case when investors have no access to risk-free bonds or are forced to hold their underlying stock positions. Second, using actual options trading data, what can we learn about investors’ options trading activity from a portfolio perspective? In particular, we will explore whether investors trade options optimally or they are subject to behavioral biases. For example, is abnormally high volume of selling activity for certain options an outcome of investors’ behavioral bias or can it be explained using analytical framework of portfolio optimization with options? We propose to answer our questions by conducting the following analyses. Analytically, we derive optimal options portfolio allocation based on various utility functions and investment constraints. The proposed study considers utility functions for both rational and behavioral investors, including various types of options as feasible assets in the portfolio optimization problem, and different stochastic processes governing the underlying stock price dynamics. Empirically, we will conduct empirical analyses testing the implications of the analytical exercise utilizing actual options trading data. 本研究課題旨在探索期權資産組合的最佳配置，並對股票期權交易活動進行實証分析。Black 和 Scholes (1973) 的研究表明，如果投資者能夠持續不斷調整期權標的資産和無風險債券的頭寸，期權將被這樣的動態組合完美複刻，變爲冗餘資産。然而，當投資者無法持續交易標的資産和無風險債券時，這一論點將不再成立。在實踐中期權並不是冗餘的資産類別，並能爲投資者帶來了可觀的經濟收益。 儘管如此，現有的期權文獻仍主要集中於對期權定價的研究，而忽略了如何使用期權來進行投資決策。例如，幾乎所有金融衍生品的入門教科書中，都將備兌看漲期權（一種買入標的股票並同時賣出看漲期權的投資組合）作爲最流行的期權交易策略之一進行介紹，並且在實踐中大力推崇爲能提高收益的投資。但與這種傳統觀點相反，我們通過初步分析和實証研究証明，對於具備合理效用函數的理性投資者來説，這樣的投資策略在大多數情況下並不是最優選擇。 本研究課題將主要解決兩個問題。首先，給定一個投資者的效用函數，她的標的股票和期權投資組合的最優資産配置是什麼？例如，一個沒有任何約束的理性投資者不會在任何情況下配置備兌看漲期權作爲投資組合。但當投資者無法持有無風險債券或被迫持有其標的股票頭寸時，情況便會有所不同。其次，利用美國交易所的期權交易數據，我們將探索是否可以從投資組合的角度了解投資者的期權交易行爲。尤其是我們將探討投資者是否以最優策略交易期權，或者投資者交易行爲是否受到自身行爲偏差的影響。例如，我們將探索某些賣出量異常高的期權是否爲投資者行爲偏差導緻的結果，還是可以使用期權投資組合優化的分析框架來解釋？ 我們將通過理論加實証的分析來回答以上問題。我們將探索根據不同效用函數和投資約束得出最優期權投資組合分配的解析解。我們的研究課題將同時考慮理性和具有行爲偏差投資者的效用函數，並將各種類型的期權包括在投資組合優化問題中作爲可行的配置資産，以及考慮不同模擬股價走勢的動態隨機過程。實証方麵，我們將利用交易所提供的個股期權交易數據進行實証分析，以了解期權投資組合在實際投資過程中的真實配置情況。

14502924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14502924.value: 網絡直播對在線零售商的影響

14502924.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14502924.value: Prof Han, Jin Soo Prof Lee, Gunwoong

14502924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14502924.value: Live shopping, also known as live commerce or livestream shopping, is an emerging form of online retail. It involves sellers using live video broadcasts to showcase and demonstrate products and services. This innovative shopping method aims to recreate the interactive and immersive elements of in-person shopping experiences by providing a dynamic and engaging environment that combines entertainment, product exploration, and seamless purchasing opportunities. Previous studies have mainly focused on the interactions between sellers and consumers during livestream sessions. Some studies have examined consumer factors that influence purchase intention, engagement, and consumption behavior. Other studies have explored host-related factors that impact sales volume during livestream sessions, such as the host's strategy, facial and verbal emotions, and linguistic styles. This project aims to investigate the impact of livestreaming on the overall sales of livestreaming sellers. Additionally, it will explore potential spillover effects of livestreams on non-livestreaming sellers in the market. While livestreaming has the potential to attract consumers to livestreaming sellers, it may also have unintended consequences, such as cannibalizing the consumer pool of other sellers or driving market expansion effects. The project will also examine whether the impact of livestreaming varies among different types of sellers and attempt to uncover the mechanisms driving the effect of livestreaming on online sellers. To address these research questions, we will utilize data on sales and attributes of online sellers from a large online commerce platform. Unlike previous literature that analyzed only a subset of livestreams, our study will utilize the entire record of all sellers under two major product categories (gardening and home-wear) and their livestreaming activities from January to December 2021. This comprehensive dataset will allow us to examine the overall influence and temporal dynamics of livestreams, as well as potential spillover effects on non-livestreaming sellers. Preliminary analyses indicate a significant positive influence of livestream events on the daily sales of online sellers. We also observe temporal dynamics in the impact of livestreaming events on seller performance. The positive effects of livestreams on sales gradually increase leading up to the event date, reach a peak on the date itself, and marginally decrease in the subsequent days. The principal investigator (PI) and Co-I’s have successfully published related works in prestigious journals. We anticipate that this project will make a significant contribution to both academic literature and managerial practice by demonstrating the impact of livestreaming on online sellers. 直播購物，又稱直播電商，是一種新興的在線零售模式。該模式通過視頻直播的形式，使得賣家能夠實時展示和演示其產品與服務。這種創新的零售模式旨在通過構建一個融合娛樂性、產品體驗和無縫購買流程的動態參與情境，來模擬傳統線下購物的互動性和沈浸感。現有文獻多聚焦於網絡直播環境下在線零售商與消費者互動的動態過程。部分研究著重於剖析消費者個體特徵對購買意向、參與度及消費行為的影響；而另一些研究則著眼於剖析直播過程中主播的個體特徵對銷售業績的潛在影響，包括主播的營銷策略、面部表情、言語情感以及語言風格等。本項目旨在研究電商直播對網絡零售商整體銷售額的影響及其對其他非直播零售商的潛在溢出效應。雖然直播有可能幫助零售商吸引更多的消費者，但也可能對市場產生意想不到的影響，如蠶食其他在線零售商的消費客戶群或推動市場擴張效應。本項目還將研究直播對不同類型在線零售商的影響是否存在差異，並試圖揭示直播對其影響的驅動機制。為了研究這些問題，我們將利用某大型電商平台提供的在線零售商銷售額和屬性數據。與以往只分析部分直播零售商數據的研究不同，我們的研究數據涵蓋了園藝和家居服飾兩大產品類別下所有在線零售商的銷售記錄以及他們從 2021 年 1 月至 12 月期間的直播數據。這一完整的數據集將使我們能夠研究直播對在線電商市場的整體影響和動態變化，以及對非直播賣家的潛在溢出效應。初步分析表明，直播活動對在線賣家的日銷售額有顯著積極影響。此外，我們還觀察到了這一影響隨時間的動態變化——直播活動對銷售額的促進作用在活動日之前逐漸增強，在活動日當天達到峰值，隨後幾天有所下降。該項目的主要研究人員（PI）和合作研究人員已在知名學術期刊上發表了相關文章。通過證實直播對在線銷售商的影響，該項目將豐富在線零售領域的理論基礎，並為電商直播的實踐提供策略建議。

14503024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14503024.value: 在線消費者搜尋中的順序滾動和搜尋決策

14503024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14503024.value: In this project, I study consumers’ decision in the online consumer search environment to sequentially scroll down the product list and search through products. I build upon the sequential search model by Weitzman (1979) and incorporate in the model the scroll decision by consumers. In the proposed model, a consumer faces two dynamic programming problems---scrolling down the product list and clicking among products that are scrolled through. After a consumer is presented with the product listing, he learns about the observable features the first product on the list. Then, he decides whether to incur a scroll cost and scroll to the second alternative on the list or to stop scrolling and begin the search process among products already scrolled through. This process is sequentially repeated until the consumer stops scrolling. I first lay out the model that incorporates the sequential scroll and search decision by the consumer. Then, I present the numerical experiments to demonstrate that the proposed model can identify model parameters, including the consumer preference, the scroll cost, and the search cost. The results from the numerical experiments demonstrate that parameters can be recovered by either Expectation-Maximization algorithm or Bayesian data augmentation even when the scroll decision and/or the search order are not observed in the data. In the empirical application of the proposed model to the dataset from Expedia, I quantify two opposing impacts of the price discount on the scroll and search behavior. The proposed model allows the consumer to search among only a subset of products on the list and therefore relaxes the assumption typically made in the consumer search literature that, prior to the search process, the consumer is aware of the observable features of all products presented. In addition, by incorporating the scroll cost in the model, the proposed model precisely measures the impact of the product position within the list on consumer’s scroll and search behavior. In the methodological perspective, this paper provides researchers with an alternative approach to estimate the parameters of interest even when the scroll decision and the search order are not observed in the data. 這個項目中，我研究了消費者在網上消費者搜索環境中，依次向下滾動產品列表並搜索產品的決策。我基於Weitzman（1979）的順序搜索模型，並在模型中加入了消費者的滾動決策。在所提出的模型中，消費者面臨兩個動態規劃問題——向下滾動產品列表和在滾動過的產品中點擊。當消費者看到產品列表後，他會了解列表中第一個產品的可觀察特徵。然後，他決定是否承擔滾動成本並滾動到列表中的第二個選項，或者停止滾動並開始在已滾動過的產品中進行搜索。這個過程會依次重複，直到消費者停止滾動。 我首先提出了包含消費者順序滾動和搜索決策的模型。然後，我進行數值實驗，證明所提出的模型可以識別模型參數，包括消費者偏好、滾動成本和搜索成本。數值實驗的結果表明，即使在數據中未觀察到滾動決策和/或搜索順序的情況下，也可以通過期望最大化算法或貝葉斯數據增強來恢復參數。在將所提出的模型應用於Expedia數據集的實證應用中，我量化了價格折扣對滾動和搜索行為的兩種相反影響。 所提出的模型允許消費者僅在列表中的一部分產品中進行搜索，從而放寬了消費者搜索文獻中通常假設的，在搜索過程之前，消費者已經了解所有展示產品的可觀察特徵。此外，通過在模型中加入滾動成本，所提出的模型精確地衡量了產品在列表中的位置對消費者滾動和搜索行為的影響。在方法論方面，本文為研究人員提供了一種替代方法來估計感興趣的參數，即使在數據中未觀察到滾動決策和搜索順序的情況下。

14503124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14503124.value: 開放經濟下貨幣政策的供給面效應

14503124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14503124.value: 在這個研究計畫中，我們探討了開放經濟體中貨幣政策傳導的供給面管道。借鑒了Baqaee、Farhi和Sangani（JPE，2023）的研究成果，我們建構了一個具有異質性企業和內生加價的兩國模型。 在模型中，擴張性貨幣衝擊可以透過資源在企業之間的重新配置來提高整體生產力。在開放經濟中，貨幣衝擊的供給側效應將透過貿易的相對價格的影響傳遞到外國，而在均衡中，相對價格主要是由內生的總體生產力差異決定。我們推導出一個易解的九方程式動態模型，並用它來研究開放經濟體中貨幣衝擊的國際傳導機制。我們也研究了有供給面效應時的最適貨幣政策。最後，我們展示了供給側效應如何隨著出口定價貨幣的不同而變化。

14503224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14503224.value: 在線UGC平台流量分配優化

14503224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14503224.value: Online user-generated content (UGC) platforms such as YouTube and TikTok are playing an increasingly significant role in our world. As of December 2022, the number of daily users on short video-sharing platforms has exceeded one billion in China. Leveraging their enormous user data, UGC platforms adopt machine-learning-based recommendation algorithms to autonomously allocate their titanic viewer traﬀic to different content to engage and retain viewers with their preferred content and motivate the content creators to produce more high-quality content appealing to the viewers. Altogether, a UGC platform seeks to foster a healthy ecosystem with a population of engaged viewers and a community of vibrant creators. This triggers some important questions of both academic and practical significance: • How to quantify the value of content for the viewers on a UGC platform? • What is the effect of viewer traﬀic on creator productivity? • How to optimise the recommendation algorithm and viewer traﬀic allocation policy of a UGC platform to improve the welfare of both viewers and creators, thus benefiting the entire platform? Existing empirical research on content evaluation and traffic allocation for UGC platforms is limited. Collaborating with one of the largest Chinese online video-sharing platforms (“Platform V” hereafter), the proposed study seeks to close this gap by conducting a series of field experiments to answer the research questions above. This project first empirically quantifies the value of UGC content for the viewers. Leveraging a large-scale experiment on Platform V whose treatment is to remove certain content in the recommendation algorithm, we obtain some initial results on the content value heterogeneity with respect to the number of followers for the creator and the activeness of the viewer. To further investigate the effect of viewer traffic on creator productivity, we plan, in collaboration with Platform V, to run another field experiment, which allocates extra viewer traffic to treated creators, to measure the changes in content production. Finally, based on our empirical insights, we propose to develop a new viewer traffic allocation policy that boosts the content of creators with a large (resp. small) number of followers for inactive (resp. active) viewers in the recommendation algorithm, which potentially leads to mutually beneficial outcomes. Such a policy can be validated by a follow-up two-sided field experiment. Overall, the research holds potential for optimising viewer traffic allocation for UGC platforms to benefit all the stakeholders thereof. 線上用戶生成內容（UGC）平台，如YouTube和TikTok，在我們的世界中正發揮著越來越重要的作用。截至2022年12月，中國短視頻分享平台的日活躍用戶數量已超過十億。UGC平台利用其龐大的用戶數據，採用基於機器學習的推薦算法，自主分配大量觀眾流量到不同的內容，以吸引和留住觀眾，讓他們觀看自己喜好的內容，並激勵內容創作者製作更多吸引觀眾的高質量內容。總體而言，UGC平台旨在培養一個擁有活躍觀眾和創意豐富創作者的健康生態系統。這引發了一些具有學術和實踐意義的重要問題： - 如何量化UGC平台上內容對觀眾的價值？ - 觀眾流量對創作者生產力有何影響？ - 如何優化UGC平台的推薦算法和觀眾流量分配政策，以提高觀眾和創作者的福利，從而惠及整個平台？ 現有關於UGC平台內容評估和流量分配的實證研究有限。與中國最大的在線視頻分享平台之一（以下稱為“平台V”）合作，本研究旨在通過一系列A/B實驗來回答上述研究問題。 該項目首先實證量化了UGC內容對觀眾的價值。利用平台V上的一項大規模實驗，其處理方法是將某些內容從推薦算法中移除，我們獲得了關於內容價值異質性的一些初步結果，這些結果與創作者的粉絲數量和觀眾的活躍度相關。為進一步探討觀眾流量對創作者生產力的影響，我們計劃與平台V合作，進行另一項實驗，該實驗將額外的觀眾流量分配給被處理的創作者，以測量內容產出的變化。最後，基於我們的實證見解，我們提出了一項新的觀眾流量分配政策，該政策在推薦算法中推動粉絲數量多的創作者為不活躍的觀眾（以及粉絲數量少的創作者為活躍的觀眾）創作內容，這可能會導致互惠互利的結果。這樣的政策可以通過後續的雙邊實驗來驗證。總體而言，該研究具有優化UGC平台流量分配的潛力，從而惠及所有利益相關者。

14503624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14503624.value: 關於中國財政製度的動態理論

14503624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14503624.value: We refer to fiscal institution as a decision framework for fiscal policies. The economic impacts of fiscal institution can be profound and long-lasting. For example, the origin of China’s current local fiscal hardship can be traced back to a relaxation of financial disciplines on local governments in 2008-09. Yet, there are few theoretical attempts to understand the politico-economic determinants of China’s fiscal institution. The goal of this project is to develop an analytical and quantitative framework for endogenous formation and evolution of fiscal institution in China. Our framework captures two distinctive features of China’s fiscal institution. The first is a high degree of decentralization. In our framework, all the fiscal policies other than tax rates are made by local governments. The second feature is the “Mandarin Model” through which the central government manages local governments (Song and Xiong, 2023). The policy decision making process is influenced by career incentives, a mechanism to select competent officials, and financial disciplines, a mechanism to avoid liquidity crisis. In this framework, a decentralized fiscal institution is mainly characterized by the degree of career incentives and financial disciplines. Our theoretical novelty is to endogenize fiscal institution. More important, the endogenous fiscal institution is dynamic and contingent on economic fundamentals. This is a major step forward from Song and Xiong (2023), where changes in career incentives and financial disciplines are exogenous. In our framework, these changes are endogenously determined by the central government. We focus on Markov perfect equilibrium of a dynamic game between the central and local governments, where the central government’s choices of fiscal institution are functions of payoff-relevant state variables. Two insights emerge from our analysis. First, the current-period fiscal institution affects the next-period economic fundamentals, which, in turn, affect the next-period fiscal institution. This forms an intertemporal linkage that makes fiscal institution path-dependent. Moreover, perceiving the path dependence, the central government can strategically manipulate local officials’ current-period choices to influence future equilibrium outcomes. Our model will also have implications on China’s short-term economic performance and long-run fiscal sustainability. Endogenous fiscal institution may speed up or slow down economic transition, amplify or dampen economic fluctuations. A calibrated or estimated model will be employed to study the economic impacts of productivity growth slowdown and aging population through the interplay between fiscal institution and economic fundamentals. 在本項研究中，我們把財政政策的決策框架稱為財政製度。財政製度對經濟的影響是深遠而持久的。例如，當前中國地方財政困難的根源很可能在於2008-09年的金融寬松。然而，很少有理論嘗試了解中國財政製度的政治經濟決定因素。本項研究旨在開發一個分析和定量框架，用於研究國財政製度的形成與演變。

14503924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14503924.value: 解構中國共產黨內部信息傳遞：以新華社《內部參考》為例，1949-1964

14503924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14503924.value: 眾所周知，在一個非民主威權政權政體中，從地方到中央的縱向資訊傳遞至關重要。 然而，關於這種縱向資訊傳遞的幾個關鍵問題並不清楚。 首先，政府及政治精英獲取的資訊在多大程度上與普通公眾可接觸的資訊不同？ 其次，制度在促進或阻礙資訊收集方面扮演何種角色？ 最後，資訊收集不足或不當有什麼後果？ 本研究旨在通過研究《內部參考》回答這些問題。 《內部參考》是中國新華社內部刊物，專供中央及高層領導閱覽。 在1949年之後，這一刊物成為中國共產黨，特別是權力精英的重要信息管道。 首先，本研究計劃比較《內部參考》與《人民日報》的內容來區分權力精英所獲取的信息與公眾可接觸到的資訊。 與《內部參考》不同，《人民日報》是中共中央的官方報紙，普通公民均可閱讀。 通過文本分析和應用自然語言處理技術，這一研究可以確定《內部參考》在多大程度上收集了公眾無法獲取的資訊。 其次，本研究將研究1958年在報導系統上的制度變革對資訊流的影響。 具體來說，在1958年，中央政府將地方記者的人事和財政控制下放給地方政府，削弱了地方記者的獨立性。 這一制度變化可能會損害資訊收集工作。 最後，本研究探尋1958年採編及財政制度變化導致的地方資訊收集不足與1959-61年大饑荒之間的聯繫，以識別資訊收集不足的後果。

14504224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14504224.value: 增強全球價值鏈彈性：公共採購的作用

14504224.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14504224.value: Prof Wang, Yongqin Dr Zhang, Yifei

14504224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14504224.value: Since the 1980s, thanks to various factors such as significant trade cost reduction and peaceful political development, global value chain (GVC) or global supply chain (GSC) have become a key feature of the world economy. In recent years, however, natural disasters, geopolitical and economic conflicts and public health crises such as the 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami, the US-China trade war, and the COVID-19 pandemic have posed serious threats to GVC resilience. Governments around the world strive to promote de-risking by encouraging reshoring or ally-shoring or GSC diversification. It intends to achieve a new balance between national security and economic efficiency. Firms, however, are typically slow to conduct GSC reconfiguration for various reasons. As a public policy to forge GVC resilience, governments typically require public procurement contractors to assess GSC risk and restructure GSC. Motivated by this observation, this project plans to employ the recent three big events that generated shocks to GVC to investigate whether public procurement plays a role in steering corporate sector to restructure GVC to enhance its resilience. First, we employ natural language processing textual analysis of corporate conference call transcripts of global firms to construct firm-level GVC vulnerability metrics. Second, we examine various forms of firm-level GVC restructuring such as reshoring, ally/friend-shoring, nearshoring, and GSC diversification, and investigate multinational corporations’ (MNCs’) global resource reallocation to mitigate GSC risk: MNCs’ acquisitions (divestments) of upstream-industry targets in low (high)-GVC-vulnerability countries and MNCs’ expansion (shrinkage) of operations in upstream-industry subsidiaries/affiliates in low (high)-GVC-vulnerability host countries. Third, we explore whether the prospects of public contracting would motivate corporations to actively restructure GVCs to raise their chances of being awarded government contracts. Fourth, we compare contractor firms with their non-contractor peer firms in the same sector in the same home country to see whether the former exhibits a more active GVC restructuring in response to firm-level GVC risk to comply with the intention of governments. Fifth, we further examine whether those firms that more actively restructured their supply chains are more likely to win public procurement contracts subsequently. This project is expected to help shed light on the role of the state in shaping GVC through public procurement, which is a considerably under-explored issue. It can contribute to the growing literature on GVC restructuring. Its findings could contain policy implications and help us understand the current wave of GVC reconfiguration. 自1980年代以來，由於貿易成本大幅下降、政治和平發展等多種因素，全球價值鏈（GVC）或全球供應鏈（GSC）已成為世界經濟的重要特徵。然而，近年來，自然災害、地緣政治和經濟衝突以及公共衛生危機，如2011年東北地震和海嘯、中美貿易戰以及COVID-19大流行，對全球價值鏈的抵禦能力構成了嚴重威脅。世界各國政府努力透過鼓勵回流、聯盟回流或 GSC 多元化來促進去風險。它旨在實現國家安全和經濟效率之間的新平衡。然而，由於各種原因，企業通常會緩慢地進行 GSC 重新配置。作為增強全球價值鏈彈性的公共政策，政府通常要求公共採購承包商評估 GSC 風險並重組 GSC。 受這項觀察的啟發，本專案計畫利用近期對GVC產生衝擊的三件大事件來研究公共採購是否在引導企業部門重組GVC以增強其彈性方面發揮作用。首先，我們採用自然語言處理對全球公司的電話會議記錄進行文字分析來建立公司級的全球價值鏈脆弱性指標。其次，我們研究了各種形式的公司層面的全球價值鏈重組，例如回流、盟友/友邦、近岸和GSC 多元化，並研究跨國公司(MNC) 全球資源重新配置以減輕GSC 風險：跨國公司的收購（撤資）在低（高）GVC脆弱性國家的上游產業目標以及跨國公司在低（高）GVC脆弱性東道國上游產業子公司/附屬公司的業務擴張（收縮）。第三，我們探討公共合約的前景是否會激勵企業積極重組全球價值鏈，以提高獲得政府合約的機會。第四，我們將同一國家同一部門的承包商公司與非承包商同業公司進行比較，看看前者是否表現出更積極的全球價值鏈重組，以應對公司層面的全球價值鏈風險，以符合政府的意圖。第五，我們進一步檢視那些更積極重組供應鏈的企業是否更有可能隨後贏得公共採購合約。 該計畫預計將有助於闡明國家透過公共採購塑造全球價值鏈的作用，這是一個尚未充分探討的問題。它可以為越來越多的全球價值鏈重組的文獻做出貢獻。其研究結果可能包含政策意涵，並幫助我們了解當前的全球價值鏈重構浪潮。

14504524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14504524.value: 基於內容消費的群眾智慧

14504524.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14504524.value: Prof Hong, Hong Prof Hu, Maggie Rong Dr Xu, Dapeng

14504524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14504524.value: Modern information technologies have dramatically changed how information is disseminated in stock financial market. For example, social media has the advantage of providing investors with up-to-date information more promptly than other sources. Consequently, increasingly more individual investors are attempting to seek useful information from online investment communities (OICs). Existing research has confirmed the “crowd wisdom” of investor opinions extracted from OICs. More specifically, information on OICs have been influential and helpful in generating returns for investors and content consumers. This confirms’ OIC content providers’ wisdom of crowds in providing useful information. However, how OIC content consumers response and utilize this information is an open question. This project will investigate whether crowds of users in an OIC are wise enough to find helpful content in the community from a content consumer perspective instead of confirming the value of OICs on the stock market from a content provider perspective. Furthermore, this project will dig deeper to investigate OIC users’ different wisdom of crowds in figuring out helpful information from OIC articles for different return momentum stocks, OIC articles provided by authors with different OIC tenures, and OIC articles with different sentiments. Besides, different from the user-generated content (UGC) perceived helpfulness measured by helpful votes voted by users in online reviews, OIC article helpfulness is assessed by the objectiveness and inherent prediction accuracy of an OIC article, which can be examined through the stock market performance in our research context. To explore these research questions, we conduct a series of article-level analyses using data obtained from Seeking Alpha (SA), which is the most popular OIC in America. We find that an article’s initial popularity is positively related to its ultimate prediction accuracy, indicating its readers’ wisdom in identifying helpful information. Besides, readers’ wisdom increases while identifying articles for high-momentum tickers, which have more media exposure, and users’ wisdom also increase when figuring our useful information from bullish articles or articles written by senior authors. The research team has worked on related topics and have been successful in publishing in top journals and producing working papers, which will be presented on several upcoming conferences. We expect the project we propose will generate significant contributions to both the academic knowledge base and business practice by probing deeply into the wisdom of crowds based on their consumption of investor-generated content in OICs. 現代資訊技術已經極大地改變了股票金融市場中資訊傳播的方式。例如，社交媒體相較於其他來源，能更及時地為投資者提供最新資訊。因此，越來越多的個人投資者嘗試從線上投資社群（OICs）中尋求有用的資訊。 現有研究已經證實了從OICs中提取的投資者意見的"群眾智慧"。更具體地說，OICs上的資訊對投資者和內容消費者產生回報方面具有影響力和幫助。這證實了OIC內容提供者在提供有用資訊方面的群眾智慧。然而，OIC內容消費者如何回應和利用這些資訊仍是一個開放性問題。 本項目將從內容消費者的角度，而不是從內容提供者的角度確認OICs對股票市場的價值，來研究OIC中的用戶群體是否足夠明智，能夠在社群中找到有用的內容。此外，本項目將更深入地研究OIC用戶在不同回報動能股票、不同OIC任期作者提供的OIC文章，以及不同情緒的OIC文章中找出有用資訊的不同群眾智慧。除此之外，與線上評論中用戶投票評定的用戶生成內容（UGC）感知有用性不同，OIC文章的有用性是通過OIC文章的客觀性和固有預測準確性來評估的，這可以通過我們研究背景中的股票市場表現來檢驗。 為探討這些研究問題，我們使用從Seeking Alpha（SA）獲得的數據進行了一系列文章級別的分析，SA是美國最受歡迎的OIC。我們發現，一篇文章的初始受歡迎程度與其最終預測準確性呈正相關，表明其讀者在識別有用資訊方面的智慧。此外，讀者在識別高動能股票相關文章時的智慧會增加，這些股票有更多的媒體曝光度，用戶在從看漲文章或資深作者撰寫的文章中找出有用資訊時的智慧也會增加。 研究團隊已在相關主題上工作，並成功在頂級期刊上發表論文，產出工作論文，這些論文將在未來的幾個學術會議上展示。我們預期我們提出的項目將通過深入探討基於OICs中投資者生成內容消費的群眾智慧，為學術知識庫和商業實踐做出重大貢獻。

14504724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14504724.value: 消費者選擇的第一印象

14504724.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14504724.value: Prof Frederick, Shane Prof MEYER, Andrew

14504724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14504724.value: When sellers offer multiple products, they must decide which ones to present first. In digital markets, this involves deciding which products to place in the top-left of a product grid or the first slot in a product carousel. In brick-and-mortar stores, it involves deciding which products to place near the store entrance or at the ends of aisles. In this project, I will leverage my past experience studying anchoring (Frederick, Meyer, & Mochon, 2011; PNAS) and contrast effects (Meyer & Hundtofte, 2023; Management Science), as well as my current research on reference point formation (Meyer & Cisternas, working paper) to explore how sellers choose which product to present first and how sellers should choose which product to present first. This involves balancing at least three considerations. The seller must consider which product will gain the largest boost in sales from increased visibility, which product will most effectively entice the consumer to explore the remaining options, and which product will provide the best context to highlight the qualities of the remaining products. Many sellers assume that the most attractive products should be presented first. However, in preliminary results with sequences of binary product purchase decisions (over 9,000 participants and 180,000 individual choices), I find some evidence that this intuition may be incorrect. I find that contrast against the first option presented is powerful enough and persists for long enough across subsequent product evaluations, that reducing the quality of the first product presented actually increases overall purchase rates. Although reducing the quality of the first product decreases the average quality, this decrease is more than offset by contrast effects on the remaining products. Although the sequential binary choice paradigm provides strong insights into theoretical questions about primacy and recency effects on reference point formation, it only provides suggestive evidence for more practical marketing application, because, in this experimental paradigm, participants cannot exit before seeing all products, and they cannot move back and forth between products. I propose to explore the consequences of this product presentation decision in more realistic shopping environments, including product grids and product carousels. This work could provide an immediate benefit to marketing practitioners in Hong Kong and throughout the world as it allows better product presentation, especially in online contexts. It is especially important now because sophisticated recommender systems are increasingly able to predict individual consumer preferences, allowing not just personalized product selections, but personalized product sequences. 當賣家提供多種產品時，他們必須決定先展示哪些產品。在數位市場中，這涉及決定將哪些產品放在產品網格的左上角或產品輪播的第一個位置。在實體店中，這涉及決定將哪些產品放置在商店入口附近或過道盡頭。 在這個專案中，我將利用我過去研究錨定效應（Frederick、Meyer 和Mochon，2011；PNAS）和對比效應（Meyer 和Hundtofte，2023；管理科學）的經驗，以及我目前對參考點形成的研究（Meyer 和Cisternas，工作論文）來探索賣家如何選擇先展示哪種產品以及賣家應該如何選擇先展示哪種產品。這涉及平衡至少三個考慮因素。賣家必須考慮哪種產品會因可見度增加而獲得最大的銷售成長，哪種產品會最有效地吸引消費者探索剩餘的選項，以及哪種產品將提供最佳背景來突出剩餘產品的品質。 許多賣家認為最有吸引力的產品應該先展示。然而，在二元產品購買決策序列的初步結果（超過 9,000 名參與者和 180,000 個個人選擇）中，我發現一些證據表明這種直覺可能是錯誤的。我發現與呈現的第一個選項的對比足夠強大，並且在後續的產品評估中持續足夠長的時間，因此降低呈現的第一個產品的品質實際上會提高整體購買率。雖然降低第一個產品的質量會降低平均質量，但這種降低被對剩餘產品的對比效應所抵消。 雖然順序二元選擇範式為關於首因和近因對參考點形成的理論問題提供了強有力的見解，但它僅為更實際的營銷應用提供了暗示性證據，因為在這個實驗範式中，參與者在看到所有產品之前不能退出，他們也不能在產品之間來回移動。我建議在更現實的購物環境中探索這種產品展示決策的後果，包括產品網格和產品輪播。這項研究可以為香港乃至全世界的行銷從業者帶來直接的益處，因為它可以更好地展示產品，尤其是在網路環境中。現在，這一點尤其重要，因為複雜的推薦系統越來越能夠預測個人消費者的偏好，不僅可以實現個人化的產品選擇，還可以實現個人化的產品序列。

14505824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14505824.value: 漂綠、資訊透明度與綠色創新：來自聯邦貿易委員會綠色指南的證據

14505824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14505824.value: Greenwashing refers to corporations disclosing green claims and investing little in real environmental practices. This proposal examines the regulatory crackdown on greenwashing and its subsequent effects on green innovation through the lens of corporate information disclosure. This proposal exploits the regulatory intervention by the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Green Guides. The guide was initially launched in 1992, aiming to combat unqualified marketing claims made by firms to consumers about environmental claims in labeling, advertising, and promotional materials. The FTC Green Guides were unexpected, and not all firms were equally affected. Firms that produce green-labeled products and services faced higher regulatory scrutiny and were more impacted than others. This proposal exploits this plausibly exogenous shock on the greenwashing crackdown and provides a novel empirical design. Identifying affected firms (i.e., greenwashing firms) is an empirical challenge. This proposal tackles this challenge by relying on corporations’ trademark textual information and classifying green-labeled trademarks that contain green words in goods and service descriptions. This proposal develops a novel empirical method, enabling follow-up studies to draw causal inferences on the effect of the greenwashing crackdown. Specifically, this proposal examines the following dimensions of impacts of FTC Green Guides: do greenwashing firms after FTC Green Guides reduce environmental disclosures, and whether their environmental disclosures less positive and better readable? Arguably, the greenwashing crackdown improves information transparency between firms and consumers and increases greenwashing firms’ litigation risk. Do greenwashing firms change strategies on green investments? The contribution of the proposal is threefold. First, this proposal contributes to the recent literature that studies the impact of the greenwashing crackdown. By introducing FTC Green Guides as a plausibly exogenous shock and investigating the impact of the greenwashing crackdown on environmental disclosure and green innovation. Second, this proposal contributes to the corporate social responsibility disclosure literature by providing novel evidence, suggesting that a regulated green guide is important for greenwashing firms to reduce environmental disclosure. Third, this proposal contributes to the burgeoning research of green innovation by providing evidence that the greenwashing crackdown enables green innovation through the channels of mitigated information asymmetry and intensified litigation risk. Overall, this proposal sheds light on the effect of greenwashing crackdown on information transparency of green claims and has a clear policy implication as it suggests a regulated green guide stimulates true green innovations and -ultimately economy. 漂綠指的是企業披露綠色宣稱但實際上很少投資於真正的環保實踐。本提案通過企業資訊披露的視角，研究對漂綠的監管打擊及其對綠色創新的後續影響。 本提案利用聯邦貿易委員會（FTC）綠色指南的監管干預。該指南最初於1992年推出，旨在打擊企業向消費者做出的關於標籤、廣告和宣傳材料中環境宣稱的不合格營銷聲明。FTC綠色指南的出台是意料之外的，並非所有企業都受到同等影響。生產綠色標籤產品和服務的企業面臨更高的監管審查，受到的影響也更大。本提案利用這種對漂綠打擊的可能外生衝擊，提供了一種新穎的實證設計。識別受影響的企業（即漂綠企業）是一個實證挑戰。本提案通過依賴企業的商標文本信息並對包含綠色詞彙的商品和服務描述中的綠色標籤商標進行分類來解決這一挑戰。本提案開發了一種新穎的實證方法，使後續研究能夠對漂綠打擊的影響進行因果推論。 具體而言，本提案研究FTC綠色指南的以下影響維度：漂綠企業在FTC綠色指南之後是否減少環境披露，他們的環境披露是否變得不那麼積極且更易讀？可以說，漂綠打擊提高了企業和消費者之間的信息透明度，並增加了漂綠企業的訴訟風險。漂綠企業是否改變了綠色投資策略？ 本提案的貢獻有三個方面。首先，本提案為研究漂綠打擊影響的最新文獻做出貢獻。通過引入FTC綠色指南作為可能的外生衝擊，並研究漂綠打擊對環境披露和綠色創新的影響。其次，本提案為企業社會責任披露文獻做出貢獻，提供了新的證據，表明受監管的綠色指南對漂綠企業減少環境披露很重要。第三，本提案為新興的綠色創新研究做出貢獻，提供證據表明漂綠打擊通過減輕信息不對稱和加強訴訟風險的渠道促進綠色創新。 總的來說，本提案闡明了漂綠打擊對綠色宣稱信息透明度的影響，並具有明確的政策含義，因為它表明受監管的綠色指南能刺激真正的綠色創新，最終促進經濟發展。

14506024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14506024.value: 敘事方法與數字信息對消費者判斷的影響

14506024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14506024.value: 這項研究檢視敘事式故事講述對消費者理解和使用數字信息的影響。敘事式故事講述作為一種流行的市場行銷技巧，按照主題和時間相關的順序展示有關事件的信息。這種格式影響消費者的信息處理策略，促進消費者的心理模擬，並增加他們對品牌故事的沉浸感。一般而言，敘事消息比非敘事方式傳達的信息更具有說服力和記憶維度。 然而，敘事方法如何影響消費者處理數字信息的方式尚不明確。所提出的研究旨在彌合這一差距，探討敘事呈現如何影響在判斷和決策中使用數字信息。我們假設，敘事處理可能有助於數字信息的理解和在判斷中的應用，特別是在數字能力較低的人群中。 我們已進行了一項預測測試以提供假設的初步證據。敘事呈現格式可以促進數字能力較低的參與者在判斷中使用數字信息。我們已經制定了一個計劃性研究議程，以測試潛在的心理機制、確定邊界條件以及測試我們發現的普遍性。 我們期望我們的研究對理論和實踐都有所貢獻。就理論貢獻而言，我們的研究通過檢視其對數字信息的理解和使用的影響，擴展了對敘事處理的理解。就實際意義而言，我們的工作將告知市場營銷專業人員在他們的信息傳達概率或數字信息時，敘事式故事講述的利弊。

14506324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14506324.value: 數據科學家和市場競爭

14506324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14506324.value: To thrive in a competitive market, firms must understand the needs of individual consumers and offer personalized products and services. However, traditional approaches to gathering consumer information, such as surveys, can be costly and time-consuming. The rise of data science has provided a solution to this challenge by enabling firms to leverage large-scale data analysis to understand consumer preferences and deliver targeted offerings. This research proposal aims to investigate the role of data scientists in product market competition. The proposal outlines a plan to construct a comprehensive dataset of data scientists at the firm-year level using individual resume data from Lightcast and Revelio Lab. The data scientists will be categorized based on their skills into four groups: data acquisition, data organization and maintenance, data algorithms, and data analytics. Further, the proposed research will utilize household-level Nielsen Scanner Data to directly capture the consumer purchase behavior of each family. These datasets, while combined together, will facilitate the investigation of different economic mechanisms through which data scientists affect product market competition. The research outputs from this proposal are expected to have profound implications for firms, investors, regulators, and universities. Firms will benefit from identifying the types of data scientists that can improve their market competitiveness. Investors will gain insights into predicting future product market and financial performance based on the presence and capabilities of data scientists within firms. Regulators can make informed decisions regarding data sharing, data privacy, data-driven anti-trust regulations. Universities will be able to design targeted training programs for data scientists based on the identified industry demands. The research outputs will be particularly meaningful for Hong Kong's innovation and technology development. With the government's focus on "AI and Data Science" in the Hong Kong Innovation and Technology Development Blueprint, this research will contribute to a deeper understanding of how data scientists can influence market dynamics in Hong Kong, as well as the interactions between Hong Kong, mainland China, and international markets. 在競爭激烈的市場中蓬勃發展，企業必須了解個別消費者的需求並提供個性化的產品和服務。然而，傳統的消費者信息收集方法，如調查，可能既昂貴又耗時。數據科學的興起為這一挑戰提供了解決方案，使企業能夠利用大規模數據分析來了解消費者偏好並提供有針對性的產品。這份研究計劃旨在探討數據科學家在產品市場競爭中的角色。 該提案概述了一項計劃，利用來自Lightcast和Revelio Lab的個人簡歷數據，在公司年度水平上構建數據科學家的全面數據集。數據科學家將根據其技能分為四組：數據獲取、數據組織和維護、數據算法和數據分析。此外，所提出的研究將利用家庭層面的Nielsen掃描數據，直接捕捉每個家庭的消費者購買行為。這些數據集結合在一起，將有助於調查數據科學家通過哪些經濟機制影響產品市場競爭。 該提案的研究成果預計對企業、投資者、監管機構和大學具有深遠的影響。企業將受益於識別能夠提升其市場競爭力的數據科學家類型。投資者將獲得洞察力，根據企業內的數據科學家的存在和能力來預測未來產品市場和財務表現。監管機構可以根據數據科學家對數據共享、數據隱私、基於數據的反壟斷法規的影響做出明智決策。大學將能夠根據已確定的行業需求設計針對數據科學家的培訓計劃。 這些研究成果對香港的創新和科技發展將具有特別重要意義。隨著香港創新及科技發展藍圖中政府對“人工智能和數據科學”的關注，這項研究將有助於更深入地了解數據科學家如何影響香港市場動態，以及香港、中國內地和國際市場之間的互動關係。

14506424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14506424.value: 氣候意識的市政債券承銷

14506424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14506424.value: 在面對日益嚴峻的氣候變遷挑戰時，金融市場在引導資本投向可持續和具韌性的投資方面發揮了關鍵作用。特別是市政債券市場，對社區基礎設施和當地公共項目有著直接的影響。作為市政債券初級市場的重要中介，承銷商可以大幅影響氣候風險的披露，進而影響項目的結果。本研究旨在探討承銷商的氣候意識如何影響披露實踐、定價和資金分配。它提出的問題是：氣候意識的承銷是否能促進更加可持續和具有氣候韌性的地方經濟？ 本研究使用了涵蓋2009年6月至2022年5月期間，由電子市政市場通道（Electronic Municipal Market Access）提供的145,026份正式聲明的龐大數據集，調查了承銷商在市政債券發行中氣候風險披露的角色及其對市場價格的後續影響。透過文本分析技術來衡量氣候風險的披露，本研究試圖分析承銷商在起草發行聲明中的氣候風險時的環境意識。初步分析顯示，各承銷商在氣候風險披露方面存在顯著的橫截面差異，這表明有必要進一步探討承銷商特定的氣候意識及其對債券定價的潛在影響。 作為對市政債券發行聲明內容的前所未有的研究，本研究可能為學術文獻提供寶貴的見解。儘管先前的研究使用了海平面上升和熱量變化等客觀指標來理解氣候風險，但本項目採用了新穎的方法，通過利用氣候風險因素的自我披露聲明，從發行者和承銷商的角度探討感知到的氣候風險。此外，本研究揭示了這些感知到的並自願披露的氣候風險如何在初級和次級市場中反映到定價中，從而拓展了我們對市政債券文獻中氣候風險的理解。通過嚴謹的分析，本研究旨在為市場參與者和監管機構提供關於氣候風險披露對市政債券市場動態影響的可行性見解。在此過程中，本研究希望強調承銷商在促進氣候韌性金融生態系統中所扮演的關鍵角色，並為經濟和監管框架的發展提供指導。

14507424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14507424.value: 貨幣政策對債券市場有重大影響。我們的早期研究（Abdi和Wu, 2018）顯示，企業債券對貨幣政策有強烈的反應。在這個新項目裡，我們計劃研究貨幣政策對地方債券市場的影響。我們將貨幣政策的影響量化為地方債券收益率對貨幣政策衝擊的反應力。由於貨幣政策影響地方政府的借款成本和違約可能，地方債券的收益將會隨著貨幣政策的改變發生變化。貨幣政策對地方債券市場的影響是一個較少被涉獵的課題。少數研究通常關注債券收益率對貨幣政策衝擊的時間序列反應。我們計劃探討美國各個州發行的地方債券對貨幣政策產生的反應。通過地方債券的交易數據和發行人信息，我們計劃研究不同投資者如何根據貨幣政策進行投資，以及美聯儲貨幣政策立場是如何影響地方債券的發行。地方債券市場是一個重要但未被充分研究的領域。美國的地方債務高達到4萬億美元，這大致相當於企業債務的一半。隨著美聯儲對通貨膨脹採取更強硬的立場並轉向歷史性的高利率，地方政府違約的風險逐漸加大，加上高額的未償還債務，這對金融系統的穩定構成巨大的風險。硅谷銀行最近的崩盤就是這種風險的生動例證。更重要的是，這種風險不僅局限於美國。在中國，高額債務以及地方政府違約日益成為一個棘手的問題。因此，全面分析地方政府債務與貨幣政策之間的關係比以往任何時候都更加緊迫。

14508024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14508024.value: 雲端計算中的接近最佳資源分配策略

14508024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14508024.value: In today's digitally driven era, cloud resource optimization is pivotal, underpinning services from e-commerce to e-governance. This research delves into a nuanced model of cloud resource allocation, integrating demand types, resource types, and queuing dynamics. Recognizing that different demands bring varied revenues and entail diverse waiting costs, the study aims to formulate optimal strategies, striking a balance between service quality and profitability. We aim to optimize the routing policy and admission control, addressing the trade-offs between waiting costs and revenue losses. In addition, since it is often costly to make all the resources flexible in matching all types of demand, we aim to design a sparse structure that could achieve near-optimal performance compared with the fully flexible system. In a nutshell, we hope to jointly optimize the choice of structure design, admission control, and routing policy in order to minimize the revenue loss and waiting cost in a cloud computing system. 在現今數位驅動的時代，雲端資源優化至關重要，支撐著從電子商務到電子治理的各項服務。本研究深入探討雲端資源分配的細緻模型，整合了需求類型、資源類型和排隊動態。我們認識到不同需求帶來的收入各異，並且涉及多樣的等待成本，因此研究旨在制定最佳策略，平衡服務質量和盈利能力。我們的目標是優化路由策略和准入控制，解決等待成本與收入損失之間的權衡。此外，由於將所有資源靈活匹配所有類型的需求往往成本高昂，我們希望設計一個稀疏結構，使其在與完全靈活系統相比時能夠達到近乎最佳的性能。總而言之，我們希望聯合優化結構設計選擇、准入控制和路由策略，以最小化雲端計算系統中的收入損失和等待成本。

14508924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14508924.value: 基於網絡的準實驗中異質性治療效果的估計：一種半參數深度神經網絡方法

14508924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14508924.value: We introduce a novel approach for estimating heterogeneous treatment effects in network-based quasi-experiments with interference (i.e., when potential outcomes of a unit depend on its treatment as well as on the treatments of other units). Motivated by recent theoretical establishments of modeling interference as mediated through the entire network (Galeotti et al. 2020), we propose a semi-parametric deep neural network model to estimate the heterogeneous treatment effects in the presence of network interference. We account for such interference by incorporating the network as a flexible control function manifested through the attributed network embeddings of the network graph. We will apply the method to a real-world quasi-experiment in an online social gaming context, and provide insights into game design and targeting. Our research contributes to the growing body of literature on causal inferences with network-based quasi-experiments. 我們介紹了一種新穎的方法，用於估計具有干擾的基於網絡的準實驗中的異質性治療效果（即，當一個單位的潛在結果取決於其自身的治療以及其他單位的治療時）。受最近理論確立的啟發，將干擾建模為通過整個網絡進行調解（Galeotti 等人，2020 年），我們提出了一種半參數深度神經網絡模型，用於在存在網絡干擾的情況下估計異質性治療效果。我們通過將網絡作為一個靈活的控制函數來考慮這種干擾，該函數通過網絡圖的屬性網絡嵌入來體現。我們將把該方法應用於在線社交遊戲環境中的一個現實世界的準實驗，並提供有關遊戲設計和目標定位的見解。我們的研究為基於網絡的準實驗中的因果推斷文獻增加了新的貢獻。

14509124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14509124.value: Trip Radar：提升網約車匹配效率的受控分散系統

14509124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14509124.value: Motivated by Uber's new Trip Radar feature, we consider the two-sided recommendation and matching problem faced by a ride-sharing platform. The Trip Radar system aims to solve the low acceptance rate problem from traditional Primary Riding system, wherein each rider/trip is sequentially recommended to individual drivers. Instead, it introduces a parallel recommendation model where a single customer can be promoted to multiple drivers simultaneously, while drivers are recommended with several trip requests concurrently and can pick the trip they are interested to serve from the list. This mechanism necessitates a two-stage decision process from the platform: i) choosing a list of customers to recommend to each driver, and ii) optimizing the subsequent matching, based on the revealed interests from the drivers. With the objective of maximizing the expected total weights of matching, we show that the Trip Radar system can attain at least 1/2 of the optimal solution, which is notably NP-hard to achieve and typically demands recommendations through sequential rounds. Remarkably, Trip Radar attains this 1/2 optimality within a single round of recommendation, underscoring its efficacy in the ride-sharing application, where reducing average wait times--of which the matching algorithm's running time is a substantial component--for both drivers and riders is paramount. In the next step, we want to extend the model to the online setting, where both the drivers and customers will arrive stochastically and remain in the platform with a random sojourn duration, thereby introducing an additional layer of complexity and stochasticity into the matching algorithm. 受Uber新推出的Trip Radar功能的啟發，我們考慮了網約車平台面臨的雙邊推薦和匹配問題。 Trip Radar系統旨在解決傳統主要乘車系統中接受率低的問題，在傳統系統中每個乘客/行程是按順序向個別司機推薦的。相反，它引入了一個並行推薦模型，其中單個乘客可以同時向多個司機推薦，而司機則同時收到幾個行程請求，可以從列表中選擇他們感興趣服務的行程。這種機制要求平台進行兩階段決策過程：i) 為每個司機選擇要推薦的乘客列表，以及 ii) 基於司機表現出的興趣優化後續匹配。 以最大化匹配的預期總權重為目標，我們表明Trip Radar系統可以至少達到最優解的1/2，而最優解通常需要通過多輪sequential推薦，對應的實現是NP的。值得注意的是，Trip Radar在單輪推薦中就達到了這1/2的最優性，凸顯了其在網約車應用中的效率，因為減少司機和乘客的平均等待時間至關重要。在下一步，我們希望將模型擴展到在線設置，其中司機和乘客都將隨機到達並在平台上停留隨機時長，從而為匹配算法引入額外的複雜性和隨機性。

14600024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14600024.value: 以人工智能驅動的聊天機器人為神經發展障礙兒童的父母提供接納與承諾治療 (Pai.ACT)：隨機對照試驗

14600024.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14600024.value: Prof Chien, Wai Tong Prof Fung, Kenneth Prof Gloster, Andrew Prof Lam, Hiu Fung Dr Li, Man-ho

14600024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14600024.value: 幼兒患有神經發育障礙（NDD）——如注意力不足/過度活躍症、自閉症譜系障礙和發展遲緩——表現出行為、語言和社交障礙，這對父母造成了相當大的照顧負擔。這些父母通常會經歷較高水平的壓力、焦慮和抑鬱，這些情緒不利地影響親子關係並加劇其子女的情緒和行為症狀。現有的干預措施往往忽視了父母情緒健康，主要集中在增強育兒技巧上。雖然一些干預有效地緩解了育兒壓力，但未能全面顧及父母和孩子的健康狀況。接納與承諾治療（ACT）已獲得實證驗證，是一種跨診斷的心理治療方法，對父母和孩子都有雙重益處。然而，其服務主要是面對面的，需要專業輔導人員，因此限制了其可擴展性和可 達性。重要的是，ACT與其他心理治療方式一樣，常常採用“一刀切”的方法，使用標準化/預包裝的練習，缺乏處理個人在心理不靈活過程中的變異—— 也是ACT 治療的核心目標。 本研究提出一項多中心、重複測量的隨機對照試驗，旨在比較Pai.ACT與正向育兒建議對210名香港NDD學齡前兒童的父母的干預效果， 跟進將持續12個月。自2021年4月以來，我們的團隊開發了「Pai.ACT」，這是第一個由人工智能驅動、聊天機器人輔助的手機應用程式，旨在為患有NDD的華語父母提供個人化的聚焦ACT 輔導服務。Pai.ACT 基於經過驗證的 ACT 協議，包含以下特點：(i) 專門為聚焦 ACT 的生活情境和問題導向訪談而設計的專業問題庫；(ii) 一個預先訓練的自然語言處理模型，能夠通過實時文本分析用戶與聊天機器人的對話來識別心理不靈活性；以及 (iii) 根據用戶心理不靈活過程中的變異而提供六星期的線上ACT自學課程，並在第六星期提供線上輔導以增強效果。我們的可行性研究數據顯示，Pai.ACT 系統具有高性能和良好的系統可用性，並且在干預後顯著改善了心理靈活性和育兒壓力。是次研究將評估多項結果，包括育兒壓力、抑鬱與焦慮症狀、父母的心理靈活性、兒童的情緒與行為症狀，以及在招募時、干預後立即、干預後3個月、6個月及12個月的醫療 及社會福利服務使用情況。數據分析將採用廣義估計方程模型來檢查多個時間點的內外組間平均結果得分和計數數據的變化。此外，研究將進行匿名的個別訪談，以探討父母對 使用Pai.ACT及其服務的經驗。

14600224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14600224.value: 普遍性拒絕與媒體營養管理: 闡釋民主倒退下的新聞迴避及其影響

14600224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14600224.value: News avoidance has captured much research attention in the past decade, as researchers found that a significant portion of the public may intentionally or unintentionally withdraw themselves from the news due to various reasons. On the negative side, news avoidance may lead to a less informed citizenry and undermine the process of democratic public deliberation. On the positive side, news avoidance may allow individuals to properly manage their emotions, thus maintaining mental well-being in difficult circumstances. Meanwhile, in Hong Kong where the political system has undergone a process of rapid democratic backsliding, news avoidance is also a widely discussed phenomenon. After the end of the Anti-Extradition Law Amendment Bill Movement and the establishment of the National Security Law in 2020, many pro-democracy citizens were frustrated by the scaling back of civil liberties in the society and saddened by news about the trial and jailing of activists, politicians, and critical journalists. Many people thus developed a tendency to avoid the news. Against such background, the present project tries to contribute to both general theoretical understanding of news avoidance as well as news avoidance under the context of democratic backsliding. It does so first of all by establishing a novel conceptual distinction between two types of intentional news avoidance, namely, generalized news rejection and news diet management. generalized news rejection refers to the tendency to avoid all kinds of news from all news sources due to a highly negative perception of the news and/or the social reality. News diet management refers to the strategic attempt to control one’s news diet, often involving the reduction of consumption of specific types of news from specific outlets, so as to maintain one’s emotional well-being and ensure oneself being reasonably informed. The project shall establish the distinction through examining how these two forms of intentional news avoidance correlate differently with a range of factors, such as news trust, public affairs knowledge, civic engagement, and so on. In addition, to understand the implications of news avoidance in the context of democratic backsliding, this study shall examine how the two types of intentional news avoidance are embedded into a cycle of political alienation and a cycle of political resilience, respectively. Furthermore, the project includes a qualitative component – in the form of focus group discussions – for generating more nuanced insights into the character and implications of generalized news rejection and news diet management. 過去十年，研究者發現相當一部分的公眾因不同原因而有意或無意地迴避新聞，因此，新聞迴避的現象獲得學界很多關注。負面而言，新聞迴避可能會引致一個對社會更少知情的公民，損害民眾就公共議題進行商議的能力。正面而言，新聞迴避或許可以讓個人適當地管理情緒，進而在艱難情勢下保持精神健康。 與此同時，香港社會在過去數年經歷了急速的民主倒退，新聞迴避也成了廣受討論的現象。在反修例運動和2020年國安法實施之後，許多支持民主派的市民因為社會的公民自由縮窄而感到沮喪，因為社運人士、政治人物和具批判性的記者入獄和受審的新聞而感到難過，於是形成了迴避新聞的傾向。 在此背景之下，研究項目希望在一般的新聞迴避理論以及民主倒退下的新聞迴避理論兩個方面有所貢獻。為此，項目首先會就兩種類型的有意識的新聞迴避做出概念性區分，即廣義的新聞拒絕以及新聞營養管理。廣義的新聞拒絕指的是因對新聞和/或社會現實高度負面的認知而迴避來自所有新聞消息來源的所有新聞的傾向。新聞營養管理指的是控制個人新聞接收的策略性嘗試，通常涉及減少來自特定新聞機構的特定類型的新聞消費，以維持個體的情緒健康，但同時保持個人對社會有一定程度的認知。 為建立上述的概念性區分，研究項目將檢驗這兩種有意識的新聞迴避如何與一系列因素關聯，例如新聞信任、公共事務知識、公民參與，等等。除此之外，為理解在民主倒退情況下新聞迴避的影響，研究將檢驗此兩種有意識的新聞迴避如何分別嵌入政治異化的循環，以及政治韌性的循環。項目包括亦一個質性研究的部分——以焦點小組討論的形式——以獲得更多關於廣義新聞拒絕和新聞營養管理的特質和影響之細緻理解。

14600524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14600524.value: 利用多普勒光達網絡和多尺度氣候模型建立極端高溫天氣下的城市垂直風速廓線數據集

14600524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14600524.value: 極端高溫天氣事件頻率和嚴重程度的增加，對城市居民的健康和熱舒適性構成了重大威脅。風對緩解城市過熱至關重要，隨著香港面臨日益嚴峻的熱相關問題風險，我們比以往任何時候都更需要深入了解風在極端高溫天氣事件下的特性。 規劃署已經開發了兩個垂直風速廓線數據集，以提供特定地點正常氣候（長期平均）條件的風速信息，用於通風評估。然而，由於極端高溫已被證明對風速強弱、廓線形狀和運動模式有顯著影響，現有數據集可能不足以支援極端高溫天氣下的通風評估。 本項目旨在通過整合先進的多普勒光達設備網絡和中尺度數值氣候模型，更好地估算極端高溫天氣中的垂直風速廓線。多普勒光達技術提供了高分辨率且穩定的垂直風速廓線觀測數據，而中尺度數值氣候模型則是唯一能夠基於全球變暖演變過程對城市邊界層氣流運動進行預測的工具。該項目有四個目標： (1) 以多普勒光達設備網絡，對極端高溫天氣中風場結構的日夜變化進行長期觀測，並對比現有正常氣候條件下的垂直風速廓線數據集。 (2) 基於目標1中的多普勒光達觀測數據，評估數值氣候模型在極端高溫天氣中的準確度，並建立香港中遠期極端高溫天氣中的24小時垂直風速廓線數據集。 (3) 利用目標2中的24小時垂直風速廓線數據集，以香港典型公共租住房單位為例，評估中遠期極端高溫天氣對高密度高層城市區域通風條件的影響。 (4) 根據目標3中的評估結果，對政策行動的必要性提出建議：引入新的極端高溫天氣垂直風速廓線數據集，建立一個機制以定期監測和評估該數據集，更新現有的通風評估指引，探索適應極端高溫天氣的通風設計策略。 在“新常態” 極端高溫天氣條件下獲得更準確的垂直風速廓線數據集至關重要。該數據可作為未來城市風環境監測和預測工作的基準，並為評估未來氣候變化中創建更健康、更具韌性的生活環境的城市政策提供依據。

14600724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14600724.value: 發展的起源：戰間期大英帝國的反殖民抵抗、社會鬥爭與勞工改革

14600724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14600724.value: This project will explore the intertwined histories of British politics, British imperial governance and developments at the international, League of Nations level in the interwar period. On all three levels, the two decades between the First and Second World Wars were a time of extensive contestation. In Britain, the 1920s saw widespread social tension and unrest, met by a government constantly on edge, which frequently deployed the repressive legal mechanisms developed during the First World War to suppress perceived threats. Around the British Empire, major clashes took place as well, including in Shanghai, Canton, Hong Kong and other locations in East Asia in the mid-1920s, and in the Caribbean and Africa in the 1930s. On the international level, the vision of a harmonious world order that was developed after the First World War, while always far from a reality, came increasingly under threat as fascist powers rose to prominence in central Europe in the 1930s. Among the steps taken by the British Empire over the period in question, both at home and abroad, were numerous measures designed to ameliorate and improve the conditions for workers, and to incorporate them more fully into the existing political order, advanced under the general heading of ‘development.’ While in some circumstances a response to advancing technologies, in the vast majority of cases these changes appeared far more a response to the growing political power of workers as such, motivated by a blend of sincere commitment and fear of alternatives, as well as a means of strategic response to perceived threats and possibilities on the international level. The broader framing of ‘development’ under which the policies in question were advanced, and those policies as such, were extensively discussed and debated in the period, moreover, by both proponents and critics. This project will attempt to map the legal, institutional and policy developments of the period; to consider the circumstances in which, and why, they were implemented; and to contemplate the manner in which they were debated and discussed at the time, including how they were used to justify British Empire, and what sorts of criticisms ‘development’ and British imperial governance in general faced in the period. 本項目將探討英國政治、英國帝國治理及國際層面（國際聯盟層面）在兩次世界大戰之間的交織歷史。在這三個層面上，第一次和第二次世界大戰之間的兩個十年是廣泛爭論的時期。1920年代，英國社會廣泛出現了緊張和動盪的情勢，政府在此期間經常處於不穩定的邊緣狀態，並經常運用第一次世界大戰期間發展的壓制性法律機制來鎮壓被視為威脅的行為。在大英帝國的其他殖民地區，亦發生了重大衝突，包括1920年代中期的上海、廣州、香港及其他東亞地區，以及1930年代的加勒比海和非洲。在國際層面上，第一次世界大戰後形成的和諧世界秩序的願景，雖然遠未成為現實，但在1930年代法西斯勢力在中歐崛起的背景下，愈加受到威脅。 在此期間，英國帝國在國內外採取的多項措施旨在改善工人的條件，並更全面地將其納入現有的政治秩序，這些措施被總稱為“發展”。雖然在某些情況下是對新技術的回應，但在絕大多數情況下，這些變化似乎更多是對工人政治力量日益增強的反應，這種反應由其真誠的承諾與對替代方案的恐懼所驅動，同時也是對國際層面上所感知的威脅和可能性的戰略回應。此外，這一時期所推進的“發展”框架及相關政策，受到支持者和批評者的廣泛討論和辯論。本項目將試圖繪製該時期的法律、機構和政策發展；考察這些措施實施的背景及原因；並思考它們在當時如何被辯論和討論，包括它們如何被用來為大英帝國正名，以及在此期間“發展”政策和英國帝國治理所面臨的各種批評。

14601524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14601524.value: 中國金融科技發展與監管背景下的數據資料保護

14601524.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14601524.value: Prof Arner, Douglas Wayne Prof LEE, Jyh An Prof Wong, Kam Fai

14601724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14601724.value: 查爾斯・朗・佛利爾的中國佛教繪畫收藏

14601724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14601724.value: Chinese Buddhist paintings housed at the Freer Gallery of Art, Washington, DC, comprise only a small portion of Asian art collected by Charles Lang Freer (1854–1919). However, these paintings were the finest Chinese works that Freer had been determined to pursue. On his sickbed months before his death, Freer instructed one of his dealers in China to keep searching for early Chinese paintings, especially Buddhist paintings of the Tang and Song dynasties in the traditions of Wu Daozi 吳道子(fl. 680–759) and Guanxiu 貫休(832–912), on his behalf. This research, therefore, explores how Freer, one of the most important Asian art collectors at the beginning of the twentieth century, shaped his understanding of the history of Chinese painting during a time when the study of Chinese painting in China, Europe, Japan, and the United States had not yet reached a consensus on methodology, masterpieces, and connoisseurship. By examining Freer’s diaries, letters, and purchase records, this research first aims to reconstruct how Freer orchestrated a Chinese Buddhist painting collection that to this day is still prominent among modern museums around the globe. Second, this research maps out the global networks of the collectors, dealers, and scholars of Chinese painting who helped build Freer’s collection. Third, this research identifies Freer’s crucial role in bringing together different art historical traditions in America, East Asia, and Europe, as well as fostering a modern discourse on the history of Chinese painting. Last but not least, this research looks into the historiography of Chinese Buddhist painting, a genre that has long been overlooked by art historians, who have traditionally preferred literati art. The intended outcome of this project is one referred journal article. 美國華盛頓特區佛利爾美術館所藏的中國佛教繪畫僅占查爾斯・朗・佛利爾（1854–1919）收藏亞洲藝術品的一小部分。然而，這些繪畫卻是佛利爾及盡心力欲意追求的中國藝術精品。佛利爾在去世前幾個月臥病在床時，仍指示他在中國的一位藝術代理人，為他繼續尋找早期中國繪畫，尤其是代表了唐宋時期吳道子（活躍於680–759年間）和貫休（832–912）傳統的佛教繪畫。因此，本研究將探討作為二十世紀初最重要亞洲藝術收藏家之一的佛利爾，如何在中國、歐洲、日本和美國的學界與收藏界，對中國繪畫的研究方法、代表作及鑑賞尚未達成共識之時，形成他對中國繪畫史的理解。通過考察佛利爾的日記、信件和購買記錄，本研究首先旨在重建佛利爾如何構建出一個至今仍在全球現代博物館中佔有重要地位的中國佛教繪畫收藏。其次，本研究將辨識出幫助建立佛利爾收藏的中國繪畫收藏家、藝術代理人和藝術史學者的全球網絡。第三，本研究將確立佛利爾在美國、東亞和歐洲不同藝術史傳統的融合，與促進中國繪畫史現代語彙的形成中所扮演的重要角色。最後，本研究將探討中國佛教繪畫史學史，這一畫類長期以來被偏愛文人繪畫的藝術史學者所忽視。 這個項目的預期成果是一篇學術期刊文章。

14602024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14602024.value: 抽象的康德：超驗哲學基礎的再思

14602024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14602024.value: The proposed research sets out to conduct a rigorous examination of the implications and consequences of identifying abstract objects as the grounds of transcendental philosophy. This project builds on my extensive previous work in Kantian studies and aims to challenge and refine traditional understandings of Kant’s transcendental idealism, particularly his commitment to mind-independent but uncognizable things in themselves and noumena. This traditional understanding has often led critics to identify internal inconsistencies in Kant’s framework. My recent research has proposed a transformative re-interpretation, conceptualizing negative noumena as abstract objects of thought. This novel approach significantly alters our understanding of the relationship between concrete spatiotemporal phenomena and their foundational noumena. One major breakthrough from this research is the synthesis of Kant’s transcendental psychology and metaphysics. By reconceiving Kant’s faculty of cognition and the transcendental subject as abstract, theoretical constructs rather than concrete entities, the project resolves longstanding allegations of psychologism that have plagued Kantian scholarship for decades. This approach provides a nuanced and integrated understanding of the ontological and epistemological roles of transcendental cognitive faculties, effectively erasing the traditionally perceived divide between Kant’s metaphysics and psychology. Another avenue of exploration in this project is the complex issue of transcendental freedom within Kant’s philosophical framework. Traditional interpretations have found it challenging to reconcile Kant’s robust commitments to both freedom and causal determinism. The theoretical model to be developed in this project aims to resolve this paradox. By interpreting concrete phenomena as spatiotemporal manifestations or instantiations of their abstract foundations, the model allows for the existence of dual-aspect perspectives. For instance, an individual could be understood as a causally determined entity from the lens of spatiotemporal instantiation while simultaneously being viewed as a rational, moral agent under a separate set of abstract, non-temporal criteria. This dual-aspect approach aligns well with Kant’s own thoughts on the duality of an individual’s empirical and intelligible characters, offering a richer and more nuanced understanding of freedom within Kantian philosophy. To realize these objectives, the project plans to utilize grant support for scholarly collaboration with leading experts in the field of Kant studies. It also aims for the dissemination of its findings through presentations at international academic forums and the publication of scholarly articles and eventual a monograph on Kant. 本研究計劃旨在探討將抽象對象作為超驗哲學基礎的意義。傳統對康德超驗觀念論的理解是接受獨立於心靈但不可知的物自身存在，但這假設導致一系列難題，甚至引發康德理論內部的矛盾。本計劃提出一種全新的解釋，將物自體或本體視為抽象對象，以重新理解經驗對象與物自身的關係。這框架同時將康德的超驗主體和認知能力視為抽象的理論構造，有助於消除康德形而上學與超驗心理學之間的傳統鴻溝。 本計劃還為康德哲學中超驗自由的難題提供新的解釋途徑，提出每個經驗主體在時空框架下可被視為因果決定的實體，同時在另一種非時間性框架下可被視為理性道德主體。這種雙重視角與康德關於個體的經驗和理智雙重性格的思想吻合，從而消解因果決定論與超驗自由之間的衝突。 本計劃將利用資助聘請代課老師，以騰出時間進行研究，並與康德研究領域的專家合作，通過在國際學術論壇上的報告和學術文章發表研究成果。

14602324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14602324.value: 重新考慮經濟制裁的國際法執行作用

14602324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14602324.value: Although various forms of economic sanctioning have long been an aspect of interstate relations, their use as a tool for the enforcement of international legal norms has greatly increased since the mid-20th century. Much of the international legal regime of sanctions today can, meanwhile, be tied to a small set of legal authorizations in domestic statutes and international agreements, whose history has not yet been adequately explored. Chief among these legal authorities are the United States statutes Trading With the Enemy Act (TWEA) and the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA). The latter was adopted by the Congress in 1976, and the former in 1917, though its interpretation was changed dramatically over the decades, especially after the beginning of the Korean War (1950-1953). Meanwhile, at the international level, sanctions are a feature of the United Nations Charter adopted in 1945, and most obviously committed to the authority of the Security Council, although there have been a number of duelling interpretations and diplomatic initiatives regarding this arrangement. This project is an innovative historical and doctrinal reassessment of modern practices of economic sanctioning, which will establish a comprehensive new account of the relevant legal architecture, its origins, and its implications for global rule of law. The research project adopts an interdisciplinary perspective drawing insights primarily from international law doctrine and theory, combined with perspectives originating in the fields of diplomatic history, as well as legal theory (including law and economics scholarship, which is useful for understanding the competitive and rational choice-oriented aspects of states' sanctioning policies). During the initial research phase, the PI will make use of diplomatic, organizational, and biographical archives in order to obtain 1) a better understanding of the origins of modern sanctioning legislation and policies and 2) the debates surrounding them, including the contributions of key theorists and policymakers involved in the formation of US and UN sanctions policies, as well as legal scholars of Global South states who affected such policies through critical engagement. During the subsequent phase of analysis and synthesis of materials, the PI will determine the extent to which 3) previously-ignored or under-studied perspectives on sanctions, and enforcement of international law in general, might help to illuminate current disagreements among states. Particularly important is the issue of how "economic sanctions" can be distinguished from "economic coercion": this project will provide the first thoroughly detailed analysis of this theoretical question from a historically-informed perspective. 儘管各種形式的經濟制裁長期以來一直运用在國際關係中，但自 20 世紀中葉以來，运用其作為執行國際法規範的工具大大增加。同時，當今國際制裁法律制度的大部分都可以與國內法規和國際協定中的一小部分法律授權聯繫在一起，而其歷史尚未得到充分探索。這些法律權威中最主要的是美國法規《與敵人交易法》(TWEA) 和《國際緊急經濟權力法》(IEEPA)。後者於 1976 年被國會通過，前者於 1917 年被國會通過，儘管其解釋在幾十年來發生了巨大變化，特別是在朝鮮戰爭開始後（1950-1953 年）。同時，在國際層面，经济制裁是 1945 年通過的《聯合國憲章》中的一項措施，受限於安理會的權威，儘管對此安排存在一些相互矛盾的解釋和外交策略。該計畫是對現代經濟制裁實踐的創新歷史和理論的重新評估，將對相關法律架構、起源及其對全球法治的影響建立全面的新解釋。本研究計畫採用跨學科視角，主要從國際法學說和理論中汲取見解，並結合源自外交史以及法學理論（包括對理解制裁政策的競爭性和理性選擇因素有利的法律經濟學領域的觀點）。在初始研究階段，首席研究員將利用外交、組織和傳記檔案，以便更好地了解1）現代製裁立法和政策的起源，2）圍繞制裁立法和政策的辯論，包括關鍵人物的貢獻，參與美國和聯合國制裁政策制定的理論家和政策制定者，以及通過批判性參與影響此類政策的全球南方國家的法律學者。在隨後的材料分析和綜合階段，PI 將闡明 3) 先前被忽視或研究不足的製裁觀點以及一般國際法的執行在多大程度上可能有助於闡明當前國際間的分歧。尤其重要的是如何區分「經濟制裁」與「經濟脅迫」的問題：該計畫將從歷史角度首次對這一理論問題進行徹底詳盡的分析闡釋。

14602724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14602724.value: 連結海洋、沿岸地區與陸地：1861–1898年香港作為華南地區海盜的紐帶

14602724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14602724.value: A top-down approach that problematizes piracy as a threat to trade and land-based regimes has dominated much scholarship on piracy related to British Hong Kong. In contrast, this project explores how maritime raiding was intertwined with the society of colonial Hong Kong and its neighboring Guangdong region. Combining a bottom-up approach with a regional perspective, the project examines the roles of Hong Kong as a node of piratical assaults, hijacking, and their associated activities from the British occupation of Kowloon in 1861 to the eve of the lease of the New Territories in 1898. Drawing on British colonial records, newspaper materials, Qing archival documents, and other sources, it explores the pattern of pirates’ attacks and the distribution of their haunts across Hong Kong and its adjacent coast, islands, and passages. The evolution of piracy around Hong Kong is largely a function of British colonial and naval power, Qing state capacity, regional conflicts, and the development of maritime transportation. A pivot of South China piracy, late nineteenth-century Hong Kong provided shelter, intelligence, and a “black market” for piratical chiefs, ordinary pirates, and their watercraft. Familial, kinship, native-place, occupational, ethnic, and sworn-brotherhood connections tied together many pirates, who were simultaneously associated with smugglers, receivers of plunder, and various other Chinese and non-Chinese groups in Hong Kong and its environs across the Pearl River Delta. In sum, colonial Hong Kong was a “piratical nexus” in modern-era piracy in South China that contributed to the social integration of the sea, littorals, and land territories in the region. Put in perspective, maritime raiding around late nineteenth-century Hong Kong was both a departure from and a continuity of piracy in China in the early modern and modern eras. The advent of the British in Hong Kong and along the China coast at large transformed the equilibrium of power between Qing forces, foreigners, and local armed groups—including pirates. At the same time, similar to their late imperial antecedents in South China, those engaged in piracy around colonial Hong Kong were so mobile that they could shift between legal and illegal occupations and traverse across administrative-political boundaries. From a transregional angle, some intrinsic features of piracy in Hong Kong and its surrounding areas—such as its inseparability from smuggling and secret societies—are also found in maritime Southeast Asia and other South China Sea regions in the nineteenth century. 過去有關英殖時代香港海盜的研究，多從自上而下的角度出發，視海盜為貿易和陸上政權的威脅。與之相反，本研究探討海上劫掠與英屬香港及其鄰近廣東地區社會密不可分的關係。是次計劃結合自下而上的研究方法與區域視野，考察1861至1898年香港作為海盜攻擊、劫持船隻及其相關活動的樞紐角色。透過英國殖民記錄、報章資料、清朝檔案與其他文件，本研究着重探討海盜襲擊的模式以及其在香港與鄰近海岸、島嶼和航道上的分佈。十九世紀香港周邊海盜的歷史，在很大程度上受英國殖民和海軍力量、清朝國力、地區衝突以及海上運輸等因素所影響。作為南中國海盜的樞紐，十九世紀末香港為海盜首領、大眾海盜及其船隻提供了避風港、情報和「黑市」。血緣、地緣、職業、族群和結拜關係聯繫了眾多海盜，他們又同時與走私者、接贓者以至珠江三角洲地區其他華人與非華人群體建立了多重關係。簡而言之，十九世紀香港是近現代華南海盜的一個核心紐帶，促進了該地區海洋、沿岸地區和陸地的社會整合。 從更寬廣的角度來看，十九世紀末香港周邊的海上劫掠不但是明清與近現代中國海盜歷史的延續，同時亦是其分水嶺。英人的到來從根本上改變了清朝軍事力量、洋人和地方武裝集團（包括海盜）之間的勢力均衡。與此同時，那些從事海盜活動的人群，與其明清時期的「祖先」非常類似。他們的流動性在於不但常常轉換合法和非法職業，而且能輕鬆跨越行政與政治邊界。從跨地域的歷史角度出發，香港及其周邊地區海盜活動的一些主要特徵（如與走私和秘密社會的密切關係），與十九世紀東南亞和其他南中國海地區的海盜個案相類似。

14603724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14603724.value: 透過加深對鄰里效應平均問題的理解來推進地理和社會科學的發展

14603724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14603724.value: 鄰里效應平均問題是一個基本的方法論問題，它可能影響對個體暴露於依賴流動性的環境因素（如空氣/噪音污染）及其健康影響的評估的準確性和可靠性。然而，儘管鄰里效應平均問題已發現了五年，但地理學家和社會科學家對它的性質和潛在機制的理解仍然非常有限，過去對它的研究的一些局限性亟待解決。為了解決這些局限性，本研究試圖使用綜合方法、大規模高分辨率的實證和模擬數據以及統計方法來：（1）檢驗鄰里效應平均問題是否是一種在所有情況下都會發生的普遍現象，或者是在某些特定情況下才會發生的現象。 (2) 檢驗基於居住地的個人暴露的常態或接近常態頻率分佈是否是鄰里效應平均問題發生的必要條件。 (3)檢驗鄰里效應平均問題是否為忽略人類流動性的結果，還是特定人類流動模式的結果。 (4) 研究環境因素的特定時空模式如何影響鄰里效應平均問題。（5）研究鄰里效應平均問題如何影響個體暴露於不同環境因素以及它如何與其他因素（如社會經濟地位、性別、年齡、種族、民族等）相互作用。 (6) 制定可行的建議和策略，以應對人類流動性和非居住環境帶來的挑戰和機會。 鄰里效應平均問題是一個基本科學問題，對所有關於依賴流動性的環境因素（如噪音、空氣污染和綠地）對人類健康的影響的研究結果的準確性和可靠性產生重大影響，並且忽視它可能會導致結果不可靠、結論錯誤、健康干預措施無效（甚至錯誤）。這些研究不僅包括許多地理和社會科學的研究，也幾乎涵蓋了所有環境與健康、環境流行病學和暴露科學的研究。因此，擬議的項目透過加深對鄰里效應平均問題的理解並強調需要充分解決和減輕該問題，有潛力大大提高這些領域未來研究的準確性和可靠性。
