14622424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14622424.value: 中學課程改革對高等教育和勞動市場結果的影響評估

14622424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14622424.value: A highly skilled workforce is a vital asset for industrialized nations, with mathematics and science proficiency driving technological advancements and scientific discoveries. In 2009, Hong Kong implemented the New Senior Secondary (NSS) curriculum reform to offer students a more flexible, broader-based education by eliminating arts and science streaming. However, concerns exist about whether this reform provided adequate resources to enrich students’ learning experiences. It’s also possible that it may have reduced students’ math and science skills, impacting their readiness for science-related college majors. Yet, there is limited systematic examination of the NSS reform’s impact on higher education outcomes, including college enrollment and major choices. Moreover, quality education in mathematics and science is linked to economic growth, and the NSS reform's effects on students’ participation in STEM fields after graduation remain unexplored. Despite the shift in male superiority following the 1989 university expansion, Hong Kong still experiences gender disparities in STEM fields. Female students continue to lag behind their male counterparts in sciences, engineering, and technology. It is imperative for policymakers to understand whether the NSS curriculum reform influenced these disparities. Additionally, the increasing number of Mainlander immigrants with proficiency in subjects free from language barriers raises questions about their role in tertiary STEM admissions and STEM employment in the labor market. Using Census and By-Census data from 2016 and 2021, and employing a regression discontinuity (RD) design based on the 2009 curriculum reform, this proposal seeks to provide a causal estimate of the link between curriculum reform and student outcomes beyond secondary school. Our study makes several notable contributions. It is the first to investigate the causal impact and consequences of the 2009 NSS reform on students' educational outcomes. Furthermore, it offers a comprehensive overview of higher education participation in Hong Kong following the 1989 higher education expansion policy. The utilization of various data sources, including Census and UGC data, allows us to document gender and nativity differences in college enrollment, major selection, and career choices, addressing the gender imbalance in STEM fields. Additionally, the study highlights the significance of Mainlander immigration in Hong Kong's STEM employment. Lastly, while existing research on wage effects of a narrower versus a broader curriculum is inconclusive, our study provides empirical evidence from an Asian perspective. 高技能勞動力是工業化國家的重要資產，數學和科學的熟練度推動了技術進步和科學發現。2009年，香港實施了新高中課程改革，旨在通過取消文理分科，為學生提供更靈活且更廣泛的教育。然而，人們對於這一改革是否提供了足夠的資源來豐富學生的學習經歷表示關切。此外，這項改革可能削弱了學生的數學和科學技能，影響他們在科學相關專業上的大學學習準備度。儘管如此，對新高中課程改革對高等教育結果（包括大學入學和專業選擇）影響的系統性研究仍然有限。此外，數學和科學的優質教育與經濟增長相關，而新高中課程改革對學生畢業後參與STEM（科學、技術、工程及數學）領域的影響仍有待探索。 儘管1989年大學擴招後男性優勢發生了轉變，但香港在STEM領域中仍存在性別差距。女性學生在科學、工程和技術領域仍然落後於男性學生。政策制定者必須了解新高中課程改革是否對這些差距產生了影響。此外，隨著更多來自內地的移民在不受語言障礙的科目中表現出色，他們在高等STEM教育入學和勞動市場STEM就業中的角色也引起了關注。本研究將利用2016年和2021年的人口普查及中期人口普查數據，並採用基於2009年課程改革的斷點回歸（RD）設計，以提供課程改革對學生在中學以後教育結果之間的因果關係估計。 我們的研究有多個重要貢獻。這是首次研究2009年新高中課程改革對學生教育結果的因果影響。此外，研究還全面概述了1989年高等教育擴招政策後香港高等教育的參與情況。通過利用包括人口普查和教資會在內的多個數據來源，我們能夠記錄大學入學、專業選擇和職業選擇上的性別和出生地差異，從而探討STEM領域的性別失衡問題。此外，該研究也強調了內地移民對香港STEM就業的重要性。最後，雖然現有關於課程寬窄對工資影響的研究尚無定論，但是我們的研究將提供來自亞洲視角的實證證據。

14623324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14623324.value: 家長工時、家長參與及青少年福祉：基於中國家庭追蹤調查（CFPS）的證據

14623324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14623324.value: The aim of this research project is to conduct a study to examine how parents’ working hours affect their involvement with their children’s education and children’s wellbeing. With the development of the 24/7 economy, working long hours has been increasingly prevalent among Chinese parents. Recent national estimates revealed that most working-age adults (62 %) in China work more than 45 hours per week, which raises concerns about its potential negative impact on children’s wellbeing. While these concerns are not novel, the extant literature has focused primarily on maternal working hours, neglecting the potential distinct effects of paternal working hours on children’s wellbeing. Furthermore, past research has tended to concentrate on the influence of parental working hours on young children, overlooking the evidence highlighting the significance of parental working conditions in shaping the development of adolescent children. Coupled with common methodological issues with previous research (e.g., failure to deal with selection bias), these limitations underscore the need for additional research on the association between parental working hours and adolescent children’s outcomes. We therefore propose to conduct a systematic investigation to examine the effect of parental (i.e., maternal and paternal) working hours on multiple domains of adolescent outcomes in a Chinese context, with a focus on the mediating role of parental involvement. Using a representative sample of children and parents drawn from the China Family Panel Studies, we will investigate how and under what conditions parental working hours affect the rate of parental involvement which in turn affects adolescent children’s educational outcomes, socio-emotional wellbeing, and physical/mental health. This study, the first to examine the association between parental working hours and adolescent outcomes in the Chinese context, is expected to reveal whether the effects of parental working hours on adolescent wellbeing are mediated by parental involvement, and whether parental involvement and children’s outcomes in low-income families, single-parent families, and families not living with grandparents are more adversely affected by such working conditions. Findings from this study will advance our understanding of work-family conflict faced by Chinese working parents. This understanding will in turn inform the development of family-friendly workplace policies and/or parental involvement initiatives that may ameliorate the potential adverse impact of undesirable working conditions on the wellbeing of children. 本研究之主要目的在於檢視家長的工作時數如何影響其參與子女教育及子女健康。隨著24/7全天候經濟的發展，長時間工作在中國家長中越發普遍。近期中國國家統計數據表明，多數國內適齡勞動成人每週工作超過45小時。社會各界憂慮家長超時工作或對兒童健康存在負面影響。因此，本研究組提出進行一項系統性調查，以檢視在中國背景下家長的工作時數對青少年子女各項發展指標的影響，並聚焦家長參與從中發揮的仲介角色。透過分析中國家庭追蹤調查 (The China Family Panel Studies) 中具代表性的兒童及家長樣本，研究組將深入探討家長工時如何影響家長參與並進而影響青少年子女的教育成果、情緒和社交發展及身心健康。作為首個在中國背景下檢視家長工時與青少年發展兩者關聯的研究，本研究將加深理解中國在職父母所面對的家庭和生活衝突，並進一步為家庭友善政策及/或促進家長參與的舉措提供資訊及指引，以期緩解不利工作狀況對兒童健康的潛在負面影響。

15100324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15100324.value: 闡明並針對內皮素信號通路治療 COVID後關節炎

15100324.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15100324.value: Dr Au, Man Ting Prof Yuan, Shuofeng

15100324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15100324.value: COVID-19 pandemic, caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus, comes to the end of emergency but not the end of challenge. Joint pain and arthritis, the major extrapulmonary manifestations of COVID-19, can turn into a long-hauled syndrome without proper treatment. It prompts further investigations into the pathomechanism and management of long COVID. Aim 1 of this project will delineate the spatiotemporal association of viral spike, endothelin-1, and their receptors with vascular and synovial joint damage up to 120 days post-infection by a variety of SARS-CoV-2 variants of concern in our established hamster model. Aim 2 seeks to examine the effects of endothelium-specific knockdown of either endothelin type A or B receptor on the pathogenesis of vascular dysfunction, arthralgia, and arthritis using the K18-hACE2 transgenic mice challenged by pseudotyped SARS-CoV-2. Aim 3 is to investigate the early or delayed treatment effect of selective endothelin receptor antagonists on the severity of viral arthritis in infected hamsters. Upon the completion of this project, our work will shed light on the vascular origin of post- COVID skeletal sequelae. We envision repurposing endothelin receptor antagonists for long COVID management. COVID-19 大流行由 SARS-CoV-2 病毒引起，雖然緊急狀態結束，但挑戰仍未終結。關節痛和關節炎是 COVID-19 的主要肺外表現，如果沒有適當的治療，可能會轉變為長期綜合症。這促使我們進一步研究長期 COVID 的病理機制和管理。本項目的目標 1 將在我們已建立的倉鼠模型中，描繪病毒刺突蛋白、內皮素-1 及其受體與血管和滑膜關節損傷在感染後 120 天內的時空關聯。目標 2 將使用 K18-hACE2 轉基因小鼠，通過假型 SARS-CoV-2 挑戰，檢查內皮特異性敲低內皮素 A 型或 B 型受體對血管功能障礙、關節痛和關節炎病理發生的影響。目標 3 是研究選擇性內皮素受體拮抗劑在感染倉鼠中對病毒性關節炎嚴重程度的早期或延遲治療效果。完成本項目後，我們的工作將揭示 COVID 後骨骼後遺症的血管起源。我們預計將內皮素受體拮抗劑重新用於長期 COVID 的管理。

15100524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15100524.value: 研究生物鐘基因 Bmal1 在全身性發炎引發的神經發炎和認知功能障礙中的作用

15100524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15100524.value: 越來越多的證據表明生物節律在調節免疫反應中起著至關重要的作用。Bmal1作為核心生物鐘基因，嚴格調控單核細胞和巨噬細胞中的內源性生物節律振盪器，密切控制免疫激活和炎症反應。破壞生物節律可以增強炎症反應。重要的是，免疫系統也可以反過來影響生物鐘。 我們的初步結果顯示，系統性炎症破壞了巨噬細胞、肝臟和大腦中Bmal1表達的晝夜節律性。此外，我們發現系統性炎症也破壞了促炎細胞因子的節律性表達，這些細胞因子直接引導單核細胞/巨噬細胞向組織遷移和浸潤。PI團隊已經證明，在不同實驗模型上（通過剖腹手術或腹腔注射脂多醣），神經炎症反應都可以被系統性炎症快速觸發。我們和其他研究團隊已經提出並進一步證明，激活的巨噬細胞可能是系統性炎症引發神經炎症的關鍵因素。這可以通過浸潤到大腦或刺激大腦中的小膠質細胞來實現神經炎症。然而，連接生物節律、系統性炎症和神經炎症的機制仍然不清楚。因此，系統性炎症如何影響生物節律以及巨噬細胞的生物節律，以及它最終如何影響神經炎症是一個重要問題。 除了免疫調節外，Bmal1在調節神經元功能和認知功能方面也起著關鍵作用。然而，Bmal1在炎症期間調節認知的神經元特異性作用仍不清楚。由於Bmal1在巨噬細胞和神經元中都具有雙重功能，我們旨在研究Bmal1在系統性炎症引發的神經炎症和認知功能障礙中的作用。我們假設巨噬細胞中的Bmal1調節炎症從外周到大腦的進展，而膽鹼能神經元中的Bmal1調節系統性炎症引發的神經炎症和認知功能障礙。為了驗證這一假說，我們將特異性地敲除巨噬細胞和膽鹼能神經元中的Bmal1。我們將利用剖腹手術小鼠模型來研究圍手術期神經認知障礙，因為該模型已被證明是研究系統性炎症對神經炎症和認知功能障礙影響的適當實驗模型。 這項研究將顯著提高我們對生物鐘如何調節系統性炎症引發的神經炎症和認知功能障礙的機制理解。我們的研究將為開發創新性治療提供新的見解，以預防手術後系統性炎症引發的神經炎症和認知功能障礙。

15102524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15102524.value: 人工智能賦能定量超音波評估用於甲狀腺癌患者管理

15102524.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15102524.value: Prof Cai, Jing Prof Chu, Winnie Chiu-wing Prof King, Ann Dorothy Dr Liu, Shirley Yuk Wah Prof QIN, Jing (Harry)

15102524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15102524.value: Thyroid nodules are common and found in up to 60% of adults. Clinically, an accurate diagnosis of thyroid nodules is crucial because it can help thyroid cancer patients by providing them early treatment and giving them a higher chance of survival. Additionally, it can avoid over-treatment of benign cases since over-treatment adversely affects patients’ quality of life. Ultrasound is commonly used to assess thyroid nodules because it is non-invasive and easily accessible in hospitals and clinics. However, ultrasound diagnosis is subjective, laborious and the accuracy is completely dependent on the operator’s experience. To solve this important clinical problem, we propose a multi-center study to develop and evaluate multiple novel artificial intelligence (AI)-empowered techniques for thyroid ultrasound clinical applications. The proposed AI-empowered techniques will allow fully automated segmentation of thyroid nodules and classification of benign and malignant thyroid nodules in ultrasound images. In the project, we will develop segmentation techniques by combining deep learning-based convolutional neural network models with emerging transformer models. We will also develop multiple radiomics-based classification models for ultrasound thyroid nodule classification. We will use 3,600 grey scale ultrasound images (1,200 benign thyroid nodule images, 1,200 malignant thyroid nodule images, and 1,200 normal thyroid gland images) to develop the segmentation and classification models. We will use another 300 cases for external validation of the models’ accuracy and robustness. In this project, we hypothesize that these novel AI-empowered techniques can yield high accuracy (≥90%) in automated segmentation of thyroid nodules, and have comparable performance to radiologists in the classification of benign and malignant thyroid nodules. To test these hypotheses, we will compare computerized segmentation from the AI techniques with manual segmentation from radiology experts. We will apply dice similarity coefficient and intersection over union to analyze the accuracy of computerized segmentation. We will compare classification results of the AI techniques and radiologists, with the pathology results as the reference standards. We will apply receiver operating characteristic curves to analyze and compare the performance of the AI techniques and radiologists. We will evaluate the AI models’ efficiency, accuracy and robustness. Our multi-disciplinary research team includes experts in ultrasonography, head and neck imaging, AI and deep learning in medical imaging, and endocrinology. With the collaborative effort of the team, the project will generate many useful outcomes that benefit many patients and clinicians, transform diagnosis across Hong Kong and beyond, and help global technology advancement. 甲狀腺結節很常見，高達 60% 的成年人都有甲狀腺結節。在臨床上，甲狀腺結節的準確診斷至關重要，因為它可以幫助甲狀腺癌患者提供早期治療並提高存活機會。此外，它可以避免良性病例的過度治療，因為過度治療會對患者的生活品質產生不利影響。超音波通常用於評估甲狀腺結節，因為它是非侵入性的，並且在醫院和診所很容易獲得。然而，超音波診斷具有主觀性、費力且準確性完全依賴操作者的經驗。為了解決這個重要的臨床問題，我們提出了一項多中心研究，以開發和評估多種新型人工智慧（AI）技術用於甲狀腺超音波臨床應用。建議的人工智慧技術將允許對超音波影像中的甲狀腺結節進行全自動分割以及良性和惡性甲狀腺結節的分類。在該專案中，我們將透過將基於深度學習的捲積神經網路模型與新興的變壓器模型相結合來開發分割技術。我們還將開發多種基於放射組學的超音波甲狀腺結節分類模型。我們將使用 3,600 張灰階超音波影像（1,200 張良性甲狀腺結節影像、1,200 張惡性甲狀腺結節影像和 1,200 張正常甲狀腺影像）來開發分割和分類模型。我們將使用另外 300 個案例對模型的準確性和穩健性進行外部驗證。在這個項目中，我們假設這些新穎的人工智慧技術可以在甲狀腺結節的自動分割中產生高精度（≥90%），並且在良性和惡性甲狀腺結節的分類方面具有與放射科醫生相當的性能。為了檢驗這些假設，我們將比較人工智慧技術的電腦分割與放射學專家的手動分割。我們將應用骰子相似係數和並集交集來分析電腦分割的準確性。我們將以病理結果作為參考標準，比較人工智慧技術和放射科醫師的分類結果。我們將應用接收者操作特徵曲線來分析和比較人工智慧技術和放射科醫生的性能。我們將評估人工智慧模型的效率、準確性和穩健性。我們的多學科研究團隊包括超音波檢查、頭頸成像、醫學影像人工智慧和深度學習以及內分泌學方面的專家。在團隊的共同努力下，該計畫將產生許多有用的成果，使許多患者和臨床醫生受益，改變香港及其他地區的診斷，並幫助全球技術進步。

15103124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15103124.value: 使用三維超聲研究腰部雙側多裂肌形態與青少年腰椎特發性脊柱側彎患者之間的關係

15103124.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15103124.value: Dr Cheung, Pui-yin Jason Dr SCHLÖSSER, Tom Pieter Cornelis Prof WONG, Arnold Prof ZHENG, Yong Ping

15121524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15121524.value: 具有精确肺功能影像和自动治疗计划的人工智能功能性肺避免放射治疗框架

15121524.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15121524.value: Dr CHOW, Tsz Kit Prof GE, Hong Dr REN, Ge Dr TIN, Wing Yan Prof WU, Qing Rong

15121524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15121524.value: Lung cancer, frequently accompanied by other lung diseases such as chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, is a leading cause of cancer fatalities both globally and in Hong Kong. This prevalence and disease complexity underscore the need for Functional Lung Avoidance Radiotherapy (FLART)—a treatment approach that seeks to selectively spare functional lung regions during radiotherapy, thereby preserving patients' lung function. However, the broader clinical application of FLART faces two primary hurdles. Firstly, capturing functional lung images for FLART is challenging. Primarily used function lung imaging modalities, such as single photon emission computed tomography (SPECT), are not part of standard radiotherapy procedures, thereby increasing both costs and inconvenience. Recent efforts have been made to develop techniques to derive lung ventilation and perfusion images directly from computed tomography (CTVI/PI), with artificial intelligence (AI) based implementations being the most novel and promising. However, current AI-based CTVI/PI techniques can only achieve limited accuracy, presumably due to over-simplified modelling using CT intensity information alone. Secondly, there is currently no effective automatic planning methods for FLART. Manual planning is labor-intensive, time-consuming, and heavily reliant on planners' experience, which can lead to inconsistencies or subpar quality due to the limited clinical experience in FLART planning. Addressing these challenges, our proposed study aims to develop a fully streamlined, AI-powered FLART framework (AI-FLART) that facilitates precise lung function mapping and automates treatment planning for lung cancer patients. Our objectives include: (i) developing a CT-based precise lung function mapping technique using a joint structural and textural analysis method, (ii) developing an auto-planning technique for FLART by combining function-guided beam angle selection and dose distribution prediction, and (iii) exploring the clinical performance and efficacy of the proposed framework. Compared to current imaging and planning techniques for FLART, our proposed framework offers several advantages including precise lung function imaging and lung function volume contouring, automated functional-guided treatment planning, and streamlined process for clinical implementation. This novel framework, which has never been reported before, has the potential to revolutionize FLART's clinical applications, ultimately enhancing lung cancer treatment outcomes for millions of patients in Hong Kong and globally. 肺癌经常伴有其他肺部疾病，例如慢性阻塞性肺病，是全球和香港癌症死亡的主要原因。这种患病率和疾病复杂性凸显了功能性肺规避放射治疗 (FLART) 的必要性 — 这是一种在放射治疗期间选择性地避开功能性肺部区域的治疗方法，从而保护患者的肺功能。然而，FLART 的更广泛临床应用面临两个主要障碍。首先，为 FLART 捕获功能性肺部图像具有挑战性。主要使用的功能性肺部成像模式，例如单光子发射计算机断层扫描 (SPECT)，不是标准放射治疗程序的一部分，因此增加了成本和不便。最近人们努力开发直接从计算机断层扫描 (CTVI/PI) 获取肺通气和灌注图像的技术，其中基于人工智能 (AI) 的实现是最新颖和最有前途的。然而，目前基于 AI 的 CTVI/PI 技术只能实现有限的准确性，大概是因为仅使用 CT 强度信息进行过于简单的建模。其次，目前尚无有效的 FLART 自动规划方法。手动规划劳动密集、耗时且严重依赖规划人员的经验，由于 FLART 规划的临床经验有限，这可能导致不一致或质量不佳。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出的研究旨在开发一个完全精简的、由人工智能驱动的 FLART 框架 (AI-FLART)，以促进精确的肺功能映射并自动为肺癌患者制定治疗计划。我们的目标包括：(i) 使用联合结构和纹理分析方法开发基于 CT 的精确肺功能影像技术，(ii) 通过结合功能引导的光束角度选择和剂量分布预测开发 FLART 的自动计划技术，以及 (iii) 探索所提框架的临床性能和疗效。与目前的 FLART 成像和计划技术相比，我们提出的框架具有多项优势，包括精确的肺功能成像和肺功能体积轮廓描绘、自动化的功能引导治疗计划以及简化的临床实施流程。这种前所未有的新框架有可能彻底改变 FLART 的临床应用，最终改善香港及全球数百万患者的肺癌治疗效果。

15123824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15123824.value: 心肌細胞特異性過表達GCH1通過抑制iNOS介導的MCT1 S-亞硝基化防治射血分數保留型心臟衰竭

15123824.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15123824.value: Prof Wong, Chi-Ming Prof XIA, Zhengyuan Prof Xu, Aimin

15123824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15123824.value: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) is a complex clinical syndrome characterized by structural and cellular alterations, including cardiac fibrosis, and hypertrophy accompanied by severe diastolic dysfunction. Although the underlying mechanisms of HFpEF remain largely unknown, aberrant activation of inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS)-mediated nitrosative stress and the subsequent key protein S-nitrosylation are the crucial drivers of HFpEF. Therefore, identifying a central controller that reverses iNOS-mediated nitrosative stress may provide new strategies to combat HFpEF. GTP cyclohydrolase 1 (GCH1) is the rate-limiting enzyme for the synthesis of tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4), an essential cofactor for NOS. The genetic enhancement of GCH1/BH4 signaling exerts protective effects on different cardiac pathological models, such as diabetic cardiomyopathy, through suppressing the aberrant activation of cardiac iNOS. Thus, it is possible that cardiomyocyte-specific overexpression of GCH1 (GCH1-tg) may protect against HFpEF via downregulation of iNOS-mediated nitrosative stress. Furthermore, monocarboxylate transporter 1 [MCT1, the main cardiac ketone (β-hydroxybutyrate, β-OHB) transporter protein] contains several potential cysteine residues for iNOS-mediated S-nitrosylation. Notably, MCT1 S-nitrosylation can impair metabolic substrate uptake. Thus, iNOS-mediated niotrosative stress may cause MCT1 S-nitrosylation, leading to impaired myocardial β-OHB uptake. Given that increased cardiac β-OHB acts as a signaling molecule to mitigate the HFpEF phenotypes through attenuation of pro-inflammatory responses and oxidative stress, we thus propose that iNOS-mediated MCT1 S-nitrosylation may drive the development of HFpEF through impaired myocardial β-OHB uptake. Indeed, our preliminary study demonstrated that GCH1-tg ameliorated the HFpEF phenotype in mice, which was evidenced by significantly improved diastolic function, exercise capacity, and decreased pulmonary congestion. This occurs along with reductions in cardiac iNOS expression, MCT1 S-nitrosylation and increased cardiac β-OHB level. Taken together, we hypothesize that GCH1-tg may protect against HFpEF through enhancing cardiac β-OHB uptake via restricting iNOS-mediated MCT1 S-nitrosylation. Additionally, GCH1 itself can be S-nitrosylated by iNOS, leading to reduced GCH1 activity and BH4 levels, which may further enhance iNOS-mediated nitrosative stress and exacerbate the development of HFpEF. Thus, the proposed research will integrate ex vivo, in vivo and in vitro approaches in combination with gene knockout/enhancement to investigate whether GCH1-tg protects against HFpEF in mice through enhancing cardiac β-OHB uptake via restricting iNOS-mediated MCT1 S-nitrosylation and the potential of clinical translation of BH4 to combat HFpEF will be explored. Information gained may facilitate the development of novel therapeutic approaches to cure HFpEF by targeting GCH1 and/or its downstream signaling pathways. 射血分數保留的心臟衰竭（HFpEF）是一種複雜的臨床綜合徵，其特徵是心臟結構和細胞的改變，包括心臟纖維化和肥大，並伴隨嚴重的舒張功能障礙。儘管HFpEF的潛在機制在很大程度上仍然未知，但誘導型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）異常活化介導的硝化應激及其後續的蛋白質S-亞硝基化是HFpEF病理發展的關鍵驅動因素。因此，尋找能夠逆轉iNOS介導的硝化應激的關鍵標靶可能為治療HFpEF提供新的策略。 鳥苷三磷酸環化水解酶1（GCH1）是合成四氫生物蝶呤（BH4）的關鍵限速酶，BH4是NOS產生NO的必需輔因子。研究顯示GCH1/BH4信號傳遞路徑的增強可藉由抑制心臟iNOS活性，在不同的心臟病理模型（如心肌梗塞後的心臟重建和糖尿病性心肌病）中發揮保護作用。因此，我們推測，心肌細胞特異性過度表達GCH1（GCH1-tg）可能透過下調iNOS介導的硝化應激來減輕HFpEF症狀。此外，MCT1（主要的心臟酮體（β-OHB）轉運蛋白）含有潛在的可被S-亞硝基化的半胱胺酸殘基。且MCT1的S-亞硝基化已被證明會抑制其代謝底物的攝取。鑑於心臟β-OHB可作為訊號分子透過減輕促炎反應和氧化應激來減輕HFpEF症狀，由此，我們提出iNOS可能導致MCT1的S-亞硝基化，透過損害心臟β-OHB的攝取從而加劇HFpEF的病理發展。事實上，我們的初步研究表明，GCH1-tg減輕了小鼠的HFpEF症狀，這表現在顯著改善的舒張功能、運動能力和減少的肺水腫。並伴隨著心臟iNOS表現的減少、MCT1 S-亞硝基化的減少和心臟β-OHB水平的增加。綜上所述，我們假設GCH1-tg可能透過限制iNOS介導的MCT1 S-亞硝基化來增強心臟β-OHB的攝取，從而保護HFpEF。此外，GCH1本身可以被iNOS S-亞硝基化，導致GCH1活性和BH4水平的降低，這可能進一步增強iNOS介導的硝化壓力並加劇HFpEF的病理發展。

15124224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15124224.value: 三週期最小表面熱療支架用於骨組織再生研究

15124224.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15124224.value: Prof Wang, Huaiyu Prof Yeung, Kelvin Wai Kwok

15124224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15124224.value: 骨是一種結締組織，其修復可受多種環境因素的調節。前期研究表明，體溫升高可通過啟動熱休克蛋白（HSPs）增強間充質幹細胞（MSCs）的成骨分化；同時，微觀拓撲表面形貌可通過機械誘導細胞骨架重組和細胞核形變從而調節骨細胞信號通路（如MAPK/ERK通路），促進 MSCs 的成骨分化。然而，熱刺激和拓撲形貌刺激如何協同調控 MSCs 成骨分化和骨組織再生仍然未知。 基於此，本項目提出構建含鎂的β-磷酸三鈣（Mg-TCP）三週期最小表面（TPMS）結構骨支架，該支架具有高孔隙率和增大的內表面積，以增強熱量的產生和擴散，並實現熱量和拓撲形貌調控成骨的相輔相成。 Mg-TCP 骨支架含有Mg2+、Ca2+和(PO4)3-，該成分已證明具有良好的生物相容性和骨傳導性；在近紅外（NIR）光照射下，Mg可用於產熱。 Mg-TCP 骨支架的TPMS結構具有較大的表面積和優異的流體滲透性，能有效產生熱量和進行熱擴散，從而廣泛影響骨組織。此外，TPMS結構還能誘導表面附著的 MSCs 的細胞骨架重組和核變形，啟動MAPK/ERK通路，促進其成骨分化。當近紅外光照射到Mg-TCP TPMS支架時，支架將光能轉化為熱能，使其溫度升高至39 ~ 41°C，從而提高 MSCs 中HSP、MAPK的表達，並激發ERK的磷酸化。我們期待熱刺激和拓撲形貌刺激將共同啟動MAPK/ERK通路，促進成骨基因（如膠原蛋白-1、RUNT相關轉錄因子2、鹼性磷酸酶和骨鈣素）的表達，從而促進骨組織再生。 本項研究將首次揭示熱和拓撲結構協同調控成骨的潛在機製。它還將為設計下一代熱療支架提供突破性的見解和概念驗證，並將熱學和仿生拓撲學巧妙地結合在一起。本項研究工作具有很強的普適性和轉化性，將為骨折和骨病患者提供新的熱療方案。從這項研究中獲得的經驗和創新理論也可應用於其他同時受結構和熱影響的組織，如皮膚、肌腱、心血管系統、軟骨等。

15124724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15124724.value: 通過ACAT抑制劑來管控能力過分攝入導致的肥胖

15124724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15124724.value: With its high prevalence and extensive health risks, obesity has long warranted effective solutions. Despite the varied causes of obesity, our available strategies remain limited, requiring enhancements in both safety and efficacy. The leptin signaling pathway, mediated by the leptin receptor type B (LepRb) in the hypothalamus, has demonstrated promising anti-obesity efficacy by reducing food intake. However, majority of obese individuals do not respond to leptin due to leptin resistance. The exact mechanism of leptin resistance and the regulation of LepRb-mediated signaling remains elusive. Cholesterol homeostasis is vital for maintaining cell function, with a key player being the enzyme acyl-coenzyme A: cholesterol acyltransferase (ACAT), which catalyzes the formation of cholesteryl ester. Global ACAT1-deficient mice, rather than ACAT2-deficient, exhibited resistance to overeating (i.e. hyperphagia) and obesity induced by a high-fat diet (HFD), with the mechanism being elusive. We have found that an ACAT inhibitor, avasimibe (AVA), effectively reduced fat mass at a clinically safe dose via anti-hyperphagia in HFD-induced obese (DIO) mice. Therefore, we asked, “How does the ACAT inhibitor, AVA, suppress hyperphagia?” and “Can AVA’s anti-hyperphagia role offer a synergistic effect when combined with existing anti-obesity strategies?" Our preliminary tests revealed that: 1) AVA treatment upregulated LepRb signaling pathway both in the hypothalamus of DIO mice and in a human neuroblastoma cell line; 2) AVA’s anti-hyperphagia function was significant in DIO mice and ob/ob mice, but abolished in LepRb deficient db/db mice. These data suggested that AVA’s anti-hyperphagia function is LepRb dependent. However, it is unknown which cell type in which region is mainly responsible for AVA’s anti-hyperphagia function, and how AVA mediates LepRb signaling pathway. In this proposal, we plan to utilize DIO mice, transgenic mice with ACAT1 knocked out specifically in LepRb expressing cells, AgRP-neuron-specific LepRb knockdown mice, and in vitro cell models to address the role of LepRb in AVA’s anti-hyperphagia function. The expected outcome from this proposal is to elucidate the mechanism by which AVA regulates food intake and the potential combined therapeutic strategies. To our knowledge, this will be the first study examining the role of AVA/ACAT1-regulated cholesterol homeostasis in the LepRb-mediated signaling pathway in vivo. It will establish a foundation for the further development of personalized anti-obesity strategies. 肥胖问题一直很严重，对健康有很大风险，所以我们一直在寻找有效的解决办法。虽然导致肥胖的原因有很多，但我们目前的应对策略还是有限，需要在安全性和效果上有所提升。胆固醇的平衡对细胞功能很重要，其中一个关键因素是酶 ACAT，它能催化胆固醇酯的形成。研究发现，缺乏 ACAT1 的小鼠（而不是缺乏 ACAT2 的小鼠）对高脂饮食引起的暴饮暴食和肥胖有抵抗力，但具体原因还不明。我们发现，ACAT 抑制剂阿伐麦布 (AVA) 可以在安全剂量下有效减少高脂饮食引起的肥胖小鼠的脂肪量，因为它能抑制暴饮暴食，但是AVA 是如何抑制暴饮暴食的尚未清楚。我们计划利用肥胖小鼠、转基因小鼠和体外细胞模型来研究 探究AVA抗暴饮暴食功能中的作用，从而为进一步开发个性化的抗肥胖联合策略奠定基础。

15125724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15125724.value: 基於多模光纖的深穿透紫外光聲顯微鏡用於體內微米級無標記腫瘤邊緣評估和術中組織病理學檢查

15125724.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15125724.value: Prof Ji, Nan Prof Yuan, Xiaocong

15125724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15125724.value: 術中病理學檢查在準確評估腫瘤邊緣時起著關鍵作用,對於高發病率和死亡率的一類腦腫瘤(譬如膠質瘤）尤為重要。這些手術的關鍵挑戰是在最小化對周圍正常腦組織的損傷的同時，實現快速且完整的腫瘤切除。然而，目前的術中組織病理學實踐涉及繁瑣且耗時的程式，延遲了術中決策。 一種潛在的解決方案是紫外光聲顯微鏡（UV-PAM），它可以即時無標記成像，能夠視覺化細胞核，提供有關腫瘤邊緣的直接視覺化資訊。然而，現有的UV-PAM系統僅限於體外使用，穿透深度有限，限制了其在體內應用場景下的廣泛應用。因此，該專案旨在通過開發一種可靠、無標記、微創且深入體內成像的影像工具來滿足臨床需求。 我們計畫開發一種基於多模光纖的UV-PAM系統。該系統使用一根細如頭髮的光纖（直徑<100 µm）將紫外光直接傳遞到深層組織的感興趣區域，實現微創、高解析度的深層組織成像。我們基於光學波前整形技術使鐳射能夠在多模光纖的輸出端實現微米級解析度光聲信號激發且快速掃描，而光纖超聲感測器則高靈敏度檢測信號並生成高解析度、高對比的光聲圖像。 為進一步提高系統的臨床效用，我們將應用先進的深度學習技術，將獲得的灰度圖像轉化為類似於常規H&E組織染色的偽染色圖像，有助於術中即時邊緣評估和決策。 本項目計畫使用膠質瘤小鼠模型進行臨床前研究，以優化成像系統並驗證其性能。我們還將與神經外科醫生和病理學家合作，評估系統的功效和可靠性，包括使用仿體、體外組織樣本和最後的活體動物模型。本項目有望顯著改善膠質瘤診斷和治療的效果，進而改善患者預後。

15126224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15126224.value: 經皮迷走神經刺激與週邊神經刺激結合對腦中風患者上肢運動功能的影響：單盲隨機對照試驗

15126224.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15126224.value: Dr Chung, Raymond Chi Keung Dr Lai, Yuen Yi Cynthia Prof Wong, Wai Lung Thomson Prof Woo, Jean

15126224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15126224.value: Impaired upper limb motor function is a common sequela of stroke, which is a global health concern. Approximately 70%–80% of people with stroke have motor deficits in their upper extremities [1]. Recovery of voluntary upper limb movement is one of the most important goals of stroke rehabilitation [2]. Our previous studies have shown that the application of transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation (TENS) over the paretic lower limb (Uni-TENS) augments the effects of task-oriented training (TOT) on lower limb motor function in patients with stroke [3-5]. Our recent studies have revealed that bilateral TENS (Bi-TENS) over both the non-paretic and paretic limbs exerts a more rapid and greater effect than Uni-TENS in improving upper limb [6] and lower limb [7] motor functions. Recent studies have demonstrated the value of vagus nerve stimulation (VNS),that modulates the synaptic reorganisation of cortical motor networks [8-13] via activation of the cholinergic and noradrenergic systems [8-10], as an adjunct to physical training in stroke rehabilitation. Results of clinical trials [14-19] and meta-analyses [20-25] have revealed the beneficial effects of combining invasive VNS or non-invasive transcutaneous VNS (tVNS) with rehabilitation therapies to improve upper limb motor functions in stroke survivors. tVNS has been shown to be safe and well tolerated in patients with stroke [19-21, 23, 25]. TENS modulates cortical reorganization and excitability [26-27] and tVNS modulates the synaptic reorganisation of cortical motor networks [9-13], causing enhanced motor recovery in patients with stroke. However, one important question remains unanswered: can tVNS be combined with Bi-TENS, and will the resultant synergetic effects further maximise the motor output of the paretic limbs? This potentially beneficial treatment regime has not been investigated. The proposed study will aim to address this critical knowledge gap. Our principal objectives will be to compare the effectiveness of four 6-week TOT programmes, that combined (1)tVNS+Bi-TENS, (2)sham-tVNS+Bi-TENS, (3)tVNS+placebo-TENS and (4)control training, at improving upper limb motor function, activities of daily living and community integration in people with stroke. Using Fugl-Meyer Assessment of Upper Extremity (FMA-UE) score as the primary outcome, we demonstrated the feasibility, effectiveness and safety of tVNS+TOT in our pilot study involving 26 patients with stroke. If proven effective, this novel TOT programme, which combines tVNS with Bi-TENS, will be readily implementable in clinical and community settings. The expected shorter treatment durations and more rapid and greater improvement effects of this combination, will result in significant personal, social and economic benefits. 上肢運動功能受損是中風的常見後遺症，這是一個全球性的問題健康問題。約 70%–80% 的中風患者的上肢運動功能缺陷。上肢自主運動能力的恢復是中風復健的一個最重要的目標。 我們前期的研究表明，單側經皮電神經的應用對癱瘓下肢（Uni-TENS）的刺激（TENS）增強了腦中風患者下肢運動功能的任務導向訓練（TOT)。我們最近的研究表明，雙側 TENS（Bi-TENS）優於單側TENS (Uni-TENS)，Bi-TENS 能達致更快、更大的作用於改善上肢和下肢的運動功能。 最近的研究證明了迷走神經刺激（VNS）的價值，即透過活化調節皮質運動網絡的重組 和調節腎上腺素功能，輔助中風復健中的體能訓練。臨床試驗結果及薈萃分析已經揭示了結合侵入性 VNS 或非侵入性VNS的有益效果。 經皮迷走神經刺激 (tVNS) 與復健體能訓練可改善上肢運動中風倖存者的功能。 tVNS 已被證明是安全且耐受性良好。TENS 調節皮質重組和興奮性 ，tVNS 調節皮質運動網絡的重組，增強運動能力及加速中風患者的復原。 然而，一個重要的問題仍未得到解答：tVNS 能否與 Bi-TENS 合併使用，所產生的協同效應是否會進一步增強癱瘓肢體的運動功能？這種潛在有益的治療尚未受到調查。擬議的研究旨在解決這一關鍵問題。 我們的主要目標是比較四次為期 6 週的 TOT 的有效性方案，結合了 (1)tVNS+Bi-TENS，(2)sham-tVNS+Bi-TENS，(3)tVNS+安慰劑-TENS和(4)控制訓練，改善上肢運動功能，中風患者的日常生活活動和社區融入。 如果證明有效，這種新穎的 TOT 計劃結合了 tVNS 和 Bi-TENS，將很容易在臨床和社區環境中實施。預期較短治療持續時間和更快、更大的改善效果結合起來，將產生顯著的個人、社會和經濟效益。

15128824.value: 揭示癌代謝物2-羥基戊二酸（2HG）在胰島β細胞功能障礙和2型糖尿病中的新角色

15128824.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15128824.value: Prof Lui, Kathy Oi Lan Prof Piao, Hai-long

15128824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15128824.value: 胰島素分泌缺陷和β細胞數量減少是導致2型糖尿病的主要原因。2型糖尿病會導致早期死亡和心血管併發症。遺憾的是， 目前尚無藥物能夠逆轉β細胞功能衰竭和治癒糖尿病。最近的研究發現，線粒體的三羧酸循環（TCA）酶不僅能控制胰島素分泌，還能調節β細胞數量。例如，TCA循環中的補充反應生成的α-酮戊二酸（α-KG）通過抑制缺氧誘導因子(HIF) 脯氨酰羥化酶和生成麩醯胺酸 (glutamine)來介導葡萄糖刺激的胰島素分泌（GSIS）。 2-羥基戊二酸（2-hydroxyglutarate [2HG]）最初被認為是一種癌代謝物，但最近的研究顯示它能夠調節糖酵解和線粒體功能。2HG是TCA循環中α-KG代謝的副產物，其在β細胞中的作用尚未得到充分研究。我們的初步研究顯示，長期高葡萄糖處理或誘導衰老的藥物會導致胰島β細胞中積累大量的2HG。R-2HG和S-2HG是對映體，它們分別通過R-和S-2-羥基戊二酸脫氫酶（R-2HGDH和S-2HGDH）代謝為α-KG。我們發現，在飲食誘導的糖尿病前期小鼠模型和長期高葡萄糖處理的β細胞中，R-2HGDH和S-2HGDH的表達明顯下調。R-2HG處理或R-2HGDH敲低顯著減弱GSIS，而S-2HG對GSIS僅有輕微的抑制作用。另一方面，抑制S-2HGDH表達會誘導β細胞衰老和p53通路激活。此外，R-和S-2HGDH的沉默或R-/S-2HG處理損害了β細胞的線粒體呼吸和ATP生成。我們還發現了幾種與R-2HG的結合蛋白，它們可能介導R-2HG對β細胞功能的有害影響。 儘管我們的體外實驗表明2HG 誘導β細胞功能障礙，其病理生理作用和潛在機制仍不清楚。在本提案中，我們將研究β細胞特異性過表達R-和S-2HGDH是否改善動物模型中的β細胞功能障礙。此外，我們將使用同位素分析平台監測β細胞R-和S-2HG代謝在正常和糖尿病應激下的動態變化。最後，我們將闡明2HG如何控制β細胞中的線粒體功能、胰島素分泌和衰老反應。本研究的發現將揭示2HG代謝在胰島β細胞功能中的新角色，並驗證能否通過改變2HG代謝來治療2型糖尿病 。

15200024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15200024.value: 面向更耐久多孔瀝青路面的基於骨料碳納米塗層的新型熱愈合系統：機理表徵及性能優化

15200024.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15200024.value: Prof Airey, Gordon Prof Bhasin, Amit Dr Zhong, Jing

15200024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15200024.value: Porous asphalt (PA), which refers to the open-graded asphalt mixture with large air void content (typically over 20%), has been widely used as a road surfacing material in Hong Kong and many other places around the world, because of its various attractive functions, such as low traffic noise, quick water drainage, improved driving safety, and reduced urban heat island effect. However, as a functional road surfacing material, PA mixture often suffers the early-age raveling problem, i.e., the debonding between and the dislodgement of aggregate particles starting from the pavement surface, which significantly compromises its durability and shortens its service life. To address the raveling problem and enhance the durability of PA road surfaces, this study aims to develop an innovative thermal healing system for PA mixtures through coating aggregate with specially designed functional nano-carbon polymer ink, which can quickly and repeatedly heal the micro-cracks in asphalt binder and between asphalt binder and aggregate, i.e., cohesive cracks and adhesive cracks, through non-contact microwave radiation or electromagnetic induction. To achieve this objective, six research tasks will be conducted, including: 1) synthesis and dispersion characterization of the nano-carbon polymer coating inks, prepared with different nano-carbon materials (carbon nanotube and graphene) and polymer solutions (polyurethane and polyacrylic acid) under different mixing conditions, using microscopic analysis tools; 2) preparation and property characterization of functional aggregates with nano-carbon coating in terms of coating quality, and surface mechanical and heating characteristics; 3) bench-scale experimental characterization of the functional PA mixtures containing nano-carbon coated aggregates, in terms of mechanical properties, heating efficiency and healing performance; 4) full-scale performance verification of the thermal healing PA pavements containing nano-carbon coated aggregates through accelerated pavement testing; 5) economic and environmental performance quantification through life cycle cost analysis and life cycle assessment; and 6) synthetic analysis of the working mechanism and optimization of the production and healing conditions of the novel heat-healing PA pavements containing functional aggregates. The outcomes of this study are expected to lay the knowledge foundation for a novel preventative maintenance method, which can be applied to significantly improve the durability and reduce the maintenance frequency, as well as the associated cost and carbon emissions, of PA road surfaces, thus promoting their wider applications as a sustainable paving option in Hong Kong and worldwide. 多孔瀝青（PA）是指具有較大空隙率（通常超過 20%）的開級配瀝青混合料。由於其具有低交通噪音、快速排水、提高駕駛安全性以及降低城市熱島效應等功能，已在香港和世界許多其他地方用作道路鋪面材料。然而，作為一種功能性道路鋪面材料，PA 混合料經常遭受早期散裂問題，即：從路面表面開始，骨材顆粒之間會脫粘和脫落。這種病害嚴重損害了其耐久性並縮短了其使用壽命。為解決PA路面的散裂問題並提高其耐久性，本研究旨在開發一種創新的PA混合料熱修復系統，透過將專門設計的功能性納米碳聚合物墨水塗覆在骨材上，進而透過非接觸式微波輻射或電磁感應，實現快速、重複地修復瀝青結合料內部以及瀝青結合料與骨材之間的微裂紋。為實現此目標，將進行六項研究任務，包括：1）透過微觀分析工具表徵採用不同納米碳材料（碳納米管和石墨烯）和聚合物溶液（聚氨酯和聚丙烯酸）及在不同混合條件下製備的碳納米聚合物塗層墨水；2）製備碳納米塗層功能集料並表徵塗層品質、表面力學和加熱特性；3）對含碳納米塗層骨料的功能PA混合料的力學性能、加熱效率和修復性能進行實驗表徵； 4) 透過加速加載路面試驗對含碳納米塗層骨料的熱修復PA 路面進行全尺寸性能驗證；5) 透過生命週期成本分析和生命週期評估量化經濟和環境性能；6) 對含功能骨料的新型熱修復PA 路面的工作機理進行綜合分析，並優化其生產和熱修復條件。本研究的成果有望為一種新型道路預防性養護方法奠定理論基礎，該方法可顯著提高PA 路面的耐久性並降低維護頻率以及相關的成本和碳排放，從而促進PA作為一種可持續鋪面材料在香港和全球的更廣泛應用。

15201124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15201124.value: 用于认知预测和神经机制的单纯形注意网络

15201124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15201124.value: 理解大脑的工作原理对于提升我们对人类行为和思维的认识至关重要。这种理解可以带来更好的脑部相关问题（如精神疾病）的治疗方法，并找到提升我们思维能力的途径。 尽管在使用机器学习和功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）预测人类思维方面取得了一些进展，我们仍然面临巨大的挑战。fMRI扫描包含比我们目前理解的更多有价值的信息，包括复杂的大脑组织结构。我们缺乏一个全面的数学框架和明确的深度学习方法来解释大脑过程和预测认知能力。 本项目有两个使命——揭示解释认知的复杂神经机制，并利用预测和预报能力来理解认知能力。我们在神经科学中引入了一种新方法，将fMRI数据视为一个单纯形复形，允许在任何k维单纯形上灵活定义图结构数据。我们引入了一种单纯形注意网络（SAN），利用Hodge-Laplacian（HL）算子和注意机制。SAN擅长学习跨k维单纯形的异质信号表示，例如大脑区域（节点）上的功能时间序列，以及两个大脑区域（边）和多个大脑区域（三角形等）之间的功能连接。其创新之处在于三个核心组件：单纯形卷积滤波器（SC-filters）、单纯形投影（SP）和单纯形注意池化（SAP）算子，所有这些都在这种复杂的数据结构上运行。 SC-filters在这些数据结构上运行，利用HL算子编码的独特拓扑结构。我们引入了一种通用的SC-filters多项式近似方法，增强了其计算效率和空间定位特性。此外，SAP通过创新的变压器和SP算子，利用自注意和交叉注意机制简化复杂的数据关系并整合特征，捕捉大脑数据不同维度之间的复杂互连。 我们使用纵向脑图像数据集（n=11,875）进行严格评估，以测量SAN在预测认知方面的准确性和鲁棒性。我们通过对现有认知-大脑研究的元分析验证了SAN对认知贡献的大脑区域。 本项目引入了一种创新的SAN数学框架。它具有预测和预报认知功能的能力，无论是单一领域还是多领域的认知功能。它还可以区分不同功能之间共享的神经机制和特定于每个功能的神经机制。该框架还具有多功能性，可以应用于各种图结构数据类型，具有在物流、计算机视觉、生物学、化学、神经科学等领域的潜在应用。

15201424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15201424.value: 晶體-非晶雙相高熵合金基納米複合材料的優異耐磨性及其原子尺度機制研究

15201424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15201424.value: 金屬的耐磨性對於提高其安全性、可靠性和使用壽命至關重要。高耐磨性材料不僅需要具備高硬度和強度，還需要在具備足夠塑性的情況下保持結構穩定性和機械性能。將金屬晶粒尺寸調整至納米級可以增強強度，但這也極大限制了塑性變形，導致應變局部化和機械性能不穩定。相反，非晶金屬的納米結構能夠抑制局部剪切帶的形成，從而提高其塑性能。因此，構建晶體-非晶雙相納米複合結構合金能夠實現雙相協同作用，提升強度-塑性特性和耐磨性。然而，晶體和非晶納米結構金屬都存在相對較低的熱穩定性，在塑性變形和高溫磨損時容易重新結晶。已有文獻指出，設計合成晶體-非晶陶瓷雙相納米複合材料，其中高結晶溫度的非晶陶瓷形成晶界，可以實現高溫強度-塑性協同作用。然而，對晶體-非晶陶瓷雙相納米複合材料的變溫耐磨性能和內在原子機制仍缺乏深入全面的理解。本項目旨在利用磁控共濺射技術，開發和設計具有優異耐磨性能的晶體-非晶雙相高熵合金基納米複合材料。具體地，本項目將優化磁控共濺射技術和合金成分，調控製備新型晶體-非晶雙相FeCrCoNi-SiC高熵合金基納米複合薄膜；認識和研究該類型結構在不同加載條件下的塑性變形和耐磨特性；重點結合運用和發展原位變溫掃描/透射電子顯微鏡微的微納米壓縮/拉伸實驗、劃痕實驗、計算機模擬，以及理論模型等，揭示該晶體-非晶雙相高熵合金基納米複合薄膜的多尺度形成和微觀結構演化、塑性和耐磨特性及其原子尺度機制。本項目的成功實施將深入理解晶體-非晶雙相高熵合金基納米複合材料的微結構-耐磨性能的關係，加速發展和設計高溫耐磨性納米複合材料。

15201824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15201824.value: 基于多智能体系统集体灵巧性的对异构聚集物塑形及运输

15201824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15201824.value: The project aims to develop innovative control methods that empower multi-robot systems to collaboratively shape and transport large-scale aggregates with heterogeneous properties. By advancing this manipulation capability, we not only deepen our understanding of the fundamental principles governing collective dexterity in multi-robot systems, but also take a significant stride towards the robotisation of crucial applications, such as retrieving marine debris and removing construction waste. While recent progress has been made in the automatic manipulation of soft materials, the development of this capability with collaborative robot agents remains an under-explored challenge in the literature. The main hurdles to its real-world implementation are twofold: the lack of efficient multi-agent policies to decompose the large-scale (deformable) operation into feasible sub-goals, and the absence of automatic control solutions to collectively interact, deform, and transport portions of the aggregate through synchronised non-prehensile actions. Drawing on our team's expertise in shape servoing, robot manipulation, and sensor-based control, this project aims to establish a new methodology for multi-robot systems that facilitates the modelling, analysis, and controller design to achieve collective dexterity with compliant objects. Our proposed approach involves formulating the long-horizon manipulation problem as a composition of several curve-based motions, each representing shaping and transport actions performed by the robotic agents. The originality of this method lies in the serialised sub-goal approach to plan and control non-prehensile actions, such as pushing and pulling. This enables the robots to gradually deform and reconfigure large-scale masses piece by piece. The addressed problem is fundamental in nature and introduces new and complex manipulation tasks for multi-robot systems, offering fertile ground to make original contributions to the field of automatic robot control. 该项目旨在开发新型控制方法，使多机器人系统能够协同规整和运输具有异质特性的大规模聚集物。通过提高这种操控能力，我们不仅可以加深对多机器人系统集体灵活性基本原理的理解，而且可以极大地促进一些重要应用领域（如回收海洋垃圾和清除建筑废料）的机器人化。尽管柔性材料的自动操控已经取得了一些进展，但是通过多机器人协作完成该任务仍然是一个尚未完全解决的问题。其在现实世界中实施主要存在两方面的挑战：一是缺乏高效的多机器人策略将大规模（可变形）操作分解为可行的子目标；二是缺乏基于非抓取操控的自动控制解决方案来实现协同互动、规整和运输聚集物。 依托我们团队在形状伺服、机器人操作和基于传感器控制方面的专业知识，该项目旨在建立一种新的方法，来促进多机器人系统的建模、分析和控制器设计，以实现对柔性物体的集体灵活性。我们拟提出的方法是将长时间域操控问题表述为若干曲线运动的组合，其中每一个曲线运动都代表一个由机器人代理执行的规整或运输动作。这种方法的原创性在于采用序列化子目标的方法来规划和控制非抓取动作（如推和拉的动作）。这使得机器人能够逐步地变形和重新配置大规模物质。该项目待解决的问题具有基础性，并引入了多机器人系统的新型复杂操作任务，为在自动机器人控制领域做出原创性贡献提供了肥沃的土壤。

15202124.value: Prof CHAN, Albert Ping-chuen Prof Wang, Shuaian Prof ZHONG, Ray Runyang

15202124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15202124.value: 模塊化建造作為一種創新的建築施工方式，有效提升生產率並減少碳排放，因此在高密度城市中獲得了越來越多的探索與應用。許多政府正積極設立模塊化建造中心，用以臨時儲存和（或）加工預製模塊，從而確保能夠準時交付符合質量與數量要求的預製模塊。然而，在高密度城市中設立模塊化建造中心面臨著以下挑戰：(i) 高密度城市土地供應有限且成本高昂；(ii)隨著模塊化建築的廣泛應用，運輸成本及運輸碳排放大幅增加。如何制定高效的模塊化建造中心部署計劃，以最小化物流成本和最小化運輸碳排放，成為當前亟待解決的關鍵問題。 有效的模塊化建造中心部署計劃必須充分考量政府與承包商之間的互動影響。一方面，承包商以自身物流成本最小化為目標，制定最優物流計劃（涵蓋運輸方式、運輸路線、模塊運輸時間安排及模塊化建造中心租賃計劃），而這些決策又受到政府關於模塊化建造中心決策（包括選址、規模、建立時間及租賃價格）的影響。另一方面，承包商的決策亦直接關乎政府目標的達成，即最大限度地降低地區物流成本（包括模塊化建造中心的建造成本及多個建築項目的模塊運輸成本總和）及運輸碳排放。然而，在研究最優模塊化建造中心部署問題時，上述政府與承包商之間的複雜互動關係尚未得到深入探討。 本項目基於上述研究空白，針對模塊化建造中心部署問題建立雙層規劃模型，該模型將為政府制定行政區域內模塊化建造中心部署的最優計劃提供指導。最優模塊化建造中心部署計劃能夠最大限度地提升區域經濟和環境績效，同時最大限度地降低承包商的物流成本。本項目還將開發定制化算法，為政府和承包商提供模塊化建造中心部署的最優方案。透過制定適當的模塊化建築物流計劃，將物流成本降至最低，可為承包商帶來經濟效益。此外，最大限度地降低區域物流成本及運輸碳排放，亦有助於促進模塊化建築供應鏈的成熟，推動建築業的可持續發展。香港政府已決定自2022年起設立模塊化建造中心，以強化模塊化建築供應鏈。本項目將以香港為案例進行研究，若研究成功，所提出的模型亦可應用於其他地區，協助其制定相應的模塊化建造中心部署計劃。

15202524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15202524.value: 預測下水道和雨水溢出的智慧建模方法

15202524.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15202524.value: Prof CAO, Jiannong Prof Li, Jianfeng Dr Liu, Catherine Chunling Prof Liu, Shuming

15202524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15202524.value: The Hong Kong (HK) sewer network (SN) comprises 4,700 km of sewage and stormwater pipelines. With the growing population, rapid urbanization, and extreme climate conditions, sewer/stormwater overflows (S/SO), one of the main types of sewer operational failure, have been increasingly observed, heavily impacting the environment, economy, public health, and society. In the past several years, the Drainage Services Department (DSD) of HK has spent about $500 millions on sewer rehabilitation works; however, the demand for future rehabilitation works and the resources needed are steadily increasing as the HKSN continues to age and deteriorate. S/SO events have become a major problem, exemplified by the 61,900 complaints received by the DSD with respect to sewer blockages and S/SO incidents during the period of 2015-18. Therefore, it is paramount to predict the potential locations, durations, and severities of S/SO events in sufficient time ahead so that the DSD can post warnings and take proactive measures to minimize negative impacts. In previous research studies, S/SO risks have been analyzed through experimental and hybrid-based modelling approaches. However, limited success has been achieved due to (a) the lack of a comprehensive list of those critical factors that cause S/SO; (b) neglecting the impacts of extreme precipitation events due to climate change on S/SO; and (c) failure to integrate long- and short-term reliable and accurate predictions of S/SO occurrences. The proposed multi-disciplinary research will develop smart models for predicting locations, durations, and severities of S/SO events using statistical and artificial intelligence (AI) based techniques supported by smart multi-sensing technologies, which have proven their precise and reliable prediction capabilities. A set of critical factors leading to S/SO incidents will be identified and investigated during this project, particularly those appropriate for megacities such as HK. Novel predictive models will then be developed to help identify potential S/SO blackspots in the HKSN. Using smart multi-sensing and IoT-based technologies, these blackspots will be monitored in real-time to prevent the occurrence of S/SO incidents with a reasonable prediction time horizon. The accuracy, reliability, and validity of the proposed models will be justified through collected historical records, numerical simulations, and results from field experiments conducted in collaboration with the DSD. The research project outcomes can help DSD and similar utilities in other megacities to manage high-potential S/SO blackspots, prioritize resource allocation, and lay a solid foundation for urban infrastructure resilience and sustainability. 香港的排水管網由4700公里的污水和雨水管道組成。隨著人口增長、快速城市化和極端氣候條件的加劇,下水道/雨水的溢流問題，作為排水管網的主要運行故障類型之一，正日益增多，對環境、經濟、公共衛生和社會造成嚴重影響。在過去幾年里,香港渠務署(DSD)已在排水管網修覆工程上花費約5億美元；然而，隨著香港排水管網的不斷老化和惡化，未來修覆工作的需求和所需資源正在穩步增加。溢流已成為影響排水管網正常運行的主要問題之一。在2015-2018年期間，DSD收到了61900起有關排水管網堵塞和溢流事故的投訴。因此，為了DSD能夠及時預警並主動幹預，減少溢流的負面影響，及時預測溢流的潛在位置、持續時間和嚴重程度至關重要。 在之前的研究中，溢流風險已通過實驗和混合建模方法進行了分析。但由於以下原因，取得的成果有限:(a)導致溢流的關鍵因素分析較為局限；(b)忽視了氣候變化導致的極端降雨事件對溢流的影響；(c)未能整合長-短期信息對溢流進行準確預測。本研究將開發基於統計和人工智能技術的智能模型,結合智能多傳感技術，預測溢流事件的位置、持續時間和嚴重程度，這些技術已被證明具有精確和可靠的預測能力。項目將聚焦於香港等災害高發城市，識別和研究導致溢流事件的關鍵因素；研發新型預測模型，幫助識別香港排水管網中的高危溢流點；利用智能多傳感和物聯網技術,對這些高危位置進行實時監測，以合理的預測時間範圍內防止溢流事件的發生。所提出模型的準確性、可靠性和有效性將通過歷史記錄、數值模擬和與DSD合作進行的現場試驗結果進行驗證。研究成果可以幫助DSD和其他城市的相關部門管控高風險溢流點，合理分配資源，為城市基礎設施的韌性和可持續性奠定堅實基礎。

15202824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15202824.value: 高強韌高間隙多組元金屬間化合物的原子結構、本征性質和變形機理

15203224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15203224.value: 從鋼鐵工業副產品中回收資源以實現碳中和的單組分堿激發方法

15203224.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15203224.value: Prof Dai, Jianguo Prof ELGHAZOULI, Ahmed Youssef

15203224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15203224.value: The iron and steel sector, specifically in China - the top worldwide producer - is shifting towards cleaner production through electrification and utilization of alternative fuels. Consequently, quantities of electric arc furnace slag (EAFS), a by-product of the steelmaking industry, will increase substantially. Besides, biomass and/or H2 use in ironmaking blast furnaces will change the resultant slag's chemical properties, differing from those of conventional ground granulated blast-furnace slag (GGBS). The imminent production decrease and changes in properties of GGBS compel the construction sector to explore new alternative Portland cement replacements and novel precursors for alkali-activated materials (AAMs) production. EAFS is a promising candidate to fulfill these needs. AAMs developed have increased dramatically over the past 30 years as low-carbon alternatives that can be produced solely with GGBS combined with alkali solutions. The development of one-part AAMs that could be commercialized as a powdered blend will accelerate the widespread uptake of this technology, as cements will be produced by mixing the dry blend with water, similar to Portland cement, but with a fraction of the embodied carbon. Activators such as sodium silicate/hydroxide are produced via energy-intensive processes, therefore, alternative activators must also be explored. This research will produce one-part AAMs based on beneficiated EAFS as a key precursor combined with low-carbon salt-type activators (i.e., oxalates and citrates), selected due to their dual functionality potential as superplasticizers and activators. The manufacturing process will be tailored to maximize the use of existing facilities for scaling up this technology. This approach will provide a solution aiding the decarbonization of the cement and iron industries while resolving major issues of management and valorization of stock-pilled steelmaking slags by manufacturing green and functional one-part AAM concretes. The research will be developed in five major tasks, aiming to create eco-friendly one-part EAFS-AAM concrete using full-volume-EAFS aggregates with excellent engineering properties. In Task 1, combined beneficiation techniques to optimize the chemical reactivity of EAFS will be explored. In Task 2, the interlinks between mix design of one-part EAFS-AAMs, reaction kinetics, and phase assemblage evolution will be determined. In Task 3, to ensure that the novel EAFS-AAMs pose no risk when used, the fate of heavy metal in EAFS will be evaluated. In Task 4, one-part EAFS-AAM concrete mixes will be developed using full-volume-EAFS aggregates and evaluating their mechanical performance. In Task 5, the durability performance of selected EAFS-AAMs concretes will be assessed to elucidate their most promising applications.

15203724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15203724.value: 多孔塗層對高速邊界層非綫性模態–模態相互作用和破碎的影響研究

15203724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15203724.value: In the past two decades, remarkable accomplishments have been achieved by China in civil space exploration programs, such as Tiangong space station and Chang’e lunar probes. Hong Kong has also contributed local specialists to National Manned Space Programme for astronaut recruitment, which has aroused positive reactions. During these missions, the high-speed vehicles are crucial to travel across the atmosphere successfully. As the vehicle is accelerated to several times the sound speed, the high drag force and severe aerodynamic heating are challenging to the mission. Currently, the uncertainty arising from the boundary layer transition from laminar to turbulent flows has become one of the major barriers towards the accurate prediction of aerodynamic and aerothermal characteristics of high-speed vehicles. The first significant issue is the understanding in fluid mechanics. The transition process, particularly the highly complicated nonlinear stage where flows eventually break down to chaotic turbulence, is far from being well understood. In high-speed flows, new instability waves are involved, such as the first and Mack second modes. Thus, the complexity is further escalated in understanding the high-speed nonlinear breakdown and in turn the transition. Recent study of the applicant has demonstrated the significance of a non-conventional breakdown scenario in high-speed flows for the first time, which is called the combination resonance. The nature is that strong nonlinear interactions between first and second modes gives rise to escalated detuned modes, which dominates the eventual breakdown. The second relevant issue is the applicable flow control strategy to delay the transition. One of the promising techniques is to use a thin porous coating attached on the vehicle surface to dissipate the unstable acoustic disturbances. What is scarcely considered and needed now is to investigate the effect of the porous coating on the nonlinear mode–mode interaction and breakdown based on the new finding of combination resonance. Furthermore, wind-tunnel experiments are necessary to validate the numerical observation. In this project, a combination of numerical, theoretical and experimental studies will be conducted based on the well-developed in-house codes and Mach 6 wind-tunnel facilities in the laboratory of the applicants. The present project is expected to reveal the role of the porous coating in the nonlinear transitional regime of boundary layers over canonical configurations, and to shed insights into the high-speed transition mechanism and control. This project is envisaged to build enhanced connections between the fundamental and application fields of high-speed boundary layer transition. 過去二十年來，中國在民用太空探索計劃方面取得了令人矚目的成就，例如天宮空間站和嫦娥月球探測器等。其中，香港還爲國家載人航天工程招募航天員貢獻了本地載荷專家，幷引起積極的反響。在這些任務中，高速飛行器是成功穿越大氣層的關鍵。當飛行器加速到聲速的數倍時，極高的阻力和嚴重的氣動發熱均會對飛行任務帶來艱巨的挑戰。目前，從層流到湍流的邊界層轉捩所産生的不確定度已成爲準確預測高速飛行器氣動力和氣動熱特性的主要障礙之一，這其中首要重要的問題即是對流體力學的理解。轉捩過程目前遠未得到很好的認識，尤其是流動最終破碎爲混沌湍流的高度複雜的非綫性階段。在高速流動中，會出現新的不穩定波，如第一模態和 Mack 第二模態。因此，理解高速流動非綫性破碎以及轉捩階段的難度進一步提升。申請人最近的研究首次證明了高速流動中非傳統破碎方式的重要性，該方式被稱爲組合共振，其本質是第一模態和第二模態之間强烈的非綫性相互作用産生了迅速增長的失調模態，從而主導了最終的破碎。第二個相關問題是延遲轉捩的可行的控制策略。其中一種很有前景的技術是在飛行器表面使用多孔薄塗層，旨在將不穩定的聲學擾動耗散掉。目前很少考慮幷需要研究的是，基于組合共振的最新發現，開展多孔塗層對非綫性模態–模態相互作用和破碎影響的研究。此外，有必要進行風洞實驗來驗證數值觀測結果。基于申請人實驗室已開發完善的程序和馬赫6風洞裝置，本項目將開展數值、理論和實驗相結合的研究。本項目預計可揭示多孔塗層在典型構型邊界層非綫性轉捩階段中的作用，幷探明高速轉捩機制及其控制方法。同時，本項目有望强化高速邊界層轉捩基礎領域和應用領域之間的聯繫。

15203824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15203824.value: 用於可持續電子紡織品的離子導電纖維的連續製備研究

15203824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15203824.value: Electronic textiles (E-textiles) perform their electric function mostly by electroconductive textiles. However, designing electroconductive textiles that are both ergonomic and conformable to achieve material-skin compatibility remains a challenge, due to the property mismatch among the rigid electroconductive materials, flexible conventional textiles, and soft human skins. On the contrary, iontronics, a class of ion-based devices using soft ionic conductors, can be conformably adapted to the skin in a mechanically invisible manner as the most skin-like electronic devices. Therefore, ionic conductive textiles present as an ideal candidate as the alternative to electroconductive textiles to match electronic and biological interfaces. Though attempts have been made to develop ionic conductive fibers for E-textile applications, challenges still remain on the material stability and the viability of scalable and sustainable manufacturing. Given this challenge, this project aims to explore the feasibility of incorporating environmentally friendly materials and methods in the development of ionic conductive textiles with sufficient mechanical strength, conductivity, stretchability, and environmental tolerance, and to explore their proof-of-concept applications of sustainable E-textile systems. Firstly, a continuous approach based on the dynamic crosslinking spinning technique and the deep eutectic solvents will be proposed to achieve the scalable production of ionic conductive fibers in a sustainable matter with full utilization of spinning materials. Underlying correlations among spinning processes, molecular-level structures of fibers, and mechanical, thermal, and conductive performance of fibers will be identified to optimize the ionic conductive fibers to high mechanical strength, high ionic conductivity, reliable electrical and mechanical stability, and promising environmental tolerance. The optimized fibers will be then manufactured into ionic yarn/fabric conductors, serving as the building blocks to develop iontronic devices with sensing capability in E-textile systems. Importantly, the recyclability of the ionic conductive textiles will be evaluated, which can effectively reveal the impact of the properties of reused ionic conductive textiles on device performance. The systematic study of the continuous spinning of sustainable ionic conductive fibers in this project will provide scientific insights into the design and manufacturing of high-performance and recyclable iontronic textile materials with ease of achieving materials-skin compatible integration. Since the proposed approach is compatible with textile fiber production and emphasizes green manufacturing by prioritizing minimal energy emissions and materials waste, the process-structure-property correlational study as well as the subsequent iontronic device demonstrations can serve as the solid foundation for the further exploration of advanced E-textile systems that unify environmental friendliness, market viability, and user experience quality. 電子紡織品（E-Textiles）主要通過導電紡織材料發揮其電子功能。然而，由於剛性電子導電材料、柔性傳統紡織和柔軟的人類皮膚之間的機械屬性不匹配，如何設計出既能符合人體工程學又能與皮膚材料良好相容的電子導電紡織品仍然是一個巨大的挑戰。相反，離子電子作為一類基於離子導體材料開發的器件，由於其柔韌特性，能夠更好地與皮膚協調適應，近年來被視爲是最貼近皮膚的電子設備。因此，離子導電纖維材料被認爲可以作為電子導電紡織材料的替代。儘管已經開發出適用於電子紡織品應用的離子導電纖維，他們在材料穩定性以及可批量和可持續製造的可行性方面仍然存在挑戰。有鑒於此，本項目旨在探索如何開發出具有足夠機械強度、導電性、彈性和環境耐受性的離子導電紡織材料，將環境友好材料和可持續製備方法納入考慮因素內，並探索離子導綫纖維在可持續電子紡織品的應用可行性。首先，項目將提出一種基於動態交聯紡絲技術和低共熔溶劑的連續纖維紡絲方法，以實現在全面利用原材料的綠色可持續原則下製備離子導電纖維。將研究紡絲條件、纖維的分子結構以及纖維的機械、熱穩定和導電性能之間的相關性，以優化離子導電纖維，使其具有高機械強度、高離子導電性、可靠的電學和機械穩定性以及良好的環境耐受性。然後將優化後的纖維製成離子導電紗線/導電織物，作為開發具有傳感功能的離子電子設備的基礎元件。項目還將評估離子導電紡織品的可回收性，分析重利用後的離子導電纖維材料的性能及其重複利用對器件性能的影響。 該項目對可持續離子導電纖維的連續紡絲進行系統研究，將為高性能和可重複使用的離子電子紡織材料的設計和製造提供新方法和新材料，從而促進電子功能材料與皮膚的良好相容。由於所提出的方法與紡織纖維的生產相相容，並且通過優先考慮最小能源排放和材料浪費來強調綠色製造，該項目的相關研究以及隨後的離子電子設備演示可為進一步探索新一代環保、可持續電子紡織品打下堅實基礎。

15204624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15204624.value: 甚高頻中距离無線電力傳輸系統的研究

15204824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15204824.value: 面向2100的大灣區城市造林潛力與不確定性評估

15204824.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15204824.value: Prof WENG, Qihao Prof Zeng, Yiwen

15204824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15204824.value: Urban afforestation is well-recognized as a cost-effective nature-based solutions to urban climate change mitigation and adaptation, in parallel with multiple social benefits. Despite a surging number of ambitious urban afforestation plans and investments in global cities, it lacks a comprehensive understanding of two pivotal questions to ensure effective implementation of urban afforestation - where to strategically plant trees and what future benefits can be expected from afforestation. Current efforts to address these questions rely on oversimplified methods that assume the available land for afforestation and its benefits remain unchanged over time. However, both factors are strongly affected by future urban land-use change and climate change. Such impact is largely understudied, bringing substantial uncertainties and risks to the long-term success of urban afforestation projects. This project aims to provide spatiotemporally explicit estimations on the land available for afforestation and the achievable climate mitigation, climate adaptation and social benefits towards 2100 by accounting for the possible impacts of future urban land-use change and climate change. Using the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (GBA), a rapidly developing urban agglomeration that is confronting upscaling climate challenges, as the testbed, we will integrate geospatial analysis, climate modelling, scenario simulation and GeoAI approaches to achieve three objectives: (1) to generate 10-m afforestable area projections maps by high-resolution remotely sensed images and a spatially explicit land-use change modelling approach; (2) to forecast the achievable climate mitigation benefit (increased carbon sequestration), climate adaptation benefit (reduced urban temperature) and social benefit (improved ecosystem service provision and equality) of urban afforestation through a two-pronged vegetation modelling approach (the “top-down”LPJ-DGVM and “bottom-up” i-Tree model), WRF-urban canopy urban climate model, InVEST model and inequality measurements, respectively; (3) to develop an online interactive afforestation dashboard to enable stakeholders to visualize and analyze possible afforestation outcomes and to optimize afforestation plans with an embedded spatial linear programming algorithm. To account for and quantify various urban land-use change and climate change possibilities in the future, we will integrate scenarios narratives and outcomes from Shared Socioeconomic Pathway scenarios and Representative Concentration Pathway scenarios frameworks. Outcomes and products of the project would add significant value to sustainable and climate-ready urban development by not only equipping urban planners with scientific levers to strategically pinpoint locations for urban afforestation and ensure its long-term success, but also providing effective tools to address the long-standing uncertainties in the response of urban vegetation to future environmental changes. 近年來城市造林因其高性價比的特性被廣泛用於緩解城市氣候變化。在大力投資、推行城市造林項目的背景下，兩個關鍵問題亟待解決：如何有策略的造林以及如何估計造林的潛在效益。目前，大部分的研究均假設可造林範圍以及潛在效益恒定不變，而事實上兩者均受到未來土地利用變化以及氣候變化的影響，為未來可造林範圍以及潛在效益帶來巨大不確定性。本研究旨在將未來城市土地利用變化以及氣候變化的影響綜合納入對可造林範圍以及潛在效益的估算中，建立高時空精度的大灣區未來城市造林潛力綜合預測。 具體而言，本研究項目通過結合地理空間大數據分析，環境模型與情景模擬等方法，實現三個主要目標：(1)利用土地利用變化模型建立10米空間分辨率的可造林區域估計；(2)結合多尺度植被模型，氣候模型和公平性評估方法預測造林的氣候變化環境效益（增加碳匯），氣候變化適應效益（城市降溫）和社會效益（增加綠地公平性）；(3)創建一個在線的城市造林規劃推演平臺，整合並可視化(1)(2)中的模型估算結果。為了解釋和量化未來各種社會經濟發展和氣候變化的可能性，本研究將整合Shared Socioeconomic Pathway (SSPs)和Representative Concentration Pathway (RCPs)情景來模擬不同情境下的可造林區域、估計相應的未來效益。該項目的成果和產品將為可持續和應對氣候變化的城市發展增加重要價值，不僅為城市規劃者提供科學依據、從戰略上確定城市植樹造林的最優區域確保其能實現長期效益，而且還為解決城市植被對未來環境變化的長期不確定性提供有效工具。

15205224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15205224.value: 大規模多層圖數據管理：查詢，索引，算法

15205224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15205224.value: 圖數據庫市場正在快速增長，預計到2025年將達到32億美元，年增長率為20-30%。在图數據庫領域，基於接近度的節點排名查詢（根據圖拓撲結構中節點與查詢節點的接近度對節點進行排名）已被廣泛研究並應用於推薦、異常檢測和網頁搜索等應用。現有研究主要集中在單層圖上，這些研究已經達到了一定的成熟度。現在，研究更具表現力的多層圖的高效管理變得越來越重要，因為多層圖能更好地表示現實世界的系統。多層圖表示同一組對象在多個通道中的交互，這在社交数据、神經科學、金融和交通系統中很常見。例如現代社交平台Facebook和騰訊微信，已經演變成至少包含三層（社交、交易和遊戲網絡）的多層圖。這些層是相關的，但在拓撲結構上有所不同。目前，對多層圖上的基於接近度的節點排名查詢缺乏系統性的研究。為了填補這一研究空白，我們將研究設計和高效處理新型多層圖查詢（MGQs）。這個項目將成為MGQs領域的領先研究，並可能惠及上述應用和系統。在複雜的多層圖拓撲結構上定義MGQs是具有挑戰性的。直接應用單層圖解決方案可能會產生反直覺的結果。此外，有效的查詢通常通過昂貴的多跳採樣來測量節點接近度。多層性的特性進一步放大了計算成本，因為多層圖中的每一層都可能非常龐大。多層圖的管理在存儲、計算和查詢時間方面成本高昂。為了解決這些挑戰，我們將進行一系列邏輯上相互關聯的研究任務。第一，我們將提出新的MGQ定義，全面考慮整個多層圖和每一層中的基於接近度的節點排名；第二，為了加速MGQs的數據訪問，我們將利用多層圖的固有特性設計快速且緊湊的索引；第三，基於這些索引，我們將開發高效且可擴展的算法來處理大量數據上的MGQs。最後，我們將系統地實施評估我們的解決方案。憑藉可行的研究計劃和我們在大規模圖處理方面的豐富經驗，我們預計這個項目的成功將大大推進數據管理研究，並加速多層圖查詢在工業中的應用。

15205424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15205424.value: 信息物理電力系統的動態分析

15205424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15205424.value: The digitalization of modern power grids greatly improves grid observability and controllability for secure operation, and plays an important role in effectively facilitating energy transition via integrating large-scale renewables. Grid digitalization has essentially transformed traditional power systems into so-called cyber-physical power systems (CPPSs) consisting of pure physical power systems and cyber communication systems. This major transformation has resulted in two inevitable facts, i.e., the coexistence of coupled power and information flows, and correlated physical-layer and cyber-layer contingencies. These facts have significantly complicated power system dynamics and posed an unprecedented threat to power system dynamic security. The classic dynamic analysis techniques currently used by power system operators are designed primarily for modeling and analysis of traditional physical power system dynamics, and mainly deal with physical-layer contingencies (PLCs). They cannot be directly used for the dynamic analysis of CPPSs. Existing CPPS research mostly studies steady-state security as affected by cyber communication systems and cyber-layer contingencies (CLCs). A limited number of works focusing on the dynamic security of CPPSs rely on co-simulation and thus cannot reveal the essential mechanisms for the dynamic coupling effect of physical and cyber layers and the combined effect of PLCs and CLCs. Moreover, the two new important types of dynamics (i.e., converter-driven and resonance stability) induced by renewables and power electronics are not yet explored in the context of CPPSs. The project aims to develop a novel dynamic analysis methodology to effectively model and analyze CPPS dynamics with a clear mechanism revelation. To strike a balance between modeling adequacy and efficiency for dynamic analysis, a simplified cyber-layer model based on graph theory and identified communication protocol sublayer structure will be innovatively developed and then integrated with the physical-layer dynamic model. Two major scientific questions will be carefully addressed: 1. what are the general methods to model and analyze CPPS dynamics considering the significant impact of expanding cyber communication systems and information flow? 2. what are the essential mechanisms for dynamic couplings of distinct physical and cyber layers and the combined effect of diverse PLCs and CLCs on CPPS dynamics? With the two questions answered, complex CPPS dynamics can be practically assessed with valuable physical insights to guide the decision-making of power system operators. On this basis, a robust and cost-effective technique will be proposed to effectively enhance CPPS dynamics. The project will undoubtedly benefit the secure and economic operation of modern digitalized power grids in HK and worldwide. 現代電網的數字化大大提高了電網的可觀性和可控性，確保電網的安全運行，在促進大規模可再生能源並網以實現有效能源轉型方面發揮著重要作用。電網數字化從根本上將傳統電力系統轉變為由純物理電力系統和網絡通信系統組成的所謂的信息物理電力系統。這一重大轉變造就了兩個不可避免的結果，即相互耦合的電力和信息流的共存，以及相互聯繫的物理層和信息層的突發事件。 這些使得電力系統動態變得异常複雜，對其動態安全構成了前所未有的威脅。 電力系統運行人員當前使用的經典動態分析技術主要用於傳統物理電力系統動態的建模和分析，主要處理物理層的突發事件。它們不能直接用於信息物理電力系統的動態分析。現有的信息物理電力系統研究主要關於受網絡通信系統和信息層突發事件影響的穩態安全。少數關注信息物理電力系統動態安全的研究基於聯合仿真，因此無法揭示物理層和信息層的動態耦合效應以及物理層和信息層突發事件的組合效應的深層機理。此外，可再生能源和電力電子器件所引起的兩種重要系統新動態（即換流器驅動穩定性和諧振穩定性）尚未在信息物理電力系統的背景下進行探索。 本項目旨在研發一種新的動態分析方法，對信息物理電力系統動態進行有效地建模和分析，並清楚地揭示其深層機理。為了在動態分析的建模充分性和效率之間達到平衡，將開創性地提出一個基於圖論和相關通信協議子層結構的簡化信息層模型，然後將其與物理層動態模型進行結合。本項目將致力解決兩個主要科學問題：1. 考慮到不斷擴展的網絡通信系統和信息流的重大影響，對信息物理電力系統動態進行建模和分析的一般方法是什麼？2.不同物理層和信息層的動態耦合的深層機理是什麼，以及不同物理層和信息層突發事件對信息物理電力系統動態的綜合影響是什麼？通過回答這兩個問題，可以對複雜的信息物理電力系統動態進行實際評估，並提供重要的洞察和見解，以指導和幫助電力系統運行人員做決策。在此基礎上，將提出一種魯棒且經濟的技術以有效地改善信息物理電力系統動態。本項目必將有益於香港以至全球數字化現代電網的安全和經濟運行。

15205624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15205624.value: 高效折叠方案：零知识以太坊虚拟机及其他密码系统的新设计

15205624.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15205624.value: Dr Guo, Yu Prof Xiao, Bin

15205624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15205624.value: 零知识以太坊虚拟机（zkEVM）通过批量处理智能合约执行，为扩展以太坊提供了一个有前途的解决方案。目前，最有效的zkEVM基于“折叠技术”，该技术通过随机组合将多个操作（实例）折叠为一个。最近，折叠方案引起了广泛关注，包括Nova、SuperNova、HyperNova、Protostar和Protogalaxy。虽然这些方法通过折叠两个实例或支持预定义的一组操作满足了zkEVM的基本要求，但在更广泛的场景中，如折叠多个实例或处理任意类型的实例时，它们变得效率较低或不适用，从而限制了以太坊的可扩展性。 本项目将首先解决处理多个实例时折叠效率的问题。我们不是直接折叠实例，而是首先将每个实例分解为子实例，从而避免在折叠过程中产生的任何成本。此外，我们展示了如何折叠这些子实例，从而实现多个实例的高效折叠。最后，我们通过折叠在分解步骤中引入的额外声明来优化效率。 此外，我们提出了一种新颖的异构zkEVM构建方法，用于处理不同类型的实例而无需昂贵的转换。对于每个实例，我们将其重构为统一结构，并为这些重构的实例设计了高效的折叠方案。我们进一步设计了一个zkEVM系统，该系统推迟高成本的验证，从而为证明者和验证者提供高效的计算。 最后，我们将我们的折叠技术扩展到进一步的应用，如设计高效的简洁非交互知识论证（SNARK）和证明聚合系统。对于SNARK，我们展示了如何将关系转化为子约束。通过折叠这些子约束，可以显著提高证明和验证的效率。我们还将折叠技术扩展到证明聚合，将多个证明折叠为一个，从而提高各种应用中的验证效率。 该项目具有许多技术优点。效率在设计zkEVM时至关重要，因为它直接关系到交易速率、交易费用和以太坊的可扩展性。为了在一般场景中提高zkEVM的效率，我们引入了几种针对多操作和任意类型实例的创新技术。这些技术有可能彻底改变zkEVM，使其在扩展以太坊方面更加高效和灵活，从而降低交易费用并提高交易速率。此外，本项目探索了折叠方案的新应用，以产生更深远的影响。这些技术无疑对香港经济具有重要意义。
