15206024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15206024.value: 大語言模型時代的推薦系統：方法、脆弱性和魯棒性

15206024.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15206024.value: Prof Li, Qing Prof Tang, Jiliang

15206024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15206024.value: 推薦系統 (RecSys) 在我們的日常生活中越來越重要,因為它們有助於緩解各種面向使用者的線上服務中的資訊過載問題。最近,隨著大型語言模型 (LLMs) 的蓬勃發展,探索將 LLMs 作為下一代 RecSys 的基礎模型已經取得了可喜的成績。然而,將 LLMs 應用於 RecSys 仍處於起步階段,面臨著兩個關鍵限制:(1) 難以有效捕捉特定領域的知識,包括高階協作性和語義知識;(2) 缺乏對 LLM 驅動的 RecSys 在面對對抗性攻擊時的安全脆弱性和穩健性的研究。 為了解決這些限制,本項目旨在探索 LLMs 時代 RecSys 的新前沿,開發一個創新的 LLM 驅動的推薦框架,並研究對抗性攻擊和防禦機制。具體來說,我們的方法包括開發一個泛化的 LLM 驅動框架,通過融合領域內高階協作知識來革新 RecSys。我們將設計用戶和項目向量量化記號化器,將用戶和項目編碼為有限數量的離散記號,並輔以代碼本表示,從而防止詞彙空間在每個用戶和項目被直接分配特定記號時變得過於龐大。此外,我們將通過項目語義重建學習過程納入項目的語義知識,在項目的文本信息(如標題和描述)與其離散記號之間進行相互生成。 此外,一個關鍵問題仍然未得到充分探索:LLM 驅動的 RecSys 在面對對抗性攻擊時的安全脆弱性。例如,存在一種潛在風險,即精心設計的提示性對抗性擾動可能會誤導 LLM 驅動的系統,為保守的金融客戶提供高風險的投資建議。通過全面研究對抗性攻擊並了解其潛在風險,我們可以更深入地洞察 LLM 驅動 RecSys 的可信度。因此,我們首先提出了兩種攻擊策略:對抗性提示攻擊和對抗性用戶描述攻擊,旨在誤導 LLM 驅動的 RecSys。在深入理解因對抗性攻擊造成的安全脆弱性之後,我們將研究加強對抗性防禦的對策,以增強 LLM 驅動 RecSys 的穩健性,包括自我調節的對抗性訓練和經過認證的穩健性,分別用於微調系統和去噪受污染的輸入,從而提高 LLM 驅動 RecSys 的可信度。最後,我們將開發一個實驗原型系統來體現我們框架的過程,並使用真實世界的數據進行廣泛的測試,以評估我們研究的有效性。

15206824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15206824.value: 研究新型同步振動超精密鑽石銑削系統加工高性能微結構表面

15206824.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15206824.value: Prof Yip, Wai Sze Lenny Prof Zhu, Zhi Wei

15206824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15206824.value: Microstructured surfaces with various functions are extensively applied in a range of modern industries, including optics, microelectronics, biomedical engineering, and anti-counterfeiting. However, their geometric complexity and nano-scale accuracy impose highly challenging requirements on machining technologies. Currently, ultra-precision diamond turning (UPDT) and ultra-precision diamond milling (UPDM) are regarded as promising methods for fabricating microstructured surfaces. However, UPDT faces limitations in fabricating high-aspect-ratio microstructures due to tool interferences, while UPDM suffers from low machining efficiency due to small material removal volume under single-edge milling. To address this research gap, a new ultra-precision machining technology for the fabrication of microstructures with a high aspect ratio and high efficiency is required. This project proposes a novel oscillation-synchronized ultra-precision diamond milling (OS-UPDM) technology. Different from the UPDT, oscillatory motions will be added to the workpiece to ensure continuous contact between the workpiece and the tool edge during milling of a single microstructure, enabling a shift from the conventional point-to-point material removal mode to a layer-by-layer mode. As a result of the shift, it is anticipated that the fabrication efficiency will increase by over five times compared to the conventional UPDT methods. Additionally, the aspect ratio of the microstructures is anticipated to be five times greater than that of conventional UPDT methods, with surface roughness and shape error of less than 2 nm and 50 nm, respectively. As a key component of the OS-UPDM technology, a novel magnetic tri-axial oscillator will be designed on the basis of Maxwell electromagnetic actuation to achieve high-frequency tri-axial oscillations with hundreds of micrometers in magnitude, thereby overcoming inherent tool motions in conventional oscillators caused by the low strokes for piezoelectric actuators and the low force density for voice coil motors. Then, a master slave collaborative control strategy will be developed to precisely control the magnetic tri-axial oscillator when milling microstructures. Next, high-efficiency fabrication of microstructures with a high aspect ratio will be conducted, followed by surface quality and form accuracy characterizations. Finally, the optical performances of the fabricated microstructured surface will be comprehensively assessed to show their functional applications, especially anti-counterfeiting for industrial products. The project outcomes and subsequent works will not only resolve the shortcomings of UPDT and UPDM in the fabrication of microstructured surfaces but will also promote applications of structured surfaces to various products, including medical diagnostics, lab-on-a-chip, optical sensing, and antibacterial devices. The success of this project has both scientific and engineering applications for the industries. 微結構表面具有多種功能，廣泛應用於光學、微電子、生物醫學工程和防偽等現代工業的各個領域。然而，其幾何複雜性和納米級精度對加工技術提出了極具挑戰性的要求。目前，超精密金剛石車削（UPDT）和超精密金剛石銑削（UPDM）被認為是製造微結構表面的可行方法。然而，UPDT 在製造高深寬比微結構時會因刀具幹涉而受到限制，而 UPDM 則因單刃銑削時材料去除量較小而導致加工效率低下。為了解決這一問題，需要開發一種新的超精密加工技術，用於高深寬比微結構的大規模高效製造。 本項目提出一種新型振動同步超精密金剛石銑削（OS-UPDM）技術。與UPDT不同，在銑削單個微結構時，將在工件上施加振蕩運動，以確保工件與刀具刃口之間的連續接觸，從而實現從傳統的點對點材料去除模式向逐層去除模式的轉變。由於這種轉變，預計製造效率將提高3-5倍以上。此外，微結構的深寬比將比傳統方法高出五倍以上，表面粗糙度和形狀誤差將分別小於2納米和50納米。將基於麥克斯韋電磁驅動設計一種新型磁性三軸振蕩器，作為OS-UPDM技術的關鍵部件，以實現具有數百微米振幅的高頻三軸振動，從而克服傳統振蕩器由於壓電致動器行程低和音圈電機力密度低而導致的固有刀具運動。然後，將開發一種主從協同控制策略，以在銑削微結構時精確控制磁性三軸振蕩器。接著，將進行高深寬比微結構的大規模製造，並進行表面品質和形狀精度測量。最後，將使用電荷耦合器件相機評估所製造的微結構表面的光學性能，以展示其在工業產品中的功能應用，特別是防偽功能。 項目成果及後續工作不僅將解決UPDT和UPDM在微結構表面製造方面的不足，還將微結構表面應用於各種產品，包括醫學診斷、晶片實驗室、光學傳感和抗菌設備。因此，本項目的成功具有科學和工程應用價值。

15207324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15207324.value: 一種基於模板的可靠信息-物理融合系統的設計方法

15207324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15207324.value: Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) are the results of the inevitable integration of computers with physical domain applications, such as smart medical operations, smart driving, and robotics. Many CPSs are safety-critical. For example, in smart medical operations, systems of various smart medical devices need to conduct safe surgeries; in smart driving, systems of Connected and Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs) need to conduct various safe driving manoeuvres: merging, lane change etc.; in robotics, systems of high-speed robotic arms need to move safely without collisions. To build a CPS of the above nature, we need to first design the CPS. The core of the design, just like any rigorous engineering design, is to define the CPS’s model and prove the model’s safety. That is, the designed model needs to be verifiably safe. This requirement is not only a prerequisite for our confidence in the CPS built according to the model (if the model cannot be proven safe, how can we trust the CPS is safe?), but may also be demanded by law for regulation/certification purposes. However, proving the safety of a CPS model is hard. The brute force approach is model checking, e.g. exhaustively search all states that the CPS model can reach (reachability model checking), and confirm every reachable state is safe. The model checking approach is well-known to be unscalable: combinatorial explosion of the subsystems’ states can quickly make the model checking intractable even at small problem scales. Empirical/statistical approach, on the other hand, is not rigorously a proof; the coverage of the empirical/statistical results are usually partial due to the same scalability problem. In this project, we aim to investigate a third alternative: the analytical approach. This approach shall consist of three components. First, we shall propose generic design templates for typical safety-critical CPSs. Second, we shall propose workflow to expand the templates to detailed designs. The safety of the resulted designs shall be analytically provable, hence obviate the intractable exhaustive model checking. Meanwhile, the analytical proof also avoids the coverage problem of the empirical/statistical approach. Third, with the overall complexity put under control, we can create synergy with the model checking approach and the empirical/statistical approach (e.g. in dealing with local design details). We call the above three-component analytical approach collectively as the “template-based design methodology,” and its feasibility has been corroborated by our several published pilot case studies. 信息-物理融合系統（CPS）是計算機與物理世界應用相結合的必然產物，如智慧醫療、智慧駕駛、機器人等。許多 CPS 都是安全攸關的。例如，在智慧醫療中，各種智慧醫療設備間需要協調保證安全的手術；在智慧駕駛中，連網自動駕駛車輛 (CAV) 間需要協調保證安全的駕駛操作：並道、變換車道等；在機器人系統中，機械手臂間需要高速且安全地移動而不發生碰撞。 為了建造具有上述性質的CPS，我們需要先設計該CPS。就像任何嚴格的工程設計一樣，設計CPS的核心是定義 CPS 的模型並證明模型的安全性。也就是說，所設計的模型需要是可驗證安全的。這不僅是對所建造CPS的信心的基礎（如果模型不能被證明是安全的，我們如何相信依此模型所建造的CPS 是安全的？），也往往是法律和監管/認證的要求。 然而，證明 CPS 模型的安全性很困難。一種方法是使用蠻力的模型檢查，例如窮舉搜尋CPS模型可以達到的所有狀態（可達性模型檢查），並確認每個可達狀態都是安全的。眾所周知，這種方法是不可擴展的：子系統的狀態會組合爆炸；即使問題的規模很小，狀態組合爆炸也會很快使模型檢查變得不可行。另一種方法是使用經驗/統計，但是這種方法並不是嚴格的證明：由於同樣的可擴展性問題，經驗/統計也只能覆蓋部分的可能狀況。 在本項目中，我們將研究第三種方法：分析方法。此方法可由三個部分組成。首先，我們將為典型的安全攸關 CPS 提出通用的設計模板。其次，我們將提出將該設計模板擴展到詳細設計的工作流程。最終設計的安全性應可透過分析證明，從而避免蠻力模型檢查。同時，分析證明也避免了經驗/統計方法的覆蓋問題。第三，在整體複雜性可控的情況下，我們可以結合模型檢查方法和經驗/統計方法（例如，在處理局部設計細節時）。我們將上述三部分分析方法統稱為“基於模板的設計方法”，其可行性已被我們已發表的先導研究所證實。

15207424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15207424.value: 基於細粒度區塊系統的網約車運營策略設計：強化學習方法

15207424.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15207424.value: Prof KE, Jintao Prof YANG, Hai

15207424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15207424.value: Ride-sourcing services provided by transportation network companies (TNCs) have significantly transformed the mobility system. Many ride-sourcing platforms and related research divide the operational space into a number of blocks and then set operational strategies for each block. For example, idle vehicle repositioning is aimed at directing empty vehicles from one block to another, while pricing operations involve dynamically adjusting the fare structures for passengers in different blocks. The block-wise setting of operational strategies allows platforms to respond differentially to various supply and demand situations across space, thereby enhancing operational efficiency. Block-based strategy design has thus been widely implemented in ride-sourcing services. However, the blocks currently in use tend to be large, each containing many streets and different infrastructures. This raises a natural question: Can we further reduce the block area down to smaller scale (e.g., individual streets or road segments) and customize fine-grained block-wise operation strategies? The primary challenge associated with this configuration is the increased complexity of operational algorithm design, especially in terms of computational efficiency, as a city may encompass many fine-grained blocks (for example, Hong Kong has more than 4,000 streets, and Beijing has over 15,000 streets). However, such a block-wise operation strategy enables us to address supply and demand disparities in the ride-sourcing market at a more micro scale, thereby improving the overall market operation efficiency. In the current environment, which is characterized by increased integration of urban development and expanding scope of shared mobility, this approach has notable research and practical implications. To design a strategy involving fine-grained blocks, we will use hierarchical reinforcement learning (HRL) to divide large operational problems raised by fine-grained blocks into smaller sub-problems, which are respectively handled by different HRL agents. This framework will help enhance computation efficiency while enabling the consideration of future impacts of operational decisions. In the second phase, for extremely large-scale cases, we will combine the HRL with non-artificial-intelligence optimization algorithms to further enhance the algorithm efficiency. Lastly, a ride-sourcing simulation platform will be deployed, calibrated, and used to conduct experimental studies for the proposed frameworks. The outcomes of the proposed project can be promptly implemented by on-demand mobility service providers (e.g., Uber and taxi companies in Hong Kong) to promote the interests of stakeholders. 共享出行平台提供的叫車服務已顯著改變了出行系統。許多叫車平台和相關研究將運營空間劃分為若干區塊，然後為每個區塊制定運營策略。例如，空車調度旨在將空車從一個區塊引導到另一個區塊；而定價操作則涉及動態調整不同區塊中展示給乘客的票價結構。區塊化的運營策略設置使平台能夠針對不同區域的供需情況做出差異化響應，從而提高運營效率。因此，區塊化策略設計在共享出行服務中得到了廣泛應用。然而，目前使用的區塊往往較大，每個區塊包含許多街道和不同的基礎設施。這自然引出了一個問題：我們能否進一步縮小區塊面積到更小的規模（例如，單個街道或路段），並定制細粒度的區塊化運營策略？這種設置的主要挑戰在於運營算法設計的複雜性增加，特別是在計算效率方面，因為一個城市可能包含許多細粒度的區塊（例如，香港有超過4,000條街道，北京有超過15,000條街道）。然而，這種區塊化運營策略使我們能夠在更微觀的層面上解決共享出行市場中的供需差異，從而提高整體市場運營效率。在當前城市發展日益融合和共享出行運營範圍不斷擴大的環境下，這種方法具有顯著的研究和實踐意義。為了設計涉及細粒度區塊的策略，我們將使用分層強化學習（HRL）將細粒度區塊設置所導致的大型運營問題分解為較小的子問題，分別由不同的智能體處理。這一框架將有助於提高計算效率，同時考慮運營決策的未來影響。在第二階段，對於極大規模的情況，我們將結合HRL與非人工智能優化算法進一步提高算法效率。最後，我們將部署、校準並使用共享出行仿真平台來進行所提框架的實驗研究。該項目的成果可以迅速在共享出行平台中（例如，香港的Uber和出租車公司）實施，以促進社會各方的總體福祉。

15208024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15208024.value: 高溫潮濕地區空調用低腐蝕性液體乾燥劑除濕技術的研發

15208024.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15208024.value: Dr Luo, Jielin Prof YANG, Hongxing

15208024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15208024.value: The energy consumption of air-conditioning systems in hot and humid weather areas like Hong Kong constitutes a significant portion (over 40%) of total building energy consumption, leading to greenhouse gas emissions and resource waste. The need for humidity control exacerbates energy usage. Liquid desiccant dehumidification for air-conditioning of buildings has been identified as an efficient approach, with energy-saving potential exceeding 30% for fresh air supply to commercial buildings. However, conventional liquid desiccants often exhibit high corrosion rates on metals, limiting their widespread and long-term operation. Moreover, existing desiccant dehumidification models rarely take into account sustainability factors such as corrosion, resulting in significant performance deviations between simulations and engineering practice. This research proposal aims to address these challenges by investigating a new kind of low-corrosive liquid desiccant or deep eutectic solvent for air-conditioning applications. A universal applicable model based on the molecular interaction method will be established to predict the properties of deep eutectic solvents. Property measurement experiments will be conducted to validate and refine the model. The selected candidates will be further evaluated through systematic simulations and experiments when they are used in an air-conditioning system. A multi-objective model for desiccant-involved air-conditioning systems will be developed, integrating energy, economic, environmental, and sustainability indicators for comprehensive evaluation of the air-conditioning systems. To evaluate the performance of the new technology, a lab-scale test rig will be developed, enabling parametric analysis, corrosion visualization, and control strategy tests. The experimental data will be utilized to refine the multi-objective model, enabling accurate predictions of short-term and long-term performance across different scales. The completion of this project is expected to benefit the societies in different aspects. The exploration of deep eutectic solvents as desiccant provides a promising solution for large-scale implementation of liquid desiccant dehumidification for air-conditioning, contributing to sustainable development in hot and humid regions. The successful application of the developed property model offers a convenient approach for predicting desiccant properties, reducing the labour and time required for property measurements. The multi-objective model of desiccant-involved air-conditioning systems will introduce a new perspective for comprehensive evaluation, encompassing energy, economic, and sustainability aspects for long-term applications. The laboratory tests of an air-conditioning system with new desiccant will generate essential data and design guidelines through quantitative and visual observations of corrosion during normal operation. Overall, this research proposal aims to advance the desiccant-involved HVAC systems, offering practical solutions, comprehensive modelling approaches, and valuable insights into sustainable air-conditioning engineering. 在炎熱天氣地區（包括香港），空調系統的能源消耗佔建築能源消耗總量的很大一部分（超過40%），導致溫室氣體排放和資源浪費。空調系統中的乾燥劑除濕已被確定為一種有效的節能方法，其節能潛力超過30%。然而，傳統的乾燥劑通常對金屬表現出很高的腐蝕率，限制了其廣泛和長期的運行。此外現有的乾燥劑除濕冷卻系統模型很少考慮腐蝕等可持續性因素，導致模擬與實際應用之間存在顯著的性能偏差。本研究計劃旨在通過研究一種稱為深共晶溶劑的低腐蝕性乾燥劑來應對這些挑戰，該乾燥劑用於空調系統應用。建立基於分子相互作用法的通用適用模型，預測深共晶溶劑的性能，將進行屬性測量實驗以驗證和完善模型。被選中的新溶劑將通過系統的模擬和實驗進行進一步評估，開發涉及乾燥劑的空調系統多目標模型，整合能源、經濟、環境和可持續性指標進行綜合評估。 為了評估這種新技術的性能，將開發一個實驗室規模的測試台，實現參數分析、腐蝕可視化和控制策略測試。實驗數據將用於完善多目標模型，從而能夠準確預測不同尺度的短期和長期表現。該專案的建成，預期將在各個方面造福社會。探索深共晶溶劑作為乾燥劑為乾燥劑輔助空調系統的大規模實施提供了有希望的解決方案，有助於可持續發展。本專案所開發的性能模型的成功應用將為預測乾燥劑性能提供了一種方便的方法，減少了性能實驗所需的人力和時間。此外乾燥劑輔助空調系統的多目標建模為綜合評估引入了新的視角，包括長期應用的能源、經濟和可持續性方面。使用新乾燥劑的空調系統的實驗室測試將通過對正常運行期間腐蝕的定量和目視觀察生成基本數據和設計指南。這項研究預期會取得豐碩成果，將提高公眾對能源和環境可持續性的認識，使香港成為全球可持續發展的領導者。總體而言，本研究計劃旨在推進涉及乾燥劑的空調節能系統，提供實用的解決方案、全面的建模方法和對可持續空調工程的寶貴見解。

15208824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15208824.value: 打击工业4.0洗绿的ESG联邦审计

15208824.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15208824.value: Prof Huang, George Q Prof Zhou, Mengchu

15208824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15208824.value: Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) has played a key part in manufacturing agenda for several years, the urgency and immediate need for concrete actions is only now to embrace increasingly serious sustainability issues. Since a satisfactory ESG report can inevitably bring a series of benefits, greenwashing behaviors have been emerged as a kind of deceptive disclosure in all three dimensions of ESG, which usually publishes large quantities of ESG data and seems to be very transparent in practicing ESG but actually perform poorly. It seems Industry 4.0 has offered a sound data infrastructure to collect and store front-end real-time manufacturing data for endorsing ESG KPIs for mitigating greenwashing behaviors However, greenwashing has not stopped in manufacturing industry. To deter the greenwashing behaviors, current studies also suggest enhancing the scrutiny from independent directors, institutional investors, and independent assurances. In practice, auditing is an effective approach for regulation. The HKEx (Hong Kong Stock Exchange) has suggested the seeking of the third-party assurance for ESG reports so that the actual ESG performance can be endorsed by this party. However, the ESG audit encounters more real-life challenges in preventing greenwashing, such as the verifiable ESG voucher generation, collusion greenwashing with auditors and ESG KPI authenticity from manufacturing big data. To meet these challenges, this project proposes a federated ESG auditing framework to mitigating Industry 4.0 greenwashing at three levels. For data level, the best practice on accounting voucher generation is introduced to generate and circulate digital ESG vouchers among multiparty. A series of cutting-edge technologies such as blockchain, zero knowledge proof and group signature are well integrated to provide provable transparency and credibility for guarantying security and privacy of manufacturing data disclosure and sharing. For the auditing level, this project converts one ESG report by a single auditing party into specific ESG KPIs by federated auditing parties to prevent collusion greenwashing. Smart contracts take the role of matching, just like a handling editor matches reviewer's to a journal paper, to bridge ESG KPIs with professional auditors. The technical innovations of smart contracts are explored in detail. In the analytics level, multi-dimensional authenticity evaluations of ESG KPIs can be conducted through verifiable ESG vouchers. Some key metrics for data-driven methods are extracted to measure authenticity levels. The major breakthrough of this project is to innovate and revolutionize the organization of ESG auditing, towards a decentralized, transparent, and independent way, to prevent Industry 4.0 greenwashing. 过去几年里，制造业对ESG的呼吁愈发强烈。特别日益严峻的可持续发展问题，对制造业如何践行ESG提出了更迫切的需求。在目前的ESG实践中，美化ESG报告会为企业带来一系列好处，因此，"洗绿 "行为应运而生，它是一种在 ESG 三个维度上的欺骗性披露。通常会公布大量 ESG 数据，在践行 ESG 方面看似非常透明，但实际表现却差强人意。然而工业4.0的基础设施为ESG报告提供了强力的数据支撑，这为透过ESG报告中的指标项找到可支撑的数据证据，从而降低洗绿风险提供了可能。为遏制 "洗绿 "行为，目前的研究还建议加强独立董事、机构投资者和审计机构的审查。在实践中，审计是一种有效的监管方式。香港交易所（HKEx）曾建议为 ESG 报告寻求第三方担保，使 ESG 的实际表现得到专业的背书。然而，ESG审计在防止 "洗绿 "方面遇到了更多的现实挑战，例如，能够支撑ESG指标的可验证的ESG凭证生成、与审计方合谋"洗绿"、及海量ESG数据的真实性验证问题。 为应对这些挑战，本项目提出了一个联邦ESG审计框架，拟从三个层面降低工业 4.0 场景下的 "洗绿 "风险。在数据层面，借鉴会计凭证的实践经验，在多方之间利用区块链、零知识证明、群体签名等一系列前沿技术的融合生成和流通数字 ESG 凭证，从而为保证生产数据披露和共享的安全性和私密性提供了可监管的数据要素计算环境。在审计层面，为防止串通洗绿，该项目将单个审计方的审计一份ESG报告转化为联合审计方的审计多个ESG指标项。项目通过智能合约的工作流创新，使得智能合约具备ESG报告的审计任务分配能力，完成审计的双向匹配过程。在真实性分析层面，可通过可验证的 ESG 凭证对 ESG 指标项及其数据基础进行多维度的真实性评估。提取了一些数据驱动方法的关键指标，用于衡量真实性水平。本项目的突破在于创新和改革ESG审计的组织方式，使其走向去中心化、透明化和独立化，以降低工业 4.0 洗绿风险。

15209324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15209324.value: 負極性空間流注莖的起源和髮展特性的實驗研究

15209324.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15209324.value: Prof DU, Ya-ping Dr Yue, Yishi

15209324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15209324.value: 空間流注莖是理解步進先導-負極性放電的最神秘現象之一-的關鍵要素，也是研究雷電起始的重要環節。空間流注莖形成機製在2014年被列爲雷電研究領域的十大未解問題之一，但至今仍未得到充分理解。空間流注莖的形成機製已有幾種假設被提出，且這些假設在解釋空間流注莖的起源和髮展方麵存在顯著差異，但由於其微觀物理過程難以觀測，這些假設尚未得到實驗驗証。因此，對這兩個方麵進行實証研究不僅有助於檢驗現有假設，還可能提出新的假設。 由於空間流注莖的尺寸小、演化快、产生的時間和地點隨機性强，且難以與流注絲區分，觀測其起源和髮展麵臨重大挑戰。爲應對這些挑戰，本項目引入了一種新的研究思路：首先，利用溫度“記憶”效應來追踪空間流注莖的初始區域，因爲該區域是最初被加熱的區域，故在短時間內保持最高溫度；其次，結合高速攝像機的二維成像能力與光電倍增管（PMT）的快速響應和連續觀測優勢，精確檢測伴隨空間流注莖髮展的電離波。 爲了成功實施上述研究思路，本項目將搭建氣壓可調節，並可同步觀測1m空氣間隙負極性放電的電壓、電流、溫度、形態和電離波的實驗平颱。具體而言，本項目將構建具有更高靈敏度和準確性的高速紋影繫統，實現放電通道溫度的可視化。此外，本項目還將新開髮基於多通道PMT組件的電離波檢測繫統，還將設計具有雙鼠籠結構的採樣電阻，用於測量不同放電階段的電流。 研究結果有望進一步加深對空間流注莖的理解，爲評估現有機製並提出新機製提供基礎。此外，這項研究还有望改進負極性先導髮展的數值模型，有助於風機、光伏和輸電線路的耐性性能評估和防雷措施優化。同時，該研究還可能推進雷電起始的研究，從而實現更及時和精確的雷電預警。

15209724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15209724.value: 利用外部工具增強基礎模型能力

15209724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15209724.value: Large language models (LLMs), also referred to as foundation models, have the substantial ability to understand and generate text. They are the fundamental building blocks adaptable to a wide range of specific tasks, revolutionizing the field of natural language processing with remarkable performance. Recent research also reveals the great potential of augmenting foundation models with external tools to enhance their problem-solving power. Prompting the successful utilization of tools by foundation models is of significant value from both practical and scholarly perspectives. On the one hand, foundation models equipped with tools hold great promise for developing robust solutions for real-world complex tasks, pushing their boundaries of applications. On the other hand, learning to use tools is vital for propelling foundation models closer to achieving artificial general intelligence. Tool learning has emerged as a compelling research area, rapidly introducing new methods that combine foundation models with specific tools. A typical example is using search engines to access up-to-date and factual information. However, the current research often limits tool-use to task-specific scenarios, thereby hindering foundation models’ ability to harness a comprehensive range of tools, such as system APIs and AI models, necessary for effectively tackling complex tasks. This project aims to develop an innovative, general framework that leverages foundation models as task planners, executors, and tool managers. To support this objective, we delve into the following four core problems. (1) Explore cost-effective strategies for storing and managing the tool knowledge that enables foundation models to master and coordinate large-scale tools. (2) Design advanced reasoning/planning mechanisms that enable foundation models to follow task instructions and decompose complex tasks into manageable and interrelated sub-tasks. (3) Develop task-tool alignment models that effectively facilitate task completion by utilizing suitable tools while taking their inherent dependencies into account. (4) Exploit closed-loop methods that monitor outcomes of execution as feedback to refine task planning and execution iteratively to increase overall success. While the importance of harnessing external tools to empower foundation models is well acknowledged, it also comes with potential safety concerns. We fully agree that people must consider preventative measures when anticipating its transformative impacts. If the allocated project amount permits, we are also motivated to investigate safety control issues. In summary, our research offers valuable insights into various personal and business applications, where foundation models with enhanced abilities to fully master and flexibly utilize numerous tools are grown to address complex real-world challenges. 大語言模型作為文本理解和生成的強大基礎模型，已經徹底改變了自然語言處理領域的研究範式。最新研究顯示，利用外部工具來增強基礎模型的能力具有巨大的潛力。不論從學術角度還是應用角度來看，促進基礎模型有效利用工具都具有重大意義。一方面，具備工具使用能力的基礎模型有望為複雜任務開發強大的解決方案，突破其應用界限。另一方面，學習使用工具對於推動基礎模型實現通用人工智能亦至關重要。然而，現有研究通常將工具使用局限於特定任務場景，因此阻礙了基礎模型利用廣泛工具來處理複雜任務的能力。該項目旨在開發創新通用框架以充分利用基礎模型作為任務規劃器、執行器和工具管理器的優勢。我們將深入研究如下核心問題：（1）探索經濟有效的工具知識管理策略，令基礎模型能夠掌握和協調大量可選工具；（2）設計先進的任務規劃機制，使基礎模型能夠遵循任務指令，將複雜任務分解為易於管理且相互關聯的子任務；（3）開發任務-工具對齊模型，透過利用合適工具並且同時考慮其固有依賴性，有效促進任務完成；（4）利用閉環監控執行結果，作為反饋信號以迭代方式改善修正任務規劃及執行，以提高整體成功率。儘管利用外部工具增強基礎模型的重要性眾所周知，但它同時也帶來潛在的安全問題，需要慎重考慮預防措施。總之,我們的研究能夠為研究者和商業應用提供寶貴經驗和見解，使具有增強能力的基礎模型可以更靈活地利用大量工具，解決現實世界中的複雜挑戰。

15209824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15209824.value: 揭謎沿海狂浪：時空演化機制與預測

15209824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15209824.value: The collision between human and ocean in coastal region has been escalated recently. The human’s coastal activities are under unprecedented threats of various coastal hazards. Among them, Coastal Rogue Waves (CRW) are exceptionally large waves that can cause damages to coastal infrastructures due to their large impact forces, or drowning incidents by engulfing people into the sea. They often occur instantaneously and disappear without a trace, which makes it difficult to be predicted. So far, many hypotheses to explain their generation mechanisms are proposed, some of which are supported by real-world observation data. Yet, most studies are based on data that is collected from instrument deployed at single point, which however underrepresents the overall risks of encountering CRW within a specified region (a platform, a beach, or offshore wind farm). Due to the lack of reliable multi-point observation data as supporting evidence, the generation mechanisms of CRWs have not been fully understood. More importantly, to predict the precise location and timing of CRWs is still challenging, though there are attempts to associate their probability with sea state parameters. To this point, an effective forecasting methodology is still in demand. In this study, a multi-point wave observation system will be established at selected study sites, namely Big Wave Bay and Shek O Bay in Hong Kong. The system consisting of 4 wave buoys for measuring the wave surface elevations, as well as a camera system to capture the large run-ups. The collected data will be aggregated and used for i) phase-resolved wave field reconstruction and mechanism analysis, and ii) predictive power analysis of sea state parameters. Regarding i), a digital twin for recovering the CRW evolution will be proposed, with the wave field reconstruction technique being introduced to reproduce the spatiotemporal evolution of recorded CRWs and investigate the mechanisms through reanalysis. As for ii), the univariant predictive power analysis will be conducted to investigate the predictability of CRWs in association with selected sea state parameters with the aim to identify the most effective parameters for making forecast. The outcomes of this research will provide a novel approach for making observation and analysing the mechanisms of CRWs. The collected data will supplement the existing opensource rogue wave datasets, which is invaluable for gaining insights of CRW phenomenon. With more comprehensive understanding of their generation mechanisms, effective forecasting can be achieved to facilitate disaster mitigation measures in practice. 近來，人类与海洋在沿海地区的碰撞不斷升級，人類的沿海活動正面臨前所未有的各種沿海災害的威脅。其中，沿海狂浪是一種異常大的波浪，其巨大的衝擊力可能對沿海基礎設施造成損害，或者將人員捲入海中而導致溺水。它們往往是瞬間發生，又消失得無影無蹤，難以預測。目前，人們提出了若幹解釋其生成機制的假設，其中一些得到了現世觀測數據的支持。然而，大多數研究都是基於單點部署的觀測儀器收集的數據，這些數據不足以代表特定區域（海洋平台、海灘或離岸風電場）內遭遇沿海狂浪的整體風險。由於缺乏可靠的多點觀測數據作為支持證據，沿海狂浪的生成機制尚未被完全了解。更重要的是，預測沿海狂浪的精確位置和時間仍然具有挑戰性，儘管有人嘗試將其機率與海況參數建立聯繫，到目前為止，仍然缺乏有效的預測方法。 本研究將在選定的研究地點，即香港大浪灣和石澳灣建立多點波浪觀測系統。該系統由 4 個用於測量波面高程的波浪浮標以及用於捕捉波浪爬昇的攝影系統組成。收集到的數據將被匯總並用於 i) 相位解析波場重建和機制分析，以及 ii) 海況參數的預測能力分析。關於i），將提出用於重構沿海狂浪演化的數位孿生，引入波場重構技術來重現沿海狂浪的時空演化，並重新分析研究其機制。對於ii)，將進行單變量預測力分析，以研究與選定海況參數相关的沿海狂浪的可預測性，旨在確定最有效的預測參數。這項研究的成果將為觀察和分析沿海狂浪的機制提供一種新的方法。收集到的數據將補充現有的開源海洋狂浪資料集，這對於深入了解沿海狂浪現象非常寶貴。透過更全面地了解其生成機制，可以實現有效的預測，以促進減災措施在實踐中的應用。

15210024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15210024.value: 使用基於深度學習的空間聲學成像為機械通風環境開發創新的智慧身心建康預測技術 (SWIFT)

15210024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15210024.value: 機械通風系統是現代建築環境中不可或缺的，這是因為通風系統為室內環境提供新鮮空氣、去除污染物、控制濕度水平，創造具可持續性的室內環境。因此，減少通風系統中因機械風扇、氣流湍流和管道不連續性所產生的噪音而造成的負面影響，對確保居住者的身心健康是極為重要的。居住者的身心健康是一個多維度的心理過程，同時亦受居住者所在空間位置的室內環境影響。儘管一些傳統聲學指標可以用作標示整體或局部環境的聲音水平，但傳統的測量和預測方法均無法充分捕捉現實環境中的所有聲學相關系數。因此，這增加了為環境中所有空間位置對居住者身心健康影響作全面評估的難度。 聲學相機是一種先進的成像設備，由麥克風陣列組成，用於捕捉環境的空間聲學成像。此外，PI的研究團隊最近揭示了聲音基本感知維度的組成結構，以及這些維度對居住者產生的多維心理影響。這一突破性發現有助於深度學習中的人工神經網絡設計，使其可以數位類比聲音感知的複雜過程。這為開發一個智能工具提供了基礎，這會是一個從未被其他研究人員甚至申請人建立的創新工具，它可以有效且全面地預測機械通風環境中各個不同位置的聲音水平及其對居住者身心健康的影響。 因此，這項研究的主要目標是統計、計算和實驗開發一個創新的智慧身心建康預測技術 (SWIFT)，該技術能夠迅速預測機械通風環境中居住者的身心健康，通過結合聲學相機和深度學習這兩項最新的技術。開發完的SWIFT將會是一個透過聲學相機所捕捉的12秒空間聲學成像，自動預測環境中任何空間位置對居住者身心健康的影響。任何非專業人士都可以輕鬆使用 SWIFT 。這項研究的意義在於，它帶來了一種智慧、革命性和用戶友好的整體預測技術，可減少負面的噪音影響，從而在建築設計中創造可持續、智慧和以用戶為中心的空間。

15210624.value: 為健康的生活環境提供基於摩擦納米發電機設計的多功能聲學驅動顆粒捕獲系統
