15310024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15310024.value: 高性能钙钛矿发光器件-面向提升稳定性与柔性的探索

15310024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15310024.value: Halide perovskite light-emitting diodes (PeLEDs) have progressed significantly in the past a few years, with many attractive properties liking high efficiency, low processing costs, high luminance/radiance, color tunability, and excellent purity, making them promising candidates for next-generation light source applications as display, lighting, imaging, and even communication. Various strategies have been developed, boosting the external quantum efficiency (EQE) more than 20% in green, red and near-infrared (NIR) PeLEDs, but poor operational stability is a critical challenge. The T50 lifetimes (the luminance/radiance intensity decreases to 50% of its initial value) for the state-of-the-art PeLEDs at reasonably operation (i.e. continuous operational current density (Jsc) of 20~100 mA cm−2 with a low brightness/radiance) are on the order of 10–100 h, which is far from the practical requirement. In particular, key issues including ionic migration, defects, instability of perovskite crystals, low temperature tolerance, and poor perovskite morphology, degrade PeLEDs quickly even under lower Jsc. Although the recent lifetime of 11,539 h in FAPbI3 PeLEDs is inspiring for the confidence, it cannot translate to high power PeLEDs applications like lighting and electrically driven lasers. Realizing long operational lifetimes and concurrently retaining high efficiency and radiance remain to be a major bottleneck for their further development, along with flexibility, stretchability for wearable electronics. Unfortunately, Zinc oxide (ZnO) based electron-transport layers (ETLs) are most used in the state-of-the-art FAPbI3 based PeLEDs, although the notorious deprotonation reaction between ZnO and perovskite causes intrinsic stability issue. Here, we propose a comprehensive research plan on new approaches in achieving high efficiency and stable FAPbI3 based PeLEDs with high radiance. First, we will develop multiple ligands-tailored tin oxide (SnO2) quantum dots as ETLs to replace ZnO for efficient and stable PeLEDs, and combine with perovskite additive/surface-passivation to establish fundamental understanding on the interfacial engineering for ultra-stable and high radiance PeLEDs. Then we propose novel bending-resistant electrode for PeLEDs, which offers a feasible scheme for flexible, and wearable PeLEDs applications as NIR imaging light source. This proposal presents a new approach to address intractable issues of an over reliance on plausible ZnO ETLs for stable PeLEDs. This proposal also aims at combining PeLEDs technology with wearable applications, and eventually paving the path of highly efficient and stable PeLEDs towards commercialization. This proposal represents a new front for PeLEDs research by integrating physics, chemistry, material engineering, providing new perspectives in next-generation light source technology and wearable applications. 摘要： 鹵化物鈣鈦礦發光二極管（PeLED）在過去幾年中取得了顯著進展，具有許多有吸引力的特性，如高效率、低加工成本、高亮度/輻射度、顏色可調性和優異的純度，使其成為下一代有希望的候選者。人們已經開發了各種策略，將綠光、紅光和近紅外線 (NIR) PeLED 的外量子效率 (EQE) 提高了 20% 以上，但運作穩定性差是一個關鍵挑戰。最先進的 PeLED 在合理操作（即連續工作電流密度 (Jsc) 為 20~100 mA cm−2，低亮度）下的 T50 壽命（亮度/輻射強度降低至其初始值的 50%） /輻射度）約10-100小時，與實際要求相距甚遠。特別是，離子遷移、缺陷、鈣鈦礦晶體的不穩定性、低溫耐受性和較差的鈣鈦礦形貌等關鍵問題，即使在較低的 Jsc 下也會快速降解 PeLED。儘管 FAPbI3 PeLED 最近達到 11,539 小時的使用壽命令人鼓舞，但它無法轉化為照明和電力驅動雷射等高功率 PeLED 應用。實現長使用壽命並同時保持高效率和亮度仍然是其進一步發展的主要瓶頸，以及穿戴式電子產品的靈活性和可拉伸性。 不幸的是，基於氧化鋅（ZnO）的電子傳輸層（ETL）大多數用於最先進的基於FAPbI3 的PeLED，儘管ZnO 和鈣鈦礦之間臭名昭著的去質子化反應會導致固有的穩定性問題。在這裡，我們提出了一項關於實現基於 FAPbI3 的高效率、穩定的高輻射率 PeLED 的新方法的綜合研究計劃。首先，我們將開發多種配體定制的氧化錫（SnO2）量子點作為ETL，以取代ZnO以獲得高效穩定的PeLED，並與鈣鈦礦添加劑/表面鈍化相結合，建立對超穩定和高光界面工程的基本理解。然後，我們提出了新型 PeLED 抗彎曲電極，為柔性、穿戴式 PeLED 作為近紅外線成像光源的應用提供了可行的方案。 該提案提出了一種新方法來解決穩定 PeLED 過度依賴 ZnO ETL 的棘手問題。該提案還旨在將PeLEDs技術與穿戴式應用相結合，最終為高效且穩定的PeLEDs商業化鋪平道路。該提案透過整合物理、化學、材料工程，代表了 PeLED 研究的新前沿，為下一代光源技術和可穿戴應用提供了新視角。

15500224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15500224.value: 分析加密貨幣衍生品的信息含量： 來自比特幣期權的證據

15500224.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15500224.value: Prof Li, Gang Prof Zhan, Xintong, Eunice

15500224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15500224.value: The last decade has seen a fast growth of cryptocurrencies as well as the derivatives of cryptocurrencies. For example, Bitcoin, the first decentralized cryptocurrency, has had its options traded in the exchange ever since 2016. Like options for other securities, Bitcoin options allow investors to hedge or speculate on the future price movements of Bitcoin. Despite the growing importance of digital assets in asset allocation and management, little is known about the information content of crypto derivatives and their relation with other financial markets. In this proposal, we aim to fill the gap by extracting the information from Bitcoin options and analyzing return predictability in both the Bitcoin and stock markets. Our methodologies could be easily modified, and we could extend the study to derivatives of other cryptocurrencies and other financial markets, e.g., corporate bonds. We could also examine the information contents of Bitcoin options in a global context. Cryptocurrencies have garnered growing attention from researchers and industry practitioners ever since the introduction of Bitcoin in 2009. Unlike traditional financial assets, cryptocurrencies have no easy-to-understand underlying/fundamentals, and the valuation of cryptocurrencies has been notoriously difficult. Scholars have undertaken both theoretical and empirical research endeavors to understand the fundamental and dynamics of the Bitcoin market. Empirical work shows that cryptocurrencies are unique in terms of trading. For example, Griffin and Shams (2020) document that purchases made with Tether were strategically timed following market downturns, leading to substantial increases in Bitcoin prices. Makarov and Schoar (2020) show that cryptocurrency markets exhibit periods of large, recurrent arbitrage opportunities across exchanges, especially across counties. Liu and Tsyvinski (2021) show that cryptocurrency returns can be predicted by factors specific to cryptocurrency markets. The evidence implies that traders and their information in Bitcoin could be unique and useful for other financial markets. We plan to extract information from Bitcoin options and examine the usefulness of the information in both the cryptocurrency and equity markets. Previous literature shows that investors in the options market are more sophisticated, and informed traders prefer trading in the options market. Moreover, stock options trading is related to stock sentiment and indicates investors’ gambling preferences. Consequently, information diffuses from the options market to other markets, leading to cross-market return predictabilities. If options of Bitcoins attract investors with private information or those that speculate on price movement or could reflect investor sentiment, we expect return predictability in cryptocurrency and equity markets. 過去十年，加密貨幣及其衍生品市場迅速髮展。其中，比特幣 (Bitcoin) 作爲第一個去中心化的加密貨幣，自2016年以來就一直在交易所進行期權交易。與其他証券的期權相似，比特幣期權允許投資者對比特幣未來價格波動進行對衝或投機。儘管數字資産在資産配置和管理中的重要性日益增加，但目前關於加密貨幣衍生品信息內容及其與其他金融市場之間關繫的認知還很有限。 本研究擬通過提取比特幣期權的信息，分析比特幣和股票市場的收益可預測性，以填補這一研究領域的空白。我們的方法可以擴展應用到其他加密貨幣的衍生品以及其他金融市場，如公司債券的研究，還可以在全球背景下研究比特幣期權信息的應用價值。 自2009年比特幣出現以來，加密貨幣已經引起了研究人員和從業者的廣泛關注。不同於傳統的金融資産，加密貨幣缺乏容易理解的基本麵信息，且其估值很難被定價。目前，已有學者從理論和實証研究兩方麵試圖理解比特幣市場的基本麵和動態。實証研究表明，加密貨幣在交易方麵具有其獨特性。例如，Griffin and Shams (2020) 髮現在市場下跌後有策略性地購買泰達幣 (Tether) 會導緻比特幣價格大幅上漲。Makarov和Schoar (2020) 表明加密貨幣市場存在大量反複出現的套利機會,特別是在跨國之間。Liu和Tsyvinski (2021) 髮現可以通過加密貨幣市場特定的因素來預測加密貨幣的收益。這些証據表明,比特幣交易者及其信息是獨特的，且對其他金融市場也很有用。 本研究計劃通過提取比特幣期權的信息，研究該信息在加密貨幣和股票市場的預測性。以往的文獻表明，期權市場的投資者更爲成熟和精明，且信息交易者更傾向於在期權市場進行交易。此外，股票期權交易與股票情緒有關，反映了投資者的投機偏好。因此，信息從期權市場傳播到其他市場，導緻了跨市場收益的可預測性。如果比特幣期權吸引了掌握內部信息的投資者或投機於價格變動的投資者，或者反映了投資者情緒，我們預測比特幣的期權信息將對加密貨幣和股票市場的收益存在可預測性。

15500424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15500424.value: 基于数据驱动、领域知识感知以及氢能驱动的电网与交通系统集成规划

15500424.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15500424.value: Prof Cheng, Jianqiang Dr Lim, Yun Fong Prof Shen, Zuo-Jun Max

15500424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15500424.value: This project is motivated by the emerging hydrogen fuel-cell vehicle (HFCV) and clean hydrogen technologies, which, along with the smart grid, form the basis for so-called "hydrogen-driven grid-mobility (HGM) systems." Driven by the global carbon-neutrality mission and public interest in sustainability, both the traditional automakers and high-tech companies are racing to invest in and develop HFCVs, while numerous nations are increasingly harnessing renewable energy from the smart grid to produce clean hydrogen. Such new systems possess two significant features, namely, end-to-end greenness and multi-domain integration, which raise pivotal questions that remain inadequately addressed and harbor substantial potential that often goes unnoticed. First, end-to-end greenness necessitates increasing penetration of renewable energy into the smart grid to generate clean hydrogen through electrolysis and serve an expanding fleet of HFCVs, emitting nothing but water vapor, thereby almost entirely eliminating carbon emissions. Nevertheless, this remarkable feature comes with considerable investment costs and operational uncertainties (i.e., renewable generation intermittency and fluctuations in grid/mobility demands). Second, multi-domain integration establishes a synergistic bridge, connecting the smart grid, hydrogen facilities, and HFCVs. Such synergy can significantly enhance the utilization of renewable energy and expedite the adoption of HFCVs while urgently calling for theoretical studies incorporating domain knowledge. Given these distinctive features, many challenging research questions arise, both at the levels of social planners and operators, specifically when the data is initially limited. First, to initially realize the benefits of end-to-end greenness, how should a social planner determine a robust plan that considers the substantial investment cost, various uncertainties, operational risks, and limited available data, to deploy renewable energy sources, hydrogen plants and stations, and HFCVs? Second, to continuously unlock the synergy between the smart grid, hydrogen facility, and HFCV mobility operators toward a mature development, how can we dynamically optimize the planning and operational decisions while incorporating domain knowledge within each operator? Third, to eventually develop a successful ecosystem contributed by these operators, how can these operators cooperate with each other to effectively coordinate the hydrogen flow, providing both energy and mobility services toward an end-to-end clean and sustainable society? To answer these questions, we develop data-driven domain-aware optimization and game-theoretic models. We obtain profound insights for managing HGM systems, fostering effective interactions among key stakeholders (e.g., the social planner, smart grid operator, hydrogen facility operator, and HFCV mobility operator), and developing practically implementable solutions for them. Our results will eventually help support a greener and smarter society. 该项目受到新兴氢燃料电动汽车（HFCV）和清洁氢技术所驱动。这些技术与智能电网共同构成了氢能驱动下的电网及交通集成系统（HGM）的基础。在全球碳中和使命和公众对社会可持续性日益关注的推动下，传统汽车制造商和高科技公司正争相投资和开发HFCV。同时众多国家也越来越多地利用智能电网的可再生能源来生产清洁氢。 这类新型系统具有两个显著特征，即端到端的绿色性和多领域整合。这俩特征带来了一些关键且尚未得到充分解决的研究问题，并且引出了一些常常被忽视的巨大潜力。首先，端到端的绿色性迫使将更多的可再生能源引入到智能电网中。从而我们可以通过电解过程生成大量的清洁氢来为不断扩大的HFCV车队提供服务。这样的电动汽车仅排放水蒸气，从而几乎完全消除碳排放。然而，这一显著特征伴随着巨大的投资成本和运营不确定性（比如可再生能源的间歇性以及电网/交通需求的波动）。其次，多领域整合这一特点为系统建立了一个协同桥梁，从而连接智能电网、氢能设施和HFCV。这种协同作用可以显著提高可再生能源的利用效率，并加快HFCV的普及。但同时也迫切需要我们针对相关领域知识的理论研究。 针对上述特征，许多具有挑战性的在社会规划者和运营商这俩层面的研究问题逐渐显现。这些问题在系统运行初期时数据有限的情况下尤为突出。首先，为了实现端到端绿色性的好处，社会规划者应如何制定一个考虑了可观投资成本、各种不确定性、运营风险和有限可用数据的稳健计划，从而部署可再生能源、氢能厂和加油站以及HFCV？其次，为了持续挖掘智能电网、氢能设施和HFCV交通运营商之间的协同效应并实现成熟的发展，我们如何动态优化规划和运营决策，同时融入各运营商的领域知识？第三，为了发展由这些运营商所支持的一个成功生态系统，这些运营商如何有效协调氢流，提供能源和交通服务，朝着端到端清洁和可持续社会的目标迈进？ 为了解答这些问题，我们提出了数据驱动的领域感知优化和博弈论模型。我们期望获得管理HGM系统的深刻见解，促进关键利益相关者（例如社会规划者、智能电网运营商、氢能设施运营商和HFCV交通运营商）之间的有效互动，并为他们制定可实际实施的解决方案。我们的成果最终将有助于支持一个更加绿色和智能的社会。

15500624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15500624.value: 人們爲何參與去中心化治理？來自去中心化自治組織（DAOs）的證據

15500624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15500624.value: Society has long taken an interest in decentralized governance such as democratic elections and shareholder voting. However, decentralized governance is often seized by a small group of influentials and elites, which can harm innocent stakeholders. The centralized nature of decentralized organizations can be broken down into two aspects: participants are reluctant or uncapable to govern. To effectively protect the rights and interests of disadvantaged participants, it is important to understand how to incentivize them to join in governance and how to guide them make more reasonable decisions. Blockchain technology presents an excellent opportunity for studying behaviors in decentralized governance. Decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs), driven by blockchain, enable participants to both propose and vote on proposals. These activities are recorded on the blockchain, ensuring transparency and immutability. Examining people’s participation in DAOs help us to understand what can incentivize people to govern. In traditional governance structures, decision-making process is either unobservable (e.g., which shareholders vote for what) or less frequent (e.g., political election). In contrast, blockchain makes it possible to observe the decision-making process of each individual in DAOs. Voting records are visible, and open discussions frequently take place. Therefore, it contains rich data for studying why and how people participate in governance. This study will analyze participant’s behaviors on DAO platforms to evaluate potential factors that may motivate people to join in decentralized governance: (1) distrust in centralized governance and (2) market condition of voting rights. Additionally, this study will also delve into participant demographics, organization profiles, and market conditions to gain a comprehensive understanding of the motivations driving individuals to embrace decentralized governance. The data used in this study includes blockchain transaction data (including proposal records, voting records, and assets transfer), forum discussion texts, and cryptocurrency market data. The research methodology will involve quantitative analysis using blockchain data parsing, textual analysis, cross-sectional regression, and difference-in-differences design. This study aims to provide valuable insights into understanding and improving not only blockchain, but also corporate, political, and legislative governance. The direct benefit is for the blockchain industry, as attracting more people to participate in the governance of the decentralized ecosystem helps restore society's trust in it. This study also benefits corporate governance and democratic elections, which both face the problem of insufficient governance participation. 社會長期以來對於去中心化的治理如民主選舉和股東投票深感興趣。然而，去中心化的治理往往被少數有影響力的精英人士壟斷，這可能會損害無辜的利益相關者。去中心化組織的中心化本質可分為兩個方面:參與者不願意或無能力治理。為了有效地保護弱勢參與者的權利和利益，了解如何激勵他們參與治理，以及如何引導他們作出更合理的決策至關重要。 區塊鏈技術為研究去中心化治理中的行為提供了一個絕佳機會。由區塊鏈驅動的去中心化自治組織(DAO)使參與者能夠提出並對提案進行投票。這些活動都記錄在區塊鏈上，確保透明度和不可改變性。 研究人們在DAO中的參與有助於我們理解什麼可以激勵人們進行治理。在傳統的治理結構中，決策過程要麼無法觀察(例如哪些股東投票支持什麼)，要麼較為罕見(例如政治選舉)。相比之下，區塊鏈使得觀察DAO中每個個體的決策過程成為可能。投票記錄是可見的，開放討論也經常進行。因此，它包含了豐富的數據來研究為什麼和如何參與治理。 本研究將分析參與者在DAO平台上的行為，評估可能激勵人們加入去中心化治理的潛在因素:(1)不信任中心化治理，(2)投票權的市場狀況。此外，本研究還將深入探討參與者的人口統計學資料、組織簡介和市場狀況，以全面了解推動個人擁抱去中心化治理的動機。 本研究使用的數據包括區塊鏈交易數據(包括提案記錄、投票記錄和資產轉移)、論壇討論文本和加密貨幣市場數據。研究方法將涉及使用區塊鏈數據解析、文本分析、橫截面回歸和差分差異設計進行量化分析。 本研究旨在為了解和改進不僅僅是區塊鏈，還有公司、政治和立法治理提供寶貴見解。直接的好處是對於區塊鏈行業，吸引更多人參與去中心化生態系統的治理有助於重建社會對它的信任。這項研究也有利於公司治理和民主選舉，兩者都面臨著參與治理不足的問題。

15500724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15500724.value: 加強中小型餐廳的策略ESG(環境、社會與治理)決策：與非政府組織的綜效

15500724.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15500724.value: Prof Lee, Seoki Prof Sharma, Amit

15500724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15500724.value: Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives have attracted much attention in recent years due to their potential to generate positive environmental and social impact while maintaining satisfactory financial performance. Many state governments and stock exchanges promote such ESG initiatives for publicly traded companies. However, given the importance of the potential impacts of ESG programs, small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) should incorporate ESG initiatives into their daily operations and planning. Yet, SMEs’ ESG initiatives often depend on the business owner’s personal preferences and decisions. Group-level decision-making, that involves various stakeholders on a strategy for ESG initiatives can ensure an SME’s ESG program has a strong strategic focus. Strategic ESG investment can enhance a business’s performance and add value to the enterprise. However, SMEs often lack both the financial and human resources possessed by larger companies, so they may not have the means to support strategic ESG initiatives. In the SME literature, it remains unclear how SMEs can promote ESG initiatives without proper support, as costs will be higher for SMEs and it may be difficult to define the benefits of an ESG initiative. This project proposes to explore a means of overcoming these challenges by examining the effect of collaboration with non-governmental organizations (NGOs). NGOs often focus on and coordinate volunteer support to address particular environmental and social issues. Therefore, collaboration between SMEs and NGOs could potentially synergize the strengths of businesses and organizations to create environmental and social impacts. Accordingly, this project will answer the following research question: How can SMEs collaborate with NGOs to enhance strategic ESG initiatives? Three studies within a mixed-method design will be conducted to answer this research question. Semi-structured interviews with ~45 ESG program adopters in restaurants, who have been working with NGOs, regardless of restaurant size, to identify best practices (Phase 1) and self-reported questionnaire targeting ~400 consumers and ~200 employees (Phase 2) will be conducted to evaluate the information and value of strategic ESG initiatives executed with NGO collaboration. Scenarios will be generated based on the information obtained from various stakeholders through this research and will be used to survey 200 SME restaurant owners and managers to evaluate their willingness to adopt ESG initiatives in collaboration with NGOs (Phase 3). The proposed project will benefit SMEs, local communities, employees, industry associations, the Hong Kong government, and the environment and society in different time frames. 環境、社會及管治（ESG）倡議在近年來因其能夠在保持令人滿意的財務表現的同時，產生積極的環境和社會影響而受到廣泛關注。許多州政府和證券交易所推動上市公司實施這些ESG倡議。然而，鑑於ESG計劃的潛在影響的重要性，中小企業（SMEs）應將ESG倡議納入其日常運營和規劃中。然而，中小企業的ESG倡議往往取決於企業主的個人偏好和決策。涉及各方利益相關者的集體決策可以確保中小企業的ESG計劃具有強大的戰略重點。戰略性的ESG投資可以提升企業的表現並為企業增值。然而，中小企業通常缺乏大公司所擁有的財務和人力資源，因此可能無法支持戰略性的ESG倡議。在中小企業文獻中，尚不清楚中小企業在缺乏適當支持的情況下如何推動ESG倡議，因為對於中小企業來說，成本會更高，並且可能難以界定ESG倡議的效益。本項目提議通過研究與非政府組織（NGOs）合作的效果來探索克服這些挑戰的方法。非政府組織通常專注於並協調志願者支持以解決特定的環境和社會問題。因此，中小企業與非政府組織的合作可能會協同企業和組織的優勢，創造環境和社會影響。因此，本項目將回答以下研究問題：中小企業如何與非政府組織合作以增強戰略性的ESG倡議？ 將進行三項混合方法設計的研究來回答這一研究問題。將對約45名在餐廳中採用ESG計劃並與非政府組織合作的受訪者進行半結構化訪談（第一階段），無論餐廳規模如何，以識別最佳實踐，並將對約400名消費者和約200名員工進行自我報告問卷調查（第二階段），以評估與非政府組織合作執行的戰略性ESG倡議的信息和價值。將根據從各方利益相關者獲得的信息生成情景，並用於調查200名中小企業餐廳業主和經理，以評估他們在與非政府組織合作下採用ESG倡議的意願（第三階段）。擬議的項目將在不同的時間框架內惠及中小企業、當地社區、員工、行業協會、香港政府以及環境和社會。

15501624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15501624.value: 什麼動機會促使旅客在酒店展現環保行為？

15501624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15501624.value: 旅遊業消耗不少能源並產生大量碳排放。儘管許多企業意識到可持續環境的重要性後實施了各種環保計劃，但由於其廣泛的服務和活動，酒店仍然是能源消耗最密集的旅遊設施之一。除了酒店業本身的高能耗特性外，人們在酒店中往往比在家中消耗更多的電力和水。因此，在不犧牲顧客滿意度的情況下，酒店業必須應對這些固有的挑戰並有效地減少碳能源的消耗。 為了解決這個難題，我們需要從顧客的角度理解影響酒店顧客在電力和水消費模式的關鍵因素。酒店業需要了解即使顧客旅行在外，如何鼓勵他們以環保方式使用電力和水。人們通常出於各種原因在家中展現出環保行為，包括情感愉悅、規範信念和經濟激勵；然而，已有大量文獻紀錄表明，即使在旅行時，有些人也願意參與環保實踐。 大多數研究使用自我報告的調查來關注酒店顧客的環保感知和意圖之間的關係；然而，這些感知和意圖往往無法轉化為實際行為。此外，日常生活中的環保感知和動機在旅行和入住酒店時不一定相同。借助先進技術，我們可以實時準確測量酒店客房的電力和水消費，而不是依賴顧客的主觀反饋。然後，我們可以將酒店顧客在日常生活中的環保動機與他們在酒店中的實際電力和水消費模式聯繫起來。這種方法將使我們了解日常生活中的哪些環保動機可以促使顧客在入住酒店時參與環保實踐。 酒店必須減少能源消耗和碳排放，這不僅是為了提高酒店的財務表現，還為了確保子孫後代的可持續性。因此，行業利益相關者和學術研究者都必須承擔起開發、建議和實施可持續節能實踐的責任。本研究的結果將提供理論和實證證據，說明酒店如何（通過加強享樂、規範或收益性目標）鼓勵顧客展現更環保的行為。

15501724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15501724.value: 助推、掌握與漸隱：運用支架式設計的移動健身應用以提升用戶在體力活動中的相對自主性和活力

15501724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15501724.value: Despite the clear benefits of regular physical activity (PA) to human health, achieving consistent physical activity maintenance (PAM) is challenging because of lack of motivation and various other barriers. The failure to meet recommended daily PA levels has become a significant global health issue and a pronounced concern for children and adolescents in Hong Kong. Mobile fitness apps, along with technological advances in artificial intelligence (AI), may facilitate people’s PAM. These apps can provide personalized and professional PA guidance for engaging in and maintaining PA. However, current fitness technologies often fall short of such goals. Researchers have shown a lack of theoretical understanding regarding effective designs that can simultaneously motivate users’ PAM and subjective vitality. In this project, we aim to explore how to design mobile fitness apps to simultaneously improve users’ PAM and subjective vitality. This project draws on scaffolding theory and proposes three scaffolding designs: modeling, progressive reflection, and zone identification to achieve such outcomes. This project involves two major studies utilizing multiple methodologies. The Principal Investigator has collaborated with a start-up company operating a digital health system servicing adolescent exercise in Mainland China. Both studies will recruit participants from our sponsor company’s user base, which encompasses 370,000 students from 300 schools in China. Study 1 will employ a design science study, involving multiple methods to develop and test the effectiveness of the experimental app. We will firstly conduct interviews with users to identify the main obstacles and potential solutions for their PAM and subjective vitality. We will then develop a mobile fitness app with three proposed scaffolding designs and assess the app effectiveness through a survey. Study 1 will provide fundamental knowledge on how the three scaffolding designs can impact the two essential health outcomes. To gain a better understanding of the underlying mechanism involved, Study 2 will include a field experiment by collecting data and manipulating different app versions to confirm the causality and the key mechanism of users’ relative autonomy motivation. To the best of our knowledge, this proposed project will be the first to develop a mobile fitness app using a scaffolding approach and empirically examine the app’s effectiveness in exercise contexts. This project will provide managerially actionable guidelines for designing fitness technologies to scaffold users toward achieving PAM and subjective vitality by boosting their relative autonomy. 盡管規律的體力活動（PA）對人類健康有顯著益處，但保持持續的體力活動（PAM）卻頗具挑戰性。未能達到推薦的每日體力活動量已成為一個全球性的健康問題，尤其是在香港的兒童和青少年中更為突出。移動健身應用結合人工智慧（AI）技術的進步，為促進人們的體力活動和參與積極性帶來了新的希望。這些應用不僅可以提供個性化和專業的PA指導，還有可能激勵用戶參與並保持體力活動。 然而，現有的健康科技仍存在一定的局限性，未能充分發揮這些潛力，鮮有研究從理論上探討如何有效設計，以同時激發用戶在體力鍛煉情境中的兩個重要目標：PAM 和主觀活力。為了填補這一研究空白，本項目基於支架理論，提出了三種移動健身應用的支架式設計：示範、漸進反思和（體力能力的）區域識別，以同時提高用戶的PAM和主觀活力。 本項目涉及兩項主要研究，採用多種研究方法。項目與一家初創公司合作，該公司運營著一個數字健康系統，為中國大陸的青少年體育運動提供服務。項目的參與者將從該平台含中國300所學校的37萬名學生用戶中隨機抽取。研究1將首先訪談現有移動健身應用的不同用戶及合作公司的用戶，以瞭解他們在PAM和主觀活力方面的主要障礙和潛在解決方案。然後我們將利用提議的三種支架式設計開發一款移動健身應用，並通過問卷調查評估用戶對新設計應用的使用體驗，借此為三種支架式設計如何影響PAM和主觀活力提供基礎知識。為了更好地理解其中的影響機制，研究2將進行現場實驗，設計不同的應用版本並收集用戶數據，以驗證用戶相對自主動機（RAM）的關鍵機制和因果關係。 據我們所知，本項目將是第一個基於支架式方法開發移動健身應用，並實證檢驗其在體力鍛煉情境中有效性的項目。該項目將為設計健康科技提供可操作的管理指南，通過提升用戶的相對自主性來同時實現PAM和主觀活力。

15502624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15502624.value: 联盟忠诚计划对顾客消费行为的影响研究

15502624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15502624.value: 联盟忠诚计划把不同的商家组合在一起。顾客从任一公司购买产品，均可获得一张抵扣卷。之后，顾客在任一商家消费，其均可使用该抵扣卷。联盟忠诚计划对顾客购买行为的影响是复杂的。随着联盟忠诚计划成员的增加，顾客在该联盟内消费的概率也会增加，因此抵扣卷过期未用的风险也随着大大降低。如此一来，顾客就不会因为抵扣卷快要过期而匆忙消费，消费意愿降低。但是，从另一方面讲，顾客在该联盟内消费的概率增加，那么抵扣卷被兑换的概率也增加，顾客的效用增加，从而促使顾客更愿意消费。因此，联盟忠诚计划对于顾客行为的影响是比较复杂的，几个研究问题也应运而生。随着越来越多的商家加入该联盟，顾客消费的越来越多，还是越来越少？顾客消费行为的变化会怎么影响联盟内商家的利润？对于那么想实施联盟忠诚计划的商家来说，这些问题显得尤为重要。但是，据我所知，并没有文献研究过此类问题。该研究项目致力于回答这些问题，填补这项空白。 我们考虑一个联盟，该联盟包含n个商家，每个商家出售一种产品，因此一共有n种产品。这n种产品互为替代品，每个顾客每期最多购买1件产品。每一期，顾客去每个商家消费的概率为λ（λ远小于1），因此顾客在该联盟内消费的概率为nλ。顾客对每个产品的估值不是固定的，而是随时间变化的。比如，顾客在这一期对该产品的估值可能较高，更愿意去消费；顾客在下一期对该产品的估值可能会较低，不愿意去消费。顾客从该联盟内任一商家消费，均可获得一张抵扣卷。该抵扣卷可在联盟内任一商家使用。联盟需要决定产品的价格，抵扣卷金额的大小，抵扣卷的有效期，以及联盟成员的数量，从而实现利润最大化的长远目标。 我们首先用动态规划来分析顾客的决策问题，该动态规划的状态是抵扣卷距离到期日的剩余时间。基于顾客的最优决策，我们首先分析在成员数量固定的情况，联盟的最优决策（包括产品价格，抵扣卷金额大小，抵扣卷的有效期），然后再分析成员数量变动对于联盟最优决策及顾客行为的影响。最后，通过跟没有实施任何计划的情况进行对比，我们也会分析联盟忠诚计划能否给商家带来利润上的增加。总的来讲，该项目聚焦于探索联盟忠诚计划如何影响顾客的消费行为，从而为商家实施此类计划提供管理意义上的指导和借鉴。

15502824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15502824.value: 動態分發至多類別並行服务器及信息的價值

15502824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15502824.value: Routing control is a central piece in many engineering and management systems, e.g., allocating processing orders in a machine shop, assigning cases to a panel of lawyers, and a web server routing requests to back-end servers. In this project, we study a queueing system with heterogeneous parallel servers and multiple job classes. Imagine that upon each job arrival, a controller will evaluate the available state information and make decision to dispatch the job to one of the servers. The dynamic state information can be the queue-length state, arrival history or service history, etc., depending on the nature of applications. For example, the web server (the controller) may employ the information about the request (job) arrival history for routing control, while it may be too costly to communicate the servers intensively and retrieve the state information such as the queue length and service history. In this study, we aim to seek the optimal routing policy that employs the available state information. It is well-known that the join-the-shortest-queue and the balanced routing policies achieve the optimal performance asymptotically when the queue-length state is observable. It would be interesting to ask what the optimal routing policy would be when the controller can not observe any dynamic state of the system. Furthermore, we also want to understand the optimal policy when only partial system state information, e.g., the arrival or the service history, can be observed. Answering these questions helps reveal the value of various state information for routing control, which is valuable when modern applications are becoming more and more complicated and new control mechanisms are being examined. However, the dynamic nature of the system under study, coupled with the complicated routing mechanism and arrival and service patterns, make it very difficult to answer these questions through exact analysis. To overcome the difficulty, we will apply an asymptotic approach, the heavy-traffic analysis, which has been used to study a broad range of stochastic processing network systems. The proposed research is timely when the fierce competition is driving many industries to the responsive regime, and effective decision-making tools for real-time resource deployment are becoming increasingly important in the competition. It is our goal to fulfill the industrial needs in this area. 在眾多工程與管理系統中，分發控制舉足輕重，無論是機械加工車間分配加工任務、律師團隊間的案件分派，還是網路伺服器將服務請求導向後端伺服器。本項目聚焦於擁有異質並行伺服器的排隊系統。每當工作抵達，一控制器即根據當前可獲取的動態資訊，如隊列長度、到達或服務歷史等（依應用場景而異），評估並決策工作應派發至何伺服器。例如，網路伺服器或許會參考請求到達歷史進行分發，但頻繁通訊以獲取隊列長度、服務記錄等資訊可能成本高昂。 我們旨在利用現有狀態資訊，探尋最佳分發策略，以最小化平均總隊長，即縮短工作等待時間。已知當隊列長度透明時，「加入最短隊列」與「平衡分發」策略常能達成最優。然而，當控制器無法洞察系統內部動態時，如何制定最佳分發策略成為一項挑戰。更進一步，若僅能獲取部分系統狀態（如到達或服務記錄），最佳策略又將如何？解答這些問題，將深刻揭示不同類型狀態資訊在分發控制中的價值，尤為關鍵於當前管理與工程工作日益複雜化，新控制機制探索不斷的時期。 鑒於系統動態性、分發機制複雜性及到達與服務模式的多變性，精確分析此類問題難度極高。為此，我們將採用漸進式方法——重流量分析，此法已在眾多隨機處理網路系統研究中證明有效。 本研究恰逢其時，行業競爭激烈促使快速響應機制與即時資源部署決策工具的重要性日益凸顯。我們的目標正是響應這一工業需求，為該領域提供有力支持。

15503124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15503124.value: 为什么我们应该尝试升级再造食品？基于特定场景和特定国家的升级再造食品消费的考察

15503124.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15503124.value: Dr LUO, Anqi Prof Mattila, Anna S.

15503124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15503124.value: Food upcycling is a novel method of reducing food waste. For example, Breer, a Hong Kong-based upcycled beer company, uses unsold bread from local bakeries to brew beer. Food upcycling can also provide health benefits. Nestlé, a Swiss-based candy maker, uses leftover white pulp that covers cocoa beans to sweeten dark chocolate without added sugar. Upcycled flour made out of spent grain contains more soluble fibre and protein than conventional wheat four. However, research has shown that the public acceptance of upcycled food is low. Although there is a large body of literature on sustainable food, including organic and plant-based food, the results of our pilot study indicated that people perceived upcycled food differently from other types of sustainable food. We also found in our pilot study that Hong Kong residents had higher levels of awareness and consumption of upcycled food than US residents, making Hong Kong a promising place for expanding the commercialisation of upcycled food. In addition, we found that culture (Western vs Asian) and food category can influence upcycled food purchases. Against this backdrop, the proposed research will address the following questions: (1) Why do people purchase or not purchase upcycled food? (2) How can the acceptance of upcycled food be increased in casual versus upscale restaurants? (3) How can the acceptance of upcycled food be increased in Western and Asian countries? In Study 1, we will address the first question by conducting field surveys and interviews at a conference reception in partnership with Breer. In Study 2, we will address the second question by examining the relative importance of attributes of upcycled food (e.g. price, taste, nutritional benefit, environmental benefit) in casual versus upscale dining contexts. In Study 3, we will address the third question by investigating the relative importance of these attributes of upcycled food in Asian and Western contexts. Choice-based conjoint experiments will be used for Study 2 and 3. Understanding the relative importance of the attributes of upcycled food will help public sectors prioritise the most important attributes to boost public acceptance. Furthermore, the findings on the interaction effect of price and other attributes of upcycled food will help private companies to align their pricing strategy with other attributes of upcycled food. The project will apply and refine the cue utilisation theory by demonstrating the context- and country-specific patterns of the interaction between the intrinsic and extrinsic attributes of upcycled food. 食品升级再利用是一种减少食物浪费的新方法。例如啤酒公司Breer，作为一家总部位于香港的升级再利用公司，它使用了当地面包店未售完的面包来酿造啤酒。食品升级再利用对促进健康也有益处。瑞士糖果制造商雀巢使用可可豆加工剩余的白色果肉代替添加糖来增加黑巧克力的甜味。由酿酒剩余谷物制成的升级再利用面粉比传统小麦粉含有更多的可溶性纤维和蛋白质。 然而，研究表明公众对升级再利用食品的接受度较低。虽然关于可持续食品（包括有机和植物性食品）的文献众多，但是我们的初步研究结果表明，人们对升级再利用食品的看法与其他类型的可持续食品不同。我们还在试点研究中发现，香港居民对升级再利用食品的认知度和消费水平高于美国居民，这使香港更有前景实现扩大升级再利用食品商业化。此外，我们发现文化背景（西方与亚洲）和食品类别会影响升级再利用食品的购买。在此背景下，我们的研究将解决以下问题：(1)人们会出于什么因素选择买或者或不买升级再利用食品？(2) 如何在休闲餐厅和高档餐厅中提高升级再利用食品的接受度？(3) 如何在西方和亚洲国家中提高升级再利用食品的接受度？ 在研究1中，我们将通过与Breer合作，在会议招待会上进行实地调查和访谈，以解决第一个问题。在研究2中，我们将通过研究升级再利用食品的属性（如价格、口味、营养益处、环境益处）在休闲和高档餐饮环境中的相对重要性，以解决第二个问题。在研究3中，我们将通过调查这些属性在亚洲和西方背景下的相对重要性，以解决第三个问题。研究2和研究3将使用基于选择的联合实验。 了解升级再利用食品属性的相对重要性将帮助政府公共部门优先考虑最重要的属性，以提高公众接受度。此外，关于升级再利用食品的价格与其他升级再利用食品属性交互作用的研究结果将有助于私营公司基于升级再利用食品的其他属性制定定价策略。该项目将通过展示升级再利用食品内在属性和外在属性的相互作用的具体情况和具体国家的模式来应用和完善线索利用理论。

15504224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15504224.value: 策展顧客在酒店的ESG體驗：視覺關注對支付意願的影響

15504224.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15504224.value: Prof Han, Heesup Prof QIU, Tianran

15504224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15504224.value: The United Nations first coined the acronym “ESG” to refer to environmental, social, and governance activities, which have since become common in society in general and the hotel industry in particular. ESG is likely to become essential for businesses to maintain their social license, the hotel industry is increasingly committed to ESG initiatives. As a framework that can enable organizations to “do good” and that can render their efforts measurable, ESG creates long-term value in terms of both financial performance, by facilitating growth and productivity, and non-financial performance, by building trust with customers. However, less attention has been paid to how hotel ESG practices can be introduced to and create value for customers. As the tourism context is highly hedonic, encouraging hotel customers to adopt more sustainable, greener, and pro-ESG behaviors is more difficult than in the home context. Thus, our proposed study will design an effective and hedonic method of presenting hotels’ ESG efforts visually to their customers and measuring customer attention to these visual stimuli. This can quantify the impact of visual attention on customer value orientation, which we will assess by their willingness to pay (WTP). Our research design will involve a three-dimensional approach. First, a virtual reality (VR) hotel will be constructed to prototype visual stimuli of ESG practices, using pop-up photos and text through the VR hotel servicescape experience. During the VR hotel tour, participants’ visual attention to each ESG practice will be measured using a VR eye-tracking device. Second, a follow-up questionnaire survey will be conducted to measure the participants’ evaluations of the hedonic VR hotel experience, the WTP choice scenarios with ten ESG attributes, and demographic and travel profiles. To measure their WTP for each ESG attribute, discrete choice experiments will be conducted and a hybrid choice model will be applied to estimate the data and elicit respondents’ heterogeneous values for the various ESG practices. Finally, the eye-tracking and questionnaire data will be combined to investigate the interaction and moderating effects and thereby understand how visual attention in ESG practices can affect hotel customers’ heterogeneous WTP and whether this interaction is moderated by hedonic VR experience and loyalty. The insights obtained will contribute to the literature on pro-environmental behaviors and the marketing strategies of hospitality and tourism organizations, which can be directed at sharing and signaling ESG values to their customers and other stakeholders. 由聯合國首次提出的“ESG”這一縮寫，指的是與環境、社會和治理相關的活動，這已經成為社會，尤其是酒店業的常見說法。隨著ESG成為企業獲得社會認可的必要條件，酒店業也越來越致力於這些實踐。ESG框架使機構能夠“做好事”並使其努力可量化，從而在財務表現（通過促進增長和生產力）和非財務表現（通過建立與顧客的信任）方面創造長期價值。然而，對於如何向顧客介紹酒店的ESG實踐並為其創造價值的關注較少。旅遊情境意味著高度享樂主義，要鼓勵酒店顧客採取更可持續、更環保和支持ESG的行為，自然比在家庭情境更具挑戰性。因此，我們的研究旨在設計一種有效且愉悅的方法，將酒店的ESG努力以視覺方式呈現給顧客，並測量顧客對這些視覺刺激的注意力。這種設計將量化視覺關注對顧客價值取向的影響，並通過他們的支付意願（WTP）來評估。 我們的研究設計涉及三個維度。首先，將構建一個虛擬現實（VR）酒店， ESG實踐以VR酒店服務環境體驗透過彈出照片和文本来呈现，從而形成視覺刺激。在VR酒店之旅中，將使用VR眼動追踪設備測量參與者對每個ESG實踐的視覺注意力。其次，將進行後續問卷調查，並測量參與者對享樂VR酒店體驗的評價、十個ESG屬性的WTP選擇場景，以及人口統計和旅行資料。為了測量他們對每個ESG屬性的WTP，將進行離散選擇實驗，並應用混合選擇模型來估算數據，以引出受訪者對各種ESG實踐的異質偏好。最後，將結合眼動追踪和問卷數據，調查交互和調節效應，從而了解視覺注意度在ESG實踐中如何影響酒店顧客的異質WTP，以及這種交互是否受到享樂VR體驗和忠誠度的調節影响。 通过本研究獲得的見解將有助於環保行為和酒店及旅遊組織的營銷策略研究，还會引導他們向顧客和其他利益相關者如何分享和傳達ESG價值。

15504424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15504424.value: 赋权香港酒店业的华人女性：揭示种族内在挑战并通过导师制促进多元化

15504424.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15504424.value: Dr Jolly, Phillip Dr Rosokha, Lindsay Prof Wilson, Kelly Schwind

15504424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15504424.value: The hospitality industry’s increasing focus on gender diversity and inclusion is shaping female employees’ professional advancement. Leading hospitality companies (e.g., InterContinental) have initiated mentorship programs to bolster female career growth and presence, nurturing a more inclusive workplace. Hong Kong—as a “melting pot” of cultures—presents a unique environment with especially complex gender-related challenges. Many females in Hong Kong, especially the burgeoning population of mainland Chinese females, experience a “double jeopardy” of gender and intra-racial discrimination. The multifaceted nature of this issue underscores the urgency of addressing the intersection of intra-racial and gender-based discrimination within mentorship programs. Employing intersectional invisibility and similarity-attraction theories, the proposed project will develop a comprehensive framework for understanding how gender and intra-racial discrimination shape mentoring outcomes longitudinally for mainland and Hong Kong Chinese female protégés and their mentors in hospitality mentorship programs. Adopting a mixed-methods design that combines in-depth interviews with a longitudinal field study, we will analyze the similarities and dissimilarities at the “surface level” (e.g., gender) and “deep level” (e.g., personalities), showing how they impact mentoring outcomes (i.e., protégé-specific outcomes, mentor-specific outcomes, and mutual interpersonal outcomes for both parties). Study 1 will use interviews to elicit insights from mentors and female protégés in Hong Kong’s hospitality sector. This study will explore (1) the surface- and deep-level characteristics that influence mentorship outcomes for mainland and Hong Kong Chinese female protégés, and (2) the mentorship outcomes of mentors who guide female protégés with mainland and Hong Kong backgrounds. Based on Study 1’s findings, Study 2 will undertake a longitudinal field survey examining how the varying impacts of surface- and deep-level (dis)similarities between mentors and female protégés affect mentoring outcomes over time. Our data collection will involve collaboration with Hong Kong–based personnel from InterContinental, Wyndham Hotels and Resorts, and HeyTea. The project’s outcomes have the potential to yield profound insights into the advancement of female workers, particularly mainland Chinese females, within Hong Kong’s hospitality industry. These findings will have great practical value, as they will empower stakeholders to swiftly adapt and enhance mentorship programs. The implications will extend to government policymaking, aligning with broader efforts to enhance diversity, equity, and inclusion within Hong Kong’s dynamic workforce market. 酒店行业日益重视性别多样性和包容性，正在塑造女性员工的职业发展。很多国际酒店集团（如洲际酒店集团）已启动了导师计划，以促进女性职业成长和影响力，培养更具包容性的工作场所。作为“文化大熔炉”的香港，呈现出独特的环境，尤其在性别相关的挑战上更为复杂。许多在香港的女性，特别是日益增长的中国大陆女性群体，面临着性别和种族内挑战的“双重困境”。这种问题的多面性凸显了在导师计划中处理种族内和性别歧视交集问题的紧迫性。本项目将运用交叉性隐形理论和相似性吸引理论，开发一个综合框架，旨在深入理解性别和种族内歧视如何影响香港女性学员及其在酒店导师计划中的导师的指导结果。 本研究采用混合方法设计，将深入访谈与纵向实地研究相结合，分析“表层”（如性别）和“深层”（如个性）相似性和差异性对导师关系结果（即学员特定的结果、导师特定的结果，以及双方的相互人际关系结果）的影响。研究一将通过访谈获取香港酒店业中导师和女性学员的见解。该研究将探讨（1）影响大陆和香港女性学员导师关系结果的表层和深层特征，以及（2）指导具有大陆和香港背景女性学员的导师的导师关系结果。基于研究一的发现，研究二将进行纵向实地调查，考察导师和女性学员之间表层和深层（不）相似性对导师关系结果随时间变化的影响。该项目的成果有望为推动女性员工，尤其是中国大陆女性在香港酒店行业的职业发展提供深刻见解。这些发现具有重要的实践价值，能够帮助相关利益方迅速调整和改进导师计划。研究的影响力将延伸至政府政策制定，与提升香港多元化、公平性和包容性劳动力市场的广泛努力保持一致。

15505024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15505024.value: 人工智慧賦能小型接待型企業宏微觀生存風險預警、監測與管理框架發展：跨學科視角

15505024.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15505024.value: Prof Li, Gang Dr Yu, Xinbo Prof ZHANG, Chen

15505024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15505024.value: Today’s business environment is increasingly competitive and uncertain, and small hospitality businesses (SHBs) are highly vulnerable. Accurate and timely micro (i.e., individual establishment) and macro (i.e., regional business landscape) survival prediction and monitoring appear essential for increasing employment, economic recovery, business planning, and policymaking. This project will develop an innovative, broadly applicable, and interpretable SHB survival management framework from an interdisciplinary perspective based on state-of-the-art artificial intelligence (AI) technology and a mixed method design. First, based on a thorough literature review and qualitative interviews with SHB owners/managers, this study will identify potential influencing factors of business survival/failure and establish a theoretical framework for SHBs’ survival. Second, a novel and interpretable multisource attention-based deep learning model will be established for individual SHBs prediction and eventually regional survival risk/landscape will be obtained. Third, by taking SHBs in Hong Kong as a sample, corresponding multisource and multimodal data will be gathered and fused to dynamically monitor and predict SHBs’ survival. Lastly, a follow-up qualitative validation study will be conducted based on the survival prediction results. This project is expected to offer meaningful policy and managerial implications for stakeholders including SHB owners, investors, and governments. This project will enhance the interdisciplinary understanding of business survival in several ways. First, it will establish an integrated AI-empowered and real-time micro and macro survival prediction, monitoring, and management framework. This framework will enrich the SHB survival literature through an interdisciplinary lens based on cutting-edge knowledge in business intelligence, computer science, and economics. It will also supplement the traditional one-off prediction approach by building a smart, dynamic, continuous prediction and monitoring system. Second, compared with the current literature’s overreliance on conventional statistical or unexplainable machine learning methods, this project proposes an innovative multisource attention-based deep learning algorithm to realize real-time risk exposure detection and interpretable root causes of business failure. Findings will contribute to the methodological development of business survival prediction, interpretable machine learning toolkits, and their applications in hospitality. Third, this project represents a pioneering effort to incorporate multisource and multimodal data fusion into business survival analysis and prediction; it transcends the single-source/unimodal nature of data in much of the literature. The resulting model will yield more accurate, complete, and uniform business survival information. Findings will guide the creation of a framework to dynamically monitor local SHBs’ rise and fall as well as the regional survival landscape. 現今的商業環境競爭日益激烈，不確定性日益增加，小型接待型企業（SHB）極易受到影響。準確及時地預測和監測微觀（即個人企業層級）和宏觀（即區域層級）的SHB生存對於增加就業、經濟復甦、商業規劃和政策制定至關重要。本計畫將基於最先進的人工智慧（AI）技術和混合方法設計，從跨學科的角度開發一個創新、廣泛適用且可解釋的 SHB 生存管理框架。首先，基於全面的文獻綜述和對 SHB 所有者/管理者的定性訪談，本研究將確定影響企業生存/失敗的潛在因素，並為 SHB 的生存建立一個完善的理論框架。其次，本研究將建立一個新穎且可解釋的基於多源注意力的深度學習模型來預測個體 SHB的生存狀態，並基於此最終獲得區域層面的生存風險模式。第三，以香港的 SHB 為樣本，收集並融合相關的多源和多模態數據，以動態監測和預測 SHB 的生存狀態。最後，將根據生存預測結果進行後續定性驗證研究。該主題預計將為 SHB 所有者、投資者和政府等利益相關者提供有意義的政策和管理建議。 該計畫將透過多種方式增強對企業生存的跨學科理解。首先，它將建立一個完善的基於人工智慧的即時微觀和宏觀的生存預測、監控和管理框架。該框架將透過基於商業智慧、電腦科學和經濟學前沿知識的跨學科視角豐富 SHB 生存文獻。它還將透過建構智慧、動態、連續的預測和監控系統來補充傳統的一次性預測方法。其次，與目前文獻過度依賴傳統統計或無法解釋的機器學習方法相比，該計畫提出了一種創新的基於多源注意力機制的深度學習演算法，以實現即時風險監測以及企業失敗根本原因的可解釋性。本研究結果將有助於豐富企業生存預測的理論和文獻，可解釋機器學習的方法論發展及其在接待業的應用。第三，相較於以往許多文獻中資料的單源/單模態性質，本研究開創性的將多源與多模態資料整合納入企業的生存分析與預測中，而由此產生的模型將能夠更準確的反映和預測企業的生存狀態。本研究結果將指導創建一個框架，以動態監控當地 SHB 的興衰以及區域SHB生存格局。

15505324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15505324.value: 科技遇上人性：通過虛擬人物驅動的元宇宙旅遊體驗提升老年人福祉

15505324.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15505324.value: Prof Back, Ki-Joon Prof Chon, Kaye

15505324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15505324.value: Global ageing presents multi-faceted challenges to society, necessitating urgent attention to the well-being of older adults. The problem is particularly acute in densely populated cities such as Hong Kong, where high living costs, limited space, and a fast-paced lifestyle often undermine the well-being of older adults. Simultaneously, traditional support structures are being strained by changing family dynamics and societal shifts, demanding innovative solutions. However, there is a noticeable gap in addressing these challenges, especially in utilising technological advancements to do so. Novel approaches are needed to bridge this gap and enhance the quality of life for older adults. The proposed project will draw on the PI’s commitment to technology and humanity, combining cutting-edge technologies with human-centred approaches to promote inclusive travel and well-being. Avatar-enabled metaverse travel presents a world of potential for enhancing the well-being of older adults. This form of virtual exploration offers not only novelty and excitement without physical constraints and financial barriers but also nurtures meaningful social connections through interactions with avatar tour guides and other users. These immersive, engaging experiences can be tailored to individual preferences and abilities, ensuring inclusive and enriching engagement for older adults and contributing to their well-being and successful ageing. The proposed project aims to capitalise on avatar-enabled metaverse travel as a novel means of enhancing the well-being of older adults. Informed by the Senior Technology Acceptance Model (STAM) and Successful Ageing Theory, the project will comprise three cohesive stages. Stage 1 will concentrate on understanding the unique needs and desires of older adult users through user experience workshops. Stage 2 will analyse real-time emotional responses using multi-modal, multi-label deep learning emotion analysis. Stage 3 will conduct a longitudinal study to assess the long-term effects of avatar-enabled metaverse travel on overall well-being and successful ageing. The proposed research is set to make significant contributions to theory, methodology, and practice. Theoretically, integrating the STAM and Successful Ageing Theory will create a novel, multi-faceted framework emphasising the convergence of gerontechnology adoption with ageing studies. Methodologically, the research will pioneer an innovative approach by seamlessly blending multi-modal, multi-label deep learning emotion analysis with longitudinal evaluation. This methodology will allow the examination of both the immediate and sustained effects of virtual engagement on the well-being of older adults. Practically, the project will benefit older adults, physically challenged individuals, healthcare providers, policymakers, technology engineers, and the tourism industry, marking a progressive step towards inclusive travel. 全球老齡化對社會提出了多方面的挑戰，迫切需要關注老年人的福祉。這一問題在如香港這樣的人口稠密城市尤為嚴峻，高昂的生活成本、有限的空間以及快節奏的生活方式往往削弱了老年人的福祉。與此同時，隨著家庭結構和社會變遷的變化，傳統的支持系統面臨著巨大的壓力，亟需創新的解決方案。然而，當前在應對這些挑戰方面存在顯著的缺口，特別是在利用技術進步方面。填補這一空白並提升老年人的生活質量，需要新的創新方法。 本項目計劃依托首席研究員對科技與人文的雙重承諾，將前沿技術與以人為本的方法相結合，以促進包容性旅行。虛擬化身驅動的元宇宙旅行為提升老年人的福祉提供了嶄新的可能性。這種虛擬探索不僅能夠打破物理限制和財務障礙，帶來新奇和興奮，還通過與虛擬導遊及其他用戶的互動促進有意義的社交聯繫。這些沉浸式和引人入勝的體驗能夠根據個別需求和能力進行調整，確保老年人能夠參與到包容且充實的活動中，從而促進他們的福祉和成功老齡化。 本項目旨在利用虛擬化身驅動的元宇宙旅行作為提升老年人福祉的一種創新手段。在高齡科技接受模型（STAM）和成功老齡化理論的指導下，該項目將分為三個階段進行。第一階段將通過用戶體驗工作坊深入了解老年用戶的獨特需求和期望。第二階段將運用多模態、多標籤深度學習情感分析技術來實時分析情感反應。第三階段將進行縱向研究，評估虛擬化身驅動的元宇宙旅行對老年人整體福祉及成功老齡化的長期影響。 本研究將對理論、方法學及實踐領域作出顯著貢獻。在理論層面，將STAM與成功老齡化理論的結合，構建一個創新的多層次框架，突顯老齡科技採用與老齡化研究的交匯點。在方法學層面，研究將創新地融合多模態、多標籤深度學習情感分析（第二階段）與縱向評估（第三階段），進行對老年人福祉的即時與持續影響的深入分析。在實踐層面，該項目的成果將惠及老年人、身心障礙者、醫療服務提供者、政策制定者、技術工程師及旅遊業界，為推動包容性旅行邁出重要一步。

15505524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15505524.value: 回收认证机制设计和绿色产品竞争

15505524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15505524.value: The adoption of recycled materials in manufacturing processes has become increasingly important in today's business world. Promoting recycled materials plays a vital role in mitigating environmental crises and establishing a sustainable, circular economy. Nowadays, more and more consumers have concerns about the utilization of recycled materials in the products they purchase, and many are willing to pay more for products that contain recycled materials. This shift has led to active competition among firms regarding the use of recycled materials. However, utilizing recycled materials is not trivial. Different firms face distinct challenges and costs when investing in recycling technologies. Moreover, they also need to use credible recycled labels provided by third-party certifiers to convey the efforts of adopting recycled materials. There are two major types of recycled labels across various industries: 1) A continuous label that directly displays the percentage of recycled content used in a product, from which consumers know the exact fraction of recycled content; 2) A binary label that sets a minimum standard for the adoption of recycled content and implements a pass/fail criterion, from which consumers only know whether the percentage of recycled content meets the standard or not. The main purpose of this proposed project is to investigate how different recycled label designs affect competing firms' incentives to adopt recycled materials and their pricing strategies. We will also study their impacts on consumer surplus and social welfare. To this end, we will build a stylized model, in which a label certifier determines whether to offer a continuous or binary recycled label. Then two competing firms decide the percentage of recycled materials and prices for their own products, depending on the label scheme and their cost efficiency of recycling. A fraction of consumers values recycled content and is willing to pay more for the product that contains it. However, they cannot directly observe the percentage of recycled content in a product; instead, they can perceive this information from the label issued by the certifier. We will investigate the firms' decisions and profits under each label scheme and then study the certifier's optimal label choice. Moreover, we will explore some possible model extensions to verify the robustness of our main results and derive additional results. This project will yield valuable insights with practical managerial implications for both label certifiers (i.e., governments or non-governmental organizations) and firms who have concerns regarding recycled materials. 在当今的商业制造过程中采用再生材料变得越来越重要。推广再生材料对缓解环境危机和建立可持续的循环经济起着至关重要的作用。如今，越来越多的消费者关心产品中是否使用了再生材料，许多人愿意为含有再生材料的产品支付更高的价格。这一现象导致了企业在使用再生材料方面的积极竞争。然而，使用再生材料并非易事。不同的企业在投资回收技术时面临着不同的挑战和成本。此外，企业通常还需要使用由第三方认证机构提供的可信回收认证标签。在各个行业中，有两大类常见的回收认证标签: (1) 连续形标准：直接显示产品中使用的再生材料的百分比，使消费者能够了解确切的再生材料含量比例； (2) 二元形标准：设定采用再生材料的最低标准，并实施通过/不通过的形式，以此消费者只能知道再生材料的百分比是否达到最低标准。该科研项目旨在研究不同回收认证标签设计对竞争企业采用再生材料和定价策略的影响，以及对消费者剩余和社会福利的影响。为此，我们将构建一个模型，在其中标签认证提供者决定提供连续形或者二元形回收标签。其后，两家竞争公司根据标签形式和各自的回收成本效率，决定其产品中回收材料的使用比例和产品价格。一部分消费者关心产品中的回收成分，并愿意为此支付更高的价格。然而，他们无法直接了解到产品中回收成分的比例，但是他们可以通过回收标签认证来获取这方面的信息。我们将研究在不同标签形式下公司做出的决策以及获得的利润，并研究认证者的最优标签选择。此外，我们将探索一些可能的模型扩展，以验证核心结果的稳健性并推导其他相关结果。该项目将为标签认证者（即政府和非政府组织）以及关注回收材料的企业提供具有实际管理意义的宝贵见解。

15506424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15506424.value: 敢于倡导：女性企业家在社交媒体上对性别平等的倡导以及对她们融资成功的影响

15506424.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15506424.value: Prof Ji, Xiaode Prof LI, Yijing Prof Little, Laura

15506424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15506424.value: 创业融资是一个男性主导的领域，存在严重的性别不平等。响应对创业领域性别平等倡导的呼吁，女性企业家也积极提倡性别平等，使用Twitter 等社交媒体平台来发声。然而，这些女性企业家倡导者可能无意中面临减少融资机会的惩罚，因为他们挑战了该领域的现状。我们的研究旨在探讨女性企业家在社交媒体上的性别平等倡导如何影响她们的融资成功。我们旨在提供理论知识和可操作的策略，以减轻女性企业家倡导者面临的融资惩罚，推动创业领域的性别平等事业。 结合有关性别、创业和社交媒体的管理研究，我们提出，尽管女性企业家在社交媒体上的性别平等倡导可能会降低她们的在线支持，从而影响融资成功，但不利影响可以通过三种方式得到缓解。首先，女性企业家可以采用鼓舞性而不是批判性的倡导方式。其次，女性企业家可以采用再分类形象管理策略，削弱她们的倡导对在线支持的负面影响。换句话说，在线展示创业能力，融入男性化生活方式，同时最大程度减少女性化生活方式，使她们在创业融资社区中更受接受和有影响力。第三，培养一个具有高文明行为水平或高性别平等倡导水平的在线创业融资社区，将加强在线支持对融资成功的正面影响。 我们计划采用混合方法来测试我们的假设。主要研究将利用 Pitchbook（2009-2023 年）的创业者和投资者数据库的档案数据。根据 Pitchbook，我们构建了 1,479 个美国女性企业家的 Twitter 账户样本和 18,576 个 Twitter 账户的在线创业融资社区。我们将使用推文和评论来构建自变量、中介变量和调节变量，使用 Pitchbook 来构建与融资相关的因变量和控制变量。我们将通过额外的定性和实验研究来解决因果关系和内生性问题。 我们的研究通过聚焦在社交媒体上的性别平等倡导场景以及关注一个高度男性主导的创业行业，来对性别研究做出贡献，增进我们对女性专业形象管理的理解。我们的研究还通过提供以理论驱动和以证据为基础的解决方案，来改善创业领域的性别平等，为创业研究和实践做出贡献。

15506624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15506624.value: 數字時代下的公司邊界

15506624.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15506624.value: Prof Hasan, Iftekhar Prof Zhang, Xiaoquan (Michael )

15506624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15506624.value: Information technology (IT) is playing an increasingly important role in corporations. Among the 4,410 PwC (2023) surveyed CEOs, 69% are considering increasing their digital investment. We study a fundamental issue of how IT affects firm boundaries. The first challenge is to incorporate dissimilar findings into a unified framework. Research evidence is inconclusive on IT and a firm’s business coverage. While early research indicates a negative correlation (Brynjolfsson et al., 1994), recent papers suggest the contrary (Chen and Kamal, 2016; Brynjolfsson, Jin, and Wang, 2023). We reconcile the inclusive findings emphasizing the dissimilar roles that IT serves within a firm. Under the framework of theory of the firm, we propose 1) IT that facilitates internal coordination and 2) IT that improves input measurement lower the cost of integration, leading to wider firm boundaries, whereas 3) IT that smoothens external coordination reduces the benefit of integration and shrinks firm boundaries. We test the hypotheses with detailed establishment-level corporate IT data. The second challenge is measuring firm boundaries. Literature mainly uses size proxies. We employ multiple data sources to calculate a firm’s geographical, alliance, innovation, and product boundary to provide a comprehensive reflection of a firm’s vertical and horizontal span of a business. For causal inference, we tackle the endogeneities in a firm’s IT status with instrumental variables (IV). The first IV captures the broadband internet coverage and speed of the locality of each firm establishment. We also construct a second IV that leverages on the regional and industrial corporate investment commonality. To further sharpen the identification results, we exclude firm establishments with recent relocation records, which assures the findings are not driven by firms’ endogenous location choice. The anticipated results show IT that serves different purpose have dissimilar influence on firm boundaries. In particular, internal coordination IT and input measurement IT increase firm boundaries, but external coordination IT decreases firm boundaries. The findings contribute to corporate IT research and theory of the frim literature. They also allow us to envision and better understand the future of organizations in the digital age. Corporate executives and chief technology officers (CTOs) can directly learn from our research findings in aligning IT investment with their business expansion strategies. Besides, as the changing firm boundaries has anti-trust and labor income implications, the competition authorities, as well as job and social security authorities are also potential beneficiaries. 信息技術（IT）在企業中扮演著日益重要的角色。在普華永道公司2023年發布的覆蓋4,410位首席執行官的調查中，69％受訪者正在考慮增加數字化投資。在此背景下，本項目研究信息技術如何影響公司邊界的基本問題。 本研究面臨的第一個挑戰，是將研究發現的不同基本事實整合到一個統一的框架中。關於信息技術與公司業務邊界的關系，研究證據並不一致。早期研究表明兩者負相關（Brynjolfsson等，1994），而最近的論文則提出相反的觀點（Chen和Kamal，2016；Brynjolfsson、Jin和Wang，2023）。我們強調不同類型信息技術在公司內部作用存在差異，進而協調上述不一致的研究發現。在公司理論的框架下，我們提出如下假說：1）促進內部協調的信息技術和2）改善要素投入測量的信息技術，可以降低整合成本，進而擴大公司邊界，而3）促進外部協調的信息技術，弱化了整合的收益，從而縮小了公司邊界。在此基礎上，我們利用詳細的網點級信息技術數據檢驗上述假說。 本研究的第二個挑戰是公司邊界的度量。文獻主要使用公司規模作為代理變量。我們利用多個數據來源，計算公司的地理、聯盟、創新和產品邊界，從而全面反映公司業務的垂直和水平邊界。 我們利用工具變量法解決公司信息技術水平中的內生性問題，從而進行因果識別。第一個工具變量捕捉了每個公司網點所在地區的寬帶互聯網覆蓋率和速度。我們還基於區域和行業公司投資的相關性，構建了第二個工具變量。為了進一步提高因果識別的準確性，我們排除了最近有搬遷記錄的公司網點，以確保研究結果並非由公司內生的位置選擇所驅動。 預期的結果將顯示不同用途的信息技術，對公司邊界產生了不同的影響。具體而言，內部協調用途的信息技術和要素投入測量用途的信息技術會增加公司邊界，而外部協調用途的信息技術會降低公司邊界。這些發現為企業信息技術研究和公司理論做出了貢獻，同時有助於我們設想並理解數字時代下組織結構的未來。 企業高管和首席技術官可以直接從我們的研究結果中獲益，從而更好的協調信息技術投資與業務擴張戰略。此外，公司邊界的變化對反壟斷和勞動收入具有明確的影響，所以競爭當局以及就業和社會保障當局也可能成為潛在的受益者。

15507724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15507724.value: 提升運營效率與韌性的魯棒柔性結構設計

15507724.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15507724.value: Dr Chen, Li Prof Sim, Melvyn

15507724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15507724.value: 在供應鏈管理中，有效地匹配供應與需求是一個持續的優先考量。然而，由於風險的存在，管理的複雜性也在增長，尤其是在當前需求模式波動且供應中斷難以預見的商業環境中，例如貿易戰或烏克蘭衝突後的石油危機等。 過程柔性指的是生產系統能夠在時間、精力或成本損失最小的情況下響應或適應變化，为供应量风险管理提供了一個重要的視角。戰略設計中的「長鏈」配置顯示，一個設計良好的稀疏系統可以通過具成本效益的風險共擔達到與完全彈性相當的效果，尤其是當產品需求在隨機上獨立時。這激勵了設計稀疏但高效的彈性配置。 基於之前通過漸近分析研究長鏈系統韌性的研究，本項目旨在研究設計靈活配置，以實現操作效率和在面對不利事件引起的中斷時的韌性。為此，我們提出了一個兩階段的分布魯棒優化（DRO）模型，用於在供應中斷不確定性和需求模糊性（隨機獨立）下優化靈活配置。方法論挑戰來自於兩階段DRO問題固有的計算複雜性以及處理不同產品隨機需求間的獨立性。為了解決這些建模和計算挑戰，我們將通過探索現有和提出新的決策規則來推進DRO文獻。此外，我們打算使用指數錐規劃來建模不確定參數之間的隨機獨立性。

15507924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15507924.value: 私人公司的社群媒體是否會影響上市公司的投資決策？

15507924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15507924.value: 社群媒體的日益普及極大地改變了企業的資訊環境。社群媒體不僅為公司向資本市場傳達訊息提供了新的管道，而且使個人能夠創建和傳播自己的內容，這些內容可以增加有關公司營運的訊息。最近的研究發現，領先的招聘和社交媒體網站的員工評論揭示了有關公司的基本資訊。學術研究和軼事證據都表明，高階主管在做出重要的公司決策時會閱讀員工的評論。對於對私人企業感興趣的外部人士來說，員工評價尤其有價值，因為私人企業的公共資訊來源有限。我們認為，高階主管有動力從私人產業同行員工發布的評論中提取有價值的訊息，並在投資決策中使用這些資訊。 我們預測，上市公司的投資與私人產業同業員工在上發布的商業前景預測呈正相關。我們將使用 社群媒體的數據來實證檢驗這個假設。我們的實證分析將控制相關特徵，例如焦點公司及其上市同行的成長機會、獲利能力和現金流，以及焦點公司及其上市同行員工發布的業務前景預測。對於橫斷面分析，我們預測，對於投資機會較大、公共資訊環境較弱的產業、對於私人企業投資強度相對重要的產業，私人同行前景預測對上市公司投資的影響更為明顯。生產的情況，以及私營和公共同行僱員的前景預測存在較大差異的行業。總體而言，我們希望提供證據，證明上市公司經理從私人同行員工的社群媒體貼文中學習如何做出投資決策。

15508224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15508224.value: 新領導如何逐漸獲得地位？新領導入職轉型期間地位獲取的動態研究

15508224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15508224.value: 「在組織中晉升到第一個正式領導職位是對任何領導者來說，都是最大、最困難的轉變之一」（Gentry et al., 2014: 1）。事實上，大約 40% 的新領導者在上任後的前 18 個月都失敗了（Bradt et al., 2011）。新領導者的失敗和表現不佳不僅影響新領導者自身也降低了身邊每個人的績效。 我們將新領導者定義為第一次承擔團隊領導角色的個體。新領導可以是從內部提拔的團隊成員、來自同一組織但某個團隊之外的個人、或來自外部組織。以往對新領導人的研究主要集中在兩個問題上。第一，研究者探究了新領導者如何帶來改變以及這些變革如何影響企業績效。這些研究主要關注公司一把手並使用二手檔案資料。第二個重點是員工對新領導是如何反應的。例如，員工可能對於前任領導離職有負面情緒，這使得他們對新領導人的信任產生了不利影響。 然而，我們對領導者入職轉型期的理解仍處於嬰兒階段。首先，我們對新領導者在新環境中對他人施加影響力的過程，尤其是其行為和心理機制缺乏了解。第二，轉型是一個動態的過程，而先前的研究未能告訴我們隨著時間的推移，新領導者如何發展或建立他們在成員中的影響力。一項對於588名高管的全球調查顯示，近 60% 的新領導花了六個月的時間——而近 20% 的新領導花了九個多月的時間——才在新崗位產生全面影響。過渡時期到底發生了什麼仍然是一個黑箱。我們這項研究的主要目的是通過縱向檢視新領導者過渡期間的動態，從而推動領導者轉型的文獻。我們整合了地位獲得理論和領導研究，提出新領導者可以通過展示不同的行為（道德、改變和虐待）從而透過強制力、能力和美德這三條路徑來獲得地位。另外，我們提出不同的獲得地位途徑在不同時期的作用不同——強制主導路線可能會在初期更有效，但穩定性較差；而能力路線則較穩定，更有可能使成員心目中的新領導地位達成一致。最後，我們預測過渡期間的地位取得和一致性將影響新領導者的長期成功。 我們已成功確保從一家大型中國乳製品製造和分銷企業收集數據的機會，能夠追蹤足夠多新領導者的來研究他們在過渡期間的動態。我們計劃利用多次問卷調查進追蹤他們的動態，並配合二手檔案資料探查領導者獲得地位的後果。這項研究將大大豐富領導者的轉變和地位獲得方面的文獻。它還將為新領導人和組織如何幫助新領導轉型提供重要的實用建議。

15509724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15509724.value: 透過視聽線索激發多感官意象：像素中的觸覺、味覺和香氣

15509724.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15509724.value: Prof Gu, Flora Fang Prof Lim, Kai H

15509724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15509724.value: 在現今數碼環境中，品牌需應對如何利用Instagram和TikTok等平台上的視聽內容來傳達產品感官特質的挑戰，尤其是那些透過觸覺、味覺或嗅覺最佳體驗的產品。視覺溝通雖主導數碼領域，但其他感官體驗卻常被忽略。現有文獻對視聽提示如何轉化為整體感官體驗的研究有限。本研究將探討視聽提示在數碼平台上增強感官體驗的能力，使消費者能在這些平台上虛擬體驗原本無法感受的感官感受。 我們基於跨模態對應理論，提出了一個研究模型。本研究模型提出視頻內容中的三個關鍵視聽提示：語義提示、間接體驗和感官增強。這些提示在引發跨模態意象方面發揮核心作用，即一個感官刺激能引發另一個感官的感受。本研究將深入探討這些提示如何克服數碼平台的感官限制，並研究內容情感層面如何影響視聽提示的效力。 我們將運用先進的人工智能技術，分析從1,000個品牌收集的200,000多個Instagram視頻，這些品牌的產品高度依賴多感官體驗。AI框架結合對比學習和編碼器-解碼器轉換模型，旨在解讀視頻的視覺和聽覺元素，找出關鍵視聽提示。在群體層面，計量經濟學分析將評估這些提示對消費者跨模態意象的影響，這將反映在他們的評論中。在個體層面，配備眼動追蹤的實驗將排除其他機制，闡明視聽刺激如何影響注意力和跨模態意象。 這項研究首度探討視聽提示在增強線上感官體驗中的作用，預計將對資訊系統、行銷及認知神經科學領域做出重要理論貢獻，闡明視聽刺激促進跨模態意象的機制。透過AI技術評估和解讀視聽內容，本研究為未來研究開闢新方法途徑，並為品牌、平台運營商和內容創作者提供設計具深刻共鳴與沉浸式跨模態體驗的策略。
