15510024.value: 电影体验会影响后续的零售消费吗？来自一家生活方式和零售集团的证据 电影体验会影响后续的零售消费吗？来自一家生活方式和零售集团的证据 电影体验会影响后续的零售消费吗？来自一家生活方式和零售集团的证据 电影体验会影响后续的零售消费吗？来自一家生活方式和零售集团的证据

15510024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15510024.value: Our research explores the connection between movie-watching experiences and subsequent retail behavior. Leveraging a unique and extensive dataset from a prominent retail conglomerate that tracks consumer activities within shopping malls, we address these key questions: 1. How does a movie-watching experience influence subsequent retail behavior? 2. How do these effects vary across different types of movies and across different individuals? 3. Are the subsequent retail actions impulsive in nature, or do they merely precipitate inevitable future purchases? To answer these questions, we began by developing measurements to gauge the customer experience when watching movies, utilizing movie plot data and machine learning techniques. We then examine the relationship between these measurements and customer purchase decisions while controlling for various confounding factors and mitigating endogeneity using econometric methods. Our findings reveal that individuals exposed to movies with lower emotional resolution are more inclined to visit major hypermarkets or supermarkets afterward, aligning with predictions from coping theory. Additionally, we find that the effect is stronger for highly-rated movies and for female customers. To fortify our conclusions, we plan to conduct lab experiments and expand our research to encompass additional movie-related metrics. Our research has the potential to inform strategies such as targeted coupon distribution within malls and coordinated movie scheduling, benefiting businesses, marketers, and policymakers. 我们的研究探索了看电影的体验与后续零售行为之间的关系。我们使用了一份来自某知名零售集团的独特且庞大的数据集，该数据集跟踪了消费者在购物中心内的活动。我们重点关注以下几个关键问题：1. 看电影的体验如何影响后续的零售行为？2. 这些影响在不同类型的电影和不同人群中是否有所不同？3. 后续的零售行为是冲动性的，还是仅仅加速了未来不可避免的购买？ 为了回答这些问题，我们首先开发了衡量顾客看电影体验的方法，使用了电影情节数据和机器学习技术。接着，我们在控制各种混杂因素的情况下，使用计量经济学方法缓解内生性，研究了这些衡量标准与顾客购买决策之间的关系。研究发现，观看情感结局较弱电影的顾客更倾向于随后光顾大型超市或超级市场，这与应对理论的预测一致。我们还发现，这一效应在高评分电影和女性顾客中更为显著。为进一步验证我们的结论，我们计划进行实验室实验，并扩展研究范围，涵盖更多与电影相关的指标。我们的研究有望为商场内的目标优惠券分发和电影排片协调等策略提供依据，从而为企业、营销人员和政策制定者带来益处。

15511024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15511024.value: 酒店组织设计与绩效：组织敏捷性和创新导向之作用

15511024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15511024.value: 对于任何企业而言，其设计和组织方式对其成功都至关重要。一家公司的组织设计包括其战略、结构、流程、人员和激励机制。在新型冠状肺炎病毒疫情爆发以后，酒店业在应对前期被迫休假、后期重新招聘困难、收入来源转变等众多挑战的过程中经历了巨大的变化。如能充分了解疫情期间酒店的组织设计如何受到影响，将有助于识别企业在这一特殊阶段面对的问题，并帮助它们在不断变化的商业环境和未来可能的危机中生存下去。本研究的第一个目标是探索酒店的组织设计在疫情期间如何变化、以及它们在今后将如何继续发展。 作为组织设计的五大基本要素之一，组织结构专注于工作任务的组织方式。面对疫情，酒店在组织结构上经历了重大变化。在任何危机中，组织的敏捷性对企业都至关重要，因为这一概念将企业视为能够灵活迅速地将资源分配到最需要的地方的有机体。在本研究中，我们旨在探究组织结构如何影响酒店的敏捷性和绩效，以及酒店敏捷性在其结构与绩效关系中所扮演的角色（第二个研究目标）。此外，酒店对新想法的开放程度，即创新导向，被认为是酒店在不断变化的环境中、特别是在危机期间和之后取得成功的关键。因此，本研究的第三个研究目标是检验酒店的创新导向对组织结构与敏捷性之间关系、以及对敏捷性与绩效之间关系的影响。 建立在团队成员最近完成和正在进行的研究基础上，本研究旨在全面理解多功能型企业（如酒店）的组织设计自重大危机爆发以后如何演变，以及这种演变在以后将如何持续。本研究将采用混合研究方法，其中定性研究部分将通过深入访谈酒店企业集团层面和酒店层面的高管来实现第一个目标。为了实现第二和第三个研究目标，我们将通过定量研究方法收集和分析来自于400多位酒店经理的数据。研究的结果将不仅对组织设计、组织结构和组织绩效的相关理论做出贡献，而且能为酒店企业、行业协会和其他相关组织的实践提供有益的指导与借鉴。

15511224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15511224.value: 在職場對同事說「不」：拒絕協助請求的後果

15511224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15511224.value: In 2021, Adam Grant, a Wharton Professor and the author of “Give and Take”, posted on X (formerly known as Twitter) “Saying no is not letting others down. It’s standing up for yourself.” As an advocate for productive generosity, Grant believes in the need to say “No” when necessary. The necessity of assertive refusal is also highlighted in “The Power of Saying No!” by Vanessa Patrick, as well as in numerous articles published in the Harvard Business Review (e.g., Knight, 2015; Tulgan, 2020). Underlying these recommendations is the (untested) assumption that help request rejection (i.e., declining to provide help in response to a request from others) could be beneficial to employees at work. However, the existing literature has overlooked the consequences of help request rejection. Without a comprehensive understanding of the consequences of declining to provide help at work, theorists and practitioners run the risk of recommending strategies for help decision that might unintentionally hurt employees. Drawing on identity threat theory (Petriglieri, 2011), we question the prevailing notion that help request rejection benefits the request recipients and examine whether and when rejecting help requests might lead to a psychological burden (i.e., prosocial identity threat), which predicts downstream work-related consequences, including public helping, private helping, and task performance. We also propose helping pressure and helping identity as important boundary conditions that amplify the negative repercussions of help request rejection, and explore whether a self-compassion intervention could mitigate these adverse effects. We have conducted one field study to test part of the conceptual model. To address the limitations in this field study, we plan to conduct two more studies. In a scenario-based experiment, we will establish the causal effect of help request rejection and control for several alternative mechanisms. In a 10-week experimental experience sampling study, we will further explore whether a self-compassion intervention could serve as an effective buffer against the psychological burden associated with help request rejection. With these studies, our goal is to caution employees about the negative consequences of saying “no” at work and provide solutions for employees to manage the discomfort associated with saying “no”.

15511424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15511424.value: 適用於多產品合併運輸機制的機器學習庫存控制方法

15511424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15511424.value: We consider the problem of a firm that sells multiple products with unknown correlated demand and has to learn the demand information and make online inventory decisions. A distinctive feature of our problem, which is common in e-commerce but has not been considered in existing stochastic inventory control literature, is that the firm uses consolidated shipping to deliver products. That is, the firm will ship all items requested by the same order via one package if they are all available, but may have to split into multiple sequential shipments otherwise. This feature provides the firm a incentive to adjust its inventories to synchronize the sales of multiple products to enjoy the benefit of consolidated shipping. However, it also leads the inventory decisions of different products to be interrelated and greatly complicates the joint optimization problem. We consider a two-product model where customers arrive according to Poisson processes and may demand either or both products. We formulate the firm's problem for four possible cases with whole order or demand of unavailable items backlogged or lost. When the firm has full demand information, we will analyze the structural properties of the problem and derive the optimal inventory policy. When the demand information is unknown, the firm must learn it from sales data collected during operations, which introduces a tension between exploration (information learning) and exploitation (cost minimization) into the decision process. The more time a firm spends learning the information, the less time remains for it to minimize the cost. In contrast, if a firm spends less time on learning, it is more likely to make a sub-optimal decision in the exploitation stage. We will develop machine learning-based algorithms for the firm to learn demand information and make its inventory decisions on-the-fly as demand arrives over time. The algorithms will help the firm to identify optimal base-stock policies that strike the balance among different costs and between exploration and exploitation. To the best of our knowledge, this study will be one of the first attempts to introduce the consolidated shipping feature to stochastic inventory management problems, whether the demand information is known or unknown. Thus, the project will make significant contribution to both inventory and machine learning research. The finding will have practical applications in inventory management and can help firms improve their operational efficiency. 我們研究公司在需求具有相關性且未知的情況下的多產品庫存管理問題；該公司需要通過學習需求信息來做出在綫庫存決策。我們的問題的一個有別於現有研究的特徵是公司盡可能地使用合併運輸來交付產品。此特徵在電子商務中很常見，但卻未被現有的隨機庫存控制文獻所考慮。在合併運輸策略下，如果一個顧客訂單中的所有商品都有庫存，公司只需通過一個包裹即可把整單商品發送；但如果部分商品缺貨，則可能需要分成多個運單先後發貨。這一特徵促使公司調整庫存決策以使相關產品的庫存量能在銷售過程中同步變化，從而享受合併運輸節省成本的好處。然而，這也導致不同產品的庫存決策互相關聯，使聯合優化問題變得更加複雜。 我們考慮一個兩產品銷售模型，其中顧客按照泊松過程到來，每位顧客可能需求一種或兩種產品。我們針對四種可能的情況構建了公司的問題，即整個訂單或僅缺貨商品的需求被積壓或丟失。當公司擁有完整的需求信息時，我們將分析問題的結構特性並推導出最優庫存策略。 當需求信息未知時，公司必須從運營中所收集的銷售數據學習相關信息；這給決策過程引入了探索（信息學習）與利用（成本最小化）之間的權衡。公司花費越多時間學習信息，剩下給執行最小化成本策略的時間就越少。相反，如果公司花費較少時間學習，則會增大在隨後的利用階段做出次優決策的風險。我們將開發基於機器學習的算法，幫助公司在顧客訂單依次到來時即時學習需求信息並做出庫存決策。這些算法將幫助公司在探索與利用之間取得平衡、找出平衡各種成本的最優基礎庫存策略。 據我們所知，無論在需求信息是已知還是未知的背景下，這將是將合併運輸特性引入隨機庫存管理問題的首項研究。因此，該項目將對庫存管理和機器學習研究做出重要貢獻。研究結果將在庫存管理中具有實際應用，幫助公司提高運營效率。

15514124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15514124.value: 社交媒体的兴起与财经新闻业格局的变化

15514124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15514124.value: The rise of social media has revolutionized how information is created, disseminated, and processed in the capital market. Prior research has shown that social media is a double-edged sword for information dissemination and consumption, but little research exists regarding how social media affects the origination of information in financial media. Our study investigates whether the rise of social media has changed the characteristics of financial journalism. We predict that the emergence of social media leads traditional media to mimic social media when reporting financial news. We argue that this mimicry results in rapid, premature publication of shorter and less accurate news articles that contain fewer verified sources and use more provocative language. We posit that the effect of social media on financial journalism can be attributed to two non-mutually exclusive factors. First, financial journalists rely on social media to stay informed about trending topics and to identify events to potentially cover. Hence, the articles they write are likely to be influenced by social media content. Second, social media competes with traditional media as an outlet for financial news. As readers’ attention span narrows, readers increasingly use social media for news because it is brief and entertaining. To compete with social media, financial journalists are incentivized to write articles like social media to attract front-page attention and secure greater readership. To examine our research question, we focus on merger rumors, which fuel highly speculative and frequently sensationalized stories in the business press. We choose this setting for three reasons. First, merger and acquisition rumors have clear ex post outcomes, so we can measure the accuracy of the news. Second, merger and acquisition rumors have a clear timeline, which enables us to assess the speed of news generation and the timing of publication. Lastly, unlike events such as earnings calls and product releases that are pre-scheduled, mergers and acquisitions are largely spontaneous. As a result, the news content cannot be prepared beforehand, which allows us to examine the real process of news generation. In addition to merger and acquisition rumors, we also examine the setting of product recalls to strengthen our study’s generalizability. Overall, our research sheds light on the emerging role of social media in the origination of information in financial journalism, which supplements the cycle of information flow in the capital market and provides meaningful insights for market participants. 社交媒体的兴起彻底改变了信息在资本市场中创造、传播和处理的方式。以往的研究表明，社交媒体在信息传播和消费中是一把双刃剑，但关于社交媒体如何影响财经媒体信息产生的研究却较少。我们研究了社交媒体的兴起是否改变了财经新闻的特征。 我们预测，社交媒体的出现使传统媒体在报道财经新闻时模仿社交媒体。我们认为，这种模仿导致了更短且更不准确的新闻文章被快速、过早地发布，这些文章包含经过验证的来源更少，且使用了更具煽动性的语言。我们认为社交媒体对财经新闻的影响可以归因于两个非互斥的因素。首先，财经记者依赖社交媒体了解热门话题，并识别潜在的报道事件。因此，他们撰写的文章可能受到社交媒体内容的影响。其次，社交媒体作为财经新闻的一个发布渠道，与传统媒体竞争。随着读者注意长度的缩短，他们越来越倾向于使用社交媒体获取新闻，因为它更简短且更具娱乐性。为了与社交媒体竞争，财经记者被鼓励撰写类似社交媒体的文章，以吸引头版关注并确保更大的读者群体。 为了检验我们的研究问题，我们专注于并购传闻，这些传闻在商业新闻中推动具有高度猜测性和频繁的耸人听闻的报道产生。我们有三个选择这一情景的原因。首先，并购传闻有明确的事后结果，因此我们可以测量新闻的准确性。第二，并购传闻有明确的时间线，使我们能够评估新闻产生的速度和发布时间。最后，与事先安排好的财报电话会议和产品发布等活动不同，并购在很大程度上是自发的。因此，新闻内容无法提前准备，这使我们能够研究新闻生成的真实过程。除了并购传闻，我们还研究了产品召回的情景，以增强我们研究的普遍性。 总体而言，我们的研究阐明了社交媒体在财经新闻信息产生中的新兴角色，这补充了资本市场的信息流动循环，并为市场参与者提供了有意义的见解。

15514924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15514924.value: 短期工资弹性在网约车市场的劳动力供给：一个参考依赖模型

15514924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15514924.value: The ride-hailing market has developed rapidly and has been favored by many customers due to its relatively low travel costs and prompt response. Since the working hours of ride-hailing drivers are determined based on personal opportunity cost and market conditions, dynamic pricing strategies (e.g., surge pricing) have been the common practice in the industry to cope with the uncertainty caused by labor supply and ensure service quality. An implicit assumption behind this pricing strategy is a positive price elasticity of labor supply, which implies that drivers are willing to work longer hours when they receive higher salaries. However, ride-hailing platforms have recently found that drivers may set a target wage depending on their experience and expected income level. This target wage behavior creates a kink in the drivers’ utility function, where going beyond the expected income reference point results in a significant decrease in the marginal benefits of working. Most studies up to now are empirical and few have applied income-targeting behavior to yield management studies in the ride-hailing market or the broader bilateral markets. In this study, we investigate ride-hailing drivers’ income-targeting behavior based on the reference dependence theory in behavioral economics. We examine the drivers' labor supply decision and the platform's revenue optimization problem using a stylized game-theoretic model, characterize the platform's optimal pricing strategy, and further study the social welfare level under the optimal pricing strategy. 网约车市场发展迅速，由于其相对较低的出行成本和快速响应，受到了许多客户的青睐。由于网约车司机的工作时间是基于个人机会成本和市场条件决定的，动态定价策略（例如高峰定价）已成为行业应对劳动力供给不确定性并确保服务质量的常见做法。这一定价策略背后的隐含假设是劳动力供给的价格弹性为正，这意味着司机在获得更高薪酬时愿意工作更长时间。然而，网约车平台最近发现，司机可能会根据他们的经验和预期收入水平设定一个目标工资。这种目标工资行为在司机的效用函数中产生了一个拐点，超过预期收入参考点后，工作的边际收益显著下降。到目前为止，大多数研究都是实证性的，很少有将收入目标行为应用于网约车市场或更广泛的双边市场的收益管理研究。在本研究中，我们基于行为经济学中的参考依赖理论，研究了网约车司机的收入目标行为。我们使用一个简化的博弈论模型，分析了司机的劳动力供给决策和平台的收入优化问题，描述了平台的最优定价策略，并进一步研究了在最优定价策略下的社会福利水平。

15515224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15515224.value: 在职场中被孤立：理解单身、无子女女性的刻板印象威胁与工作生活

15515224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15515224.value: 在当代职业环境中，单身无子女女性在性别刻板印象和社会期望的复杂网络中游走，常常面临尚未被充分研究和理解的职场挑战。本研究调查了这些女性所面临的复杂挑战。由于她们拒绝传统性别角色，她们常常受到微妙的社会不公和刻板印象的影响（Delacruz & Speer, 2023；Gloor, Okimoto, & King, 2021；Letherby, 2002；Russo, 1976；Rudman & Glick, 2001）。职场往往成为单身无子女女性因表现出“男性”特质而受到惩罚，同时又缺乏预期的“群体性、关系性”领导特质的战场（Merluzzi & Phillips, 2022）。 本研究探讨了这种现象对单身无子女女性的幸福感和组织经验的影响。我们调查了感知到的刻板印象威胁如何侵蚀组织支持，并减少这些女性的工作相关情感幸福感。当个体对与其群体相关的负面刻板印象有高度认知时，刻板印象威胁就会出现，从而导致对确认这些刻板印象的线索更加敏感（Steele & Aronson, 1995）。对这些刻板印象的持续意识会营造出一种敌对的工作环境，导致孤立、挫折和焦虑的感觉。 通过在新加坡和香港进行的涉及单身无子女职业女性的半结构化访谈的试点研究，本研究的理论框架得以证实。访谈强调了负面刻板印象、职场不文明行为和感知到的组织支持缺乏的普遍存在。这些初步见解在现有理论和单身无子女职业女性的经验之间架起了一座桥梁，突显了当前学术讨论中的一个重要空白。 基于这些见解，我们的研究采用混合方法来加深对社会刻板印象与工作生活界限之间复杂相互作用的理论理解，提供了一个全新的理论视角来理解这些动态。我们拟议的研究1将通过深入访谈继续进行定性探索，而研究2将采用横断面调查系统地检验理论模型。该模型表明，刻板印象威胁对单身无子女职业女性的组织支持感知和工作相关幸福感产生负面影响。此外，我们将工作生活界面框架作为一个背景因素，揭示其如何可能缓解或加剧这些不利影响。 总之，本研究在推进理论知识方面取得了重大进展，提供了对性别、工作生活交叉领域的全面理解。它强调了在理论构建中考虑独特人口群体的必要性，最终为更包容和公平的工作生活政策和实践做出了贡献。

15515324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15515324.value: 跨相关系统学习的小样本数据整合决策

15515324.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15515324.value: Prof Feng, Qi Prof Shanthikumar, J. George

15515324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15515324.value: Decision making with limited data and lack of statistical characterization is challenging. However, though the data of the decision problem at hand may be limited, the firm may have sufficient understandings of its operating environment and enough experiences of managing similar situations. The typical statistical-machine-learning approaches would call for migrating the experience of a related system with ample data through transfer learning or leveraging the similarity of multiple systems with limited data through data pooling. We, instead, will develop new solution concepts for learning across systems by adapting the Operational Data Analytics (ODA) framework, which aims to identifying the appropriate direct mapping from data to decision by a careful balance between data integration and decision validation. We consider a date-integrated decision making problem with homogeneous profit function and scalable demand. Under this domain of validation, we will primarily focus on the following challenging questions. First, how to construct proper data-integrated solutions by cross learning (co-learning), when there is another (many) related system with ample (limited) demand samples and identical normalized demand. Second, we will extend the construction of these solutions when the normalized demands are not exactly identical. We will also analyze the choice among the constructed solutions under different data characteristics. To answer these questions, we will utilize the homogeneity of profit function and the scalability of demand, to construct the data-based validating models approximating the ultimate performance measure for different classes of data-integrated solutions. Under the ODA framework, a data-integrated solution is determined by maximizing the validating model subject to a class of data-integrated solutions. Through the application of newsvendor systems, we will demonstrate the performance of the proposed cross learning solutions and co-learning solutions both theoretically and numerically. Our solutions underscore the roles of domain knowledge and the structural relationships between the data and the decision in designing efficient learning solutions with limited data. 在数据有限且缺乏统计特征的情况下进行决策是具有挑战性的。然而，尽管手头的决策问题数据可能有限，公司可能对其运营环境有足够的了解，并且有足够的管理类似情况的经验。典型的统计机器学习方法会通过迁移学习将相关系统的丰富数据经验迁移过来，或者通过数据汇集利用多个系统的相似性来处理有限数据。我们将通过运营数据分析（ODA）框架来开发新的跨系统学习解决方案概念，该框架旨在通过在数据整合和决策验证之间进行仔细平衡，识别从数据到决策的适当直接映射。 我们考虑一个具有同质利润函数和可扩展需求的数据整合决策问题。在这个验证领域内，我们将主要关注以下具有挑战性的问题。首先，当存在另一个（多个）具有丰富（有限）需求样本和相同归一化需求的相关系统时，如何通过跨学习（共同学习）构建适当的数据整合解决方案。其次，当归一化需求不完全相同时，我们将扩展这些解决方案的构建。我们还将分析在不同数据特征下构建的解决方案之间的选择。 为了回答这些问题，我们将利用利润函数的同质性和需求的可扩展性，构建基于数据的验证模型，以近似不同类别的数据整合解决方案的最终性能度量。在ODA框架下，数据整合解决方案是通过在一类数据整合解决方案中最大化验证模型来确定的。通过在报童系统中的应用，我们将从理论和数值上展示所提出的跨学习解决方案和共同学习解决方案的性能。我们的解决方案强调了领域知识以及数据与决策之间结构关系在设计有限数据的高效学习解决方案中的作用。

15600724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15600724.value: 香港青年學者的幸福感：一項縱向混合方法研究

15600724.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15600724.value: Prof Shek, Daniel Prof Yu, Lu

15600724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15600724.value: 雖然員工幸福感已在各個專業領域得到廣泛研究，但很少有研究考察青年學者的幸福感。香港的青年學者由於職業不確定性以及需要平衡教學、研究和個人生活，而承受巨大壓力。儘管學術界關注改善學生的幸福感，但對於教職員工，特別是對處在職業生涯早期的青年學者幸福感的關注仍然非常有限。 我們將使用工作需求-資源模型，嘗試通過探索香港這個擁有世界知名高等教育系統的國際大都市的青年學者的幸福感來填補這一研究空白。具體而言，本項目將解答以下四個研究問題： （1）青年學者的享樂主義幸福感（即工作滿意度、生活滿意度和心理健康）和幸福主義幸福感（即工作投入和生活意義）在不同人口統計群體（即性別和學術職級）中有什麼不同？ （2）工作需求（即工作負荷和工作不安全感）和個人需求（即表現期望和家庭需求）與幸福感之間的縱向關係如何？ （3）工作資源（即專業發展機會和工作場所支援）和個人資源（即韌性、自我效能感和家庭支援）如何調節工作和個人需求與幸福感之間的關係？ （4）青年學者如何透過恰當利用資源去應對職業和個人生活的需求以及他們在學術界的職業生涯？ 這項研究將採用混合方法設計（包括定量和定性研究），分兩個階段進行。 在第一階段，我們將對來自香港八所教資會資助的公立大學的523名青年學者（博士後研究員、研究助理教授和助理教授）進行三波追蹤研究問卷調查。這項調查將研究青年學者的工作需求、個人需求、工作資源、個人資源和幸福感之間的縱向關係。 在第二階段，我們將通過理論抽樣邀請35名完成問卷調查的青年學者進行深入訪談。他們的敘述將被用於解釋定量研究結果，以及探索他們如何應付早期的學術生涯，並揭示青年學者在職業和個人生活中遇到的困難和挑戰。 研究結果將有助於大學管理層和政府制定對員工友好的政策，創造積極的研究環境，促進青年學者的幸福感。這些結果還將用於為利益相關者（例如：教資會）提供建議，幫助他們找到解決學者倦怠這一全球性問題的可能方案，並留住年輕人才為香港做出貢獻。

15600924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15600924.value: 邊緣性問題：張義雕塑實踐中的等級與超越（1950年代至1980年代）

15600924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15600924.value: The emergence and acknowledgment of “global modernism” in the field of art history has justifiably created a pressing need to investigate and integrate the artistic experience of individuals who had previously been excluded from the hegemonic modernist discourse of Europe and North America. The present research project contributes to the building of a more equitable art history of the twentieth century by investigating the peripheralized experience of Cheung Yee 張義 (1936–2019), a pioneer of modernist sculpture in Hong Kong from the early 1960s through the early 1980s. This research, on the one hand, will examine Cheung’s archive and collection—presently preserved at his old residence-studio in California, where he emigrated to in 1998—of books and magazines about the era’s modern and contemporary art to identify the epistemological construct of the artist from the world’s margins in the 1950s–1960s. It also explores, on the other hand, how the artist selectively employed the knowledge acquired in his sculptural pursuit and how he sought to destabilize conventional hierarchical positions of those knowledges through using different sets of agents: ancient Chinese cultural elements, non-cultural and non-artistic components, and vernacular means. This collection of archive materials and tools had remained unpublished and untouched until my initial inspection, conducted during a preparatory research trip in winter 2022. Ultimately, this project seeks to elucidate the various creative ways in which the first modernist sculptor of Hong Kong transcended his peripheralized status by actively erasing the hierarchical division between the center and the periphery, the binary construct pitting the Chinese and the Western, and the temporal schism between tradition and modern. The conceptual architectonics and methodological framework of this project benefits not only researchers of Hong Kong art but also scholars of underrepresented artistic practitioners and their practices in general, to the extent that they interrogate the contents and meanings of pluralistic modernisms in a global context. 隨著 "全球現代主義 "在藝術史領域的出現和被認可，人們需要調查和整合過去被排除在歐洲和北美現代主義話語以外的個人藝術經驗。本研究項目透過研究香港現代雕塑藝術先驅張義（1936-2019 年）的邊緣化經歷，為建構更全面的二十世紀藝術史作出貢獻。本研究一方面將檢視張義（1998 年移居美國加州，現保存於其舊居工作室）的檔案和收藏，包括有關那個時代的現代和當代藝術的書籍和雜誌，以確定這位來自1950 年代至1960 年代世界邊緣的藝術家的知識論建構。另一方面，本研究亦探討了張氏如何在其雕塑追求中篩選所獲得的知識，以及他如何透過使用不同的媒介（中國古代文化元素、非文化和非藝術成分）來顛覆這些知識的傳統等級地位。 最後，本項目試圖闡明香港第一位現代主義雕塑家超越其邊緣化地位的各種創作方式，以消除中心與邊緣之間的階級劃分、中國與西方之間的二元建構，以及傳統與現代之間的時間分裂。本研究計畫的概念架構與方法論架構，不僅對香港藝術研究者有益，對一般未被充分代表的藝術家及其實踐的學者也有助益，因為他們可以在全球的情境中，詰問多元現代主義的內容與意義。

15601024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15601024.value: 睡眠期間聲學提示對泛化語音學習的效應：以非母語聲調學習為例

15601024.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15601024.value: Prof Hu, Xiaoqing Prof QIN, Zhen

15601024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15601024.value: Generalization is a hallmark of learning. An identical circumstance seldom occurs twice; thus, it is key to apply past experiences to similar but new circumstances. Likewise, a speech sound (e.g., /a/) is rarely physically the same when spoken by different speakers. From a learner’s perspective, it is important to extract regularities from variable physical forms of a sound to form an abstract representation, and to apply it to new speakers. Crucially, sleep seemingly facilitates this phonetic generalization process in second language (L2) acquisition. However, many past sleep studies tested participants at different times of the day (e.g., evening vs. morning) or employed sleep deprivation (e.g., sleep vs. wake). These methods inevitably induced differences in circadian rhythm and alertness that confounded the results. Furthermore, few studies have probed the neural activities during sleep that contribute to phonetic generalization. Understanding the neurophysiological basis of sleep-based memory generalization is crucial for harnessing sleep to enhance memory. The current study aims to illuminate the neurophysiological basis of sleep-based memory generalization and its evolution over the course of learning in the L2 phonetic learning context. The study will employ targeted memory reactivation (TMR), while measuring learners’ brain activities during sleep using electroencephalography, to probe the brain oscillations that contribute to phonetic generalization. TMR is a new technique that re-exposes learners to auditory/odor cues to bias the reactivation of specific memories during sleep without raising awareness. This exciting new tool for reinforcing memory in educational and clinical contexts will address the aforementioned confounded results by comparing learners with and without TMR during a comparable period of post-learning sleep. Thus, the first aim is to employ TMR to provide more causal evidence for the role of sleep-based memory reactivation in L2 phonetic generalization. Crucially, taking inspiration from high-variability perceptual training (i.e., multi-talker training materials), the study will test a new hypothesis—exposure to auditory cues that switch to a new talker (or nonspeech sounds with identical pitch cues) during sleep will promote generalization. It will also test the hypotheses that neocortical slow oscillations contribute to generalization, which is strengthened over the learning course. To answer these questions, this study will capitalize on the team’s expertise to investigate Cantonese tone learning in a large number of Mandarin-speaking L2 learners via a four-day training+TMR design. The output of this project has the potential to advance L2 learning theories and memory models. 泛化是學習的重要標誌。完全相同的情況很少發生兩次；因此，將過去的經驗泛化應用於類似但新的情況是關鍵。 同樣，一個語音範疇（例如：/a/）由不同的說話者說出時很少在物理屬性上完全相同。 從學習者的角度來看，重要的是從聲音的不同物理形式中提取規律以形成抽象表徵，並將其泛化應用於新的說話者。重要的是，睡眠似乎促進了二語習得中的這種語音泛化過程。 然而，許多過去的睡眠研究方法存在一定的侷限性，比如在一天中的不同時間（例如：晚上與早上）測試參與者，或採用睡眠剝奪範式（例如：睡眠與清醒組對照）。這些方法不可避免地會引起晝夜節律和警覺性的額外差異，從而混淆結果。 此外，很少有研究探討睡眠期間語音泛化的神經活動。了解基於睡眠的記憶鞏固和泛化的神經生理學基礎對於利用睡眠來增強記憶至關重要。 本研究旨在闡明睡眠記憶泛化的神經生理基礎及其在二語語音學習進程中的演變。 本研究將採用標靶記憶再激活（Targeted memory reactivation，TMR）方法，同時使用腦電圖測量學習者在睡眠期間的大腦活動，以探測輔助語音泛化的腦振盪活動。 TMR 是一種新方法，它透過讓學習者在睡眠期間重新接觸聽覺或氣味線索，在不影響睡眠的情況下調控特定記憶的重新激活。 通過比較睡眠期間TMR對於睡眠後記憶保留的直接作用，這種方法有助解決上述混淆結果。因此，本項目的第一個目標是利用 TMR 為睡眠記憶再激活在二語語音泛化中的作用提供更多因果證據。此外，本項研究將從高變異性感知訓練（即多說話者訓練材料）中汲取靈感，測試一個新的假設——在睡眠期間接觸切換到新說話者的聽覺提示（或承載相同音高信息的非言語聽覺提示）將進一步促進泛化。本項研究還將測試新皮質慢波活動有助語音泛化的假設，以及泛化在學習進程中逐步加強的假設。為了回答這些問題，這項研究將利用團隊的專業知識，透過為期四天的感知訓練+TMR 設計，研究以普通話為母語的學習者的粵語（二語）聲調學習情況。 此計畫的成果將有助深化二語學習理論和記憶模型。

15601324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15601324.value: 親社會行為作為天然的安眠藥？探討善行與優質睡眠的雙向關係

15601324.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15601324.value: Dr Au, Kit Yee Algae Dr Ho, Fiona Yan-Yee Dr Ng, Chi Kit Jacky

15601324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15601324.value: 睡眠問題作為一項普遍的全球健康挑戰，會加劇健康脆弱性並降低工作生產力。基於先前研究揭示的親社會行為——尤其是日常非正式幫助行為——與心理和身體健康之間的正向聯繫（Hui et al., 2020），以及親社會行為與健康之間的互惠關係（Hui, 2022），本項目從情緒調節的角度探討親社會行為與睡眠質量之間的協同作用。 現有研究已揭示了睡眠與親社會行為之間的聯繫，但仍存在顯著的研究空白。我們的元分析顯示，以往研究往往只關注親社會行為如何影響睡眠（或反之亦然），而對於這種複雜的雙向關係尚未深入探討。許多研究依賴於兩波縱向設計，且數據收集點之間的時間間隔較長。這種方法可能忽視了中期、短期甚至瞬時的雙向關係，僅捕捉到穩定的個體間差異，卻忽略了重要的個體內變異。此外，對於連接親社會行為與睡眠關係的中介機制的研究有限，且缺乏對這一雙向關係的實驗證據。 為了填補這些研究空白，我們提出了三個創新性研究。研究1採用為期一年的三波縱向交叉滯後面板設計，旨在揭示非正式幫助行為與睡眠質量之間的短期和中期雙向動態。研究2結合為期兩週的體驗採樣研究、睡眠動作計及日記研究，旨在深入探討日常生活中的瞬時動態和個體內波動。這種方法通過結合主觀自我報告數據與客觀測量，提供了多維度的睡眠質量評估。鑑於實驗數據的稀缺性，我們在研究3a和3b中引入嚴格的設計，以因果檢驗非正式幫助行為與睡眠質量之間的互惠關係。在所有研究中，我們將深入探討潛在的心理機制，假設個體內和人際情緒調節可能巧妙地解釋這種雙向關係。具體而言，非正式幫助行為可能通過個體內情緒調節改善睡眠質量，反之，睡眠質量可能通過人際情緒調節促進非正式幫助行為。 透過我們全面的研究方法，我們的目標是加深對親社會行為與睡眠質量之間未被充分探討的雙向關係的理解。為了提供可操作的見解，我們建議親社會行為可以改善一般人群的睡眠問題，作為現有提高睡眠質量方法的補充。反過來，更好的睡眠也可以促進親社會行為，促進社會的凝聚力和良好運作。

15601624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15601624.value: 普通法司法話語之情態：基於香港雙向平行語料庫的判決書研究

15601624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15601624.value: Hong Kong’s legal system occupies a unique position within common law jurisdictions due to its operation in both English and Chinese. This duality allows Hong Kong to maintain its common law foundation while providing legal services to the Chinese-speaking population through legal resources and translation services. The preservation of this distinctive legal framework is crucial for upholding the rule of law in Hong Kong. However, as judicial decisions are predominantly in English, there exists a potential disconnect with certain segments of the population. To address this issue, Hong Kong has taken innovative steps to translate judgments of jurisprudential value or broad interest into Chinese. Nevertheless, the translation process between these two languages presents challenges that may distort subtle nuances and essential meanings necessary for accurate legal interpretation. Therefore, a comprehensive examination of judgment translation is indispensable within Hong Kong’s dual-language legal system. This research project endeavors to conduct a systematic analysis of judgment translation, with a specific focus on modality. Modality pertains to how language expresses a speaker’s or writer’s position, level of certainty, obligations, permissions, and necessities regarding a particular statement or action. Within the context of judgments, precise translation of modality holds immense significance in effectively upholding the rule of law. Therefore, this research aims to systematically examine the intricate and nuanced patterns of modality present in both original and translated judgments. By utilizing both quantitative and qualitative analyses, this research aims to explore how accurately the justificatory and declaratory functions of judgments are conveyed within the bilingual common law framework. Based on the Bidirectional Parallel Judgment Corpus of Hong Kong compiled under this project, this research will systematically examine modality expressions found in judicial decisions. Annotations, encompassing the type, orientation, value, and polarity, will be utilized to categorize these expressions. Subsequently, distribution patterns across genres, case types, and translation status will be analyzed to unveil variations and commonalities in how modality is represented and used in both original and translated judgments. Through conducting an extensive investigation into this relatively underexplored domain, our study seeks to enhance the quality and precision of translations, thereby making a significant contribution to upholding the rule of law within the linguistically diverse context of Hong Kong. The findings of this study are expected to yield insights into the challenges associated with harmonizing the common law tradition with the bilingual legal representation in Hong Kong. 香港的法律制度由於中英雙語並行運作，在普通法體系中佔據特殊地位。這一機制使香港得以在實施普通法的基礎上，憑藉法律資源並透過中英翻譯，為華語社群提供優質的法律服務。維護這一獨特的法律架構對於確保香港法治的有效運作至關重要。然而，鑒於司法裁決主要以英語頒佈，以致某些群體與法律系統之間形成隔閡。為應對此問題，香港推出了創新舉措，將具有法理價值與涉及廣泛公眾利益的判決書譯為中文。儘管如此，中英雙語法律翻譯仍面臨諸多挑戰，可能導致在某些細微卻關鍵的法律概念和涵義上的曲解或誤譯。 本研究旨在對判決書翻譯進行系統分析，特別聚焦於情態的使用。情態涉及語言如何表達說話者或撰文者對特定陳述或行為所持的立場、確信程度、責任、許可範圍及必要性。在判決書的翻譯中，精准捕捉和傳達情態對於有效維護法治具有舉足輕重的意義。本研究致力於深度剖析原創判決書及其譯文中複雜且微妙的情態模式。通過融合定量與定性研究方法，本研究將探索在雙語普通法體系下判決書的闡明（justificatory）與宣告（declaratory）功能是否得以準確傳遞。通過構建香港雙向平行判決書語料庫，本研究將系統分析司法判決書中的情態表達。我們將對情態標記進行多維度標注（包括類型、方向、值和極性），並建立一套系統化的分類框架。在此基礎上，本研究將聚焦於情態標記在中英兩種語言、各類案例類型及翻譯與非翻譯文本間的分佈規律，以揭示原創判決書與翻譯判決書在情態表達層面的異同。通過對該領域展開系統研究，本研究力求提升法律翻譯的品質與準確性，從而為維護香港多語環境下的法治作出重要貢獻。本研究的成果有望為深入揭示香港普通法傳統與雙語法律體系在相互融合過程中所面臨的複雜挑戰提供重要參考與啟示。

15602024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15602024.value: 沉浸式虛擬實境能否放大粵語慢性失語症稿本訓練的治療效果？隨機對照實驗

15602024.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15602024.value: Prof FONG, Nai Kuen Kenneth Dr Li, Shi Pui Dr NG, Hiu Fung Peter

15602024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15602024.value: 背景 失語症是一種後天語言理解和表達障礙，持續存在於20% 的中風人群（Dijkerman 等，1996）。由於治療有助提升日常生活中的溝通能力，即失語症患者的功能性溝通（Brady 等，2016），研究人員因此致力制定有效的治療方案及研究如何利用科技以放大治療效果。虛擬實境已被應用在中風患者的運動/認知復康中，並取得不錯的使用者接受度及治療效果。相比之下，在失語症治療中，目前使用虛擬實境的果效較參差。然而，研究人員認為虛擬實境具有沉浸感和互動性的優勢，有助增強針對功能溝通的治療果效。例如結合稿本訓練及虛擬實境，可能會增強治療效果。失語症患者能夠在安全及現實情境中練習和互動來取得溝通能力的進展。此外，考慮到語言處理和非語言認知之間的密切聯繫，以及功能性溝通治療對非語言認知的潛在裨益（Wong & Law，2022b），稿本訓練對認知功能的影響，以及虛擬實境能否進一步增強非語言認知等議題都值得探索。 目標 此隨機對照實驗研究電腦化稿本訓練能否促進功能性溝通及非語言認知功能，以及研究虛擬實境能否進一步放大治療效果。 方法 約 105 名說粵語的失語症患者將被隨機分配至以下其中一組：1）虛擬實境電腦化稿本治療； 2）非虛擬實境電腦化稿本治療； 3）無治療的對照組。兩個治療組將接受 14節治療，每節治療包括30 分鐘的電腦化稿本訓練，以及30分鐘的稿本練習。在虛擬實境治療組中，參與者將在沉浸及互動的虛擬實境練習。而在非虛擬實境電腦化稿本治療組中，參與者將在沒有虛擬實境的情況下使用靜態照片進行練習。無治療對照組的參與者將在未經訓練的情況下進行定期評估。研究將對各組在語言、言語溝通和非言語認知功能在治療前/治療後，以及維持期間作比較。 研究重要性 此隨機對照實驗將：1）對失語症治療及復康建立臨床實證2) 探索沉浸式虛擬實境在的失語症治療潛在優勢及其理論基礎，3）解構失語症的理論以及在失語症復康中語言與其他認知功能之間的相互作用（如Code，2001）。

15602324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15602324.value: 邊疆策略：伊斯蘭師範學校在現代中國形成中的作用，1920年代至1940年代

15602324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15602324.value: 本項目研究在1930年代到1940年代期間，國民政府對私立伊斯蘭師範學校進行大力資助的獨特案例。對這一案例的研究有助於揭示國民政府與回民軍閥和知識分子之間極複雜的動態關係。因為國民政府的資助偏離了其自身在1933年針對師範學校而制定的法規，該法規要求所有師範學校都由國家運營。為了分析這種複雜的動態關係，本研究直面“回”這個詞的模糊性。根據不同的語境，“回”可以指代一個宗教、民族或地域。然而，這個詞的模糊性也使得它的含義可以因為不同利益相關者的需要而出現變化。因此，它在促進兩種不同邊疆策略的共存方面起到了重要作用。這兩種邊疆策略為國民黨政府控制西北邊疆的策略，和回民軍閥、知識分子利用國民黨控制西北的願望推進自身利益的策略。“回”的模糊性可以讓雙方在推進各自策略的同時，不會感到處於不利的地位。 在私立伊斯蘭師範學校這一機構上，國民政府與回民軍閥和知識分子的多種需求交匯在一起。因此，這類學校在歷史上的影響力與它們的數量不成比例。對於國民政府來說，不堅持伊斯蘭師範學校要由國家來運營是值得的。因為支持伊斯蘭師範學校，可以間接加強政府對西北邊疆——這一有眾多回民的區域——的影響。對於回民軍閥來說，與國家和知識分子一道，支援現代化的回民學校可以提升他們在現代中國社會中的地位。對於回民知識分子來說，與國民黨和軍閥的合作也有明顯帶好處。知識分子能在獲得大量資助的同時，獨立管理師範學校的內部事務，並繼續他們的伊斯蘭文化復興運動。 本專案還將嘗試利用一些數字工具來分析國家、回民軍閥和知識分子之間的關係。具體來說，通過社會網路和空間技術的分析，這項研究將揭示回民知識分子如果通過突出他們的師範學校與邊疆地區的聯繫，來吸引國民政府和軍閥的注意。除了數字工具外，本研究還將使用檔案、報紙、回憶錄和學校雜誌來描繪國家、回民軍閥和伊斯蘭師範學校之間互動的全貌。現代中國的伊斯蘭師範學校是以往的歷史研究中被相對忽略的機構，對它們的研究能加深我們對宗教、民族和現代國家形成之間的關係的理解。

15602624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15602624.value: 城鄉變遷的前沿：中國的土地政治與農業發展

15602624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15602624.value: Under a dominant agenda of urbanization and urban-rural integration, spatial transformation at China’s peri-urban edge has for decades been characterized by the conversion of rural land for non-agrarian use, including infrastructure construction and industrial and real estate projects. In recent years, however, a conjuncture of developments – including the COVID-19 pandemic, ongoing geopolitical tensions, and extreme weather events – has challenged China’s ability to feed itself and renewed concerns for national food security. The Chinese government’s bid to bolster food self-sufficiency has animated efforts to modernize agriculture, industrialize production, and reclaim farmland around the country – developments that have created new territorial dynamics and emerging forms of agrarian urbanization at China’s rural-urban fringe. Through multi-sited ethnographic research in peri-urban areas, this project proposes to investigate the politics of land and labor at China’s agricultural industrial parks. Our analysis focuses on three components: (1) logic of territorialization, namely the policy instruments and spatial techniques used in zoning and assembling land for projects of agricultural modernization; (2) regime of accumulation, the dominant mode of surplus generation and forms of rural-urban interconnections that these parks put in place; and (3) impact of and response from local society. Adopting the multiple-case comparative method, we compare how industrial parks that specialize in different types of production activities engender distinct logics of territorialization and accumulation, while affecting and incorporating segments of the rural population in uneven ways. By shedding light on the co-production of peripheral urbanization and agrarian change at China’s urban-rural interface, this study seeks to advance interdisciplinary dialogue between urban studies and critical agrarian studies. It responds to calls within urban geography to theorize ongoing attempts by state and corporate actors to rationalize rural space and environments, as well as calls for agrarian scholars to recognize the urban dimension of agrarian questions. Empirically, this study will provide first-hand insights into the community impact of China’s agricultural modernization projects, which can serve as valuable materials for evidence-based policy-making both within and beyond China. By providing a critical appraisal of China’s current pathway of rural-urban development, and by engaging decision-makers, practitioners and local stakeholders, our aim is for this project to become a foundation for further comparative research and knowledge exchange on sustainable rural-urban development in the developing world.

15603524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15603524.value: 新冠疫情後香港的網上地方品牌形象

15603524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15603524.value: 建立地方品牌是指通過整體努力，將一個地方從其他地方分辨出來。這不僅對旅遊、移民和外來投資日趨重要，而且對當地經濟、公民參與和社會凝聚力也起了關鍵的作用。本研究從話語此一甚少被探索的角度，分析詞語的位置和詞語間的聯繫，以及這些詞語出現的環境。而此兩方面，正是現有的建立地方品牌市場研究中有所欠缺的。因此，本研究對建立地方品牌此範疇，作出了獨特貢獻。 作為建立地方品牌研究的一個關鍵組成部分，地方品牌形象是持分者對一個地方的實際認知和體驗。在互聯網已成為溝通和行銷主要場所的數位時代，必須透過充分考慮持分者的網上觀點，來全面理解地方品牌形象。 世界在新冠疫情後逐漸恢復正常，然而由於香港較遲放寬疫情相關限制，故此於復常方面落後於許多主要經濟體。令人擔憂的是，隨著旅客的期望和偏好改變，香港的旅遊業可能不會反彈。因此，現在是瞭解人們對香港的看法是否有變，及以何種方式變化的決定性時刻。本研究結合語料庫語言學、話語分析和建立地方品牌研究的概念、工具和技術，分析於全球最大旅遊網站TripAdvisor®上，有關香港的內部和外部持分者的觀點，從而比較和對照疫情前後，香港的網上地方品牌形象。 試點研究中已經完成的基礎工作，包括開發用於大規模數據收集的定製軟體和產生一個樣本數據集。在完成該等基礎工作後，本研究將彙編並查考分別在疫情前後一年內產生的兩大數據集。這些數據集來自TripAdvisor®上的香港旅遊論壇，每個數據集估計約為一百萬字。 透過對TripAdvisor®上數千篇論壇貼文進行比較分析，本研究將識別出疫情前後國際社會對香港看法存在的差異（如有）。分析涉及研究最常出現詞語的語言模式，包括它們的文本和語境、與常見共現詞的聯繫以及在特定情境中出現的情况。研究結果能直接應用於香港及其他地區，可以為政策制定提供資訊和指導，並透過實證、證據驅動的方法增強我們對網上建立地方品牌的理解。

15603924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15603924.value: 追蹤健康老化過程中語言理解的時空動態：腦電圖-功能性磁力共振造影（EEG-fMRI）研究

15603924.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15603924.value: Dr Grisoni, Luigi Dr Lars, Meyer Prof LI, Jixing

15603924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15603924.value: Background: It is unclear whether healthy aging results in less efficient semantic prediction in real-time language comprehension. Given substantial variability in the reported degree of decline in cognitive functions during healthy aging, one explanation for the mixed findings could be that an individual differences approach is not adopted in most studies. Purpose: The proposed study will examine whether language deterioration is a consequence of healthy aging or a downstream consequence of decline in other cognitive functions which are influenced by healthy aging. This is an important question given that Hong Kong’s aging population is increasing and that language is the basis of social participation. Methods: Healthy young (25-40 years old) and older (over 65) participants will be recruited from Hong Kong. Cantonese spoken sentences that vary in semantic predictability will be designed. Simultaneous electroencephalogram (EEG) and functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) recordings will be conducted while participants listen to these sentences. The simultaneous EEG-fMRI has rarely been done in previous research. It allows a set of real-time models describing where and when semantic prediction occurs in the healthy brain across the lifespan. For analysis of neural data, a novel multivariate approach called EEG-fMRI fusion will be used. This analysis combines the data from both modalities into a single space. To account for individual differences, metrics such as working memory, verbal fluency, processing speed, inhibitory control, non-verbal intelligence, and participants’ language experiences are included in the analyses. These variables are known to predict cognitive decline in aging. The inclusion of individual differences enables us to draw conclusions on how much of the differences reported between younger and older people can actually be attributed to aging itself. The use of two acquisition modalities simultaneously and inclusion of a variety of individual differences are novelties of this study which could help advance the field of healthy aging. Implications: Findings help healthcare professionals gain a deeper knowledge of how much language comprehension changes with aging and to what extent individual differences could mediate the effects of aging on language comprehension. Findings could be used in programs that aim to improve quality of life and cognitive functions in older adults. The fact that this study will be conducted in Hong Kong will create a more realistic and contextualized picture of healthy aging in Hong Kong. This evidence-based, contextualized approach could inform healthcare policy decision making in healthy aging in the long run. 背景：健康老化會否降低實時語言理解中語義預測的效率尚未清晰。鑒於以往健康老化過程的報告中，對認知功能下降程度存在很大差異，對這混合結果的一種解釋可能是大多數研究並未採用個體差異方法。 目的：本研究將探討語言能力衰退是否由健康老化所引致，還是受健康老化引起的其他認知功能衰退而導致。這是一個重要的問題，因為香港人口老化日益加劇，而語言是社會參與的基礎。 方法：研究將於香港招募健康的年輕（25-40歲）和老年（65歲以上）參與者。實驗將使用語意可預測性不同的粵語口語句子。當參與者聆聽這些句子時，將同時進行腦電圖（EEG）和功能性磁力共振造影（fMRI）記錄。在先前的研究中，很少進行同步的腦電圖-功能性磁力共振造影。這種方法可以使用同一組實時模型來描述在整個生命週期中健康大腦進行語義預測的時空動態。為了分析神經數據，研究將會使用一種稱為 EEG-fMRI 融合的新型多變量方法。此分析將兩種模式的數據組合至單一空間中。為了分析個體差異，研究將納入工作記憶、語言流暢性、處理速度、抑制控制、非語言智力和參與者的語言經驗等指標。已知這些變數可以預測老化過程中認知能力的衰退。納入個體差異使我們能夠探討以往報告中，年輕人和老年人之間的差異有多少可以歸因於老化本身此議題上得出結論。同時使用兩種腦功能擷取方式並納入各種個體差異是這項研究的新穎之處，有助於推動健康老化領域的發展。 研究重要性：研究結果將令醫療保健專業人員更深入地了解語言理解力隨著年齡的增長而變化的程度，以及個體差異在多大程度上可以調節衰老對語言理解力的影響。研究結果可用於旨在改善老年人生活品質和認知功能的項目。這項研究將在香港進行，這將為香港健康老化提供更現實和更情境化的信息。從長遠來看，這種基於實證、情境化的方法可以為健康老化的醫療決策提供資訊。

15604424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15604424.value: 增強脊柱側彎矯正治療：研究嵌入矽膠的光纖光柵傳感器體壓測織物的有效性

15604424.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15604424.value: Dr Cheung, Pui-yin Jason Dr Liang , Ruixin Prof Lu, Chao

15604424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15604424.value: Bracing is usually prescribed as the non-surgical treatment for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis (AIS) patients with a moderate Cobb's angle to prevent the progression of their spinal curvature. The objective of this treatment is to passively correct spinal abnormalities by applying pressure. However, the effectiveness of these braces can be significant influenced by the brace-skin interface pressure, which currently lacks precise measurement methods and guidelines. Excessive pressure not only poses a risk of physical injury but also negatively impacts compliance and quality of life. This study aims to revolutionize orthotic treatments for scoliosis by developing Body Pressure Mapping Knitwear (BPMK) with embedded fiber Bragg grating sensors. The BPMK will provide an innovative, accurate, and safe method for real-time measurement of overall brace-skin interface pressures, leading to more precise brace settings during the prescription process. Another goal of the study is to investigate the relationship between the brace pressure and its resulting corrective effect on the spine. Additionally, the study aims to examine tolerable pain levels at various pressure levels that exerted by braces, which would contribute to the development of practical guidelines for brace prescription. Our approach involves utilizing MRI scans, in-brace pressure measurements by using BPMK, and pain assessments under various pressure settings. This data will be integrated with scientifically validated finite element (FE) torso-brace simulations to predict the corrective effects. The loading conditions will be increased until reach the maximum tolerable pressure and at different locations. The pressure level at which the minimum Cobb's angles are achieved will be considered as the optimal pressure level. Thus, practical guidelines for bracing can be develop, such as suggesting optimal pressure at specific areas on torso, depending on the type and severity of spinal curvatures. This innovation is expected to improve the standard of care for scoliosis patients by assisting clinicians in determining the optimal pressure levels while still within their tolerance range. We firmly believe that the BPMK will accurately measure pressure distribution and assist clinicians in determining optimal bracing pressure levels. This information will be translated into guidelines for safe and effective AIS treatment, improving the quality of life of the AIS patients. Research outcomes will be shared through publications, conferences, patents, open forums, and community engagement. As such, we anticipate widespread adoption of these guidelines within the scoliosis treatment community in the decade following project completion. 支具通常被處方作為青少年特發性脊柱側彎（AIS）患者中度Cobb角的非手術治療，以防止其脊柱彎曲的進一步惡化。這種治療的目的是通過施加壓力來被動地矯正脊柱異常。然而，這些支具的有效性可能會受到支具與皮膚界面壓力的顯著影響，目前缺乏精確的測量方法和指導方針。過大的壓力不僅會帶來身體損傷的風險，還會對依從性和生活質量產生負面影響。本研究旨在通過開發嵌入光纖布拉格光柵傳感器的身體壓力測繪針織品（BPMK）來革新脊柱側彎的矯形治療。BPMK將提供一種創新、精確且安全的方法，用於實時測量整體支具與皮膚界面的壓力，從而在處方過程中實現更精確的支具設置。研究的另一個目標是調查支具壓力與其對脊柱的矯正效果之間的關係。此外，研究還旨在檢查支具施加的不同壓力水平下可忍受的疼痛程度，這將有助於制定實際的支具處方指南。我們的方法包括利用MRI掃描、使用BPMK進行支具內壓力測量以及在不同壓力設置下進行疼痛評估。這些數據將與經科學驗證的有限元（FE）軀幹-支具模擬相結合，以預測矯正效果。負載條件將增加直到達到最大可忍受壓力並在不同位置進行測試。達到最小Cobb角的壓力水平將被視為最佳壓力水平。因此，可以制定實際的支具指南，例如根據脊柱彎曲的類型和嚴重程度，建議在軀幹特定區域施加最佳壓力。這一創新預計將通過幫助臨床醫生確定在患者可忍受範圍內的最佳壓力水平來提高脊柱側彎患者的護理標準。我們堅信，BPMK將準確測量壓力分佈，並幫助臨床醫生確定最佳的支具壓力水平。這些信息將被轉化為安全有效的AIS治療指南，改善AIS患者的生活質量。研究成果將通過出版物、會議、專利、公開論壇和社區參與進行分享。因此，我們預計在項目完成後的十年內，這些指南將在脊柱側彎治療社區中得到廣泛採用。

15604524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15604524.value: 讓居家老年人使用智能電話輔助的以人為本護理方法進行自我管理:一種混合有效性-實施設計

15604524.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15604524.value: Prof Cheng, Shu-kei Andy Prof Choi, Namkee G Prof Kwan, Yiu Cho Dr Lee, Paul Hong Prof Ng, Sheung Mei Shamay Prof Wolf, Axel Prof Wong, Chi Sang Martin Prof Wong, Frances Kam-yuet Dr Wu, Ka

15604524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15604524.value: The rapid global growth of the ageing population means that attention must be paid to the increasing numbers of homebound older adults. These individuals, aged 60 or older, face physical or functional limitations that prevent them from leaving their homes. Homebound older adults are at a higher risk of depression, experience poorer health, and have lower levels of instrumental activities of daily living compared to their counterparts. They are susceptible to social isolation and struggle with medication and disease management. These challenges significantly impact their quality of life and contribute to increased utilization of hospital services, leading to substantial healthcare expenditures. In response to these issues, mobile health (mHealth)-assisted self-care support programmes have emerged as a prevalent service for homebound older adults in recent years. These programmes aim to provide remote assistance in basic daily living activities and offer health and social care services. Typically, a nurse case manager provides remote face-to-face geriatric assessments and care planning, and coordinates community services, allowing homebound older adults to receive prompt electronic services without leaving their homes. However, these programmes have shortcomings, including a lack of focus on psychosocial issues, challenges in maintaining services, and a tendency to encourage older adults to take a passive role. Consequently, there are limited opportunities for homebound older adults to actively participate in planning their care management, potentially impeding their determination and motivation to comply with treatment regimens and reducing the potential benefits of the programme. Person-centred care (PCC) is an approach that addresses individual preferences and empowers individuals to act as partners with healthcare professionals. Integrating the PCC approach into a self-care support programme can provide homebound older adults with a sense of control in managing their own health and motivate them to engage in self-care activities, ultimately promoting their long-term health and enabling them to remain at home. However, there is a lack of research on the implementation of PCC in mHealth self-care support programmes. The proposed study will be the first to evaluate both the effectiveness and implementation outcomes of adopting PCC in an mHealth-assisted self-care support programme for homebound older adults. The findings will not only contribute insights into the optimal implementation and sustainability of the programme but also provide evidence justifying the adoption of PCC alongside mHealth by health and social care providers. 全球老年人口的急速增長意味著我們必須關注日益增多的居家老年人。這些60歲及以上的人士由於身體或功能上的局限而無法離開家園。與其他老年人相比,居家老年人更容易出現抑鬱,身體健康狀況較差,並且日常生活活動能力較低。他們容易遭受社交孤立,在用藥和疾病管理方面也面臨困難。這些挑戰嚴重影響了他們的生活品質,並導致醫院服務的大量使用,從而造成巨大的醫療費用。 為應對這些問題, 自我健康管理支持計劃近年來已成為一種常見的服務方式。這些計劃旨在提供基本日常生活活動的遠程協助,並提供健康和社會護理服務。通常,一名護士個案經理會提供遠程老年人評估和護理,並協調社區服務,使居家老年人能夠獲得即時的服務,而無需離開家園。然而,這些計劃存在不足,包括缺乏對心理社會問題的關注以及傾向於鼓勵老年人扮演被動角色。因此,居家老年人主動參與自我健康管理的機會有限,可能會阻礙他們遵守治療方案的決心和動力,從而降低計劃的潛在效益。 以人為本的護理(PCC)是一種關注個人偏好並賦權個人與醫療專業人員合作的方法。將PCC方法融入自我健康管理,可以為居家老年人提供管理自身健康的掌控感,激勵他們參與自我護理活動,從而促進他們的長期健康,使他們能夠繼續在家生活。然而,關於在利用智能手機對自我健康管理計劃中實施PCC的研究很少。本研究將是首次評估在智能手機輔助下的自我健康管理計劃中採用PCC方法的有效性和實施結果。研究結果不僅將為優化計劃的實施和可持續性提供見解,還將為衛生和社會護理提供者採用智能手機和PCC提供對居家老年人健康的依據。

15605424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15605424.value: 針對認知障礙症家庭照顧者的閉環式與神經可塑性靜觀減壓計畫：隨機對照試驗與過程評估

15605424.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15605424.value: Dr CHEUNG, Daphne Sze Ki Prof Chou, Kee Lee Dr Galante, Julieta Prof Ho, Rainbow Tin Hung Prof LIU, Yat Wa Justina Prof Mak, Winnie Wing Sze Prof WONG, Samuel Yeung-shan Prof Zarit, Steven

15605424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15605424.value: 背景 照顧認知障礙症患者是一項具挑戰的工作，鑑於疾病進展的不確定性，照顧者往往承受高度壓力，從而威脅到他們的健康以及與患者的雙方關係。在多項研究中，靜觀介入（Mindfulness-based interventions）被顯為有效的減壓方法。然而，它亦有一些局限性。首先，大多數靜觀介入採用了高強度訓練（每週150分鐘，持續8週），對於認知障礙症患者的照顧者來說是非常具有挑戰性，並導致他們的流失率高。其次，參加者的注意力分散而產生的心智游移是靜觀練習中最具挑戰性，然而參與者在練習過程中並沒有得到任何可量化的指標或表現反饋，使參加者的參與度和堅持長期練習變得相當困難。另一個問題是標準化的靜觀介入方案（如每天練習45分鐘），有部分照顧者無法達到目標，從而對介入產生挫折感。為了解決上述局限性，我們提出將閉環式和神經可塑性方法整合到靜觀訓練中。 目的 探究針對認知障礙症患者家庭照顧者的閉環式與神經可塑性靜觀計畫在減壓方面的成效。 方法 在這項三組隨機對照試驗中，我們將從社區招募189名認知障礙症患者的家庭照顧者，隨機分配到閉環式與神經可塑性靜觀介入組、傳統靜觀介入組或對照組。閉環式與神經可塑性靜觀計畫將包括每週三次的面對面訓練（每節90分鐘），及通過手機應用程式在8週內每天進行自主練習。根據參與者對自己心智遊移的反思及自我報告，應用程式採用閉環式方法，並使用自適應階梯算法來調整下一次訓練的時間，當參與者報告他們保持了對呼吸的覺察時，會增加訓練時間；當他們表示注意力無法集中在呼吸上時，則會減少訓練時間。結果指標將包括感知壓力（主要指標）、抑鬱症狀、積極情緒、照顧負擔、雙方關係、正念特質、照顧者的心率變異性以及被照顧者的行為和心理症狀。這些指標將在介入後立即測量（T1）和6個月後追蹤（T2），並與基線（T0）進行比較。我們將使用廣義估計方程式評估時間、組別和時間-組別交互作用對所有結果指標的影響。焦點小組將被用來深入探討介入的優勢、局限性和困難。

15605824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15605824.value: 認知和語用因素對香港英語學習者在面對面和電腦媒介口語任務中語言和語用表現的影響

15605824.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15605824.value: Prof Hu, Guangwei Prof Lam, Phoenix

15605824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15605824.value: 在第二語言習得中，說話能力不僅是指能夠流利且語法準確地使用複雜句子和高級詞彙（即語言能力中的複雜性、準確性、流利性和詞彙使用）。它還涉及在適當的時間說出適當的話，並遵循語言使用的常規規則（即語用能力）。然而，在第二語言學習和教學中，語言能力被高度重視，而語用能力則較少受到關注。現實情況是，學習者可能會利用多種句子結構和詞彙項來流利且準確地表達，但他們的言語可能不符合語用慣例。先前的研究表明，香港英語學習者缺乏第二語言語用能力，這可能源於第一語言文化規範對第二語言表達的影響。例如，受中華文化中“禮貌”和“面子”概念的影響，粵語英語學習者傾向於使用間接策略來拒絕請求，以追求與對話者的和諧關係。這一現象表明，在第二語言課堂中，教師及學生需要同時關注語言和語用能力。 為滿足此項需求，本研究的目的是探討如何通過任務型語言教學法(TBLT)來發展英語學習者的語言和語用能力。任務型語言教學法的優勢在於，教師可以設計口語任務為學習者提供真實的交流機會。因此，在本研究過程中，120名香港英語學習者將完成一項英語水平測試，並在面對面（n = 60）或電腦媒介交流（n = 60）中與教授或學生進行四項口語任務。研究團隊將使用定量和定性方法分析學習者的任務表現，探討認知需求、語用需求和英語水平如何影響他們在不同交流模式口語任務中的語言和語用表現。其中，32名學習者將在任務完成後立即參與回憶訪問，報告他們在執行每項任務時與語言和語用產出相關的認知過程。研究團隊將使用內容分析法分析其訪問文本。 此研究將通過闡明任務因素、交流模式和英語水平對語言和語用產出的影響，促進任務型教學法理論的發展。在教學方面，此研究將提供有效任務設計的建議，並向教師建議如何在線下和線上教學中合理設計口語任務。在方法論方面，此研究將展示定量測量和定性會話分析在評估語言和語用產出中的整合。

15605924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15605924.value: 針對有電玩失調風險的青少年之重要他人的心智化導向動機式訪談小組的成效：一項隨機對照試驗研究

15605924.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15605924.value: Prof Chan, Edward Ko Ling Dr Ho, Frederick Ka Wing Prof Ip, Patrick Dr Tse, Ka Wo Prof Yu, Lu

15605924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15605924.value: 背景 電玩失調對青少年身心健康的影響深遠，因此針對患有電玩失調的青少年的介入措施亦隨之而開展，這些措施更已被證實有效於改善青少年電玩失調的嚴重程度和心理健康方面的症狀。然而，目前的文獻對患有電玩失調的青少年對其重要他人帶來壓力的這一情況關注甚少，這種壓力不但可能損害他們之間的關係，還有機會加劇青少年電玩失調的嚴重程度。迄今為止，只有一項先導性研究嘗試應對有電玩失調的青少年之重要他人所經歷的心理壓力，而該研究是採用單組前後測設計。有見及此，我們需要採用更嚴謹的研究設計作進一步的研究，以評估這些介入措施的有效性。 目標 1. 因應有較高風險患上電玩失調的青少年之重要他人的需求，開展一個短期的心智化導向的動機式訪談小組； 2. 評估此介入小組是否有效減少重要他人的心理健康症狀（主要指標）和減少重要他人與青少年的衝突，以及減低重要他人為青少年評估電玩失調的嚴重程度（次要指標）； 3. 評估此介入小組的效果是否能在六個月的跟進期間內得以維持。 研究設計 此研究將採用兩組隨機對照試驗的研究方法，並招募176名來自香港中小學、患有或有電玩失調風險的青少年之重要他人參與。研究團隊早前已開展該介入小組並曾進行一項先導性研究（N = 38），確定了該介入措施的可行性和接受性。參加者將以1:1的比例隨機分派到兩個小組中：實驗組，參與四節的介入小組，並收到與電玩失調相關的教育資訊；或等待名單對照組，先接收與電玩失調相關的教育資訊，然後在研究結束後再參與與實驗組相同的介入小組。研究的主要指標為重要他人的心理健康症狀，次要指標則包括重要他人與青少年的衝突及其電玩失調的嚴重程度。而結果將在基線（T1）、介入後（T2）和介入後六個月（T3）進行測量，以評估介入的效果和可持續性。 貢獻 在電玩失調的研究中，此研究是首個旨在為重要他人的介入措施成效提供實證證據進行的隨機對照試驗。此外，介入說明手冊將會發放給服務提供者，讓更多的重要他人能夠從介入措施中受益，同時鼓勵更多人致力於為重要他人提供研究上的支持。

15606524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15606524.value: 執行功能缺陷及其與輕度認知障礙人士白質功能參與的關聯 ：一項多模態磁力共振造影研究

15606524.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15606524.value: Prof HSU, Chun Liang Dr Mak, Ka Fung Henry Prof Qiu, Anqi Prof Shum, Ho Keung David

15606524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15606524.value: Given tremendous increases in the aging population, the prevalence of mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and dementia is expected to also rise. Early identification and treatment of MCI will help prevent or delay the onset of dementia, allowing individuals to maintain functional independence and quality of life. Executive function (EF) is a high-level neurocognitive function that enables humans to select, focus, and plan goal-directed behavior. Deficits in EF are commonly observed among individuals with MCI, and are predictive of the development of dementia. There are three core components of EF:(1)inhibition, (2)working memory, and (3)cognitive flexibility. Each of these components is supported by the brain’s anatomical structure and function, which can be assessed using structural magnetic resonance imaging (sMRI, including anatomical MRI and diffusion tensor imaging [DTI]) and functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI). Despite the proliferation of MCI research focusing on task-related fMRI brain activation during EF tasks, the use of DTI and T2-weighted-fluid-attenuated inversion recovery has also enabled the exploration of valuable complementary information (e.g., lesions, tracts) within white matter (WM) microstructure and in regard to structural connectivity. However, due to differences in the biophysical origins of the signals and the tissue in question, there has been no direct integration of these techniques to date. Recent studies have indicated that blood oxygenation level-dependent (BOLD) effects in WM can reflect neural activities, offering an additional complementary perspective on the brain’s functional organization. As WM BOLD signals could be a potential novel biomarker for functional changes associated with the decline in EF, we propose a quantitative assessment of the significance of individual WM voxels in identifying functional networks. We refer to this concept as “engagement”. WM engagement maps, a form of neuroimaging representation, can effectively illustrate the involvement of WM in cognitive tasks. This study will test the hypothesized associations between the task-based functional alterations in grey matter and the regions shown in the WM engagement map. Specifically, we will focus on the prefrontal cortex and its related circuitry within the neural networks that are essential for EF. In addition, we will evaluate the role of WM engagement during rest at both network and global levels. The study findings will illuminate the pathophysiological mechanisms underlying MCI with EF deficits and, in turn, pave the way for the future development of more effective diagnostic tools and therapeutic strategies for managing MCI and potentially preventing progression to dementia.

15606924.value: 結合動機式訪談與影像髮聲法增強獨居及雙居長者的未來養老規劃及準備：一項三組聚類式隨機對照試驗
