16301524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16301524.value: 鏡對稱中費曼傳播子的幾何研究

16301524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16301524.value: Mirror symmetry is an fascinating subject that can predict the connection between two types of string theories. It suggests that the Calabi-Yau (CY) threefolds (inner space of our universe in addition to space and time) must appear in pairs and have equivalent geometry theories. One of the most interesting geometry theories is the Gromov-Witten theory, which enumerates 2-dimensional surfaces in the inner CY space. Another interesting one is type IIB string theory, which includes periods of the inner CY space's mirror. The predicted equivalence between them is one of the capstones in mirror symmetry. The P.I. and his collaborators have spent over 10 years finding a framework that is expected to explain such equivalence for all genera of Gromov Witten invariants. The program has been tested successfully for one inner space: quintic threefold. In the test, the key ingredients: propagators, on both sides of the mirror symmetry, are calculated to be equivalent. This is expected to be more than just a coincidence. The current project aims to find geometric reasoning behind such equivalence and to generalize it to other inner spaces. This project, if successful, will elevate our understanding of all genera of mirror symmetry to another level. 鏡像對稱是將Gromov-Witten（GW）理論與卡拉比-丘幾何相聯繫的最迷人主題。高層次的GW理論是鏡像對稱中最困難的分支之一。BCOV理論在1994年讓物理學家能夠以數學家難以企及的方式探索所有層次的GW結構。最近，通過混合自旋P場（MSP）理論的發展，BCOV的費曼規則在幾何上本質地內建。 在BCOV理論中，傳播子的主要概念多年來一直神秘莫測，而現在已知它在MSP理論中對應於CY三維流形之外的曲線計數。目前的項目旨在尋找NMSP和BCOV理論傳播子之間鏡像對稱的精確幾何理解。同時，此項目還旨在將此推廣到其他卡拉比-丘情況。

16302324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16302324.value: 构象手性杂化晶体的设计及手性诱导自旋选择机理的研究

16302324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16302324.value: 精确操控自旋自由度对于现代技术（如磁性存储）和未来技术（如自旋电子学设备）等至关重要。与传统晶体管控制电荷状态相比，自旋电子器件通过操控电子自旋的自由度来存储和处理信息，可以提供更快的速度和更高的能源效率。然而，传统的自旋控制方法依赖于铁磁材料和低温，在构筑电子集成设备中具有一定的难度。因此，发展新的自旋控制方法和具有优异自旋性质的新材料对于基础研究和下一代光电器件都至关重要。 手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）通过利用分子手性实现室温下的自旋操纵，是一种新兴的自旋控制手段。当电子通过具有空间对称破缺的手性分子传输时，某一个特定的自旋被选择性地通过，从而实现自旋极化，并且这种自旋选择可以通过分子的手性来精确控制。由于CISS效应可以在无需铁磁材料和磁场的条件下实现室温自旋调控，在自旋电子学和量子技术等领域受到广泛关注。然而，基于传统自组装手性单分子层的 CISS 效应普遍偏低，无法实现高的自旋极化。我们最近的研究表明，手性有机-无机杂化半导体表现出远高于其他手性体系的自旋极化度（>90%）。然而，CISS 的基本机制仍存在争议，并且在手性杂化半导体中尚无法实现双向的自旋选择切换。 在本项目中，我们将开发一系列构象手性的杂化半导体材料，并用其研究 CISS 的根本机制。我们拟发展新型不对称合成手段，从非手性构建单元制备构象手性的杂化金属卤素半导体。同时，我们将以此类材料为研究平台，通过调节有机和无机组分以及手性界面，对 CISS 机理进行系统的研究。最后，我们将利用构象手性材料特有的低翻转能垒，设计可双向切换自旋选择的自旋阀器件。我们的项目有望填补目前在CISS领域的知识空白，并克服CISS效应在自旋器件实际应用的限制。本项目的成功将有助于发展具有优异自旋性质的新型有机无机杂化半导体材料。同时，CISS效应作为自旋化学、材料化学和纳米技术中一个新兴领域，本项目的研究成果也将进一步阐释其在手性材料中自旋极化的根本机制。

16302624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16302624.value: 转角双层MoTe2整数和分数量子反常霍尔态的扫描探针显微镜研究

16302624.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16302624.value: Prof Dai, Xi Prof Lei, Shiming Prof Wang, Ning

16302624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16302624.value: Spontaneous symmetry breaking of topologically non-trivial electronic states can engender novel quantum states, such as the fractional quantum anomalous Hall (QAH) state. The topologically non-trivial flat bands of two-dimensional moiré superlattices have emerged as a promising testbed to search for these states because the effect of electron-electron interactions is expected to be particularly strong in these systems. Topological many body states can potentially host unique quasiparticles, such as non-Abelian anyons. Hence, their study is of fundamental importance and may also facilitate the realization of robust forms of quantum computation. Very recently, a ground-breaking study on the hole-doped moiré bands of twisted MoTe2 (tMoTe2) reported the observation of the integer and fractional QAH effects in electrical transport experiments. To date, there is a lack of experimental insights into various key aspects, such as the flat band electronic structure, the spectral properties of the observed QAH states, and the electronic wavefunctions of the underlying symmetry broken many body states. Hence, a better understanding of the observed phenomenology demands for further experimental insights that may be challenging to obtain from electrical transport experiments alone. In this project, our goal is to obtain microscopic insights into the QAH states of tMoTe2 by performing low-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy experiments. We will use high-resolution scanning tunneling spectroscopy (STS) to obtain first experimental insight into the moiré flat band electronic structure. Performing STS as a function of the charge carrier density and temperature, we will further explore the spectral characteristics of the QAH states, such as the presence and size of their spectral gaps. We will combine STS with spin polarized STM to find microscopic evidence for Ising ferromagnetism in the partially occupied moiré bands, a prerequisite for QAH states, and reveal its impact on the moiré band electronic structure. We will also employ spectroscopic mapping measurements to visualize the squared many body wavefunctions of the QAH states that could provide unique insights into the topological order parameter and the symmetry-breaking mechanism. Carrying out these measurements as a function of the twist angle, our goal is to map out the phase diagram of topological many body states of tMoTe2. We are confident that our combined expertise in the fabrication, STM study, and theoretical investigation of moiré materials will enable us to generate microscopic insights into the integer and fractional QAH states of twisted MoTe2 and shed light on the fundamental mechanisms that underlie interaction-driven topological phase transitions. 摘要：拓扑非平凡电子态的自发对称破缺可能导致新颖量子态的产生，譬如分数量子反常霍尔（QAH）态。二维莫尔转角叠层材料有着的独特的拓扑非平凡平带，在这个系统中电子-电子相互作用尤为强烈，成为了研究上述量子态颇具希望的平台。拓扑多体态中可能会激发出例如非阿贝尔任子这样不同寻常的准粒子，对他们的研究不仅能推动基础科学的发展，也可能会对促进稳定量子计算形式实现有帮助。最近，对转角双层MoTe2（tMoTe2）的开创性研究引起广泛关注，在电输运实验中观察到了其存在的整数和分数量子反常霍尔效应。然而直到今天，许多关键的物理特性，如平带电子结构、QAH态的光谱特性，以及基础对称破缺多体态的电子波函数等，还缺乏实验研究。因此需要使用其他的表征手段而并不限于电输运测量来全面跟深刻地理解其物理现象背后的本质。 在这个项目中，我们的目标是通过低温扫描隧道显微镜实验，获得对 tMoTe2 的 QAH 态的微观洞察。我们将使用高分辨率扫描隧道光谱（STS）来争取首次实验性地了解莫尔叠层平带的电子结构；在不同的载流子密度与温度条件下进行 STS测量，我们将进一步探索 QAH 状态的光谱特征，比如它们的光谱能隙的存在和大小；我们将结合自旋极化的扫描隧道探针技术进行 STS测量，以尝试找到部分填充的莫尔带中存在 Ising 铁磁性的微观证据，这是 QAH 状态的先决条件，并揭示其对莫尔带电子结构的影响。我们还将利用STS光谱的实空间测量来可视化 QAH 状态的平方多体波函数，这使得我们有机会实现进行对有关拓扑序参量和对称破缺机制的独特研究。改变扭转角度进行上述这些测量，我们的目标是绘制出 tMoTe2 拓扑多体态的相图。 我们在莫尔叠层材料的制备，扫描隧道显微镜实验和量子多体与凝聚态物理理论方面的专业知识将使我们有把握能对扭曲 MoTe2 的整数和分数量子反常霍尔态进行高质量的微观测量与探索，并进一步去阐明驱动交互作用的拓扑相变之基本机制。

16303024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16303024.value: 設計「中心到中心」型聚合物受體以增強高效能全聚合物太陽能電池的分子內堆疊

16303024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16303024.value: 全聚合物太陽能電池由於其優越的器件穩定性和較好的機械性能，相較於小分子受體器件，成為有機太陽能電池中一個極具前景的子類別。儘管全聚合物太陽能電池具有這些優勢，但在效率方面通常落後於基於小分子受體的器件，主要原因是聚合物受體的電子傳輸遷移率低於小分子受體。為了解決這一限制，許多研究人員致力於開發新型聚合物受體，以提高電荷傳輸性能，從而提升全聚合物太陽能電池的器件效率。本項目的目標是設計並合成具有增強的分子內π-π堆積的新型聚合物受體，以期有利於電荷傳輸，從而提高器件效率。 在本項目中，我們著重強調分子內π-π堆積，指的是同一分子或聚合物的不同子單元之間的π-π堆積（相比之下，傳統的有機半導體依賴於分子間π-π堆積，即不同分子之間的π-π堆積）。如項目附圖所示，該設計確保了同一聚合物骨架上的相鄰單體單元部分重疊，建立了顯著的分子內π-π堆積。這樣的構型有望有利於電荷傳輸。此外，最近的光物理研究表明，小分子受體器件效率提高的主要原因之一是Y6分子形成的增強的三維π-π堆積。因此，分子內π-π堆積可以增加電荷轉移態的局部化，從而提高激子擴散長度和電荷分離效率。 我們項目的第二個創新點在於新型聚合策略。最先進的聚合物受體通常採用線性的“端對端”聚合模式，這阻礙了相鄰單體單元的重疊。而我們提出的“中心對中心”聚合策略，將Y系列單體單元在中心位置連接，導致相鄰單體單元的末端基團部分重疊。在這種聚合物幾何構型中，同一聚合物鏈的不同單體單元之間可能存在顯著的分子內π-π堆積。 在顏河教授的指導下，我們香港科技大學的團隊在開發高性能聚合物受體方面有著紮實的研究背景，已成功實現高效率和高穩定性的全聚合物太陽能電池器件。所提議的聚合策略將為全聚合物太陽能電池的分子設計開闢新的機遇。我們的初步結果顯示了這種新分子設計策略的巨大潛力，不僅實現了高效率（>18%），還觀察到了預期的增強分子內π-π堆積的證據，表明我們項目方法的可行性非常有希望。

16303224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16303224.value: 關於張量線性形式的統計推斷和多重檢驗

16303224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16303224.value: A tensor linear form refers to a linear combination of the tensor's entries. This can include the difference between two specific entries and the sum of a specific group of entries. Statistical inference and multiple tests of tensor linear forms find broad applications in tensor data analysis such as testing the equality of two missing rating values in a recommender system and comparing the spatial patterns of gene regulation of brain development between early and late childhood. Despite their wide-ranging applications, the methods for statistical inference and multiple tests for tensor linear forms remain significantly under-explored. This project aims to address this gap with three primary objectives: (1) develop methods and theories for the statistical inference of a tensor linear form under various models; (2) investigate the correlation between pairs of tensor linear forms, establish a multivariate Berry-Esseen bound, and study a Hotelling's-type statistic; and (3) develop methods and theories for controlling the false discovery rate in multiple tests of tensor linear forms. These goals will advance our understanding and application of statistical inference and multiple tests in tensor data analysis. 張量線性形式指的是張量條目的線性組合，這可以包括兩個特定條目之間的差異以及特定條目組的總和。張量線性形式的統計推論和多重檢驗在張量數據分析中具有廣泛應用，例如在推薦系統中檢驗兩個缺失評分值的相等性，以及比較早期和晚期童年期間大腦發育的基因調控空間模式。儘管其應用範圍廣泛，但張量線性形式的統計推論和多重檢驗方法仍然顯著缺乏探索。本項目旨在通過三個主要目標來填補這一空白：(1) 在各種模型下開發張量線性形式的統計推論方法和理論；(2) 研究張量線性形式對之間的相關性，建立多元Berry-Esseen界限，並研究類似Hotelling's統計量的統計量；(3) 開發方法和理論以控制張量線性形式多重檢驗中的虛假發現率。這些目標將推進我們對張量數據分析中統計推論和多重檢驗的理解和應用。

16303524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16303524.value: 開發基於Aza-Achmatowicz重排方法構建2-ABN和全合成Akuammiline生物鹼

16303524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16303524.value: The central theme of this proposed study is to develop a new and efficient synthetic approach for the chemical synthesis of bioactive natural products: akuammiline alkaloids. Akuammiline alkaloids are a group of naturally occurring alkaloids that are primarily found in the seeds of the Picralima klaineana tree, which is native to West Africa. These alkaloids are characterized by their unique chemical structure, which contains a indole moiety fused to a 2-azabicyclo[3.3.1]nonane ring system. Akuammiline alkaloids have been the subject of extensive research due to their diverse biological activities, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, antimalarial, and anti-cancer properties. In recent years, there has been growing interest in the potential therapeutic applications of akuammiline alkaloids, and several studies have focused on their pharmacological properties and mechanisms of action. This project is focused on the synthetic chemistry and bioactivity of akuammiline alkaloids. We propose a new synthetic methodology to construct the versatile 2-azabicyclo[3.3.1]nonane (2-ABN) and then apply it to the unified total synthesis of five akuammiline alkaloids (strictamine, akuammiline, aspidophylline A, picraline, and arborisidine). Our methodology features the strategic exploitation of aza-Achmatowicz rearrangement with powerful intramolecular cyclization such as aldol reaction (Morita-Baylis-Hillman), which represents the first example of constructing 2-ABN from biomass-derived furan compounds and greatly extends the synthetic utility of aza-Achmatowicz rearrangement in organic synthesis. The main advantage of our methodology for total synthesis lies on the high efficiency, flexibility, and divergency (a common intermediate used for four natural products), which allows reliable supply of natural product materials and their analogues for bioactivity evaluation and elucidation of mode of action. This project can have a direct impact on synthetic chemistry and medicinal chemistry because the new synthetic methodology and strategy (for total synthesis) can be used by others for chemical synthesis of related privileged nitrogen-containing scaffolds and alkaloids and importantly lay the chemistry ground for drug discovery. 這項研究的中心主題是開發一種新的、有效的合成方法，用於具有生物活性天然產物的化學合成：Akuammiline生物鹼。Akuammiline 生物鹼是一組天然存在的生物鹼，主要存在於原產於西非的 Picralima klaineana 樹的種子中。這些生物鹼的特徵在於其獨特的化學結構，其中包含與2-氮雜雙環[3.3.1]壬烷環系統（2-ABN）融合的吲哚部分。Akuammiline 生物鹼因其多種生物活性而成為廣泛研究的主題， 包括鎮痛， 抗炎， 抗瘧， 和抗癌特性。近年來，人們對阿庫米林生物鹼的潛在治療應用越來越感興趣，一些研究集中在其藥理學性質和作用機制上。本項目的研究重點是阿庫米林生物鹼的合成化學和生物活性。我們提出了一種新的化學合成方法來構建通用的2-氮雜雙環[3.3.1]壬烷（2-ABN），然後將其應用於五種Akuammiline生物鹼（strictamine、阿庫阿米林、阿司匹多茶鹼A、苦菜鹼和arborisidine）的匯集式全合成。我們的方法巧妙地利用氮雜-阿赫馬托維奇（aza-Achmatowicz）重排與強大的分子內環化反應，如Morita-Baylis-Hillman反應，這是從生物質衍生的呋喃化合物構建2-ABN的第一個例子，並極大地擴展了氮雜-阿赫馬托維奇（aza-Achmatowicz）重排在有機合成中的合成效用。我們的全合成方法的主要優勢在於高效率、靈活性和發散性（四種天然產物的常用中間體），這使得天然產物材料及其類似物的可靠供應成為可能，用於生物活性評估和作用模式的闡明。該研究方案對合成化學和藥物化學產生直接影響，因為新的合成方法和策略（用於全合成）可以被其他人用於相關特定含氮支架和生物鹼的化學合成，並且重要的是為藥物發現奠定了化學基礎。

16303624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16303624.value: 非线性扩散方程的正则性与渐近行为

16303624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16303624.value: Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) provide a robust and precise mathematical framework for describing a diverse array of natural phenomena, encompassing domains such as sound propagation, heat transfer, and fluid dynamics. Moreover, their utility extends beyond the realm of natural sciences, fostering rich intersections with other mathematical disciplines like geometry and probability, as well as bridging connections to engineering and economics. This proposed project is set to undertake an analytical exploration of a specific family of linear and nonlinear evolution equations. The family of nonlinear evolution equations underscored in this proposal arise in the realm of physics, featuring prominently in models of plasma, as well as in geometric flows in the field of differential geometry. Of paramount interest within this sphere are the regularity of these solutions, and the dynamic they undergo as time progresses. It would be ideal if we could find explicit solutions of such equations. But this is only possible for very few special cases. Delicate analysis are required to prove the existence and regularity of solutions and to describe their asymptotic behavior. In a classical paper by Berryman and Holland, the limiting behavior of the solutions to fast diffusion equations in bounded domains in the Sobolev subcritical regime was explored. They found that this limiting behavior, which is a steady state of the evolution equation, could be obtained along a sequence of times, on the assumption that the solutions were globally smooth. This convergence was later verified without the smoothness assumption, and the convergence rate was strengthened. The regularity assumption was recently confirmed by the PI and his collaborator. In this proposal, our aim is to study nonlocal variants of these equations, specifically the fractional fast diffusion equations and the fractional porous medium equations. These equations provide a model for scenarios wherein the diffusion process is influenced not only by proximate points, but also by distant ones. This characteristic lends itself to a variety of real-world phenomena, including anomalous transport in heterogeneous media, heat control, and specific biological, ecological, and financial models. A keen interest has arisen in comprehending these equations. Notably, they have been found to exhibit properties that are akin to their classic counterparts, yet they also display distinct phenomena. Through this proposal, our goal is to foster a more profound understanding of the interplay between nonlinearity and fractional diffusion. 偏微分方程经常用于描述各种自然现象，包括声音传播、热传导和流体动力学等领域。此外，它们的应用不仅限于自然科学，还在几何学和概率论等其他数学学科中，以及在工程和经济学中建立了丰富的交叉联系。本拟议项目将对一类线性和非线性演化方程进行分析探索。 本提案中的非线性演化方程来源于物理学领域，尤其是在等离子体模型和微分几何中的几何流模型中。这一领域的主要研究点是这些解的正则性及其随时间推移所经历的动态变化。 理想情况下，我们希望能够找到这些方程的显式解。但这仅对极少数特殊情况可以实现。大部分情况下，我们需要精细的分析来证明解的存在性和正则性，并描述它们的渐近行为。在Berryman和Holland的一篇经典论文中，他们研究了Sobolev次临界状态下有界区域内快速扩散方程解的极限行为。他们发现，这种极限行为，即演化方程的稳态解，可以在假设解是全局光滑的情况下沿一串时间序列获得。这种收敛性后来在不需要光滑性假设的情况下得到了验证，并且收敛速度得到了加强。最近，PI及其合作者确认了正则性假设。 在本提案中，我们的目标是研究这些方程的非局部变体，特别是分数快速扩散方程和分数多孔介质方程。这些方程为扩散过程不仅受邻近点影响，还受远处点影响的情景提供了模型。这一特性适用于各种实际现象，包括异质介质中的异常传输、热控制以及特定的生物、生态和金融模型。

16304124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16304124.value: 探索反應性鐵氧化物對濱海濕地潮間帶有機質保存的影響

16304124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16304124.value: Mangrove wetlands, which form a typical transitional zone between land and sea, are considered important carbon sinks due to their ability to sequester and fix atmospheric CO2. Among the various mechanisms involved in carbon storage, the burial of organic matter through mineral protection, particularly facilitated by reactive iron oxides, plays a crucial role in preserving organic carbon in mangrove ecosystems for extended periods. The association between reactive iron oxides and organic matter is influenced by the redox potential of the environment, with tidal fluctuations in the intertidal zone being a crucial environmental factor affecting the redox conditions. Existing studies have primarily focused on the burial efficiency of organic matter in mangroves, while neglecting to investigate the mechanism of the association between reactive iron oxides and organic matter during tidal processes. This proposed project aims to comprehensively explore the burial mechanisms of organic carbon binding to reactive iron oxides, considering the influence of tidal dynamics in coastal mangroves. Through a case study conducted in the Mai Po wetland of Hong Kong, we will investigate the regional characteristics of the interaction between reactive iron oxides and organic matter by analyzing the concentrations of reactive iron oxides and organic matter in sediment and porewater samples collected from the Gei Wai, mangrove, and mudflat areas. The binding capacity and modes of reactive iron oxides with organic matter, regulated by seasonal variations, will be demonstrated by comparing samples from wet and dry seasons. Furthermore, the molecular composition characteristics of long-term stored and buried organic matter will be uncovered using Fourier transform ion cyclotron resonance mass spectrometry (FT-ICR MS). The proposed project will employ a multidisciplinary approach, combining field sampling and observations, laboratory analyses including chemical analyses, optical spectroscopy, FT-ICR MS, and flow-through reactor experiments, followed by comprehensive data integration to uncover the mechanisms of organic carbon burial. This interdisciplinary project will contribute to the training of both undergraduate and postgraduate students in chemical oceanography, biogeochemistry, and hydrogeology. The findings of the proposed research will provide a theoretical basis for accurately assessing the carbon burial capacities of coastal wetlands and their role in the global carbon cycle. 紅樹林濕地是陸地與海洋之間典型的過渡帶，由於其固定和固定大氣中CO2的能力，被認為是重要的碳匯。在參與碳儲存的各種機制中，通過礦物保護埋藏有機物，特別是由活性氧化鐵促進的方式，在維持紅樹林生態系統中有機碳長期保存方面發揮著至關重要的作用。活性氧化鐵和有機物之間的關聯受環境的氧化還原電位影響，潮汐波動在潮間帶中是影響氧化還原條件的關鍵環境因素。現有研究主要集中在紅樹林中有機物的埋藏效率上，而忽視了在潮汐過程中活性氧化鐵和有機物之間關聯的機制。 本項目旨在全面探索有機碳與活性氧化鐵結合的埋葬機制，考慮到潮汐動力在沿海紅樹林中的影響。通過在香港米埔濕地進行的案例研究，我們將通過分析從基圍、紅樹林和泥灘地區收集的沈積物和孔隙水樣品中的活性氧化鐵和有機物濃度，來研究活性氧化鐵和有機物之間的區域特徵。通過比較濕季和旱季的樣品，將展示活性氧化鐵與有機物的結合能力和模式，受季節變化的調節。此外，將使用傅裏葉變換離子回旋共振質譜（FT-ICR MS）揭示長期保存和埋藏有機物的分子組成特徵。擬議項目將採用多學科方法，結合野外採樣和觀測、實驗室分析包括化學分析、光譜學、FT-ICR MS和流通反應器實驗，然後進行全面的數據整合，以揭示有機碳埋藏的機制。這個跨學科項目將有助於培養化學海洋學、生物地球化學和水文地質的研究生。本研究的發現將為準確評估沿海濕地的碳埋藏能力及其在全球碳循環中的作用提供理論基礎。

16304524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16304524.value: 朝向量子領域的超表面全息圖

16304524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16304524.value: In the recent decade, optical metasurfaces have been under active development, proving themselves not only potential candidates to make conventional optical components more compact, but also to bring new integrated functionalities, such as light-field imaging and polarization-enabled holograms. These are all due to the huge engineering flexibility in storing and revealing information through the nano-structures of the metasurfaces. On the other hand, we are witnessing a boost in quantum technologies, particularly driven by quantum entanglement as a new resource of operation, making quantum computations and simulations becoming accessible in future. It is exciting that the wavefront control capability from metasurfaces combined with quantum optical entanglement may enable a coming revolution in optics, not only making more compact quantum optical platforms but also bringing new techniques in imaging, quantum state manipulation, information processing and even a tool to study fundamental quantum physics. In this project, we will explore such applications enabled by metasurfaces in the quantum regime to control holograms. In particular, we focus on generating two-photon entangled states with metasurfaces. First, non-local entangled states with hybrid entanglement can be generated by transforming polarization-entangled states with a metasurface. Second, quantum holograms with single-photon or two-photon operations can be generated with metasurfaces. The demonstrations will bring an additional layer to metasurfaces’ wavefront control, allowing the possibility of entangled holograms for quantum state generation and quantum communication. 在過去的十年裡，研究人員積極發展光學超表面，不僅展示了其有潛力使傳統光學元件更加緊湊，還帶來了如光場成像和偏振啟用全息圖等新的集成功能。這一切歸功於研究人員能夠靈活地利用超表面納米結構來儲存和揭示信息。同時，我們見證了量子技術的快速增長，特別是由量子糾纏作為一種新資源所推動，使量子計算和量子模擬在未來變得更易實現。更令人興奮的是，當超表面的波前控制能力與量子光學糾纏結合時，可能會帶來光學領域的革命性變革，不僅能使量子光學平台更加緊湊，還將帶來成像、量子態操控、信息處理，甚至研究基礎量子物理的新技術。在這個項目中，我們將探索超表面在量子範疇內控制全息圖的應用。我們特別關注利用超表面來生成雙光子糾纏態。首先，我們將通過超表面轉換偏振糾纏態，來產生具有混合糾纏的非局域糾纏態。其次，我們將利用超表面生成單光子或雙光子操作的量子全息圖。這些演示將為超表面的波前控制增添新的層面和深度，從而實現糾纏全息圖在量子態生成和量子通信中的應用可能性。

16304724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16304724.value: The minor process of the complex Gaussian Wigner matrix (GUE) has been widely studied in the literature due to its deep connections with various other probabilistic models, such as last passage percolation and random tiling. A fundamental phase transition concerning the edge eigenvalues of the GUE minor process was discovered by Forrester and Nagao. The Forrester-Nagao transition states that the joint behavior of the top eigenvalues of a GUE and its minor undergoes a coupling-decoupling transition when the difference between the dimensions of two matrices crosses a threshold. The joint distribution of the top eigenvalues of the two matrices was explicitly depicted in their work. We have further noted that this phase transition is closely related to the eigenvector noise sensitivity problem of random matrices and also the law of the fractional logarithm for Wigner matrices. In this proposed project, we will first establish the universality of the Forrester-Nagao transition for the generally distributed Wigner minor process using a dynamic approach. We will then extend the discussion to the noise sensitivity problem and study the eigenvalue and eigenvector behavior of this model at the fluctuation level. Finally, we will further develop our method to a small deviation regime to establish the law of the fractional logarithm for Wigner matrices. 複高斯Wigner矩陣（GUE）的子矩陣過程在文獻中被廣泛研究，因為它與其他多種概率模型有深刻的聯繫，例如最後通過滲透和隨機鋪磚。Forrester和Nagao發現了一個關於GUE子矩陣過程邊上特徵值的基本相變。Forrester-Nagao相變指出，當兩個矩陣的維度差異超過一個閾值時，GUE及其子矩陣的頂端特徵值的聯合行為會經歷耦合-解耦轉變。他們的工作明確描述了這兩個矩陣的頂端特徵值的聯合分佈。 我們進一步注意到這個相變與隨機矩陣的特徵向量噪聲敏感性問題以及Wigner矩陣的分數對數律密切相關。在這個提議的項目中，我們將首先使用動力學方法建立一般分佈的Wigner子矩陣過程的Forrester-Nagao相變的普適性。然後我們將把討論擴展到噪聲敏感性問題，研究這個模型在波動層面上的特徵值和特徵向量行為。最後，我們將進一步發展我們的方法到小偏差範疇，以建立Wigner矩陣的分數對數律。

16304924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16304924.value: 大气颗粒物中水溶性和水不溶性有机氮干沉降特征与来源解析

16304924.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16304924.value: Prof FU, Tzung-May Dr Yu, Xu

16304924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16304924.value: 大气氮（N）沉降是向陆地和水生生态系统输入氮营养元素的重要途径。 对于无机氮（IN，主要包括硝酸盐和铵盐）沉降的观测已十分广泛，其环境影响也已得到了充分的评估。 相比之下，对有机氮（ON）沉降的监测则很缺乏。和IN类似，ON 同样可以被生物利用。 然而一直以来，准确测量气溶胶或雨水中ON总量是一个技术难题，特别是对于水不溶性ON（WION）这一部分。 近期，我们创建了一套仪器系统并建立分析方法，实现了对气溶胶IN和ON灵敏、简便的测量，从而为准确量化气溶胶ON和WION含量以及估算WION和水溶性ON（WSON）沉降量提供了有力的技术支撑。 本项目中，我们将于不同大气环境（包括城市、郊区/农村和森林地点）下采集分粒径气溶胶样品，分析样品中IN、WSON和WION的含量，获得气溶胶IN、WSON和WION的粒径分布以及估算它们的干沉降量。此外，本研究也将测定样品中尿素和氨基酸的含量，探查这些物种对ON含量的贡献。 由于气溶胶的大气沉降速度高度依赖其粒径大小，因此探查气溶胶含氮组分的粒径分布对估算其干沉降量十分重要。另外，考虑到不同地点的气溶胶氮组分的来源可能会有显着差异，因此有必要采集不同大气环境下的气溶胶样品。本研究将在香港的一个城市站点、一个郊区/农村的空气质量观测站，以及广东省的一个森林地点，使用微孔均匀沉积冲击器（MOUDI采样器）采集一年的分粒径气溶胶样品。随后，进行实验室分析测量所有样品中的氮组分（IN、WSON和WION）、有机碳/元素碳、水溶离子、尿素、氨基酸和有机源示踪物。 使用GEOS-Chem化学输送模型（CTM）估算不同气溶胶氮组分的沉降速度，并计算出其干沉降通量（沉降通量等于氮组分的大气浓度乘以对应的沉降速度）。 模型计算的结果将与干沉降直接观测结果进行对比来验证模型估算结果的可靠性。另外，将使用正定矩阵因子分解模型（PMF）结合测量的多种源指示物种来定量解析气溶胶WSON和WION的来源。本研究将揭示大气气溶胶ON沉降的量级和其来源组分，为利用模式研究精准刻画氮循环过程和评估相应的环境效应提供高质量的观测数据。

16305024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16305024.value: 二維偶極玻色氣體中 BKT 躍遷的表徵

16305024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16305024.value: Ultracold atoms have been successful in studying low-temperature quantum many-body phenomena, such as Bose-Einstein condensation and superfluidity. In two-dimensional systems, however, thermal fluctuations prevent Bose-Einstein condensation, but superfluidity can still occur at very low temperatures through the Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) transition mechanism. The BKT transition has been extensively investigated in ultracold atomic systems with isotropic short-range interactions. Recently, there has been growing interest in the new developments of ultracold magnetic atoms (e.g. lanthanide atoms), as they address a long-standing question - whether a dipolar gas of bosons with anisotropic interactions follows the BKT scenario in a two-dimensional system. This is particularly interesting because the ground state at low temperatures, exhibiting superfluidity under the BKT scenario, may reveal a stripe structure that leads to the emergence of a supersolid. Despite extensive theoretical study, the BKT mechanism in a dipolar bosonic system remains unclear and has rarely been observed experimentally in quantum systems. In the past few years, our group has made significant progress in producing magnetic erbium atoms in a two-dimensional trap and observing the first emergence of BKT superfluid in this dipolar system. Based on these developments, our goal in this project is to address several open questions regarding the generalization of conventional BKT theory to the dipolar system. Additionally, we aim to assess the effectiveness of classical-field simulations involving contact interactions in describing a dipolar scenario. During the proposed project, we will (1) investigate the BKT mechanism through the equation of state of the 2D dipolar system, (2) characterize anisotropic compressibility and non-local effects in harmonic and box-like potentials, and (3) measure roton excitation with erbium atoms in a box potential. This project will contribute to advancing our understanding of two-dimensional superfluidity in the presence of dipolar interactions. Importantly, it will also provide training for students in experimental atomic physics, quantum optics, and quantum materials. This will help develop a highly skilled workforce, strengthening research capacity in Hong Kong in the field of quantum science and technology. 超冷原子已經成功地研究了低溫量子多體現象，例如玻色-愛因斯坦凝聚和超流性。然而，在二維系統中，熱波動會阻止玻色-愛因斯坦凝聚，但透過別列津斯基-科斯特利茨-托利斯(BKT) 轉變機制，超流性仍然可以在非常低的溫度下發生。 BKT 轉變已在具有各向同性短程相互作用的超冷原子系統中得到廣泛研究。 最近，人們對超冷磁性原子（例如鑭係原子）的新發展越來越感興趣，因為它們解決了一個長期存在的問題——具有各向異性相互作用的玻色子偶極氣體是否遵循二維系統中的BKT 場景。這是特別有趣的，因為低溫下的基態在 BKT 場景下表現出超流動性，可能會揭示導致超固體出現的條紋結構。儘管進行了大量的理論研究，偶極玻色子系統中的 BKT 機制仍然不清楚，並且很少在量子系統中透過實驗觀察到。 在過去的幾年裡，我們的研究團隊在二維陷阱中產生磁性鉺原子以及觀察到該偶極系統中首次出現的BKT超流體方面取得了重大進展。基於這些進展，我們在這個計畫中的目標是解決將傳統 BKT 理論推廣到偶極系統的幾個懸而未決的問題。此外，我們的目標是評估涉及接觸交互作用的經典場模擬在描述偶極場景中的有效性。 在建議的項目中，我們將（1）透過二維偶極系統的狀態方程式研究BKT 機制，（2）表徵諧波和盒狀勢中的各向異性壓縮性和非局部效應，以及（3）測量旋轉鉺原子在盒勢中的激發。該專案將有助於增進我們對偶極相互作用存在下的二維超流性的理解。重要的是，它還將為學生提供實驗原子物理、量子光學和量子材料的培訓。這將有助於培養高技能勞動力，並加強香港在量子科學和技術領域的研究能力。

16305224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16305224.value: 利用范德華異質結構的磁輸運來探測二維磁性材料

16305224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16305224.value: Since the discovery of intrinsic ferromagnetism in exfoliated monolayer CrI3, many different magnetic phases and their properties have been demonstrated in the two-dimensional magnetic materials (2DMMs). Simultaneously, magnetic heterostructures have drawn significant attention as they offer exciting opportunities for manipulating magnetism at the nanoscale, paving the way for advancements in magnetic technology and spin-based electronics. The great achievement in twisted graphene systems has proved that twisting is an effective way to tailor the electronic band structures and aroused research interest in twisting of other 2D materials, such as transition metal dichalcogenides and magnetic materials. For instance, the periodic alternation of ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic orders was observed in twisted CrI3 superlattice. While transport research was focused on the magnetic behavior and mechanism in 2DMMs, more possibilities in 2DMMs-based junctions remain to be verified systematically, such as the engineering to control electron dynamics in 2D magnetic-based vdW heterostructures and moiré stacks. In this proposal, apart from finding the intriguing properties in 2DMM-based junctions, efforts will be dedicated to probing the interaction of the constituent materials. We propose to investigate the transport properties of 2D magnetic-based heterostructures and moiré stacks, using devices in tunneling or Hall-bar configuration, aiming at attaining insights into the correlation between the electronic structures and physical properties. These structures are designed to exploit the properties and interactions to achieve magnetic functionalities for potential application. 自從在剝離單層 CrI3 中發現本徵鐵磁性以來，許多不同的磁性相及其特性已在二維磁性材料 (2DMM) 中得到證明。同時，磁性異質結構也引起了人們的廣泛關注，因為它們為在奈米尺度上操縱磁性提供了令人興奮的機會，為磁性技術和基於自旋的電子學的進步鋪平了道路。扭曲石墨烯系統的巨大成就證明了扭曲是定制電子能帶結構的有效方法，並引起了人們對其他二維材料（例如過渡金屬二硫屬化物和磁性材料）扭曲的研究興趣。例如，在扭曲的 CrI3 超晶格中觀察到鐵磁性和反鐵磁序的周期性交替。雖然輸運研究主要集中在2DMM 中的磁性行為和機制，但基於2DMM 的結的更多可能性仍有待系統驗證，例如控制基於2D 磁性的vdW 異質結構和莫爾堆疊中的電子結構。在該提案中，除了尋找基於 2DMM 的結中有趣的特性之外，還將致力於探索組成材料的相互作用。我們建議使用隧穿或霍爾條器件來研究二維磁基異質結構和莫爾堆疊的傳輸特性，旨在深入了解電子結構和物理特性之間的相關性。我們設計這些結構是為了研究其特性和相互作用，以實現潛在磁功能的應用。

16305724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16305724.value: 低价金属卡拜化合物参与的末端炔烃复分解反应研究

16305724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16305724.value: Alkyne metathesis reactions are synthetically very useful reactions for organic synthesis and materials chemistry. These reactions are usually carried out with internal alkynes due to the characteristics of available catalysts. Terminal alkynes are common reagents for organic synthesis and are therefore also attractive substrates for alkyne metathesis reactions. However, their metathesis reactions have met with limited success and have only been demonstrated with a few high valent d0 Mo(VI) and W(VI) alkylidyne-based catalysts. In view of the wide uses of the user-friendly non-d0 ruthenium carbenes for metathesis of terminal olefins, it is desirable to develop terminal alkyne metathesis catalysts based on low valent non-d0 alkylidyne complexes. The main objective of the project is to develop chemistry that can help to develop catalysts for terminal alkyne metathesis based on low valent alkylidyne complexes. The main tasks are to study chemistry centered at metathesis reactions of terminal alkynes with low valent alkylidyne complexes to reveal factors affecting metathesis and non-metathesis pathways. The ultimate goal is to search for efficient and user-friendly catalysts for metathesis of terminal alkynes with a broad substrate scope. 炔烃复分解反应是一类非常重要的反应，常用于有机合成和材料化学。鉴于当前催化剂的特性，这些反应通常适用于内炔烃。末端炔烃是有机合成的常见试剂，因此它们也是炔烃复分解反应的潜在底物。然而，目前可用于末端炔烃复分解反应的催化剂还很少，仅有几个高价 d0 Mo(VI) 和 W(VI) 卡拜化合物具有这种催化活性。考虑到非d0钌卡宾化合物在催化末端烯烃复分解反应中已被广泛的应用，开发可用于末端炔烃复分解的低价非d0金属卡拜化合物催化剂具有较大的研究价值。该项目的主要目标是研发基于低价金属卡拜化合物的末端炔烃复分解反应催化剂。主要任务是研究以末端炔烃与低价金属卡拜化合物的复分解反应为中心的化学，揭示影响复分解和非复分解途径的规律。最终目标是寻找高效、用户友好且具有广泛底物适应性的末端炔烃复分解反应催化剂。

16305924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16305924.value: 氫氧化鈉-氫氧化鉀-水電解質中硝酸鹽電合成氨的高性能電催化劑的開發

16305924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16305924.value: 哈伯-博世過程將分子氮轉化為氨 ，會導致全球氮循環嚴重不平衡，進而留下大量碳足跡。這種不平衡導致硝酸鹽（即含有硝酸根離子的鹽）在全世界陸地和水中大量累積。通過電化學 硝酸根還原 (NO3RR) 將這些硝酸鹽轉化回 NH3 ，可以以永續的方式解決這個問題。然而，儘管在 NO3RR 電催化劑方面取得了重大進展，但在工業應用電流密度（>1000 mA cm−2）下實現高生產率仍然具有挑戰性。因此，需要開發高選擇性、高效且廉價的 NO3RR 電催化劑。本項目將通過開發基於地球上豐富的廉價金屬的新型電催化劑來解決這些問題，這些電催化劑可以在溫和溫度（80-250°C）的超高鹼度氫氧化鈉-氫氧化鉀-水電解質中以大電流密度將硝酸根催化為氨。具體來說，我們將製備一種合金電催化劑，可以降低工作電極電位和整體電池電位，同時在寬電流密度範圍（即250至3000 mA cm−2）內保持前所未有的法拉第效率（即> 92% ）。這將大大有利於廢水處理產業，並為開發哈伯-博世的可持續替代方案鋪平道路。

16306124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16306124.value: 透過行列子集選擇進行矩陣逼近的可證明高效算法

16306124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16306124.value: Column and row selection, a problem often encountered in various scientific and engineering fields such as machine learning and signal processing, involves approximating a large data matrix by choosing representative columns and rows from different source matrices. This research project aims to construct novel, provable, and efficient algorithms for two types of column and row selection problems: the generalized column and row subset selection (GCRSS) and the generalized CUR problem (GCUR). Our primary tool will be interlacing polynomials, a powerful and promising method that has recently facilitated the solution of several challenging and open problems in mathematics and computer science. We will explore enhanced error bounds by utilizing this method, with the expectation of deriving asymptotically sharp error bounds. Furthermore, we intend to develop new, provable algorithms to achieve these newly derived approximation errors. This will be accomplished by examining various acceleration techniques within the scope of the method of interlacing polynomials. From an algorithmic standpoint, the efficient and reliable algorithms developed in this project will significantly augment the scientific community's toolkit for managing large data matrices. Theoretically, the refined error bounds established in this project will not only enhance the precision of matrix approximation via column and row subset selection, but also deepen our comprehension of the method of interlacing polynomials and potentially reveal connections between this method and other mathematical domains. 列和行選擇是機器學習和訊號處理等各種科學和工程領域經常遇到的問題，涉及透過從不同源矩陣中選擇代表性列和行來逼近大數據矩陣。本研究計畫旨在為兩類列和行選擇問題建立新穎、可證明且高效的演算法：廣義列和行子集選擇（GCRSS）和廣義 CUR 問題（GCUR）。我們的主要工具將是交錯多項式，這是一種強大且有前途的方法，最近促進了數學和計算機科學中幾個具有挑戰性和開放性問題的解決。我們將利用這種方法來探索增強的誤差界，並期望導出漸近最優的誤差界。此外，我們打算開發新的、可證明的算法來實現這些新導出的逼近誤差。這將透過推導交錯多項式方法的各種加速技術來實現。從算法的角度來看，本項目開發的高效可靠的算法將顯著增強大數據矩陣處理的工具包。從理論上講，本項目中建立的細化誤差界不僅可以透過列和行子集選擇來提高矩陣逼近的精度，而且可以加深我們對交錯多項式方法的理解，並有可能揭示該方法與其他數學領域之間的聯繫。

16306224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16306224.value: 沿海城郊環境中短壽命鹵代烴的觀測研究

16306224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16306224.value: Halocarbons are primary cause of stratospheric ozone layer depletion and pose serious health risks, making them a priority for research since the 1970s. Furthermore, halocarbons are increasingly acknowledged to exert significant influences that affect both climate and air quality. The collective implementation of international agreements (e.g., Montreal Protocol) has controlled the production of most long-lived halocarbons (e.g., chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs), halons), and their abundances are slowly declining. However, there remains significant uncertainty on the rate of ozone layer recovery. One key uncertainty is the increasing emissions of uncontrolled short-lived halocarbons (SLHs) with a lifetime less than six months, as highlighted in the WMO Assessment of Stratospheric Ozone Depletion. As some short-lived halocarbons can reach the stratosphere through deep convention, it was suggested that they may delay the recovery of the stratospheric ozone hole by decades. Despite their ubiquitous presence, SLHs remain subject to substantial uncertainties regarding their abundances, emissions, and environmental impacts due to the paucity of continuous measurements. While SLHs can be emitted from complicated nature sources, recent studies suggested there was rapid and unexpected increase of anthropogenic emissions, especially in eastern and southeastern Asia. Based on our previous study results, we found there is a critical need for continuous measurement of SLHs in Hong Kong. In this proposed project, we plan to study the characteristics of major SLHs by conducting long-term measurements on a daily basis at a coastal suburban site in HKUST. Combining intensive measurements during episodic events, we will analyze the potential contributions from complicated emission and transport processes on their temporal variations. Utilizing observation data, we will conduct top-down emission estimation through both interspecies correlation method and Bayesian interference method, while emission results and uncertainties will be compared and assessed. The long-term observation data and emission estimates obtained from this project will provide valuable information in improving modeling the interactions between anthroposphere and biosphere. 鹵代烴是平流層臭氧耗損的主要原因，對健康構成嚴重威脅，自1970年代以來一直是研究的重點。此外，鹵代烴對氣候和空氣質素的影響日益受到重視。國際協議的協作實施（例如蒙特利爾議定書）已控制了大多數長壽命鹵代烴（例如氯氟烴、哈龍）的生產，它們的濃度正在緩慢下降。然而，臭氧層恢復的速率仍有顯著不確定性。正如世界氣象組織關於平流層臭氧耗損的評估所強調的，一個關鍵的不確定性是不受控制的短壽命鹵代烴的排放量不斷增加，雖然這些鹵代烴的壽命不到六個月。由於一些短壽命鹵代烴可以通過深層對流到達平流層，因此有研究指出它們可能會使平流層臭氧空洞的恢復延遲數十年。 儘管短壽命鹵代烴無所不在，但由於缺乏長期連續觀測，它們的豐度、排放量和環境影響仍存在大量不確定性。雖然短壽命鹵代烴可以來自複雜的自然來源，但最近的研究表明，特別是在東亞和東南亞，人為排放量出現了快速且意外的增加。根據我們先前的研究結果，發現香港對短壽命鹵代烴的連續觀測有著迫切的需求。在這個計畫中，我們計劃透過在香港科技大學的一個沿海城郊站點進行長期觀測，研究主要短壽命鹵代烴的特性。並在強污染事件期間的加強測量頻度，分析複雜的排放和傳輸過程對其變化的潛在貢獻。利用觀測數據，我們將透過物種間相關係數和貝葉斯推論方法進行自上而下的排放估算，同時將比較和評估排放結果和不確定性。該計畫獲得的長期觀測數據和排放估算將提供寶貴的信息，以幫助對人類圈和生物圈相互作用的模擬研究。

16306924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16306924.value: 界面上活性液晶的三維流體力學的計算研究

16306924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16306924.value: Active matter comprises a variety of out-of-equilibrium systems consisting of units that can utilize ambient free energy to self-propel or self-spin. Active matter exhibits many exotic behaviors not found in equilibrium systems, such as collective motion of their units (e.g., birds flocking and fish schooling). Studying active matter can help us understand the physical mechanisms that underlie living systems, and is also useful for applications such as soft robotics, biomimetics, and autonomous materials. Active liquid crystals (LCs) are an exemplary active-matter system composed of densely packed, elongated units, such as confluent cells and cytoskeletal polymers (e.g., microtubules and actin filaments). Many active LCs are confined to liquid interfaces, where they form two-dimensional (2D) active nematics hallmarked by self-propelled point-like defects and spontaneous flows. Planar and droplet interfaces harboring active nematics provide a versatile system to extend the applications of active matter and LCs. In 2D active nematic systems, spontaneous interfacial flows can propagate into bulk, forming “slaved” three-dimensional (3D) flows, reminiscent of Marangoni flows. In existing 2D theoretical and simulation efforts, these bulk flows are often represented by a friction term in the model, thereby functioning as a passive energy dissipator. Recent experiments suggest that these slaved flows may play a more nontrivial role in active nematic interfaces. One experiment suggests that a 3D flow slaved to an active droplet can regulate the motion of defects on its interface. In another experiment, an active ellipsoidal droplet was found self-spins near a substrate, which is believed to be caused by the slaved flow. However, the fluid dynamic mechanisms underlying these phenomena remain elusive, limiting their further applications. Therefore, in the proposed research, we plan to adopt a 3D hydrodynamic model to investigate how slaved and externally driven flows can be used to regulate active LCs on planar and droplet interfaces. Our model will be validated by comparing to the experimental data of a 2D active nematic over a topographic substrate provided by our collaborator. We will further use the model to study the dynamics of motile droplets with active nematic interfaces and their interactions in different scenarios, including near a wall and under a driven force. As such, the proposed research will unravel the physics of 3D flows in 2D active nematic systems, provide external flows as a control parameter to regulate active interfacial flows, and pave the way for emerging applications, including lab-on-a-chip technology, drug delivery, and photonics. 活性物質由各種非平衡系統組成，這些系統由可以利用環境自由能進行自推進或自旋轉的單元組成。活性物質展現出平衡系統所沒有的許多奇特行為，例如其單元的集體運動（例如鳥群和魚群）。研究活性物質可以幫助我們了解生命系統的物理機制，對於軟體機器人、生物仿生學和自主材料等應用也很有用。 活性液晶是一種典型的活性物質系統，由密集排列的細長單位組成，例如匯合細胞和細胞骨架聚合物 (例如微管和肌動蛋白絲)。許多活性液晶被限制在液體界面上，在那裡形成二維活性向列相，其特徵是自推動的點狀缺陷和自發的流動。含有活性向列相的平面和液滴界面提供了一個多功能系統來擴展活性物質和液晶的應用。在二維活性向列相系統中，自發的界面流可以傳播到液體內部，形成「從動」的三維流，類似於馬蘭戈尼流。在現有的二維理論與模擬工作中，這些三維流經常由模型中的摩擦項來表示，從而起到被動耗能器的作用。最近的實驗顯示，這些從動流可能在主動向列相中發揮更重要的作用。一項實驗表明，受控於活性液滴的三維流可以調節其界面上缺陷的運動。在另一個實驗中，一個活性橢圓液滴被發現在基板附近有自旋現象，這被認為是由於從動流所造成的。然而，這些現象背後的流體動力學機制仍然不清楚，限制了它們的進一步應用。 因此，在本研究中，我們計畫採用三維流體力學模型來研究如何利用從動流和外部驅動流來調節平面與液滴界面上的活性液晶。我們的模型將與合作夥伴提供的地形基板上的二維活性向列相實驗結果進行比較驗證。我們將進一步使用此模型來研究具有活性向列界面的動態液滴，以及它們在不同情境下 (包括靠近牆壁及在驅動力下) 的互相作用。 因此，擬開展的研究將揭示二維活性向列相系統中的三維流動的物理原理，提供外部流動作為調控參數來調節活性界面的流動，並為新興應用（包括晶片實驗室技術、藥物遞送和光子學）鋪路。

16307024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16307024.value: 二维蜂窝结构的光晶子/声晶子材料中的算子谱问题

16307024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16307024.value: Wave localization and confinement in lossless media are crucial for wave energy transport and manipulation. They find applications in designing waveguides, photonic integrated circuits, and optical switches, among others. This project is inspired by recent developments in topological materials that have introduced new mechanisms for wave confinement and localization. The aim of the project is to develop a rigorous mathematical theory for wave confinement in two-dimensional photonic/phononic systems with honeycomb structures. The focus will be on in-gap interface/edge eigenvalues that bifurcate from Dirac points. The associated eigenfunctions, known as interface/edge modes, are confined near the interface between two different periodic structures or the boundary of a truncated periodic structure. This project will analyze and characterize the existence of these modes and their dependence on the types of interfaces and truncation boundaries, as well as the boundary conditions imposed there. The mathematical theory will be developed using tools from quasi-periodic layer potential techniques, Gohberg-Sigal theory for operator-valued analytical functions and asymptotic expansions. 把波约束在无损介质中的限定区域对波能量的传输和操控至关重要。它们在设计波导、光子集成电路和光开关等方面具有广泛应用。该项目受到拓扑材料近期发展的启发、引入了局部区域约束波的新机制。项目的目标是为具有蜂窝结构的二维光晶子或声晶子系统中的波约束发展一个严格的数学理论。项目重点将放在能隙中从狄拉克点分岔出的界面/边界特征值上。这些特征值对应的特征函数被称为界面/边界模式，它们被限制在两个不同周期结构之间的界面附近或截断周期结构的边界上。该项目将分析和刻画这些模式的存在性及其对界面类型、截断边界类型以及边界条件的依赖性。项目将采用准周期层势技术、Gohberg-Sigal算子值解析函数理论和渐近展开等工具来发展数学理论。

16307124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16307124.value: 碳納米管中一維等離激元平衡態和非平衡態的近場紅外光譜學研究

16307124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16307124.value: Charge transportation in materials of regular dimensions, such as two-dimensional and three-dimensional systems, is generally attributed to directionally moving charged particles, such as electrons and holes. Although this conventional picture is valid in general, it breaks down when electrons are restricted to move only in a single direction, as in one dimension (1D). Unlike in higher dimensions, electrons in 1D have limited space to avoid one another to reduce Coulomb interactions by simply taking a new trajectory. The new traffic rule, due to the reduced dimensionality and inevitable strong electron correlation, prompts a new paradigm for charge transportation. In the new paradigm, the job of charge carrier is allocated to collective density waves of restricted electrons, which can be viewed as “water” waves in the 1D “electron” sea. Such a paradigm shift immediately engenders new species of elementary excitation, Tomonaga–Luttinger liquid (TLL) plasmons, of which an in-depth understanding is fundamentally important for condensed matter physics and its potential application. Recent advancements in sample quality and advanced near- field microscopy have enabled the first real-space imaging of TLL plasmons in single-wall carbon nanotubes (CNTs). However, despite the successful demonstration of TLL plasmons, these studies have been limited to regular-sized CNTs and to equilibrium state. The ultra-small (4-Å diameter) CNT, a near-perfect 1D system bearing even more intriguing physics due to its radically altered orbital environment and exponentially stronger electron-lattice coupling, has not been studied from the perspective of plasmons as elementary charge excitation. In the proposed project, we will use state-of-the-art ultrafast scattering-type scanning near-field optical microscopy, powered by both continuous-wave and ultrafast lasers, to perform a comprehensive nano-scale near-field microscopy study of 1D plasmons and determine their interaction with lattice modes, under the extreme geometrical limit offered by 4-Å CNTs, in both equilibrium and non-equilibrium states. The proposed project in a near-perfect 1D system will not only enrich our understanding of many-body interactions in reduced dimensionality but also establish new connections to many other perplexing phenomena in CNTs and in the even broader context of the carbon-based materials. Furthermore, the proposed study will provide new opportunities for the future real application of plasmonic-based communication and sensing devices with enhanced functionality. 通常二維和三維材料中的電荷輸運，是由帶電粒子（例如，電子和空穴）的定向移動完成的。這種物理圖像一般情況下適用，但在一維電荷體系中，由於維度降低的影響，會逐漸失效。一維體系中的電子不會像高維體系中的電子那樣，爲減少庫倫相互作用的強度，可以簡單的通過自由選擇新的運動軌跡而互相規避。因此，一維體系中的電荷輸運將遵從全新的“交通規則“。在新的規則中，電荷的空間轉移不由單獨電子的運動完成，而是由類似“水波”的實空間電荷密度波作爲載體進行傳輸，其對應的元激發模式在一維情形下稱作“湯川-拉廷格”（TLL）等離激元。近年來，樣品質量的提升和近場光學的發展使得納米尺度上對碳納米管中的實空間成像研究成爲可能。然而，現有的研究局限於稍大尺寸碳納米管平衡態下的物理研究。小尺寸碳納米管，是一個接近完美的一維電子系統，因而承載了更豐富的物理現象。這些現象被認爲來源於其中顯著增強的原子軌道環境和強電子-晶格耦合效應。目前人們還未對其中的物理，以等離激元作為出發點進行研究。在本研究課題中，我們會結合使用基於連續和脈衝輸出激光的散射型近場光學顯微技術，在平衡態和非平衡態下，對碳納米管中一維等離激元以及其與晶格模式的相互作用，進行系統性的納米尺度近場光譜學研究。該研究不僅能夠讓我們更加充分的理解接近完美一維電子系統中的多體相互作用，而且有可能建立與碳納米管中一些懸而未決的物理現象的新聯繫點，並在碳基材料這一更廣闊背景下形成新的物理認知。更近一步，這些研究內容可以爲等離激元在通訊、探測和傳感器件等領域的實際應用帶來新的機會。

16307324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16307324.value: 在全球海洋模式中實現地形坡度與動力尺度感知的中尺度湍流參數化

16307324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16307324.value: 海洋環流模式是描述海洋物理特徵和生物地球化學狀態的核心工具，進而被廣泛應用於地球系統氣候預測。該類工具的預測力高度依賴於其以何種方式表徵海洋中尺度湍流（即海洋中無處不在的、水平尺度為10到100公里的旋轉流體結構）所引發的一系列過程。用於氣候預測的現代海洋環流模式已經逐漸能夠解析大洋深海環境中的中尺度湍流。然而，受限於計算條件，即便當今最強大的超級計算機也無法使全球海洋環流模式完全解析大陸坡海域的中尺度湍流；而該類區域的中尺度湍流主導了近海與深海之間的交換過程、從而調節具有全球影響力的近岸過程（例如：沿海生態系統、沿海淡水輸入的再分佈、高密度陸架水的形成與冰川的消融）。現有海洋環流模式中表徵未解析的中尺度湍流的方法，即中尺度湍流參數化，要麼假設平坦的海底、要麼會輕易抹除已解析的中尺度湍流過程，從而不可避免的引入氣候變化條件下針對海洋狀態預測的顯著偏差。 通過本研究項目，我們將開發一種新型的、同時具備物理與數值自適性的中尺度湍流參數化，稱其為GEOM_slope參數化方案；一旦應用在全球海洋環流模式中，該參數化將自動“感知”（I）當前是否處於大陸坡海域、以及（II）中尺度湍流在當前區域內能否被足夠解析或應當被參數化。GEOM_slope方案可以如此先進，是因為它將首次融合本研究項目團隊近期所發布的兩種最前沿的研究工具：一套基於物理機理的用於量化大陸坡海域中尺度湍流效應的標度律，以及一套預防在線參數化方案與可解析湍流之間產生非物理相互作用的數值方法。為有效評估GEOM_slope方案對於海洋物理狀態預測的影響，我們將在一套全球海洋環流模式中寫入該方案，並根據全球海洋水文、環流、及熱量收支的觀測數據評估改進後的海洋環流模式的預測力。此外，基於全球海洋環流模式的實驗將通過一套基於區域性的、計算可行的“測試平台”模式實驗得到有效提升；該套“測試平台”模式包含了真實海洋環境中環流和海底地形的主要特徵，進而有助於優化GEOM_slope方案在普遍的海洋物理環境和數值模式配置中的預測力。本項目完成後，GEOM-slope方案的源代碼將面向海洋與氣候研究領域公開，進而致力於下一代氣候模式預測力的提升。

16307524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16307524.value: 一些关于Niho指数的公开问题

16307524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16307524.value: 在这个提案中，我们将研究与Niho指数相关的两种不同类型的问题。第一个子项目涉及Niho类型指数的互相关分布。我们将关注Niho原始博士论文中的一些开放性问题，比如在$\mathbb{F}_{2^{2m}}$上对于$d=4(2^m-1)+1$和$d=2^{m+2}+2^m-3$的互相关分布。我们还将研究具有许多Niho类型非零元的循环码的两个开放性问题。第二个子项目是研究来自Niho指数的2对1函数。我们将主要关注两类四项式。近年来，这些函数因其多种加密属性（如置换、APN、差分谱和回飞均匀性）而得到广泛研究。预计将发现许多新的2对1函数。以上提到的所有这些问题在该领域中都很重要，项目负责人在近期对相关问题取得了一些新进展，这些进展主要是基于他最近的研究成果。

16308224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16308224.value: 開發用於對映選擇性反應的新型雙功能氮雜環卡賓催化劑

16308224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16308224.value: 本項目旨在設計並合成創新的雙功能氮雜環卡賓催化劑，以顯著擴展其在催化反應中的應用範圍。啟發於自然界中酶催化機制，我們計劃開發新穎的方法，在氮雜環卡賓骨架中引入輔助功能基團，從而提升這些催化劑在合成複雜手性分子方面的效能。為了達成此目標，我們將設計、合成新型的雙功能氮雜環卡賓催化劑，研究額外功能基團對催化性能的影響，並應用這些新催化劑於解決目前面臨挑戰的多類不對稱化學反應。項目的最終目的是擴大氮雜環卡賓催化劑的應用領域，同時提高其催化效率與立體選擇性。 項目的主要任務是深入探討兩個催化活性基團之間的距離與相對位置對反應活化、選擇性以及在不對稱反應中的耐受性。為此，我們的研究內容如下： 1. 設計和合成新型雙功能氮雜環卡賓催化劑：採用多樣化的合成策略，並結合人工智能模型來協助催化劑的設計和優化。通過製備具有不同空間排布的雙功能基團催化劑，精確控制氮雜環卡賓與次級功能基的空間排布。 2. 探討雙功能基團的協同作用：研究不同空間排布的雙功能基團在各種不對稱反應中的表現。進行一系列機理研究，包括反應動力學、密度泛函理論計算和光譜技術，以揭示催化劑結構特徵與催化選擇性之間的關係。這些研究將為控制不對稱選擇性的因素提供重要的啟示。 3. 在困難不對稱反應中的應用：探索雙功能氮雜環卡賓催化劑在一系列具有挑戰性的不對稱反應中的應用，特別是那些目前缺乏有效解決方案或存在重要不足的化學反應，以展示新催化劑在不對稱催化領域的作用和潛力。 本項目將開發仿生新雙功能性氮雜環卡賓，提升這類催化劑在複雜不對稱合成反應中的選擇性和功能性。這一研究不僅將加深對氮雜環卡賓催化的理解，還將為開發高效和高選擇性的催化劑奠定堅實的基礎。

16308924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16308924.value: 驅動溫帶海洋低雲季節變化和氣候反饋的顯著物理過程的研究

16308924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16308924.value: Climate model estimates of the global-mean surface temperature increase following a doubling of CO2, known as the equilibrium climate sensitivity (ECS), are subject to large uncertainties. The shortwave low cloud feedback plays a predominant role in driving the inter-model differences in ECS. Recent studies have demonstrated a strong correlation between the seasonal variations of the marine low cloud fraction in the extratropics (30-60N/S) and the long-term climate feedback of these clouds. However, discrepancies exist in utilizing the seasonal variations of the extratropical low cloud fraction (ELCF) to infer the likelihood of ECS. To justify the efficacy of ELCF's seasonal cycle as an emergent constraint on ECS and to inform the development of next-generation climate models, we must address the following questions: Q1: What is the phase of the ELCF's seasonal cycle? Does it peak in winter or summer? Q2: How do extratropical cyclones affect the seasonal variations of ELCF? Q3: How do extratropical cyclones influence the long-term trends of ELCF, and is this influence similar to the seasonal cycle? Q4: What are the relative roles of extratropical cyclones and lower tropospheric inversion strength in shaping long-term ELCF trends? Q5: Which model parameters exert the most significant influence on ELCF's seasonal variations and long-term trends? Q6: What are the realistic ranges of model parameters that can faithfully simulate ELCF variability in accordance with observations? To address these questions, we propose an integrated approach that combines observational data analysis and climate model simulations. Our aim is to unravel the dominant physical processes that drive the seasonal variations of ELCF and their associated climate feedbacks, pinpoint key model parameters that contribute to the uncertainties and use observations to constrain the model parameters. In Year 1, we will analyze various satellite and ground-based observations, along with field campaign data, to address Q1 and Q2. In Year 2, we will analyze CMIP6 model simulations to answer Q3 and Q4. Additionally, we will conduct specially designed experiments with CESM2 to test hypotheses and reveal underlying physical mechanisms. Year 3 will be devoted to tackling Q5 and Q6 by analyzing a set of perturbed parameter ensembles (PPEs) from several global climate models. Furthermore, we will use observations to constrain the model parameters and improve the accuracy of model predictions. The proposed study will enhance our understanding of the climate system response to increasing greenhouse gases and contribute to better-informed policymaking toward climate resilience and sustainable development. 氣候模式對二氧化碳濃度增加一倍後全球平均地表溫度上升的估計(即平衡氣候敏感度, ECS)存在很大不確定性。其中, 低雲短波輻射反饋是導致模式間差異的主要因素。最新研究表明, 溫帶海洋上空低雲雲量(ELCF)的季節變化與其長期氣候反饋緊密相關。然而, 利用ELCF季節變化來推斷ECS高低存在很大差異。 為了驗證ELCF季節變化作為ECS新興約束的有效性, 並為下一代氣候模型開發提供指導, 本研究擬解決以下問題: 1. ELCF季節變化的位相特徵,即峰值出現在冬季還是夏季? 2. 溫帶氣旋如何影響ELCF的季節變化? 3. 溫帶氣旋如何影響ELCF的長期趨勢? 4. 溫帶氣旋和對流層逆溫強度對ELCF長期趨勢的相對作用? 5. 哪些模式參數最顯著影響ELCF的季節變化和長期趨勢? 6. 能夠準確再現觀測ELCF變化的模式參數取值範圍是多少? 本研究將採用結合觀測分析和氣候模式模擬的綜合方法, 以揭示驅動ELCF季節變化的主要物理過程及其相關氣候反饋, 找出導致模式不確定性的關鍵參數, 並利用觀測資料對模式參數進行約束。 該研究有助於增進我們對氣候系統對溫室氣體增加的響應的理解, 為氣候適應和可持續發展决策提供更有依據的科學支撐。

16309224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16309224.value: 希格斯玻色子衰變到τ輕子的新物理

16309224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16309224.value: 2012 年，CERN 大型強子對撞機 (LHC) 發現了希格斯玻色子，完成了粒子物理標準模型 (SM) 難題的核心部分。在接下來的十年裡，大型強子對撞機實驗中對希格斯玻色子特性的理解取得了顯著的進展。儘管大型強子對撞機沒有直接探測到新物理的明顯跡象，但粒子物理學和宇宙學中仍然存在許多懸而未決的問題，例如觀察到的宇宙物質-反物質不對稱性、SM粒子的質量等級、中微子質量的起源、暗物質的本質以及宇宙的演化，可能會對希格斯玻色子的詳細性質產生影響。對希格斯玻色子及其與基本粒子相互作用的更完整、精確的描述，可以引導我們探索這些問題中的新物理。 經過幾年的維修期，世界上最大最強力的粒子對撞機LHC現已在第三個數據採集階段中全面恢復運行，對其中的粒子探測器提供更高的數據速率和 13.6 TeV 的最高碰撞能量。未來幾年，它將提供比先前數據採集期多兩倍的數據。 ATLAS探測器中的數據選擇系統也進行了重大升級，以應對更高的數據速率。這些新系統將以更有效的方式探測到碰撞後產生的粒子，並記錄更廣泛帶有趣特徵的數據。 此 GRF 計畫旨在利用 τ 輕子終態擴展對希格斯玻色子產生以及其與基本粒子相互作用的研究。香港ATLAS研究團隊的成員對ATLAS的探測器的操作和數據分析作出了重大貢獻，包括對希格斯玻色子在輕子終態性質的研究做出了領先貢獻，以及對希格斯玻色子與輕子相互作用中CP不守恒的首次搜尋。擬議的研究基於這些成就，利用2022 年開始收集的新數據集，將團隊的專業知識擴展到更廣泛的希格斯玻色子特性研究。這些研究將為提高下一步希格斯玻色子特性測量的精確度提供必要的工具，並為 ATLAS 中重建 τ 輕子的性能研究做出貢獻。

16309424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16309424.value: 3D 空间转录组学数据分析的计算和统计方法的开发

16309424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16309424.value: 空间转录组学（ST）技术的出现引发了科学研究的革命，使得能够在细胞的原生空间环境中评估表达水平成为可能，涵盖了数千甚至数百万个细胞。这一突破性进展为在三维空间中探究组织提供了无与伦比的机会，尤其是当利用ST技术获得了多个二维切片时。然而，与传统的2D ST数据分析相比，3D ST数据分析面临着重大挑战。首先，3D ST数据分析要求将多个组织切片整合成一个连贯整体，导致了相当大的计算复杂性。其次，在切片之间存在的批次效应在3D ST数据分析中构成了重要障碍。这些批次效应由样本处理过程中的技术变异引起，可能会在分析结果中引入不一致性。第三，细胞类型的复杂组成经常会混淆3D ST数据中的空间变化表达模式，可能会掩盖宝贵的生物学见解。这些挑战凸显了需要创新的统计和计算方法，以有效发挥ST技术的全部潜力。 本研究提出了一个用于3D ST数据分析的统一概率框架。我们的目标是检测具有生物学解释力的空间域，估计每个空间点的细胞类型比例，并识别3D中的空间变化表达模式。在我们的试点研究中，我们开发了一种方法，同时实现了两个关键任务：3D中的空间域检测和细胞类型解卷积。值得注意的是，我们的方法引入了空间点的潜在表示，并将这些相互关联任务之间的共享信息纳入分析中，增强了分析的准确性和稳健性。此外，我们的方法有效地考虑和纠正了切片之间的批次效应，缓解了其对结果的影响。我们试点研究的结果展示了我们的方法相对于基于2D ST数据的现有方法的卓越性能。在此成功的基础上，我们的目标是将我们的概率框架扩展到识别3D中的空间变化表达模式。通过将细胞类型感知的空间模式推断构建为一个假设检验问题，我们的扩展框架提供了对假阳性的有效控制和高统计功效。

16309924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16309924.value: 全磁性絕緣體異質結構中的交換耦合和新奇相態

16309924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16309924.value: Magnonics, the science of wave excitations or 'magnons' in magnetic systems, holds promise for processing and transmitting information without charge current. This field emphasizes coherent magnon currents, which are capable of encoding information and forming interference patterns for computation. These currents bypass the need for charge current and, consequently, Joule heating. However, a key challenge is the decay of magnon propagation, mainly influenced by the damping factor of the magnetic material. Magnetic insulators such as yttrium iron garnet (YIG) have low damping, making them suitable for magnonics research. Researchers have been extending the scope of magnetic insulator magnonics by introducing hybrid systems consisting of a magnetic insulator and a ferromagnetic metal, which are promising for coherent magnon-magnon coupling, novel magnon transport properties, and topological phases. However, these metals often exhibit high damping factors, which induce high dissipation rates, reduce decay length, and limit transmission distance. To address this, this proposed project focuses on exploring all-magnetic-insulator heterostructures, specifically YIG and thulium iron garnet (TmIG) bilayers. These have shown promising preliminary results, including low dissipation rates and strong magnon-magnon coupling. However, the physical mechanisms and electronic control of exchange couplings in these structures are still not well understood. Also, despite theoretical predictions, whether these all-magnetic-insulator heterostructures can host topological phases remains elusive. We plan to design and grow YIG/TmIG multilayers and study exchange couplings and topological phases by using various probes and adjusting material system parameters. The probes include magnetometers and ferromagnetic resonance techniques, and the parameters include field strength, angle, temperature, and magnetic insulator layer thickness. We aim to understand the electronic control of exchange couplings potentially through current-induced spin-orbit torques. We will also fabricate thin multilayer films into nanodevices to study magnon band structures through propagating spin-wave spectroscopy. We anticipate enhanced nonreciprocity and increased decay length in the topological nontrivial phase. The project is highly feasible as the research team has extensive experience in magnetic insulators, spin-orbit torques, topological insulators, and ferromagnetic resonance, and collaborations with the experimental magnetic insulator growth group and magnon theory group. The proposed project aims to provide insights into exchange coupling, its electronic control, and topological phases in all-magnetic-insulator systems. The results of this proposed project are anticipated to enrich magnonics knowledge and set the foundation for ultra-low-power magnonic devices based on all-magnetic-insulator heterostructures. 磁子學，即研究磁性系統中波激發或"磁子"的科學，預計在不產生電荷電流的情況下處理和傳輸資訊。該領域強調相干磁子電流，這種電流能夠編碼資訊並形成用於計算的干涉圖案。這些電流繞過了對電荷電流的需求，因此也避免了焦耳熱的產生。然而，一個關鍵挑戰是磁子傳播的衰減，這主要受磁性材料阻尼因子的影響。釔鐵石榴石等磁性絕緣體具有低阻尼特性，使其成為磁子學研究的理想材料。研究人員透過引入由磁性絕緣體和鐵磁金屬組成的混合系統，正在擴展磁性絕緣體磁子學的範圍，這些系統在相干磁子-磁子耦合、新型磁子傳輸特性和拓撲相態方面很有前景。然而，這些金屬通常表現出高阻尼因子，導致高耗散率、減少衰減長度並限制傳輸距離。 為解決此問題，本計劃建議專注於探索全磁性絕緣體異質結構，特別是釔鐵石榴石和铥鐵石榴石雙層。這些結構已顯示出令人鼓舞的初步結果，包括低耗散率和強磁子-磁子耦合。然而，這些結構中交換耦合的物理機制和電子控制還不太清楚。此外，儘管有理論預測，但這些全磁性絕緣體異質結構是否能承載拓樸相態仍未知。我們計劃設計和生長釔鐵石榴石/铥鐵石榴石多層結構，並透過使用各種探測手段和調整材料系統參數來研究交換耦合和拓撲相態。探測方法包括磁強計和鐵磁共振技術，而參數包括場強、角度、溫度和磁性絕緣體層厚度。我們的目標是理解交換耦合的電子控制，可能透過電流誘導的自旋軌道力矩來實現。我們也將薄多層膜製成奈米元件，透過傳播自旋波譜學研究磁子帶結構。我們預期在拓樸非平凡相中會出現增強的非互易性和增加的衰減長度。 該專案具有很高的可行性，因為研究團隊在磁性絕緣體、自旋軌道力矩、拓撲絕緣體和鐵磁共振方面有豐富的經驗，並與實驗磁性絕緣體生長組和磁子理論組合作。本計劃旨在提供對全磁性絕緣體系統中交換耦合、其電子控制和拓樸相態的深入理解。預計本計劃的結果將豐富磁子學知識，並為基於全磁性絕緣體異質結構的超低功耗磁子裝置奠定基礎。

16310824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16310824.value: 空間共軛簇受體的設計用於高效穩定的有機太陽能電池

16310824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16310824.value: Non-fullerene acceptors (NFAs) have emerged as an important class of material enabling high-efficiency organic solar cells (OSCs). There are generally three types of acceptors, including small-molecule acceptors (SMAs), polymer acceptors (PAs) and oligomer acceptors (OAs), each endowed with different strengths and limitations. SMAs, for instance, excel in efficiency but are somewhat lacking in device stability. In contrast, PAs exhibit superior stability, albeit at the cost of reduced efficiency and batch-to-batch reproducibility due to weak crystallinity and inconsistent molecular weight distribution respectively. To address the trade-off between PAs and SMAs, OAs have emerged to offer stability akin to PA-based devices while affording precise molecular weight control to enhance packing and charge transport for efficiencies. Like polymerization, the end group is the most common site for oligomerization, which has led to some efficient dimeric acceptors. In this project, instead of focusing on linear oligomeric acceptors based on the Y6 backbone, we propose to develop a series of non-linear cluster types of OAs (in this proposal, we will refer them as cluster acceptors). The concept of cluster acceptors has been demonstrated in our prior research at Prof. He Yan’s group in Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST). For instance, we connected four perylene diimide (PDI) units to a tetraphenylethylene core, forming a tetramer cluster with a propeller-shaped molecular geometry. For this project, we intend to design a series of cluster acceptors, including tetramers, pentamers and hexamers. Unlike their linear counterparts, which can only form "end-to-end" connections, our cluster acceptors offer a completely different molecular geometry with different through-space conjugation and electron delocalization properties. Moreover, some of these molecular configurations could enhance intramolecular π-π stacking and through-space conjugation through the overlap between different monomer units which will be beneficial for charge transport and exciton dissociation. The proposed cluster strategy will open up new avenues for material development of OSCs. Our research group at HKUST led by the PI and Co-I (Dr. Han Yu and Prof. He Yan) has been one of the leading research groups in the field of OSCs, PAs and SMAs. Through our extensive work in developing numerous acceptor materials, we have cultivated a profound understanding of molecular design principles for NFAs. Our previous success in NFA design and devices optimisation can give us invaluable insight for the development of the new cluster acceptors. 非富勒烯受體已成為一類重要的材料用於實現高效能有機太陽能電池。他們通常有三種類型的受體：小分子受體，聚合物受體和低聚物受體，每一種都有不同的優點和限制。例如小分子受體，在效率方面表現出色，但在裝置穩定性方面有所欠缺。相較之下,聚合物受體表現出優異的穩定性，儘管是以降低效率和批次重複性為代價，是由於聚合物弱結晶度和不一致的分子量分佈。為了平衡聚合物和小分子受體之間的裝置效率與穩定性，低聚物受體被開發並提供了類似於聚合物受體的裝置穩定性，以及像小分子一樣精確控制的分子量，以保證堆積和電荷傳輸。在聚合時，端基是最常見的偶合位點，基於此已有一些高效率的二聚體低聚物受體報告。 在本項目中，我們不再關注基于Y6的綫性低聚物受體，在此基礎上，我們計劃開發一系列非綫性低聚簇分子受體（在本項目中，我們將其成爲簇受體)。簇受體的概念在我們香港科技大學顔河教授課題組的前期研究中得到過闡釋。例如，我們以四苯基乙烯爲核心連接了四個苝二醯亞胺單元，形成了一個四聚體的簇受體，其具有螺旋槳形狀的分子結構。對于本項目，我們計劃設計一系列簇受體，包括四聚體、五聚體和六聚體。不像他們的綫性對應物，只能形成“尾-尾”連接，我們的簇受體可以提供一個完全不同的分子幾何形狀與不同的電子空間共軛和電子離域的性質。此外，其中一些分子構型可以增强分子內π-π堆積和電子空間共軛，主要是通過不同單體單元之間的重叠形成共軛，這將有利于電荷輸運和激子解離。我們提出的簇受體策略將爲有機太陽能電池材料的開發開闢一個新途徑。 我們在科大的研究小組由課題負責人及共同課題負責人(于涵博士及顔河教授)一直是有機太陽能電池, 聚合物受體和小分子受體領域的主要研究小組之一。基于我們之前在開發大量受體材料方面的工作，我們對于非富勒烯受體分子的設計原理已經積累了的深刻經驗與理解。我們在之前非富勒烯受體的設計工作和器件優化方面的成功可以爲我們提供寶貴的見解用于開發全新的簇受體材料。

16310924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16310924.value: α-手性羰基化合物不對稱合成新策略的發展

16310924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16310924.value: Nature is full of chirality. Chiral molecules have important relevance to human health and daily life. Therefore, the ability to synthesize chiral molecules reflects our ability to improve human health and life quality to some degree. In this context, asymmetric synthesis has become one of the major pillars of modern organic synthesis. One of the key aspects in asymmetric synthesis is to effectively generate chiral centers. Among all those chiral centers, the chiral carbon at the α-position of carbonyl compounds are particularly important in drug development and organic synthesis. In this project, we propose to a series of new catalytic asymmetric reactions for the efficient synthesis of diverse α-chiral carbonyl compounds. Specifically we will take advantage of two types of previously less-explored molecules, namely α-carbonyl sulfur ylides (including their precursors) and strained four-membered rings. In particular, sulfonium cations have unique properties to serve as both charged species as well as a leaving group, which allow the highly useful ion pairing catalysis to be implemented. Moreover, asymmetric ring-opening of strained four-membered heterocycles with enolate/enamine nucleophiles will lead to the efficient generation of both α-chiralilty and another remote stereogenic center/functionality in an efficient way. By combining organocatalysis and synergistic catalysis, these new approaches will offer complementary solutions to those conventional strategies. These studies will fundamentally advance organic synthesis. For example, some of the processes studied here (e.g., catalytic asymmetric α-halogenation using aqueous halide anion toward acyclic α-tertiary ketones) have remained as unsolved problems so far by conventional approaches. These studies also have meaningful practical applications. Successful execution of this project will provide green access to useful molecules with strong relevance to human life, including chiral drug development, materials science, and environmental sustainability. 大自然充滿了手性。手性分子對人類健康和日常生活具有重要意義。因此，合成手性分子的能力在一定程度上反映了我們改善人類健康和生活品質的能力。在此背景下，不對稱合成已成為現代有機合成的主要支柱之一。不對稱合成的關鍵之一是高效能建構手性中心。其中羰基化合物α位的手性中心在藥物開發和有機合成上尤其重要。在本專案中，我們擬實現一系列新的催化不對稱反應用於高效合成各種α-手性羰基化合物。具體來說，我們將利用兩種類型的先前較少探索的分子，即α-羰基硫葉立德（包括它們的前體）和張力四元環。特別是，硫鎓離子具有獨特的性質，既可以充當帶電物種，又可以充當離去基團，從而可以實現非常有用的基於陰陽離子對的催化反應。此外，張力四元雜環與烯醇/烯胺親核試劑的不對稱開環將可以高效地建構α-手性和另一個遠程立體中心/官能基。通過將有機催化和協同催化相結合，這些新方法將為這些傳統策略提供補充解決方案。本專案中涉及的一些反應（例如，使用含水鹵化物陰離子催化非環狀α-叔酮的不對稱α-鹵化）仍然是傳統有機合成未解決的問題。這些研究也具有實際應用價值。本計畫的成功實施將為獲取與人類生活密切相關的有用分子提供綠色途徑，包括手性藥物開發、材料科學和環境可持續性。

16311324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16311324.value: 近岸海洋沉積物中溫室氣體一氧化二氮的循環和通量

16311324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16311324.value: 一氧化二氮 (N2O) 是一種強效溫室氣體，對全球暖化有顯著影響。在過去一個世紀，大氣中一氧化二氮的濃度迅速增加，這不僅是由於農業和工業來源的排放，更是由自然生物地球化學循環的擾動所造成，在近岸海洋尤甚。近岸海洋沉積物控制水柱 N2O 動力學，從而調節 N2O 向大氣中的排放。然而，近岸海洋沉積物中 N2O 通量尚未得到很好的定量，且沉積物 N2O 循環的機理尚未明確。 擬議的工作將量化沉積物 N2O 通量並研究其對香港週邊沿海海洋生態系統的控制。我們將研究多個季節和不同鹽度、營養物濃度、氧氣水平、初級生產力和有機物沉積的不同條件下的沉積物。我們將結合多種方法，包括現場採樣、地球化學和微生物分析、實驗室實驗和數值模型計算。我們將進行1) 氮和其他相關元素（例如氧、碳和鐵）在沉積物中性質表徵和通量測量，2)沉積物中N2O 的產生和消耗涉及的關鍵功能標記基因進行分子分析，以及 3) 關鍵代謝途徑的穩定同位素示蹤。擬議的工作將是對該地區沉積物氮生物地球化學和 N2O 通量的首次徹底調查。它將填補我們在沉積物氮循環方面的知識空白，幫助限制區域氮預算和生物地球化學循環，並支持當前和未來的生態系統和氣候建模工作。所獲得的沉積物 N2O 循環機制的基礎知識不僅有利於當地學界，而且可以轉移到其他地方類似的動態沿海環境，使我們能夠預測沿海生物地球化學動態隨氣候變化的反饋。

16311424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16311424.value: 平帶超導體的量子度規效應研究

16311424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16311424.value: Recently, the discovery of moiré materials such as twisted bilayer graphene and moiré transition metal dichalcogenides has enabled the creation of very flat electronic bands. In moiré materials with very flat bands, the kinetic energy of the electrons is suppressed, and interaction effects become very important. As a result, many novel states, such as superconducting states, valley-polarized quantum anomalous Hall states, and fractional Chern states, have been discovered in moiré materials. Importantly, there is one fundamental and interesting property about flat bands: the absence of conventional electronic length scales. In conventional metals, the Fermi wavelength 1/k_F, where k_F is the Fermi momentum, is a natural electronic length scale that determines many of the material's properties, such as the period of the charge density wave and the Friedel oscillation. However, k_F is not well defined in a complete flat band. In a conventional superconductor, the superconducting coherence length, which is proportional to the Fermi velocity v_F, is a natural length scale. However, v_F is zero in a flat band. Therefore, what should be the superconducting coherence length in a flat band superconductor? Recently, we pointed out that, in a flat band superconductor, the natural electronic length scale is defined by the quantum metric. The quantum metric describes the "quantum distance" between two quantum states and has the dimension of length squared. In a recent work, we showed that the Cooper pair size of a flat band superconductor is determined by the quantum metric. As the coherence length is a fundamental length scale in a superconductor, it is believed that many of the physical quantities in flat band superconductors are also determined by the quantum metric. In this proposal, we propose to study the sizes of the Andreev bound states, the Yu-Shiba states, and the topological bound states to determine how they are affected by the quantum metric. Moreover, the impact of the quantum metric will go beyond the superconducting state. This proposal aims to study the quantum metric effects on the excitonic size of flat band materials as well. In particular, we would like to show that the minimal size of an exciton is indeed determined (lower bound) by the quantum metric. The proposed studies are at the frontier of the study of quantum metric, and they will lay the foundation for further understanding of flat band materials. 最近，莫爾材料（如轉角雙層石墨烯和莫爾過渡金屬二硫屬化物）的發現使得非常平的電子能帶成為可能。在具有平帶的莫爾材料中，電子動能受到抑制，相互作用效應因而變得極為重要。因此，許多新奇物態如超導、谷極化量子反常霍爾態和分數陳態等在莫爾材料中相繼被發現。 重要的是，平帶有一個基本而有趣的性質：沒有傳統的電子特徵長度。在通常金屬中，費米波長 1/k_F（其中 k_F 是費米動量）是自然的電子長度尺度，它決定了材料的許多特性，例如電荷密度波和弗里德爾振蕩的空間週期。然而，k_F 在絕對平帶中並不是良定義的。在傳統超導體中，正比於費米速度 v_F 的超導相干長度是自然的長度尺度，然而在平帶系統中v_F 為零。那麼，平帶超導體中的超導相干長度應該是什麼呢？ 最近我們指出，在平帶超導體中，自然的電子長度尺度是由量子度規給出的。量子度規描述了兩個態之間的“量子距離”，具有長度平方的量綱。在近期的研究中，我們指出平帶超導體的庫柏對大小由量子度規決定。由於相干長度是超導體中的一個基本長度尺度，我們認為平帶超導體中的許多其他物理量也是由量子度規決定的。 在本提案中，我們將研究安德烈夫束縛態、Yu-Shiba 態和拓樸束縛態的空間尺寸，以確定它們如何受到量子度規的影響。此外，量子度規表徵了電子能帶的幾何特性，其效應也不局限於超導系統中。該提案还將研究量子度規對平帶材料激子尺寸的影響。特別是，我們將證明一個激子空間尺寸的下限確實是由量子度規所決定。本提案的研究內容處於量子度規研究的前沿，它們將為進一步理解平帶材料奠定基礎。

16311524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16311524.value: 透過單分子力譜結合拉曼光譜的方法揭示α-突觸核蛋白、其mRNA、反義寡核苷酸和小分子的動態相互作用

16311524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16311524.value: With the growth of aging population, the prevalence of neurodegenerative diseases increases, placing substantial burdens on healthcare resources and impacting societies on a broader scale. Among them, Parkinson's disease, characterized by symptoms such as shaking, slowed movements, and impaired balance, is closely linked to the pathological aggregation of α-synuclein. Recent studies have demonstrated that targeting α-synuclein messenger RNA (mRNA) could reduce α-synuclein expression and inhibit its aggregation, offering a potential avenue for treating Parkinson's disease. However, there are severe concerns on the efficacy, specificity, and safety of current mRNA-interacting agents, due to the limited understanding of their underlying molecular mechanisms. Meanwhile, practical challenges arise due to dynamic structure-function properties of mRNA, interaction complications of mRNA and different interacting agents, and heterogenous nature of α-synuclein towards amyloid aggregation under various influences, calling for feasible biophysical method developments. We propose to utilize novel single-molecule mechanical manipulation and spectroscopic characterization approaches to accommodate the unique biophysical properties of mRNA and α-synuclein, leveraging the advantages to discern the dynamic signal from individual molecules to avoid ensemble averaging. Optical tweezers-based single-molecule force spectroscopy enables the precise mechanical manipulation of a single mRNA upon binding to various agents, generating molecular extension at a nanometer spatial and a millisecond temporal resolution to quantify its structural changes, monitor dynamics, and capture rare events. In addition, single-molecule surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy (SERS) directly probes molecular vibrations to identify chemical structure in label-free manner, sensitive to nitrogenous bases and interaction environments, in particular, bond formations and cleavages. Moreover, the dynamic hotspot in optical tweezers-controlled surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy (SERS) enables small-volume sampling of α-synuclein to characterize its structural heterogeneity upon interacting with antisense oligonucleotides and small molecules at physiological concentration. Specifically, we will utilize these single-molecule approaches to analyze certain regions along α-synuclein mRNA with specific structures and sequences to identify potential targeting sites that provide more stable binding environments, which is crucial for designing strong binding agents. Moreover, we will study their interactions with small molecules, antisense oligonucleotides, and α-synuclein to unveil molecular mechanisms that determine better binding affinity and specificity, since α-synuclein plays an important role in stabilizing mRNA to modulate protein synthesis via direct binding. Furthermore, we will explore their influences on α-synuclein aggregation propensity that might disrupt overall α-synuclein regulation efficacy, aiming to provide profound insight into the development of α-synuclein mRNA-targeting therapeutic strategies. 隨著人口老化的增長，神經退化性疾病的盛行率增加，對醫療保健資源造成巨大負擔，並在更廣泛的範圍內影響社會。其中，以顫抖、運動緩慢、平衡受損等症狀為特徵的帕金森氏症與α-突觸核蛋白的病理性聚集密切相關。最近的研究表明，靶向 α-突觸核蛋白信使 RNA (mRNA) 可以減少 α-突觸核蛋白的表達並抑制其聚集，為治療帕金森氏症提供了潛在的新途徑。然而，由於對其潛在分子機制的了解有限，人們對目前 與mRNA相互作用的藥物的功效、特異性和安全性有嚴重擔憂。同時，由於mRNA的動態結構-功能特性、mRNA與不同藥劑的相互作用複雜性以及α-突觸核蛋白在不同影響因素下對澱粉樣蛋白聚集的異質性，需要開發合適這個體系的生物物理表徵方法，用以解決具體研究工作中所遇到的困難與挑戰。 我們提議利用新穎的單分子機械操作和光譜表徵方法，針對mRNA和α-突觸核蛋白的獨特生物物理特性，發揮方法優勢來辨別單一分子的動態訊號，避免傳統整體訊號取平均造成的模糊不清。基於光鑷的單分子力學能夠精確操縱單一mRNA並測試其與各種劑結合時的力學特性，以空間奈米和時間毫秒的分辨率測量其對應的分子伸展，從而量化其結構變化、監測動態並捕獲罕見事件。並且，單分子表面增強拉曼光譜（SERS）可直接探測分子振動，以無標記方式識別化學結構，能靈敏地感知mRNA鹼基和分子相互作用的化學環境，特別適合探測化學鍵的形成和斷裂。此外，光鑷控制的表面增強拉曼光譜（SERS）中的動態熱點能夠進行小體積取樣，以表徵α-突觸核蛋白在生理濃度下與反義寡核苷酸和小分子相互作用時的結構異質性。 具體來說，我們將利用這些單分子方法來分析α-突觸核蛋白mRNA上具有特定結構和序列的某些區域，以識別潛在的標靶位點，提供更穩定的結合環境，這對於設計強結合劑至關重要。因為α-突觸核蛋白可透過與mRNA結合來穩定其結構並調節蛋白質合成，我們將研究它們與小分子、反義寡核苷酸和α-突觸核蛋白的相互作用，以揭示優化結合親和力和特異性的分子機制。最後，我們將探討它們對α-突觸核蛋白聚集傾向的影響，這可能會影響整體α-突觸核蛋白的調控效果，旨在為α-突觸核蛋白mRNA 標靶治療策略的發展提供深刻的見解。

16500024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16500024.value: 當情況變得艱難時，堅強的人會迎難而上：弱勢企業家扭轉融資差距的溝通策略

16500024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16500024.value: 儘管來自傳統上受歧視群體的企業家越來越普遍，但在尋求早期資金時，企業家仍然面臨基於個人和族群背景的歧視。有能力的企業家被切斷稀缺的資本，無法擴大規模，而投資者則失去了贊助創新項目和獲得更高回報的機會。 在這項研究中，我們詢問：弱勢的創業家是否有可控的策略，來吸引比有優勢的創業家更正面的投資人評價？我們集中探討企業家在與有優勢的企業家競爭時，如何在展示他們劣勢的情況下仍能確保獲得投資的方法。 根據針對動機(motivation)和劣勢者效應(underdog-effect)研究的見解，我們認為投資人並沒有普遍的方式來理解逆境證據，或是回應艱難奮鬥的行動者。相反地，（a）承認考驗可以展現行動者的積極和努力；（b）投資者也可能只是從支持艱難奮鬥的行動者中獲得滿足感。 我們將在不同國家以眾籌(crowdfunding)和加速器計劃(accelerator)作為推介手段的背景下檢視這種可能性。這專案旨在推動企業者溝通和融資的文獻進展。

16500124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16500124.value: 建模内容平台上用户多行为的动态变化及数据可视化

16500124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16500124.value: In the digital landscape, understanding online user behavior offers unparalleled insights for marketers, aiding in effective campaign design and future trend prediction. While platforms like news outlets and social media have been researched, gaps remain. Current literature often generalizes behavior, overlooking individual variations across multiple activities. Additionally, most existing research is centered around publisher-driven content, overshadowing the rising influence of user-generated content (UGC). Addressing these challenges, we introduce the Dynamic Multi-Action Neural Poisson System (DMNPS). This innovative model reconciles both short-term and long-term behavioral dependencies, capturing temporal structures across diverse user actions. Importantly, it accounts for both platform-level and individual temporal dynamics, allowing for nuanced and interpretable insights into online behavior dynamics. A standout feature of DMNPS is its ability to distill high-dimensional data into clear visualizations, offering a profound understanding of intricate online interactions. We applied DMNPS to Zhihu, China’s leading Q&A platform, to analyze user engagement deeply. Our focus is on "big V" users, key contributors whose behaviors drive the broader platform’s dynamics. Zhihu’s blend of content consumption and contribution makes it an apt case study, illuminating distinctions between user interests and contributions. As the digital domain evolves, our innovative modeling framework paves the way for dissecting and understanding user interactions online, filling existing research gaps, and providing actionable insights for businesses and marketers. 在数字化时代，理解在线用户行为为营销人员提供了无与伦比的见解，帮助他们设计有效的活动并预测未来趋势。尽管新闻媒体和社交媒体等平台已经被研究，但仍存在一些空白。目前的文献通常对行为进行泛化，忽略了多种活动中的个体差异。此外，大多数现有研究都集中在发布者驱动的内容上，忽视了用户生成内容（UGC）日益增长的影响。 为了解决这些挑战，我们引入了动态多动作神经泊松系统（DMNPS）。这一创新模型同时调和了短期和长期的行为依赖性，捕捉了各种用户行为的时间结构。重要的是，它既考虑了平台级别的时间动态，也考虑了个体级别的时间动态，从而能够对在线行为动态进行细致入微且可解释的分析。DMNPS的一个突出特点是能够将高维数据提炼成清晰的可视化图表，从而深刻理解复杂的在线互动。 我们将DMNPS应用于中国领先的问答平台——知乎，以深入分析用户参与度。我们的重点是“大V”用户，这些关键贡献者的行为驱动着整个平台的动态。知乎融合了内容消费和贡献，使其成为一个适合的案例研究，通过它可以揭示用户兴趣和贡献之间的差异。随着数字领域的演变，我们的创新建模框架为解剖和理解在线用户互动铺平了道路，填补了现有研究的空白，并为企业和营销人员提供了可操作的见解。

16500724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16500724.value: 基金直播的決定因素及後果

16500724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16500724.value: 公募基金費用在投資人回報方面扮演舉足輕重的角色。為了吸引資金並實現規模經濟，基金將高達三分之一的費用用於行銷和分銷。先前的文獻記載，廣告等基金行銷工具可吸引資金流入。近年來，基金管理公司開始使用新穎的方式，利用社交媒體來吸引投資人。在這些方法中，直播成為中國最重要的基金營銷工具之一。2022 年，中國有 140 個基金管理公司舉辦了 44,665 場直播，吸引了 30 億人觀看（STCN 2023）。這些直播由基金公司主辦，期間基金經理或其他基金員工討論行業趨勢、解釋投資策略，並回答散戶投資者的現場提問。有別於傳統基金行銷主要介紹投資重點或過往表現等基金資訊，直播提供基金經理與散戶投資人直接互動的溝通方式。直播所討論主題的廣泛性和互動性讓投資者了解基金和基金經理，也讓基金與投資者建立個人聯繫。儘管基金直播活動日漸受歡迎，但卻沒有針對基金直播的學術研究。我們的項目將是第一個研究這個新興現象的項目。 我們的項目將有助於三方面的文獻。首先，我們透過記錄公募基金（最重要的投資中介之一）如何利用新社交媒體工具來傳播資訊和吸引投資者，以及其經濟後果，來補充有關公司如何利用社交媒體來傳播資訊的文獻。其次，我們提供了公募基金業直播有效性的第一手證據，對基金行銷文獻有所貢獻。最後，我們透過研究一系列不同的特徵，包括教育、經驗、技能和投資風格，如何影響直播的決策和後果，拓展了有關直播行銷的文獻。 我們的研究結果將對行業和政策產生影響。首先，鑒於直播日益普及，我們的研究結果為公募基金在這一領域進一步投資的權衡提供了有用且及時的資訊。其次，我們關於基金經理的個人特徵如何影響直播決策和結果的研究結果可以說明資產管理中的性別差異。最後，我們提供了第一個證據，說明直播如何影響資本配置結果，為業界人士和監管機構提供了啟示。

16500924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16500924.value: 理解与克服二手消费的心理障碍

16500924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16500924.value: 可持续性已成为当今社会的重要议题之一。联合国呼吁全球共同努力，实现可持续消费，并“通过减少、回收和再利用，显著减少废物的产生”（联合国大会，2015）。然而，尽管关于可持续消费的消费者研究不断增多，消费者的再利用行为仍然研究不足。再利用是3R框架中帮助实现可持续发展的重要支柱，甚至可以说是最重要的支柱（Sandin & Peters, 2018）。相比于制造新产品，即使是使用回收材料，再利用能够显著节约更多资源并减少污染，这使其成为一种更理想的废物管理方式。 再利用的一种重要形式是二手消费。然而，尽管二手消费具有许多优势，例如价格较低和环境效益，消费者购买二手商品的意愿仍然较低。例如，在香港，少于20%的消费者使用最大的二手商品平台Carousell（Carousell, 2021）。本研究提案旨在通过探讨几种重要的二手消费心理障碍来填补这一研究空白--包括感知, 污染、与二手消费相关的负面社会印象，以及物品心理所有权。 我们提出，除了二手消费的客观障碍（如质量问题、物流困难）之外，一些心理障碍也导致了消费者不愿购买二手商品：认为二手商品因其使用历史而受到污染，对购买二手商品的负面社会印象（即被认为经济能力不足或吝啬）的担忧，以及对二手产品较低的心理所有权。此外，我们确定了所提出效应的边界条件。具体来说，我们假设，对于从未使用过的二手商品（即较低的感知污染）、在私人场合使用的二手商品（即对购买二手商品的负面社会污名的担忧较少）以及实用性产品（即对心理所有权的担忧较少），消费者购买二手商品的意愿会有所提高。最后，我们提出了三种理论导向的干预措施，以鼓励二手消费。具体而言，我们预测，通过使用较少感官化的产品描述、强调“二手消费＝可持续消费”的关联性，并提供个性化二手产品的机会，将能增加消费者购买二手商品的意愿。我们计划通过一系列实验室实验和实地实验来检验我们的假设。

16501524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16501524.value: 性别视角下的结构转型和劳动力配置障碍：中国的定量分析

16501524.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16501524.value: Dr Gu, Jiajia Prof Ngai, Rachel L.

16501524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16501524.value: Recent data from the International Labor Organization reveals a concerning trend of declining female employment rates in several developing countries, including many African nations, as well as China and India, the two largest economies. Notably, a significant aspect of the early stages of development is the reduction in the proportion of agricultural employment. However, the transition from agricultural work to other sectors often encounters various barriers. This project aims to investigate the impact of labor mobility barriers on labor allocation by gender during the process of structural transformation, with a focus on the case of the hukou (household registration) system in China. Over the past few decades, China has undergone rapid economic growth, resulting in a structural shift away from agriculture. The hukou system, a prominent mobility barrier, particularly affects the rural population and often leads to the separation of households during the early stages of migration, with male members typically migrating while females remain behind. Empirically, our study aims to leverage comprehensive microdata that provides information on labor supply by sector, gender, and hukou status. By exploiting variations across provinces and over time, we seek to establish a relationship between the decline in female labor supply, the decline in agriculture, and the reinforcing effect of the hukou system. Theoretically, we propose constructing a two-sector and two-locations model. The agricultural sector is situated in rural areas, while the non-agricultural sector is in urban areas. Within this framework, there are two types of hukou holders: agricultural hukou and non-agricultural hukou. The hukou system acts as a mobility barrier, impeding movement from rural to urban areas. Each household consists of a male and a female member. Households with agricultural hukou face decisions regarding whether to stay and work in the rural sector or to migrate, with various possibilities including both members staying, one member becoming a migrant, or both members becoming migrants. Additionally, we utilize the quantitative model to conduct counterfactual experiments. This allows us to explore the impact of mobility barriers on labor supply by gender, migration patterns, and the resulting agricultural productivity gap. Through our study, we aim to shed light on the influence of mobility barriers on women's position in the labor market.
