The findings from China have the potential to inform policy implications and contribute to narrowing gender gaps in less developed countries that share similar characteristics and are at the early stages of development. 近期来自国际劳工组织的数据显示，包括许多非洲国家在内的一些发展中国家，以及中国和印度这两个最大的经济体，女性就业率呈下降趋势，这一趋势令人担忧。值得注意的是，发展的早期阶段的一个重要方面是农业就业比例的减少。然而，从农业工作转向其他行业往往会遇到各种障碍。本项目旨在调查农业减少与女性劳动力配置之间的关系，以及这种关系如何受劳动力流动障碍的影响，重点关注中国的户口制度案例。 在过去几十年里，中国经历了快速经济增长，导致远离农业的结构性转变。户口制度，作为一个显著的流动障碍，特别影响农村人口，通常导致在迁移的早期阶段家庭分离，男性成员通常迁移，而女性留在原地。 在实证上，我们的研究旨在利用提供按部门、性别和户口状况供给劳动力信息的综合微观数据。通过利用各省份和时间的差异，我们试图建立女性劳动力供给减少、农业减少以及户口制度的强化效应之间的关系。 从理论上讲，我们提出构建一个双部门和双地点模型。农业部门位于农村地区，非农业部门位于城市地区。在这个框架内，有两类户口持有者：农业户口和非农业户口。户口制度充当着流动障碍，阻碍了从农村到城市地区的移动。每个家庭包括一个男性成员和一个女性成员。具有农业户口的家庭需要面临决定留在农村部门工作还是迁移的问题，可能的选择包括两个成员都留在原地、一个成员成为移民或者两个成员都成为移民。 此外，我们利用定量模型进行反事实实验。这使我们能够探讨流动障碍对性别劳动力供给、迁移模式以及由此产生的农业生产力差距的影响。通过我们的研究，我们旨在揭示流动障碍对妇女在劳动力市场中地位的影响。从中国得出的研究结果有潜力对政策产生影响，并有助于缩小那些具有相似特征并处于发展的早期阶段的较不发达国家中的性别差距。

16501924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16501924.value: 利用眼动数据从单次选择数据中揭示偏好差异

16501924.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16501924.value: Dr Martinovici, Ana Prof Pieters, Rik

16501924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16501924.value: Understanding consumers’ preferences is a critical requirement for marketing decision making. Decisions about new product developments, advertising, pricing, and the choice of sales, all rely on consumer preferences and differences between people. Marketing researchers have developed various tools to measure individual preferences, and choice-based conjoint analysis has proven to be the most effective and successful in practice. An important disadvantage of choice-based conjoint analysis is that participants in these experiments need to repeatedly make choices from a similar set of alternatives. This causes boredom in answering these choice questions, which negatively affects the validity of the responses. This project aims to address this problem by developing a novel eye-tracking methodology in which respondents only need to answer one choice question. Answering one choice question is much more like real-life shopping situations and avoids that participants are getting tired during the data collection process. This significantly enhances both the internal and external validity of the preference estimates, and we anticipate that the proposed methodology will be valuable for marketing researchers. To be able to derive individual-level preferences from single choice data, we will leverage eye-tracking data to obtain reliable estimates. Preferences are an important driver of people’s eye movements, as people tend to process information that is important and relevant to the choice task. Based on theories in psychology and economics, this project aims to develop a novel statistical eye-movement model of choice that can identify preferences from a single choice decision. During the eye-tracking choice experiment, the number of choice alternatives will be manipulated. This experimental set-up allows testing the optimal design of the choice experiment. It is hypothesized that the optimal number of alternatives in the choice set ranges from five to ten products, as fewer products result in insufficient eye-tracking information, while larger choice sets may lead to choice overload. We believe that this proposal will not only generate important theoretical insights into the relative importance of psychological and economic process during choice, but it will also be valuable to practitioners. Eye-tracking equipment is increasingly available at marketing research firms and consultancies, and there are also developments in which webcams in laptops are used to collect such information. To increase the value of this research, all collected data and programming code will be made publicly available. 理解消费者的偏好是营销决策的一项关键要求。有关新产品开发、广告、定价和销售选择的决策，都基于消费者偏好和消费者之间的差异。营销研究人员已经开发出各种工具来衡量个人偏好，基于选择的结合分析在实践中被证明为其中最有效和成功的方法。但该方法的一个重要缺点是实验参与者需要反复地在相似选项中进行选择。这会导致参与者在答题时感到厌倦，从而降低回答的有效性。本项目旨在通过开发一种仅需答题者做一次选择题的新颖眼动追踪技术来解决这个问题。只做一次选择题更加贴近现实生活中的购物环境，并且避免了实验参与者在数据收集过程中感到疲倦。这将显著提高偏好估计的内部和外部有效性。我们希望，所提出的方法会为市场研究人员提供价值。 为了能够从单次选择数据中得到个人偏好，我们将利用眼动追踪数据来获取可靠的估计值。偏好是人们眼动的一个重要驱动力，因为人们倾向于处理对选择任务重要和相关的信息。基于心理学和经济学理论，本项目旨在开发一种能通过单次选择决策来推断偏好的新颖的统计学眼动选择模型。在眼动追踪选择实验中，我们将控制选项的数量。该实验设置让我们能够测试出选择实验的最佳设计。因为较少的产品选项会导致眼动追踪信息不足，而较大的选择集则可能造成选择过载，我们假设：最优的选择集产品选项数量在五到十之间。我们相信，本项目不仅会产生有关心理过程和经济过程在选择中的相对重要性的重要理论洞见，而且会对从业者极具价值。眼动追踪设备在市场研究公司和咨询公司日益普及，笔记本电脑的网络摄像头也逐渐被用于收集此类信息。为提高本研究的价值，所有收集到的实验数据和编程代码都将被公布。

16502224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16502224.value: 供應鏈可視化：非平穩環境下的資源配置與分配

16502224.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16502224.value: Prof Jiang, Jiashuo Prof Teo, Chung-Piaw

16502224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16502224.value: In recent years, emerging technologies have sparked a revolution in the field of supply chain management. Blockchain, Internet-of-Things, and Digital Twin solutions create clearer visibility into supply chain management, and empower manufacturers to operate with increased agility and intelligence. However, despite the immense potential of these new technologies, the orchestration of complicated supply chain processes remains a challenging endeavor. This challenge is further exacerbated by the fact that such processes are often managed by multiple agents, each with their own specific constraints and key performance indicators (KPIs). Consequently, it becomes crucial to comprehend how to leverage the power of supply chain visibility to strike a balance among various KPIs by designing a real-time allocation policy, and on top of that, how much capacity we should configure at different sites within the supply chain to achieve the desired performance targets. In this project, we propose to develop a two-stage data-driven approach to iteratively solve the capacity configuration and allocation problem in an online fashion, with the goal of minimizing the triggered capacity configuration cost while achieving the desired performance targets by the end of the planning horizon. However, it is worth noting that the capacity configuration problem becomes particularly challenging in diverse operational environments, due to the fluctuating demands that exhibit non-stationarity across different time periods. As a result, the classic online optimization method cannot be directly applied to solve this joint capacity configuration and resource allocation problem. From an operational perspective, our primary focus is showing that our proposed two-stage approach provides a provably near-optimal performance guarantee, even when the underlying stochastic inputs follow non-stationary distributions. This will extend the previous study that focused on stationary inputs and pave the way for establishing a transparent data-driven oracle that can be applied to a wide range of two-stage online decision-making problems. We intend to employ these techniques and insights to address challenges encountered in the design of crowdsourcing walker deployment for last-mile delivery operations, as well as real-time order fulfillment problems in the e-commerce industry, using real data from two industries. By deeply integrating theoretical development with practical application in the industry, our ultimate goal is to offer tactical and operational solutions that leverage supply chain visibility to its fullest potential in the field of supply chain management. 近年來，新興技術的蓬勃發展極大地推動了供應鏈管理的革新。區塊鏈、物聯網和數位孿生解決方案為供應鏈管理帶來了更透明的視角，賦予了製造商更大的靈活性和智慧化營運能力。然而，儘管這些新技術具有巨大潛力，協調複雜的供應鏈流程仍然是一項具有挑戰性的任務。這項挑戰進一步凸顯了一個事實，即這些流程通常由多個部門管理，每個部門都有其獨特的限制和關鍵績效指標。因此，如何基於供應鏈的可視化資訊設計有效的即時分配策略進行平衡不同的績效指標，並在此基礎上配置供應鏈不同環節的容量變得至關重要。 該專案旨在開發一類兩階段資料驅動的方法，以解決即時容量配置和分配問題，進而在規劃週期結束時實現所製定的績效指標，同時最小化資源容量配置成本。然而，由於營運環境中隨機需求的非平穩性，容量配置問題也變得極具挑戰性。因此，經典的線上最佳化方法無法直接解決非平穩環境下的聯合容量配置和資源分配問題。從營運的角度來看，該計畫的研究重點在於證明所提出的兩階段方法具備非漸進式最優性能保證，即使在具有非平穩特徵的隨機參數下也能有效運作。這項研究將擴展先前專注於穩態隨機參數的研究，並開發數據驅動工具來解決兩階段線上決策問題。 此外，該專案將利用這些技術和見解來解決最後一公里物流配送中的眾包快遞員部署問題和電子商務領域中的即時訂單履行難題，並結合兩個行業的真實數據進行驗證。透過深度融合理論發展與實際應用，研究旨在提供利用供應鏈視覺化提升供應鏈管理的有效解決方案。

16502324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16502324.value: 先验独立机制的最优设计：鲁棒满意视角

16502324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16502324.value: Auction or mechanism design, driven by the popularity of auctions in diverse areas such as e-commerce, procurement, antique sales, and online advertising, is an important and popular research topic at the intersection of economics, computer science, marketing, and operations research. The classic theory of auctions relies on the fundamental assumption that the value of the good to each bidder is private information whose distribution is a common prior that is shared between all firms. Therefore, based on this common prior and anticipating the strategic bidding equilibrium behavior of all bidders, the auctioneer can optimize the mechanism. In practice, however, such prior knowledge is not available, i.e., the precise distribution of the bidders’ private values is rarely known and it is unclear how the firms’ beliefs about values coincide or whether they are formed correctly. The auctioneer often only has partial information based on historical data, such as a confident estimate of immediate information about bidders’ valuations. This motivates us to consider, from both a practical and a theoretical perspective, characterizing the optimal mechanism to relax the assumption that the auctioneer only has limited and partial information about the valuation distribution. In the proposed project, we consider the design of optimal mechanisms for selling multiple goods. The seller does not know the distribution of the buyer’s valuation and robustly maximizes its revenue against the most adverse distribution within a set of probability distributions, called the ‘ambiguity’ set. To make the trade-off between information about the unknown distribution and revenue, we will adopt the robust satisficing approach, a target-driven approach that aims to reach a predetermined target over a set of individually rational and incentive-compatible mechanisms. We plan first to explore the simplest setting with a single-buyer and a single-good to derive comprehensive understanding of the structural properties of robustly optimal mechanisms, and then leverage these insights to consider the problem of robust mechanism design in a more complex setting with multiple goods. Our objectives are to provide understanding of the impacts of decision criteria (such as regret, utility, or satisficing target) and information ambiguity (i.e., ambiguity set) on the design of robustly optimal mechanisms. We are also keen to apply our theoretical research findings in two practical settings, online advertising and procurement, that correspond to different levels of information ambiguity. 买卖机制设计在电商、采购、艺术品销售、网络广告等现实生活中有广泛且普遍的应用，因此成为经济学、计算机、市场、和运营管理等领域重要且流行的研究课题。传统的拍卖理论依赖于一个重要的核心假设，即商品对于每个买家的价值是服从于某个分布的私有信息并且所有公司都准确的知道这个分布信息。因此，基于这个公开的分布信息，卖方或者拍卖者可以预测所有买家的均衡竞价行为并设计出相应的最优机制。然而，在实践中，买家对于商品价值的分布信息往往都是未知的，拍卖者一般只能通过一些历史数据来或者部分信息，比如买家价值的均值、方差等信息。这些现实的一些问题激励我们去考虑一个学术和实际角度方面最根本的问题，即当卖家或拍卖者仅有有限和部分信息的情况下，如何去设计最优的买卖机制？ 在该项目中，我们将研究关于多产品的最优买卖机制的设计。卖家在不知道买家价值分布信息的情况下去设计收益方面鲁棒最优买卖机制。为了平衡收益和未知的分布信息，我们将采用一种目标驱动的鲁棒满足方法，即在一系列个体理性和激励相容的机制中寻求达到预先设定的目标值的鲁棒满足买卖机制。我们计划先分析最简单的单买方单产品的情景下，从而可以得到关于鲁棒最优机制设计方面结构属性的全面理解， 进而更进一步的去分析在更复杂比如多产品的情况下的鲁棒机制设计。我们的目标是提供关于决策准则（比如效用，满足目标）和信息模糊性对于鲁棒优化买卖机制设计的影响。

16502424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16502424.value: 数字时代下的版权与音乐创作

16502424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16502424.value: The question of what type of copyright law to implement has been debated for many years, but systematic empirical evidence on the effects of copyright on creation remains scarce. The importance of this research question is particularly evident in the digital age, where industries such as books, music, and movies are undergoing significant transformations. Digitization has spurred a reassessment of how to balance creator incentives and public access in the field of copyright protection. On one hand, digitization has enabled private infringement while concurrently making it more challenging to detect and prevent. As such, it's crucial to establish robust copyright protection laws to defend the rights of creators. On the other hand, digitization has removed many physical and cost barriers, broadening access to content and offering creators more income opportunities. The Internet represents a unique chance to fulfill the public interest objectives of the copyright system, fostering learning and information access, as well as opening new distribution channels for creators. Some scholars propose that a copyright law overly focused on creator incentives may not be entirely appropriate for the digital era, advocating instead for a greater emphasis on public access. In the proposed project, the PI aims to shed light on this vital issue by extending a preliminary empirical analysis that she and her doctoral student have conducted to investigate the impacts of copyright law on music creation in the context of digitization. Capitalizing on the Music Modernization Act (MMA) in the US as a natural experiment, we examine the effect of stricter copyrights on music creation. We pinpoint the causal effects of the MMA by taking US singers as the treatment group and non-US singers as the control group. We are also interested in exploring potential variations in effects across musicians with disparate popularity levels and across different types of music genres. In addition, we strive to unravel the underlying mechanism that drives the impact of the MMA. The proposed project will make several important contributions. First, it will augment the existing literature on the effects of copyright law by providing the first empirical evidence regarding the impact of copyright law on music creation in the digital age. Second, it will expand the literature on whether the Internet and digitization lead to a superstar or long tail effect. Third, the findings from this project carry significant implications for policymakers, digital service providers, and musicians. 关于应该实施何种类型的版权法的问题已经争论多年，但关于版权对创作影响的系统性实证证据仍然十分匮乏。这一研究问题在数字时代尤为重要，因为书籍、音乐和电影等行业正在经历重大变革。数字化促使人们重新评估如何在版权保护领域平衡创作者的激励和公众获取的权益。一方面，数字化可能促进私人侵权行为，同时也使得侦测和防止这种行为变得更加困难。因此，建立健全的版权保护法律以维护创作者的权利至关重要。另一方面，数字化消除了许多物理和成本障碍，拓宽了内容获取途径，为创作者提供了更多的收入机会。因此，互联网也为实现版权制度的公共利益目标提供了一个独特的机会。一些学者提出，一个过分侧重于创作者激励的版权法可能并不完全适合数字时代，相反，应更加重视公众的获取权。在拟议的项目中，负责人旨在通过扩展她和博士生已进行的初步实证分析来阐明这一关键问题，调查数字化背景下版权法对音乐创作的影响。利用美国音乐现代化法案（MMA）作为自然实验，我们研究更严格的版权保护对音乐创作的影响。我们通过将美国歌手作为处理组，非美国歌手作为对照组，来确定MMA的因果效应。我们还计划探索这种效应在不同受欢迎程度的音乐人和不同音乐类型之间的潜在变化。此外，我们希望揭示推动MMA影响的基本机制。该项目将做出几个重要贡献。首先，它将通过提供数字时代版权法对音乐创作影响的首个实证证据，丰富现有文献。其次，它将扩展关于互联网和数字化是否导致超级明星或长尾效应的文献。第三，该项目的发现对政策制定者、数字服务提供商和音乐家具有重大意义。

16502624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16502624.value: 生成式人工智能对金融财务分析的影响

16502624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16502624.value: Generative AI, fueled by the latest advancements in Large Language Models (LLM), such as OpenAI’s ChatGPT and Google’s Bard, is revolutionizing various industries, including customer service and software development. In this project, we aim to collaborate with a financial institution to examine the effect of generative AI on the task performance, efficiency, and overall quality of financial analysis conducted by financial analysts. We will partner with a Hong Kong-based financial institution to develop a generative AI chatbot capable of analyzing financial reports and responding to analysts’ inquiries. By leveraging instruction tuning and prompting techniques, we will develop an LLM capable of generating varied responses, descriptive vs. prescriptive and long vs. short. Descriptive responses will concentrate on summarizing information, omitting advice or actions, whereas prescriptive ones will offer specific recommendations, such as buy/sell/hold, along with the information. Long responses will delve deeper into topics but may demand more comprehension time, whereas short ones will offer succinct insights but might lack detail. Additionally, we will investigate how task complexity moderates the effects. Our approach involves conducting a field experiment, altering the LLM response types in each interaction session with the participated analysts. We will evaluate the outcomes based on objective measures like time efficiency, decision confidence, and recommendation alignment, and subjective measures like analyst satisfaction and cognitive load, to assess the analysts’ efficiency, the overall quality of financial analysis, and their experience. The insights gained from this project will enrich the existing body of knowledge on the impact of generative AI on the labor market and business services, offering practical insights for financial institutions contemplating the integration of generative AI in their operational activities. Moreover, the results will shed light on the path to developing more nuanced, task-specific generative AI services. 生成式人工智能，以最新的大型语言模型（LLM）为基础，如OpenAI的ChatGPT和Google的Bard，正在革新各行各业，包括客户服务和软件开发。在本项目中，我们计划与一家金融机构合作，研究生成式人工智能对金融分析师的任务表现、效率以及整体分析质量的影响。我们将与一家香港的金融机构合作，开发一个能够分析财务报告并响应分析师询问的生成式AI聊天机器人。通过使用指令微调和提示技术，我们将开发一个能够生成不同类型回应的LLM，并研究不同类型的回应会如何影响分析师的最终决策。我们的研究方法包括进行一项实地实验，改变参与分析师每次互动中的LLM回应类型。我们将通过时间效率、决策置信度、建议一致性等客观指标，以及分析师满意度、认知负荷等主观指标来评估分析师的效率、金融分析的整体质量以及他们的体验。本项目的发现将丰富现有关于生成式AI对劳动市场和商业服务影响的研究，为金融机构考虑在其运营活动中整合生成式AI提供实用见解。此外，结果将为设计更细致、面向特定任务的生成式AI服务提供指引。

16502824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16502824.value: 在线评论中的社会学习：个性化信号的价值

16502824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16502824.value: Customers often consult online reviews to learn about a product’s quality before deciding whether to purchase it. This research focuses on a platform’s information provision policy when customers learn through numeric ratings (e.g., five-star ratings). The quality of a product (such as hotel accommodation) is defined by multiple features (such as convenience, transportation, breakfast, etc.). Customers are categorized into different "types" based on the weight they assign to different product features. Customers are aware of their own type, but unaware of the types of other customers. In our model, customers sequentially arrive at the online platform, and if they decide to purchase a product, they will write a review for the product after making the purchase. The next customer will use this review to update their belief about the product quality. Our preliminary analysis shows that customers’ learning is fragile: when customers are uncertain about the types of reviewers, the true quality of the product may not be revealed to customers even if the number of reviews increases to infinity. Building on this insight, we propose signaling mechanisms for customers that meet three essential criteria: first, signals do not compromise privacy; second, signals provide reliable information about product quality that goes beyond the information available online reviews; and third, signals are incentive-compatible, such that platforms benefit from sending them. These conditions ensure that the signaling mechanism can address the issue of incomplete information in online reviews, while also enabling platforms to increase their profits by sending those signals. Based on our initial analysis, platforms may accomplish this goal by utilizing their existing operational tools, such as product recommendation and personalized pricing. Our findings will provide normative guidelines for a wide range of organizations looking to design effective online review systems. 消费者在决定是否购买产品之前，经常会查阅在线评论以了解产品质量。本研究聚焦于当消费者通过数字评分（如五星评级）学习时，平台的信息提供策略。产品（如酒店住宿）的质量由多种特征（如便利性、交通、早餐等）定义。基于消费者对不同产品特征的权重分配，他们可以被分为不同的“类型”。消费者了解自己的类型，但不了解其他消费者的类型。在我们的模型中，消费者依次到达在线平台，如果他们决定购买产品，他们将在购买后为产品撰写评论。下一位消费者将使用此评论来更新他们对产品质量的信念。我们的初步分析表明，消费者的学习是脆弱的：当消费者不确定评论者的类型时，即使评论数量增加到无穷大，产品的真实质量可能也无法揭示给消费者。 基于这一见解，我们提出了信号机制设计需要满足的三个基本标准：首先，信号不会损害隐私；其次，信号提供的关于产品质量的可靠信息超过在线评论中可获得的信息；最后，信号是激励相容的，即平台受益于发送这些信号。这些条件确保了信号机制可以解决在线评论中信息不完整的问题，同时使平台能够通过发送这些信号来增加利润。根据我们的分析，现有的运营工具（如产品推荐和个性化定价）即可满足上述信号设计要求。我们的研究结果将为寻求设计有效在线评论系统的各种组织提供规范性指导。

16502924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16502924.value: 逆向選擇下的價格歧視

16502924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16502924.value: The project aims to study the intersection of two classic topics in economics: price discrimination and adverse selection. The conventional wisdom in the literature is that, compared with uniform pricing, third-degree price discrimination allows the monopoly to better extract the surplus from trade. Specifically, using consumers' observable characteristics to partition the aggregate market into different segments, the monopoly is able to condition its optimal pricing strategy on the market segments. This effect culminates in the extreme case of first-degree price discrimination, by which the monopoly can perfectly identify every individual consumer's willingness to pay (WTP), and charge each of them a personalized price equal to their WTP, thus fully extracting the surplus from trade. In this project, we show that this conventional wisdom may not be valid in a market plagued with adverse selection. In a market with adverse selection, consumers are uninformed of the seller's product quality. In order to signal high quality, the monopoly can charge a high price that leads to a low volume of sales --- a result that is more costly to the low-quality seller (who has a low marginal cost of production). The signaling cost borne by the high-quality seller depends on, among other things, the demand curve it faces. In particular, we find that the aggregate signaling cost can go up if the monopoly possesses more precise information about the consumers' WTP. Knowledge about the consumers' WTP is therefore a double-edged sword in a market with adverse selection. On the one hand, it allows more effective surplus extraction. On the other hand, it escalates the signaling cost of the high-quality seller. Using a simple two-type setting, we identify conditions under which a commitment to refrain from learning any information about the consumer can yield a higher profit than a commitment to perfectly learn the consumers' WTP. We therefore show, somewhat surprisingly, that in a market with adverse selection, uniform pricing can possibly outperform first-degree price discrimination. If the monopoly has the ability to design the information policy and commit to it, how does the optimal design resolve the tradeoff mentioned above? Below, we shed light on this question by showing that perfect information acquisition is never seller-optimal, and never socially efficient. These preliminary findings suggest that the interaction between market segmentation and adverse selection provides an exciting avenue of research and deserves serious exploration. 本計畫旨在研究經濟學中兩個經典主題的交叉點：價格歧視和逆向選擇。 文獻中的傳統觀點認為，與統一定價相比，三級價格歧視可以讓獨佔者更能從貿易中榨取更多盈餘。具體來說，利用消費者的可觀察特徵將整體市場劃分為不同的細分市場，壟斷者能夠根據細分市場制定並優化定價策略。這種效應最終在一級價格歧視的極端情況下達到頂峰，壟斷者可以完美識別每個消費者的支付意願（WTP），並向每個消費者收取與其WTP相等的個人化價格，從而完全榨取消費者的剩餘。在本計畫中，我們證明這種傳統觀點在受逆向選擇困擾的市場中可能無效。 在逆向選擇的市場中，消費者不了解賣方的產品品質。為了表明高品質，壟斷者可以收取高價，從而導致銷量低——這對低品質賣家（生產邊際成本較低）來說代價更高。優質賣家所承擔的訊號成本取決於其面臨的需求曲線等因素。特別是，我們發現，如果壟斷者掌握有關消費者支付意願的更準確信息，則總訊號成本可能會上升。 因此，在逆向選擇的市場中，了解消費者的支付意願是一把雙面刃。一方面，它可以更有效地提取剩餘資金。另一方面，它增加了優質賣家的訊號成本。利用只有兩種類型賣家和買家的簡化模型，我們確定了在哪些條件下，承諾不獲取消費者的任何資訊比承諾完全獲取消費者的支付意願資訊能產生更高的利潤。因此，有趣的是，我們展示，在逆向選擇的市場中，統一定價可能優於一級價格歧視。 如果壟斷者有能力設計並承諾資訊政策，那麼最優設計如何解決上述的權衡呢？下面，我們證明完全獲取消費者的支付意願資訊永遠不是對賣方最優的，也永遠不是對社會效率最優的。這分析有助闡明最優設計問題。 這些初步研究結果表明，市場區隔和逆向選擇之間的相互作用提供了可行的研究途徑，值得認真探索。

16503124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16503124.value: 在線黑客市場中的負面反饋溢出效應

16503124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16503124.value: Hacker marketplaces have emerged as a significant threat globally by facilitating the trafficking of illegal and unethical goods and services. These marketplaces often feature low-quality products and widespread cheating owing to the anonymity of participants and their unregulated nature. Reputation, particularly negative reputation, plays a crucial role in weeding out unscrupulous sellers and maintaining the efficient functioning of these marketplaces. Previous research has focused on whether a negative reputation affects the implicated sellers. An outstanding research question is whether a negative reputation creates spillover effects on other sellers. Such spillover effects, if exist, could help regulators tackle the threat posed by hacker marketplaces. However, the lack of high-quality transaction-level data has hindered rigorous analyses of this research question. In this proposed project, we will utilize real transaction data in a prominent hacker marketplace, Hackforum.net, to investigate the broader impact of negative reputation within hacker marketplaces. In particular, we will test whether a negative reputation generates spillover effects on other marketplace sellers who do not have a negative reputation. We will leverage a policy change in Hackforum.net and employ a regression-discontinuity-in-time (RDiT) strategy to identify the causal impact of negative reputation on unaffected sellers of similar products. We also plan to explore how social interaction in the hacker forum, a common feature in many hacker marketplaces, influences the spillover effect. Such analysis will allow us to link hackers’ transaction activities with their incentives to contribute socially undesirable information, such as knowledge about hacking or illicit goods, in online hacker forums. To develop a nuanced understanding of the spillover effect of negative reputation, we will consider the impacts of different kinds of heterogeneity--user, negative feedback, and product--on the spillover effect. This project will deepen our understanding of the economic features of hacker marketplaces and shed new light on hackers' incentives to contribute socially undesirable information through hacker forums. The findings of this research can inform cybersecurity practitioners and law enforcement agencies about effective strategies to combat the threats posed by the online trading of harmful goods and hacking tools in hacker marketplaces. 黑客市場已成為全球性的威脅，因其促進非法和不道德商品及服務的交易。這些市場由於缺乏監管和參與者的匿名性，往往充斥著低質量的產品和廣泛的欺詐行為。聲譽，特別是負面聲譽，在剔除不誠實賣家和維持市場高效運作方面起著關鍵作用。先前的研究文獻集中在負面聲譽是否影響相關賣家。一個重要的研究問題是負面聲譽是否會對其他賣家產生溢出效應。如果存在這種溢出效應，則可以幫助監管機構應對黑客市場帶來的威脅。然而，缺乏高質量的交易數據一直阻礙著對這一研究題目的嚴謹分析。 在這個項目中，我們將利用著名黑客市場Hackforum.net的真實交易數據，調查負面聲譽在黑客市場中的更廣泛影響。我們將測試負面聲譽是否會對沒有負面聲譽的其他市場賣家產生溢出效應。我們將利用Hackforum.net中的政策變更，並採用時間回歸不連續性（RDiT）策略來識別負面聲譽對類似產品的未受影響賣家的因果影響。 我們還計劃探索黑客論壇中的社交互動（這是許多黑客市場的常見特徵）如何影響溢出效應。這些分析協助我們將黑客交易活動與他們在網上黑客論壇中提供社會不良信息（如黑客知識或非法商品）的動機聯繫起來。為了更深入理解負面聲譽的溢出效應，我們將考慮不同類型的異質性（用戶、負面反饋和產品）對溢出效應的影響。 這個項目將加深我們對黑客市場經濟特徵的理解，並為黑客通過黑客論壇提供社會不良信息的動機提供新的見解。這項研究的結果可以為網絡安全從業者和執法機構提供有效策略，以應對黑客市場中有害商品和黑客工具的在線交易所帶來的威脅。

16503224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16503224.value: 通胀盲点：消费者忽视通胀对企业的影响

16503224.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16503224.value: Dr Yang, Yang Dr Yin, Mingzhang

16503224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16503224.value: Recent years have witnessed the highest inflation rates since the 1980s, forcing businesses to raise prices to stay afloat. While existing price fairness theories suggest that consumers will understand and accept price hikes resulting from uncontrollable macroeconomic factors such as inflation, our research within the restaurant sector paint a different picture. Analyses of a Yelp restaurant dataset and results from five controlled experiments reveal that consumers perceive such price hikes as unfair, consequently lowering their review ratings. This effect arises because consumers have an inflation blind spot: while consumers are acutely aware of inflation’s toll on their own expenses (e.g., rising prices), they often overlook its financial strain on businesses (e.g., surging costs). Simple interventions, such as prompting consumers to reflect on the reasons behind price adjustments or the economic consequences of inflation on businesses, can attenuate this effect. Further, this research offers effective mitigation strategies for restaurants and online review platforms, and it also highlights some strategies that may backfire. Theoretically, this work enriches the price fairness literature and the cognitive bias literature. Practically, it elucidates a previously overlooked issue and offers actionable solutions for businesses and online platforms to bolster perceived fairness and sustain consumer satisfaction. 近年来，通胀率达到了自1980年以来的最高水平，迫使企业提高价格以维持生存。虽然现有的价格公平理论表明，消费者将理解并接受由不可控的宏观经济因素如通胀引起的价格上涨，但餐饮行业的数据却展示了不同的情况。对Yelp餐厅数据集的分析以及五个控制实验的结果揭示，消费者认为此类价格上涨不公平，从而降低了他们的评价等级。这一效应部分源于消费者对通胀有一个盲点——尽管消费者非常清楚通胀对自己开支的影响（例如，价格上涨），但他们常常忽视其对企业财务的压力（例如，成本飙升）。提示消费者考虑通胀对企业的影响可以减轻通胀盲点，提高感知公平性和评价等级。此外，这项研究为餐馆和在线评价平台提供了有效的缓解策略。从理论上讲，这项工作丰富了价格公平文献和认知偏差文献。从实践上讲，它阐明了一个以前被忽视的问题，并为企业和在线平台提供了可行的解决方案，以增强感知的公平性和维持消费者满意度。

16503424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16503424.value: 股權融資與企業出口：來自中國IPO審批的證據

16503424.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16503424.value: Prof Li, Yao Amber Prof SUN, Stephen Teng

16503424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16503424.value: This project investigates the impact of accessing equity financing through IPOs on firms' export activities in China using a unique setting of IPO approvals. We compare firms whose IPO applications were approved to those whose applications were rejected to gauge the effect of IPO approvals on firm exports. To address potential endogeneity concerns, we introduce a novel identification strategy that excludes rejections citing revenue- or profitability-related clauses, which are indicative of the presence of unobserved factors that directly impact a firm's export outcomes. Using a difference-in-differences strategy, we find that IPO approvals increase a firm's export volume by over 40% in the subsequent six years after its IPO review meeting. Unlike previous studies on the effect of bank credit on firm exports, our analysis reveals that the effect of IPO approvals mainly appears on the extensive margin of exports, as firms operate in more destination-product markets but make minimal changes in their average exports to each destination-product market. We further investigate the channels through which IPOs affect firm exports by examining the heterogeneous responses among firms, products, and destinations. Additionally, we utilize natural language processing (NLP) tools to analyze the textual data from firms' IPO prospectuses and quantify the importance of each potential mechanism in firms' export activities. 股票融資與銀行融資存在本質上的差異，而關於其對企業出口表現的影響的研究還很不充分。與美國的註冊制度不同，中國的IPO採用審批制 ，企業必須經過嚴格的審核程序才能獲得上市資格。我們的實證策略利用中國獨特的制度背景，比較成功 IPO 申請者的出口表現和那些 「接近失敗 」的申請者的出口表現（「接近失敗 」是指在 IPO 審核會議，即審核過程的最後階段，被拒絕的申請者）。我們進一步利用審核會議紀錄的文本信息排除由於基本面不佳被拒絕的申請者，從而解決可能的內生性問題。我們的雙重差分的分析顯示，IPO 獲批會使企業在隨後六年的出口值顯著增加約 40%。與現有的債務融資研究不同，股權融資的效應主要通過廣義邊際（擴展到更多目的地產品市場）來產生。此外，我們發現股權融資透過多種經濟機制提升公司出口，包括促進無形資本累積、減少信息摩擦，以及促進高風險的國外市場探索活動。

16503524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16503524.value: 推荐系统，替代效应和库存管理

16503524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16503524.value: Recommender systems are software tools and algorithms used to generate personalized recommendations of products or services to consumers. Since the mid-1990s, much work has been done in academia to develop new recommendation methods and improve the performance of recommender systems, paving the way for wider applications of recommender systems in various domains such as e-commerce, tourism, health, and e-learning. The benefits of recommender systems are well documented, with the most recognized benefit being increased consumers’ purchase intention and product sales. Recommender systems also bring value to consumers. In particular, by matching consumers to their preferred products, recommender systems can reduce consumers’ search costs, alleviate uncertainty associated with unfamiliar products, deliver greater value to consumers, and improve consumer satisfaction and brand loyalty. The evaluations of recommender systems have evolved over time. Most prior studies, especially earlier ones, have focused on technical metrics such as the accuracy and coverage of recommendations. Recent studies have proposed economics-oriented metrics such as customer lifetime value and return on investment. Some studies have incorporated profit or cost terms into their objective functions to obtain the best recommender system designs for vendors. However, research on how recommender systems affect operations management is still scarce, particularly regarding how product recommendations affect inventory management. This is the void our proposed research aims to fill. In this proposed project, we plan to utilize both experimental study and analytic modeling approaches to examine how adopting a recommender system affects consumers’ choice and substitution behaviors, and the implications such a system would have for a firm's inventory management and profitability. The findings can help firms better understand and subsequently better serve their customers, thus improving consumer satisfaction and loyalty. Moreover, understanding the impact of various market conditions and firms’ operational decisions on the benefits of adopting a recommender system can shed light on the advantages of using such systems for efficient inventory management and can provide valuable guidelines to practitioners in the hospitality sector and beyond. 推荐系统是用于向消费者生成个性化产品或服务推荐的软件工具和算法。自1990年代中期以来，学术界已经做了大量工作，发展了新的推荐方法并提高了推荐系统的性能，为推荐系统在电子商务、旅游、健康和电子学习等各个领域的广泛应用铺平了道路。推荐系统的好处已得到充分证实，其中最为认可的好处是增加了消费者的购买意愿和产品销量。推荐系统还为消费者带来价值，尤其是通过将消费者与他们喜爱的产品匹配，推荐系统可以降低消费者的搜索成本，减轻与不熟悉产品相关的不确定性，为消费者提供更大价值，并提高消费者满意度和品牌忠诚度。 对推荐系统的评估随着时间的推移而发展。大多数先前的研究，特别是早期的研究，主要侧重于技术指标，例如推荐的准确性和覆盖率。最近的研究提出了以经济为导向的指标，如客户终身价值和投资回报率。沿着这一方向，一些研究将利润或成本项纳入其目标函数，以获得最佳的供应商推荐系统设计。然而，关于推荐系统如何影响运营管理，特别是关于产品推荐如何影响库存管理的研究仍然很少。这正是本研究项目旨在填补的空白。 在本研究项目中，我们计划利用实验研究和分析建模方法来研究采用推荐系统如何影响消费者的选择和替代行为，以及对企业的库存管理和盈利能力的影响。有关消费者在推荐系统存在的情况下的行为的研究结果可以帮助企业更好地了解并随后更好地为客户提供服务，从而提高消费者满意度和忠诚度。此外，了解各种市场条件和企业运营决策如何影响采用推荐系统的好处，可以从有效库存管理的角度为酒店业及其他行业的从业者提供有价值的指导。

16503624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16503624.value: 外匯干預對市場預期的影響：以人民幣匯率政策為例

16503624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16503624.value: Since the last global financial crisis, foreign exchange (FX) interventions have been increasingly prominent. Central banks worldwide see FX intervention as an integral part of their tool kit and apply it accordingly. Evidence on the effectiveness of FX interventions focuses mainly on the actual intervention – central banks selling or buying currencies. Actual interventions are often accompanied by oral intervention – where central banks communicate the intended outcomes of their interventions. Still, there is little study on the effectiveness of oral interventions due to the lack of official accounts of such oral interventions. In this proposed project, we aim to construct novel data on the daily frequency of announced FX interventions by the Central Bank of China (PBoC) and to study how they affect the market’s expected exchange rates. Our construction of daily announced intervention takes advantage of PBoC’s unique central parity system for managing the RMB exchange rate. We take the daily deviation of the central parity rate (CPR) from its past policy rule as a measure for PBoC’s announced intervention. We will study whether and when the announced intervention is effective in moving the market’s expectations in desirable directions for the central bank and the mechanisms for its effectiveness. Since the market’s exchange rate expectation is central in determining the exchange rate dynamics, the effectiveness of the announced intervention will determine the effectiveness of the actual (often costly) intervention. Our anticipated findings will help the design of the optimal intervention policy. We also expect this proposed project to shed light on the central parity system pioneered by the PBoC, which is a policy experiment to test whether a country could achieve both flexibility and stability of the exchange rate by breaking sizable and infrequent foreign exchange interventions into a gradual day-to-day practice. 自從2009全球金融危機以來，外匯干預變得越來越重要。世界各地的中央銀行將外匯干預視為其工具箱中不可或缺的一部分。關於外匯干預有效性的證據主要集中在實際干預——即中央銀行出售或購買貨幣。實際干預通常伴隨著口頭干預，即中央銀行傳達其干預的預期結果。然而，由於缺乏此類口頭干預的官方記錄，關於口頭干預有效性的研究較少。在本研究計劃中，我們旨在建立有關中國中央銀行（PBoC）每日宣布的外匯干預的新度量，並研究其對市場預期匯率的影響。我們利用中國人民銀行獨特的人民幣匯率中間價管理系統，將宣布的中間價（CPR）每日相對於其過去政策規則的偏離作為中國人民銀行口頭干預的度量。我們將研究中國人民銀行的口頭干預是否以及何時能夠有效地將市場預期向有利於中央銀行的方向引導，以及其有效性的機制。由於市場的匯率預期在決定匯率動態中起著關鍵作用，口頭干預的有效性將影響實際干預的有效性，從而降低實際干預帶來的高昂成本。我們預期的研究結果將有助於設計最優的干預政策。我們也期望本計畫能夠對中國人民銀行首創的每日中間價系統提供政策實驗評估：旨在測試一個國家是否能夠透過將大規模且不頻繁的外匯干預分解為逐日的漸進實踐，從而同時實現匯率的靈活性和穩定性。

16503924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16503924.value: 全流程癌症篩查、治療和恢復管理

16503924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16503924.value: 隨著人口老齡化,大多數國家癌症發病率隨時間呈顯著上升趨勢。由於癌症治療成本高昂且病死率高,以高效的方式預防和治療癌症不僅惠及廣大人群,也對醫療系統實現其目標至關重要。然而,癌症管理是一個複雜的過程,涉及多種資源、參與者和服務。因此,提高癌症診療的效率不僅需要新的醫療技術,還需要合適的管理工具。癌症診療的一個重要環節是對潛在患者的篩查。儘管許多癌症在晚期診斷時會導致高昂的醫療費用和高死亡率,但如果能在症狀出現前及早發現癌症,通常是相對容易治癒的。已經開發出針對不同癌症的有效篩查方法,如肺癌的低劑量CT、結腸癌的腸鏡檢查和乳腺癌的乳腺X光檢查。然而,在大規模提高癌症預防和治療的可及性和質量仍然是一項巨大挑戰,引起了政策制定者和醫療專業人士的廣泛關注。 在本研究項目中,我們計劃開發一個分析框架,用於對某種特定癌症的全流程管理。我們的目標是在兩個方面為現有文獻作出貢獻:首先,我們在模型中考慮了該癌症的全流程,包括篩查、治療和恢復階段。在模型中,決策者需要同時確定篩查政策和不同服務階段的能力配置。由於癌症管理是一個複雜的過程,每個階段的決策都可能對其他階段產生重大影響,並以複雜的方式影響系統動力學。例如,更頻繁地進行篩查將增加篩查階段的工作量,但可能減少後續治療階段的工作量,因為患者轉化為更嚴重狀態的可能性降低。此外,分配給每個階段的能力將影響患者的等待時間,從而影響他們健康狀態的轉化。我們將使用一般的排隊網絡模型捕捉這些內生的相互作用和系統動力學中的關鍵權衡。這允許決策者評估不同政策的全局影響,做出優化決策以提高系統效率。其次,我們通過採用人群動力學方法關注系統層面的績效。這種方法適合分析不同政策對系統層面的影響,因此可為監管大區域人群健康狀況的大型醫院和政策制定者提供有用的管理見解。人群方法還為求解複雜系統中的最優政策提供了分析可行性。 我們將開發一個排隊網絡模型,納入癌症管理的多個階段、患者狀態的隨機轉化,以及患者風險情況和服務者類型的異質性。我們將使用分析和數值方法,展示決策者如何在這個複雜系統中做出全局最優決策。此外,我們將通過與中國大陸一家頂尖綜合醫院的合作,將我們的模型應用於實際數據。本研究有助於癌症篩查計劃安排、醫療運營管理,以及為政策制定者提供數據驅動的決策支持等領域。此外,我們預計研究成果將為醫療從業者提供有價值的管理見解和可實施的建議。

16504024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16504024.value: 企业投资，融资和流动性管理：理论和证据

16504024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16504024.value: 当面临巨大的不确定性时，企业如何管理其现金持有量？现金管理策略与其他公司决策是如何互相影响的？哪些因素决定了公司现金持有量的分布？几十年来，这些问题一直吸引着经济学家的关注。Bolton、Chen 和 Wang（2011）阐明了企业决策的相互交织的本质并表明他们仅依赖现金与资本的比率。然而，关于企业的流动性管理又是如何受到公司其他特征影响，例如公司规模和盈利能力，则仍不清楚。 为了填补这一空白，该项目将针对有流动性约束的企业开发一个易于求解的动态流动性管理模型。我们的目的是研究具有持久性影响的盈利冲击，规模收益递减，以及融资成本等因素对公司的现金持有量和托宾q的影响。通过清晰的刻画各种公司决策，包括流动性管理、投资、融资和分红等，我们将揭示这些决策如何受到公司规模和盈利水平的影响。利用实际数据来校准我们的模型，我们的项目将解释公司规模和盈利能力何时以及在何种程度上决定公司现金持有量的分布。该项目将为企业提供实用指南以有效管理投融资和其他活动的流动性。

16505124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16505124.value: 塑造更绿色的未来： 组织的时间视野对脱碳承诺和碳减排的影响

16505124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16505124.value: Climate change is a pressing challenge that has led to extreme weather events and natural disasters, causing severe casualties and economic losses. Firms are under pressure from regulators, investors, and stakeholders to take action to mitigate their climate impacts, as part of broader Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) considerations (Flammer, Toffel & Viswanathan, 2021). However, firms face short-term profitability goals and other stakeholder demands that may conflict with investing in fulfilling climate pledges (Sampson & Shi, 2023). This raises two questions: What determines firms' tendency to make decarbonization pledges and strategies? Do these pledges and strategies effectively reduce their carbon footprints? We address these questions by focusing on organizational time horizon. Organizational time horizon describes the temporal distance that organizations consider for future events and decisions (DesJardine & Bansal, 2019). Climate risk is likely to have a more substantial influence on firms' decision-making in the long run, compared to their day-to-day concerns. Despite the significance of its potential impacts, firms’ engagement in climate-related issues will be contingent on the time frames of their strategic decision-making. Therefore, drawing on the literature on organizational time horizon, we tend to investigate how organizational time horizon drives firms’ decarbonization efforts. We argue that firms with a longer time horizon are more likely to set net-zero targets and commit to green innovation strategies since they tend to pay greater attention to long-term objectives and are more likely to consider long-term payoffs and risks, like those imposed by climate change. Physical and regulatory climate risks might be expected to strengthen any influence of an organization’s time horizon on its setting of net-zero targets and adoption of green innovation strategies, because such pressures underscore the significant impacts climate change can have on firms’ business operations (Mueller & Sfrappini, 2022). We plan to investigate the effectiveness of adopting these targets and strategies in terms of firms' carbon footprint. Our study uses data on Chinese listed firms and has important implications for policy and practice aimed at mitigating the impact of climate change. By examining the role of organizational time horizon and attention in driving firms' decarbonization efforts, we can provide insights into the factors that motivate firms to set net-zero targets and adopt green innovation strategies. Moreover, by investigating the effectiveness of these decarbonization pledges and strategies in reducing carbon emissions, we can inform policy and practice aimed at promoting sustainable business practices. 摘要 气候变化是一个紧迫的挑战，已导致极端天气事件和自然灾害，造成了严重的人员伤亡和经济损失。企业正面临来自监管机构、投资者和利益相关者的压力，要求其采取行动以减轻气候影响，这也是更广泛的环境、社会和治理（ESG）考量的一部分(Flammer, Toffel & Viswanathan, 2021)。然而，企业面临的短期盈利目标和其他利益相关者的要求，这可能与履行气候承诺的投资相冲突(Sampson & Shi, 2023)。这就引发了两个问题：是什么决定了企业做出脱碳承诺和制定战略的倾向？这些承诺和战略是否能有效减少碳足迹？我们通过聚焦于组织时间视野来回答这些问题。 组织时间视野描述了组织在未来事件和决策所考虑的时间距离 (DesJardine & Bansal, 2019)。与日常事务相比，气候风险在长期内更有可能对企业决策产生更大的影响。尽管其潜在影响重大，企业参与气候相关事务的程度将取决于其战略决策的时间框架。因此，基于组织时间视野的相关文献，我们倾向于研究组织时间视野如何驱动企业的脱碳努力。 我们认为，时间视野较长的企业更有可能制定净零排放目标并承诺绿色创新策略，因为它们倾向于更关注长期目标，更有可能考虑长期收益和风险，如气候变化带来的风险。物理和监管方面的气候风险可能会加强组织时间视野对其设定净零排放目标和采用绿色创新战略的影响，因为这些压力凸显了气候变化对企业业务运营的重大影响(Mueller & Sfrappini, 2022)。我们还计划研究采用这些目标和战略在减少企业碳足迹方面的有效性。 我们的研究使用了中国上市公司的数据，对旨在减轻气候变化影响的政策和实践具有重要意义。通过研究组织的时间视野和注意力在推动企业脱碳努力中的作用，我们可以深入了解促使企业制定净零目标和采用绿色创新战略的因素。此外，通过研究这些脱碳承诺和战略在减少碳排放方面的有效性，我们可以为旨在促进可持续商业实践的政策和实践提供参考。

16505224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16505224.value: Addiction to shopping is prevalent among consumers. For instance, in the United States alone, about 18 million adults have been affected by shopping addiction. People addicted to shopping keep shopping not to consume the products, but only to enjoy the process of purchasing and cannot restrict their expenditure and time under budget. In this case, shopping could be seen as addictive behavior and may cause severe consequences. We plan to provide evidence for, formalize, and explore the implications of shopping addiction behavior. We aim to answer several questions regarding the nature and magnitude of online shopping addiction. First, how common is online shopping addiction and who are most prone to it? Second, what is the degree of consumer awareness (naive or sophisticated) about their addictive behavior in shopping? Third, which product categories and what platform features may make people more likely to become addicted? Lastly, how can e-commerce platforms design the marketplace to align their profits with customer welfare? How can consumers use self-monitoring devices to control their shopping behavior to achieve desired well-being? We propose to answer these questions by combining experimental approaches and structural modeling. Our proposed study contributes to the literature that has investigated the consumption of addictive products or services. 在美国，大约有1800万成年人受到了购物成瘾的影响。那些对购物上瘾的人不是为了消费产品，而是仅仅享受购买的过程，无法控制自己的开支和时间。此情况下，购物可能被视为一种成瘾行为，并可能对消费者健康和福祉造成严重的负面影响。在此项研究中，我们计划通过实证研究为购物成瘾行为提供证据，规范量化研究方法，并探讨购物成瘾行为的影响。 我们的研究旨在回答几个关于在线购物成瘾的本质和程度的问题。首先，在线购物成瘾的普遍程度如何，哪些人群最容易受到影响？其次，消费者对自己购物成瘾行为的意识程度如何？第三，哪些产品类别和平台功能可能使人们更容易成瘾？最后，电商平台如何设计平台功能以将利润与客户福利对齐？消费者如何利用自我监控工具来控制购物成瘾行为？我们将结合实验方法和消费者决策建模来回答这些问题。我们的研究将对市场学和经济学文献中研究成瘾产品或服务的领域做出贡献。

16506024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16506024.value: 基於因子模型的因果推斷

16506024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16506024.value: We propose a framework for causal inference using factor models. Our first identification strategy is based on the assumption that policy intervention is applied to only a few units. Such an intervention induces structural breaks in the factor loadings in the affected units without affecting the common factors. One example is California's Proposition 99 which affects only a single state without affecting the rest of the US. The proposed framework provides a useful alternative to the popular synthetic control method. We compare our methods with the synthetic control methods of Abadie, et al (2010) and achieve similar results. One advantage of our method is that no numeric optimization is required in estimating the causal effects. Our second identification strategy is based on the assumption that the treated group and the control group are both of large size. This allows us to identify the causal effect even when the policy intervention affects the common factors. We compare the second identification strategy to the popular difference-in-differences method and discuss possible extensions. 本項目提供一個基於因子模型的因果推斷研究框架。我們將考慮兩種政策干預情形並提出相應的分析策略。第一種策略針對的情形是政策干預隻會影響少數經濟個體。在此情形，政策干預會導致因子係數的結構變化但不會影響共同因子本身。比如加利福利亞州的99條例僅影響美國的一個州，而不會直接影響其它州。我們的方法是現有的合成控制方法的有益補充。在現有實例中，比如Abadie及其合作者（2010），我們的定量結果與合成控制方法的結果相似。不同於合成算法，因子因果推斷模型的一個強力優勢在於其免於複雜的優化算法。我們的第二種策略針對的情形是政策干預會廣泛地影響宏觀經濟。在此情形，干預組和對照組的樣本規模類似，所以政策干預會同時影響因子係數和因子本身。我們的識別策略能有效估計此情形下的因果關係。通過跟因果推斷中的差分方法進行比較，我們討論了因子模型的適用範圍及其推廣。

16506824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16506824.value: 大模型如何帮助消费者处理信息?

16506824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16506824.value: In the era of information explosion, consumers are faced with abundant product information before making a purchase decision. Through online retail platforms or user-generated-content platforms, consumers can access information from other consumers who have already experienced the products that they are interested in. Ample evidence has demonstrated that such information can impact consumers’ decision making. However, the sheer volume of information could overwhelm consumers, who find it challenging to extract meaningful information and make informed choices. This research proposes to investigate the prospect of using Large Language Models (LLMs), or Generative AI, to help consumers address the information overload problem. Specifically, we focus on how using an AI shopping assistant can help consumers navigate through the large volume of product reviews, and it can impact consumer’s purchasing decisions. The value of this research lies in the increasing role that online reviews play in shaping consumer behavior. However, the time and effort required to read, analyze, and interpret these reviews can become daunting for individuals with limited time or expertise in a particular domain. By developing an intelligent system that can understand and summarize reviews, we can empower consumers to extract valuable insights without being overwhelmed by the sheer magnitude of information available. However, as LLM is an emerging technology in artificial intelligence, its large-scale application in assisting consumers’ decision-making is yet to be materialized. Therefore, researchers face the challenge of lacking suitable data for study. To address this challenge, we propose to build an online shopping website with real products and their customer reviews that are available on Amazon, and develop a shopping assistant chatbot powered by the latest LLM model from OpenAI. We then run a series of experiments on this shopping platform, tracking their search and purchase behaviors, and investigating how the use of LLM-powered shopping assistants can affect these behaviors. 本研究探讨人工智能在帮助消费者处理信息方面的潜力和效果. 我们旨在搭建虚拟购物平台以及基于大语言模型的购物助理, 通过实验的方式测量人工智能购物助理对消费者信息搜索, 信息处理, 购买决策, 和购买体验的全方位影响. 其中一个重要议题是人工智能助理究竟能否帮助消费者解决信息过载问题. 我们将会讨论这些结果对人工智能时代下购物平台的设计, 市场机制和结构, 消费者福利的启示.

16506924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16506924.value: 不可预测波动性如何塑造信任

16506924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16506924.value: Trust is essential for effective professional and personal relationships. Over the past 40 years, there has been a large literature examining the interpersonal effects of trust. Although foundational trust research proposed the importance of predictability for trust (Johnson-George and Swap, 1982; Mayer et al., 1995; McAllister, 1995, Rempel et al., 1985), work building on these ideas has treated predictability inconsistently. In this research, I plan on investigating how volatility in key character traits (Integrity, Sociability, and Ability), and the extent to which this volatility along each trait is predictable, influence trust. I plan on conducting this research in four key stages. In Stage 1 of this research, I plan on developing a scale to assess perceptions of Integrity, Sociability, and Ability, the volatility of each dimension, and the predictability of the volatility. I then plan on comparing the results of this scale to establish trust scales (e.g., the ABI scale; Mayer & Davis, 1999) to assess to whether capturing the unpredictable volatility of each trait enables us to better understand trust. In Stage 2, I plan on conducting experiments where I manipulate the extent to which an individual demonstrates high or low levels of a character trait (Integrity, Sociability, or Ability), the volatility, and the predictability of the volatility in order to understand the causal nature of unpredictable volatility and trust. In Stage 3, I plan on assessing to what extent individuals are accurate in their self-assessments of their own unpredictable volatility. In Stage 4, I will examine how individuals’ own unpredictable volatility influences their trust of others, as well as potential interventions which might make individuals more trusting of others who are perceived to demonstrate unpredictable behavior (e.g., colleagues with a mental illness). Combined, these findings could help to deepen our theoretical and practical understanding of trust within organizations. 信任是有效的职业和人际关系的基石。过去四十年间，大量文献致力于探讨信任对人际关系的影响。尽管早期的信任研究提出了可预测性对于信任的重要性 (Johnson-George和Swap, 1982; Mayer等, 1995; McAllister, 1995; Rempel等, 1985)，但基于这些理念的后续研究对可预测性的处理却不尽一致。本研究将探讨关键人格特质（正直、社交技能和能力）的波动性，以及这种波动在每个特质上的可预测程度如何影响信任 本研究计划通过四个关键阶段展开。第一阶段，本研究将开发一个综合量表，用于评估个体对诚信、社交能力和能力的感知，以及这些维度的波动性及其可预测程度。随后，本研究将比较该量表与现有信任量表（如ABI量表；Mayer & Davis, 1999）的结果，以评估捕捉各特质的不可预测波动性是否能够深化我们对信任的理解。第二阶段，本研究将设计实验，通过操纵个体展现的性格特质（正直、社交技能或能力）水平、波动性及其可预测程度，以探究不可预测波动性与信任之间的因果关系。第三阶段，本研究将评估个体对自身不可预测波动性的自我评估准确度。第四阶段，本研究将探讨个体自身的不可预测波动性如何影响其对他人的信任倾向，并研究可能的干预策略，这些策略旨在提高个体对表现出不可预测行为者（如患有精神疾病的同事）的信任程度。 总体而言，这些研究结果有望深化我们对组织内信任的理论和实践理解。

16507624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16507624.value: 投资者如何使用期权——来自印度股市的证据

16507624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16507624.value: Options are redundant in many standard asset-pricing models, and yet option markets have shown tremendous growth in the recent decades. To explain this growth, newer models typically introduce heterogeneous investors that differ in their risk aversions or beliefs. These models clarify the risk exposures of different investors and the risk sharing implicit in their option positions in a general equilibrium setting. However, testing empirically these newer models is far from trivial, and one main reason for that is the lack of suitable and comprehensive datasets that distinguish different investor types and include both their equity and option trades. This project will use a rich new dataset from India's National Stock Exchange that is particularly suitable for empirical investigations that involve (i) heterogeneous investors, (ii) their trading in both stocks and options, and (iii) their exposure to a single (or low-dimensional) source of equity risk, which brings us very close to the stylized setting of asset-pricing models. This dataset allows us to construct the total risk exposures (or ex-ante profit and loss profiles) and their dynamics for various categories of investors for various future states. These risk exposures are novel two-dimensional objects (surfaces), the two dimensions being price and maturity. These surfaces (hopefully) can be described with a few parameters. Of particular interest will be the parameters that describe the tails, which are most informative about the risk considerations of various investors and provide an ideal setting to investigate the risk sharing among multiple investors and its evolution over time. 期权在许多标准资产定价模型中都是多余的，但期权市场 近几十年来显示出巨大的增长。为了解释这种增长，更新 模型通常会引入异质投资者，他们的风险厌恶程度或程度不同 信念。这些模型阐明了不同投资者的风险敞口和风险 在一般均衡环境下，他们的期权头寸隐含着共享。 然而，对这些新模型进行实证测试绝非易事，一个主要原因 因为缺乏合适且全面的数据集来区分不同的 投资者类型并包括他们的股票和期权交易。该项目将使用一个 来自印度国家证券交易所的丰富新数据集，特别适合 实证调查涉及（i）异质投资者，（ii）他们在两者的交易 股票和期权，以及（iii）他们对单一（或低维）来源的敞口 股权风险，这使我们非常接近资产定价模型的程式化设置。 该数据集使我们能够构建总风险敞口（或事前损益） 配置文件）及其对各种未来状态的各类投资者的动态。 这些风险暴露是新颖的二维物体（表面），二维 是价格和成熟度。这些表面（希望）可以用一些东西来描述 参数。 特别令人感兴趣的是描述尾部的参数，这些参数是最重要的 提供有关各种投资者风险考虑的信息，并提供理想的 设置调查多个投资者之间的风险分担及其演变 时间。

16507724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16507724.value: 平民屠殺的經濟遺產: 來自朝鮮戰爭的證據

16507724.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16507724.value: Prof Jung, Yeonha Prof Lim, Jia De Gedeon

16507724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16507724.value: 朝鮮戰爭(1950-1953年)是20世紀致死人數最多的衝突之一，據估計約有300萬人喪生，其中至少100萬是平民 (Halliday & Cumings, 1988)。南北韓軍隊都曾實施過屠殺。例如，在朝鮮入侵初期的保導聯盟屠殺中，韓國總統李承晚下令處決涉嫌共產主義同情者。同樣地，有充分的記錄表明，朝鮮軍隊在佔領的南韓領土上進行了階級清洗，受害者包括商人、地主、教師、政府官員及其家屬。因此，除了戰爭對物質資本的毀滅性破壞外，大規模平民屠殺還可能對人力資本和社會資本造成難以磨滅的損害，而這兩者都是經濟發展中的重要因素。 通過結合史料、當代人口普查(1930-2010年)、企業層面的調查(1921-2004年)以及社會調查(2003-2021 年)數據，本研究探討了戰時平民屠殺對韓國經濟發展的短期和長期影響。我們將收集並數字化兩個關於平民屠殺的新數據來源:(一)民間社會和政府組織的事件級數據，提供每次屠殺事件的詳細位置、肇事者和平民傷亡情況;(二)包含被朝鮮軍隊殺害平民地理和人口信息的個體級數據，提供被殺害平民的個體教育和職業信息。 這些微觀數據源將幫助我們研究階級清洗期間個人被殺害如何影響韓國的戰後發展軌跡。 我們將使用一個利用平民屠殺局部強度外生變化的工具變量 (IV) 策略來確定因果關係。我們的識別策略利用了這 樣一個事實，即平民屠殺在朝鮮軍隊從聯合國進攻線撤退的地方更為激烈，而這條進攻線是由仁川登陸戰役和釜山防禦戰兩次關鍵行動形成的。我們使用距離聯合國進攻線的遠近作為地方平民屠殺強度的工具變量。鑒於仁川登陸和釜山防禦戰的成功是高度出乎意料且迅速發生的事件，由這些行動所形成的進攻線的鄰近性將為我們提供一個合理的平民屠殺集中度的外生變化。 據我們所知，這是首個定量研究戰時平民屠殺對韓國長期經濟發展影響的研究。在學術方面，我們通過將獨特的個體受害數據與豐富的微觀層面企業、人口和態度調查相結合，提供了關於平民屠殺對戰後結果的豐富因果證據。使用個體受害信息將有助於識別平民屠殺遺留的具體機制，這種方法在之前的文獻中尚未得到探索。在政策方面，我們為政策制定者提供了關鍵見解，以幫助緩解內戰對人力資本積累和經濟發展的長期影響。

16508024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16508024.value: 快时尚供应链中的需求学习：信息共享、风险分配与环境影响

16508024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16508024.value: In the fast fashion industry where demand is highly uncertain, the inability to accurately forecast demand can result in a mismatch, leading to stockouts or unsold inventory. Hence, demand learning and rapid response play a crucial role in determining the operational performance and environmental consequences of fast fashion companies. Specifically, firms rely heavily on a business strategy that learns about uncertain consumer preference by experimenting with new designs and monitoring their early sales and then expediting the production process to replenish the trendy products. This business model has become increasingly popular in recent years following the success of companies such as Zara and H&M, and aided by the rise of e-commerce platforms. Given that most fast fashion retailers outsource their manufacturing activities to independent suppliers, however, little is known about the challenges of channel coordination when the supply chain players dynamically learn about and adapts to the uncertain consumer demand. Different from the centralized system, decentralized supply chain players may have the divergent interests and incentives in business-to-business interaction, which could lead to inefficiencies in learning about consumer demand and matching supply with demand. In this project, we will emphasize four key challenges on demand learning in fast fashion supply chain, including channel coordination, information structure, risk distribution, and environmental consequence. Because the supplier can leverage the retailer's acquired demand information to charge higher wholesale prices for trendy products, it is unclear, whether and to what extent, the supply chain players still find demand learning beneficial. Moreover, we also examine whether decentralized decision-making inefficiencies can be reduced by keeping consumer sales information invisible to the supplier or sharing inventory risk between the supplier and retailer. Finally, we discuss how these strategies impact the environmental consequences of the supply chain, given the fast fashion industry's widespread criticism for generating disposal waste. 快时尚行业的需求高度不确定，使得准确预测需求变得困难，这可能导致供需不匹配，进而造成缺货或滞销库存。因此，需求学习和快速响应在决定快时尚公司的运营绩效和环境影响方面发挥着至关重要的作用。具体而言，企业在商业策略上高度依赖通过实验新设计并监测早期销售情况来了解不确定的消费者偏好，然后加快生产过程以补充流行产品。近年来，随着Zara和H&M等公司的成功，这种商业模式变得愈加流行，并受益于电子商务平台的崛起。然而，由于大多数快时尚零售商将制造活动外包给独立供应商，因此关于供应链参与者在动态学习和适应不确定消费者需求时所面临的渠道协调挑战仍知之甚少。与集中式系统不同，分散的供应链参与者在企业对企业的互动中可能存在不同的利益和激励，这可能导致在了解消费者需求和匹配供需方面的低效。 在本项目中，我们将重点讨论快时尚供应链中需求学习的四个关键挑战，包括渠道协调、信息结构、风险分配和环境影响。由于供应商可以利用零售商获取的需求信息，对流行产品收取更高的批发价格，因此尚不清楚供应链参与者在多大程度上仍然认为需求学习是有益的。此外，我们还将探讨通过让供应商无法看到消费者销售信息或在供应商与零售商之间共享库存风险，是否可以减少分散决策带来的低效。最后，我们将讨论这些策略如何影响供应链的环境后果，考虑到快时尚行业因产生废弃物而受到的广泛批评。

16508524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16508524.value: 自新大陆：制裁与移民投票

16508524.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16508524.value: Dr Chen, Ting Prof Han, Li

16508524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16508524.value: 在过去的三十年里，全球经济一体化显著加速，尤其体现在移民到西方民主国家，特别是美国的人数大幅增加，且移民的来源国也更加多样化。近年来，全球化的趋势显示出一个显著的转变，即越来越多地使用制裁手段来实现特定的经济和政治目标。这一转变引发了一个关键问题：移民在多大程度上对其居住国对其原籍国实施的制裁作出反应，特别是在投票行为方面？ 相关研究相对较少，部分原因在于假设移民投票的可能性低于本地居民，或者认为他们自然倾向于支持居住国。然而，这些假设本身存在局限性。移民通常在入籍多年后才成为具有影响力的投票群体。此外，居住国与原籍国之间复杂的互动关系可能对移民产生独特的影响。有证据表明，移民的政治态度可能会受到其原籍国的影响。制裁有可能激发移民对居住国现任政党的负面情绪。此外，由于居住国与原籍国关系恶化，移民可能会遭受经济损失或经历更多的仇恨犯罪，从而在这一群体中引发恐惧和不满。这些因素强调了对制裁对移民投票行为影响进行全面调查的必要性，这也是本次资助申请所要研究的主题。 一个主要的实证挑战在于投票记录中缺乏关于移民原籍国的数据。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了两种解决方案：1）我们将利用LinkedIn用户数据集来识别移民到美国的人，并将其与L2的选民登记记录进行匹配。通过这种方法，我们可以研究制裁对这一特定群体投票行为的影响。2）我们还将通过基于姓名的技术推断亚裔美国选民的原籍国。基于现有方法，我们将开发一种基于词典的方法，通过分析不同亚洲国家的独特罗马化方式来推断原籍国。该方法将使我们能够更广泛地研究亚裔移民选民。 对于两种方法所得的样本，本研究将评估制裁对两个主要变量的影响：1）未来选民登记的可能性，2）登记选民的党派归属变化。我们还将调查潜在的中介因素，包括经济冲击、信息消费和仇恨犯罪发生率。项目的数据来源将包括全球制裁数据库、选民登记记录、LinkedIn用户数据、全国亚裔美国人调查、美国人口普查数据、选举数据以及有关经济冲击和仇恨犯罪的信息。

16508824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16508824.value: 未来声景：交通噪音的经济影响

16508824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16508824.value: 随着当代社会对汽车交通运输的依赖日益增加，交通污染问题引发了广泛关注。交通污染的主要来源包括汽车的尾气排放和交通噪音。本研究旨在更精确地估算噪音对经济和环境的影响，尤其是它们对居民健康和房产价值的影响。通过结合汽车及交通流数据和噪音监测信息，我们在享乐分析框架内采用工具变量法，分析交通噪音污染变化的经济后果。同时，电动汽车（EVs）因其清洁、高效且无噪音的特点，成为减少交通污染和推动可持续交通实践的重要解决方案。 本研究的结果对交通政策（噪音屏蔽设施）和电动汽车相关政策具有重要的政策启示。

16600224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16600224.value: 在香港大學實現多元化：國際化儒家背景下的酷兒歸屬論述

16600224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16600224.value: How is language used to navigate sociocultural context amongst sexual minority individuals in Hong Kong? How do Hong Kong institutions and their staff frame diversity and sexual minorities? The proposed project uses sociocultural discourse analysis to explore the description and performance of sexual minority identity in Hong Kong (Blommaert, 2005). It investigates the interplay of ideology and practice by comparing the language used by institutions and their staff with the ways identities are performed in everyday life. Data will consist of 1) printed and online institutional materials dealing with diversity and/or sexual minorities; 2) transcripts of interviews with institutional staff responsible for diversity and inclusion; and 3) observational data from multi-sited ethnographies with NGOs and LGBTQ+ societies (Marcus, 1995). Diversity and sexual minority identity are seen here as pertaining to key contemporary ideological debates amongst individuals, groups and institutions. Close analysis of their associated linguistic moves will be used to elucidate the navigation of multifaceted ideological context in everyday life. Hong Kong features an especially complex matrix of influential value systems, ranging from the broadly cosmopolitan to the broadly traditional. Its distinctly globalised outlook as ‘Asia’s world city’ reflects its long history as a fundamentally internationalised site, while the salience of notions of ‘Chinese culture’ corresponds to a prominence of relatively conservative, Confucian ideology. The influence of conservative Christianity is also prominent in many cases, as is recent legislation which mandates greater inclusion in powerful institutions. Furthermore, in institutions such as universities, recognising diversity means not only serving the needs of a broad spectrum of stakeholders, but also demonstrating international reach and global perspective. These ideological intersections salient in contemporary ‘cosmopolitan, Confucian’ Hong Kong inevitably affect sociolinguistic approaches to gender and sexual identity, but individual and institutional responses will vary. By examining specific, associated language and practice, using the tools of sociocultural discourse analysis, the project will contribute to knowledge of and of queer linguistics and shed light on the discursive construction of sexuality and gender within the contemporary Hong Kong context. Furthermore, insight from the project will be used to create community impact in the later stages of the project, through the development of sociolinguistic workshops for university staff and community events for student organisations. It will also promote practical communicative tools for navigating sexual minority identity in a culturally sensitive yet empowering way. 香港機構使用甚麼語言來為性小眾群體建構多元化？在這些機構中，自我認同為多元性別者的人士如何使用語言來駕馭意識形態背景？ 本研究項目運用社會文化話語分析來探討本港大學在機構及日常環境兩個層面中對多元性別身分的描述和表現，並透過比較不同機構所使用的語言與日常生活中多元性別身分的表達和協商方式考察意識形態與社會和語言實踐的相互作用。 普遍而言，多元化主題——尤其關於多元性別身分——與香港（和其他地方）當代社會的主要爭論息息相關，而針對語言進行深入分析可以闡明相關意識形態影響的多面性。舉例說，香港擁有一個特別複雜、大體上從國際橫跨至傳統的強大價值體系矩陣。「中華文化」概念的彰顯往往與相對傳統的儒家意識形態所佔據的顯著地位相對應，而保守的基督教影響同時亦遍及全港。此外，香港作為「亞洲國際大都會」所抱持獨特的全球化觀點反映出其作為一個從根本上國際化場所的歷史及與世界主義的連繫。在此背景下，近年來要求機構必須促進包容性的法律條例和內部政策變得更具影響力。因此，與多元化相關的語言和實踐在大學和其他機構中日益俱增；然而，這意味着這些機構不僅需要滿足廣泛利益相關者的需求，還需展示其國際影響力和全球視野，可見認識和促進多元化絕非輕而易舉的事。 這些問題背後的意識形態交叉點涉及到當代香港這個「國際、儒家、基督教」城市的政治化辯論和日常互動，個人和機構無疑有着各色各樣的反嚮。當然，性小眾人士亦同樣地以五花八門的方式去理解和表現其身分，反映出其對相關社會和意識形態壓力的駕馭能力。有鑑於此，本研究項目將剖析教職員、學生和其他利益相關者的語言和實踐（書面和口頭、線上和線下），並透過社會文化話語分析來研究在當代本港大學中性和性別的話語建構。

16600324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16600324.value: 政治收權下的當代中國地方政府創新：雙階段序列研究

16600324.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16600324.value: Dr Huang, Biao Prof Ma, Liang Dr Tang, Na

16600324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16600324.value: Policy innovations are of paramount importance for good governance in contemporary societies as they have the potential to drive progress and address complex social problems. It is widely believed that active local government experimentation and innovation in China since the 1980s were one of the cornerstones underlying the country’s rapid socioeconomic development. Yet, there have been increasing concerns that the powerful political recentralization since 2013 has led to a remarkable decrease in local government innovations. Others, however, contend that the fundamental momentum of local state dynamism remains robust in China, despite the marked changes in political incentives and opportunity structure. This scholarly disagreement points to a prominent theoretical debate in public administration and the broad political science literature: Does political (re)centralization stifle local government innovations? This proposed study seeks to answer this central question through an empirical investigation. We first review the mainstream theoretical arguments that explain local innovations in authoritarian China, namely, the fiscal decentralization argument, the promotion tournament argument, and the need-based argument, which will be re-examined against the backdrop of political recentralization. Emerging theoretical explanations, such as ‘policy experimentation under pressure’ and the ‘administrative choice’ argument will be incorporated into our analytical framework too. Several research hypotheses are formulated to guide the study, inspired by not only the theoretical literature, but also the research team’s long observations and pilot interviews since 2017. The research design adopts a two-stage sequential strategy synthesizing a first-stage text-as-data quantitative analysis and a second-stage comparative case studies in two provinces. Using text-mining techniques, the first stage will collect data from a large corpus of official texts to substantiate all types of local government innovations from 2008 to 2023. This step seeks to map out the macro landscape of innovations before and after the central leadership transition and identify the various types of such innovations. Zooming into the micro level, the second stage offers in-depth qualitative insights through comparative case study design. Such a combination of quantitative and qualitative evidence maximizes the analytical power of this study. Specializing in public policy and administration, the highly experienced research team has a strong track record in the field. Wide local connections can facilitate smooth data collection. Upon completion, this study will advance scholarly knowledge on the dynamics of local state dynamism in an authoritarian system and shed fresh light on administrative behaviours in contemporary China. 在當代社會，政策創新不但推動進步，亦可助力解決複雜的社會問題，對於達致良治至關重要。自1980年代以來，形形色色的地方政策試點與政府創新被廣泛認為是中國經濟社會快速發展的關鍵推動力。然而，2013年以來的強勢中央收權令部分學者認為中國地方政府創新的黃金時期已然逝去。不過亦有學者認為，縱使政治激勵和機會結構發生重要變化，地方政府創新的根本動力仍然存在。上述爭鳴指向公共行政及政治科學研究中的重大理論問題：政治收權是否必然抑制地方政府創新？本研究旨在透過一個雙階段序列研究設計來回答上述研究問題。 我們將首先對中國地方政府創新的主流理論解釋進行回顧及評估，爾後在政治收權的大背景下檢視其解釋力。近年來出現的新理論解釋亦將被納入文獻回顧之中。隨後我們將基於理論文獻及研究團隊對中國地方政府創新的長期觀察提出若干研究假設，用以指導實證研究。在雙階段序列研究設計包括第一階段的大文本量化研究以及第二階段在兩個省進行的比較案例分析。其中，第一階段將採用政策文本挖掘技術對於2008年至2023年間中國地方政府創新的大量素材進行處理分析，釐清創新的類型學，幫助我們對政治收權前後地方政府創新的格局進行宏觀闡釋。第二階段的研究則聚焦微觀層面，透過比較案例分析更加深入地解釋地方政府創新的動力、過程及機制。此一結合量化研究及質性研究的設計將大大提高研究的解釋力。 研究團隊由四位具有豐富研究經驗的公共政策及行政領域的學者組成。在中國內地兩個研究省份廣泛的研究網絡可以保障本研究的順利進行。收官之後，本研究將深化威權體制下地方政府創新的理論，並對當代中國地方行政行為提供新的解釋。

16601224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16601224.value: 監管能否推動循環經濟？紡織業中生產者責任延伸法規與可持續創新之關係研究

16601224.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16601224.value: Prof Nickolay, Anguelov Dr Steuer, Benjamin

16601224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16601224.value: How can governments drive the changes required to make one of the largest, most polluting, high growth, globally dispersed industrial sectors more sustainable? The global textile and fashion industry is one with a significant environmental impact, including overconsumption of natural resources, water pollution, greenhouse gas emissions, and waste into landfills . In terms of CO2 alone, the apparel sector will need to achieve a 45% reduction in carbon emissions by 2023 to achieve the 1.5C pathway 1. The industry is estimated to have used 79 billion cubic meters of water in 2015, was the third largest source of land degradation and use in 2020, is responsible for 20% of global water pollution. In 2018, the EU Waste Framework Directive of 2008 was amended to outline a roadmap towards circularity in the EU textile space, resting on an an overall focus on repair, reuse, a target for member states to establish separate collections of household textile waste by Jan 1, 2025, 12 and a shift of the burden towards producers through encouragement of extended producer responsibility (EPR). In response, France (2020), Sweden (2022), Italy (2023) and the Netherlands (2023) have promulgated binding EPR regulations, which include targets of the proportion of clothing to be recovered for either recycling or resale While implementation is emergent, starting with France in 2020, and the others rolling out rules in 2023 for implementation in 2025, EPR for textiles may quickly become an EU-wide directive. This past July (2023), the EU released a “Proposal for a targeted revision of the Waste Framework Directive.” This revision, would require the implementation of a harmonized EPR program across Europe, with targets for collection, recycling and reuse, policies to prevent ‘dumping’ of post-consumer textiles within (or beyond) the EU, and incentives for the development of collection and recycling infrastructures, and innovations that support a more circular apparel value chain. The effectiveness of this approach remains to be seen. There are a number of well-understood challenges for EPR in textiles, specifically. At the core, there is a disconnect between the policy goals to be achieved, and the goals that can actually be achieved with current technologies, infrastructure, and business models. Given this context, this project will take up an important policy research question: Can EPR systems drive sustainability and circularity in globally dispersed value chains? 政府如何推動必須的改變，使一個龐大、嚴重污染、高增長、全球分散的工業更加可持續？全球紡織和時尚產業對環境有明顯的巨大影響，包括自然資源的過度消耗、水污染、溫室氣體排放以及堆填區的廢棄物。僅就二氧化碳來說，服裝業需在2023年前實現45%的碳排放減少，以達到攝氏1.5度的目標。據估計，該行業在2015年使用了790億立方米的水，並在2020年成為土地退化和使用的第三大來源，負責全球20%的水污染。在2018年，歐盟對2008年的廢物框架指令進行修訂，以制定歐盟紡織領域邁向循環經濟的路線圖，重點在於修復、重用，並要求成員國在2025年1月1日前建立家庭紡織廢物的單獨收集系統，並通過鼓勵生產者責任延伸（EPR）來將責任轉移給生產者。作為回應，法國（2020年）、瑞典（2022年）、意大利（2023年）和荷蘭（2023年）頒布了具有約束力的EPR法規，其中包括回收或轉售衣物比例的目標。儘管這些法規的實施仍在初期，從法國在2020年開始和其他國家在2023年推出規則並計劃在2025年實施，紡織品的EPR有機會很快成為歐盟範圍內的指令。今年7月（2023年），歐盟發布了《廢物框架指令修訂建議》。該修訂要求在歐洲實施統一的EPR計劃，設置收集、回收和重用的目標，制定防止消費後紡織品在歐盟內外‘傾倒’的政策，並激勵發展收集和回收基礎設施以及支持更循環的服裝價值鏈的創新。這種方法的有效性仍有待觀察。紡織品的EPR還有一些眾所周知的挑戰。核心問題在於政策目標與現有技術、基礎設施和商業模式之間的脫節。在此背景下，本項目將探討一個重要的政策研究問題：EPR系統能否在全球分散的價值鏈中推動可持續性和循環性？

17100924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17100924.value: 探究基因組中尿嘧啶在人類細胞表觀遺傳中的作用

17100924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17100924.value: The fundamental units encoding all genetic information are the nucleobases adenine (A), cytosine (C), guanine (G), thymine (T) and uracil (U). A curiosity in the central dogma of biology is that DNA is encoded by A, C, G and T, while RNA is encoded by A, C, G and U. One hypothesis of why T is used instead of U in DNA is to maintain DNA integrity as C is frequently deaminated to U, a process which would be difficult for cells to recognise as an error if U was also part of the DNA code. However, mammalian DNA polymerases can efficiently use dUTP instead of dTTP to replicate DNA. Thus, cells have evolved safeguards to minimise genomic uracil with dUTPase to ensure low levels of dUTP in the nucleotide pool and that any uracil present in DNA is efficiently repaired by uracil dna glycosylase (UDG). Despite these safeguards, genomic uracil is readily detectable in DNA. In normal human cells, different methods have found uracil to range 10-100 per million bases in genomic DNA. This number substantially increases when the nucleotide pool is pharmacologically perturbed, cytidine deaminase activated, or UDG activity compromised. While high levels of uracil can cause DNA damage, there is also strong evidence that genome uracil has biologically important functions, including meiotic cell division, antibody diversification, insect metamorphosis and regulation of transcription. With the recent development of methods for profiling genomic uracil, it has become possible to examine its role in finer detail. We have analysed genome-wide distribution of genomic uracil, finding that it is differentially associated with chromatin with localised variation at transcription factor binding sites, some of which we have experimentally validated. We hypothesise that genomic uracil may have an underappreciated role in the epigenome, and perturbation that increases uracil in DNA due to misincorporation or cytosine deamination could affect cellular function through epigenetic mechanisms. To study this phenomenon, this project will examine the biological function of genomic uracil through the following aims: (1) Assessment of uracil on gene activation and transcription factor binding (2) Association of chromatin changes with uracil levels in genomic DNA (3) A nanopore sequencing approach for direct detection of uracil in DNA These results will further our understanding of the functional impact of genomic uracil, providing both biological insights and potential improvements in widely used therapeutic strategies that perturb the nucleotide pool. 所有遺傳信息編碼的基本單位是核鹼基：腺嘌呤（A）、胞嘧啶（C）、鳥嘌呤（G）、胸腺嘧啶（T）和尿嘧啶（U）。生物學中心法則中的一個有趣之處是，DNA是由腺嘌呤、胞嘧啶、鳥嘌呤和胸腺嘧啶編碼，而RNA是由腺嘌呤、胞嘧啶、鳥嘌呤和尿嘧啶編碼。關於為什麼在DNA中使用胸腺嘧啶而不是尿嘧啶的一種假說是為了保持DNA的完整性。因為胞嘧啶經常可以通過脫氨反應變成尿嘧啶，如果尿嘧啶也是DNA編碼的一部分，細胞將難以識別這一錯誤的過程。儘管如此，哺乳動物的DNA聚合酶卻可以高效地利用脫氧尿苷三磷酸（dUTP）代替脫氧胸苷三磷酸（dTTP）來複製DNA。因此，細胞已經進化出了一些保護機制，如通過脫氧尿苷三磷酸酶（dUTPase）來確保在核苷酸池中脫氧尿苷三磷酸保持低水平，並通過尿嘧啶DNA糖基化酶（UDG）高效修復任何存在於DNA中的尿嘧啶。 儘管存在這些保護機制，尿嘧啶在基因組DNA中仍然很容易被檢測到。在正常的人類細胞中，不同方法檢測發現尿嘧啶的含量在每百萬基因組DNA鹼基中有10-100個。當核苷酸池受到藥物干擾、胞苷脫氨酶被激活或尿嘧啶DNA糖基化酶活性受損時，這個數字會顯著增加。雖然高水平的尿嘧啶會導致DNA損傷，但也有證據表明基因組尿嘧啶在生物學上具有重要功能，包括減數分裂細胞的分裂、抗體多樣化、昆蟲變態和轉錄調控等。隨著近期基因組尿嘧啶分析方法的發展，使我們現在可以更加深入地研究其作用。我們對基因組尿嘧啶在全基因組範圍內的分佈進行了分析，發現它在不同的染色質區域中有所不同，且在轉錄因子結合位點存在局部差異，其中部分發現我們已通過實驗驗證。 我們假設基因組尿嘧啶在表觀遺傳中可能具有未被充分認識理解的作用。由於錯誤掺入或胞嘧啶脫氨導致的DNA中尿嘧啶的增加，可能通過表觀遺傳機制影響細胞功能。為了研究這一現象，本項目將通過以下目標來研究基因組尿嘧啶的生物學功能： （1）評估尿嘧啶對基因激活和轉錄因子結合的影響 （2）研究染色質變化與基因組DNA中尿嘧啶水平的關聯 （3）開發用於直接檢測DNA中尿嘧啶的納米孔測序方法 這些結果將進一步加深我們對基因組尿嘧啶功能性影響的理解，不僅可以提供生物學見解，還可以優化改進被廣泛使用的干擾核苷酸池的治療策略。

17101024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17101024.value: 新型抗菌聚合氟化物預防齲齒

17101024.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17101024.value: Prof LI, Xuechen Prof Yu, Yiru Ollie

17101024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17101024.value: 研究背景:世界衛生組織（WHO）已將氟化氨銀（SDF）納入其基本藥物名單，用於治療影響全球約24億人口（佔全球人口的35%）的蛀牙（齲齒）。牙醫應用38% SDF（44,800 ppm 氟離子）於齲齒的治療，因其能有效阻止齲齒的進展（即靜止齲齒）。SDF靜止齲齒的方法具有簡單、無痛、無創、經濟且不產生氣溶膠等優點。然而，SDF可能會導致患部染色，影響美觀，從而可能導致患者拒絕使用。為此，本研究團隊已成功合成一種生物相容性的聚合物即聚（二烯丙基二甲基胺）氟化物（PDDAF），並已取得專利。PDDAF是一種新型抗菌聚合物，具有再礦化性質，且相較於SDF，其不會導致染色並具有較低的細胞毒性。因此，有必要進一步研究PDDAF在靜止齲齒方面的潛力。 研究目的: 本研究旨在評估PDDAF溶液對以下兩個方面的影響：1）多種致齲生物膜的結構、活性及動力學；2）齲齒中的礦物質和有機物含量以及顏色變化。 研究方法: 本研究開發了一種鹼性（pH 9.5）280,000 ppm PDDAF溶液，該溶液中約含有238,000 ppm陽離子聚合物和42,000 ppm氟離子。研究中將利用人類健康第三磨牙切片製作牙本質切片，並將每片切成三塊，分別進行三種不同處理。研究將準備156個牙本質塊，並通過多種致齲生物膜進行脫礦化，以製造人工齲損。這些牙本質塊將被均勻分配至三個治療組，分別使用1）PDDAF溶液，2）38% SDF溶液（作為陽性對照組），或3）去離子水（作為陰性對照組）。處理後的牙本質塊將在電腦控制的人工口腔中進行致齲挑戰。研究將通過掃描電子顯微鏡、共聚焦激光掃描顯微鏡以及菌落形成單位計數等方法，檢查生物膜的結構、活性和動力學。同時，將利用掃描電子顯微鏡、X射線衍射、傅立葉變換紅外光譜和分光光度法，分別檢查牙本質塊的表面形態、元素含量、晶體特徵、膠原降解和顏色變化。此外，研究將重複進行（除膠原降解外），並使用126個牙釉質塊進行相關測試。 可能的結果及意義: 預期該新型、生物相容性且不導致染色的PDDAF溶液將展現出抗菌和再礦化的特性。若能證實PDDAF溶液在不導致染色的情況下對再礦化齲齒具有顯著效果，則有望將PDDAF應用於臨床治療，以實現齲齒的靜止。這一發現的應用前景及對齲齒管理的潛在益處將極為廣泛。

17101324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17101324.value: 基因組挖掘为导向的P450催化雙芳基橋環大環肽類抗生素的發現和改造

17101324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17101324.value: Antimicrobial resistance remains a significant global threat, contributing significantly to mortality rates worldwide. Microbial macrocyclic peptides have emerged as a promising source of novel peptide antibiotics due to their diverse chemical structures. Biaryl-bridged macrocyclic peptides (BMPs), crosslinked by versatile P450 enzymes, have shown great promise as a source of macrocyclic peptide antibiotics. Successful examples of BMPs as antibiotics include ribosomal cihunamide, non-ribosomal vancomycin, and arylomycin. While BMPs show great therapeutic potential, their complex structure presents significant challenges in synthetic preparation. Fortunately, recent advancements in P450 enzyme studies provide a promising and sustainable alternative for biosynthesizing BMPs and their analogs. P450 enzymes are known for their effectiveness as catalysts, but their potential in modifying ribosomal peptides (RiPPs) as class-defined modification enzymes has been understudied. In our preliminary work, we developed a rule-based genome mining strategy that harnesses the intrinsic biosynthetic principles of RiPPs to facilitate the identification of diverse class-defined P450s. The versatile catalytic capabilities of these P450s enable the formation of novel aromatic crosslinks, serving as valuable starting templates for the biosynthesis and bioengineering of BMPs. Additionally, we have discovered a group of P450s that can crosslink diketopiperazine (DKP) produced by concise NRPS-like enzymes, representing a distinct and underutilized pathway for BMP macrocyclization. Using synthetic biology techniques, we identified a new BMP antibiotic family that effectively targets gram-positive bacteria. Our preliminary data also revealed the promiscuity of several P450s. These findings provide a solid foundation for our proposed project's discovery and bioengineering of BMP antibiotics. Our proposal aims to unlock untapped biosynthetic potential through synthetic biology strategies, enabling the generation of new natural BMPs and new-to-nature analogs for antibiotic discovery. To achieve this, we have outlined four independent yet interrelated objectives: (1) Utilize synthetic biology techniques to transform unexplored BMP biosynthetic gene clusters into viable antibiotic candidates; (2) Conduct a comprehensive characterization of the enzymatic activity and mechanism of P450 enzymes; (3) Leverage the versatile nature of P450s to bioengineer new-to-nature BMPs. (4) Evaluate the efficacy of these antibiotic peptides in vitro and in vivo, focusing on identifying low-resistance risk and low-toxicity candidates. We will also collaborate with microbiologists to investigate the mode of action of these antibiotic peptides. Our ultimate goal is to discover new macrocyclic peptide antibiotics that can address the global threat of multidrug-resistant superbugs. Our previous achievements in genomics-guided antibiotic discovery demonstrate our ability to establish a successful and sustainable program in peptide antibiotic discovery. 抗生素耐藥性是全球性威脅，對人類健康產生嚴重影響。 微生物環肽小分子因結構多樣和活性良好，成為新型肽類抗生素的關鍵來源。 特別是P450酶催化的聯芳基偶聯環肽類在抗生素領域展現出巨大潛力，如核糖體肽cihunamide、非核糖體肽vancomycin和arylomycin。 雖然聯芳基偶聯環肽類具有巨大治療潛力，但複雜結構令BMP的化學合成具挑戰。 P450催化多肽環化酶学研究最新進展為生物合成聯芳基偶聯環肽類抗生素供了有效可行替代方案。 P450酶以其高效的催化能力而聞名，P450酶的催化功能多樣性使其能催化新型芳基偶聯，為聯芳基偶聯環肽類的生物合成及改造提供可能; 但其作為修飾酶在核糖體合成和翻譯后修飾肽（RiPPs）的催化潛力還未充分研究。 我們的前期研究開發了一種基於生合成邏輯的基因組挖掘策略，初步發掘多功能修飾RiPP的P450酶。 利用合成生物學策略，我們鑒定了一個新的聯芳基偶聯環肽類抗生素家族，能有效抑制革蘭氏陽性細菌。 同時，我們的實驗結果顯示這類P450酶具有良好的底物寬泛性，為聯芳基偶聯環肽類抗生素的發現和生物工程改造提供了堅實的基礎。 我們的研究目標是通過聯用基因挖掘及合成生物學策略，解鎖P450酶未開發的生物合成潛力，以挖掘新的聯芳基偶聯環肽類抗生素。 為此，我們設定了四個相互關聯的目標：（1）利用合成生物學技術將未開發的聯芳基偶聯環肽類生物合成基因簇產物轉化為有效的抗生素候選藥; （2）全面表徵P450酶的催化能力和機制; （3）利用P450酶的多功能性對全新的聯芳基偶聯環肽類進行生物工程改造; （4）評估這些肽類抗生素在體內和體外的藥效，尋找具有低抗藥性風險和低毒性的候選藥。 我們還將與微生物學家合作，研究這些肽類抗生素的體內效果和作用機理。 最終，我們希望發現新的聯芳基偶聯環肽類抗生素，以應對全球多葯耐葯超級細菌的威脅。

17101524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17101524.value: 揭示馬爾尼菲籃狀菌以半胱氨酸爲介導的免疫逃逸新機製及其在靶向治療中的應用

17101524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17101524.value: 馬爾尼菲籃狀菌(Talaromyces marneffei, TM)是一種造成東南亞地區廣泛的侵襲性真菌感染的重要的真菌,。由TM引起的馬爾尼菲籃狀菌病(talaromycosis)的死亡率高達30%,該病主要影響免疫功能低下的個體,尤其是艾滋病患者。儘管其臨床意義重大,對TM的研究相比其他真菌病原體仍然滯後,而且馬爾尼菲籃狀菌病的發病率持續上昇使得這種新興感染性疾病迫切需要關注。 TM能夠在巨噬細胞內存活是其緻病性關鍵所在。然而,調控TM存活和免疫逃逸的精準分子機製仍然不明確。我們最近的發現為此提供了新的線索。首先,相較於其最近親緣物種柄籃狀菌(Talaromyces stipitatus),TM能夠抑製巨噬細胞中NF-κB的激活。其次,TM會在遇到酸性環境(如與巨噬細胞相互作用時)時釋放半胱氨酸。因此,我們假設TM通過分泌半胱氨酸來調節宿主免疫反應以抑製巨噬細胞中NF-κB的激活,從而逃避免疫繫統。 本研究旨在揭示TM利用半胱氨酸介導的在巨噬細胞內生存並逃避宿主免疫的新機製。我們通過TM基因組分析,確定了參與半胱氨酸合成的多個關鍵候選基因,並建立了不具有半胱氨酸合成能力的TM缺陷突變株。本研究的目標是:(i)建立單一候選基因敲除的TM突變株,評估其在抑製NF-κB激活以及在巨噬細胞內存活和感染動物的能力。(ii)採用多學科方法,分析野生型和突變型TM在基因和蛋白水平的差異,以闡明相關信號通路。(iii)探討半胱氨酸介導的免疫逃逸機製是否適用於其他的重要細胞內真菌病原體。(iv) 利用免疫缺陷和正常小鼠模型,評估針對半胱氨酸合成的靶向治療方法在治療TM感染的潛力。 我們的初步結果已經產生了有前景的發現:(i)我們建立了兩株缺失上述候選基因之一的TM突變株,與野生型TM相比，它們的NF-κB激活能力減弱、在巨噬細胞中存活能力降低以及對動物的緻病性下降。(ii)與TM類似, 申克孢子丝菌(Sporothrix schenskii)在酸性條件下也表現出半胱氨酸分泌增加的特性,暗示這可能是細胞內真菌病原體通用的機製。(iii)使用半胱氨酸合成抑製劑治療TM感染的免疫缺陷小鼠,其存活期延長且對降低了真菌的毒力。 這些初步結果對於深入認識TM感染及其治療具有巨大潛力,有望推動針對性治療措施的改進。

17102124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17102124.value: 解析組蛋白分子伴侶C1QBP對核小體和染色質功能的調控機製

17102124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
