17502124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17502124.value: 儿童和老人照料的动态家庭安排：机制与公共政策影响

17502124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17502124.value: Aim: This project aims to explore the mechanisms driving joint childcare and old-age support arrangements between young couples and their parents, and examine the impact of public policy on old-age support, childcare, and female labor market outcomes. Background: Past research has separately analyzed children's provision of old-age support to parents and parents' provision of childcare for children. These studies show that children support their parents for altruistic reasons and strategic bequest concerns, while childcare provision by parents is primarily driven by altruism. However, few studies consider eldercare and childcare arrangements together in a dynamic lifecycle framework. Project Description: Using the China Family Panel Study and China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Studies, I will conduct reduced form analysis and structural estimation. I will first document novel facts about the dynamic relationship between childcare, old-age support, property ownership, and the effects of pension reform. Then, I will develop a dynamic, non-cooperative life cycle model incorporating various family decisions. The model proposes two novel channels in family arrangements: 1) exchange motive, where parents provide childcare to increase children's current and future earnings, ensuring more old-age support; and 2) guilt, where parent-provided childcare incurs disutility if children do not provide eldercare when needed. I will estimate the model, using a pension reform to identify the exchange motive, and conduct simulations to quantify the relative importance of altruistic, exchange, and guilt motives. I will also perform counterfactual experiments on potential eldercare and childcare policies, analyzing their effects on family arrangements, the female labor market, and welfare. Significance: This study contributes to family economics literature by proposing a dynamic link between early-stage childcare and later-stage old-age support. It also offers a novel strategy to identify the exchange motive through pension reform. As childcare and eldercare arrangements impact women's labor supply, this study sheds light on how family arrangements affect labor market outcomes. For policymakers, understanding family arrangements helps design policies that improve the welfare of both women and the elderly. 目的：本项目旨在探索年轻夫妇和其父母之间联合育儿和老年支持安排的驱动机制，并研究公共政策对老年支持、儿童照料和女性劳动力市场结果的影响。 背景：过去的研究分别分析了子女向父母提供老年支持和父母为子女提供儿童照料。这些研究显示，子女出于利他和策略遗产考虑支持父母，而父母提供儿童照料主要是出于利他的原因。然而，很少有研究将照顾老人和孩子安排在一个动态生命周期框架中一起考虑。 项目描述：使用中国家庭追踪调查和中国健康与退休纵向研究，我将进行回归分析和结构估计。首先，我将记录有关儿童照料、养老支持、财产所有权和养老金改革影响的新颖事实。然后，我将开发一个动态、非合作的生命周期模型，纳入各种家庭决策。该模型提出了两种家庭安排中的新颖渠道：1）交换动机，父母提供儿童照顾以增加子女的现在和未来收入，确保更多的老年支持；2）负罪感，如果父母前期提供儿童照顾，但子女在父母需要时不提供养老支持，子女会有负罪感。我将使用养老金改革来估计模型并分离出交换动机，并进行模拟以量化利他、交换和负罪动机的相对重要性。我还将对潜在的老年护理和儿童护理政策进行反事实实验，分析它们对家庭安排、女性劳动力市场和福利的影响。 意义：本研究通过提出早期儿童照料和后期养老支持之间的动态联系，为家庭经济学文献做出贡献。它还提供了一种通过养老金改革确定交换动机的新策略。由于儿童护理和老年护理安排影响女性的劳动力供给，本研究阐明了家庭安排如何影响劳动力市场结果。对于政策制定者来说，了解家庭安排有助于制定既有助于女性又有助于老年人福利的政策。

17502524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17502524.value: 社會規範、里程碑年齡與散戶投資人的風險承擔

17502524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17502524.value: Risk preference is central to individuals’ economic decision-making on risk-taking behaviors of labor market participation, saving, consumption, innovation, and investment. In this project, we aim to examine whether and how social anxiety, which is pervasive in daily lives yet underexplored in the finance literature, alters individuals’ risk preferences, thereby affecting their stock investments. We will capture the shock of social anxiety conditional on how close investors’ ages are to their milestone ones (e.g., 30, 40, 50). Both anecdotal evidence and current psychological studies suggest that milestone ages could trigger social anxiety. Milestone ages occur exogenously and periodically in life, yet they represent occasions for existential stock-taking that may magnify the feeling of failure and emptiness in life. We plan to utilize an account-level trading dataset from a large representative brokerage house in China. The detailed order submission and trading records for account holders together with their demographic data allow us to compare the risk-taking behaviors of investors that are close to the milestone ages with those of their counterparts. We hypothesize that (1) the trading behavior of an individual investor who is around his milestone age would be substantially different from his trading behavior when he is away from the milestone age and (2) these “milestone agers” also exhibit trading patterns that are substantially different from their non-milestone ager counterparts. By exploring the milestone age effect on individuals’ risk preferences in financial markets, this project could add to the literature on determinants of individuals’ risk preferences from the less explored perspective of social anxiety. By providing novel evidence on how milestone age affects individuals’ trading, this project also has the potential to enrich the literature on the consequences of individuals’ social anxiety from the perspective of their financial market behaviors. 風險偏好是個人在勞動市場參與、儲蓄、消費、創新和投資等經濟決策的核心變數。在本計畫中，我們將探討在日常生活中普遍存在、但在財經文獻中未被充分探討的社交焦慮，是否以及如何改變個人的風險偏好，從而影響他們的股票投資決策。我們將根據投資者的年齡與他們的年齡里程碑（例如 30、40、50 歲）的接近程度，來衡量社交焦慮對投資行為的影響。間接證據和目前的心理研究都顯示，里程碑年齡可能會引發社交焦慮。年齡里程碑是不受個人決策影響的外生變數，然而越靠近整數年齡越可能使人們對自己存在的意義作出反思與盤點，進而放大生活中的失敗感和空虛感。我們計劃使用中國一家大型代表性券商的帳戶交易資料。該資料包含帳戶持有人的詳細交易記錄，以及他們的人口統計數據。我們因此可以比較接近里程碑年齡的投資者，和除此以外的同類投資者，兩者之間風險承受行為的差異。本計畫提出下列兩項假說：(1)個人投資者在其里程碑年齡附近的交易行為，會與他在遠離里程碑年齡時的交易行為有重大差異；(2)這些「里程碑年齡者」的交易模式，也會與「非里程碑年齡者」的交易模式有重大差異。透過探討里程碑年齡對個人在金融市場中風險偏好的影響，本計畫可以從文獻少見的社會焦慮角度，對個人風險偏好決定因素的文獻做出貢獻。透過提供里程碑年齡如何影響個人交易的新證據，本計畫也可以從散戶投資行為的角度，擴展個人社交焦慮後果的文獻。

17503124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17503124.value: 關於人工智能控制問題的經濟觀點

17503124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17503124.value: The field of artificial intelligence (AI) has seen remarkable growth in the past few decades. With the advent of deep learning and other machine learning techniques, AI has become increasingly capable of performing complex tasks that were once considered the exclusive domain of human intelligence. However, as AI continues to advance, there is a growing concern that it may eventually surpass human intelligence. The AI Control Problem revolves around the challenge of ensuring that AI systems adhere to human values and goals. Within this problem, a particular concern arises from the potential lack of comprehensive understanding of AI systems by humans. This research proposal centres precisely on this aspect and seeks to establish a novel theory by integrating artificial intelligence into conventional economic models. The underlying theme across these models is the delegation of certain decisions to AI within a typical human-driven economy, while humans possess imperfect information regarding the choice behaviour of AI systems. By exploring this paradigm, we aim to shed light on the potential consequences that arise from the interaction between imperfect human understanding and economic decision-making by artificially intelligent agents. We propose three research ideas that examine the integration of the AI Control Problem within economic contexts. Our flagship project, Natural Selection of Artificial Intelligence, draws inspiration from evolutionary biology to predict the predominant types of AI in the future. By applying concepts similar to the notion of natural selection, we aim to gain insights into the long-term trajectory of AI evolution. Our second project, Artificial Kin Selection, delves into the implications of AI’s capacity to reveal and recognize its own code. We seek to analyse how strategic interactions may change when the players involved are programs capable of credibly revealing information about their own identity. Our third project, Price Competition Played by Machines, introduces AI into conventional models of dynamic price competition. The objective is to explore whether the humans’ imperfect understanding of programs could potentially facilitate collusion among firms, leading to inefficiently high market prices. Through these research endeavours, we aim to deepen our understanding of the economic implications of the AI Control Problem within diverse scenarios. Our theoretical models serve as a tool to predict the implications of humans’ limited comprehension of AI on resource allocation. 人工智能（AI）领域在过去几十年中取得了显著的增长。随着深度学习和其他机器学习技术的出现，AI在执行复杂任务方面变得越来越强大，这些任务曾经被认为是人类智慧的专属领域。然而，随着AI的不断进步，人们越来越担心它最终可能会超越人类智能。AI控制问题围绕着确保AI系统遵循人类价值观和目标的挑战。在这一问题中，一个特别值得关注的方面是人类对AI系统的全面理解可能存在不足。这项研究提案正是以此为核心，旨在通过将人工智能整合到传统经济模型中来建立一种新的理论。这些模型的基本主题是在典型的人类驱动的经济中，将某些决策委托给AI，而人类对AI系统的选择行为拥有不完全的信息。通过探索这一范式，我们希望揭示由人类不完全理解与由人工智能代理进行的经济决策相互作用所带来的潜在后果。 我们提出了三个研究思路，以探讨AI控制问题在经济背景下的整合。我们的旗舰项目《人工智能的自然选择》借鉴了进化生物学的灵感，以预测未来占主导地位的AI类型。通过应用类似于自然选择的概念，我们旨在获得AI进化的长期轨迹的见解。我们的第二个项目《人工亲属选择》深入探讨了AI揭示和识别其自身代码的能力的影响。我们希望分析当参与者是能够可信地揭示其自身身份信息的程序时，战略互动可能会发生怎样的变化。我们的第三个项目《机器间的价格竞争》将AI引入传统的动态价格竞争模型中，目标是探讨人类对程序的理解不完全是否可能促使公司之间形成合谋，从而导致市场价格不合理地高企。通过这些研究工作，我们旨在深化对AI控制问题在不同情境下的经济影响的理解。我们的理论模型将作为一种工具，用于预测人类对AI有限理解对资源分配的影响。

17503224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17503224.value: 人类劳动力在非例行任务中相对于机器的比较优势

17503224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17503224.value: As automation continues to displace human workers, it is crucial to examine the future of work and the value that human workers bring to the production of goods and services. Previous research use firm- and country- level data to show increasing demand for labor towards non-routine work, which requires social interactions and decision-making in unforeseen circumstances. This study aims to provide direct empirical evidence on the comparative advantage of human labor over machines in the service industry. Our empirical setting is a large restaurant chain that used tabletop technology to replace waiters in placing orders and collecting payments. We exploit an unexpected technological breakdown that forced the workers to take over the previously automated task and examine the effect of de-automation on sales and service. Our preliminary findings suggest that human workers perform better in making more sales and promoting high-margin items than automated technology. The findings of the study have managerial implications on automation decision, job design and human-machine complementarity. 随着自动化在越来越多的经济生产过程中取代人工，研究人类劳动力的独特价值至关重要。现有的研究大多使用公司、行业和国家总和的数据来论证经济对非例行工作的需求增加，这类工作任务尤其强调社交互动，以及在突发环境下的决策能力。本研究旨在利用服务业的微观数据，来阐释人类劳动力相对于机器的比较优势。研究的实证场景来自一家大型餐饮连锁店。该店数年前开始使用桌面技术替代服务员进行点餐和收款。我们利用了一次外生的技术故障带来的“去自动化”。这场故障使得人工服务员进行全部的点餐和收款任务，从而让研究者有机会比较“去自动化” 对销售和服务的影响。我们的初步发现表明，服务员在销售菜品的量和高利润品类方面比机器更具有优势。本研究将对企业的自动化决策、任务设计和人机互补性具有实际意义。

17503324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17503324.value: 數字成癮服務的定價與控制

17503324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17503324.value: As individuals spend more time in the digital world, research increasingly suggests that addiction, rather than utility, drives this usage. The overuse of digital services can lead to significant negative impacts on mental health and well-being. Consequently, policymakers and socially responsible firms should consider reducing the harm from addiction when designing pricing and operational strategies for digital products. While addiction control has been extensively studied in traditional addictive goods such as alcohol and cigarettes, digital products exhibit unique features. This study focuses on two specific factors: personalized dynamic pricing and experience variation. Personalized dynamic pricing is widely used in games and video platforms, such as mobile games where the price for continuing play increases exponentially after a certain number of daily free trials. Experience variation refers to the random shock in user experience that is partially controlled by the service provider. For example, a video game may provide a daily surprise gift to the player, influencing their engagement. Although dynamic pricing and experience variation are not explicitly designed for managing addiction, they can serve as new levers to manage addiction at a micro-level and warrant further investigation. The dynamic and personalized nature also enables more tailored and dynamic control tools in practice. However, even for profit-maximizing companies, the optimal pricing policy and its impact on consumers remain unclear. This research aims to answer three questions: 1) How do firms decide on pricing strategies for digital addictive services? 2) How do consumer addiction levels and utilities change in response to different pricing policies and control tools, particularly dynamic pricing and experience variation? 3) What interventions and policies can policymakers and socially responsible firms implement to effectively reduce digital addiction while minimizing profit loss? What kind of control tools should be offered to users and parents? An infinite horizon dynamic pricing model will be employed to investigate these problems, taking into account two essential factors that lead to addiction: habit formation and self-control. Habit formation refers to the phenomenon where past consumption increases the marginal utility of subsequent consumption. On the other hand, users with self-control problems tend to consume more than the optimal consumption level. The study will then explore how to leverage dynamic pricing and experience variation to provide more efficient addiction control compared to traditional methods. By examining these questions, the research expects to provide a first step in addressing this critical concern from a revenue management perspective. 隨著人們在數位世界中花費的時間越來越多，越來越多的研究表明，推動這種使用的是成癮，而不是效用。過度使用數位服務可能會對心理健康和福祉產生重大負面影響。因此，政策制定者和有社會責任感的公司在設計數位產品的定價和營運策略時應考慮減少成癮的危害。 雖然成癮控制已在酒精和香菸等傳統成癮商品中得到廣泛研究，但數位產品卻表現出獨特的功能。本研究重點在於兩個具體因素：個人化動態定價和體驗變化。個人化動態定價廣泛應用於遊戲和影片平台，例如手機遊戲，每天免費試用一定次數後，繼續玩的價格會呈指數級增長。體驗變化是指使用者體驗中的隨機衝擊，部分由服務提供者控制。例如，電玩遊戲可能會向玩家提供每日驚喜禮物，影響他們的參與度。儘管動態定價和體驗變化並不是專門為管理成癮而設計的，但它們可以作為在微觀層面上管理成癮的新槓桿，並值得進一步研究。動態和個人化的本質也使得在實踐中能夠實現更客製化和動態的控制工具。然而，即使對於利潤最大化的公司來說，最優定價政策及其對消費者的影響仍然不清楚。 本研究旨在回答三個問題：1）企業如何決定數位成癮服務的定價策略？ 2）消費者成癮程度和效用如何隨著不同的定價政策和控制工具而變化，特別是動態定價和體驗變化？ 3）政策制定者和有社會責任感的企業可以採取哪些幹預措施和政策來有效減少數位成癮，同時最大限度地減少利潤損失？應該提供使用者和家長什麼樣的控制工具？將採用無限地平線動態定價模型來研究這些問題，並考慮到導致成癮的兩個基本因素：習慣形成和自我控制。習慣形成是指過去的消費增加了後續消費的邊際效用的現象。另一方面，有自製力問題的使用者往往會消費超過最適消費水準的消費。然後，該研究將探索如何利用動態定價和體驗變化來提供比傳統方法更有效的成癮控制。透過研究這些問題，該研究預計將從收入管理的角度解決這一關鍵問題邁出第一步。

17503424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17503424.value: 零工经济中的信息与薪资机制设计

17503424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17503424.value: 在零工经济中，向打工者隐瞒潜在需求信息和支付细节是一种常见做法。例如，例如，打车行业的传统观点认为，向司机披露行程细节会损害平台的利益，因为司机会对行程进行选择（“择优挑选”）。然而，缺乏透明度也引起了人们的担忧，担心这可能会对 “打工者 ”造成伤害（联邦贸易委员会，2022 年）。最近为应对监管压力而进行的提高透明度的改革并不一定能改善打工者的境况，有报道称 Uber 和 Lyft 的司机在实施预付费政策后收入更低且更难以预测，就证明了这一点。 受这些最新发展和悬而未决问题的推动，本研究项目旨在调查透明度对打工经济市场的影响。我们的分析侧重于一个平台，该平台利用两个手段来影响工人：佣金率和薪酬透明度。该平台在需求不确定的环境中运行，其特点是存在多种需求情景。在每种情况下，打工者组成一个队列从平台接收工作，并可自由决定是否参与。一旦打工者进入平台，他们就会决定自己的接受策略，以实现预期效用最大化。给定平台的策略，均衡参与水平就形成了。最后，平台选择使利润最大化的政策。 我们发现，有趣的是，在每种情况下，只要薪酬设置得当，披露全部信息对平台来说都是最优的。这一结果还揭示了监管机构推动市场更加透明化的负面潜在结果：如果平台采取灵活的薪酬政策，虽然看似有利，但如果信息越多，工人的处境可能越差。然而，如果平台不能动态调整薪酬，那么完全的信息可能会损害平台，比完全不共享任何信息更糟糕。我们的初步结果凸显了信息政策与打工经济中打工者薪酬之间错综复杂的关系。项目计划进一步探讨其对工人和社会福利的影响。

17503824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17503824.value: PCAOB检查威胁是否影响政府采购？来自中国的证据

17503824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17503824.value: We investigate whether the threat of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB) inspecting U.S.-listed Chinese firms impacts the Chinese government contracts awarded to these firms. PCAOB is responsible for overseeing all auditors and auditors that audit U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) registrants. PCAOB’s main regulatory mechanism is its auditor inspection program, and one of its most significant challenges is having access to the audit work papers of U.S.-listed Chinese firms. Obtaining this access has been a longstanding point of contention between the U.S. and China, with PCAOB unable to complete its inspections because the Chinese authorities required that certain audit work papers be withheld or redacted due to concerns about sensitive information or state secrets. In December 2020, the SEC finalized rules for implementing the Holding Foreign Companies Accountable Act (HFCAA), which was a response to PCAOB’s inability to inspect the auditing of U.S.-listed Chinese firms. Among other things, the statute requires the SEC to identify public companies that have retained a registered public accounting firm to issue an audit report where the firm has a branch or office that: (1) is located in a foreign jurisdiction, and (2) the PCAOB has determined that it is unable to inspect or investigate completely because of a position taken by an authority in the foreign jurisdiction. Identified companies are banned from trading in the U.S. market if PCAOB is unable to inspect the audits for three consecutive years. We plan on utilizing the HFCAA as an exogenous shock to the increased likelihood that U.S.-listed Chinese firms receive a PCAOB inspection. Our primary hypothesis is that relative to non-U.S.-listed Chinese firms, U.S.-listed Chinese firms experience a decrease in the awarding of new Chinese government contracts after the enactment of the HFCAA. This decrease derives from the Chinese government’s greater caution about sensitive information or state secrets being leaked to PCAOB if the pressure created by the HFCAA enables PCAOB to inspect these firms. We also hypothesize that the decrease is likely to be more pronounced for those U.S.-listed Chinese firms that are more likely to possess sensitive information or be more compliant with PCAOB. Our research will contribute to the ongoing debate around PCAOB’s international inspection program, which has raised concerns about sensitive national information being leaked. 我们研究PCAOB（美国上市公司会计监督委员会）对在美上市中国公司可能的检查是否会影响这些公司所获得的中国政府合同。PCAOB负责监督美国证券交易委员会（SEC）注册公司的审计师。他们主要的监管机制为审计师检查计划，而该计划最大的挑战之一是获取在美上市中国公司的审计工作底稿。由于某些审计工作底稿涉及敏感信息或国家机密，中国当局要求扣留或编辑这些底稿，导致PCAOB长期以来无法完成其对在美上市中国公司的检查。 2020年12月，SEC最终确定了《外国公司问责法案》（HFCAA）的实施规则，这是对PCAOB无法检查在美上市中国公司审计工作的回应。该法规要求SEC识别出那些聘用注册会计师事务所发布审计报告的上市外国公司，其中（1）该会计师事务所在外国司法辖区设有分支机构，（2）由于该外国司法辖区当局的立场，PCAOB无法完全检查或调查其审计工作。如果PCAOB连续三年无法完成对其审计工作的检查，该上市公司将被禁止在美国市场交易。 我们计划利用HFCAA作为一种增加在美上市中国公司被PCAOB检查可能性的外生冲击。我们的主要假设是，相对于在其他国家上市的中国公司，在美上市的中国公司在HFCAA颁布后获得新的中国政府合同的数量会减少。这种减少源于中国政府对PCAOB检查中敏感信息或国家机密被泄露可能的谨慎。我们还假设，对于那些更有可能拥有敏感信息或更可能遵守PCAOB规定的在美上市中国公司，这种减少可能会更加显著。 我们的研究将为围绕PCAOB国际检查计划的持续争论提供贡献，该计划在过去引发了外国政府对敏感信息泄露的担忧。

17503924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17503924.value: 实现目标的策略：对Berlitz模型的重新审视

17503924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17503924.value: This paper explores the strategy of goal attainment through the double-edged sword effect of effort: while effort can act as a driving force toward the goal, it can also induce negative effects such as stress and fatigue that may lead to quitting and, consequently, failure to reach the goal. This dual role of effort was first examined by Herbert Simon (1954) in what is known as the Berlitz model. However, Simon's model is non-adaptive, meaning that an individual cannot modify his effort level. The goal of this paper is to study the optimal strategy of attaining goals by allowing the individual to choose his effort over time. 这个项目探讨了在努力的双刃剑效应下，实现目标如何达成策略：虽然努力可以作为向目标前进的驱动力，但它也可能引发诸如压力和疲劳等负面影响，这些影响可能导致放弃，进而无法实现目标。努力的双刃剑效应最初由赫伯特·西蒙（Herbert Simon）在1954年所检验，即众所周知的Berlitz模型。然而，西蒙的模型是非自适应的，意味着个人无法调整他的努力水平。本文的目标是研究通过允许个人选择其随时间变化的努力水平来实现目标的最优策略。

17504224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17504224.value: 企業所得税政策與企業邊界

17504224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17504224.value: In this research proposal, our aim is to investigate the influence of taxes on firm boundaries. Within the realm of economics, an important question pertains to how firms determine whether to produce goods or services internally (“make”) or acquire them from external sources (“buy”). Our proposed study investigates the impact of corporate income taxes on these decision-making processes, focusing on how tax planning incentives shape firms’ choices regarding production and procurement. Our proposed analysis is centered around the adoption of addback statutes, which disallow firms from deducting intangible and interest expenses paid to related parties (Li, Ma, and Shevlin 2021). This adoption diminishes the benefits of using domestic tax havens, which raises the tax burden of retaining income in the U.S. Our proposed research will address the following questions: after the implementation of addback statutes, do firms have a stronger incentive to engage in foreign tax planning by shifting their pre-tax domestic income outside of the U.S.? Are firms more likely to engage with suppliers or trade partners in tax havens, or display a greater inclination to own subsidiaries in these tax havens? Answers to these research questions will enhance our understanding of how taxes affect firm boundaries and operations within economic systems. 本项目旨在研究企业所得税政策对企业边界的影响。企业如何决定是在企业内部生产还是从市场上购买商品或服务是一个重要的经济学研究问题。本项目探究企业所得税政策如何影响企业边界的相关决策，并聚焦于企业避税动机对企业生产和采购的影响。美国本土税收政策禁止企业在计算应纳税所得额时扣除支付给关联企业的利息费用和与无形资产相关的费用。本文的研究结果将为深刻理解税对企业边界和经营决策的影响提供研究证据。

17504324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17504324.value: 考慮金融對沖的數據驅動庫存管理

17504324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17504324.value: 本研究提案旨在探討新產品的數據驅動庫存管理與金融對沖問題。我們考慮一家公司如何根據協變量信息，同時決定訂貨量和金融對沖策略，以在控制利潤風險的同時最大化預期利潤。新產品庫存管理面臨的主要挑戰是缺乏歷史銷售數據，導致需求預測困難，可能引致嚴重的庫存短缺或積壓，進而增加利潤風險。研究顯示，類似產品的銷售歷史和金融市場數據可為新產品需求預測提供寶貴參考。例如，積極的金融趨勢或有利的市場條件可能預示新產品需求增加。然而，這些數據並不保證準確預測，且數據驅動模型本身的局限（如模型錯誤設定）可能進一步加劇利潤風險。為此，我們提出基於特徵的金融對沖方法，利用類似產品和金融市場的歷史數據來降低庫存決策的利潤風險。我們特別關注產品需求與特定金融資產回報率在歷史銷售期間的潛在相關性，藉此設計金融衍生品（如期貨合約）策略，以對沖新產品的利潤風險。我們建立了一個結合風險價值約束的特徵基礎利潤最大化模型。 本研究面臨的獨特挑戰在於：金融資產回報率的不確定性、相互依存性、與產品需求的相關性，以及受可觀察金融特徵影響等複雜結構。為應對這些挑戰，我們計劃開發創新的數據驅動決策框架，有效利用不確定性與可觀察特徵間的關係，基於金融市場和類似產品的歷史數據，高效得出數據驅動解決方案。我們還將致力於確保所提出方法的漸近最優性。最後，我們將通過模擬和實際數據實驗，評估數據驅動金融對沖的價值，並探索相關管理見解。我們計劃將此數據驅動方法從單期報童模型擴展至多期情境。

17504424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17504424.value: 城市搜救行動資源高效分配策略研究：全面建模與分析框架

17504424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17504424.value: In recent years, the escalating frequency and intensity of extreme weather events, attributed to climate change, have posed increasingly grave challenges to urban communities. In particular, urban search and rescue (USAR) operations have emerged as critical response efforts during such crises. These operations are profoundly complex, characterized by perilous weather conditions, a surge in rescue requests, and persistently limited resources. Remarkably, despite their vital role, a standardized framework for optimizing resource allocation in USAR operations is conspicuously absent. Our proposed research initiative is motivated by the urgent need to enhance the effectiveness of USAR operations and safeguard lives and property during extreme weather events. Drawing inspiration from the impactful experiences of the 2017 Hurricane Harvey response, we have embarked on a project to develop and refine resource allocation strategies tailored to the unique challenges faced by USAR teams. Our research centers on the development of a sophisticated mathematical model that frames the resource allocation problem as a Markov decision process (MDP). Our primary objective is to identify the optimal service scheduling policy for various customer classes, aiming to maximize the total expected rewards over the planning horizon. Key features of our model include class-dependent common deadlines, heterogeneous service rates, and a general cost and reward structure. While our preliminary analysis has yielded promising insights, the complex nature of USAR operations demands a more extensive and data-driven investigation. To this end, we plan to collect and incorporate real-world data into our simulation model, grounding our research in practical scenarios. This critical step will not only validate the effectiveness of our proposed resource allocation strategies but also ensure their applicability to the dynamic and unpredictable conditions encountered in actual crisis situations. Our future work entails refining and extending our mathematical model, conducting extensive data-driven analyses, and collaborating with USAR practitioners to evaluate the practical feasibility and performance of our proposed resource allocation policies. In conclusion, our ongoing research project holds the promise of significantly enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of USAR operations in the face of climate-induced extreme weather events. We are committed to continuing and expanding this vital work, which has the potential to save lives and mitigate the devastating impact of disasters on urban communities. 近年來，由於氣候變化的影響，極端天氣事件的頻率和嚴重性不斷增加，對城市社區造成了巨大的挑戰。在這種情況下，城市搜救（USAR）行動成為了應對這些危機的關鍵手段。然而，這些行動面臨著極大的挑戰，如危險的天氣條件，搜救需求激增，以及資源持續匱乏。值得注意的是，儘管城市搜救行動的重要性不言而喻，但我們仍缺乏一個標準化的框架來優化資源分配。 我們的研究計劃就是基於這種迫切的需求，旨在提高城市搜救行動的效率，並在極端天氣事件中保護生命和財產。我們將從2017年哈維颶風的經驗中汲取靈感，著手開發並改進針對城市搜救團隊所面臨的獨特挑戰的資源分配策略。 我們的研究主要集中在開發一個複雜的數學模型，該模型將資源分配問題視為一個馬爾可夫決策過程。我們的主要目標是找出最適合各種客戶類型的服務調度策略，以期在規劃期間內獲得最大的預期總收益。 雖然我們的初步分析已經得出了一些有希望的成果，但是，由於城市搜救行動的複雜性，我們需要進行更廣泛和數據驅動的研究。因此，我們計劃收集並將實際數據納入我們的模擬模型，讓我們的研究更接近實際情況。這一重要步驟將不僅驗證我們提出的資源分配策略的有效性，還將確保它們能夠適應實際危機情況中的動態和不可預測的條件。 總的來說，我們正在進行的研究項目有望顯著提高城市搜救行動在面對氣候引起的極端天氣事件時的效率和效果。我們致力於繼續和擴大這項重要的工作，因為它有可能挽救生命，並減輕災害對城市社區的破壞性影響。我們將進一步完善和擴展我們的數學模型，進行大量的數據驅動分析，並與城市搜救實踐者合作，以評估我們提出的資源分配策略在實際應用中的可行性和效果。

17505224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17505224.value: 中国科学对美国技术进步的贡献：来自学术论文专利引用的证据

17505224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17505224.value: 全球科学人才竞赛正在进行中.中国作为向美国和欧盟STEM项目发送最多的留学生的国家，启动了雄心勃勃的人才项目，以招募海外的精英科学家。这些项目受到了美国政府（通过启动“中国倡议”）和学术界的高度关注。 尽管受到了高度的关注，但是对于中国在招募外国科学人才方面的努力，以及这些努力的影响和政策含义的基于证据的研究却很少。例如，我们对在中国工作的外国科学家的科研水平和人员数量几乎一无所知；我们也不知道中国在培养这些科学家的生产力，以及在全球人才竞赛中留住最有生产力的科学家方面的成功程度。尽管学术界对中国本土科研机构培养顶级科学家的能力存在怀疑，但中国在高等教育和人才发展方面投入了资源是毋庸置疑的。对于有能力但在OECD国家没有资金进行独立研究的科学家来说，移居中国可能是一个可行甚至有吸引力的选择。 本项目通过实证的方法来研究在华的外国科学家。我们将首先使用OpenAlex来识别过去二十年中在中国工作和发表过文章的所有外国科学家，以记录他们的普遍性和生产力。我们将手动收集在中国精英985高校理工及医学领域工作的外国科学家的简历数据，并构建他们在海外的同行群体，这些同行曾在相同的博士机构学习，毕业于相同的领域，并在大约相同的时期进入了就业市场。使用这些科学家（及其子群体）作为基准，可以让我们回答有关中国作为研究地点的相对吸引力，以及中国移民对科学家生产力的影响的问题。作为公共服务，我们将向学术界公开这个数据集。据我们所知，这样的数据集从未被构建过。 研究在华外国人才在学术上具有重要意义，也与政策相关。越来越多的国家正在成立各种鼓励机制以招募海外侨民和外国人才，以促进国内知识产出和人才发展。一些政府开始相信，吸引海外人才是形成具有全球竞争力的研究机构以及将经济转型为充满活力、以知识为基础的经济体的关键。

17505324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17505324.value: 从时间和组合的角度解锁直播带货的力量

17505324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17505324.value: 近年来，直播行业经历了爆炸式的增长，改变了包括电子商务在内的各个领域。直播带货作为实时视频流和产品推广的一种开创性融合，已成为重要的市场营销工具。主要的电子商务平台纷纷采用这种营销策略，利用直播展示产品，与观众即时互动。尽管直播销售已被广泛应用，但其时间影响以及有效的网红组合仍然未被充分探讨。 本研究旨在调查直播销售的长期可持续性，重点关注在不进行直播的时候其对销售的影响。在这些日子里，销售可能会持续但逐渐降低，恢复到正常水平，或者降到正常水平以下。此外，仅了解时间影响对品牌和零售商优化直播销售策略来说是不够的，本研究还将探讨网红组合选择策略。鉴于零售商合作的网红组合对销售业绩的影响非常显著，本研究旨在通过分析不同组合下直播销售的异质影响，找出有效的网红合作伙伴，考虑到诸如受众规模和参与率等因素。 我们将与亚洲一家知名的直播平台合作，利用准自然实验设计研究一些通过网红直播销售进行推广的零售商。首先，我们将采用匹配和差分法（DID）识别策略，研究直播销售的时间影响。随后，我们将探讨导致销售业绩变化的潜在机制，如促销策略和消费者参与。最后，我们将建立一个多层次模型，量化各种网红组合的影响，使零售商能够根据具体需求和目标制定更有效的合作策略。 本研究将通过研究直播销售的长期效果、潜在机制，以及构建数据驱动的网红选择框架，为相关文献做出贡献。我们的研究结果将为实践者提供有价值的管理启示，使他们能够利用直播销售实现长期成功，并根据特定需求和目标调整网红选择策略，最终提高数字营销的有效性。

17505824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17505824.value: 资本流动和全球资产收益

17505824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17505824.value: 美国投资者持有的外国股票证券能负向预测外国股票的美元收益。这一预测关系对不同国家的月度，季度和年度持有期限均十分强大且稳健，拟合优度高。 这一发现似乎与标准的局部均衡的资产组合理论不一致。标准理论说明，当外国股票提供更高的预期收益时，美国投资者应该持有更多的外国股票。我们提供了一个简单的框架来说明，必须要一般均衡的理论来理解这一实证发现。在一般均衡模型中，美国对外国风险资产和持有和外国风险资产的预期收益是被美国投资者的风险态度共同决定。这一发现与美国在国际金融体系中的重要作用的文献发展一致。 我们使用资产需求系统的方法来估计美国投资者对外国风险资产的需求，并复现了美国持有外国风险资产和外国资产后续收益的负相关关系。我们通过一系列反事实试验来识别美国投资者为何扮演特别重要的角色。最后，我们发展了一个宏观金融模型来解释这一事实并量化资本流动和资产收益之间的动态关系。特别的，我们研究了国际经济政策的作用并评估了这些政策对资本流动和资产收益的影响。

17506124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17506124.value: 组织内部的非正式裁量与沟通

17506124.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17506124.value: Prof Cheng, Chen Prof Xing, Yiqing

17506124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17506124.value: This project plans to understand better the relationship between the quality of communication and the degree of informal discretion within organizations. Consider an example where a local disaster such as a flood or famine occurs. The local government seeks financial support from the central government to combat the disaster. The central government lacks knowledge about the disaster's severity, and the funding it provides depends on the information communicated by the local government. However, the central government recognizes that the local government's communication is strategic, as it would like to receive more funding than what the central government views as optimal. This causes the central government to limit the funding it gives out. The new element we highlight in the project is the local government’s informal discretion. In particular, when there is insufficient funding from the top, the local government can raise additional funds by exercising informal discretion. These are actions unknown (or not approved by) to the government, and they may require bending/breaking the rules. For example, the local government might divert funds allocated for other purposes or nudge local businesses to contribute financially. While these actions are costly for the central government (because funded diverted can no longer be used for their original purposes), they also allow the local government to mitigate the disaster more effectively. In addition to the direct effects of the informal discretion, it also has important indirect effects, which is the focus of our study. In particular, when the central government makes its decisions, it takes into account that these decisions can be amended by the local government. Furthermore, anticipating the top's reaction, the local government will adjust the information it communicates. In other words, informal discretion affects strategic communications. It is unclear how informal discretion affects the quality of communication. One possibility is that, because the local government can use informal discretion, good information is less valuable, so the communication quality will decrease. However, we show that increasing the flexibility of informal discretion improves the effectiveness of communication. When the local government can better exercise informal discretion, he is less worried that the central government will take advantage of his report and make a decision that is very different from his ideal outcome. This makes the local government more willing to communicate. An implication of the research, then, is that offering some degree of informal discretion can be valuable for the organization. 这个项目计划更好地了解组织内部沟通质量和管理层裁量权度之间的关系。重点是关注管理者的双重角色。一方面,管理者将有价值的信息传达给总部,以获得任务支持和指导。另一方面,总部作出决策后,管理者在执行这些决策时拥有一定的裁量权。该项目旨在更好地了解管理者在执行任务时事后享有的裁量权,如何影响其事前的战略沟通质量,从而影响组织的效率。

17506424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17506424.value: 量化贸易模型中的最优政策: 一个基于梯度的机器学习方法

17506424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17506424.value: After four decades of global economic integration, which culminated in China's accession to the WTO in 2001, the tide of global economic cooperation has gradually shifted. In recent years, economic conflicts have emerged among major global economies, highlighting the need for a comprehensive understanding of the incentives and consequences associated with these conflicts in economic studies and policy-making. Within this context, two prominent trends have emerged. Firstly, countries are increasingly relying on a combination of trade and industrial policies to compete with one another. A notable recent example is China's export-promoting trade policies and the Made-in-China 2025 initiatives, which aim to develop specific advanced technology sectors through government subsidies to enhance China's manufacturing industry's future competitiveness. It is important to note that China is not the only country employing such policies, as there has been a global rise in industrial policy interventions over the past decade and a half. Secondly, countries have been behaving as if engaged in non-cooperative games, necessitating consideration of potential retaliatory actions from other countries when formulating optimal policies. A prime illustration of this is the US government's response to China's trade and industrial policies. In 2018, the Trump administration initiated a tariff war against China to counter the Made-in-China 2025 initiatives. Subsequently, the Biden administration escalated the technology competition between the US and China by implementing export controls and its own industrial policies, as outlined in the CHIPS Act and Inflation Reduction Act. Given these significant trends, it is crucial to assess the costs of economic conflicts and the potential benefits of economic cooperation by examining non-cooperative policy competitions using large-scale and realistic quantitative trade models. However, solving for high-dimensional optimal policies in trade models poses computational challenges. In our proposed research, we aim to develop a novel new method for solving optimal unilateral, non-cooperative multilateral, and cooperative policies in multi-country, multi-sector general equilibrium trade models. These models will incorporate global input-output linkages and scale economies. The methods we develop will provide valuable insights into fundamental questions that have remained unanswered thus far, such as the equilibrium outcomes of non-cooperative policy competitions, the welfare implications for individual countries, and the potential benefits of feasible international policy cooperation. 经过四十年的全球经济一体化，最终在2001年中国加入WTO，全球经济合作的潮流逐渐转变。近年来，主要全球经济体之间出现了经济冲突，凸显了经济研究和政策制定中需要全面了解这些冲突的激励和后果的必要性。在这一背景下，出现了两大显著趋势。首先，各国越来越依赖贸易和工业政策的组合来相互竞争。一个显著的最近例子是中国的出口促进贸易政策和“中国制造2025”倡议，旨在通过政府补贴发展特定先进技术领域，增强中国制造业未来的竞争力。需要注意的是，中国并非唯一采用此类政策的国家，过去十五年间全球工业政策干预呈上升趋势。其次，各国行为就像参与非合作博弈一样，需要在制定最佳政策时考虑其他国家可能采取的报复行动。一个典型例证是美国政府对中国贸易和工业政策的回应。2018年，特朗普政府发起对中国的关税战，以应对“中国制造2025”倡议。随后，拜登政府通过实施出口管制和其自身的工业政策，如CHIPS法案和通货膨胀削减法案，加剧了美中之间的技术竞争。 鉴于这些重要趋势，通过使用大规模和现实的定量贸易模型来研究非合作政策竞争，评估经济冲突的成本和经济合作的潜在收益至关重要。然而，在贸易模型中解决高维度最优政策存在计算挑战。 在我们提出的研究中，我们旨在开发一种新颖的方法，用于解决多国、多部门一般均衡贸易模型中的最优单边、非合作多边和合作政策。这些模型将纳入全球的投入产出联系和规模经济。我们开发的方法将为解决迄今为止尚未得到答复的基本问题提供宝贵见解，例如非合作政策竞争的均衡结果、个别国家的福利影响，以及可行的国际政策合作的潜在收益。

17506524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17506524.value: 通过设计垂直差异化产品选项的价格展示来优化在线零售界面

17506524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17506524.value: As one of the most important inputs for shopping decisions, price information is not always presented in the same manner on online shopping platforms. In some major platforms (e.g., Target.com), the prices for multiple options are displayed at the same time. This price display mode is referred to as all-option price display in the current research. In other platforms (e.g., Amazon.com), the price of an option is revealed only when consumers click on the focal option. This price display mode is referred to as option-contingent price display in the current research. As two ways of price information display that are prevalent in marketing practice but have not received attention from academic researchers, can option-contingent versus all-option price displays lead to different decision outcomes? The proposed research explores this intriguing possibility in the context of consumers’ choice among vertically differentiated options, which vary in performance and price. The PI proposes that the same way of displaying multiple options’ performance levels but different ways of displaying the options’ prices will lead to different product choices across all-option and option-contingent price displays. In an all-option price display, the higher performances of some options and the lower costs of other options are both salient to consumers. Nevertheless, in an option-contingent price display, while the information regarding the higher performances of some options is always salient to consumers, the information regarding the lower costs of other options is not always salient to consumers because only one price is revealed at once when consumers click on the focal option. As a result of the neglect of the low-price information when the price display adopts an option-contingent mode, the pursuit of a higher performance will exert a relatively greater impact on consumers’ shopping decisions than the pursuit of a lower cost, driving a larger choice share of a higher-priced, higher-performing option in the option-contingent price display. Theoretically, the proposed research will reveal how price display modes on online retailing interfaces systematically affect consumers’ choice among vertically differentiated options. Managerially, the findings of the proposed research will inform marketers and retailers of the effective designs of price display modes on online retailing interfaces. 作为购物决策中最重要的依据之一，价格信息并不总是以相同的方式呈现于在线购物平台上。在一些平台上（例如Target.com），多个产品选项的价格被同时展示。这种价格展示模式在本研究中被称为全选项价格展示。在其他平台上（例如Amazon.com），只有当消费者点击某个产品选项时，该选项的价格才会被展示出来。这种价格展示模式在本研究中被称为选项依赖价格展示。作为市场营销实践中普遍存在但尚未得到学术研究人员关注的两种价格信息展示方式，选项依赖价格展示和全选项价格展示是否会导致不同的购买决策结果？着眼于消费者从多个性能和价格不同的垂直差异化产品选项中进行选择的这个决策情境，本研究考察了这个可能性。研究人员提出，在多个产品选项的性能水平总是被同时展示时，全选项价格展示和选项依赖价格展示会导致不同的产品选择。在全选项价格展示中，某些产品选项的更高性能和其他产品选项的更低价格对于消费者来说都很明显。然而，在选项依赖价格展示中，尽管一些产品选项的更高性能始终被明显地展示，其他选项的更低价格并对消费者来说并不总是非常明显，这是因为只有当消费者点击这些低价产品选项时其价格才会被显示。由于在选项依赖价格展示下消费者对低价信息的忽略，在这种价格展示模式下对更高性能的追求将对消费者的购物决策产生相对更大的影响。因此，选项依赖价格展示会提高消费者对高价格、高性能的产品选项的购买份额。在理论层面上，本研究揭示了在线零售界面上的价格展示模式会系统地影响消费者在垂直差异化产品选项之间的购买选择。从管理角度来看，本研究的结果对营销人员和零售商如何对在线零售界面上的价格展示进行有效设计模式提供了启示。

17506824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17506824.value: 直播電商經濟學之購物娛樂化：一個結構經濟模型的實證研究

17506824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17506824.value: In recent years, the retail industry has witnessed a significant shift from traditional brick-and-mortar stores to e-commerce, and now to the innovative live-commerce era. Live-commerce, also known as "shoppertainment," combines shopping and entertainment by integrating live streaming, social media, and e-commerce, creating a dynamic and immersive experience for consumers. At the core of shoppertainment are influencers who showcase and promote products during live shopping sessions, balancing both "selling effort" and "entertaining effort." The influencer, who in this context is also the salesperson, is essentially allocating the two efforts to optimize the overall gain from both sales and entertainment. It is therefore crucial to understand their effort allocation strategies. This research proposal aims to develop a structural model that examines how influencers balance between selling and entertaining efforts, how sales incentives and engagement metrics impact these strategies, and how to design optimal incentive and compensation schemes for influencers. By addressing these research questions, the project aims to provide valuable insights for retailers, platforms, and influencers, ultimately enhancing the live-commerce experience for consumers. This research will provide platforms and retailers with guidance on optimizing influencer effort allocation in shoppertainment livestream sessions, leading to improved customer engagement and conversion rates. The findings will also shed light on the optimal design of incentive mechanisms, compensation structures, and revenue-sharing models, fostering a mutually beneficial ecosystem for all stakeholders involved in the rapidly evolving shoppertainment industry. 近年來，零售行業經歷了從傳統實體店到電子商務，再到如今創新直播電商時代的重大轉變。直播電商，又稱「購物娛樂化」 ，將直播、社交媒體和電子商務融合在一起，為消費者創造了一種動態和沉浸式的體驗。網紅是「購物娛樂化」的核心，他們在直播購物環節中既要展示展品，又要推廣產品，需要同時平衡在“銷售”和“娛樂”兩方面投入的精力。實際上，網紅在「購物娛樂化」中扮演著銷售人員的角色，他們需要有效分配精力，以期在銷售和娛樂方面實現收益最大化。因此，瞭解網紅的精力分配策略至關重要。本文旨在開發一種結構經濟模型，用於研究網紅如何在銷售和娛樂精力分配之間取得平衡，分析銷售激勵和參與度指標如何影響網紅的策略，並探討如何為網紅設計最佳激勵和薪酬方案。本專案希望通過解決這些研究問題，為零售商、電商平臺和網紅提供有價值的見解，最終提升消費者的直播電商體驗。本研究將為平臺和零售商提供指導，説明網紅優化購物娛樂直播中的精力分配，從而提高客戶參與度和轉化率。此外，研究結果還將揭示最佳的激勵機制、薪酬結構和收益分配方案，為快速發展的購物娛樂行業中所有利益相關者構建互惠互利的生態系統。

17507124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17507124.value: 关于创业衰退的家庭起源

17507124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17507124.value: In recent decades, the United States has experienced a secular decline in entrepreneurship and the "grand gender convergence", especially rising female labor force participation and a narrowing gender wage gap. This project aims to understand the extent to which these two key trends are interconnected. Specifically, we seek to answer three questions: (1) how primary forces contributing to the "grand gender convergence" or the "quiet revolution" impact entrepreneurship by affecting women's incentives to become entrepreneurs or support their husbands in entrepreneurial endeavors; (2) how the incentive to become an entrepreneur affects household formation and the consumption-saving and time allocations within a household; and (3) the welfare consequences of the two important trends across heterogeneous households and the relevant policy implications. 在过去的四十年里，美国经历了两个重要的宏观经济趋势。第一个是创业的长期下滑，包括入市率和人口份额，这一点在Decker（2014）；Jiang and Sohail（2023）；Salgado（2020）的研究中得到了记录。创业下滑是商业活力下降的重要指标，通常与创造性破坏减少有关，这对就业创造和生产率增长等宏观经济方面产生重要影响。第二个趋势是女性在教育程度、劳动力参与和收入方面逐渐赶上男性，这是2023年诺贝尔奖获得者克劳迪娅·戈尔丁（Claudia Goldin）在她具有影响力的著作中强调的“性别大趋同”（Goldin，2006年，2014年）。由于技术、偏好、社会规范和婚姻相关政策的变化，美国女性劳动力供应在1970年至2020年间增加了一倍多。在同一时期，男女小时工资差距显著缩小，从1.77的比例降至1.20。戈尔丁（2006年）将这些变化称为“平静革命”。 本项目旨在了解这两个关键趋势在多大程度上是相互关联的。具体而言，我们试图回答三个问题：（1）对“性别大趋同”或“平静革命”作出贡献的主要力量如何通过影响女性成为创业者或支持丈夫从事创业事业的动机来影响创业；（2）成为创业者的动机如何影响家庭形成以及家庭内的消费储蓄和时间分配；（3）两个重要趋势在不同家庭中的福利后果及其相关政策启示。

17507224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17507224.value: 分析師的認證要求對分析師工作質量的影響

17507224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17507224.value: Securities analysts play a vital role as information intermediaries in capital markets. While the quality of analysts' work is essential for the efficient functioning of capital markets, the qualifications and regulations for securities analysts differ among jurisdictions. In most developed countries, such as Australia, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, the United States, Singapore, and Switzerland, regulators do not establish specific entry standards for securities analysts. In contrast, other countries, including Brazil, China, France, and India, have clear regulations stipulating that individuals must obtain relevant certifications or licenses to issue research reports as securities analysts. These regulations often entail qualification exams and educational requirements. Such a system with certification requirements remains an underexplored area of research. This study aims to address this gap by examining the impact of certification requirements on the quality of information provided by securities analysts. In the primary analyses, we examine the accuracy and comprehensiveness of analysts' work, using the precision of earnings forecasts and the frequency of cash-flow forecasts as indicators. The reform of China's certification system in 2011 presents an opportunity for empirical investigation into the effects of certification requirements. This reform involved the mandate that analysts signing research reports must possess a newly designated certificate. This certificate necessitates individuals to successfully pass a qualification examination in the Chinese Securities Investment Analysis module (SIA module). Consequently, this certification regulation created a plausibly exogenous change in the assignment of analysts within brokerage firms that deployed different analysts to track the same listed companies from the pre-2011 period to the post-2011 period in response to the 2011 reform (i.e., the affected analysts). Still, many analysts had successfully completed the Chinese SIA module examination before the reform and hence we can employ a difference-in-differences (DID) approach to assess changes in the quality of analysts’ work following the personnel changes among analysts due to the certification requirements. We expect that certification for securities analysts leads to a deep understanding of accounting and demands proficiency in applying financial valuation models. Therefore, we hypothesize that the affected analysts demonstrate improved earnings forecast accuracy and an increased propensity to issue cash-flow forecasts following the implementation of the certification requirements, relative to other analysts unaffected by personnel changes (i.e., the unaffected analysts). Next, we conduct several cross-sectional analyses to reinforce our main findings and to delve deeper into the benefits and costs associated with the entry standards set by certification requirements. 證券分析師在資本市場中扮演著信息中介的重要角色。雖然分析師的工作質量對資本市場的有效運轉至關重要，但世界各國對證券分析師資格和監管的規定存在差異。在大多數發達國家，如澳大利亞、德國、荷蘭、英國、美國、新加坡和瑞士，監管機構並不設立特定的證券分析師入行標準。相反，其他國家，包括巴西、中國、法國和印度，有明確的規定，規定個人必須獲得相關認證或許可證，才能發布證券分析師的研究報告。這些規定通常包括資格考試和教育要求。這種具有認證要求的制度仍然是一個未被充分研究的領域。本研究旨在通過觀察新實施的認證要求如何對證券分析師信息質量的影響來填補這一研究空白。在主要分析中，我們將使用盈利預測的精度和現金流預測的頻率作為指標，研究分析師工作的準確性和全面性。中國在2011年進行的認證系統改革為實證研究提供了機會。這項改革要求簽署研究報告的分析師必須擁有新指定的證書。該證書要求個人成功通過中國證券投資分析模塊（SIA模塊）的資格考試。因此，該認證規定對在2011年改革前和改革後被影響的分析師創造了一個可能具有外生性變化的情況（即受影響的分析師）。由於許多分析師在改革前已經自願完成了中國SIA模塊考試，因此我們可以採用差異分析法（DID）來評估認證要求後分析師工作質量的變化。我們預計，證券分析師的認證要求會帶來對會計更深刻的理解，和更熟練運用財務估值模型的技能。因此，我們假設在認證要求實施後，受影響的分析師相對於未受影響的其他分析師將表現出明顯的盈利預測準確性提升和現金流預測傾向增強。接下來，我們將進行幾個橫向分析，以加強我們的主要發現，並深入探討認證要求設定的入行標準所帶來的利益和成本。

17507524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17507524.value: 从设想到实现：知识工作轨迹对创新的影响

17507524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17507524.value: 创新根植于知识工作。从爱迪生对灯丝的精细实验，到图灵对现代计算算法的系统构建，科学史一再证明，新发现往往源于持续且有针对性的知识探索。然而，创新本质上充满不确定性；各种组织在推动创新实践时经常遇到困难。鉴于创新在技术进步和经济增长中的关键作用，研究何种形式的工作以及在何种条件下能够产生创新至关重要。 本研究拟跟踪创新尝试的全过程，包括想法的概念形成及完成情况。在这个过程中，某些想法会转化为科技成果，而其他想法则可能被调整或被放弃。我们特别关注知识工作者的工作轨迹——包括任务内容和顺序——并探讨其对创新尝试和成果的影响。 回答我们的研究问题需要一个不仅可以系统记录任务层面的工作，而且可以观察创新尝试（包括失败和成功）的情境。我们基于一家大型科技公司的工作历史及其创新尝试来构建数据库。我们的数据库包括该公司知识工作者的任务项目，以及两个和创新相关的里程碑事件：1）创新设想的概念形成，以及2）相关专利申请。我们将采用机器学习和序列建模方法进行分析。 我们的项目将对研究和实践做出贡献。首先，对于创新的前因，我们将直接考察知识工作任务，而不再是间接通过工作成果（比如论文、专利等）。其次，我们研究任务顺序对创新的影响，提供了一个超越传统关注点（如多样性）的新视角。第三，我们跟踪从概念形成到完成的过程，希望填补现有文献的重要空白。最后，在实践方面，我们的研究旨在为组织设计，人力资源配置和创新管理提供可实操的见解，进而提升组织的创新能力。

17600124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17600124.value: 透過音高和節奏訓練提升粵英雙語幼童的音韻及閱讀能力：隨機對照試驗

17600124.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17600124.value: Prof BAUTISTA, Alfredo Dr KONG, Siu-Hang Eric Dr Lai, Ka Wai Veronica Prof ZHANG, Caicai

17600124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17600124.value: 閱讀發展對學業成功至關重要，而研究表明，音樂訓練能夠顯著增強音韻覺識，從而提升閱讀能力。然而，現有的介入型研究通常會合併音高訓練和節奏訓練，使得難以區分它們各自的效果。前人已經考察了音高訓練和節奏訓練對音韻覺識的各自影響，但是他們沒有深入考究音高訓練和節奏訓練的潛在機制。具體而言，音高訓練和節奏訓練是如何通過多種中介變數改善音韻覺識和其他語言成果指標？為突破這一理論缺口，我們提出並將測試一個嶄新的三途徑模型，該模型融合了現有的「音樂到語言遷移」的理論解釋。 首席研究員及其同儕的相關性研究顯示，音樂訓練可以改善粵英雙語幼兒的粵語音韻覺識、粵語音調覺識、英語音韻覺識、英語重音覺識。然而，相關性證據有因果推論的局限。為了推動理論和應用創新，本項目將： 1. 檢驗音高訓練和節奏訓練對語言成果指標（即粵語音韻覺識、粵語音調覺識、英語音韻覺識、英語重音覺識和粵英雙語單詞閱讀）的各自影響。 2. 評估三種中介途徑，即音高訓練和節奏訓練是如何通過感知途徑、認知途徑和認知——感知途徑改善語言成果指標。 本項目將採用三臂前瞻性平行隨機對照試驗設計。我們將隨機分配150名五至六歲的幼兒到音高訓練、節奏訓練或等待名單對照組。在前測和即時後測中，我們將評估語言成果指標和中介變數（即音樂音高靈敏度、音樂節奏靈敏度和認知能力）。在即時後測六個月後，我們將在後續測試中檢驗訓練效益的保留程度。 在理論層面，我們的三途徑模型將融合「音樂到語言遷移」的感知和認知學說。此外，它還將鑒定每個中介途徑的相對作用。該模型將擴展以往的隨機對照試驗研究，探討音高訓練和節奏訓練如何改善語言成果的潛在機制。在方法層面，我們將採用嚴格的隨機對照試驗設計和因果中介分析來測試三途徑模型。在應用上，我們將開發以證據為本的音高和節奏訓練，旨在針對粵英雙語幼兒的音韻覺識、音調覺識、重音覺識和單詞閱讀進行訓練。在教育上，本項目將啟發課程發展人員如何利用音高和節奏訓練計劃來補充語言訓練。

17600524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17600524.value: 非自由國家內的自由地區

17600524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17600524.value: The phenomenon of liberal regions within illiberal states raises intriguing questions. Why would illiberal rulers allow such regions to exist? How can the - likely acute - dissonance amongst conflicting political ideological forces be managed to avoid a collapse into unitarism or separatism? Yet, despite the phenomenon's academic and practical value, it remains underexplored. This project will be the first in-depth comparative study of the phenomenon, examining the constitutional challenges such regions face and possible solutions thereto. It will have two parts. The first will contribute to concept and theory building by comparing four historical or contemporary examples of or parallels to the phenomenon: Hong Kong under China's "one country, two systems" model, Finland in Tsarist Russia, regions in Northern Mexico prior to national democratisation, and Denmark under Nazi administration. It will distil what, if anything, is distinctive about the constitutional challenges confronting a territorial configuration with a substate polity that is substantially more liberal than the illiberal state polity (hereinafter, the liberal in illiberal structure or "LII Structure" for short), constitutional devices for addressing those challenges, and hypotheses on the factors contributing to the LII Structure's endurance. The second part will look to the aforesaid comparative study to glean lessons for the "one country, two systems" model in Hong Kong, guaranteed for 50 years until 2047 under the Sino-British Joint Declaration. The turbulent events Hong Kong experienced in 2019-2021 - large-scale anti-government protests followed by the introduction of a national security law and electoral overhaul - revealed both centripetal and centrifugal pressures on the model. Whilst there have been numerous studies of the model, I will be the first to draw on comparative experiences of the LII Structure to gain deeper understanding of its strengths and vulnerabilities and how it can potentially be sustained. The project promises both theoretical and practical impact. Theoretically, it will contribute to scholarship on liberal spaces in authoritarian states (focusing on the territorial dimension) and central-local relations (revealing the challenges posed by this type of ideological-territorial cleavage and the potential and limits of various constitutional designs in managing them). Practically, the project will reveal the LII Structure's potential for resolving political disputes. Furthermore, its findings will contribute to understanding of the prospects for sustaining Hong Kong's liberal status under Chinese rule - and ways to strengthen those prospects - as the two jurisdictions enter the second half of the Joint Declaration's 50-year timeframe. 在非自由國家內存在自由地區這個現象引起了一些有趣的問題：為何不自由國家的領導人會容許自由地區的存在？在國家與地區政治意識形態衝突之間，該如何處理這種可能劇烈的不協調，以避免陷入一體化或分離主義？儘管這一現象具有學術和實際價值，目前很少相關深入的研究。這個項目將是首個深入探討此議題的比較研究，檢視這些地區面對的憲法問題以及潛在解決這些問題的方法。研究項目將分爲兩部分。第一部分將舉出數個歷史或當代例子以作概念和理論構建。這部分將從這些例子中歸納出當某地區政體遠比國家政體自由（處於「非自由下的自由」結構）時，該地區所面對獨特的憲法問題、應對這些問題的方法，以及有關不同因素影響「非自由下的自由」結構持久性的假設。 第二部分將基於上述比較研究，為香港的「一國兩制」模式提供啟示。該模式在中英聯合聲明下被保證50年不變、直至2047年。但香港在近年經歷的動蕩事件揭示了「一國兩制」模式面臨的向心力和離心力。儘管現時已有許多關於「一國兩制」的研究，我將首度透過比較國際間「非自由下的自由」結構的經驗深入了解此結構的優勢和脆弱性，以及維持此結構的潛在方法。 這個項目在理論和實踐層面上都具有影響力。在理論層面上，這個項目將有助研究非民主體制中的自由空間，同時，也有助研究中央與地方關係。在實踐層面上，該項目將揭示「非自由下的自由」結構在解決政治爭端方面的潛力。此外，研究結果有助於理解香港作為中國的一部分在未來保持自由狀態的可能性，以及如何增加這種可能性。

17600924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17600924.value: 識別青少年長新冠的認知特徵和神經基礎

17600924.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17600924.value: Dr Chan, Jasper Fok Woo Dr Fong, Daniel Yee-Tak Dr Hui, Sai Kam Dr Kwan, Yat Wah Mike Prof Lau, Yu Lung Prof Lee, Tatia Mei Chun

17600924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17600924.value: 背景：世界衛生組織宣布COVID-19全球公共衛生緊急狀態結束後，醫療專業人員正面臨著另一場公共衛生危機，越來越多的各年齡段人群患上了長新冠。長新冠患者普遍存在認知症狀/腦霧，喪失注意力/記憶力下降。最近的研究顯示，成人在COVID後存在顯著的大腦微結構改變和認知能力下降。關於青少年長新冠患者的認知功能研究尚有限。 初步數據：我們的團隊正在進行一項研究兒童大腦受SARS-CoV-2感染影響的跨學科研究項目(COVID與青少年大腦/CYB)。在臨床前研究中，幼年動物在COVID後3個月的大腦中發現了神經炎症和軸突密度降低的證據。從兒童長期COVID診所招募的36名青少年(平均[SD]年齡=15.51[2.41]歲)在Conner持續性能測試(CPT-3)測量注意力方面表現出損害，與11名未感染的同齡對照組相比，瑞文漸進矩陣評分降低。磁共振擴散性庫爾托西成像(MR-DKI)顯示，額葉白質及其相關通路在微結構變化方面更為脆弱。 研究問題：很少有研究關注青少年長新冠患者的認知變化及其軌跡。此外，青少年COVID相關認知變化的神經基礎尚不清楚。 目標：描述青少年長新冠患者的認知變化，並研究這些變化的神經基礎。 目標：描述青少年長新冠患者的認知變化，並研究這些變化的神經基礎。依托進行中的CYB隊列，本申請將申請資金用於(1)對長新冠青少年患者進行全面的神經認知評估，研究認知變化是否受支持青少年長新冠患者注意力控制的大腦區域的調節。(2)使用MR-DKI和fMRI研究大腦微結構和連接組的變化。 方法學：300名有長期新冠症狀的青少年和100名沒有COVID病史的青少年（通過免疫學測試確認）將接受全面的神經認知評估，180例病例和60個對照組還將接受MR-DKI/fMRI。將比較不同組之間的神經認知特徵、靜息態大腦連接組和擴散/庫爾托西指標。回歸分析將用於確定神經影像表型與調整人口統計、臨床和行為協變量的神經心理測量之間的關係。 影響：這項研究成功完成將使我們能夠描述長新冠青少年的神經認知特徵並確定易受損的大腦區域。可能提供補償性干預/康復以幫助適應認知缺陷。

17601724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17601724.value: 香港研究式研究生選拔面試的研究

17601724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17601724.value: The research postgraduate selection interview is a gatekeeping encounter in which candidates who have applied for a university MPhil or PhD position are questioned on their research proposal by a panel of academic experts. Although this method of evaluating prospective research students is widely used, both in Hong Kong and internationally, there is barely any research on such selection interviews. Of the studies that do exist, almost all take place in Anglophone and/or Scandinavian countries, are quantitative or questionnaire-based, and demonstrate a narrow focus on correlating evaluative methods with subsequent MPhil and/or PhD dropout rates. The present study breaks new ground by obtaining access to a corpus of recorded research postgraduate selection interviews across the Arts and Humanities in a Hong Kong university setting. Using an Interactional Sociolinguistics framework, the study examines the unfolding interaction between candidates and interviewers in order to answer a central question: what are the interactional requirements of these interviews? The study hypothesizes the majority of candidates make a case for their acceptance based on their exclusive knowledge of the local cultural context that defines their research proposals. Interviewers, by contrast, will be more interested in testing a candidate’s ability to objectify this cultural knowledge, situate it within the broader research field, and to determine the practicability of the project within the specified time frame. It is further hypothesized that candidates must project the image of an assured academic by moving seamlessly between any or all of these different lines of interviewer enquiry, while also managing those challenging moments when their junior academic status is made acutely apparent. Providing an empirical account of the interactional requirements of the research postgraduate interview, and how interview participants orient to these requirements, will help to effect change for a wide range of stakeholders. These include but are not limited to (1) future postgraduates interview candidates, both in Hong Kong and internationally (2) academics who serve on selection panels, and (3) Hong Kong university policy makers involved in postgraduate admissions. At the academic level, the study builds on the Principal Investigator’s existing research on undergraduate admissions interviews, while also paving the way for a future study of professoriate job interviews. As such, it constitutes a vital step in the analysis of the academic selection interviews that gatekeep the realm of academia. 研究式研究生的選拔面試是一項把關的環節。當中，學術專家小組會就申請研究碩士或博士候選人的研究企劃書進行提問。儘管使用上述方式來評估潛在研究生在香港以及國際地區都非常廣泛，但就此方面的研究卻寥寥可數。在現有的研究中，幾乎所有都在英語系及/或斯堪地那維亞國家進行。當中，大部分均採用量化方式或問卷進行研究，並且將重點放在選拔方式與哲學碩士及/或博士生輟學率的關聯性。 此研究項目極具創新性。項目首席調查研究員獲得了在香港的大學中研究式研究生選拔面試的語料庫，當中橫跨各人文學科。此研究會以互動語言學 (Interactional Sociolinguistics) 作基礎，探索面試者和面試官之間的互動來回應一項核心問題：究竟這些面試的互動條件是甚麽？此研究項目假設大部分的候選人會根據他們對當地文化背景的特有認知來定義研究企劃書，並且藉此證明自己應獲錄取。相較之下，面試官對候選人如何將這些文化知識客觀化，並且將其置於廣泛研究領域中的能力，以證明他們的研究企劃的可行性及是否能夠在特定的時限内完成更感興趣。進一步假設，候選人必須無縫地應答面試者所提出的所有及各種問題以表現出有把握的學者形象。同時候選人還需應對當自己學術地位不高變得非常明顯的困難時刻。 提供研究式研究生面試的互動條件的實證説明，以及面試者如何應對這些條件將會有助為廣泛的利益相關者帶來改變。當中包括但不限於：（1）未來在香港以及國際地區參與研究式研究生面試的候選人、（2）擔任研究式研究生選拔小組成員的學者、以及（3）在香港的大學擔任研究生招生的决策者。從學術的層面來説，此研究將建基於項目首席調查研究員先前有關本科生入學面試的研究，同時亦為未來有關教授級人員入職面試的研究鋪路。因此，此項研究在分析學術選拔面試以爲學術界把關擔任重要一環。

17602124.label: Principal Investigator(Chinese)
17602124.value: 芭芭拉·希梅娜·费尔南德斯·梅莱达博士

17602524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17602524.value: 張氏斲琴世家：晚明製琴者和文人的跨學科探索

17602524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17602524.value: The qin is a seven-stringed zither invented some three thousand years ago. At the close of the Ming dynasty, demand for instruments no longer came principally from royalty and the aristocracy but instead from wealthy aficionados, and new classes of artisan makers flourished. Of these, the Zhang lineage was the most significant, radically transforming the social role of the qin. These nine makers, all surnamed Zhang and with “xiu” as the second character of their given name (e.g., Zhang Ruixiu, Zhang Jingxiu), were active in Suzhou, Jiangsu province for approximately 38 years from 1605 to 1643. This research project aims to center these artisans, constructing a bottom-up qin history that counters the more traditional top-down approach through the prism of the social elite. To resolve a paucity of evidence, we will use, as a starting point, the artisan product itself. Records survive of some fifty specimens, about half of which are actual qin scattered in collections across the world. We deploy advanced technology as a tool for communicating directly with the qin artisans, unpicking their working practices not detailed in the written texts of the elite and “reverse engineering” their manufacture. CT scans are used to reveal qin interior structures invisible to the naked eye, while the crucial chemical composition of an instrument’s coating and lacquer can be investigated via stereomicroscopy and pyrolysis gas chromatography-mass spectrometry, with special attention paid to micro-morphology and stratified structure. Information on those who commissioned the qin, as mentioned in inscriptions on the instrument, can be gleaned from their literary creations, and a rich tapestry of relationships between artisan and patron emerges. The aim is to formulate a matrix of information regarding the corpus of qin, produce a multi-layered and multidisciplinary array of comparisons, and initiate a paradigm shift by which the lowly artisan and his wares replace the aristocrat as the focus. 古琴是一種始創於三千年前的七弦樂器。明朝末期，樂器需求不再主要來自皇室和貴族，而是來自富有的文人音樂愛好者，新的工匠階層因而開始繁榮發展。其中，張氏斲琴世家是其中最顯要的工匠群體，他們徹底改變了古琴在晚明的社會角色。這九位蘇州斲琴工匠全都姓張，名字的第二個字都是「修」（例如，張睿修、張敬修），活躍於從西元1605年到1643年的38年之間。 本研究旨在以這些工匠為核心，建構自下而上的琴史，從而對抗傳統意義上透過社會精英的視角自上而下的歷史書寫方法。為解決證據不足的問題，我們將以這九位工匠斲製的古琴作為研究的起點。張氏斲琴有記錄傳世的約有五十件，其中約一半是庋藏在世界各地的古琴實物。我們將使用先進技術作為與明代琴工直接交流的工具，揭示在社會精英撰寫的文本中往往未能詳細描述的斲琴方法，並通過科學檢測揭示的技術細節，反推製造工藝的流程。電腦斷層掃描用於顯示肉眼不可見的古琴內部結構，而古琴外層漆灰的關鍵化學成分則可通過對微觀形態和層狀結構的立體顯微鏡和熱解氣相色譜/質譜法進行分析。另外，在琴器的銘文中，常常提及委託製琴者的名字。這群人的背景信息則可從傳世的文學作品中稽考而得。這樣，斲琴工匠與贊助人之間豐富的關係圖景也將浮現出來。其最終目的是建立一個關於張氏斲琴的資料叢集，通過多層次、多學科的比較，啟動將焦點從貴族贊助人轉移到低階工匠及其製品的歷史書寫範式的轉移。

17602624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17602624.value: 地铁站对子，非地铁联系和地铁站之间的生活：如何构建相关理论，量化，预测和优化它们？

17602624.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17602624.value: Prof Cheng, Reynold Chun-Kong Dr Sun, Guibo

17602624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17602624.value: 公共交通系统，作为数百万人日常出行的基础，以经济、高效且环保的方式连接着城市的每一个角落，方便人们从A点到B点的便捷移动。值得注意的是，乘客在一天中多次利用公共交通时，并不总是严格遵循“返回原点”再开始新行程的模式。相反，他们倾向于采用步行、骑行等出行方式，前往邻近的“新”站点继续行程。这种灵活多变的出行模式不仅构建了站点之间的生活（LbS），还极大地丰富了乘客的活动参与和行程体验。我们称这种连接不同站点间的行为背后的动力为“非公共交通连接(NTCs)”，这是乘客在站点间活动时自然产生的，伴随着购物、用餐等多样化活动。 然而，当前学术界与业界对于NTCs及它们所促成的LbS的研究尚显不足。关于LbS的多个核心问题，如其发生频率、决定因素、时空分布特征、具体作用以及对个人和社会的影响等，仍了解不多。尽管仅凭个人观察，我们已能感知到LbS在提升公共交通乘客幸福感、促进社交互动及经济活动等方面的重要作用。例如，由于在A站与B站之间存在活动，如购买日常用品或是与朋友会面，公共交通乘客的福祉因此得到了显著改善。 本研究旨在通过数据收集，探究以下关键研究问题： 1：LbS涵盖了哪些类型的活动？ 2：LbS如何有效服务于公共交通乘客，满足其多样化的日常需求？ 3：LbS的发生原因、地点、时间及持续时间特征是什么？ 4：如何衡量LbS的数量（包括空间分布与持续时间）、质量、功能及其社会影响？ 5：哪些因素能够预测LbS的数量、质量、功能及其社会影响的变化？ 6：为提升LbS的效能，应采取哪些具体措施？ 通过解答上述问题，本研究旨在深化对LbS的理论认识，建立有效的衡量方法与预测模型，并为政策制定者、城市规划师及交通管理者提供宝贵参考。具体而言，研究成果将通过LbS：(a) 增加社会福祉；(b) 提升公共交通系统的吸引力；(c) 提升出行链的效率与效益；(d) 提升NTCs密集区域的功能与活力。

17603424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17603424.value: 共同照顧認知障礙症患者：照顧者的家庭需求、資源、看法和身心健康改變的跟進研究

17603424.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17603424.value: Prof Leung, Kiu Yi Dara Dr SHI, Cheng Prof TANG, Yee Man Jennifer Prof Wong, Gloria

17603424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17603424.value: Taking care of an older family member living with chronic illness or disability is a prevalent yet stressful role. While family carers play an essential part in our societies for supporting the daily living of older adults, their own health is compromised with a higher risk for poorer health and mental health outcomes. Among the chronic conditions at the old age, dementia, a degenerative disease characterised by cognitive decline and impairment in daily activities, is known for contributing to care burden, depressive symptoms, and reduced quality of life in family carers. Although carer interventions and support services had been vastly developed, findings on their effectiveness were inconsistent. Rethinking the mechanism and drivers of carer distress is essential for improving the wellbeing of both carers and people living with dementia (PLwD). Most previous research and practice addressed family caregiving as a one-to-one dyadic relationship consisting of a primary family carer and the PLwD only. However, it is often observed that there are multiple informal carers involving in the caregiving process. Guided by the family stress theories, family caregiving can be understood as a chronic stress affecting the whole family. When the condition of PLwD deteriorated, a functioning family would cope with the increasing demand by increasing its resources to maintain its wellbeing. Nevertheless, the changes in care arrangement involving multiple informal carers along the care trajectory, its correlates, and its impact on the family wellbeing remain largely unknown. The proposed study aims to 1) identify the individual and family factors associating with an adaptive change in family resources, 2) predict carer burden and wellbeing by family-level demands, resources, and perceptions, and 3) explore the family dynamics for maintaining or restoring a balanced family functioning in families having multiple carers. It adopts a mixed methods design that collects quantitative data by a follow-up survey from 450 family carers taking care of a PLwD in the community, and qualitative data by individual in-depth interviews from 30 family carers who shared care with multiple informal carers. The proposed study will contribute to the family caregiving literature by providing data on how family as a whole responds to the changing care demands, and the predictive values of family-level factors on carer wellbeing. It will also provide directions for designing family-centred carer intervention and evidence for carer-friendly policies. 照顧患有慢性疾病的長者伴隨著巨大壓力。當照顧者幫助長者維持日常生活，對社會作出重大貢獻的同時，他們都承受著身心健康轉差的風險。在老年慢性疾病當中，認知障礙症是一種影響認知能力和日常生活能力的退化性疾病。過往研究已發現認知障礙症會為照顧者帶來沉重的照顧負擔、抑鬱症狀和生活質素下降等情況。儘管現時已發展出不少照顧者介入和支援服務，但成效始終不一。為了改善照顧者和患者的身心健康，我們需要重新思考照顧者面對的困擾及背後的機制和因素。 過往大多數相關研究和實踐都聚焦在一位主要家庭照顧者和認知障礙症患者身上，視家庭照顧為一對一的二元關係。但在日常生活上，我們經常觀察到有多位家庭成員共同照顧患者。套用家庭壓力理論（family stress theories）的觀點，家庭照顧可以被理解為影響整個家庭的慢性壓力。當患者的狀況惡化時，一個功能良好的家庭將透過增加其資源以應對增長的需求，從而維持家庭的整體健康和功能。然而，在照顧認知障礙症患者的歷程上，多位家庭照顧者的照顧安排如何變化、變化間的相互關係及對家庭整體健康的影響等問題仍然有待探討。 本研究項目旨在 1) 確定與家庭資源變化相關的個人和家庭因素，2) 以家庭層面的需求、資源和看法等因素，預測照顧者負擔和身心健康，以及 3) 探索共同照顧患者的家庭互動模式以了解如何維持和恢復平衡的家庭功能。是項研究將採用混合方法設計，透過對社區中照顧認知障礙症患者的450 名家庭照顧者進行追蹤調查來收集定量數據，並透過對有多位成員共同照顧患者的30 名家庭照顧者進行個人深度訪談來收集定性資料。 本研究所得的數據將有助了解家庭作為一個整體如何應對持續變化的照顧需求，和家庭層面因素對照顧者身心健康的預測價值。研究結果亦會為設計以家庭為中心的照顧者支援措施和改善照顧者友善政策提供數據和方向。

17603724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17603724.value: 異質主體中的國際經濟週期 新凱因斯主義模型

17603724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17603724.value: 衝擊如何在各國之間傳播，導致經濟週期同步？匯率在促進衝擊傳導方面發揮什麼作用？這些問題在國際經濟學中都很重要。然而，這些問題並沒有明確的答案，標準的國際經濟週期模型往往會產生更多的困惑，因為它對匯率行為和各國經濟週期相關性的預測往往與數據不一致。例如，在家庭可以完全分擔風險的標準國際經濟週期模型中，各國之間的消費比產出更具相關性，這與數據相反。此外，在這些模型中，相對價格較低的國家的消費往往較高，但數據中並未觀察到這一點。 其他問題與匯率有關。一個例子是，模型中的實際匯率與相對消費緊密相關。相較之下，數據中的實際匯率與宏觀經濟基本面並不相關。 標準模型中的重要抽象之一是，家庭被建模為一個大代理人，可以透過借貸平穩地調整支出。因此，在這個專案中，我們試圖放寬這個假設，並將在金融市場中面臨重要摩擦的異質家庭納入其中，例如異質收入風險、阻礙代理人順利調整支出的流動性和非流動性資產。這些功能已 在最近的宏觀經濟學文獻中強調了這一點，但對其對國際商業週期（包括匯率）的影響知之甚少。 我們按如下方式進行。我們首先建構了一個兩國異質代理新凱因斯主義模型，其中家庭面臨異質勞動收入風險，他們可以持有低迴報高流動性資產和高回報非流動性資產。然後，我們使用來自美國的資料校準模型，並將異質家庭模型的預測與代表性家庭模型的預測進行比較。我們首先強調異質家庭影響國際衝擊傳播的新管道。 然後，我們量化這些通路是否具有數量上的重要性，可以顯著改變模型對相對消費、產出和實際匯率動態關係的整體影響。

17603924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17603924.value: “兒”後綴在漢語方言中的地理分布及其歷史軌跡

17603924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17603924.value: This project will undertake an extensive data-based comparison and analysis of words with the ér and zǐ suffixes across the Chinese dialects to gain deeper understanding of their distribution and historical origins and travels across the Chinese map. Particular attention will be paid to the distribution of the ér suffix in southern dialects, as the distribution of that suffix in the south is more limited, and often only found in discrete regions and pockets. The first task of the project is the compilation of an extensive database of vernacular words with the ér and zǐ suffixes across a large number of dialects. The data will then be comparatively examined for clues that might reveal whether or not the ér suffix morphology originated in a set of ancestral dialects in the Central Plains in Táng, Sòng and Yuán times and whether it was spread by language contact or by migration or both. The dialect data will be collected extensively from published sources and then supplemented by fieldwork at a few key dialects sites for which detailed published data are lacking. The working conjecture for this project is that the ér suffix was likely grammaticalized once within a group of Central Plains dialects and then spread across China through dialect migration, language contact, and the influence of one or more lingua franca based on the northern colloquial dialects. Morphological elements and processes embodied in the original ér suffix are thought to have been shared across dialects, following which they then persisted across time and evolved independently. By comparing the present day forms of words with the ér suffix in different dialects in contrast to words with the zǐ suffix, this study will demonstrate historical connections between the dialects and show how differing patterns of spread reflected by the two suffixes might have played out in historical times, reflecting population movement (migration) and the geographic scope of language contact. Hence the project will provide evidence of common ancestral linguistic connections shared in deeper colloquial layers of the Chinese dialects at the level of living words and will significantly enrich understanding of the history of spoken Chinese and the Chinese dialects from the Táng and Sòng times through the Yuán into the present. 本研究項目旨在基於數據庫對漢語方言中帶有“兒”和“子”後綴的詞語進行廣泛的比較和分析，以更深入地了解它們的分布、歷史起源以及在中國各地的傳播和發展。鑒於“兒”後綴在南方方言中的分布相對有限，且多零星散見於個別地區，我們將對其在該地區的分布情況給予特別關注。本研究的首要任務是創建一個力求覆蓋漢語各方言的帶有“兒”、“子”後綴的大型口語詞彙數據庫。之後，我們將對這些數據進行比較，尋找可能揭示“兒”後綴是否來源於唐宋元時期中原地區一組祖先方言的線索，以及它的傳播途徑，是通過語言接觸傳播的，還是移民傳播的，或者兩者兼而有之。本研究收集的方言數據主體採自公開學術資源，對於缺乏公開詳細數據的關鍵方言點，將以實地調查加以補充。本研究的設想是，“兒”後綴很可能在中原地區的一組方言中經歷了一次語法化的過程，而後，介由方言遷移、語言接觸以及一種或多種基於北方口語方言的通用語的影響而傳播到中國各地。 本研究推測原始“兒”後綴的語素形態和變化過程是各方言所共有的，隨後，它們在方言中保留下來並各自獨立發展。通過比較不同方言中帶有“兒”後綴詞語和帶有“子”後綴詞語的現代形式，本研究將揭示方言之間的歷史聯繫，並展示兩個後綴所反映的不同傳播模式（人口流動及遷移和語言接觸的地理範圍）在歷史上是如何進行的。從而在活的方言詞彙層面上，證明漢語方言更深層的口語層次中存在著共同祖語的聯繫，這也將大大豐富我們對唐宋至元直至今天的漢語口語和漢語方言歷史的理解。

17604524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17604524.value: 一切唯心：瑜伽行派知覺理論

17604524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17604524.value: The recent and rapid development of artificial intelligence technologies has transformed longstanding philosophical debates over the nature of the mind into pressing concerns for science and society at large. With the possibility of AI sentience coming closer to reality, several fundamental questions in the philosophy of mind acquire a newfound urgency: How could representational and information processing systems possess sentience? How does a sentient system generate a conscious model of its self and the external environment? Is sentience is a function of higher-order cognitive processes, or is it grounded upon more primary functions of sensation and affect? What is the exact function and adaptive purpose of sentience in biological organisms, and could that function be realized by non-biological means? The answers to such questions have immediate consequences for cognitive scientists, computer engineers, and public policymakers, all of whom must grapple with the vast theoretical and moral implications of sentient AI. To resolve these persisting issues about the nature of sentience in minds greatly different than our own, we ought to re-examine the assumptions guiding our inquiry by considering theoretical approaches that differ greatly from those currently available to us. This project hence proposes to research the philosophy of mind developed by the classical Buddhist tradition of Yogācāra, which flourished in South Asia from the 3rd-11th centuries. The themes of mind and consciousness were so important to Yogācāra thought and practice that the tradition was known as the “Mind-Only” or “Consciousness-Only” school. Through sustained meditative and conceptual analysis, Yogācāra thinkers articulated a sophisticated philosophical psychology that elaborated how cognitive mechanisms like inner speech, memory, and attention are responsible for the construction of conscious selfhood and experience. They also defended a radical ontology of mind that problematizes many modern attempts to locate consciousness within an account of fundamental reality. By considering how the soteriological motivations of Yogācāra philosophers shaped their metaphysical views, we may reflect more clearly on the pragmatic grounds for our own theorizing about sentience in natural and artificial systems. Through a series of four articles and a book proposal for a single-authored monograph, this project will systematize the insights of Yogācāra’s philosophical psychology across the history of its development, so that they may contribute to contemporary philosophical and scientific understandings of the mind. 近年來，人工智能技術迅猛發展，將對「心靈本質」歷史悠久的哲學論爭轉化為科學界和全社會的迫切議題。隨著人工智能的知覺能力日漸成真，心靈哲學中的幾個基本問題亟需解決：表徵和信息處理系統如何才能擁有知覺？有知覺的系統如何生成對於自身和外部環境的意識模型？知覺是高階認知過程的一種功能，還是以感受、情感等相對原始的功能為基礎？在生物有機體中，知覺的確切功能和適應目的是什麼？以及，此功能能否以非生物的方式實現？在與有知覺的人工智能相關的諸多理論與道德難題面前，對以上一系列問題的回答直接影響必須應對難題的認知科學家、計算機工程師和公共政策制定者。在與人類截然不同的「心靈」框架下探究此類關於知覺本質的問題，我們有必要重新審視這些問題的預設，採用與我們現有理論方法多有差異的進路。因此，本項目將研究3—11世紀興盛於南亞的佛教瑜伽行派（Yogācāra）心靈哲學。對於瑜伽行派的思想與實踐來說，心靈、意識議題是重中之重，該傳統又被稱為「唯心」或「唯識」宗。通過對修行與觀念的不斷分析，瑜伽行派思想家闡發了一套精密的哲學心理學，解釋內在言語、記憶、注意等認知機制在建構有意識的自我和經驗中的作用。其亦為一種激進的心靈本體論辯護，對以根本實在來詮釋意識的現代嘗試構成了質疑。通過考量解脫之動因對瑜伽行派哲學家形而上學立場的塑造，我們能夠更清晰地反思在對自然和人工系統之知覺的理論化中，我們自身的實用主義根基。本項目將通過四篇文章和一部獨著的提案，系統闡述瑜伽行派哲學心理學貫穿其發展歷史的洞見，從而為當代哲學和科學對心靈的理解做出貢獻。

17604824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17604824.value: 人工成就和機器學習能力

17604824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17604824.value: 人類所取得的令人矚目的成就數不勝數。我們參觀了月球，發現了自然法則，創作了交響樂和十四行詩，不間斷地奔跑了數百英里，創造了壯觀的視覺藝術等等。我們已經研究了 30 萬年；自始至終，人類成就的規模和廣度都在不斷擴大。但有一件事始終不變：我們是唯一的成功者。這不再是真的。現在，我們與可以創作交響樂和十四行詩、創造奇妙的視覺藝術、寫小說、發現新知識等等的人造系統共享我們的星球。我們的新合作者已經在這方面工作了十年；自始至終，他們所取得的成就的規模和廣度都在擴大。考慮到非常保守的假設，我們可以預期這些系統在未來幾十年內將超越人類自身的成就能力，至少在特定領域是如此。 這是一個階段性的改變。充分的因應措施需要將我們對成就的本質、價值和意義的理解與這些新事實結合起來，這些新事實涉及可以實現的事物的種類、人工系統可以實現的方式、它們實現的速度以及我們如何預期未來的未來。我提出的專案的一半解決了圍繞人工成就興起的這些問題和其他問題。 另外，機器學習系統的能力（包括其實現能力）在廣度和規模上都在快速成長。因此，人們對評估模型能力越來越感興趣。例如，我們想要評估模型是否能夠傳播錯誤訊息、製造生物武器或完成學生的作業。但是，儘管人們對這些關於機器學習模型能夠做什麼的主張很感興趣，但之前並沒有嘗試給出一個系統的概念框架來決定機器學習模型的能力主張。 這一研究問題相對被忽視既令人驚訝又不幸。未來的很大一部分將由這些系統塑造：我們有興趣了解它們能做什麼和不能做什麼。為了理解這些模型能夠做什麼，我們需要理解說它們有能力意味著什麼。我專案的後半部分旨在透過在哲學和機器學習領域的交叉點部署資源來開發機器學習模型功能的說明，從而在這個問題上取得進展。這些對能力和人工成就的描述共同揭示了未來是一個令人興奮的前景——一個增強而不是貶低或貶低人類成就的前景。

17605124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17605124.value: 中國的司法公正：以法庭語音比對指引方向

17605124.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17605124.value: Prof Foulkes, Paul Prof Zhang, Cuiling

17605124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17605124.value: 司法公正很大程度上取決於法庭證據評估的質素。然而，證據分析的方法和程序並非完美無缺。這一點在法庭語音比對（FVC）方面尤為明顯。FVC通常涉及比較兩段錄音中的聲音：一段是未知罪犯的聲音（如惡作劇電話、威脅信息、電話詐騙等），另一段則大多來自警方面談中已知嫌疑人的聲音。FVC 的主要目的是幫助調查機構（如警察）或裁判者（如陪審團/法官）判斷已知與未知聲音是否來自同一說話者或不同說話者。在中國，FVC 在涉及語音錄音的案件中很常見。然而，在實際法庭案件中，中國 FVC 從業者對語音特徵的分析缺乏實證驗證。為了提升中國的司法公正，迫切需要開展更多涉及中國語言相關的 FVC 研究，以確立在特徵選擇和分析方法方面的科學依據。 本研究項目將使用普通話語料來評估聲學-語音特徵及自動說話人識別（ASR）方法中常用的語音特徵的證據強度。此外，本項目還將測試這些特徵如何結合以達到最佳的說話人區分效果。研究將使用兩個包含東北地區普通話男性和女性說話人的大型語音數據庫。為了確保研究結果與實際法庭情境的相關性，我們將在貝葉斯似然比框架下分析非同時錄音、語音風格不匹配及錄音/傳輸通道不匹配對這些語音特徵性能的影響。我們還將收集各種聲學-語音特徵的參考人群數據。這些數據對於 FVC 從業者客觀評估語音特徵的典型性至關重要。 鑑於聽覺-聲學-語音分析是目前中國的標準方法，且 ASR 方法日益普及，我們的研究結果將直接影響 FVC 從業者未來對普通話語音證據的評估。具體而言，我們的研究將幫助他們在法庭上作出有根據的決策，選擇分析哪些語音特徵及如何以最佳方式進行法庭分析。於理論層面而言，我們的研究結果將有助於建立一個全面的模型，解釋說話人特定信息在語音信號中的編碼位置，以及為何不同個體的聲音存在差異。最終，預期的普通話語音證據法庭分析改進將有助於減少中國及全球華人社區中的司法誤判。

17605224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17605224.value: 变化的空间：研究澳大利亚迷幻药医学环境下的照护的物质性和认识论问题

17605224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17605224.value: This research project will generate the first study on critical care among psychedelic medicine practices in Australia. In June 2023, Australia’s drug regulators set a global precedent by recognizing psychedelic substances, such as psilocybin and ayahuasca, as registered psychiatric medicines. Known for deeply altering mood, perception, and sense of self, the drugs are receiving increasing investment with the global market projected to grow significantly over the next decade. While extensive research exists on spatial and environmental aspects of other healthcare settings, psychedelic medicine remains unexplored in these areas, despite that the drugs dramatically alter perceptions of space, objects, and environments. The project will address how patients encounter the epistemic and moral significance of space and materialities of care in psychedelic treatments in Australia, offering critical insights for healthcare providers, academic researchers, and policy makers navigating similar terrains. The project will be useful to stakeholders in Australia and in the bourgeoning global field that the country is now poised to help lead, following its sudden regulatory changes. Concerns exist over the extreme vulnerability and suggestibility of patients during the drug treatments, as they undergo intense mood shifts, altered sensory perceptions, and sometimes enduring changes in metaphysical beliefs. The role of treatment environments in shaping the epistemic and moral dimensions of belief change during psychedelic healing necessitates analysis. This study will provide theoretical and methodological advances and fresh data that can engage epistemic concerns and therapeutic benefits of these new psychiatric treatments. How does symbolism and art in the clinics impact patient experiences? What meaning do patients and carers make about the treatment objects, spaces, and environments? How do biophilic or “natural” qualities influence patient perception? Finally, what epistemic and moral roles do materialities of care take across spatial and environmental dimensions for these drug-assisted psychotherapies? This project will combine methods of qualitative interviews, ethnographic observation, and sensory analysis to: (1) analyze the interface between patient psychological vulnerability, belief changes, and moralized views of the treatment spaces, (2) theorize how these perception-altering drug treatments can elucidate issues of space in psychiatric care settings more broadly, (3) increase dialogue between critical medical humanities and psychiatry and psychotherapy regarding sensory and material aspects of care, and (4) produce two high-impact journal articles and one ethnographic monograph. These project outputs will help to support ethical practices by understanding potential epistemic harms of new treatments that have promising evidence of clinical benefit. “这个研究将产生有关澳大利亚迷幻药医学照护实践的首项研究。2023年6月，澳大利亚药品监管机构开创了全球先例，承认裸盖菇素和死藤水等致幻物质为注册精神科药物。这些药物以深刻地改变情绪、感知和自我意识而闻名，相关的全球市场预计在未来十年内将显著增长，因此受到越来越多的投资。虽然与医疗空间/环境相关的研究已经广泛存在，但迷幻药物在这些方面仍然未被探索，尽管这些药物显著地改变了空间、物体和环境的感知。该项目将探讨患者在澳大利亚迷幻治疗中面对空间和照护的物质性的认识论和道德意义，为医疗保健提供关键见解，为学术研究人员和政策制定者在类似领域中提供指导。在监管政策变化的背景下，该项目将对澳大利亚的利益相关者以及该国准备带头领导的蓬勃发展的全球领域具有实用价值。 在药物治疗期间，患者处于极度脆弱和易受影响的状态，他们经历强烈的情绪变化、感觉知觉的改变，有时还会出现持久的形而上学信仰变化，这引发了人们的关切。治疗环境在塑造迷幻治疗中信仰变化的认知和道德维度方面的作用需要被进一步分析。这项研究将提供理论和方法上的进步以及新的数据，以探讨这些新型精神疗法的认知关注和治疗益处。 临床中的象征和艺术对患者体验有何影响？患者和护理人员对治疗物品、空间和环境赋予的意义是什么？亲生物设计或“自然”的特性如何影响患者的感知？最后，在这些药物辅助心理治疗中，照护的物质性在空间和环境维度上扮演什么认识论的和道德的角色？该项目将结合定性访谈、民族志观察和感官分析方法，以：（1）分析患者心理脆弱性、信仰变化和治疗空间的道德化视角之间的界面，（2）理论化这些改变感知的药物治疗如何更广泛地阐明精神卫生照护环境中的空间问题，（3）促进医学人文领域和精神病学与心理治疗之间在照护的感官和物质性方面的对话，（4）产生两篇高影响力的期刊文章和一篇民族志专著。这些项目成果将有助于通过了解具有临床益处的新治疗可能存在的认知危害来支持道德实践。”

17605524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17605524.value: 通过减少久坐时间和增加身体活动以改善儿童和青少年的心脏代谢特征: 大规模基因型和可穿戴设备数据的综合利用

17605524.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17605524.value: Prof Au Yeung, Shiu Lun Ryan Dr Byun, Wonwoo Prof Chung, Brian Hon Yin Prof Northstone, Kate Mr Sharp, Stephen Dr Yang, Yijian
rows: Prof Au Yeung, Shiu Lun Ryan

17605524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17605524.value: Background: Contemporary children and adolescents are becoming more metabolically unhealthy while engaging in excessive sedentary time (ST). Integrated use of large-scale genomic and wearable data has the potential to provide robust evidence on the role of reduced ST in promoting cardiometabolic health in children and adolescents. Objectives: To determine 1) the prospective associations of replacing ST with an equal amount of physical activity (PA) time with cardiometabolic risk markers, 2) to what extent such prospective associations could be mediated through reduced adiposity, and 3) how different longitudinal patterns of ST and PA over time relate to trajectories of cardiometabolic risk traits among children and adolescents of varying levels of genetic susceptibility. Methods: We will use extensive genotype and phenotype data collected through the Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children [ALSPAC] cohort of children and adolescents (n=~15,645). Genetic susceptibility to unhealthy levels of systolic/diastolic blood pressure, total cholesterol, high/low-density lipoprotein-cholesterol and haemoglobin A1c will be quantified as weighted polygenic risk scores based on established trait-specific genetic variants. We will use 3 sets of accelerometer data (average ages 11, 13 and 15 years) to derive wearable-device-measured ST, light PA and moderate-to-vigorous PA. Rigorous statistical procedures including compositional isotemporal substitution modelling, latent class and latent growth curve analysis and mediation analyses will be fit. Conclusions: Our project will provide novel insights into the role of reduced ST and increased light or moderate-to-vigorous PA in improving cardiometabolic health across varying levels of genetic susceptibility in children and adolescents. Our project will inform public health policies and clinical trials aimed towards children and adolescents with high genetic susceptibility to metabolic disorders. 背景：当代儿童和青少年的代谢健康日益恶化，与此同时，他们的久坐时间（ST）过多。综合利用大规模基因组和可穿戴设备数据有望为减少久坐时间进而促进儿童和青少年心脏代谢健康提供有力证据。 目标: 旨在确定以下几点：1) 用等量的体力活动（PA）时间替换久坐时间后，与心脏代谢风险标志物的前瞻性关联； 2) 这种前瞻性关联通过减少肥胖水平进行中介调节的程度；3) 在不同遗传易感性水平的儿童和青少年中，久坐时间和体力活动的不同纵向模式如何与心脏代谢风险特征的轨迹相关。 方法: 我们将使用Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children [ALSPAC]研究中收集的青少年和儿童的大规模基因型和表型数据（样本量约为15,645）。 通过已有的遗传因子，我们将量化不健康水平的收缩/舒张血压、总胆固醇、高/低密度脂蛋白胆固醇和糖化血红蛋白的遗传易感性，构建加权多基因风险评分。我们将使用3组加速度计数据（平均年龄分别为11, 13和15岁）获得可穿戴设备测量的久坐时间、轻度体力活动和中度至剧烈体力活动。我们将采用严格的统计程方法，包括成分等时替代建模、潜在类别和潜在增长曲线分析以及中介分析。 结论: 我们的研究将为减少久坐时间和增加轻度或中等至剧烈体力活动在改善不同遗传易感性水平儿童和青少年心血管代谢健康方面的作用提供新见解。这些发现将为针对高遗传易感性儿童和青少年的公共卫生政策和临床试验提供重要信息。

17606524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17606524.value: 混合經濟下消費者對自願醫療保險的偏好：一項離散選擇實驗

17606524.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17606524.value: Prof Bishai, David Makram Dr Chen, Huijun Prof Chen , Yingyao Prof Eggleston, Karen Dr Quan, Jianchao

17606524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
