17606524.value: The aim of this proposal is to outline a study utilizing a discrete choice experiment (DCE) to investigate consumer preferences for voluntary health insurance in Hong Kong. With the rising healthcare costs and increasing demand for better healthcare options, understanding consumer preferences is vital for insurance providers and policymakers to develop effective and tailored health insurance plans. This study will provide valuable insights into the key factors influencing consumer decision-making in the context of voluntary health insurance in Hong Kong. Objectives: 1. To identify the attributes that consumers consider when choosing voluntary health insurance plans in Hong Kong and assess their relative importance. 2. To estimate consumer willingness-to-pay for different attribute levels in voluntary health insurance plans and their affordability. 3. To explore the heterogeneity in consumer preferences based on demographic and socioeconomic factors. The findings will be analysed and interpreted to identify the key factors influencing consumer preferences for voluntary health insurance in Hong Kong. The study will provide insights into the design and marketing of health insurance plans, enabling insurance providers and policymakers to develop more tailored and consumer-centric offerings. This proposed study aims to utilise a discrete choice experiment to investigate consumer preferences for voluntary health insurance in Hong Kong. By exploring the attributes and attribute levels that influence decision-making, this research will contribute to the development of effective health insurance products, better meet the needs of consumers, and inform policy decisions. The results will be valuable for insurance providers, policymakers, and researchers interested in the healthcare market in Hong Kong. 摘要： 本研究旨在利用離散選擇實驗（DCE）調查香港消費者對自願醫療保險的偏好。隨著醫療保健成本的上升和對更好的醫療保健選擇的需求增加，了解消費者偏好對於保險提供商和政策制定者制定有效且定制化的醫保計劃至關重要。本研究將為理解香港自願醫保計劃市場下影響消費者決策的關鍵因素提供寶貴見解。 目標： 1. 確定消費者在選擇香港自願醫保時考慮的屬性，並評估其相對重要性。 2. 估計消費者對自願醫保計劃中不同屬性層次的支付意願及其可負擔性。 3. 基於人口和社會經濟因素，探索消費者偏好的異質性。 研究結果將被分析和解釋，以確定影響香港自願醫保消費者偏好的關鍵因素。本研究將為自願醫保計劃的設計和營銷提供見解，使保險提供商和政策制定者能夠開發更為量身定制和以消費者為中心的產品。 本研究旨在利用離散選擇實驗調查香港消費者對自願醫療保險的偏好。通過探索影響消費者決策的屬性和屬性層次，本研究將有助於開發有效的醫療保險產品，更好地滿足消費者的需求，並為政策決策提供信息。研究結果將對關心香港醫療保健市場的保險提供商、政策制定者和研究人員具有參考價值。

17606624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17606624.value: 中國青年律師工作狀況調查

17606624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17606624.value: This research project aims to investigate the work conditions and experiences of early-career lawyers in China, a topic of critical importance given the unprecedented growth of the Chinese legal profession in recent years. Despite the significant increase in the number of early-career lawyers, many face serious issues in their everyday work, including labour contract disputes, inadequate case sources, long work hours, and exploitation from law firm partners. Female lawyers are particularly vulnerable to gender discrimination and sexual harassment in the workplace. I will be the first to carry out a large-scale empirical study on this topic in China and seek to provide insights into the challenges, coping strategies, and well-being of early-career lawyers in different types of law firms and practice areas. Over a period of three years, the researchers will conduct 100 in-depth interviews with early-career lawyers in Beijing and four provinces (Guangdong, Jilin, Yunnan, and Zhejiang), as well as engage in participant observation in law firms and online ethnography. The study will explore the impact of China’s legal and social changes on early-career lawyers’ work, seeking to understand how these changes affect their career paths and professional development. This research project addresses a critical gap in the socio-legal scholarship on the legal profession. It has the potential to influence policy and practice in the legal field. The findings will contribute to the development of a more supportive and sustainable legal profession in China. 本研究課題旨在調查中國青年律師的工作條件和經驗，這是一個至關重要的主題，因為近年來中國法律職業的增長是空前的。儘管青年律師的數量顯著增加，但許多律師在日常工作中面臨嚴重問題，包括勞動合同糾紛、案源不足、工作時間長以及律師事務所合夥人的剝削。女性律師在職場中尤其容易受到性別歧視和性騷擾。本課題將通過在中國進行大規模實證研究來尋求提供關於不同類型律師事務所和執業領域的青年律師所面臨的挑戰、應對策略和身心健康的見解。在三年的時間裡，研究人員將在北京和几個省份對青年律師進行約100次深入訪談，同時進行在律師事務所的參與觀察和在線民族誌。本課題將探討中國法律和社會變革對青年律師工作的影響，試圖了解這些變化如何影響他們的職業道路和專業發展。本研究課題填補了關於法律職業的法社會學研究的重要空白。它有可能影響法律領域的政策和實踐。研究結果將有助於中國法律職業的更具支持性和可持續性的發展。

17606724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17606724.value: 中國高品質茶葉的文化經濟地理學：象征價值、社會-技術網絡及其地理意義

17606724.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17606724.value: Dr Jie, Dongzheng Dr Peng, Chong

17606724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17606724.value: 在當代中國，傳統茶葉日漸成為被美學化的商品，其價格的飆升已成為引起公眾討論的一個迷思，需要學術研究的深入掲示。不僅茶葉的內在品質屬性受到文化話語和理念的影響，其相關的種植、採摘、加工等一系列技能方法也被神秘化為“工匠”實踐。茶葉經濟的這一文化特征有潛力為兩個重要研究領域貢獻新的實證材料和理論見解。一方面，農業食品研究中的“品質轉向”顯示出對重塑經濟價值生產和價值鏈協調過程的文化、意義和話語要素的興趣。另一方面，文化經濟地理學和異端經濟學理論關注市場邏輯和市場外邏輯之間的共存與相互建構過程。 為了探究位於經濟和文化邏輯交匯之處的茶葉經濟，項目會歷時36個月，通過檔案研究、參與式觀察、深度訪談、焦點小組訪談以及行動者網絡分析等研究方法，對產於浙江省杭州市的龍井茶和福建省武夷山區的武夷岩茶展開調研。本項目置於的背景是，2010年後龍井茶和武夷岩茶價格飛漲，並成為日益精致復雜的文化知識所建構的對象。在理論層面，本項目立足於文化經濟地理學和異端經濟學的主要範式，闡明經濟、美學和符號價值之間的相互關係。這一理論任務通過以下三方面實現：（1）符號價值如何被轉譯為經濟價值；（2）非人類因素、物質性和社會-技術網絡在商品價值評估過程中如何協作；（3）品質規範和標準如何取決於地理環境與過程。在實證層面，中國情境下的研究表明人們對於農業產品原真性的認知與文化話語尤其是關於產品原產地的話語緊密相關。本研究則將更進一步明晰經由文化編碼的品質概念與市場動態之間的具體關係。在學術界外，本項目還將對香港內外關注經濟增長和本地生產社區福祉中文化維度的農民、商業界、政策製定者和消費者有重要意義。

17606824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17606824.value: 家居改造能否預防殘疾並減少殘疾相關結果？針對居家長者及其照顧者的跨國縱向比較研究

17606824.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17606824.value: Prof Lou, Vivian Weiqun Mr Ng, Simon Tat ming

17606824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17606824.value: As population ageing is occurring across the world, there are increasing numbers of older adults with mobility or functional impairments, many of whom wish to continue living at home. Home modifications such as ramps, rails and kitchen or bathroom alterations can often enable them to remain independent in their own home. However, much of the evidence on the effectiveness of such modifications for reducing the severity of functional impairments or delaying disability onset is of low to moderate strength. As a result, decision-makers and stakeholders such as occupational therapists may delay or deny funding for home modifications to those who could benefit the most. The methodological weaknesses of previous research on the role of home modifications in preventing disability, which may have led to weak and inconsistent estimates of effects, are highlighted in this proposal. We propose an innovative solution to estimating the effects of home modifications, taking into account the selection processes that led to them, using data from the spouses and partners of older adults. The research will analyse longitudinal household data from population-representative samples of more than 50,000 older adults from 13 countries (11 European countries, China and the USA) who have been followed up repeatedly for at least four years. In addition, the research will examine inequalities in the distribution of home modifications by housing tenure in Hong Kong, and assess whether home modifications can address the complex needs of caregivers of older adults in a longitudinal follow-up study of a representative sample of caregivers living in Hong Kong. The results of the proposed research are likely to produce strong evidence that home modifications can reduce or prevent disability and disability-related outcomes such as falls, pain and depression among older adults and their caregivers across different countries and contexts. The research will thus benefit older adults, the stakeholders involved in housing older adults, such as housing associations and government housing departments, as well as occupational therapists who assess the housing conditions of older adults. In addition, we expect to find strong evidence of unequal outcomes for disabled and older adults living in the private rental sector versus the public sector in Hong Kong, demonstrating the need for policies to improve housing conditions for older adults who rent their homes in the private sector.

17607324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17607324.value: 職前英文教師數碼素養教學培育：基於香港的質性個案研究

17607324.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17607324.value: Prof Gu, Ming Yue Michelle Dr Lai, Chun Dr Li, Mimi Dr Mirhosseini, Seyedabdolhamid

17607324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17607324.value: 數字素養涵蓋兩種能力，一為使用數字工具的實用技能，二為以批判和反思的態度將數字工具融入日常生活中的社會實踐。將數字素養作為一種功能性和社會性並存的能力進行教學，不僅能幫助學生掌握運用數字工具進行讀寫的能力，亦能培養其成為有生產力且有責任心的數字公民。為提供如此教育，我們必須深入理解職前英語教師所經曆的社會性和文化性歷程以及影響因素，因其賦予職前教師切實可行的價值觀和實踐能力以應對具體的數字素養問題。過往研究主要將數字素養視為一套功能性技能，卻忽略了其作為社會實踐的重要意義。而關於教師的數字素養培訓也常常局限於短暫的課程或工作坊式的技能類培訓，未能深入探究職前教師在多種經歷和發展過程中如何逐步發展和深化對於數字素養教育的理解和學習。儘管一些學者和跨國組織已製定一系列關於數字素養的課程設計和實施的框架，但我們仍然對職前英語教師如何概念化數字素養和數字素養教育，以及他們如何將自身對數字素養的理解踐行與日常的教學實踐活動中知之甚少。若缺乏此等知識，正確培養職前英語教師的數字素養教育能力將面臨極大的挑戰。 為了填補這一研究空白，是項研究將從社會文化視角概念化數字素養，並從生態學的視角將其加以應用，去探究英語語言專業的師範生如何學習數字素養教學，不僅著眼於課堂內的學習，更關注其如何將學習數字素養教育貫穿於整個教師教育項目的學習中，以及如何將數字素養教育的學習遷移至多種多樣的學習情境中。是項研究將採用為期一學年的質性案例研究設計，在香港的兩個英語職前教師教育項目中實施，涉及60名師範學生，6位教師教育者以及4位項目負責人/協調人。為了深入了解在職前語言教師教育中，師生如何理解和學習數字素養教育，是項研究將收集多種數據來源，包括個人訪談、課堂觀察、課程資料、學生的思維導圖以及課程作業/作品集文件。 是項研究將對職前教師在多種情景下的複雜學習過程提供新的認識和理解，並對數字素養教育融入職前英語教師教育進行理論化建構。之後我們亦將開發相關的理論模型，用以幫助職前英語教師學習數字素養教學。此理論模型將為課程和政策發展的製定者和決策者提供參考，並提出幹預措施建議，旨在培養社會所需的教學人員隊伍，並在香港及更廣泛地區更有效地推廣數字素養。

17607724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17607724.value: 全球知識體系中的香港人文社科研究：全球動態與香港面貌

17607724.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17607724.value: Prof Oancea, Alis E. Dr OLDAC, Yusuf Ikbal Dr Thun, Theara Prof Yang, Rui

17607724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17607724.value: This study proposes to research Hong Kong (HK) humanities and social sciences (HSS) research in the unequal yet dynamic global knowledge system, with the objective to develop a landscape of HK HSS research, including its position in and interaction with the global knowledge system. Uniquely placed in the Eastern-Western border and attracting researchers and students from all over the world, HK has rich resources and great potential to develop innovative and original HSS intellectual work and make significant contributions to global epistemic diversity and building a more equal global knowledge system. However, it remains unknown what the position of HK HSS research is in the global knowledge system, and what efforts are being made to enhance its capacity. Neither do we know much about what global inequalities, power struggles, and opportunities HK HSS researchers encounter in research and how they conduct and share research in such contexts. Building on the existing literature on global knowledge production and sharing and Margaret Archer’s theorisation of the agency-structure complex, this study views HK HSS researchers as knowledge agents who exercise reflexive agency in interacting with the global and local research structures in research. It aims to fill the above research gaps through three domains of exploration. First, it will unpack the historical and current states of HK HSS research output through bibliometric investigations. Second, it will unpack the HK local structure of HSS research through document analyses and semi-structured interviews with HK research policymakers, university senior managers, and HSS researchers. Third, it will explore the perceptions and actions of HK HSS researchers in research through semi-structured interviews. Attention will be paid to these researchers’ perceptions of the global and local research structures and their actions in interacting with the structures in research production and sharing. By doing these, this study will delineate a comprehensive, rich, detailed, and nuanced landscape of HK HSS research, its position in, and interaction with, the dynamic and unequal global knowledge system. The study will contribute to the understanding of HSS research in HK and the global knowledge system, the theorisation of the global-local nexus in HSS research production and sharing, and the conceptualisation of potential approaches to challenging global inequalities in HSS research and to promoting global epistemic diversity. It will generate important policy implications for developing HK HSS research, and is of significant global relevance, especially to other non-Euro-American systems and their HSS researchers. 在當前不平等卻持續動態發展的全球知識體系背景下，本研究旨在勾勒香港人文社科研究的全貌，包括其在全球知識體系中的地位及在其中的互動。 香港地處東西方交匯之處，吸引了來自世界各地的學者和學生，擁有豐富的資源和巨大的潛力，能夠發展出具有創新性和原創性的人文社科智識成果，並為建設全球知識多樣性和更為平等的全球知識體系做出重要貢獻。然而，香港人文社科研究在全球知識體系中的地位尚不明確，當下為提升其能力所做的努力也鮮為人知。我們極少了解香港人文社科研究者在研究過程中面臨的全球不平等、權力鬥爭和機會，以及他們在這種背景下如何開展和分享研究。 本研究以全球知識生產和分享的現有文獻以及瑪格麗特·阿切尔（Margaret Archer）的結構-能動理論為基礎，將香港人文社科研究者視為在研究中有反思能動性與全球-地方研究結構進行交互作用的知識能動者。它將通過探索三個方面的研究來填補上述研究空白。首先，通過文獻計量學研究，揭示香港人文社科研究的發展歷程和現狀。其次，通過文獻分析和半結構化訪談香港研究政策製定者、大學高層管理人員和人文社科研究者，分析香港本地的人文社科研究的結構。第三，通過半結構化訪談，探討香港人文社科研究者在研究中的觀點和行動，關注這些研究人員對全球-地方研究結構的看法及其在科研生產與分享中的實踐。通過這些方式，本研究將勾勒一個關於香港人文社科研究的全面、豐富、詳細和細致的圖景，包括其在動態而又不平等的全球知識體系中的地位，及在其中的交互作用。 該研究將有助於了解香港和全球知識體系中的人文社科研究，以及在人文社科科研生產、分享中關於全球-地方關係的理論化，並提出挑戰全球人文社科研究不平等狀態和促進全球知識多樣性的潛在方法。它將為香港人文社科研究的發展貢獻重要的政策啟示，並且具有重大的國際意義，尤其對其他非歐美體系及其人文社科研究者而言。

17608624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17608624.value: 重新思考我们的方法：没有概念分析的分析哲学

17608624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17608624.value: The traditional conception of analytic philosophical methodology assigns a central role to intuitions about imaginary ‘thought experiment’ cases. These intuitions are held to provide evidence either for or against analyses of central philosophical concepts like ‘knowledge’ or ‘free will’. Starting around the beginning of the 21st century, a substantial metaphilosophical literature began to emerge which expressed profound doubts about intuition’s suitability for this role. In particular, an emerging subfield of ‘experimental philosophy’ began to gather data indicating that intuitions might be problematically sensitive to demographic variables such as cultural background, as well as to contextual variables such as the order in which cases are considered. A number of philosophers suggested that such findings showed intuition to be unreliable, and therefore unable to justify philosophical conclusions. As the metaphilosophical literature developed, increasingly sophisticated responses to this ‘intuition problem’ emerged – including the claim that the picture of philosophy as dependent on intuition was simply a misrepresentation. Concurrently, interest in more revisionary approaches to philosophical methodology began to gain ground. There is now a fertile literature advocating ‘conceptual engineering’ as an alternative to purely descriptive analysis. On the conceptual engineering approach, philosophers should aim to improve our concepts, rather than simply analyzing them. In fact, many would argue that conceptual engineering is already a common practice both within philosophy and without – examples familiar to non-specialists might include the expansion of ‘marriage’ to cover same-sex partnerships, and the redefinition of ‘planet’ to exclude Pluto. The link between the two topics just outlined has thus far received a surprisingly small amount of attention. The proposed project aims to fill this lacuna by providing an integrated picture of philosophical methodology combining the two strands. This picture will make use of philosophical and experimental critiques of intuition in order to motivate the reframing of our philosophical goals as projects in conceptual engineering. It will simultaneously use the conceptual engineering perspective to motivate a re-conception of the intuition problem itself, arguing that current approaches to it are hampered by over-reliance on concepts that are better suited to problems in epistemology, rather than metaphilosophy. I’ll argue that metaphilosophers should rethink their use of such core concepts as ‘reliability’, ‘justification’, ‘knowledge’, and even ‘truth’. 分析哲学方法论的传统概念赋予了关于想象中的"思想实验"案例的直觉以核心地位。这些直觉被认为为中心哲学概念如"知识"或"自由意志"的分析提供了支持或反对的证据。大约从21世纪初开始,一个substantial的元哲学文献开始出现,它对直觉在这个角色中的适当性表达了深刻的怀疑。特别是,一个新兴的"实验哲学"分支开始收集数据,表明直觉可能会对人口统计变量(如文化背景)以及情境变量(如考虑案例的顺序)产生problematic的敏感性。一些哲学家认为,这些发现表明直觉是不可靠的,因此无法证明哲学结论。 随着元哲学文献的发展,对这个"直觉问题"的increasingly sophisticated回应开始出现 - 包括认为哲学依赖于直觉的观点simply是一种误解。同时,对哲学方法论more revisionary的方法的兴趣开始gain ground。现在有一个fertile的文献在倡导"概念工程"作为纯粹描述性分析的替代方案。在概念工程的方法中,哲学家应该致力于改进我们的概念,而不是简单地分析它们。事实上,许多人会认为概念工程已经是哲学内外的普遍做法 - 非专业人士熟悉的例子可能包括将"婚姻"扩展到涵盖同性伴侣关系,以及重新定义"行星"以排除冥王星。 迄今为止,上述两个主题之间的联系得到的关注surprisingly small。proposed项目旨在通过提供一个结合这两个方面的integrated philosophical methodology picture来填补这个lacuna。这个picture将利用对直觉的哲学和实验批评,以motivate将我们的哲学目标重新定位为概念工程的项目。它将simultaneously使用概念工程的视角来motivate对直觉问题本身的re-conception,认为当前对它的approaches因过度依赖更适合认识论问题而非元哲学问题的概念而受到hampered。我将论证,元哲学家应该重新思考他们对"可靠性"、"justification"、"知识",甚至"真理"等核心概念的使用。

17608724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17608724.value: 走向前音接触类型学：斯瓦希里语的音调变体

17608724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17608724.value: This project aims to advance our understanding of how tone and stress evolve as languages interact with one another. The focus of the project is Swahili, a Bantu language spoken natively and as a lingua franca throughout East and Central Africa. Swahili has been described as a language that makes use of stress, not tone. By contrast, all other languages native to East and Central Africa employ lexical and grammatical tone. The project will therefore explore the hypothesis that the prosodic systems of some varieties of Swahili also make use of tone due to interaction with other African languages. In the course of research, the following main questions will be explored. Firstly, what is the nature of the tone systems that may have resulted from the interaction? Secondly, how does the data on Swahili fit into the broader picture of what we already know about the outcomes of contact between tone and stress elsewhere in Africa, in Asia, and in other parts of the world? In order to find answers to these questions, a corpus of different varieties of Swahili will be gathered in Nairobi (Kenya) and Lubumbashi (Democratic Republic of Congo) and analysed phonetically and statistically. The results of this study have the potential to change our understanding of how prosodic systems interact when they come into contact. The resulting theoretical framework could fill gaps in our knowledge of the linguistic features and the social factors that play a role in these interactions. This project is expected to result in the publication of three journal articles, participation in three conferences, the creation of a corpus of Swahili, and the integration of findings into teaching and learning at the researcher's home institution. 此项目旨在提高我们对于语言相互作用时音调和重音如何演变的理解。项目的重点是斯瓦希里语，这是一种在东非和中非广泛使用的班图语系原生语言和通用语言。斯瓦希里语被描述为一种依赖重音，而不是音调的语言。相比之下，东非和中非的所有其他原生语言都使用了词汇和语法音调。 因此，该项目将探索这样一个假设，即由于与其他非洲语言的交互，斯瓦希里语的某些方言也可能使用音调。在研究过程中，将探索以下主要问题。首先，从交互中可能产生的音调系统的性质是什么？其次，关于斯瓦希里语的数据如何适应我们已经了解到的关于非洲、亚洲和世界其他地方的音调和重音接触结果的更广泛的画面？为了找到这些问题的答案，将在内罗毕（肯尼亚）和卢巴夏希（刚果民主共和国）收集不同斯瓦希里语的语料库，并进行语音和统计分析。 这项研究的结果有可能改变我们对于当韵律系统接触时如何相互作用的理解。由此产生的理论框架可能填补我们对于在这些交互中发挥作用的语言特征和社会因素的知识的空白。

17609024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17609024.value: 價值、政策與基礎建設：香港的 Web3 願景與實驗性未來

17609024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17609024.value: This project will investigate how different socio-economic actors co-construct the sociotechnical imaginaries of Hong Kong as a global centre for Web3 through building on different values regarding the role of technology. Web3 (or Web 3.0) refers to a constellation of novel technologies – including blockchain, cryptocurrencies and non-fungible tokens – that are said to represent the ‘next stage’ in the evolution of the internet. Web3 markets have witnessed a dramatic boom-bust cycle, with many of the assets powered by Web3 technologies currently experiencing a prolonged period of depressed prices. Nevertheless, Web3 professionals (e.g. entrepreneurs, investors and promoters) remain tied to dreams of Web3 technologies becoming the backbone of a rapidly expanding, decentralised infrastructure that they believe is destined to reshape flows of capital and information in society, albeit with differing visions of what that future might look like. An international partnership of scholars combining expertise in media anthropology, economic anthropology and science and technology studies will use ethnographic methods to construct a comprehensive account of the cultural and economic exchanges occurring amongst professionals in Hong Kong’s Web3 community and uncover the multiple forms of value –monetary and non-monetary – that circulate alongside such exchanges. The objectives of the project are: (1) to conduct a comprehensive study using anthropological and sociological data to capture the multiple forms of value (e.g. economic, political, intellectual) circulating amongst professionals working in Hong Kong’s Web3 sector and open significant new ground in the anthropological theorisation of value; (2) to examine how Web3 professionals and broader publics (e.g. media and opinion leaders) respond to the Hong Kong government’s efforts to promote the city as a leading Web3 centre so as to pioneer an innovative social scientific grounded approach for examining the role of public policy in influencing values ascribed to hubs of technological innovation; (3) to examine the experimental futures of Hong Kong as a global financial centre, through unravelling the enabling potentials of Web3 as an infrastructural discourse in order to open new ground in science and technology studies. By bringing together scholars specialising in the socioeconomics of technology from a range of disciplinary backgrounds, the project will establish a cluster of expertise necessary for deepening social science knowledge of Web3 through the development of novel approaches, methodologies and theories tailored to the Asian region. 本項目將研究不同的社會經濟參與者如何基於對科技角色的不同價值觀念，共同構建香港作為全球 Web3 中心的科技想像。Web3（或 Web 3.0）包含一系列新興科技，當中包括區塊鏈、加密貨幣和非同質化代幣（NFT）。它被認為是互聯網進化的「下一階段」。Web3 市場經歷了顯著的繁榮及蕭條週期，目前，許多由 Web3 技術驅動的資產正經歷長期的價格低迷期。儘管如此，有著不同願景的 Web3 專業人士（如企業家、投資者和推廣者）依然堅定地相信 Web3 科技將成為迅速擴展至去中心化基礎建設的支柱，且這些技術注定會重塑社會中的資本和信息流動。一個結合了媒介人類學、經濟人類學和科學技術研究的國際學者團隊將使用民族誌方法，構建對於香港 Web3 社區專業人士之間的文化和經濟交流的全面研究，並從這些交流中分析不同形式的價值——包括貨幣和非貨幣價值。本項目的目標包括：(1) 使用人類學和社會學數據進行全面研究，捕捉在香港 Web3 領域工作的專業人士，在他們交流中揭示的多種形式的價值（如經濟、政治、知識價值），並透過人類學理論開闢對於價值觀念的新重要領域；(2) 研究 Web3 專業人士和更廣泛的公眾（如媒體和意見領袖）如何回應香港政府將香港推廣為領先 Web3 中心，以此開創一種創新的社會科學方法，考察公共政策在影響技術創新中心價值中所起的作用；(3) 通過解開 Web3 作為基礎建設的潛在能力，探討香港作為全球金融中心的實驗性未來，從而在科學技術研究領域開闢新天地。通過匯集來自不同學科背景、專注科技研究的社會經濟學家，本項目將建立專業技能團隊，以通過開發針對亞洲地區的創新方向、研究方法論和學術理論，更深化開闢 Web3 相關的社會科學知識。

17609624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17609624.value: 在香港第五波新冠肺炎（COVID-19）疫情期間的兩個公共屋邨案例的建築科學研究

17609624.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17609624.value: Dr Downie, Marc Dr Huang, Jianxiang Prof Webster, Chris Dr Zhou, Yulun

17609624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17609624.value: Within a span of four months during the peak of the 5th wave, Hong Kong recorded 3.1 million infections in a city of 7.4 million residents. To combat COVID-19 spread in communities, Hong Kong government implemented a comprehensive Restriction-Testing Declaration (RTD) to identify hidden cases within buildings that were deemed the most dangerous residential blocks of each day. During these months, 319 buildings were issued an RTD and the statistics indicated a significant disparity in COVID prevalence regarding architecture design types: 100%, 75% and 45.9% of the “Ziggurat,” “Single I,” and “Twin Towers” buildings were issued an RTD with an average infection rate of 14.45%, 20% and 11.87%, respectively. In contrast, only 7.90%, 16. 33% and 9.09% of “Flex 2,” “Trident 2,” and “Trident 4” buildings were issued an RTD with an average infection rate of 3.84%, 2.57% and 2.55%, respectively. This disparity of COVID prevalence across varying architecture design types has not been studied, but comprehending the role architecture design plays in commutable infectious diseases is critical. Considering aerosols transmission through airflow is understood to be one of the main sources of COVID-19 infection. We hypothesize that the disparity in COVID prevalence of buildings is associated with the variations of airflow paths, which might be fundamentally influenced by apartment floorplan, architectural layout design, estate master planning layout, and city breezeways. To test the hypothesis, we propose an Artificial Intelligence based Computational Fluid Dynamics framework (AI-CFD) with Shun Tin and Butterfly estates as the two case studies based on our prior CRF research. CFD and physics informed neural networks (PINN) will be employed to reconstruct the airflow distribution of the case study buildings prior-, present-, and post-RTD test. The airflow distribution will be combined with infection data into explainable machine learning to quantify the contribution of airflow patterns to COVID-19 and what apartment floorplan and architectural layout designs are associated with which airflow patterns. The same logic will be implemented for estate and city breezeways to investigate their respective impact. The case study draws on a 319-building cross-sectional study of architecture features and COVID-19 infection rates in buildings issued an RTD and a ~3,000-building COVID-19 architectural features study currently underway. It seeks to drill down to further explore results from these studies, using BIM-level aerosol simulation, experimental and qualitative interview data. 在第五波新冠疫情（COVID-19）高峰期的四個月內，香港這座擁有740萬居民的城市錄得了310萬人感染。為了阻止新冠病毒在社區中傳播，香港政府實施了全面的限制與檢測宣告（RTD），于「受限區域」實行強制檢測，以找出每天最高危的住宅內隱藏的病例。在該數月間，一共319棟住宅被列為「受限區域」，而統計數據顯示，新冠病毒傳播率因應建築設計類型存在着顯著差異：100%的「梯級型」、75%的「單座I型」和45.9%的「雙塔式」建築被列為「受限區域」，平均感染率分別為14.45%、20% 和 11.87%。相比之下，只有7.90%的「靈活性大廈2型」、16. 33%的「Y字2型」和9.09%的「Y字4型」建築被列為「受限區域」，平均感染率分別為3.84%、2.57% 和 2.55%。新冠肺炎傳播率在不同建築設計類型中的顯著差異尚未被研究，理解建築設計在疾病傳染中所扮演的角色至關重要。 考慮到氣溶膠被認為是新冠病毒傳播的主要途徑之一，我們假設建築物中新冠病毒感染率的差異與其氣流路徑有關，而這取決於不同因素，包括單位佈局、樓宇建築平面設計、屋邨總體規劃和城市通風走廊。為了驗證這個假設，我們利用之前的CRF研究項目提出的人工智慧計算流體力學框架（AI-CFD），來研究順天邨和蝴蝶邨兩個案例。我們將利用計算流體力學（CFD）和物理信息神經網絡(PINN），來重建建築物案例在強制檢測之前、之際和之後的氣流路徑。重建的氣流路徑將與感染數據配對並用於可解釋的機器學習中，來量化氣流模式對新冠病毒傳播的影響，以及找出哪些單位佈局、樓宇建築平面設計與哪些氣流模式相對應。相同的邏輯將用於屋邨總體規劃和城市通風走廊，以找出其各自的影響力。此案例研究借鑒了目前正在進行的兩項研究，包括319 棟「受限區域」建築的建築特徵與新冠病毒感染率的橫向研究，以及約3,000棟受新冠病毒感染建築的建築特徵與周邊環境關係的研究。綜合建築資訊模型（BIM）級氣溶膠模擬測試、以及實驗性和質性研究訪談資料，我們將深入探討這些研究的結果。

17609724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17609724.value: 以溝通啟動介入來改善晚期慢性腎病老年患者與臨床醫生的共同決策

17609724.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17609724.value: Prof Arnold, Robert M. Dr Chow, Kai Ming Dr Fong, Daniel Yee-Tak Dr Lam, Wendy Wing Tak Dr Schell, Jane Prof Yap, Yat Hin Desmond

17609724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17609724.value: With the global aging population, increasing numbers of older adults with advanced chronic kidney disease (CKD) are initiated on dialysis. For older adults with multiple comorbidities, dialysis may not confer significant survival benefit, but contributes to high treatment burden and adversely affects quality of life. Studies have reported that older adults with advanced CKD are dissatisfied with the treatment decision-making process and a substantial proportion regret their decision to start dialysis. Clinical guidelines recommend shared decision-making (SDM) around advanced kidney disease treatment choices. SDM is an interactive process whereby the patient, family members, and healthcare team deliberated treatment choices within the expressed values and preferences of the patient. The goal is to reach consensus about the preferred choice that aligns with the patient’s goals and values. The implementation of SDM with older adults with advanced CKD can be challenging due to healthcare-related and patient-related barriers. Little is known about effective strategies that promote integration of SDM for older adults in nephrology practices. Recent studies have suggested that communication-priming interventions can support seriously ill patients, family members and clinicians to engage in goals-of-care discussions and increased patient receipt of goal-concordant care. This intervention has potential to improve SDM in dialysis treatment decisions for older adults. The aim of this study is to test the effects of a communication-priming intervention tailored for older adults with advanced CKD in nephrology outpatient clinics. Using a multicenter cluster-randomized trial design, clinicians will be randomized to the communication-priming intervention or usual care, with 140 patients assigned in each arm. The primary outcome is observer-rated level of shared decision-making during a target consultation. Secondary outcomes include patient-reported shared decision-making, quality of communication, patient involvement in decision-making, decisional conflict, decision regret, timing of and adherence to treatment choice, and health-related quality of life. Consultation length will also be captured as a process measure. This study has the potential to identify an effective, feasible intervention to support SDM on treatment decisions for older adults with advanced CKD. The study findings will help to advance the theory and practice of SDM for older adults with multi-morbidity. 隨著全球人口老齡化，越來越多患有晚期慢性腎病（CKD）的年長患者開始進行透析治療。對於患有多種合併症的年老患者而言，透析治療可能並不能顯著提高生存率，反而增加了治療負擔，並對生活質量造成不利影響。研究顯示，不少患有CKD的長者對治療決策過程感到不滿意，相當數量的患者對當初開展透析治療的決定感到後悔。 臨床指南建議晚期腎病患者治療選擇方面進行共同決策（SDM）。SDM是一種互動式的過程， 患者、家屬和醫護團隊結合患者的價值觀和喜好共同商討治療選項，以達成與患者的目標和價值觀一致的首選方案共識。然而，在腎臟專科實踐中對年長腎病患者實施SDM，仍面臨不少挑戰。這些挑戰既可源於醫療體系，亦可源於患者本身。然而關於在腎病學實踐中促進老年人共同決策整合的有效策略，目前所知甚少。 近期的研究顯示，溝通啟動介入有助於重病患者、家屬及臨床醫生就患者的照護目標進行討論，並增加患者獲得與目標一致的護理的機會。這種介入措施有機會改善年長腎病患者在透析治療的共同決策中的共享性。本研究旨在測驗一種針對年長晚期慢性腎病門診患者而設計的溝通啟動介入的成效。 採用多中心集群隨機試驗設計將臨床醫生被隨機分配至溝通啟動介入組或常規護理組，每組各有140名患者參與。主要結果指標是觀察員評估的目標會診過程中的共同決策水平。次要結果包括患者報告的共同決策、溝通質量、患者在決策過程中的參與程度、決策衝突、決策後悔、治療選項的時間性和依從性，以及與健康相關的生活質量。會診時間長度也將被記錄作為過程指標。 這項研究有機會識別一種有效且可行的介入措施，以協助年長腎病患者在治療過程中的共同決策。此項研究結果將有助於推進針對患有多種合併症的長者共同決策的理論與實踐。

17610624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17610624.value: 將數值發展綜合理論擴展至包含負數

17610624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17610624.value: Adolescents’ mathematical competence plays an important role in their STEM career choices. Therefore, it is important to identify factors that predict achievement in mathematics. According to the integrated theory of numerical development (ITND; Siegler, 2016), the understanding of numerical magnitude plays a critical role in mathematics learning. However, our understanding of numerical magnitude is incomplete as negative numbers, which cover half of the mental number line on the left side of zero, have not received adequate attention from the literature. The proposed studies aim to address this issue. As negative numbers have two components - sign and digit - they may be processed either holistically (i.e., -9 is smaller than -1) or componentially (i.e., -9 is larger than -1 because only the absolute values are processed), and empirical studies are divergent in terms of how negative numbers are processed (Fischer & Shaki, 2017; Tzelgov et al., 2009; Zhang et al., 2019). Only the holistic processing view is consistent with the ITND. The proposed studies, therefore, aim to examine whether individuals who process negative numbers holistically demonstrate better understanding of other types of numbers, as well as mathematics achievement. Study 1 is a longitudinal study in which seventh graders’ negative number processing will be assessed to see if the type (holistic versus componential), precision, and application of negative number processing are related to the understanding of other types of numbers and their mathematics achievement. Study 2 is a randomized controlled trial with a gamified intervention that examines whether adolescents’ negative number processing can be altered through exposure to different scenarios (presenting positive and negative numbers separately versus together) and whether such a change would result in a change in mathematics achievement. The proposed studies are significant in several ways. First, they allow us to better understand the range of numbers being represented on our mental number line. If negative numbers are indeed parts of the mental number line and are important for mathematics learning, then it is essential to investigate how they can be processed more effectively, which is now under-investigated. Making use of the existing literature on negative number processing, Study 2 develops an intervention that may serve the purpose. If it is demonstrated to be effective, it will offer a cost-effective means to improve adolescents’ mathematical competence, which may ultimately increase STEM labor for society in the long run. 青少年的數學能力在他們會否選擇科學、技術、工程及數學(STEM)等相關職業的決擇中發揮著重要的作用。故此，找出與數學能力發展相關的因素非常重要。根據數值發展綜合理論（Integrated theory of numerical development/ITND；Siegler，2016），對數值的理解在數學學習的過程中有著關鍵的作用。然而，我們對數值處理的理解並不完整，因為現時的研究只涵蓋了正數。負數涵蓋了數線的一半，但在文獻中卻沒有得到足夠重視。因此，是項研究旨在增加我們對負數數值處理的理解。 由於負數有兩個組成部分 ( 即符號和數字 )，理解它們時，我們可以整體地處理（即 -9 小於 -1），亦可以按部分處理（即 -9 大於 -1，因為我們只處理正數部分）。在人類如何處理負數這個議題上，過往的研究存在分歧（Fischer & Shaki, 2017；Tzelgov et al, 2009；Zhang et al., 2019）。在兩種處理方法中，只有整體處理學說與ITND一致。因此，是項研究旨在驗證使用整體處理方法處理負數的人是否在整體數學解難上有更好的表現。研究 1 是一項縱向研究，將驗證中學一年級學生的負數處理是否與對其他類型數字的處理及其數學成績相關。研究2 是一項採用遊戲化介入的隨機對照實驗，研究通過不同形式地呈現負數（即將正數和負數分開或一起呈現）是否能改變青少年處理負數的方法，以及這種改變是否會令數學成績產生變化。 是次研究能使我們更清楚地理解人類如何處理各類型的數值。如果負數在我們的心理數線上佔一席位，而且與數學成績相關，那麼我們就有必要研究如何更有效地理解它們。這一點目前尚未得到充分研究。研究 2 利用有關負數處理的文獻，發展了一種可以達到此目的的訓練措施。如果它被證實是有效的，它將為提高青少年的數學能力提供一種具成本效益的方法。從長遠來看，本研究有望能增加社會的 STEM 勞動力。

17611924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17611924.value: 認知障礙症單獨外出決策的矛盾性研究：子女照顧者的社會心理生理模型

17611924.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17611924.value: Dr Hsiao, Janet Hui Wen Prof TANG, Yee Man Jennifer Prof Tsang, Hector Wing-hong Prof Yuen, Jacqueline Kwan Yuk

17611924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17611924.value: 個體能否單獨外出是個體獨立生活的重要關鍵，但是認知障礙症患者在病程進入中期後，單獨外出可能意味著各種風險，子女照顧者往往會對患者的室外活動範圍進行規範，我們的初步調查顯示，子女在做出類似決定的時候會感到矛盾重重，一方面目標患者需要有自主生活，過分限制會對或者的生活質量造成負面影響；另一方面，患者單獨外出發生意外的風險卻會讓子女感到很難承受，處於兩難的處境。 本研究建議用社會、心理、和生理的視角來探索子女照顧者的矛盾，首先我們會從德爾菲法入手，探索子女照顧者在照顧認知障礙症父母時的人本價值，然後由專家討論來形成典型的矛盾處境。然後從矛盾處境入手，對子女照顧者進行調查和實驗，探索矛盾處境下決定的情況及其影響因素。 本研究將在矛盾處境下的決定過程做出理論探索和研究檢驗，對未來的認知障礙症獨自外出決定將有重要意義。

17612824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17612824.value: 覺囊派之前：探索11至14世紀西藏「他空見」（Gzhan stong）的先驅

17612824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17612824.value: Buddhism first made its way into Tibet in the seventh century, but it was not until the late 10th century that new translations of canonical literature and the rise of lineages and new practices produced the distinct traditions of Tibetan Buddhism. This phase of diversification was catalyzed by the introduction of new translations of canonical texts, the emergence of innovative practices, and the evolution of novel lineages. Among these, the Jo nang school increasingly attracted the interest of scholars for their “empty-of-other” (gzhan stong) philosophy that accepts an ultimate that is empty of the relative truth of cyclic existence, but not its own buddha qualities. The Jo nang pas base their gzhan stong view on a cohesive interpretation of both sūtric and tantric literature. In terms of sūtric sources, the Jo nang position of ever-present buddha qualities finds support from the Maitreya Works. In terms of tantric sources, the Jo nang pas chiefly base their view on the Kālacakratantra with its concept of a primordial buddha (ādibuddha). The proposed project aims to comprehensively identify and map the precursors to the Jo nang interpretation of emptiness within a historical framework that spans from the initial phase of the second diffusion (phyi dar) of Buddhism in Tibet to the era of Dol po pa (1292-1361). The starting point of the research will be an annotated translation of Kun dga' dpal's "Explanation of the Ornament of Luminosity'" which is the locus classicus for the Jo nang interpretation of Kālacakra and the Maitreya Works, and a survey of Sa bzang Mati paṇ chen's commentary on the Yogācāra work Mahāyānasūtrālaṃkāra. This will establish the background against which a careful selection of textual passages from a huge collection of old manuscripts (the Bka' gdams gsung 'bum) that deal with buddha nature and Yogācāra thought will be evaluated. In addition, while the primary research focus will remain on the already extensive scope of sūtric literature from the Bka’ gdams gsung ‘bum, the research will also take into account relevant tantric sources. Notably, this includes the Kālacakra works of Yu mo Mi bskyod rdo rje (1038?-1117?), whom Tāranātha (1575-1634) considers the originator of gzhan stong. 佛教在7世紀首次傳入西藏，但在10世紀末期後弘期之前，新譯的佛典文獻的出現、傳承的興起以及新實踐的產生，都使藏傳佛教有著不同的傳統。這一多樣化的階段由於新譯佛典的引入、創新實踐的出現以及新傳承的演變而得以催化。其中，覺囊派 (Jo nang) 因其“他空” (gzhan stong) 哲學越來越受到學者們的關注。這一哲學堅持一種終極實相。它空於輪回存在的相對真理，但不空於其自身的佛性。覺囊派基於對佛典和密宗文獻的連貫解釋，提出了他們的他空觀點。 在佛典文獻方面，覺囊派關於永恆存在的佛性觀點在彌勒五論中得到了支持，特別是在《寶性論》 (Ratnagotravibhāga) 中關於佛性教義和《法界分別論》 (Dharmadharmatāvibhāga) 中基於非概念智慧的根本轉變的探討，使得這種智慧能夠如實地認識真理（Mathes 2023）。在密宗文獻方面，覺囊派主要基於《時輪經》 (Kālacakratantra) 的觀點，提出了本初佛 (ādibuddha) 的概念，同時對從空性中顯現出的所有至高品質也表達出了肯定闡述。 該擬議的項目旨在在特定的歷史背景下全面識別和地圖化覺囊派對他空解釋的前驅，時間範圍從佛教在西藏的後弘期的初期到笃補巴·喜饒堅贊（Dol po pa Shes rab rgyal mtshan，1292-1361）及其親密弟子那弘更噶拜（Nya dbon Kun dga' dpal，1285-1379）和薩桑瑪迪班針（Sa bzang mati paṇ chen，1294-1376）的時代。研究的起點將是對更噶拜的《光明裝飾之釋》 (Od gsal rgyan gyi rnam bshad) 的註釋翻譯。這本譯作是覺囊派對《時輪經》和彌勒菩薩的著作和對薩桑瑪迪班針對《大乘莊嚴經論》 (Mahāyānasūtrālaṃkāra) 的評論的探究。同時，這項研究將為評估《噶當文集》 (Bka' gdams gsung 'bum) 中大量舊手稿中有關佛性和瑜伽行派思想的文獻片段奠定背景基礎。 此外，儘管主要研究重點將繼續關注《噶當文集》中已經廣泛的經典文獻，研究還將考慮相關的密宗文獻。特別值得注意的是，這包括于摩米交多吉（Yu mo Mi bskyod rdo rje，1038?-1117?，Stearns 1999，Hatchell 2014 & Kemp 2021），多羅那他（Tāranātha，1575-1634）認為的覺囊派的創始人，的《時輪經》 (Kālacakra) 著作。

17613224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17613224.value: 網絡空間非法市場的社會秩序：中國的法外治理與線上賭博

17613224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17613224.value: How do illegal markets operate in cyberspace? This proposed research project will examine the organizational structure of China's illegal online gambling businesses and their use of extralegal governance institutions to marketize services, ensure fair play, enforce compliance, and reduce the risk of prosecution. The proposed research will also investigate the impact of China's intensified efforts to repress illegal markets on the daily operation of illegal transactions and the evolution of extralegal governance institutions. It will explore how operators in the illegal online market settle gambling debts using ex ante means, such as deposits, and ex post mechanisms, such as using interpersonal obligations or violence to enforce debt collection. This research will be based on field research, interviews with gambling agents, players, police officers, and academics who study gambling, as well as a review of official documents and news reports in Chinese and English. It will contribute to the literature on extralegal governance and illegal markets. 非法市場如何在網絡空間運營？本預計研究項目將探討中國非法線上賭博業務的組織結構以及其如何利用法外治理機構來做市場推廣，確保賭博遊戲的公平，強制遵守規則，以及降低被起訴的風險。該預計研究也將調查中國加大打擊非法市場力度對非法交易的日常運營以及法外治理機構的演變的影響。它將探討非法線上市場的經營者如何使用事前手段，如存款，以及事後機制，如利用人際關係網絡或暴力來強制債務收回。該研究將基於實地調研數據，與賭博代理人，玩家，警察和研究賭博的學者的訪談，以及對中英文官方文件和新聞報導的審查。這將為治外治理和非法市場的文獻做出貢獻。

17613524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17613524.value: Much research has debated whether immigrants’ health advantages over natives decline with their duration in the destination (i.e., unhealthy assimilation). Prior studies mostly are based on (pooled) cross-sectional data and use retrospective information on the number of years since immigration as a proxy for duration of residence, which could be confounded by the cohort-of-arrival effect and age-of-arrival effect. Some recent studies have used longitudinal data that follow immigrants’ health and mortality over time, but their results remain mixed. Such inconsistent results could be due to the differences in the outcome examined, length of observation period, or sampled population across studies. No studies so far have used longitudinal data to simultaneously examine how the native-immigrant gaps in various health-related outcomes evolve over time, not to mention explaining any differences in the trajectories. The key innovation of this proposed project is to use an unprecedented, longitudinal cohort study design to simultaneously examine how the native-immigrant gaps in various health-related outcomes evolve over real time. This project will use Waves 1-13 of the Health and Retirement Study (1992-2016) to simultaneously examine how the native-immigrant gaps in various health-related outcomes evolve over real time. Doing so can bypass the identification problem embedded in (pooled) cross-sectional analyses, eliminate the sources of discrepancies caused by differing data and research designs among existing longitudinal analyses, and uncover any conflicting patterns across the differing measures of health-related outcomes. We will study natives and immigrants with various ethnoracial identities (Whites, Blacks, Hispanics, and Asians). If our analysis shows that immigrants’ health advantage over natives narrows, while their mortality advantage widens, with their duration of stay, as suggested by previous longitudinal research, we will further use the selection model and the shared parameter model to assess the extent to which mortality selection mechanisms may explain the divergent patterns. Finally, we will comprehensively test how, aside from behavioral factors (obesity, smoking, physical activity), the socioeconomic (income, wealth), psychosocial (stress exposures), health access, and genetic mechanisms may explain changes in the nativity gaps in health and mortality over the 24 years of follow-up period. By focusing on testing this wide range of mechanisms, this project will provide an exceptionally complete picture of the forces behind alterations in immigrants’ relative health and mortality advantages over their lifetime. This project will significantly advance our knowledge about immigrant health and aging and settle the longstanding debate on immigrants’ unhealthy assimilation. N/A

17613724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17613724.value: 評估根本心理因素對患有慢性疾病的成人接種疫苗和經歷疫苗副作用的影響：一項縱貫研究和其中的巢式隨機對照研究

17613724.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17613724.value: Dr Blais, Joseph Edgar Prof COWLING, Benjamin John Prof Kwok, Wang Chun Dr Liao, Qiuyan

17613724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17613724.value: 慢性病患者感染新冠和流感病毒後有較高的風險發展成嚴重疾病，所以他們被推薦每年接種新冠和流感疫苗的加強劑。然而，在香港和很多亞洲地區，慢性病患者對新冠疫苗和流感疫苗的接受度仍然很低。研究表明，慢性病患者接種新冠或者流感疫苗後通常自述出現更多並且更強烈的疫苗副作用。這些自我評估的疫苗接種後的負面經歷可能是來源於他們對疫苗有更多的恐懼和對疫苗副作用的擔憂而不是因為疫苗本身的特征。這種現象亦稱為反安慰劑效果。反安慰劑效果可能會減少人們下一次接種疫苗的意願。現時的文獻通常聚焦於了解人們對疫苗安全的擔心，認為疫苗效果不理想和感染疾病的風險不高等等這些“表面態度”對疫苗接受度或接種經歷的影響。但是，這些“表面態度”的形成是由例如對權威和科學的信任，對打針的恐懼，和各種偽科學的信念（如自然就是最好，非主流醫學更安全）等一系列的根本心理因素所決定的。再者，一些跟患有慢性病有關的心理因素例如認為自己的身體比較脆弱或者對疫苗的反應比較敏感以及較高的心理壓力等等也會增加對疫苗安全性和副作用的擔憂，從而有可能放大反安慰劑效果。此項縱貫研究將評估這些根本心理因素對慢性病患者的疫苗接種決策和接種疫苗後的副作用和疫苗效果經歷的影響。參與者將來是自香港一所公立醫院的普通門診和專科門診患有慢性病，病情穩定可控並且合資格接種新冠和流感疫苗的病人。緊接著這項縱貫研究，我們會進行一項隨機對照研究以測試根據病人的心理因素而定制的對錯誤疫苗信息的反駁是否可以提高他們對疫苗的接受程度和減少所經歷的疫苗副作用。我們期望本研究可以測量因為根本心理因素所導致的反安慰劑效果並且設計相關的應對信息，以最終鼓勵病人常規接種相關的疫苗。

17614224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17614224.value: 聯通兩難：中國歷史上對外數字基礎設施

17614224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17614224.value: How has the Chinese government formulated policies toward digital infrastructure projects that increase outward connectivity? More generally, what factors affect states’ openness to, support for, and control over digital infrastructure projects? These questions loom large for governments and researchers given mounting China-U.S. tensions over critical digital technologies. However, while digital infrastructures such as telecommunications and payment systems support much of the modern global economy, international relations research has mostly ignored how states craft policies around these connective projects. This research will examine China’s past and present policies toward digital infrastructure projects. It argues that China’s rulers have consistently faced a “connectivity dilemma:” digital infrastructures generate a complex set of domestic and international political benefits and risks that breeds uncertainty about their net political effects. How states resolve this dilemma depends heavily on elites’ assessments of the political risks and rewards of connective projects. States’ digital infrastructure policies are often sticky but can shift in response to shocks such as institutional reforms that inject new actors into policy debates. I argue that China’s policies toward digital infrastructures have historically varied in their 1) embrace and support; 2) mode of control; and 3) foreign policy functions. After developing a typology for categorizing digital policies and projects, I will use a mixed methods approach to gather and analyze data on infrastructure attitudes, policies, and projects since the late-19th century. Data collection will yield multiple outputs including historical cases based on archival work and a first-of-its-kind dataset on contemporary Chinese global digital infrastructures. This empirical evidence will support quantitative and qualitative analysis across multiple infrastructure contexts. By examining diverse historical periods and infrastructures, this unique study will contextualize contemporary China’s massive, controversial digital infrastructure initiatives at home and abroad. It will demonstrate that the basic political trade-offs introduced by these projects have resurfaced throughout Chinese history, from telegraphs in the late 19th century to 21st-century transborder payment systems. This research significantly extends the PI’s research agenda on Chinese global infrastructure by focusing on digital infrastructures. It will produce three peer-reviewed journal articles in leading international relations journals. Findings will be presented at major political science and international relations conferences. I have a track record of producing rigorous, policy-relevant research (4*) on Chinese historical and contemporary foreign economic policies and am confident that I will complete the research as scheduled. 中國政府如何制定對於具有對外屬性的數字基礎設施項目的政策？什麼因素影響國家對數字基礎設施政策的開放性、支持程度和控制程度？隨著中美關係在關鍵數字技術上的緊張局勢不斷升級，這些問題對政府和研究人員來說尤其重要。然而，雖然電信和支付系統等數字基礎設施在支撐現代全球經濟交往上發揮重要作用，但國際關係研究大多忽略了國家如何制定這些連接性項目的政策。 本研究將探討中國對數字基礎設施項目的過去和現在政策。研究認為，中國政府一直面臨著“聯通兩難”：數字基礎設施產生了一系列複雜的國內和國際政治利益和風險，這種不確定性導致人們對它們的政治利弊產生疑問。國家如何解決這個困境，很大程度上取決於政府高層對這些具有對外屬性的數字基礎設施項目的政治風險和回報的主觀評估。 中國歷史上數字基礎設施政策有三個重要變量：1）政府接納和支持程度；2）控制模式；3）外交政策功能。在建立一個分類數字基礎設施政策的分類系統之後，本研究將使用混合研究方法進行數據收集和分析，研究自19世紀末以來的政府高層對基礎設施的態度、政策和項目投入。數據收集將產生多種研究成果，包括基於歷史檔案研究的歷史案例分析和關於當代中國全球數字基礎設施的數據庫。這些實證證據將支持定量和定性分析。 透過研究不同歷史時期和基礎設施案例，這項獨特的研究將為當代中國在國內外推動的重大數字基礎設施項目和政策提供新的背景和證據。它將專注這些項目的政治邏輯。

17614424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17614424.value: 阐明焦虑中威胁预期如何导致威胁检测偏差：研究认知和神经机制

17614424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17614424.value: 焦虑是一种普遍存在的心理障碍，对患者和社会都造成了重大的成本。焦虑的认知模型强调了对威胁的注意和感知偏差A / PTB在焦虑障碍的发展和维持中起着关键作用。然而，这些偏差背后的机制仍不清楚，阻碍了改善临床焦虑模型的进展。焦虑的特点是预期性，威胁预期可能导致对威胁的超敏感性。尽管如此，焦虑的神经生物学主要是通过研究自下而上的过程来研究的，即焦虑者更容易被外部和当前威胁性刺激所吸引。 “低道路”假说认为，通过快速传递低（LSF）但不是高（HSF）空间频率信号到杏仁体，威胁信号到达杏仁体，导致其迅速被检测到，这在这一领域的研究中具有影响力。仅最近，研究人员才开始关注自上而下的因素，例如威胁引导的注意力（威胁作为注意力的目标）和期望（威胁预计可能存在）在A / PTB和因此在焦虑中的作用。在基础科学的进展基础上，拟议的研究旨在计算和神经地调查如何通过威胁预期（即自上而下的威胁注意和威胁期望）调节LSF和HSF信号中的威胁相关信息的处理，从而导致在焦虑中具有偏差的威胁检测。此外，该研究旨在了解焦虑的两个主要症状维度，即焦虑激发（AR）捕捉生理反应和焦虑担忧（AP）捕捉持续担忧，如何影响自下而上和自上而下的过程，可能通过不同的认知和神经途径有助于A / PTB。该研究将使用新开发的任务，结合计算建模和功能性磁共振成像（fMRI），研究不同焦虑水平的人类的心理和神经过程。这项研究的发现将阐明A / PTB的具体心理和神经机制。这些知识对于未来有关焦虑症病因的研究，了解认知偏差重点心理治疗的机制以及开发新

17614624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17614624.value: 开发最先进的词汇资源和词汇教学大纲框架，以支持小学各年级的英语语言学习和教学

17614624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17614624.value: Vocabulary is an important predictor of reading success. In Hong Kong, there has been increasing expenditure on English language education in primary school, however 20-30% of students are still not meeting basic English proficiency benchmarks. This project develops a crucial resource to support the English Language curriculum in Hong Kong, address pressing proficiency issues, and create international impact. The project delivers an information-rich lexical database that functions as a vocabulary syllabus for primary school. It provides teachers and the Education Bureau with a comprehensive update to their current resource: “Wordlists for the English Language Curriculum” (published 2009). Research has advanced significantly making it urgent to update the vocabulary guidance. This project will be the most methodologically innovative vocabulary resource yet developed. It applies data mining to derive wordlists from new corpora and digital repositories of Hong Kong English, learner Englishes, and grade-level textbooks. Words will be grouped into ‘nuclear word families’ (morphologically related) and ‘semantic clusters’ (a thematic organisation of words into topics/meaning-based groups. To recommend learning progressions, we will rank words by mean text frequency weighted by dispersion to indicate which words are commonly encountered by learners. The resource will be based on new BNC-COCA word family lists (generated within this project), making the database of use internationally, with vocabulary information enriched by corpora of Hong Kong and Asian Englishes to give the resource specific educational value to the local context. Advanced keyness-dispersion measures will be used to associate words with reading needs across subjects, grades, and types of English (e.g., spoken-written). International data will be collected from Australia to compare with an English-dominant school system. This will produce both a clear comparison of similarities/differences between Hong Kong English patterns and the English-dominant system, whilst simultaneously making the resource of use to Australian education. To support teaching in-context, an app will be developed to support use of the resource and have impact beyond the project. This app allows a teacher (or learner) to take a picture of a page of a book (or worksheet) on their phone and perform optical character recognition/OCR and highlight words from the database that may be worth teaching in context, and also allows quick measures of whether the material would be aligned with estimated vocabulary proficiency.

17614824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17614824.value: 人力资本跨发展水平的迁移流量的变化

17614824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17614824.value: Age, sex, and education are the three largest sources of observable heterogeneity in the components of population change. In the study of migration, regularities in age profiles and the changing patterns in sex composition have been extensively explored in recent decades. Conversely, variations in migration flows by educational attainment are less well studied, principally driven by the lack of published migration statistics on education-specific migration data. Nevertheless, the topic of human capital losses and gains via migration has been discussed at length in the migration literature, especially the impacts of skilled migration on the development levels of sending and receiving countries. Migrant educational attainment has become an essential component of migration policies of many governments as they adopt points-based immigration systems. In this project, we aim to explore migration patterns by educational attainment in multiple contexts and across many countries. In particular, we wish to investigate how the educational composition of migration flows varies by the level of development in sending and receiving countries and their sub-regions. We will carry out multiple analyses based on data from the IPUMS International repository, where harmonised responses on migration histories and educational attainment are both available from over 400 million individual records spread across a wide variety of countries. This immense resource, which has largely been untouched by migration researchers, can potentially provide a robust indication of how education profiles of both international and internal migration flows evolve at the different stages of development. Gaining a better understanding of the role of human capital in migration is becoming of greater importance as migration becomes the predominant driver of population change in many countries and regions across the world, as fertility and mortality decline and reach relatively lower levels. The research findings can also help address important priorities related to data on migration in the United Nations Global Compact of Migration. 年龄，性别和教育是人口变化组成部分中可观察到的异质性的三个最大来源。在迁移的研究中，近几十年来广泛探讨了年龄概况的规律性和性别组成模式的变化。相反，通过教育程度进行的迁移流量变化的研究较少，主要是由于缺乏针对特定教育的迁移数据的公开移民统计数据所驱动。然而，在迁移文献中，已经讨论了通过移民而获得的人力资本损失和收益的话题，尤其是熟练移民对发送和接收国家的发展水平的影响。随着国家继续采用基于点的移民系统，教育成就也已成为移民政策的重要组成部分。在这个项目中，我们旨在探索在多种环境和许多国家 /地区通过教育成就的移民模式。特别是，我们希望调查迁移流的教育组成如何因发送和接收国家及其子区域的发展水平而变化。我们将根据IPUMS国际存储库的数据进行多次分析，在该数据中，对迁移历史和教育程度的统一回应都可以从超过4亿个个人记录中获得，这些唱片分布在各种各样的国家中。这种巨大的资源在很大程度上受到移民研究人员的影响，它可以有可能提供强烈的迹象表明，国际和内部移民的教育概况如何在发展的不同阶段发展。随着移民成为人口变化的主要驱动因素，随着生育能力和死亡率的下降并达到相对较低的水平，人们对人力资本在移民中的作用的了解变得更加重要。研究结果还可以帮助解决与联合国可持续发展目标（SDG）和全球移民（GCM）中移民人口目标相关的重要优先事项。

17615424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17615424.value: 港英時期法院與政治干預的法律史研究

17615424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17615424.value: 司法獨立長期以來一直是普通法法律教育的基石。傳統的敘述是，獨立的司法作爲法治的必要元素，是英國殖民統治香港155年最重要的遺產。這一遺產經常被用來區別香港與中國大陸的法律和社會發展。本研究提出的觀點是，這樣的敘述在歷史檔案研究中站不住腳。 本研究計劃利用以前未被探索的歷史檔案，進行爲期三年的法律史研究，挑戰廣泛接受的司法獨立是英國法治遺產的敘述。通過展示殖民地法院和法官在殖民時期大受到的政治干預和系統控制，並在英國殖民統治的很晚的階段逐漸“解放”於這種干預和控制，本研究爲理解香港如何成爲法治城市打開了創新的視野。

17615924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17615924.value: 專利制度管理中的人工智慧

17615924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17615924.value: The patent system is economically integral (Dam, 1994; Khan, 2005; Kitch, 1977). Yet, despite its importance, it faces myriad challenges and is described by some innovation scholars as “broken” (Jaffe & Lerner, 2011) or “failing” (M. D. Frakes & Wasserman, 2019). Many of these challenges arise because of the sheer amount of information that must be analyzed to examine patent applications, and the difficulty that applicants and patent examiners have in dealing with this vast and expanding information universe as they determine whether a claimed invention is patentable. Artificial intelligence (AI) excels at dealing with large sets of data and offers the prospect for efficiency gains in the patent system if implemented appropriately. This project addresses two linked sets of questions: how might this implementation take place and what are the potential benefits and risks that automated administration of the patent system might bring? In this project’s first stage I will engage with two topics: why policymakers should consider adopting increased use of AI to administer the patent system, and how best to implement it to further the system’s goals. This stage of the project will detail and summarizes the challenges facing the patent system and explore how machine learning and AI might help address those challenges. It will then take a theoretically, and empirically driven perspective on how to go about engineering technologies to improve the patent system’s efficiency. In the second stage I will empirically demonstrate the capacity of AI to make labour intensive patent examination tasks more efficient. This will entail producing demonstration models allowing users to explore how different methods of automating patentability classifiers affect the classification results. Comparing different approaches, such as a naïve metadata correlational approach, with more sophisticated text-based approaches, will help reveal the tradeoffs inherent in engineering legal decision-making aides. In the final stage, I will build on the first two by critically examining the effects of automated decision-making aides on the innovation system. The adoption of technologically-aided decision-making technologies is not a new phenomenon, but recent improvements in the abilities of machine learning techniques have enabled technologies that could fundamentally change many elements of legal and administrative decision-making. This final stage will explore these possible futures and discuss what we can learn from the patent system’s adoption of artificial intelligence technologies to aide in patent examination. 專利制度在經濟上是不可或缺的（Dam，1994；Khan，2005；Kitch，1977）。然而，儘管它很重要，但它面臨著無數的挑戰，一些創新學者將其描述為「破碎的」（Jaffe & Lerner，2011）或「失敗的」（M. D. Frakes & Wasserman，2019）。其中許多挑戰的出現是因為審查專利申請時必須分析大量信息，以及申請人和專利審查員在確定所要求保護的發明是否具有專利性時在處理這一龐大且不斷擴大的信息世界時遇到的困難。人工智慧 (AI) 擅長處理大量數據，如果實施得當，有望提高專利制度的效率。該計畫解決了兩組相互關聯的問題：如何實施以及專利制度的自動化管理可能帶來哪些潛在的好處和風險？ 在這個計畫的第一階段，我將討論兩個主題：為什麼政策制定者應該考慮更多地使用人工智慧來管理專利制度，以及如何最好地實施它以進一步實現該制度的目標。本計畫的這一階段將詳細介紹和總結專利制度面臨的挑戰，並探討機器學習和人工智慧如何幫助應對這些挑戰。然後，它將從理論和經驗驅動的角度來探討如何利用工程技術來提高專利制度的效率。 在第二階段，我將實證證明人工智慧讓勞力密集專利審查任務更有效率的能力。這將需要產生演示模型，使用戶能夠探索自動化專利性分類器的不同方法如何影響分類結果。將不同的方法（例如簡單的元資料相關方法）與更複雜的基於文字的方法進行比較，將有助於揭示工程法律決策助理固有的權衡。 在最後階段，我將在前兩個階段的基礎上，批判性地研究自動化決策助理對創新系統的影響。採用技術輔助決策技術並不是一個新現象，但最近機器學習技術能力的提高使得技術能夠從根本上改變法律和行政決策的許多要素。最後階段將探索這些可能的未來，並討論我們可以從專利制度採用人工智慧技術來輔助專利審查中學到什麼。

17616324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17616324.value: 生成模型的法律與倫理基礎：合作、透明度與隱私

17616324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17616324.value: 本研究項目致力於探究法律/倫理與人工智能及機器學習（AI/ML）最新進展之間的雙向互動：（1）生成性和基礎性AI/ML模型（以下簡稱生成模型）將如何影響及重塑社會與政治決策的版圖？（2）我們的規範和法律應如何調整以適應這些技術的發展，這些技術特點包括（i）基於海量數據訓練，（ii）理解難度大，以及（iii）快速演變？ 具體而言，我特別關注與生成模型相關的三個核心議題：（A）我們應以怎樣的態度對待人與人工智能之間的合作關係？（B）我們如何讓生成模型更加智能化/透明化？（C）我們能否為基於海量數據訓練的生成模型建立起一層隱私保障？ 大約自五年前開始，AI/ML的倫理與法律問題作為一個跨學科研究領域開始流行起來。起初，研究者們關注的是AI/ML系統對群體結果的規範性影響，例如自動化招聘決策是否存在性別偏見等問題。然而，新模型的發展日新月異，諸如GPT-3、Dall-E、BLOOM和Ernie等大型語言及其他基礎模型的出現，迫使學界必須重新思考一套有效的法律和倫理框架，以有效管理AI/ML。例如，許多學者曾主張系統應具備透明度。在以往這是可行的，因為許多深度學習任務可以通過線性回歸模型同樣有效地完成。但在如今的模型中，這很難實現。例如，我們無法簡單地用一個簡單的線性模型來替代GPT-3。那麼，我們應如何重新理解透明化的概念？ 同樣，針對具體且已知的數據集，在過去能夠建立並實現不同程度的隱私保護。但如今，基礎模型往往是在公共互聯網上進行訓練的。因此，各種形式的隱私保護已不再可能實現。那麼，我們應如何處理AI/ML所涉及的隱私問題？ 最後，在以往的人機合作研究中，往往以人類為主導，而AI/ML系統更為被動。而目前，所需要面對的是一種全新的合作模式，其中AI/ML系統可能佔據主導地位，例如Chat-GPT為了說服人類服務工作者解決驗證碼任務而“撒謊”的著名案例。那麼，我們又應該如何看待、研究這種合作關係？ 簡而言之，我希望構建一套基礎性的規範框架，用以思考生成性AI/ML的治理與監管，其中，主要關注透明度、隱私及合作這三個向度。

17616524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17616524.value: 邁向共治？中國城市鄰里治理的新興形式

17616524.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17616524.value: Dr Cai, Rong Dr Lu, Tingting Prof Wu, Fulong

17616524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17616524.value: Portraited as the ‘last mile’ and ‘basic unit’ of social governance in Chinese official discourse, the neighbourhood has recently gained unprecedented importance in urban China. Traditional neighbourhood governance predominantly led by state actors and the semi-private governance in gated communities are being widely replaced by the emerging ‘neighbourhood co-governance (社区共治)’ in both discourse and practice. Characterised by active neighbourhood participation and multi-actor collaboration, new forms of neighbourhood co-governance become widespread. A nationwide campaign of neighbourhood co-governance is in full swing, with the aim of rolling out the co-governance scheme in all urban neighbourhoods in the near future. Three major forms of neighbourhood co-governance have emerged in the past decade: state-led co-creation, professional/elite-led place-making, and enterprise-party co-development. What are the distinctive features and underlying mechanisms of these new forms of neighbourhood governance? Do they represent a paradigm shift towards more participatory and inclusive neighbourhood governance? Can they achieve the alleged goals of neighbourhood satisfaction, cohesion, and participation? What are their theoretical and policy implications for neighbourhood governance? To address these timely yet largely unexplored questions, this project will employ the theoretical lens used in examining state-market-society relations in China, including the state project of crisis management (He et al., 2020), state infrastructural power (Cai and He, 2022a), and state entrepreneurialism (Wu, 2018a), to scrutinize the emerging forms of neighbourhood governance. Specifically, we will 1) provide an updated and comprehensive understanding of major forms of neighbourhood co-governance in Chinese cities; 2) conduct a detailed examination of the diverse outcomes of neighbourhood co-governance; 3) theorise these emergent forms of neighbourhood co-governance by interrogating the various roles, interactions and power relations among state-market-society actors; 4) organise policy forums to inform more inclusive and cohesive neighbourhood governance. Leveraging the research team's extensive experience in neighbourhood governance in Chinese cities, this project will conduct multi-sited case studies of different modes of neighbourhood co-governance in Guangzhou and Shanghai. Data collection methods will include semi-structured interviews and focus groups with major stakeholders, non-participant observations, web-scraping online documents, and large-scale questionnaire survey in the two cities. We will employ a mixed-method approach incorporating qualitative case studies, critical discourse analysis and content analysis, Natural Language Processing, hierarchical linear modelling, structural equation modelling, and other statistical methods. This project will advance our theoretical and empirical understanding of neighbourhood governance and inform policymaking in Chinese cities and beyond. 鄰里治理在中國官方話語中被描繪為社會治理的“最後一公里”和“基本單位”，近年來獲得了前所未有的重視。新型鄰里治理形式以積極的社區參與和多方協作為特點，得以廣泛傳播。傳統的鄰里治理主要由政府主導，當前通過與封閉社區的半私人治理相結合，已在話語和實踐中向“社區共治”過渡。在過去的十年里，社區共治出現了三種主要形式：政府主導的共創、專業精英主導的地方營造、黨企共建。如何解釋這些新型鄰里治理形式的出現？它們是否代表著向更具參與性和包容性的鄰里治理的範式轉變？它們能否實現提升鄰里滿意度、凝聚力和參與度等目標？對於鄰里治理，它們在理論和政策上有哪些啟示？ 為了解決這些尚未被充分探討的問題，本項目將結合多種關於國家-市場-社會關係的理論，包括危機管理國家工程、國家基礎設施權力、國家企業家主義，來研究新興的鄰里治理形式及其啟示。具體而言，我們將1）通過利用AI輔助的數據分析和定性案例研究，提供關於中國城市鄰里共治主要形式的最新和全面的理解；2）基於問卷調查和案例研究，對鄰里共治的多樣化結果進行詳細探討；3）通過探究國家-市場-社會各方在共治過程中的角色、互動和權力關係，對這些新興的鄰里共治形式進行理論化；4）為更具凝聚力和包容性的鄰里治理政策制定提供參考。 基於研究團隊在中國城市鄰里治理方面的豐富經驗，本研究將對不同模式的鄰里共治進行多點案例研究，包括廣州和上海的政府主導共創、精英主導地方營造、黨企共建。數據收集方法將包括網絡抓取、與主要利益相關者進行半結構化訪談和焦點小組、非參與者觀察、在兩個城市進行大規模問卷調查。本研究將結合自然語言處理、批判性話語分析、多層次模型、結構方程模型及其他統計方法，對中國城市及其他地區的鄰里治理研究作出理論和實證方面的貢獻。

17616824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17616824.value: 兴起与局限：司法改革时期的行政诉讼研究 《中国司法的兴起与局限：改革时期的行政诉讼研究》 《中国司法的兴起与局限：改革时期的行政诉讼研究》 《中国司法的兴起与局限：改革时期的行政诉讼研究》 中国司法《中国司法的兴起与局限：改革时期的行政诉讼研究》 中国司法的兴起与局限：司法改革时期的行政诉讼研究

17616824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17616824.value: This study aims to analyze the performance of the Chinese judiciary in administrative ligation during the recent reform period, using a dataset of over 1.6 million judicial documents. The conventional understanding of the politics in China in the recent decade is its “turn against law.” In a preliminary study conducted by the PI, however, I find evidence that the judiciary in China has become increasingly significant in checking the power of the government. Courts accepted 79% more cases from 2014 to 2021, and plaintiffs’ win rate against the government has risen from 33.2% to 42.2%. This increase is even more pronounced in cases with strong impact on local government, such as those reviewing land expropriations and police penalties. Judicial authority has significantly improved, with chief government officials personally attending more than 50% of trials. In this proposed research, I plan to study the causes of the rise of the Chinese judiciary. More specifically, I will study two policy reforms that may have contributed to the rise of judicial power, one regarding court funding, and the other on court’s jurisdiction arrangement. Exploiting a staggered roll-out reform that removed local governments’ fiscal control over local courts, I plan to study whether the independence of court finance improves courts’ ability to hold local governments accountable. Another reform changed jurisdiction rule in administrative litigation from intra-regional to trans-regional. I plan to study whether the trans-regional jurisdiction design increases plaintiffs’ win rate. The proposed study will also explore the limitation of the judiciary. In previous interviews with judges, I found that Chinese courts still carefully distance themselves from reviewing the behavior of any Party organ and remain silent on citizens’ political rights. Judges are reluctant to conduct substantive reviews of government actions beyond procedure matters. In this proposed research, I will substantiate and test these hypotheses using more solid and comprehensive empirical evidence, i.e., data of millions of judicial documents. In total, this proposed research plans to present a tripartite theory for understanding the rule of law in China, where the law and the judiciary are instrumental in routine and even hard cases, but their power rapidly wanes in the face of politics. 本研究旨在分析我国2014年至2020年司法改革中的行政诉讼。在初步研究中，我们使用了超过160万份司法文书数据，发现：法院在监督政府行政权力方面变得愈发重要。自2014年至2021年，法院受理的行政案件数量增加了79%，原告对政府的胜诉率从33.2%上升至42.2%。在对地方政府有重大影响的案件中，如涉及土地征收、公安机关行政处罚的案件，原告胜率的上升更为明显。司法权威也有着显著提升，行政机关负责人出席了超过50%的庭审。 在本研究中，我将探索和分析我国行政诉讼中，法院能力提升的原因。具体而言，我将研究两项政策改革，一项是法院的人财物统管，另一项是行政诉讼的集中管辖。利用人财物统管在各地不同时间点推出的特点，我将研究法院财政相对独立是否提高了法院监督地方政府的能力。同时，我也将研究行政诉讼集中管辖是否提高了原告的胜诉率。 本研究还将探讨法院能力的局限。在此前的访谈中，我发现法官较为倾向于对行政行为进行程序审查，而非实质审查。在本研究中，我将使用更为扎实的访谈资料和更为全面的数据（数百万份裁判文书数据），检验一系列相关理论假设。 根据研究的发现，我还将提出理解中国法治的相关理论。

17617024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17617024.value: 多模式衛星影像融合用於連續時間序列的雨天和多雲條件下地球觀測

17617024.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17617024.value: Prof Liao, Mingsheng Prof Pun, Man-On

17617024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17617024.value: Optical satellite remote sensing, despite its advancements, faces significant obstacles due to missing data from cloud contamination. This impedes consistent satellite observations, undermining subsequent analyses such as change detection, object tracking, and trend prediction, especially in regions with frequent cloud cover like the Greater Bay Area or during extreme weather events and disasters. This project proposes to address this fundamental challenge through multimodal satellite image fusion, integrating multi-satellite optical and Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery. Traditional cloud removal methods, relying on static land cover, are inadequate in changing, heavily clouded areas. Despite utilizing SAR sensors’ cloud penetration, current multimodal fusion has not fully exploited spatiotemporal correspondences across space, time, and spectrum for data reconstruction. Building upon our previous work on cloud removal using multi-temporal and multi-source optical satellite imagery and using both optical and SAR imagery through dictionary learning, we propose a unified deep learning framework that leverages the Transformer model for sequence data processing to capture spatial-temporal-spectral intricacies in multimodal satellite imagery. The model aims to establish more precise correspondences between available optical and SAR observations, enabling the reconstruction of seamless, daily updated, Landsat-like multispectral optical imagery even in adverse weather conditions. Self-supervised learning techniques will be developed for model training, eliminating the need for manual annotations, and thus paving the way for large-scale training and applications. The method's accuracy will be assessed through a rigorous comparison between satellite observations and reconstructed data. To augment the reach and impact of this research, we also plan to develop a user-friendly, desktop-level application for multimodal satellite data downloading and reconstruction. The successful implementation of this project will significantly advance remote sensing applications, with substantial implications for climate studies, environmental monitoring, disaster management, and other fields requiring dense time-series satellite observations. 儘管光學衛星遙感技術已取得顯著進步，雲層污染導致的資料缺失依然是一個重大挑戰，這嚴重阻礙了衛星觀測的可獲得性，特別是在雲層頻繁覆蓋的區域（如大灣區）以及遭遇極端天氣事件和災害時。這些問題對變化檢測、目標跟蹤和趨勢預測等關鍵後續分析造成了負面影響。為應對這一核心難題，本項目創新性地提出利用多模式衛星圖像融合技術來整合多顆光學衛星與合成孔徑雷達（SAR）的資料。傳統雲移除方法在處理動態變化且雲層厚重區域時效果有限，而現有融合技術未能充分利用衛星圖像在空間、時間和光譜維度上的對應關係以有效重建資料。 基於前期在多時相及多源光學衛星圖像雲移除上的研究，本項目將開發一個新方法，該方法結合了光學與SAR影像，並通過深度學習框架，特別是利用Transformer模型處理時間序列資料，來捕捉並利用多模式資料中的時空及光譜細節。此項目将建立一個精確的光學與SAR資料對應模型，以實現即使在惡劣天氣下也能進行每日無縫更新，類似於Landsat的多光譜光學圖像重建。此外，通過自監督學習技術減少對人工標注的依賴，這將為模型的大規模訓練和應用掃清障礙。該方法的有效性將通過與原始衛星資料的詳細對比來驗證。 為了擴大研究成果的應用範圍，本項目計畫開發一個使用者介面友好的桌面應用程式，簡化多模式衛星資料的獲取與重建過程。此項目的成功實施將極大地推進遙感技術的應用，對氣候研究、環境監測、災害管理以及依賴高頻率衛星資料的眾多領域產生深遠影響。

17618124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17618124.value: 中文讀寫困難不同亞型如何從手寫訓練中受益？揭示神經相關性和認知行為標記

17618124.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17618124.value: Prof Siok, Wai Ting Dr YEUNG, Kin Chung Michael Dr Yeung, Pui Sze

17618124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17618124.value: 相對於字母語言，中文讀寫困難與更為複雜的能力缺陷有關，例如視覺空間技能。這是因為中文屬於象形文字書寫系統，日常生活閱讀通常需要記住至少3,000個基本生字。以中文為母語的學生通過大量的抄寫練習來學習識別中文字。因此，手寫技能可預測閱讀能力，並加強字形結構意識和生字記憶。然而，針對手寫技能和讀寫困難之間的訓練研究相對較少。本研究旨在探討針對讀寫困難兒童的手寫訓練的有效性和認知變化，並確定從此類訓練中受益最多的中文讀寫困難亞型。假設增強的書寫技能將通過增加對字形結構的敏感性來鞏固生字記憶，對具有字形結構意識缺陷的讀寫困難兒童最有益。 方法： 研究1將探究在患有中文讀寫困難的初小學生中，手寫技能對中文閱讀的獨特預測性。參與的兒童將接受一系列有關中文讀寫能力、相關認知及手寫能力的評估。為了更清楚地了解字形結構意識在手寫技能中的作用，兒童將被分為兩種認知亞型：字形結構意識缺陷（字缺型）和字形結構意識完好（字完型）。研究將比較字缺型和字完型兒童之間的手寫技能差異。 研究2是一項隨機、雙盲、對照、平行設計的研究，旨在比較訓練組和對照組在中文讀寫能力和字形結構意識方面的變化。研究將比較有和無字形結構意識缺陷的兒童在不同培訓條件下的中文讀寫表現的改善情況。 研究3將探究手寫困難與閱讀表現的神經相關性。本研究將使用腦電圖（EEG）來衡量字缺型和字完型中文讀寫困難亞型之間的差異。 預期結果： 預計該訓練將顯著提高讀寫困難兒童的中文讀寫能力，尤其是那些具有字形結構意識缺陷的兒童。腦電圖結果可能有助於了解手寫訓練如何影響腦神經發展，從而更好地了解如何改善與中文讀寫相關的認知能力。本研究將為讀寫困難兒童提供更有針對性和有效的訓練方法，並推進對中文讀寫困難神經基礎的了解。

17618424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17618424.value: 提升中國廣東省“雙一流”高校博士生成功發表國際論文的能力

17618424.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17618424.value: Prof Chu, Samuel Kai Wah Prof JIN, Tan Dr Wang, Simon Ho

17618424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17618424.value: In the Guangdong–Hong Kong–Macao Greater Bay Area (GBA), which has become a strategic zone of development for China, the capacity of the eight “Double First-Class” universities in Guangdong for achieving international publishing success is significant for the academic internationalization of the entire GBA region. A crucial means for enhancing these universities’ overall capacity for international publishing is to develop English for Research Publication Purposes (ERPP) initiatives. Nevertheless, ERPP is only an emerging phenomenon in mainland China, including in Guangdong. By contrast, across the border in Hong Kong, importance has long been attached to research communication education for doctoral students at the government-funded universities. It would be timely to initiate resource-sharing for scaling up ERPP instruction within the GBA. This project aims to design and deliver a two-tier intervention scheme, consisting of An Integrated Training Program for International Publication (ITPIP) intervention targeting participants from the eight “Double First-Class” universities in Guangdong, and an institutional intervention in the form of forging an ERPP-driven language-content partnership at each of three case universities. Two research questions (RQs) are asked: How can best-practice pedagogies be developed in the four runs of the 24-hour ITPIP? And how can effective and sustainable ERPP-driven language-content partnerships be forged in the local institutional contexts of three case universities? The methodology of action research is adopted to address the RQs. The key analytical concept to be employed in answering RQ1 is pedagogical episodes, defined as purposeful and observable instruction units, involving teaching material, teaching points, pedagogical steps, tasks, and/or feedback; that to be employed in answering RQ2 is partnership episodes, defined as purposeful and observable literacy events that involve at least one language teacher and at least one content teacher engaging in a text-mediated collaborative venture. In following a data collection and analysis cycle, we will combine observational and non-observational methods in collecting data, use content analysis and classroom discourse analysis in analyzing data, and integrate multiple types of triangulation to enhance trustworthiness. Our project will not only boost the international publishing success of the target universities, but also offer innovative solutions to challenges faced by universities worldwide in scaling up international publishing success. The project will signify the beginning of the GBA’s cross-border collaboration in research communication education and will have significance for the international competitiveness of the region’s higher education sector in the long run. 在廣東—香港—澳門大灣區已經成爲中國的戰略發展區域的大背景下，廣東省的八所“雙一流”大學的國際發文能力對整個大灣區的學術國際化都有著重要的意義。提升這些大學的國際發文能力的一個重要手段是發展以科研發表為目的的學術英文教育。然而，這種學術英文教育在中國大陸，包括廣東省的高校尚處在起步階段。相比之下，對博士生的科研發表能力的培養在由政府資助的香港高校一貫受到重視。當前有必要抓住在大灣區通過共享資源，提升以科研發表為目的的學術英文教育的時機。 此課題的目的是設計并實施一項由兩個部分構成的干預計劃：第一部分是針對來自廣東八所“雙一流”大學的參加者的“國際發表綜合培訓計劃（ITPIP）”；第二部分是在三所個案大學推動以學術英文教育為基礎的語言教師與學科教師的合作。本課題有兩個研究問題：如何通過四輪ITPIP的實施從而發展以科研發表為目的的學術英文最佳教學法？如何在三所個案大學推動有效并持久的以學術英文教育為基礎的語言教師與學科教師的合作？本課題采用行動研究方法回答這兩個研究問題。“課堂教學片段” 和“教師合作片段”是回答兩個研究問題的中心概念。它們分別定義為：有目的的、可觀察的教學過程單位，包括教學材料、内容、步驟、任務及/或反饋；有目的的、可觀察的合作過程單位，涉及至少一名語言教師和一名學科教師，以書面或口頭文本為媒介。在循環收集與分析數據的過程中，我們將綜合觀察性的和非觀察性的數據收集方法，結合内容分析方法和課堂話語分析方法，并整合多種方式以增强結果的可信度。 此課題將不僅有效提升目標大學的國際發文能力，而且將為世界其它地區的大學在提升國際發文能力方面提供富有創新意義的對策。此課題將標志著大灣區在科研發表能力的培養方面開始了跨境合作，對加强整個地區的高等教育的國際競爭力將具有長遠意義。

17618724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17618724.value: 國家如何運用非選舉手段在政策轉向中管理公共輿論

17618724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17618724.value: How do non-electoral regimes use propagandist institutions to facilitate policy turns and political reversals of major significance? In this project, we seek to demonstrate the way in which non-electoral regimes dynamically use propaganda to accomplish rapid discursive shifts in face of major political changes. We will analyse and compare the modus operandi of China’s political propaganda in three major episodes of political reversals, namely (1) the Lin Biao incident—the overnight fall of a Vice Commander-in-Chief to a national enemy; (2) the “Re-education Through Labour”—the abolishment of the notorious administrative punishment system; and (3) the One-Child Policy—the loosening up of a thirty-year-long “basic national policy”. In each and every one of these three episodes, the major reversal of policy or political orientation has led to general shock in the public, released expansive public discussion of the legitimacy and credibility of the regime, and risked challenges of the legitimacy of the regime in general. We will analyse how the Party-state strategically adjusted the political narratives to justify the three episodes of major political reversals and how it tactically deployed the official propaganda at different levels in a dynamic and orchestrated manner to manage the public opinion—a phenomenon we call “discursive engineering”. Using unsupervised machine learning methods, we will dissect and compare the content, style, and timing of propaganda in official party newspapers from central to provincial and prefectural levels—the mouthpieces of the Communist Party at all levels. Also, by conducting a triangulation with archival analysis of the three significant episodes in China's political history, we will delve into the strategic adjustments made in political narratives and the tactical deployment of official propaganda across various levels of governance. This study offers a rare opportunity to examine how the Chinese state tactfully undertook a systematic, precise, multi-dimensional and multi-layered discursive engineering campaign to facilitate the reversal of a basic national policies. Such a campaign involves disparate narrative forms, rhetorical styles and arguments that are customized based on contextual factors. The discursive engineering unveiled in this research is not a structural or institutional idiosyncrasy; it is a reflection of the state’s manoeuvring of political discourses carefully designed to match the critical moment of a major policy reversal that has political significance. 國家如何利用宣傳動作促進具有重大意義的政策轉向？在政策轉向中如何管理輿論，以避免對政府整體信譽造成損害，並確保新政策路線順利實施？政治領導人時常需要應對國家政策的根本性轉向。重大政策轉向打破政策現狀，創造超出官僚管理常規的事件，並將政治問題引入公共討論。更重要的是，重大國家政策轉向往往需要使現有的政治和政策敘事失效。如果沒有適當宣傳策略介入，這種迅速自我否定的政治成本和影響可能引致非常嚴重的後果。 在本研究項目中，我們試圖展示國家如何動態地利用宣傳動作來應對重大政策轉向之際的官方話語及敘事轉型。我們將擇取重要的歷史與現實案例，分析國家如何戰略性地調整政治敘事，以論述重大政策轉向的合理性，以及如何在不同層面動態、有序地管理公眾輿論。我們將這一現象稱之為“話語工程”。我們將使用無監督的機器學習方法，剖析和比較在重大政策轉向之際，不同級別官方新聞報紙中的宣傳內容、風格和時機，深入探討國家政治敘事的戰略調整過程。

17619224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17619224.value: 谁有资格获得公共租赁住房？——一个福利应得性研究

17619224.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17619224.value: Prof Chen, Jie Dr Laenen, Tijs Prof Wong, Michael Bo-lin

17619224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17619224.value: 人们用不同的标准去评估各种群体的社会福利应得性。目前文献主要针对与收入相关的社会福利的应得性，对公共或社会租赁住房福利的应得性研究较少。同时，目前的文献主要关注福利获得的应得性，比较少关注福利退出的应得性。一些新兴的文献还关注为什么人们会使用不同的标准去评估群体的福利应得性，并提出了一些解释框架。比如，自我利益动机，意识形态立场和刻板印象等。但这些解释框架还未在公共租赁住房应得性上得到应用。通过设计基于情景的因素调查实验，本研究将探究公租房住户的不同特征如何影响大众对他们福利应得性的评估。同时，我们还会探求这两者的关系将如何受到个人的利益，意识形态和刻板印象的影响。

17620024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17620024.value: 從小學中文教學轉變為中學英文教學：語言轉換在促進英語作為外語學生動機發展中的作用

17620024.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17620024.value: Prof Prada, Josh Dr Wang, Yi Prof Wei, Li

17620024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17620024.value: English-medium-instruction (EMI) is a global practice where academic subjects are taught and learnt in English as a second language (L2). While EMI is preferred by parents and students in Hong Kong, existing research documents inadequate support for students transitioning from Chinese-medium-instruction primary schooling to English-only secondary education. This lack of support causes language-related problems in classroom interactions, content understanding, and assignments. A crucial factor in EMI adaptation is students’ L2 English learning motivation. However, although motivation is essential for successful knowledge acquisition and sustained L2 learning, little research attention has been paid to its fluctuation and dynamics throughout students’ transition into the EMI context. Translanguaging, which involves the exploitation of diverse linguistic, multimodal and sociocultural resources to facilitate meaning-making and empowerment, has been proven to positively impact language and content learning. Recent research shows that translanguaging can boost students’ L2 learning motivation, but its benefits for EMI students’ English-learning motivation have received less attention. Given the complex and dynamic nature of L2 learning motivation, its interplay with translanguaging during the transition to EMI environments needs further clarification. To address this gap, this mixed-methods design study will draw on a multi-levelled conceptual framework, integrating the notion of translanguaging experiences into Dörnyei’s L2 motivational self-system through an ecological perspective. We will use this framework to examine EMI students’ translanguaging experiences during academic adaptation, the interaction between students’ translanguaging experiences and L2 self-guides (i.e., the ideal L2 self and ought-to L2 self), and the mechanisms underlying students’ motivational dynamics. A questionnaire will be administered at 3 time points in the academic year to track students’ L2 motivational dynamics.
