21103324.value: 研發首個針對亞洲水產養殖柱形病的減毒活疫苗

21103324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21103324.value: 科瓦氏黃桿菌 （Flavobacterium covae）（以前稱為II型柱狀黃桿菌）是柱狀病的致病菌，可以影響全球許多淡水魚類。 這種細菌附著在魚體上產生病灶和潰瘍，並導致魚苗90%的死亡率以及成魚60%的死亡率。 儘管柱狀病對全球淡水水產養殖業有著重大影響，但在亞洲仍然沒有有效的疫苗來預防柱狀病。 缺乏成熟的靶向基因操作技術和毒力評估模型是柱狀病疫苗研究的主要挑戰之一。 在我們之前的研究中，我們利用抗生素隨機誘變方法（即利福平篩選法）篩選到一株活性疫苗候選株。 該突變體完全喪失了毒力，但保持了較高的免疫原性。 此外，比較基因組學發現野生型和突變株之間存在14個點突變，這些突變點位於8個蛋白質編碼區域和5個基因間隔區。 然而，導致該突變株毒力喪失的主效基因或調控元件仍未得知。 在本專案中，我們的第一個目標是通過同源重組構建含有每個點突變的突變體，並評估每個點突變對細菌表型特徵的影響。 我們的第二個目標是通過人工感染實驗評估突變體的毒力和安全性進行測試，從而確定影響致病力的主效基因。 此外，當細菌突變體除了與毒力相關的突變外還包含多個其他突變時，由於野生型表位的蛋白質結構發生改變，免疫原性可能會受到影響。 我們認為通過靶向產生與毒力相關的突變並同時避免任何與毒力無關的突變，將會使新疫苗候選株的相對保護率進一步提高。 因此，我們的第三個目標是評估新構建的突變體的免疫保護率，從而篩選優越的活疫苗候選株。 本研究將幫助我們探究科瓦氏黃桿菌的致病機制，併為開發由科瓦氏黃桿菌引起的柱狀病的首個活體改良疫苗奠定基礎。

21200224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21200224.value: 國共内戰與戰後東北文壇的重建（1945-1948）

21200224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21200224.value: This project seeks to reassess the complex process of reconstructing the literary field in Northeastern China within the shadow of the Chinese civil war and early Cold War conditions. Following the victory of the Anti-Japanese War, the Communist Party (CCP) and the Kuomintang (KMT) established bases in the Northeast, leading to a standoff. The situation was further complicated by the involvement of the United States and the Soviet Union. Both parties prioritized cultural work as a tool for political struggle. The KMT and CCP, based in Shenyang and Harbin respectively, established unique cultural production systems in the Northeast region therefore. Informed by Bourdieu’s concept of “field,” or the Chinese term Wentan, this project focuses on the social units that defined the writers in the Northeast region. Four types of writers were significant and interacted within this literary field: former "Manchukuo" writers, the "Northeast Writers Group" returning from China proper, Yan’an writers and Nationalist writers who accompanied the two parties' armies to the Northeast region. The post-war Northeast literary scene can be seen as the interplay of these four types of writers within the emerging literary systems of the two parties. The KMT sought to reintegrate the borderlands into the central order, while the CCP dealt with the clash and adjustment of the Yan'an literary system with the experiences in the new region. The establishment of these cultural systems also determined the inclusion or exclusion of Manchukuo writers within each political power. The reconstruction of the post-war literary field in Northeastern China remains an underexplored academic area. Unlike existing research that primarily focuses on the Chinese Communist Party and the liberated areas, this project aims to consider the experiences of the KMT, the CCP, and local Manchurian writers to present a comprehensive picture. This project intersects with Yan’an studies, KMT literature studies, "Manchukuo" studies, and research on the "Northeast Writers Group," and in turn will help deepen the understanding of the aforementioned four research areas. Additionally, this project will also help understand the literary experiences of other regions in China during the civil war period and shed lights on the post-war literary experiences in other Cold War frontline regions of Eurasia. 本計劃希望在國共内戰與冷戰興起的雙重背景下，梳理東北文壇在二戰後的重建及發展。抗戰勝利後，共產黨與國民黨先後進駐東北形成對峙局面，美蘇兩國的加入使局面變得更為複雜。文藝戰線作為政治鬥爭的手段，被兩黨視作具體工作的一部分。四類作家在其中扮演了重要角色：前「滿洲國」作家，從關內歸來的「東北作家群」，跟隨兩黨軍隊接收東北的延安作家與國統區作家。戰後東北文壇正是四類作家在逐漸成型的兩黨文藝體制中互動產生的。 東北戰後文壇的重建問題在目前尚是學術空白，既有研究大多著眼於中共與解放區，本計劃希望兼顧國民黨，共產黨與本土作家的經驗，系統呈現全貌。本計劃處在延安文藝研究，國民黨文藝機制研究，「滿洲國」文學研究與「東北作家群」研究的交匯點上，反過來也將有助於深化對前述四個研究領域的認識。從比較文學的視野出發，這一個案既有助於理解內戰時期中國其他區域的文學經驗，與同時期歐亞冷戰前沿地帶的戰後文學經驗也有所互動。

21200424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21200424.value: 分布式太陽能發電的小時內電力預測泛化：一種結合自注意力機制與空間嵌入的可解釋生成方法

21200424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21200424.value: 相較於集中式太陽能電站，屋頂分布式太陽能發電（DSG）在多個方面展現出優勢，包括減少輸電損耗、降低投資門檻以及靈活安裝以最小化土地佔用等。這些優勢在人口密集區域尤為重要，如香港郊區，其年度DSG潛力可達5981吉瓦時（GWh），約占當地總電力消耗的14%。然而，DSG的擴展也面臨挑戰，特別是需要在公用事業規模區域內進行空間DSG預測以實現電力整合。截至2023年10月，Web of Science核心收錄的大多數太陽能預測研究僅有不到2%的文獻探討了空間預測方法，且其中適合大規模但分佈稀疏的DSG的研究更是寥寥無幾。 自2021年以來，包括《自然》和《科學》在內的知名期刊強調了數據駆動的人工智能在科學發現中的應用，特別是用於識別動態天氣預報駆動因素的生成框架。這些方法有可能理解動態氣象數據與空間相關的DSG電力序列之間的時空關係。受此進展啟發，本項目提出了一種創新的、可解釋的生成方法，專門解決大量DSG的序列預測挑戰。本項目的主要貢獻包括：（1）本項目旨在透過利用衛星數據進行廣泛區域內DSG的小時內預測，並降低部署和維護新本地傳感器網絡的成本。（2）本項目將採用自注意力機制和其他可解釋性方法，對雲層和天空狀況變化的主要駆動因素和機制進行解釋和建模，這不僅有助於可再生能源預測，還將惠及氣象學和大氣研究等領域。（3）所開發的模型將在實際運行的DSG數據中進行實時評估。本項目與申請人其他相關研究相輔相成，共同推動向淨零目標及智能、可持續社會的發展。 自2011年以來，申請人在可持續預測領域的混合學習研究中積累了豐富的經驗，並開發了適用於多種實際應用的通用模型，這在其一系列出版物和專利中得到了證明（請參閱個人簡歷）。申請人與加州大學伯克利分校、加州大學聖地亞哥分校、清華大學等多學科實驗室的合作，為本項目的成功完成奠定了堅實的基礎。

21201124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21201124.value: 異構表面強化極端條件高通量液體冷卻的研究

21201124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21201124.value: Cooling technologies that dissipate heat at high heat flux and function stably at extreme temperatures are fundamental to a vast number of high-power systems including aerospace, nuclear reactors, electronics, etc. Phase-change-based spray cooling, characterized by superior heat capacity, excellent uniformity, and minimal coolant consumption, has been recognized as one promising solution to meet the severe cooling demand. However, its efficacy at extreme conditions is restricted by the inevitable formation of a complete vapor cushion beneath the sprayed droplet in Leidenfrost regime. To solve this bottleneck, extensive studies have been conducted to explore the fundamental origins of Leidenfrost effect and develop surface engineering approaches to extend temperature domains for boiling heat transfer. Despite concerted efforts, current cooling strategies suffer from the mutual exclusiveness in heat flux and Leidenfrost point, which dramatically limits their practical implementations. In this proposal, we aim to decipher the complex heat transfer mechanism of high-temperature droplets and establish new design rationales for high-flux cooling at extreme conditions. Our preliminary results reveal that the porous copper cantilever can accelerate the evacuation of evaporated vapor while maintaining fast liquid wicking even at a temperature near to material melting point, decreasing the droplet lifetime by ten times. Drawing from this, we propose the design of heterostructured surfaces by integrating tilt and porous fins with directional and solid bases. On the one hand, tilt and porous fins can facilitate the downward liquid replenishment (z-axis) for massive evaporation; On the other hand, gaps between tilt fins and solid base will form separated and directional channels, reinforcing vapor evacuation along y-axis. As such, we can break the integrity of the vapor cushion, enabling mutual enhancement in heat flux and Leidenfrost point. By combining microscale visualization with theoretical analysis, we will explore how heterogeneous integrations of surface attributes affect the dynamic evolution of liquid/solid contacts, and establish critical design criteria for high-flux cooling at extreme conditions. Further, leveraging the hydrodynamic and thermodynamic characterization of droplets, we will examine the cooling efficacy promoted by heterostructured surfaces. Finally, the practical feasibility of our design will be tested under typical water spray platforms, and alternative manufacturing techniques that are low-cost, scalable, and deployable will be explored to broaden their application scenarios. We envision that the heterostructured surface strategy proposed here represents an innovative solution to decouple the conventional trade-off between heat flux and Leidenfrost point, and will open new avenues for effective heat dissipation of high-power systems. 極端工況下的高通量散熱對包括航空航太、核反應爐、電子設備等在內的高功率系統至關重要。基於相變的噴霧冷卻技術由於其卓越的熱容量、出色的均勻性及較低的冷卻劑消耗量而被認為是滿足日益增長的冷卻需求的最優方案之一。然而，在極端高溫條件下，蒸發的液體不可避免地在固液介面聚集並形成完整的蒸汽層，進而導致Leidenfrost傳熱危機。為解決這一瓶頸，研究者們開展了大量的研究以探索Leidenfrost效應的物理起源，並開發了多種表面以擴大沸騰傳熱的溫度範圍。儘管如此，當前的冷卻方案難以兼顧高熱通量和高Leidenfrost點，這極大地限制了它們的實際應用。 在本項目中，我們將深入探究高溫液滴的複雜傳熱機制，並建立表面設計新方案，以在極端高溫條件下實現高通量冷卻。我們的初步結果表明，多孔銅懸臂梁可以加速蒸汽排放，即使在接近材料熔點的溫度下也能保持持續快速的液體浸潤，使液滴的蒸發時間減少了十倍。基於此，我們提出由傾斜、多孔的超親水翅片與定向、固體基底組成的異構表面。一方面，傾斜的多孔翅片可以促進液體向基底方向（Z軸）的補充，以實現大量蒸發；另一方面，傾斜翅片與固體基座之間的間隙將自發形成非連續的定向通道，以加強蒸汽的定向排放（Y軸）。這樣，我們將有望打破蒸汽的完整性，從而實現熱通量和Leidenfrost點的協同提升。通過微觀表徵和理論分析，我們將探討表面屬性的異質對固、液介面動態演變的影響規律，並確立極端條件下高通量冷卻的關鍵設計標準。此外，通過對撞擊液滴的流體動力學和熱力學表徵，我們將檢驗異構設計提升樣本基底冷卻速率的可行性。最後，結合噴霧冷卻平臺，探索低成本、可擴展和可部署的替代製造技術，以拓寬其應用場景。本文提出的異結表面將解耦熱通量和Leidenfrost點對表面設計的矛盾需求，有望為高效散熱技術的開發提供新思路和新途徑。

21203724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21203724.value: 用於螢光成像的奈米光子超表面生物感測晶片

21203724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21203724.value: 外泌體等奈米生物顆粒因能成為疾病診斷和治療效率的重要生物標記物（包括癌症、神經退化性疾病、代謝紊亂、病原體感染等）越來越受到關注。外泌體的分子譜分析旨在改善早期疾病診斷、了解疾病的生物學途徑並進行治療效果研究。另一方面，了解不同病毒株的傳染性或抗原決定位變異以及藥物的作用是為未來疫情制定診斷、治療和預防措施的關鍵。 螢光分子影像是識別多種潛在生物標記的強大工具，具有高特異性和高靈敏度。然而，覆蓋整個可見光範圍的多重螢光分子成像的主要瓶頸是（1）此類奈米生物顆粒中的生物標誌物濃度極低，以及（2）由於低輻照度光源或成像感測器的低量子產率，紅到遠紅外範圍內螢光成像的靈敏度有限（> 600 nm）。 本項目旨在透過利用多種先進技術（超表面、矽奈米光子學、免疫螢光和微流控）來開發對紅到遠紅外超靈敏的下一代螢光增強分子成像技術，基於奈米光子超表面中的表面晶格共振效應的範圍從而解決這些瓶頸。首先，我們將設計和製造一種由奈米天線陣列組成的新型奈米光子超表面，透過表面晶格共振增強螢光訊號（> 50 倍訊號放大）。其次，我們將提高奈米級生物顆粒（例如外泌體、病毒、細菌）免疫標記的特異性，減少背景噪音，並優化超靈敏多重螢光分析。第三，我們將設計微流控晶片來處理低於毫升的體積，以實現自動化並提高效率和均勻性。作為案例演示，我們將採用開發的奈米光子超表面生物感測平台對從實驗室培養的乳腺癌細胞收集的外泌體進行多重螢光分子成像，展示增強的紅色和遠紅範圍螢光檢測，並說明基於外泌體的重要里程碑疾病診斷。奈米光子超表面平台可應用於其他奈米生物顆粒，如病毒和細菌，將有助於推動香港成為生物醫學工程和轉化生物醫學設備的國際領先研究中心，同時造福醫療行業、專業人士和患者，並降低財務成本。

21204124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21204124.value: 開發先進的 X 射線顯微成像技術來解碼複合電池正極中的粒子動力學

21204124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21204124.value: 鋰離子電池(LIBs)已廣泛應用於從消費電子到電動車等各種高價值領域。這些電池的性能、安全性和使用壽命, 與電池正極及其關鍵組件活性顆粒內發生的複雜化學和物理過程密切相關。監測和分析電池操作過程中這些動態過程, 對於優化其整體性能至關重要。雖然傳統的同步加速器和實驗室X射線技術已經提供了有用的見解, 但它們通常受到複雜設置和有限功能的限制。 本項目提案旨在利用生成式機器學習的力量, 提高X射線顯微技術在研究LIBs正極顆粒動態過程方面的效率和實用性。我們將著重捕捉這些顆粒的複雜動態, 重點關注其形態、化學和晶格結構的變化。同時, 我們將利用改進的實驗室和同步加速器X射線成像設置, 提高成像速度、視場、靈敏度和空間分辨率, 以滿足電池研究對詳細和具有統計意義表征的需求。 我們將開發基於坐標的神經網絡為基礎的算法和系統, 以推動這些技術進步。所獲得的多模態成像數據將通過偏微分方程約束優化和不確定性量化得到充分挖掘和分析, 從而揭示潛在的物理機理。如果成功, 這個項目將為LIBs正極顆粒的X射線表征建立新的研究基准, 大幅推進我們對LIBs內部複雜動態的認知。最終, 我們將把研究成果與學術界和工業界的領域知識相結合, 提供獨特的洞見, 為電池技術的下一代創新和優化提供指導。

21206924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21206924.value: 氣候變遷下熱帶氣旋眼牆置換的風險分析

21206924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21206924.value: Tropical cyclones (TCs) have caused large numbers of fatalities and vast economic loss, making them one of the most expensive weather disasters. With anthropogenic climate change, the probability of the most intense TCs, as well as associated rainfall, storm surge and inland flooding, is likely to increase, posing increasing challenges to coastal communities around the world. Recent infamous TC rainfall and flooding events make us wonder whether these extreme events, rarely recorded in decades, may have become the ‘new normal’ in the changing climate. The physics-based TC risk assessment framework aims to quantify the risks of the worst-case scenarios by generating large numbers (~104) of synthetic TCs across the point of interest, and estimate the probability associated with the hazards using Monte Carlo simulations. The framework has been widely used to estimate TC hazards in the U.S. and the identify potentially large risks of unexpected ‘grey swan’ TCs for highly vulnerable coastal regions. Compared with real-time forecasting (lead time of a few days), the risk assessment of extreme TC events is of crucial importance to strategic engineering design and urban planning on the time scale of decades or centuries. This research aims to incorporating eyewall replacements cycles (ERC), a fundamental change in storm structure and intensity that observed to occur in over 70% of the most intense TCs into the physics-based TC rainfall risk assessment schemes for the first time. Our previous work on TC rainfall modeling and a simple diagnostic of storm undergoing ERC provide a handy tool in incorporating ERC, a widely believed complicated process, into the framework of TC risk assessment. Building upon our previous efforts, this project plans to 1) build a detailed long-term dataset of observed ERC; 2) Incorporate ERC in the physics-based TC rainfall model; 3) improve the modeling of rapid intensification by taking ERC into account; and 4) investigate the effects of ERC on storm surge. The outcome of this project is expected to yield better understanding and representation of the rainfall risk of landfalling TCs in a changing climate, facilitating more strategic management of TC hazards by engineers, urban planners, stakeholders and government agencies. 熱帶氣旋（Tropical Cyclones, TCs）是全球危害最嚴重的氣象災害之一。在未來氣候情境下，TCs 會出現強度增大、降雨增加等特點，對全球沿海地區帶來挑戰。約 70% 的強TC會經歷眼牆置換（Eyewall replacement cycles, ERCs）。 ERCs 的持續時間為幾個小時 到幾天不等，期間的氣旋的強度和結構發生大幅振盪，給預報帶來挑戰。同時 ERCs伴隨著強風區和外雨帶的快速擴張，若發生在TC登陸前，更易造成嚴重災害。因此，雙眼牆特徵及ERCs演變過程的研究對於提升TC模擬及災害風險預報能力非常重要。 本研究旨在將ERCs納入基於物理機制的熱帶氣旋風險評估框架中。研究目標為：1）建立ERCs觀測資料集；2）在用於統計-動力降尺度的基於物理機制的熱帶氣旋降雨模型中考慮ERCs；3）通過ERCs來提高TCs強度變化的模擬；4）研究ERCs對風暴潮的影響。

21207824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21207824.value: 用于6G的先进和绿色波束成形超表面天线

21207824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21207824.value: To combat global climate change, 194 Parties have joined the Paris Agreement and committed to achieving carbon neutrality. Pioneering this initiative, the information and communication technology (ICT) industry pledges to achieve carbon net zero by 2050. This signifies a significant shift in the telecommunications landscape, which must not only prioritize network coverage and user experience but also strive to go “green”. Massive multiple-input and multiple-output (MIMO) with beamforming is one of the core technologies in 5G to increase the transmission gain and spectral efficiency. The canonical beamforming networks, such as full-digital architecture, rely on extensive and power-hungry Radio Frequency (RF) chains to upconvert baseband signals and shape beams. Their power consumption, however, becomes one of the primary contributors to the 5G energy drain. Towards the future Beyond 5G and 6G systems, there is a growing consensus that scaling up antenna apertures into ultra-massive MIMO promises to meet the burgeoning data traffic demand. However, the associated costs and power consumption of such beamforming networks, characterized by ultra-massive RF chains and expensive high-frequency RF components, are expected to become prohibitively high. Therefore, industry and academia are actively exploring innovative, high-performance, and green beamforming technologies to achieve the net-zero goal. For example, a special issue on “Advanced Beam-Forming Antennas for Beyond 5G and 6G”, in which the PI is one of the lead guest editors, has been announced by the IEEE Open Journal of Antennas and Propagation in 2023 to collect advanced beamforming technologies from world-leading researchers and experts. This project aims to develop an RF-chain-free beamforming paradigm based on the space-time-coding metasurface antenna (STCMA). This technology offers a cost- and energy-efficiency solution while enabling complex beamforming tasks. We will explore the high-efficiency STCMA design and its potential for direct spatial multiplexing, e.g., simultaneously transmitting different data streams to various users at the same time and frequency. We propose to use the simplest 1-bit ON-OFF switch coding scheme to perform complicated 2-D beam scanning, multi-beam generation, sidelobe cancellation, and multi-user interference elimination by leveraging the unique waveguide-integrated structure of the STCMA. The output of this project will tackle the long-standing energy-intensive challenge in conventional beamforming networks and lead to a new high-performance and green beamforming architecture for next-generation low-carbon wireless communication systems. Its successful implementation promises to benefit Hong Kong and the global academic and industrial communities, contributing to a more sustainable and environmentally conscious future. 为了应对全球气候变化, 全世界已有194个缔约方加入了《巴黎协定》, 并承诺实现碳中和。作为这一倡议的先驱,信息和通信技术(ICT)行业承诺到2050年实现碳中和。这标志着电信行业格局的重大转变,它不仅要优先考虑网络覆盖和用户体验,还要努力实现"绿色"发展。 大规模多输入多输出(Massive MIMO)搭配波束成型技术是5G中的核心技术之一,可以提高传输增益和频谱效率。传统的波束成型网络,如全数字架构,依赖于大量耗电的射频链路来实现上变频信号并实现赋形波束。然而,它们的功耗已成为5G能耗的主要来源之一。 面向后5G和6G系统,业界普遍认为扩大天线口径面以进入超大规模MIMO将满足不断增长的数据流量需求。但是,这类波束成型网络所需的超大规模射频链路和昂贵的高频射频部件,其成本和功耗预计将变得过高。因此,产业界和学术界正在积极探索创新、高性能和绿色的波束成型技术,以实现碳中和目标。比如, 《IEEE Open Journal of Antennas and Propagation》期刊在2023年出版了一期特刊"面向后5G和6G的先进波束成型天线",由本项目负责人担任客座主编,旨在收集全球研究人员和专家的先进波束成型技术。 本项目旨在开发一种基于时空编码超表面阵列天线(STCMA)的无射频链路波束成型范式。这项技术在实现复杂波束成型任务的同时,提供了低成本和高能源效率的解决方案。本项目将探索高效STCMA的设计,以及其在直接空间复用(如同时向不同用户传输不同数据流)方面的潜力。我们提出利用最简单的1比特开关编码方案,通过STCMA独特的波导集成结构,实现复杂的二维波束扫描、多波束生成、副瓣消除和多用户干扰消除等任务。 该项目的成果将解决传统波束成型网络中长期存在的高能耗挑战,开创下一代低碳无线通信系统的新型高性能绿色波束成型架构。其成功实施将惠及香港乃至全球的学术和工业界,为更加可持续和环保的未来做出贡献。

21211024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21211024.value: 3D打印混凝土中钢纤维取向分布的主动调控技术

21211024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21211024.value: Three-dimensional concrete printing (3DCP) is an advanced additive manufacturing technique that has garnered significant attention, owning to its ability to eliminate the need for formwork and provide great freedom in creating personalized structures. Thus, 3DCP has the potential to revolutionize the construction industry by increasing efficiency, reducing labor and costs, and minimizing material wastage. To enhance the mechanical properties of printed structures, steel fibers exhibit significant promise because they align along the printing direction during the extrusion process. However, the fibers remain randomly distributed in other directions, with limited bridging between adjacent layers. Additionally, the 3D printing of concrete with steel fibers poses the risk of nozzle blockage, particularly at higher fiber volumes and smaller nozzle sizes. This proposed project will address these challenges by using a magnetic field to actively control steel fiber alignment in 3D printing concrete. This approach will minimize fiber clogging through the adjustment of steel fiber orientation in the flow direction, and meanwhile, improve the buildability and ductility of printed structures by uniformly aligning fibers in filaments. This will be achieved by characterizing the changes of steel fiber distributions and rheological, microstructural, and mechanical properties of steel fiber reinforced concrete (SFRC) in response to a magnetic field. Moreover, the magnetic field-induced flow behavior and extrudability of SFRC will be assessed using a custom pipe/nozzle device. Consequently, the relationships between steel fiber distributions, magneto-induced flow behavior, and rheological response will be established. This will allow determination of the mechanisms whereby the magnetic field and the extrusion process synergistically affect steel fiber alignment and buildability. In addition, the mechanical properties and layer-interface characteristics of 3D printed structures with magneto-induced steel fiber alignment will be determined. Ultimately, an approach for the active control of steel fiber orientation in 3D printing concrete will be devised, and a magnetic nozzle prototype will be developed for experimental validation. The novelty of actively controlling steel fiber orientation using a magnetic field lies in its non-contact and post-control nature. This enables the manipulation of material flow without affecting the pumping process, allowing for tailoring of both extrudability and buildability of the same concrete mixture. The proposed project outcomes will improve the overall quality of 3D printed concrete structures and facilitate the emergence of four-dimensional (4D) concrete printing. The knowledge gained will support the structural application of 3DCP in the construction industry, thereby contributing to sustainability and carbon neutrality goals. 3D打印混凝土技术是一种先进的增材制造技术，具有免模板、自动化和智能化等特点，能够显著提高施工效率、减少劳动力成本，并降低固体废弃物的排放，在建筑领域备受关注。由于钢纤维在挤出过程中能够沿打印方向排列，因此在增强3D打印结构的力学性能方面展现了广阔的前景。然而，钢纤维在其它方向呈随机分布，导致对相邻打印层的桥接作用有限。此外，在较高的纤维掺量和较小的喷嘴直径下，钢纤维混凝土在打印过程中存在堵塞喷嘴的风险，这限制了3D打印混凝土技术的快速发展。为应对这些挑战，本项目提出采用磁场主动控制钢纤维在3D打印混凝土中取向分布的方法，以降低钢纤维堵塞喷嘴风险并增强打印层的可建造性和力学性能。为实现这一目标，本项目将研究磁场作用下钢纤维混凝土中纤维取向、流变性能、微观结构和力学性能的响应行为，分析磁场诱导钢纤维混凝土在定制喷嘴装置中的流动变化规律，建立钢纤维分布、流动行为和磁流变响应性能之间的关系，阐明施加磁场和挤出过程对钢纤维取向分布和可建造性的协同影响机理。此外，本项目还将揭示磁场诱导钢纤维分布对3D打印混凝土的力学性能和层间界面粘结性能的作用机制，提出一种通过施加磁场主动控制3D打印混凝土中钢纤维定向排列的方法。本项目的主要特色在于磁场的非接触特性，能够在不影响泵送过程的情况下主动控制混凝土的流动行为，从而根据实际需要调控同一混凝土拌合物的可挤出性和可建造性，以提升3D打印钢纤维混凝土的整体质量。项目成果将推动4D打印混凝土技术的发展，促进3D打印混凝土在建筑结构领域的应用，并为实现可持续发展和碳中和目标提供理论支持。

21216024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21216024.value: 基於跨尺度構效關係 (SAR) 研究溫拌聚氨酯改質瀝青與再生瀝青路面 (RAP) 之間相互作用行為以實現耐用且低碳的鋪路材料

21216024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21216024.value: 聚氨酯(PU)作為一種可持續的活性瀝青改質劑，因其優異的路用性能和環境友好特性，在道路工程領域已被廣泛研究。然而，聚氨酯改質瀝青(PUMB)與集料間獨特的黏附機制不同於透過物理改質所獲得的常規聚合物改質瀝青，其黏附性容易受到組分的化學性質、界面形態以及環境和載重條件的影響，進而形成了複雜的混合料劣化機制。因此，有必要對聚氨酯改質瀝青與骨材之間的黏附性進行相關研究，以全面揭示聚氨酯改質瀝青混合料的劣化機制。 為了填補此研究領域的空白，同時推動聚氨酯作為可持續性和高韌性路面材料在香港的應用，本計畫將探討影響聚氨酯改質瀝青-骨材界面黏附的關鍵因素，並建構多尺度分析框架揭示其黏附機理。 首先進行聚氨酯改質瀝青界面改質機制研究，並在不同的環境和負荷條件下評估聚氨酯改質瀝青與不同礦物成分集料的黏附性。改良接觸角測試方法，取得聚氨酯改質瀝青在不同表面粗糙度集料板上的接觸角，從而確定集料表面形態對界面黏附能量的影響。其次，基於實驗表徵、黏附理論和分子建模，揭示聚氨酯改質瀝青和集料在納觀、微觀和宏觀尺度上的脫黏機制。在納觀尺度上，採用分子動力學模擬，研究化學因子對聚氨酯改質瀝青及骨材黏附性的影響。在微觀尺度上，結合骨材表面形態和理化交互作用特性建構脫黏現象的力學判斷準則，並利用改進動態剪切流變儀(M-DSR)試驗進行驗證。在宏觀尺度，建立損傷擴展模型來表徵脫黏的演化機制。針對不同初始脫黏狀態的聚氨酯改質瀝青、骨材性質及載重條件，進行M-DSR試驗對預測結果進行實驗驗證。最後，基於以上影響因素建構多尺度模型，實現對黏附失效和整體材料反應的精準預測，以改善聚氨酯改質瀝青混合料的材料設計和性能評估，從而提高香港本地和全球範圍內公路的耐久性。

21216624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21216624.value: 基于云的机器人自适应与空间感知的具身导航系统

21216624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21216624.value: 随着现代城市环境的复杂性和密度不断增加，以香港等城市为代表，服务机器人领域对先进导航系统的需求变得愈发迫切。这些导航系统对于部署在医疗保健、公共交通等服务行业的机器人来说至关重要，有助于提升其效率和自主性。目前的机器人导航系统主要依赖传统算法和传感器输入。然而，在人口密集、建筑复杂的环境中，传统系统往往难以应对其中的动态和不可预测因素。机器人在多变的场景中实时适应的能力，正是现有算法难以有效解决的主要挑战之一。 创新性地将前沿导航方法、物理世界奖励机制以及基于云的集体智能相结合，展现出了超越现有模型的巨大潜力。在本研究项目中，我们的首席研究员（PI）计划探讨两个新颖的组成部分：实时自适应学习算法和空间感知系统。这些组件有望弥合当前机器人导航中的空白。我们的初步研究表明，在校园环境中应用这些组件后，导航精度和适应性较现有系统有了显著提高。通过利用机器人之间的共享通信和知识，我们的先进系统能够快速适应环境变化，使服务机器人不仅能够导航，还能预测并提前应对潜在障碍。这种导航能力表明，我们的系统有可能在医院、仓库和公共交通枢纽等拥挤或高流量区域中部署，并展示了机器人在这些环境中展现出的卓越灵活性，充分体现了该系统的潜力。 本研究的成果预计将重新定义复杂环境中机器人导航的范式，不仅适用于服务机器人，还将在其他需要复杂导航的领域发挥作用。此外，该项目中获得的方法和见解或将为其他人工智能驱动的导航系统开辟更广泛的应用前景。

21300624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21300624.value: 潜空间模型中以个体为中心的局部信息

21300624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21300624.value: 网络数据在各领域的定量与定性分析中发挥着关键作用。传统的统计网络研究通常通过使用整体网络数据或从多个子图聚合的信息来估计全局网络特性。然而，在现实网络中，个体通常只能接触到有限的信息。此前的研究注意到了这种个体信息的局限性，并引入了一种以个体为中心的局部信息框架，这促进了基于个体局部信息研究网络全局结构的方法的发展。我们的项目聚焦于在广义网络模型设置中分析以个体为中心的局部信息。主要目的是探索个体在研究广义社交网络全局属性方面的潜力。本项目的方法在社群检测、社交距离测量和网络可视化等任务中展现出色的能力，并具备优越的理论属性，而无需依赖严格的社群结构假设。这种方法将大幅度降低网络数据获取和大矩阵计算的相关成本，同时增强个人数据隐私保护。

21300824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21300824.value: 華南地區森林覆蓋度變化對碳固存與氣候變化的影響

21300824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21300824.value: The Government of the People’s Republic of China has announced its intention for China to limit carbon dioxide emissions: the goal is to peak before 2030 and achieve carbon neutrality by 2060. Carbon emissions must be reduced to balance natural carbon sequestration and to achieve carbon neutrality. Nature-based climate solutions (NBCSs) in China—most are carbon sequestration in the terrestrial ecosystem—have mitigated 8% of fossil carbon dioxide emissions during the past decade. Forests in China have undergone intensive afforestation since the early 1950s. Powerful laws to protect forests have prevented forest destruction and preserved their role in carbon sequestration for the future. Forests in Southern China have the highest carbon sequestration rate in China and throughout East Asia. However, thus far, there have been no studies on optimal forest management and restoration (FMR) practices for maximizing carbon sequestration in Southern China. Furthermore, it is reported that land cover change will introduce changes in the regional climate through biogeophysical processes, such as surface temperature change through albedo modulations and soil moisture depletion due to additional transpiration. Therefore, more scientific evidence is needed to determine appropriate FMR practices in Southern China for the optimal cost-to-benefit of NBCSs and to minimize adverse regional climate change impact to support the implementation of the carbon neutrality agenda. To address these critical issues, we propose to: 1) quantify regional terrestrial ecosystem productivity in Southern China based on data- and process-driven datasets; 2) create a land surface model to simulate carbon sequestration changes under scenarios of change in forest cover fraction; 3) project regional climate change using coupled Earth system modeling. These projections will help identify cost-effective regions that have the highest carbon sequestration rate and the lowest regional climate change impact. The project outcomes will help to 1) provide scientific evidence for suggesting appropriate FMR locations to maximize carbon sequestration and minimize regional climate change; 2) quantify future carbon sequestration changes in Southern China depending on the scenarios of forest cover fraction change; and 3) support to achieve the carbon neutrality goals of the Government of China by suggesting optimized FMR practice and relevant carbon sequestration benefits. 中國政府提出爭取於2030年達到峰值，2060年前實現碳中和的減碳目標。通過減少碳排放以平衡自然的碳固存，從而實現碳中和。在中國，以自然為基礎的氣候解決方案 (Nature-based climate solutions, NBCS) 主要通過陸地生態系統進行固碳 ，在過去十年中減緩了佔比達 8% 的化石燃料源二氧化碳排放。 20 世紀 50 年代以來，中國開展了大規模的造林工程，同時通過相關法律禁止森林破坏，使得森林固碳的功能得以保存和發揮。華南地區森林的固碳率在中國乃至東亞地區都為最高。然而，目前仍未有研究探討如何在華南地區開展最佳森林管理和恢復 (forest management and restoration, FMR) 以最大化實現碳固存的問題。此外，據報導，土地覆蓋變化將通過生物地球物理過程影響區域氣候變化，例如反射率調節引起的地表溫度變化，額外的蒸騰導致土壤水分耗損等。因此，我們需要更多的科学证据為华南地区確定适当的 FMR 实践，以实现 NBCS 的最佳成本效益，同時最大限度地减少对区域气候变化的不利影响，支持碳中和目標的实施。 為解決這些問題，我們建議 ：1）基於數據和過程驅動的數據集，量化華南地區的區域陸地生態系統生產力；2）建立陸地表面模型，模擬森林覆蓋率變化情景下的碳固存變化；3）利用耦合地球系統模式預測區域氣候變化。 這些預測將有助於確定碳固存率最高、區域氣候變化影響最低的成本效益區域。本項目的成果將有助於：1）確定適合開展FMR的位置並提供科學證據，以最大限度地增加碳固存和減少區域氣候變化；2）基於森林覆蓋度變化的情境模擬，量化華南地區未來碳固存的變化；3）提出最佳的FMR實踐和相應的碳固存效益，支持中國碳中和目標的實現。

21302524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21302524.value: 矽酸鉍作為先進凡得瓦電介質的全面探索與應用

21302524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21302524.value: 近期，凡得瓦（vdW）介電材料在凝聚態物理和高端電子技術領域中顯得尤為重要。相比傳統的非晶介電材料，凡得瓦介電材料提供了原子級平滑的表面，進一步提升了裝置性能，並迎合了二維（2D）電子學的新興需求。然而，這些介電材料的種類受限以及低介電常數限制了其發展潛力。矽酸鉍（Bi2SiO5）以高介電常數和顯著的能隙突破框架，其獨特的Aurivillius型層狀結構在需要鐵電和壓電性質的應用中展現突破性前景。 本研究致力於開發矽酸鉍的應用潛力。考慮到目前合成的挑戰和對超薄矽酸鉍的探索不足，我們的研究計劃聚焦於三大核心目標。首先，通過化學氣相沉積（CVD）技術改善矽酸鉍的生長，應對合成過程的複雜性。其次，深入探究矽酸鉍的介電性質及其與二維半導體的整合，為未來晶體管技術提供前瞻性支持。最後，挖掘超薄矽酸鉍層的微妙壓電與鐵電特性，瞄準能源收集和記憶體設備的創新應用。 憑借我們在CVD合成新興材料、材料整合以及壓電與鐵電性質探索方面的豐富經驗，我們準備好了填補對矽酸鉍理解與應用的空白。我們的研究目標是全面了解矽酸鉍的多功能性，從而引領低功耗、高性能電子設備的未來發展。

21304024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21304024.value: 南海海洋热浪及其与热带气旋活动的相互作用

21304024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21304024.value: Coastal regions face risks relating to extreme weather events owing to the combination of an increasing human population and vulnerable natural ecosystems. Exposure to extreme weather events is thus a major concern. In the South China Sea (SCS) region, concerns mostly relate to high temperatures and strong winds and heavy rainfall caused by tropical cyclones (TCs). However, the prediction of such extreme events is challenging owing to the complex interaction of extreme weather events. Marine heat waves (MHWs), defined as excessively warm seawater persisting for long periods, have substantial impacts on marine ecosystems. It has been shown that MHWs can rapidly intensify TCs and that TCs can, in turn, affect the duration and intensity of MHWs. However, most studies have focused on individual events, and no comprehensive analysis of the interaction between MHWs and TCs or future changes in the frequency and intensity of MHWs and TCs over the SCS has been conducted. The proposed project will systematically investigate (1) the characteristics of MHWs in the SCS, (2) the interaction between MHWs and TC activity, and (3) the impact of climate change on the interaction between these phenomena. The findings of the project will advance effective early warning systems for coastal communities in the SCS, enabling the communities to mitigate risks associated with TCs and MHWs. The project will have additional advantages for environmental protection and food security as the SCS is a vital fishing ground for millions of people in Southeast Asia. 由于人口增长和脆弱的自然生态系统，沿海地区面临与极端天气事件发生相关的风险。因此，遭受极端天气事件的影响成为一个主要关注点。在中国南海地区，人们关注的主要是热带气旋（tropical cyclones, TCs）造成的高温、强风和强降雨。然而，由于极端天气事件之间复杂的相互作用，对这些极端事件的预测仍面临挑战。海洋热浪（marine heat waves, MHWs）是指海水温度长时间持续的过热，对海洋生态系统有重大的影响。研究表明，MHWs可以迅速增强TCs，而TCs反过来也能影响MHWs的持续时间和强度。然而，大多数研究集中于单个事件，目前尚无关于MHWs与TCs相互作用的综合分析，也没有对未来南海地区MHWs和TCs频率和强度变化的研究。 本项目旨在系统地研究：（1）南海MHWs的特征，（2）MHWs与TC活动之间的相互作用，以及（3）气候变化对这些现象相互作用的影响。该项目的研究成果将推动南海沿岸地区建立有效的预警系统，使这些沿岸地区能够减轻与TCs和MHWs相关的风险。由于南海是东南亚数百万人的重要渔场，该项目还将对环境保护和粮食安全带来更多的好处。

21304324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21304324.value: Electro-organic synthesis is one of the most prominent pathways toward sustainable and environmentally benign synthetic chemistry. The combination of electrochemical synthesis with other newly developed synthetic techniques is extremely attractive to chemists. The asymmetric hydrogenation reaction is of practical significance in industry, because it shows a strong ability to construct various chiral motifs for drug synthesis. Therefore, it piques our interest to combine asymmetric hydrogenation with electrochemical synthesis to develop asymmetric electrochemical hydrogenations. Although electrochemical reductions have been widely explored, research on electrochemical hydrogenation hasn’t been extensively studied and especially asymmetric electrochemical hydrogenation is scarce. The compatibility and distinctive mechanisms of these two component reactions pose significant challenges to their successful adoption. In the propose project, we aim to use electricity and water as a replacement for traditional pressurized H2 in asymmetric hydrogenation. Strategies from indirect and direct electrolysis pathways are proposed, including chiral mediators, chiral organocatalysts and organometallic catalysts. From the mechanistic aspect, these strategies show totally different reaction pathways compared with traditional asymmetric hydrogenation. This proposed project will provide both practical meaning and a theoretical perspective of the electrochemical asymmetric hydrogenations. 電化學有機合成是實現持續和環境友好的合成化學的最重要途徑之一。電化學合成與其他新開發的合成技術的結合對化學家極具吸引力。不對稱氫化反應具有很強的建構多種手性基團用於藥物合成的能力，在工業上具有實際意義。因此，將不對稱氫化與電化學合成相結合來開發不對稱電化學氫化引起了我們的興趣。儘管電化學還原已被廣泛探索，但電化學氫化尚未被大量報道，而不對稱電化學氫化報道更少。挑戰可能來自傳統不對稱氫化與電化學氫化條件相容性和不同反應機制。在此，我們的目標是使用電和水來取代傳統的加壓氫氣來進行不對稱氫化。提出了間接和直接電解途徑的策略，包括手性介質、手性有機和有機金屬催化劑等。因此，該研究的實施不僅具有重要的實際意義，而且為電化學不對稱氫化提供了理論鋪墊。

21306524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21306524.value: 可压缩相对论流体的双曲耗散和洛伦兹不变零粘度极限

21306524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21306524.value: 流体动力学应用范围广泛，从宇宙的宇宙学模型到医学中的血流模拟。冲击波（通常通过压缩形成的不连续波前）是流体动力学的核心，并带来了许多数学挑战。消失粘度法在经典冲击波理论中发挥了重要作用，它既提供了确定正确物理冲击波的缓和极限，又作为设计用于模拟物理冲击波的数值差分方案的指导原则。然而，对于相对论流体流动，底层耗散机制（基于拉普拉斯算子）违反了光速界限——相对论的基本原理。因此，相对论流体动力学缺乏一种简单的耗散机制，使消失粘度法无法将相对论冲击波研究为与相对论定律一致的平滑粘性近似（例如，在数值方案中）。 为了克服相对论流体动力学的这一缺陷，首席研究员 (PI) 最近引入了一种简单的相对论可压缩流体流动耗散机制，即基于（双曲）波算子的 HD 欧拉方程（HD 代表双曲耗散）。HD 欧拉方程是洛伦兹不变的，因此遵循相对论原理，包括光速界限。PI 在此提出研究 HD 欧拉方程是否与用于研究冲击波的消失粘度法的经典（基于拉普拉斯）耗散机制相当（具有全局适定性、非线性稳定性和物理冲击波作为零粘度极限），但符合相对论定律。 在前期工作中，PI 通过证明傅里叶拉普拉斯模式的衰减（耗散）和选择物理冲击波的一维冲击波剖面的存在，建立了 HD 欧拉方程作为消失粘度法耗散模型的基本一致性。这一分析表明，由于相对论的精细几何结构和光速界限，该机制比经典耗散机制有显著的简化。这引发了一个问题，作为一个潜在的后续项目，HD 欧拉方程是否比经典耗散机制更有效。特别是，HD 欧拉方程的零粘度极限是否有可能产生多维冲击波，这些极限是否足够严格以排除可压缩欧拉方程的伪（非物理）弱解？这可能会改变相对论流体动力学及其众多应用，从天体物理学到核聚变反应堆中的等离子体约束问题。

21500824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21500824.value: 理解早期儿童干预项目效果机制以及分析儿童技能测度方法

21500824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21500824.value: Early childhood is a crucial stage of development and education in these early years can have long-lasting effects. Many early childhood education interventions have shown significant positive impacts on children's skill development. Some even lead to positive effects on long-term labor market outcomes such as education and wages. Despite much research in this area, several questions remain unanswered in this field, including: (a) how to measure skill and skill development across different ages based on different skill measure instruments; (b) what are the key mechanisms for the successful early childhood interventions to boost children skill development and even generate long-term effects (post-intervention period) on children's skill development; (c) what are the cost-effective policies to boost children skill development. In this proposal, we will conduct the new round longitudinal data collection for the largest early childhood intervention in China: the China REACH (Huachi) project, in which we will follow these children up to the teenage range in 2024. We will use longitudinal data from 2015--2017, 2019, and 2024, and will develop research in three directions: First, we plan to develop a framework to measure skills and to evaluate the dynamic formation and growth of children's skills, even if the skills are measured by different instruments at different ages. Second, we plan to examine how interactions among the child, parent (caregiver), and home visitor affect children's skill development and the impacts of early childhood education intervention during the post-intervention period. Third, we will implement different counterfactual policies (i.e., cash transfer, home visiting, and center-based early childhood education) to evaluate their cost-effectiveness policies for children's skill development and household welfare. 许多早期儿童干预措施对儿童技能发展显示出显着的积极影响，甚至对其长期劳动力市场表现（例如教育成都和工资）产生积极影响。该领域的研究仍然有几个主要问题需要回答：（a）如何根据不同的技能测量工具来测量不同年龄段的技能和技能发展； (b) 成功进行儿童干预以促进儿童技能发展甚至对儿童技能发展产生长期影响（干预后阶段）的关键机制是什么； (c) 有哪些具有成本效益的政策来促进儿童技能发展。 在本项目中，我们将对中国最大的儿童早期干预项目：慧育中国（华池）项目的儿童进行跟踪，跟踪这些儿童直至青少年范围。鉴于此项目是目前中国唯一的针对早期儿童干预项目跨期十年的追踪数据，我们在三个方向开展研究：首先，我们计划开发一个衡量技能和技能增长的框架。在研究中，我们将利用技能形成技术的框架来扩展潜在增长曲线分析，并将开发最先进的动态分析方法。我们将用更新颖的方法来了解孩子的技能是如何动态发展的。我们计划开发一个关于如何衡量技能以及如何理解技能形成过程的框架，即使技能是在不同年龄段用不同的测度工具来衡量的。其次，我们计划进行研究，以了解早期儿童干预如何在干预后时期产生影响。根据2019年和2024年的后续数据，我们将扩展我们的框架，研究成功的幼儿干预的关键机制，以促进儿童的技能发展，甚至对儿童的技能发展产生长期影响（干预后时期）。此外，根据结构模型的估计，我们可以实施不同的反事实政策（即现金转移、家访和中心幼儿教育），然后找到具有成本效益的儿童技能发展和家庭福利政策。

21505524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21505524.value: 刪失分位數回歸之擴展：時間相關協變量及龐大數據

21505524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21505524.value: 分位數迴歸 (QR) 由 Koenker and Bassett (1978) 於計量經濟學中提出，而其對右刪失事件時間的變體則稱為刪失分位數迴歸 (CQR)。QR及CQR與傳統的線性迴歸不同，著重於分析協變量如何影響應變量的條件分位數，而非其條件平均值。QR容許協變量效應隨分位數水平而變化，可以有效抵抗誤差異質性，從而分析應變量的整個條件分佈，因此被廣泛應用在各種計量經濟學和統計學的範疇，包括勞動經濟和信用分析。 在時距分析，或稱生存分析、事件時間分析中，應用CQR技術面臨雙重挑戰。首先，某些協變量在此類追蹤研究中無可避免地隨時間變化，因為數據本身是隨著時間的推移而收集的，例如在違約時間研究中，債務償還記錄和利率歷史記錄等資訊都與時間相關。現有文獻大多只著重在不隨時間變化的協變量上，而擴展到隨時間變化的協變量則相對複雜，因其計數過程是根據分位數過程來計時的。另外，巨量數據在大數據時代於各種商業環境中更加普遍，這給根據小數據而開發的傳統方法帶來了巨大的計算負擔。尤其CQR在計算上比QR更具挑戰性，因為後者是一個凸優化問題，可以透過線性規劃來實現，但刪失版本的前者則欠缺此特點。 我們希望透過這個計劃書在兩個方面擴展CQR模型。第一個想法是我們先前工作 (Chu, Sit and Ying, 2023) 的延續，此前我們討論了如何在CQR中處理時間相關協變量，現在我們將競爭風險框架引入此模型。即當對象受到多於一個而又互相關聯的失敗原因時，研究如何納入時間相關協變量，我們提出一種遞推算法以估計整個迴歸參數的過程。第二個方向是研究CQR的最佳子取樣方法，以便以有限的運算資源處理巨量資料。我們推導出最佳的子取樣程序，使得根據此子樣本得出的估算有著最小的漸近均方誤差，透過子採樣從大量數據中最佳地提取資訊，為大數據分析提供了一個實用的解決方案。我們將在這兩個項目中研究實際可行的計算程序，並開發軟體包以供業務分析師、計量經濟學家和統計學家等應用此方法。

21505624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21505624.value: 基於忠誠的國家控制：檢視專制政權下董事會政治意識形態對公司決策的影響

21505624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21505624.value: This project investigates how autocratic governments control firms through exposure of their elite decision makers to state political ideology. By highlighting the congruence of political actors around a singular set of ideological doctrines in autocratic regimes, we argue that corporate elites exposed to state political ideology develop loyalty to the ruling political party, thus becoming “agents of the state” who facilitate corporate conformity with evolving state public policies by influencing boardroom decision making. This loyalty can be used as a tool for state control over firms, as it allows the top leader to interpret the prevailing political ideology personally to redirect the prescribed behavior for these loyal agents. We further explore differences in receptivity to this loyalty-based control mechanism, proposing that the effectiveness of political-ideological control is more pronounced in regions that bear the imprints of the top leader’s historical power base but less conspicuous in regions with a stronger bureaucratic presence, rendering them less susceptible to policy swings. We exploit China’s 2012 political-ideological transition from “Dengism” to “Xiism” to test our ideas. Our study demonstrates how political-ideological beliefs and corporate elite decisions evolve in tandem in autocratic contexts, and it advances management scholarship on the role of political ideologies in the boardroom by emphasizing the corporate control function of state political ideology. 該計畫調查專制政府如何透過讓精英決策者接觸國家政治意識形態來控制企業。透過強調獨裁政權中政治行為者圍繞一套單一意識形態學說的一致性，我們認為，接觸國家政治意識形態的企業精英會發展出對執政政黨的忠誠，從而成為“國家代理人”，促進企業與不斷發展的企業保持一致。這種忠誠度可以用作國家控制企業的工具，因為它允許最高領導人親自解釋流行的政治意識形態，以重新引導這些忠誠代理人的規定行為。我們進一步探討了對這種基於忠誠的控制機制的接受度差異，提出政治意識形態控制的有效性在有最高領導人歷史權力基礎印記的地區更為明顯，但在官僚存在較強的地區則不那麼明顯。我們利用中國2012年從「鄧主義」到「習主義」的政治意識形態轉變來檢驗我們的想法。我們的研究展示了政治意識形態信念和企業精英決策如何在專制背景下同步演變，並透過強調國家政治意識形態的企業控制功能，推進了關於政治意識形態在董事會中的作用的管理研究。

21507024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21507024.value: 同时走路和嚼口香糖？评估工会化工厂的环境绩效

21507024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21507024.value: This study will examine the impact of labor unions on the trade-offs in social performance within firms, focusing on employee welfare and environmental performance. While unions play a vital role in shaping organizational practices and improving employee welfare, we argue that they may inadvertently compromise an organization's commitment to other stakeholders, particularly in regard to environmental sustainability. We leverage a unique longitudinal dataset of U.S manufacturing facilities, integrating the Toxic Release Inventory (TRI), Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service (FMCS) records, and Dun and Bradstreet (D&B) Historical Data File. Our preliminary findings suggest that unionized facilities increase the overall release of pollution. However, total, and accidental release of substances that are particularly harmful (OSHA chemicals) to employees who handle or are exposed to these chemicals are reduced. Based on our preliminary findings, we demonstrate there exists both a trade-off and complementary relationship between union presence and environmental performance, highlighting the complexity of balancing stakeholders' needs in resource-constrained situations. The objective of our research is to enhance the understanding of labor unions' influence on environmental performance and to highlight the importance of a balanced approach to stakeholder interests for sustainable organizational practices. 本研究将探讨工会对企业内部社会绩效权衡的影响，重点关注员工福利和环境绩效。虽然工会在塑造组织实践和改善员工福利方面发挥着至关重要的作用，但我们认为，它们可能会无意中削弱组织对其他利益相关者，特别是环境可持续性承诺的力度。我们利用了一份独特的纵向数据集，涵盖了美国制造设施，整合了《有毒物质释放清单》（TRI）、联邦调解与调停服务（FMCS）记录和邓白氏历史数据文件（D&B）。我们的初步研究结果表明，工会化的工厂增加了污染物的整体排放。然而，对员工处理或暴露的特别有害物质（OSHA化学品）的总排放和意外排放有所减少。基于我们的初步发现，我们展示了工会存在与环境绩效之间既有权衡又有互补关系，突出了在资源有限的情况下平衡利益相关者需求的复杂性。我们的研究目标是加深对工会对环境绩效影响的理解，并强调在可持续的组织实践中平衡利益相关者利益的重要性。

21611724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21611724.value: 立言不朽：庾信在古代物質文化史中的接受與重構

21611724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21611724.value: This proposed project mainly studies the perception of “immortality through words” in the Northern and Southern Dynasties with the reception history of Yu Xin’s (513–581)庾信 inscriptional literature as major primary sources from inter-disciplinary perspectives. The project consists of three parts. The first part focuses on Yu Xin’s famous inscription on Maijishan Buddhist caves in today’s Gansu. The PI will theoretically study the ritualistic and artistic functions of inscriptions in Buddhist space. It also explores what the reconstruction of the lost Maijishan inscription in the Ming dynasty in the form of a free-standing stele can inform us of Yu Xin’s poetic image and his literary immortality. The second part studies the material culture of Northern Zhou entombed epitaphs. The environmental and economic history of the epitaph-producing industry deepens the understanding of labor mobility and deployment of natural resources in early medieval northern China under the non-Chinese Xianbei rule. Yu Xin and his families' theoretical development and practice of calligraphy contributed to the making of Northern Zhou tomb inscriptions. The third part studies how Yu Xin’s poetic works were received in calligraphy and paintings since the Tang dynasty. Several levels of historical and theoretical knowledge are expected to be achieved in this project. Firstly, it helps to evaluate Yu Xin’s literary achievement and essential role in traditional Chinese material culture. Yu Xin's contribution to material culture, in particular, has been generally overlooked in previous scholarship. Secondly, it helps to understand the interconnectivity between textuality and materiality. These discussions will benefit theorists of literature, art history, and material culture. Thirdly, it helps to enhance our knowledge about the social and economic history of the Northern Zhou. Finally, it will advance the understanding of "achieving immortality through words" from the perspective of the material bearer of words, namely, stone materials. In addition to its academic value, this project will also help train undergraduate students in art curatorship, as a small in-person or online exhibition will be held after the research’s completion. This exhibition will also enrich the cultural life of people in and outside of Hong Kong. In the long term, it would also potentially inform the general public of traditional funerary practices so that the funeral services industry might introduce innovative burial methods to people. 本研究項目旨在以庾信為例，探討南北朝時期對於「立言以不朽」觀念的理解和實踐。以庾信（513-581）的碑志書寫為主要研究對象，利用跨學科的研究視角進行分析。項目分為三個主要部分： 第一部分集中討論庾信在甘肅麥積山石窟撰寫的銘文。一方面從理論上探討碑文在佛教空間中的儀式和藝術功能，另一方面還原歷史情境，探討明代以獨立石碑形式重建失傳的麥積山銘文對於理解庾信詩歌形象及其文學不朽性所能提供的啟示。 第二部分著重於北周時期墓志銘的物質文化研究。旨在深入探索墓志銘製作行業的社會環境和經濟背景，期待加深對鮮卑族統治下北周時期早期勞動力流動和自然資源利用的理解。同時，也嘗試探索庾信及其家族在書法理論與實踐上的貢獻，與北周墓志銘的製作產生了怎樣的交互影響。 第三部分則聚焦於庾信詩歌作品自唐代以來在書法和繪畫中的接受與傳承情況，從文本和圖像互動的角度理解後代的藝術創作如何理解、重構庾信的文本形象。 本項目預期在歷史和理論兩個層面上取得新的學術成果。首先，它將有助於重新評價庾信的文學成就及其在中國傳統物質文化中的影響和貢獻，這在以往的研究中常被忽視。其次，項目將深化對文本與物質性之間相互關係的理解，為文學理論、藝術史和物質文化研究提供新的視角。再者，它將增進我們對北周時期社會經濟背景的認識。最後，從石碑作為文字物質載體的角度出發，項目將深化對「立言以不朽」概念的理解。 除學術價值外，本項目亦將促進本科生藝術策展能力的培養。研究完成後，將舉辦小型實體或在線展覽，從長遠來看，本項目有望提升公眾對傳統葬禮習俗的認識。

21613224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21613224.value: 針對香港男性接種 HPV 疫苗的溝通策略研究

21613224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21613224.value: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is the most common sexually transmitted infection worldwide and is linked to cervical, anogenital, and oropharyngeal cancers. The rising rate of HPV infection among males, as well as their poorer immune response to and lower literacy about the virus compared to females, has prompted alarm among health experts. There is an urgent need to promote HPV vaccination among males, and evidence-based communication strategies can play an important role in this promotion. One solution is to examine evidence-based health intervention strategies by experimentally testing the intrinsic correspondence between strategic language use and recipients’ change in attitudes and behavioral intentions. However, the vast majority of studies investigating HPV communication strategies have focused on attitude change in North American participants, leaving the Hong Kong context largely underexplored. Different from American samples who are mostly L1 English speakers, Hong Kong residents are mostly bilingual speakers of L1 Chinese and L2 English. This is an essential difference in understanding health messaging because L1 English speakers tend to follow an individualistic cultural orientation and attend to their own health concerns, whereas L1 Chinese speakers tend to follow a collectivist cultural orientation and care for both the self and related ones. Building on the PI's previous work on persuasive health message design, this project will employ a between-subject factorial design to experimentally test main and interaction effects of four evidence-based linguistic strategies on recipients' health beliefs and behavioral intentions regarding HPV vaccination. These four strategies are selected because of their demonstrated impact on people’s attitudes toward HPV or similar health threats. The persuasive mechanism of these messages derives from the Extended Parallel Process Model (EPPM), which describes how people can be motivated to adopt prosocial actions by taking advantage of their natural tendency to control fearful emotions. The primary efficacy hypothesis is that the aforementioned four message influence strategies, individually and in combination, will encourage accurate beliefs about HPV among the participants (e.g., consider HPV as more threatening, more susceptible, and more willing to get vaccinated). These hypotheses will be tested using an online survey of 800 male adults from Hong Kong. On a theoretical level, this project experimentally tests the applicability of EPPM in the bilingual Hong Kong context, contributing to a culturally sensitive health communication model. On a practical level, this project offers evidence-based health intervention strategies that can be easily employed by healthcare providers, pharmacists, and governmental agencies. 人類乳突病毒 (HPV) 是全世界最常見的性傳染感染，可能導致子宮頸癌、肛門生殖器癌和口咽癌等多種癌症。與女性相比，男性 HPV 感染率不斷上升，而且他們對病毒的免疫反應較差，對這一病毒的了解也較少，這引起了健康專家的警覺。當前研究迫切需要在男性中推廣 HPV 疫苗接種，基於證據的健康溝通策略研究可以在這項推廣中發揮重要作用。一種解決方案是透過實驗檢測言語策略使用與受眾態度和行為意圖變化之間的內在對應關係來探究基於證據的健康幹預策略。然而，絕大多數針對 HPV 傳播策略的研究都僅關注北美參與者的態度變化，而鮮有針對香港居民的相關研究。與美國樣本大多以英語為母語的人不同，香港居民大多是使用中文和英文的雙語人士。這一語言差異可能導致理解健康訊息的本質差異，因為前人研究表明說英文的人傾向於遵循個人主義的文化取向並關注自己的健康問題，而說中文的人則傾向於遵循集體主義的文化取向並關心自我和相關的人。 基於項目主持人先前在說服性健康策略設計方面的研究，該項目將採用主體間因子設計來實驗測試四種基於證據的語言策略對接受者關於HPV 疫苗接種的健康信念和行為意圖的主要影響和交互影響。選擇這四種策略是因為它們對人們對 HPV 或類似健康威脅的態度產生了明顯的影響。這些訊息的說服機制源自於擴展平行過程模型（EPPM），該模型描述如何利用人們控制恐懼情緒的自然傾向來激勵人們採取健康促進行為。主要的研究假設是：上述四種話語影響策略，無論是單獨或組合，都將有助於參與者對 HPV 形成更為準確的認識（例如，認為 HPV 更具威脅性、更容易受到感染並且更願意接種疫苗）。這些假設將透過對 800 名香港成年男性進行的線上調查進行檢驗。 在理論層面上，該計畫透過實驗測試了 EPPM 在香港雙語背景下的適用性，有助於建立基於文化特性的健康溝通模式。在實踐層面上，該項目提供了基於證據的健康幹預策略，可供醫務人員和相關政府機構採用。

21613924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21613924.value: 女性主義文學翻譯與另類歷史小說的語言工作

21613924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21613924.value: 此計畫探討了全球英語文學學術中一個重要但又被嚴重忽視的面向：文學翻譯的作用，以及語言、民族和性別的形式。背後的偏見塑造了我們所謂的「世界文學」的規範輪廓。長期以來，翻譯一直受到懷疑或嘲笑，但它卻越來越受到人們的推崇。布克(Man Booker) 在 2016年決定將國際布克獎(Man Booker Prize) 頒給作者和譯者年鞏固了這種觀念的轉變，承認翻譯是一種獨特且同樣重要的文學創作形式。在這項具有里程碑意義的決定之後，其他主要獎項也紛紛效仿，獎項和獎項致力於英語文學翻譯的選集激增（Alter）。人們對翻譯小說興趣的增長暴露了許多長期在英語文學翻譯界不平等的現象。其中包括代表的源語言範圍的不平等(主要是歐洲浪漫語言，以犧牲亞洲和非洲語言）；翻譯作者方面的性別差異 （絕大多數是男性）；譯者和作者方面的種族差異（絕大多數是白色）（Venuti 2019；Patel & Youssef 2022） 。從歷史上看，世界文學被定位為糾正這些盲點，其想法是透過閱讀超越 國家、文化和語言的邊界，英語文學變得更加多元化、包容性。但是，儘管世界文學在以下方面做出了令人欽佩的工作： 使經典多樣化，將翻譯小說無縫同化為「世界文學」——這要求令翻譯政治在很大程度上不受質疑—這只起到了強化作用上述不平等現象並沒有減少。在我的專案中，我透過論述女性主義的重要性來解決這些世界文學研究上的關鍵盲點。我審視越來越多的我稱之為「另類歷史小說」的文學作品：透過其特定的表逹形式和實驗性，展示了歷史寫作如何與文學翻譯是並行的實踐，需要作者才能做出價值判斷圍繞記錄中要保留、特出和省略的內容。審視一系列翻譯 作品中的策略與實踐, 當中包括R. F.Kuang、Theresa Cha、M. NourbeSe Philip、Trish Salah、Marie-Célie Agnant、Naomi Fontaine, and Xu Xi的作品。我認為這些另類歷史小說 有助於闡明塑造世界文學經典的偏見，同時也引起人們注意那些被認為不利於民族主義對世界歷史的敘述的主題和故事。我也透過對這些著作中多樣化的女性主義政治的仔細參與，展示如何用女性主義的文學翻譯方法可以糾正這些偏見，同時開拓國際和多語言合作的機會。

21614424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21614424.value: 探索早期尼德蘭繪畫意圖性修改的歷史理解

21614424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21614424.value: Old master paintings are presented within public collections as static objects, hanging on a wall isolated, preserved, and frozen. This current method of display concentrates on retrieving and conserving the authentic state of these paintings. As a result, non-original additions made to old master paintings are often removed by art conservators, even when they were made in the past by other famous masters. Telling is the recent removal of overpaints applied by well-established masters, Lancelot Blondeel and Jan van Scorel, around 1550 to the Ghent Altarpiece – a large-scale altarpiece made about a century earlier by Hubert and Jan van Eyck. About 70% of the original surface was overpainted, and these overpaints were removed to again reveal the original form. The Ghent Altarpiece is not a unique example of an old master painting that has been altered profoundly in the past. Ample material evidence has come to light revealing that many old master paintings were altered relatively soon after their conception. Often these alterations result from damage or repairs that come with time, though sometimes these alterations were intentionally made to transform the painting's original form. These intentional alterations not only include adaptations like overpainting but also enlargements, repositioning, and deletions. Despite the abundant evidence on their existence, little interest has been shown in the historical significance of intentional alterations. This project remedies this issue by focusing on altered early Netherlandish paintings, including the Ghent Altarpiece. These paintings were produced in the Low Countries (roughly corresponding to present-day Belgium and The Netherlands) between 1400 and 1550. The project will investigate the hypothesis that intentional alterations were motivated by broader historical changes that took place during the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries within Netherlandish society, including the birth of the art market, civic elite formation, and the dawn of the reformation. This hypothesis is grounded in previous findings on intentional alterations of Italian Renaissance art and of early Netherlandish illuminated manuscripts. To test the hypothesis, recently digitized datasets containing material evidence of intentional alterations of early Netherlandish paintings will be analyzed. Specifically, the aim of the analysis is to identify relationships between historical changes – economic, social, religious, and political – and intentional alterations made to early Netherlandish paintings. This project elucidates as such the significance of intentional alterations, not only as material changes, but as historical sources that further help us to understand the complex relation between art and society.

22105524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22105524.value: 研究植物中O-fucose修飾和 O-GlcNAc修飾介導的新型營養訊號傳導機制

22105524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22105524.value: Photosynthetic organisms provide food, energy, shelter, therapeutics, and a large diversity of vital biomolecules that sustain human life. The metabolic processes that produce these products are regulated by complex nutrient signaling pathways that are essential and highly conserved across kingdoms. Instead of being passively absorbed and fed into metabolic pathways, nutrient molecules such as nitrate, sugar, and their derivatives act as signals to regulate nutrient assimilation, metabolism, storage, as well as growth and developmental processes critical for plant productivity and nutritional values. Two forms of vital sugar metabolites, uridine 5′-diphospho-N-acetylglucosamine (UDP-GlcNAc) and guanosine 5′-diphospho-β-L-fucose (GDP-fucose), are used as donor substrates by SECRET AGENT (SEC) and SPINDLY (SPY) respectively. They modify the serine and threonine residues of many nucleocytoplasmic proteins in a reversible and dynamic manner. These two forms of essential post-translational modifications (PTM), known as O-linked-N-acetylglucosaminylation (O-GlcNAcylation) and O-linked fucosylation (O-fucosylation), are believed to represent evolutionarily conserved regulatory mechanisms that modulate protein functions and cellular responses according to energy and nutrient availability. Compromising O-GlcNAcylation and O-fucosylation causes lethality in both animals and plants. Despite their essential functions, the study of O-GlcNAcylation and O-fucosylation (collectively termed O-glycosylation) in plants is still in its infancy. There is widespread speculation that O-GlcNAcylation and O-fucosylation play a role in metabolic signaling in plants, but there is no direct evidence to support this hypothesis. Our team aims to investigate how O-glycosylation modulates nutrient signaling using Arabidopsis as a model. Preliminary results indicate that SPY and SEC play important roles in nitrate signaling and sugar signaling. Proteomic studies done by us show that key transcriptional and translational regulators in nitrate signaling and sugar signaling are O-GlcNAc and O-fucose modified. The proposed project will investigate if and how O-glycosylation of these candidates modulate nitrate and sugar signaling processes, using a combination of proteomics, transcriptomics, genetic, microscopic, and biochemical approaches. We will also screen for other direct and indirect SPY/SEC targets that modulate sugar signaling and perform functional studies. Importantly, we will investigate if and how O-glycosylation serves as a sugar sensor to mediate sugar sensing and growth regulation. Our proposed study will generate novel insight into plant metabolic signaling, providing theoretical basis for genetic engineering to boost crop yield and quality. Notably, O-GlcNAcylation is closely related to many diseases and O-fucosylation modulates virulence of parasites. Knowledge gained on the conserved molecular functions of O-glycosylation could also be useful for advancing healthcare. 光合生物提供了人類生存所須的食物、能量、建材、藥物以及其他多種重要生物分子。複雜的營養訊號路徑調節著產生這些物質的代謝過程，且在各生物界中都不可或缺且高度保守。糖和氮等營養分子及其衍生物並非只是被動地由細胞吸收並進入代謝途徑，它們也充當調節營養吸收、代謝及儲存的信號來調控植物的生長和發育過程，這對植物的產量和營養價值有重要的影響。 UDP-GlcNAc和GDP-fucose是兩種重要的糖代謝物，SEC和SPY糖基轉移酶分別以這兩種糖代謝物為底物，以可逆和動態的方式對許多細胞核與細胞質蛋白進行O-GlcNAc修飾和O-fucose修飾。一般認為這兩種翻譯後修飾介導了進化保守的能量和營養訊號的調節途徑。 O-GlcNAc修飾和O-fucose修飾的缺失會導致動物和植物的死亡。 儘管O-GlcNAc修飾和O-fucose修飾具有重要功能，但它們在植物中的研究仍處於起步階段。在植物中，O-GlcNAc修飾和O-fucose修飾被認為在代謝信號傳導中發揮作用，但尚未有直接證據支持這一假說。我們將以擬南芥為模式生物，研究O-GlcNAc修飾和O-fucose修飾如何在植物中調節營養訊號的傳導。 我們的初步結果顯示SPY和SEC在氮訊號和糖訊號傳導中發揮重要作用。我們的蛋白質體學研究表明，一些氮訊號和糖訊號傳導中的重要因子受到了O-GlcNAc修飾和O-fucose修飾。我們將結合蛋白質體學、轉錄組學、遺傳學、顯微鏡觀察和生物化學等實驗方法， 研究O-GlcNAc修飾和O-fucose修飾如何透過這些因子調控氮訊號傳導和糖訊號傳導。我們也將篩選其他可能調節糖訊號傳導的直接或間接的 SPY/SEC 標靶並進行功能研究。更進一步，我們將研究O-GlcNAc修飾和O-fucose修飾是否以及如何發揮糖感受器的作用來介導糖感應和生長調節。 這項研究將揭示植物營養代謝訊號調控的新機制，並為植物基因工程提供作物增量和提升品質的理論基礎。值得注意的是，O-GlcNAc修飾與多種疾病密切相關，O-fucose修飾具有調節寄生蟲毒性的作用。關於 O-GlcNAc修飾和O-fucose修飾的進化保守的分子功能的認知也可能有助於推進醫療研究。

22107124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22107124.value: 植物UFMylation修飾調控環境脅迫誘導過氧化物酶體自噬的分子機制的研究

22107124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22107124.value: Ufmylation is a ubiquitination-like post-translational modification (PTM) system identified in the past decade. In mammals, it has been revealed to be closely associated with DNA repair, autophagy, and endoplasmic reticulum (ER) homeostasis, where its dysfunction causes embryo lethality, serious developmental defects, and affects cancer progression. Ufmylation cascade is revealed to interplay with autophagy, the degradation pathway for bulky cytosolic materials and organelles upon nutrient deprivation or stress induction. In plants, we have identified the E3 ligase of the ufmylation system, Ufl1, as an interactor of the autophagy marker ATG8 under salt stress condition to regulate ER-stress associated reticulophagy (ER-phagy). Coordinately, the C53/UFL1/DDRGK1 receptor complex is also proved to regulate plant reticulophagy. We hypothesize that besides reticulophagy, ufmylation plays multiple roles in regulate distinct stress-induced pathways, especially selective autophagy. The current knowledge of plant selective autophagy receptors and ufmylation is rudimentary, with few known receptors or substrates characterized. Our first aim is to conduct pull-down assays followed by mass spectrometry (MS) using Ufl1 as bait to reveal its candidate interactors as well as the potential plant ufmylome. In our preliminary screening, the presence of canonical Ufl1 interactors in the list strengthens the screening assay. Candidates were then grouped based on their subcellular localization and biological functions. We identified multiple peroxisomal proteins as potential Ufl1 interactors and hypothesized that Ufl1 might function in mediating peroxisome homeostasis under oxidative stresses which potentially involves the autophagy pathway. In this proposal, we have extended and will further conduct our study to verify the interaction of the candidates with Ufl1 or other ufmylation components and investigate the molecular mechanisms by which ufmylation regulates peroxisome homeostasis by pexophagy. This study will establish a clear mechanistic understanding of how ufmylation functions in maintaining cellular homeostasis under stress conditions and provide novel insights into how this process contributes to plant responses to environmental stresses. UFMylation是一種近年發現的類似泛素化的翻譯後修飾體系。在哺乳動物中，它已被證實與DNA修復、自噬和內質網穩態密切相關，其功能失調會導致嚴重的發育缺陷、胚胎致死，並影響癌症進程等。有研究表明，UFMylation途徑與自噬相關。自噬是在營養缺乏或壓力誘導下降解細胞內大分子物質及細胞器的途徑。在植物中，我們已發現UFMylation體系的E3連接酶UFL1在高鹽脅迫條件下是自噬體的重要標記蛋白ATG8的互作蛋白，並調控與內質網壓力相關的內質網自噬過程。此外，C53/UFL1/DDRGK1複合體也被證明在植物內質網自噬中起重要調控作用。我們推測，除內質網自噬外，UFMylation在調節多種由環境脅迫誘導的自噬途徑尤其是選擇性自噬中發揮多重作用。 目前，有關植物選擇性自噬受體和UFMylation的研究還處於初級階段，只有少數受體或底物被鑒定。我們的第一個目標是使用UFL1作為誘餌，通過拉下（pull-down）實驗和質譜分析尋找UFL1互作候選蛋白以及潛在植物UFMylation底物庫（UFMylome）。在初步篩選中，我們於列表中發現了已知的UFL1互作蛋白，增強了我們對篩選結果的信心。隨後我們根據初步篩選出的候選蛋白的亞細胞定位和生物學功能對其進行分類，並鑒定出多個過氧化物酶體蛋白作為潛在的UFL1互作蛋白。我們推測，UFL1可能在氧化壓力下通過自噬途徑調節過氧化物酶體的穩態。在此項目中，我們將進一步驗證這些候選蛋白與UFL1或其他UFMylation體系蛋白的互作，並探討UFMylation通過過氧化物酶體自噬調節過氧化物酶體穩態的分子機制。本研究將幫助闡明UFMylation系統如何在環境壓力條件下維持細胞穩態，並為植物應對環境壓力的機制提供新見解。

22200324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22200324.value: 无线边缘网络中的分布式机器学习：计算和通信的联合在线优化

22200324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22200324.value: 现代无线边缘网络（如设备到设备和物联网系统）支持广泛的计算和通信应用（如自动驾驶和智慧城市）。在这些应用中，机器学习将涉及大数据计算，这可能会给传统的中央服务器带来沉重的负担。我们提出的研究将利用分布式优化在本地设备上来缓解沉重的计算负担。然而，将优化从中央服务器迁移到本地设备会产生大量的通信开销。这鼓励我们开发通信高效的分布式优化方法，这需要机器学习和无线通信技术的结合。 大多数现有研究中，机器学习和无线通信是分别考虑的。然而，由于通信效率和待传输的计算结果之间存在强烈依赖关系，我们可以通过主动优化通信来显著提高计算性能，反之亦然。同时，大多数现有研究忽略了在线优化，而在线优化通常需要适应不断变化的计算任务和通信系统。在本提案中，我们的目标是回答以下关键研究问题：如何开发联合考虑计算和通信的在线分布式优化算法，用于无线边缘网络的机器学习？ 在本提案中，我们提倡对先前分离的离线机器学习和无线通信解决方案进行整体的联合在线设计。我们必须解决的一个主要挑战是无线设备和边缘主机的有限且动态的计算和通信能力。此外,由于计算和通信之间存在强烈依赖关系，我们需要共同考虑它们对学习性能和通信成本的影响。此外，无线设备、边缘主机和云服务器之间在计算和通信方面的有效协作对整个系统性能至关重要。 为了解决上述关键优化问题中的这些挑战，我们提出：1） 通过设计基于信息新鲜度的在线调度算法来解决“何时优化”的问题，以优化在有限通信资源下的异步计算在线分布式学习性能；2） 通过探索新的分布式约束在线优化理论来解决“优化什么”的问题，在动态计算和通信系统下，共同考虑机器学习模型训练的改进和模型聚合的成本；3） 通过开发在线分布式鲁棒学习框架来解决“在哪里优化”的问题，以有效协调无线设备、边缘主机和云服务器在多层次分层网络上的计算和通信性能权衡。最后，我们将开发验证概念原型系统来演示我们提案的性能。 凭借我们在分布式学习、无线网络和在线优化方面的丰富研究经验，我们希望本项目的成果能够引领新的集成计算-通信应用，从而加速分布式机器学习技术和无线边缘智能在相关行业的发展和利用。

22200824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22200824.value: 為負責任的視覺決策而設計的連貫思維提示框架

22200824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22200824.value: 該研究項目旨在透過將自然語言解釋整合到決策過程中,來提高機器視覺模型的可解釋性。現有的機器視覺模型通常作為黑箱運行,缺乏人類可理解的可解釋性,尤其是在高風險的醫療保健和自動駕駛等應用中。雖然現有工作已經提出了各種方法來解決人工智能的可解釋性問題,但它們通常無法提供通俗易懂的解釋,並且過度依賴特定領域的專業知識。為了應對這些挑戰,該項目提出了一種新穎的基於思路鏈的提示方法,以自然語言作為解釋媒介,將自然語言解釋融入決策過程。具體來說,該項目旨在開發: (i) 高效的提示學習方法,將大型語言模型轉變為處理圖像和文本的多模態智能體;(ii) 全面的視覺-語言對齊策略,以在預訓練的大型語言模型中實現對齊;(iii) 強大的學習策略,使得對齊後的視覺-語言模型能夠進行思路鏈推理並產生可操作的預測。這將有助於增強模型的問責制,並使用戶能夠識別和減輕現實應用中的偏見、錯誤或意外行為。該項目的研究成果和相關資源將公開發布,以促進可解釋和負責任的視覺智能的發展。

22300124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22300124.value: In the present era, the utilization of AI in decision-making processes has become an increasing practice. However, recent reports have drawn attention to the potential unequal treatment by AI-driven decisions to different social groups. Moreover, recent laws and regulations also enforce fair treatment by automatic decisions. Consequently, the concept of algorithmic fairness has gained significant attention. From a statistical point of view, the goal of algorithmic fairness is to ensure equitable outcomes for all social groups involved in machine learning classification tasks. Starting from this perspective, we aim to tackle two problems in this project: firstly, how can institutions like banks and companies find a balance between prioritizing algorithmic fairness and maintaining the efficiency that they seek by using statistical learning; and secondly, how can fair and efficient classifiers be trained in a scenario where label noise occurs because of biases in the existing datasets as a result of historical inequalities. Addressing these complex challenges is of utmost significance in order to establish decision-making processes in AI that are both fair and efficient. To address the first question regarding the dual focus on efficiency and fairness, we introduce the Neyman-Pearson (NP) classification paradigm, which measures institutional efficiency in industries like finance and medical diagnosis. Moreover, as there are various fairness criteria, each serving a specific purpose or scenario, we propose a comprehensive framework that combines the NP classification with any algorithmic fairness criterion. Additionally, we present a classifier-training algorithm that can be applied to any classification method, such as logistic regression, ensuring that the resulting classifier meets the requirements of both efficiency and fairness with high probability. In addressing the second question regarding training under label noise, we propose a robust method that can also be adapted to any classification method. Specifically, we utilize the median-of-means method, a robust statistical estimation technique, to mitigate the impact of label noise during the training process of the fair NP classifier. This method is capable of handling arbitrary types of label noise, as long as the proportion of mislabeled data remains low. By incorporating the median-of-means method, our proposed approach ensures robustness in the presence of label noise, allowing for more accurate and reliable classification outcomes for fairness-efficiency dual focus. 随着大数据技术在各个行业的深入应用，其人工智能算法所带来的社会效应受到了广泛关注。在这样的背景下，算法公平性成为了近年来研究和讨论的热点。另一方面，人工智能的有效性，特别是在关键的二元分类领域，对于用户来讲同样至关重要。在许多应用场景下，一个分类器的有效性取决于它能否满足不同重要性级别的分类需求。因此，本项目着眼于在有效性与公平性之间寻求平衡。为了保证算法有效性，我们以可以处理不同重要性分类需求的Neyman-Pearson（NP）分类法作为出发点，关注NP分类方法在算法公平方面的交叉领域。我们以此为基础提出了两种融合NP框架和算法公平的方法，旨在同时实现二元分类的有效性和公平性：首先，我们提出一种在不同算法公平标准下实现NP分类的算法；其次，我们提出一种即便使用历史上不公平的数据也能训练出公平的Neyman-Pearson分类器的方法。

22300324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22300324.value: 高度有序的有機半導體薄膜中的強光-物質相互作用

22300324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22300324.value: Organic semiconductors are important optoelectronic materials that enabled high quality display applications and are rapidly entering new areas of applications such as photodetectors and flexible solar foils due to their inherent mechanical flexibility and promising optoelectronic properties. Despite these exciting developments, the charge carrier mobility in organic semiconductors is orders of magnitude lower than their inorganic counterparts limiting their device performance in terms of switching speed and power efficiency. While recent work on highly ordered organic semiconductor thin films show long-range order is effective in boost charge transport and operation speed of organic electronic devices, the carrier mobility achievable is still at least one order of magnitude lower than crystalline inorganic semiconductors. Exciton-polariton, quasi-particle formed by strong coupling of exciton and photons has been identified as one way to enhance charge transport in organic semiconductors by theoretical studies. However, there is a mixture of experimental results reported, some observed polariton enhanced charge transport while others didn’t. Since there isn’t a well-established protocol for the experiment, different groups use different cavity structures, and most studies probe the charge transport by a transistor structure often under dark conditions where the polaritons are not generated. In this proposal, we aim to characterize the charge of transport of highly ordered organic semiconductors under strong coupling regime using a set of state-of-the-art charge transport measurements to convincingly unveil the effect of polariton on charge transport of organic semiconductors. We will further investigate the conditions required to maximize the effect of polariton enhanced charge transport. Finally, a proof-of-concept photodetector device based on highly ordered organic semiconductor films under strong coupling will be prepared aiming to advance the organic electronic device performance to unprecedented level by combining the excellent transport of organic thin film crystals and the polariton-enhanced transport. 有機半導體是重要的光電材料，它實現了高品質顯示應用，並且由於其固有的機械靈活性和有前景的光電特性，正在迅速進入光電探測器和柔性太陽能箔等新的應用領域。儘管取得了這些令人興奮的進展，但有機半導體中的電荷載子遷移率比無機半導體低幾個數量級，限制了它們在開關速度和功率效率方面的器件性能。雖然最近對高度有序有機半導體薄膜的研究表明長程有序可有效提高有機電子器件的電荷傳輸和運行速度，但可實現的載流子遷移率仍比晶體無機半導體低至少一個數量級。理論研究表明，激子-極化子（激子與光子強耦合形成的準粒子）是增強有機半導體中電荷傳輸的一種方式。然而，報告的實驗結果多種多樣，有些觀察到極化子增強了電荷傳輸，而有些則沒有。由於實驗沒有完善的協議，不同的小組使用不同的光腔結構，並且大多數研究通常在不產生極化子的黑暗條件下探測晶體管結構的電荷傳輸。在本提案中，我們的目標是使用一組最先進的電荷傳輸測量來表徵強耦合狀態下高度有序的有機半導體的電荷傳輸，以令人信服地揭示極化子對有機半導體電荷傳輸的影響。我們將進一步研究最大化極化子增強電荷傳輸效果所需的條件。最後，我們將製備一種基於強耦合下高度有序有機半導體薄膜的概念驗證光電探測器裝置，旨在透過結合有機薄膜晶體的優異傳輸和極化子增強傳輸，將有機電子器件性能提高到前所未有的水平。

22303424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22303424.value: 經驗分布變換的統計建模：基于Wasserstein度量

22500324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22500324.value: 簡單與複雜的資訊：需求、信念更新與決策

22500324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22500324.value: Complexity has a profound impact on learning and decision-making. This paper analyzes how complexity of information structures affects belief updating and decision-making. More specifically, I investigate a novel notion of complexity related to the interpretability of information, which is overlooked in the literature. The complexity of information has become particularly important in recent years. Given that many social issues nowadays are multidimensional, so does the related information. It thus becomes ever more difficult to understand the underlying information structure and interpret information. For example, in the issue of global warming, despite many scientific studies pointing to its impact and scale, understanding and interpreting the results is difficult for laypeople which leads to skepticism and denial (cite{dunlap2013climate}). The aim of this project is to investigate the impact of the complexity/interpretability of the information structure on the demand for information, belief updating, and decision-making. With a series of experiments, I analyze whether and how much individuals prefer a ``simple'' but noisy information structure over a ``complex'' but informative information structure, which I call an informativeness-complexity trade-off. The trade-off would also imply that individuals tend to pay more attention to simple or easily-interpretable information. I also analyze how the complexity of information structure affects the belief updating and action chosen by individuals, and shed light on the underlying mechanism of the informativeness-complexity trade-off. In the short run, this project will generate at least one paper to be published in a top international journal in the field of economics as well as several presentations at conferences and seminars. In the longer run this project will have important implications for the literature of information design, advertisement, and persuasion, as it proposes a new characteristic of information structures that affects people's attention and belief formation. Moreover, it will help firms and governments to improve their informational policies to gain attention and maximize their effectiveness. 複雜性對學習和決策有著深遠的影響。本文分析了信息結構的複雜性如何影響信念更新和決策。更具體地，我研究了一個與信息可解釋性相關的新型複雜性概念，這在文獻中被忽視了。 近年來，鑑於當今許多社會問題和相關信息也都是多維度的，信息的複雜性變得尤其重要。因此，理解基本信息結構和解釋信息變得越來越困難。例如，在全球暖化問題上，儘管許多科學研究指出了其影響和規模，但對於非專業人士來說，理解和解釋結果是困難的，這導致了不同人對全球暖化的懷疑和否認（Dunlap (2013)）。 本項目的目的是研究信息結構的複雜性/可解釋性對信息需求、信念更新和決策的影響。通過一系列實驗，我分析個體是否以及在多大程度上偏好一個「簡單」的信息結構，而不是一個「複雜」但有更多信息量的信息結構，我稱之為信息量-複雜性權衡。這種權衡也意味著個人更傾向於關注簡單或易於解釋的信息。我還分析了信息結構的複雜性如何影響個體的信念更新和所選擇的行動，並揭示了信息量-複雜性權衡的潛在機制。 從短期來看，這個項目將至少產生一篇將發表在經濟領域國際頂級期刊的論文，以及在多個會議和研討會上的幾次演講。從長遠來看，這個項目將對信息設計、廣告和說服方面的文獻產生重要影響，因為它提出了一種影響人們注意力和信念形成的信息結構的新特性。此外，它將幫助企業和政府改進他們的信息政策，以獲得注意力並最大化其效果。

22501224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22501224.value: 交易所交易基金的流動性創造

22501224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22501224.value: This project aims to quantify the value of liquidity created by exchange-traded funds (ETFs) for retail investors. The measure of liquidity creation, originally from Chernenko and Doan (2022), compares the costs to retail investors of trading on their own in response to liquidity shocks with the costs incurred by ETFs when trading in response to fund flows. The introduction and increasing popularity of ETFs have provided retail investors with a cost-effective means to gain exposure to the broad financial markets. Several studies have examined the impact of ETFs on the trading of underlying assets, identifying both positive and negative effects. However, none of these studies have directly assessed the specific costs or benefits that retail investors derive from investing in these investment vehicles. Therefore, this project seeks to quantitatively measure the value of liquidity creation by ETFs in the U.S. municipal bond markets. Furthermore, it aims to provide further evidence and recommendations on how policy makers can effectively regulate ETFs to ensure the best outcomes for retail investors and maintain overall financial market stability. 這個專案旨在量化交易所交易基金（ETFs）為散戶投資者創造的流動性價值。流動性創造的衡量方式，最初來自Chernenko和Doan（2022），比較了散戶因流動性衝擊而自行交易所產生的成本與ETFs在基金流入時進行交易所產生的成本。ETFs的推出和日益普及為散戶投資者提供了一種成本效益高的方式來參與廣泛的金融市場。許多研究已經探討了ETFs對基礎資產交易的影響，並識別出正面和負面效應。然而，這些研究中沒有直接評估散戶從投資於這些投資工具中獲得的具體成本或利益。因此，這個專案旨在定量測量ETFs在美國市政債券市場中所創造的流動性價值。此外，它旨在提供更多證據和建議，以指導政策制定者如何有效監管ETFs，確保散戶投資者獲得最佳結果，並保持整體金融市場的穩定性。

22502424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22502424.value: Workers coming from lower social class backgrounds are disadvantaged in terms of long-term career success in higher-status occupations even when they attain a high level of education and work competence, an issue known as the “class ceiling.” Research trying to explain the class ceiling has focused predominantly on discrimination and bias that workers from lower social class backgrounds might face. I introduce a new theoretical perspective that highlights the role of workers’ social capital in explaining sources of the class ceiling. Among workers with high and comparable human capital and technical competence, social capital has been shown to be a major factor explaining differences in achievement (Bauer et al. 2007; Morrison 1993, 2002; Ng et al. 2005). This is imperative because psychological research has shown that individuals from lower social class backgrounds are more likely to experience higher social self-concerns in settings dominated by middle-class norms (e.g., Stephens et al., 2014) and prefer not to engage in political behavior (e.g., Belmi & Laurin, 2016). Since social capital is a strong candidate for explaining the class gap, I leverage the framework on lay theories of networking (Kuwabara et al., 2018) to investigate two important mechanisms that might contribute to the gap. Specifically, I examine the role of class background in influencing lay theories about 1) social intelligence and 2) social relations that may contribute to lowered networking behavior among individuals from lower social class backgrounds. Furthermore, I investigate how cross-class interactions, interactions that “occur between individuals whose social class backgrounds differ in terms of status and representation in higher education settings” (Carey et al., 2022, p. 892), moderate the relationship between social class background and networking behavior. Through novel theoretical work, this project aims to underscore the gap in social capital development as one of the main reasons that hold individuals from lower social class backgrounds back in modern organizations. This project also aims to uncover how having cross-class interactions can potentially improve the networking behaviors of those from lower social class backgrounds. N/A

22601324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22601324.value: 礦物質和金屬抗衰老配方Rasaśāstra

22601324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22601324.value: The project examines alchemical materials and formulations meant to halt or reverse the aging process. Particular focus will include recipes containing gemological substances. In many cases gems such as rubies and diamonds were unavailable to alchemical practitioners who would instead use other materials to replicate the properties of the desired gemstones, which were then used. The project will explore the creation of such materials to examine how the substituted substances act as a genuine fill-in for the desired materials. The project compares how such changes and substitutions are used within medicine in order to transform the body into a desired state, much like the replication of gems. This project examines particular recipes for selected outcomes over time, from the 12th to 17th centuries. This will be the first project of its kind to compare particular usages within the texts to tell the story of alchemical development. The focus on rejuvenation therapies will be highlighted for several reasons. A) The vast majority of rasaśāstra texts contain at least some formulations for such outcomes. B) Rejuvenation within rasaśāstra shares terminology and philosophical ideas far outside medicine, with overlap in religious and yogic understandings of the body. C) The modern subculture of health and wellness includes a focus on anti-aging that uses many of the same plant (e.g. turmeric, shilajit, ashwagandha) and even mineral (e.g. diamonds, mineral rich clay, zinc) materials found in rasaśāstra recipes. To date, studies on Sanskrit alchemical literature are limited. This sub-field of South Asian medicine received some attention by the Romanian scholar Arion Roşu and several of his graduate students. Roşu's work (1986, 1997, unpublished), which is published in French, has not been continued and those graduate students (most notably White, 1996) have now retired. Rather that let this important field flounder, this project will pick up those threads and produce work in English that will break open the field to a new generation of scholars. Additionally, working at the intersections of tantric and alchemical studies will provide an audience. Tantric studies is a thriving sub-field of South Asian literature and religion, that currently stands on its own, with tantric works being compared to one another rather than the wider body of works it influenced. This project will demonstrate the interconnections between tantra and alchemy by revealing the ideas and practices that tie them together. 本項目將研究阻止或扭轉老化過程的煉金術材料和配方，尤其是包含寶石物質的配方。在許多情況下，煉金術師無法獲得紅寶石和鑽石等寶石，他們會使用其他材料來複製所需寶石的特性。然後再使用這些複製品。本計劃將探討這些複製材料的製造過程，以檢視替代物質如何發揮真正填補所需材料的作用。本計劃將比較這些改變和替代如何在醫學中使用，以便將身體轉換成所需的狀態，就像寶石的複製一樣。 本計劃將檢視從 12 世紀到 17 世紀的不同配方，是同類型的專案首次使用的方法。計劃將比較典籍中記載的用法，以闡述煉金術發展的故事。計劃將重點放在回春療法有幾個原因。A）絕大多數的拉薩希斯拉（rasaśāstra） 經典至少包含一些有關療效的配方。B）拉薩希斯拉經典中的回春療法所使用的術語與哲學觀念，超越了醫學的範疇，與宗教與瑜珈對身體的理解有重疊的地方。C）現代次文化的健康與養生包括抗衰老，使用許多相同的植物（如薑黃、shilajit、ashwagandha），甚至礦物（如鑽石、富含礦物質的黏土、鋅）材料，這些材料都可以在 拉薩希斯拉配方中找到。 迄今為止，有關梵文煉金術文獻的研究相當有限。羅馬尼亞學者 Arion Roşu 和他的幾位研究生對南亞醫學的這個分支領域給予了一定的關注。Roşu 的著作（1986, 1997, 未出版）以法文出版，但沒有後續研究，而那些研究生 （最著名的是 White, 1996）現在亦已退休。與其讓這個重要的領域陷入死胡同，本計畫將拾起這些線索，並以英語為新一代學者開啟這個領域。此外，研究密教與煉金術研究的交集亦有其意義。密教研究是南亞文學與宗教中一個蓬勃發展的次領域，目前自成一系，但密教作品被相互比較，其更廣泛的影響則未被關注。本計劃將透過揭示將密教與煉金術聯繫在一起的觀念與實踐，展現密教與煉金術之間的相互關系。

22602324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22602324.value: 聆聽音樂能否激發創意？有關音樂誘發創意心理與神經的研究

22602324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22602324.value: Creativity has been previously linked to mind-wandering and emotion, respectively. Specifically, experiencing high levels of mind-wandering during an incubation period —a break from performing a task that requires creative effort— can augment creative insight and engage the brain’s default mode network (DMN). Moreover, although positive emotions have often been associated with creativity, some conflicting findings exist regarding negative emotions. While in recent years research has shown how music can be effectively employed to evoke a wide range of emotions as well as to stimulate the frequency and contents of mind-wandering (and more broadly mental imagery), the impact of music listening on creativity is currently unknown. This project will address this gap by elucidating the psychological and neural processes underlying music-induced creative incubation in two experiments using behavioral methods (Study 1) and fMRI (Study 2). Study 1 will determine whether a period of incubation characterised by music listening can improve, in the short-term, performance on two measures of creativity (Unusual Uses Task and Story Generation Task). Study 2 will further test whether the influence of music on creativity is due to the engagement of the DMN and will explore the functional role of its subsystems, interactions with other large-scale brain networks, and how they change over time. Three incubation conditions will be employed: two musical ones, in which mind-wandering and mental images will be triggered by unfamiliar music evoking positive (inspiring) and negative (tense) emotions with similar arousal, allowing us to determine whether positive emotions have a stronger impact on creativity than negative ones; and an auditory emotionally-neutral control condition, consisting of environmental sounds. Individual characteristics such as music liking and personality traits (mindfulness, imagination, openness to experience, and tendency to mind-wander spontaneously and deliberately), which have been previously suggested to impact creative ideation, will be also taken into account to further explore whether they mediate music’s effects on creative performance. The proposed project represents the first effort to address the relations between creativity and music-induced emotional and cognitive states, having crucial implications for the study of creativity and mind-wandering, as well as for music psychology research. Beyond academia, this project will have a profound impact on various individuals living in Hong Kong. For example, it will facilitate new creative practices among artists and creative talents, and support a goal-oriented use of music in daily life in music listeners. 創意一直與心神漫遊（mind-wandering）和情緒聯繫在一起。具體而言，若然在醞釀階段（incubation period）時經歷一種高程度的心神漫遊— 即是在進行創意工作中停歇 —這將有助於增強創意的洞察力，並激活腦部的預設模式網絡（DMN, Default Mode Network）。此外，正面情緒雖然常常與創意連結一起，然而，不少有關負面情緒的研究卻與之有所衝突；近年來的研究也展示了音樂如何能夠有效地被運用，以喚起各種情緒，並刺激心神漫遊（以及更為廣泛的心理圖像（mental imagery））的頻率與內容。不過，暫時而言，聆聽音樂對創意的影響仍是不明。此計劃將針對這一空白，在兩項實驗中，透過運用行為研究方法（behavioral methods，研究一）暨功能性磁振造影（fMRI, functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging，研究二），以闡明音樂誘發創意醞釀的心理與神經過程：研究一將會決定以聆聽音樂為特徵的醞釀期，能否在短期內改善兩項創意測量指標（特殊用途實驗（Unusual Uses Task）與故事生成實驗（Story Generation Task））；研究二則會進一步測試音樂對創意的影響是否源於預設模式網絡的參與，並會探索其子系統的功能與角色、與其他大規模腦部網絡的互動，以及它們如何隨著時間而改變。本文將會採用三種醞釀誘發條件：其二都是音樂誘發條件。在這一條件之下，心神漫遊與心理圖像將會被陌生音樂所喚起的正面（鼓舞人心的）與負面（緊張）情緒所觸發，並產生相似的喚醒效果，繼而決定正面情緒是否比負面情緒更能影響創意；另一種條件則是由環境聲音所組成的聽覺情緒中性對照條件。個人特質，例如音樂喜好以及人格特質（正念、想像力、經驗開放性（openness to experience），以及自發地和有意地心神漫遊的傾向），這些素來被認為會影響創意思維的特質，也會納入本文的考量之中，以進一步探索它們是否能夠促成音樂對創意表現的成效。本研究是為首份專題以探討—創意、音樂誘發情緒與認知狀態—三者之間的關係。它於創意、心神漫遊以及心理學研究而言，有重要意義所在。除了學術界以外，本研究亦會對生活於香港的不同人士產生深遠的影響。譬如說，它將會促進藝術家與創作人的實踐活動，並支持聽眾在日常生活中有目的地聆聽音樂。

22603024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
