22603024.value: 理解音樂中的不平等：香港流行音樂產業中少數族裔的案例

22603024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22603024.value: Globally, awareness of and critical reflexivity about inequalities related to ethnicity, class, gender, age, and ability in the music industries are rising. Scholarship and policy work have highlighted the need to assess how these inequalities are constructed and their consequences for different populations, particularly outside of Euro/Anglo-centric music industries. In Hong Kong S.A.R. (HK), while scholarship and policy work increasingly pay attention to the place of ethnic minorities (EM) in the cultural life of the city, no study has yet focused on all non-Chinese EM music practitioners as active participants in the city’s popular music industries. This project fills this gap and analyzes how different EM music practitioners – comprising musicians, as well as other individuals involved in the production and distribution of music in HK – potentially experience and mediate social, cultural economic and spatial inequalities to understand the terms and contributions of EM musical work across the HK popular music industries. Taking the cue from recent research on the significance of artistic activity by EMs in HK, academic work on inequality in music, and research on cultural infrastructures, this project asks: What are the inequalities faced by different EMs in the HK popular music industries, and when, how and why do they impact their careers? How are these inequalities co-constituted or alleviated by other aspects of EMs lives, including (but not limited to) gender, class, education, and age? How do EMs, using existing public, private and digital infrastructures, respond to their needs and mediate these inequalities? Using quantitative and qualitative methods, the research team will a) map and analyze the careers of different EM groups and individuals, and the current local hard and soft cultural popular music infrastructural landscape commonly used by EMs music practices; b) curate and organize an exhibition/performance for select under-represented EM music practitioners to perform/present their works; c) use the data gathered through surveys, interviews and the exhibition/performance to produce academic articles and a report aimed at being a resource for potential policy planning and funding allocation under the HK government’s leadership. By gathering and analyzing data about EM in the HK music industries for the first time, the proposed project seeks to provide novel theorization of the concept of inequalities in the music industries outside of Western creative cities, and to increase HK society’s awareness and appreciation of EM music practitioners contribution to the HK musical landscape. 在全球範圍內，人們對音樂產業中與種族、階級、性別、年齡和能力相關的不平等現象的認識和批判性反思正在不斷提高。學術和政策工作強調需要評估這些不平等是如何構成的及其對不同人群的影響，特別是在以歐洲/英國為中心以外的音樂產業。在香港特別行政區，學術研究和政策工作越來越重視少數族裔 (EM) 在文化生活中的地位，但在這座城市，目前還沒有研究將所有非華裔 EM 音樂從業者視為活躍的流行音樂產業的參與者。因此此研究項目填補了這一缺口，去分析不同EM 音樂從業者的經歷（包括音樂家以及其他從事及參與香港音樂製作和發行的人), 並調解社會、文化、經濟和空間不平等，以深入了解少數族裔的音樂作品在香港流行音樂界的貢獻。 從最近的研究集中關於少數族裔在香港藝術活動中的重要性、音樂不平等的學術工作以及文化基礎設施的研究得到啟發，這項目提出：香港流行音樂中不同少數族裔市場面臨哪些不平等對待以及他們的職業何時、如何以及為何受這些不平等待遇影響？ 這些不平等是如何透過少數族裔生活的其他面向共同構成或減輕，包括（但不僅限於）性別、階級、教育程度和年齡？ 少數族裔如何利用現有的公共、私人和數碼基礎設施來應對他們的需求並調解這些不平等？使用量化和質量方法，研究團隊將 a) 繪製和分析不同少數族裔群體和個人的職業生涯，以及當前少數族裔於本地常用的軟硬音樂基礎建設； b)為未被充分代表的少數族裔音樂從業者策劃展覽及表演，以此展示他們的作品； c) 透過調查、訪談和展覽去收集及使用數據，並製作旨在成為潛在政策規劃的學術文章和報告，並在香港政府的領導下進行資金分配。 透過搜集和首次分析少數族裔在香港音樂產業的數據，此建議項目旨在提供在西方創意城市以外的音樂產業不平等概念的新穎理論，並提高香港社會對此理論的意識並重視少數族裔音樂從業人員對香港音樂市場的貢獻。

22603324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22603324.value: The eighteenth century, historians have increasingly recognized, could not be interpreted solely as the Age of Reason, for the Enlightenment’s guiding force was not only reason but also sensibility. If sensibility was a dominating force of the Enlightenment, how did music fit into the discourse, especially when the Enlightenment remains a subject of much disagreement? Music in general does not occupy the spotlight of the historiography of Enlightenment—and yet, eighteenth-century thinkers across philosophical, political, medical, religious, literary, and artistic realms had integrated a variety of musical imageries and concepts into their writing to articulate their understandings of sensibility and its nature, mechanism, and effects. These musical accounts and narratives, prevalent in philosophical works, physiological treatises, political critiques, sentimental novels, religious poetry, and even sermons, also prove music’s capacity to expound complex concepts. In current studies of sensibility, however, scholars including musicologists have overlooked these many musical thoughts and narratives. Musicologists who work in the intersection of music and the history of sensibility tend to isolate itself from other disciplines in eighteenth-century studies by categorizing sensibility as both a musical period (Empfindsamkeit) and a stylistic term (empfindsamer Stil), associated mostly with the keyboard music of C.P.E. Bach and his German contemporaries. Such readings, which have marginalized the role of philosophy, have been challenged due to their inconsistencies that conflict with historical literature. Sensibility, as eighteenth-century writing demonstrates, remains fundamentally a personal disposition that renders humans sensitive to feelings, all the while informing our moral and aesthetic judgment, without being restricted to one specific musical genre, form, or composer. Resurrecting the silenced musical language in eighteenth-century writing on sensibility—which Enlightened Sensibility: A Musical History seeks to accomplish as a monograph project—thus proves urgent. It offers new opportunities to reconsider both the ways music participated in the culture of sensibility and the role of sensibility in history. It also encourages the ongoing discussion on what the Enlightenment was and is—and, in recasting the role of sensibility in history, readers are also invited to reflect on the benefits of sensibility on both the individual and the social levels today. 歷史學家越來越意識到，十八世紀不能僅僅被解釋為理性時代，因為啟蒙運動的指導力量不僅是理性，當中也有感性。如果感性可以被看成啟蒙運動的主導力量，那麼音樂如何融入語篇（discourse）中，尤其是當啟蒙運動仍是一個存在許多分歧的話題時？普遍來說，音樂並不是啟蒙運動史學的焦點。然而，十八世紀哲學、政治、醫學、宗教、文學和藝術領域的思想家將各種音樂意象和概念融入他們的著作中，以表達他們的思想。這些音樂敘事和敘事普遍存在於哲學著作、生理學論文、政治批判、感傷小說、宗教詩歌甚至講道中，也證明了音樂闡述複雜概念的能力。然而，在目前的感性研究中，包括音樂學家在內的學者卻忽略了許多音樂思想和敘事。研究音樂和感性史交叉點的音樂學家傾向於將感性分為音樂時期（Empfindsamkeit）和風格術語（empfindsamer Stil），主要與巴赫和他的同代德國作曲家寫作的鍵盤音樂相關，同時將自己與十八世紀研究中的其他學科隔離開來。這些解讀將哲學邊緣化，同時也因為與歷史文獻顯示衝突而受到挑戰。十八世紀的寫作表明，情感從根本上來是跟個人性情分不開的，它使人類對感情敏感，同時也影響著我們的道德和美學判斷，不受某種特定音樂流派、形式或作曲家的限制。因此，《啟蒙的感性:音樂史》試圖恢復被沈默的十八世紀寫作關於感性的音樂語。 這是緊迫的，因為這研究可以提供新的機會來重新考慮音樂如果參與感性文化以及感性在歷史中的作用。它也繼續推動關於啟蒙運動過去和現在的討論，並且在重塑感性在歷史中的作用時，也邀請讀者反思感性對當今在個人和社會層面的價值和益處。

22605424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22605424.value: 歐盟委員會的「不執法」？探討委員會對成員國不遵守《神根公約》的回應

22605424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22605424.value: The EU is a community of law. The coherence and legitimacy of its legal order are central to its success as an integration project. The European Commission is the supranational institution charged with safeguarding EU legal order by overseeing member states’ compliance with EU law. To this end, the Commission is empowered to bring infringement proceedings against non-compliant member states. Given its institutional interests and legal powers, we would expect the Commission to rigorously enforce uniform compliance with EU law. Yet, it often does not. Instead, it may respond to non-compliance by employing ‘soft’ measures, such as warnings and dialogues, by seeking to accommodate the preferences of non-compliant states via legal reform, or even by tacitly tolerating non-compliant behaviour. The key question this project seeks to answer is which factors lead the Commission to choose which kind of response and why? The project will utilise a mixed-method, small-n case study design to investigate how the Commission responds to non-compliance and which factors condition its response. The empirical focus is on the Schengen area; the EU’s 27-member free travel zone. The inquiry is both timely and policy relevant, as Schengen has faced many challenges to its legal governance over the past several years and is currently undergoing reform. The cases of interest are clustered around three external shocks to the Schengen system: first, the ‘migration crisis’ of 2015, second the COVID-19 pandemic that began in 2020, and third, the Russian invasion of Ukraine that began in 2022. Each crisis led to violations of Schengen law by multiple member states, but none have resulted in infringement proceedings. Thus, the project will collect and analyse data on the Commission’s responses to Schengen violations with a view to explaining them. Data will be collected from a range of sources, including semi-structured interviews with EU and member state officials, extensive analysis of EU and government documents, and relevant case law. By seeking to explain when and why the Commission eschews hard enforcement, the project builds on extant literature. By focusing on Schengen, the project addresses a major limitation in our current knowledge, while also linking research on the Commission’s enforcement behaviour to broader debates about the future of Schengen, most importantly whether it can be maintained as an essentially borderless area of travel or whether it is being (partially) ‘re-bordered’. 歐盟作為一個法治社會，執法的一致性對其作為統整多個國家的社會型態尤為重要。應運而生的歐盟委員會負責監督各成員國對歐盟法律的遵循，從而維護歐盟的法治秩序。因此，委員會有權對不「守法」的成員國提起侵權訴訟。然而，雖然大眾一向期望委員會對成員國「嚴正執法」，現實卻是委員會有時更傾向以發出警告、尋求對話等「軟性」措施回應不遵循法律的成員國。此項研究的核心問題是，哪些因素導致委員會選擇何種回應，以及為甚麼？ 此研究將採用案例研究的方式去研究委員會如何回應歐盟成員國的不遵守行為，以及其回應受哪些因素影響，並以《神根公約》作為本研究的實證焦點。該協定容許其27個成員國（又稱「神根區」）相互之間取消邊境管制，即持有任一成員國有效身份證或神根簽證的人可以在所有成員國境內自由流動。觀乎《神根公約》在過去數年中面臨了數次挑戰，且目前正在醞釀改革，以此作為研究對象既及時又具有政策意義。2015年的「移民危機」，2020年開始的新冠疫情，以及俄羅斯2022年開始入侵烏克蘭，都先後衝擊了《神根公約》。上述的突發事件均引致了多個成員國選擇了違反《神根公約》，但均未引來委員會的法律行動。此研究將收集並分析委員會對《神根公約》違規行為回應的資料，包括與歐盟和成員國官員的訪談，歐盟和成員國的政府文件，以及相關的判例法。 透過將研究範圍集中於《神根公約》上，此研究除了可以深入探討一項前途未卜且對歐盟生態有深遠影響的法案，亦可藉此進一步了解委員會的行為模式，後者更可延伸應用於其他歐盟法案上。兩者均可進一步充實現存文獻。

22605524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22605524.value: 納瓦歌手：慶賀十六世紀墨西哥城的原住民帝國

22605524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22605524.value: "Nahua Singers" examines how the daily communal activity of playing and singing music was central to history keeping, political debates, and conceptions of masculinity during the Aztec Empire and early colonial period. My research shows that the normally erased voices of commoners and minor nobles are recorded down in song lyrics which discuss events from the ancient Aztec past into the sixteenth century. Though originally collected by Indigenous scribes in the 1550s, and misunderstood by Franciscan friars, my research shows that the singers of these lyrics came from diverse backgrounds and communicated directly between nobles and commoners in public and private spaces. By placing the surviving song lyrics into the center of historiographic discussions, and acknowledging that they are indeed comprehensible, my research changes the narratives of how Indigenous traditions were suppressed by colonial regimes, or that they were preserved only by a handful of Aztecs nobles. Instead, the lyrics were composed and performed by both minor nobles and commoners with the intention of communicating and defining their pride in their long and successful history. One of the primary uses of songs by commoners and minor nobles was to protest colonial injustices to Indigenous leaders and specific friars they saw as allies. The singers chose historical events in public performances to hint at the cultural criteria of what the nobility must maintain: overcoming setbacks, fighting for justice, and providing for their people. The singers were communicating that at times it was fine to negotiate, but sometimes outright resistance was needed. These songs were used by everyday people to navigate their transition from imperial citizens under the Aztecs to colonial subjects under the Spanish. In addition to negotiations and rumblings of resistance, some of the singers discussed concerns over their future and wonder about a new and much larger world. “Nahua Singers” shows that a newly colonized people struggled to understand their role in a colonial empire, but found comfort and power in traditional knowledge and stories of their ancestors. In this way, the songs were very early intellectual and poetic reflections by minor nobles and commoners attempting to understand their place in a world that was now transoceanic and had a very different political, economic, and social role for the residents of Mexico City. The singers used their traditional artform as a way to navigate the shifting colonial landscape of power, death, and environmental change with their audiences. 《納瓦歌手》探討阿茲特克帝國和早期殖民時期的日常公共音樂演奏和歌唱活動如何對歷史保存、政治辯論，以及男子漢氣概等概念產生影響。我的研究表明，通常被忽視的平民和小貴族訴求皆被記錄在歌詞中，這些歌詞講述了阿茲特克從古代過去到十六世紀末的歷史事件。歌曲的主要用途之一，是被平民和小貴族利用來抗議殖民者對原住民領導人和他們視為盟友的部分教士的不公平待遇。歌手會選擇歷史事件作為公眾表演項目，來暗示貴族必須堅守的文化準則：克服挫折、爭取正義、為人民提供保障。歌手用歌詞來傳達進行談判有時是可行的，但其他時候則需要徹底的抗爭。這些歌曲被民眾用來引導他們從阿茲特克統治下的帝國公民過渡到西班牙統治下的殖民地人民。 歌詞除了提及談判和抗爭之外，一些歌手還討論了他們對未來的擔憂，以及對一個嶄新及偌大的世界的好奇。《納瓦歌手》表達了新殖民地人民努力理解自己在跨洋殖民帝國中扮演的角色，但從傳統知識和祖先的故事中也找到了安慰和力量。這些歌曲是早期以聰慧及詩意形式反影小貴族和平民在試圖理解自己在這個世界中的位置。他們的世界現在擴展到包括海洋旅行、羅馬城，以及和特諾奇蒂特蘭（墨西哥城）居民截然不同的政治、經濟和社會角色。歌手用他們傳統的表演藝術與觀眾一起駕馭不斷變化的殖民者權力、死亡，以及環境變遷。 《納瓦歌手》將展示十六世紀來自不同背景的原住民歌手在公共和私人空間中與貴族和平民直接進行交流。這個研究將把現存歌詞置於史學討論的中心，並確認它們可以被理解。我的研究將改變一般認為原住民傳統被殖民政權粉碎和壓制，或是只為少數阿茲特克人服務。相反，歌詞是由貴族和平民共同創作和表演的，目的是傳達訊息和表達他們對悠久而成功的歷史感到自豪。

22606524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22606524.value: 香港長者的環境暴露與精神健康的實時關係：基于可攜帶設備的地理生態瞬時評估方法

22606524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22606524.value: Numerous studies have revealed that the built environment can affect older adults' mental health. However, such studies have largely been based on static designs, such as questionnaires, which can be prone to recall bias. Recall bias can be minimized to a great extent by using objective and real-time measures providing more dynamic information about how the built environment affects older adults' mental health. This proposed study aims to explore this dynamic interaction. Objective and real-time indicators for the built environment and mental health among older adults will be developed based on geographic ecological momentary assessment (GEMA) and wearable technologies. These technologies will provide vivid information about the direct and indirect effects (i.e., based on a behavior-based model and a perception-based model) of the built environment on older adults' mental health. Participants will be recruited from three areas in Hong Kong, each area having at least 30 participants to ensure their environmental exposure includes all types of the built environment attributes in Hong Kong. They will be required to complete one 15-minute baseline survey, which will include basic person-level information. They will then be required to wear the watch and GPS device for 15 days. A research assistant will send participants real-time short questions four times daily to gather information about their real-time feeling and activities by using Qualtrics software. The real-time data will be geocoded and linked to geo environment dataset and real-time data set by address and time. The intra-class correlation coefficients (ICC) will be estimated to determine the total variance of mental health changes explained at the within-person and between-person levels. Latent growth curve modeling (LGCM) will be integrated with structural equation modeling (SEM) to provide a quantitative exploration of the longitudinal direct and indirect effect of the built environment on mental health. Methodoloically, this study will provide a new approach which can also be applied to other research topics. The wearable technologies will be helpful in reducing the re-call bias used in traditional approaches, i.e., questionnaire survey. From the policy perspective, the study findings have potential implications for urban planning and resident's welfare policy. Practically, the study findings will play a significant role in policy recommendations to create an environment that can improve older people's mental health. 大量研究表明，環境會影響老年人的心理健康。然而，此類研究很大程度上基於靜態設計，例如問卷調查，容易出現回憶偏差。透過使用客觀和實時的方法，提供有關環境如何影響老年人心理健康的更多動態信息，可以在很大程度上最大限度地減少回憶偏差。這項研究旨在探索這種動態相互作用。基於地理生態瞬時評估法和可穿戴式技術，將開發針對老年人環境暴露和心理健康的客觀即時指標。這些技術將提供有關環境對老年人心理健康的直接和間接影響（即基於行為的模型和基於感知的模型）的生動資訊。參與者將從香港的三個地區招募，每個地區至少有 30 名參與者，以確保他們的環境暴露包括香港不同類型的環境屬性。他們將被要求完成一項 15 分鐘的基線調查，其中包括基本的個人資訊。然後，他們將被要求佩戴手錶和全球定位系统設備 15 天。研究助理每天四次向參與者發送即時簡短問題，使用 Qualtrics 軟體收集有關他們實時感受和活動的資訊。實時資料將被地理編碼並按地址和時間連結到地理環境資料集和實時資料集。將估計組內相關係數，以確定在人內和人際層面上解釋的心理健康變化的總變異數。潛在生長曲線模型將與結構方程模型結合，定量探索環境對心理健康的縱向直接和間接影響。在方法論上，這項研究將提供一種新方法，也可以應用於其他研究主題。穿戴式科技將有助於減少傳統方法（即問卷調查）中使用的回憶偏差。從政策角度來看，研究結果對城市規劃和居民福祉政策有潛在影響。研究結果將在政策建議中發揮重要作用，以創造一個可以改善老年人心理健康的環境。

22607024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22607024.value: 關係： 通過關係的力量加強醫療和社會護理合作

22607024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22607024.value: Hong Kong faces one of its greatest challenges in meeting the needs of an ageing population. This has created great demand for health and social care systems. Meeting the complex needs of older people requires effective collaboration between health and social care professionals within interdisciplinary teams. In Hong Kong, some community-based care services have adopted a multidisciplinary approach to support older people to ensure ageing in place. Although the development of interdisciplinary collaboration between health and social care has increased in recent years, it is still at an early stage in Hong Kong. Some health and social care professionals experience difficulties with interdisciplinary collaboration. Such collaboration has proved ineffective when communication barriers, incompatible professional cultures and institutional barriers prevent interdisciplinary collaboration. Many factors affect collaborative practices, and communication barriers have been identified in most previous studies. In Hong Kong, there is a lack of in-depth studies exploring the influence of interprofessional communication on collaborative practices. The underlying mechanisms that promote interdisciplinary collaboration remain poorly understood. This study will examine the factors facilitating interprofessional communication and interdisciplinary collaboration in the Integrated Home Care Services (IHCS) and the Enhanced Home and Community Care Services (EHCCS). Conceptually, this study will be informed by the theory of relationality, theory of relational coordination and concepts of collaborative practice A mixed-methods research design will be adopted to achieve the following objectives, to: (1) understand communication patterns in interprofessional relationships in IHCS and EHCCS; (2) explore awareness, perceptions and attitudes of health and social care professionals about interprofessional communication and interdisciplinary collaboration, and (3) examine how different relational factors influence interprofessional communication and interdisciplinary collaboration among health and social care professionals. An online survey will be employed to identify communication patterns by measuring the relationship ties between health and social care professionals within the collaborative processes. Individual semi-structured interviews will be conducted with social workers, nurses, physiotherapists, occupational therapists, dietitians and speech therapists to explore different professionals’ awareness, perceptions and attitudes about interprofessional communication and interdisciplinary collaboration and examine how these are influenced by relational factors. This study will contribute a new insight into interdisciplinary collaboration by incorporating relational elements into the interprofessional work process. Findings from the study will underscore the importance of relationality in developing services, professional education and training, and policy. 香港正面臨的最大挑戰之一是應對人口老齡化的需求，人口老齡化也對衛生和社會護理系統提出了巨大需求。滿足老年人口的複雜需求有賴於衛生和社會護理專業人員等跨學科團隊之間的有效合作。在香港，一些以社區為本的護理服務已經採用跨學科方式為長者提供支援，以確保長者居家安老。近年來，雖然香港衛生與社會護理領域之間的跨學科合作發展加快，但本地跨學科合作仍處於早期階段，一些衛生和社會護理專業人員在跨學科合作過程中遇到各種困難。當出現溝通障礙、專業文化不相容和制度障礙時，跨學科合作模式的有效性便大打折扣。 許多因素會影響跨學科合作實踐，其中，溝通障礙在以往的大量研究中被證實為影響因素。可是，香港尚未有深入研究來探討跨專業交流對跨學科合作的影響。此外，研究者對促進跨學科合作基本機制的了解仍然十分不足。因此，本研究將探討促進綜合家居照顧服務（IHCS）和改善家居及社區照顧服務（EHCCS）中跨專業交流和跨學科合作的因素。 從概念上來講，本研究將以關係理論、關係協調理論和協作實踐概念為依據，並將採用混合方法研究設計來實現以下目標：（1）理解 IHCS 和 EHCCS 中跨專業關係中的溝通模式;（2）探索衛生和社會護理專業人員對跨專業交流和跨學科合作的認識、看法和態度，以及（3）研究不同的關係因素如何影響衛生和社會護理專業人員之間的跨專業交流和跨學科合作。 本研究還將採用網上調查問卷方法，通過衡量衛生和社會護理專業人員在協作過程中的關係紐帶，來確定他們的溝通模式。此外，本研究會與社會工作者、護士、物理治療師、職業治療師、營養師和言語治療師等專業人員進行個人半結構化訪談，以探討不同專業人士對跨專業溝通和跨學科合作的認識、看法和態度，並探究這些維度如何受到關係因素的影響。 這項研究通過將關係元素納入跨專業合作過程中，為跨學科合作提供了新的見解。另外，該研究的結果將突顯關係這一元素對服務發展、專業教育和培訓，以及政策方面的重要性。

22611624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22611624.value: 新疆頁岩資源開發對水資源的影響與管理研究

22611624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22611624.value: 隨著中國頁岩油氣資源的大規模開發，水力壓裂開采技術的大量用水所帶來的環境影響，成為了新的挑戰。新疆擁有中國三分之一以上的頁岩資源，但其水資源也嚴重匱乏，這使該地區極易受到密集頁岩開發對有限水資源的影響。本研究擬量化新疆頁岩開採活動的用水情況，評估其對區域水資源的潛在影響，並為缺水地區頁岩開發項目的可持續水資源管理提供政策建議。 新疆擁有中國最大的頁岩油和第二大的頁岩氣資源。認識到頁岩資源的重要性，新疆自治區政府已經建立了全國頁岩油生產示範區以推動大規模開發。然而，新疆的乾旱氣候爲此開發帶來了巨大挑戰。新疆水資源極度匱乏，農業用水佔92%，同時具有大量的農村人口。預計頁岩開採將進一步加劇稀缺的水資源的用水壓力，更可能危及農業生產、影響當地民生和生態環境。但目前對這種乾旱條件下頁岩開採用水的定量研究十分有限，突顯了隨著頁岩開發的推進，進一步研究乾旱地區水資源管理和可持續發展的重要性。 本研究項目旨在：(1)通過實地調研收集一手數據和通過油氣開發公司獲取二手數據，全面量化新疆頁岩開發全生命週期的用水情況；(2)開發一個估算頁岩開採活動用水強度並預測不同開發情景下水需求的模型；(3)構建一個將地表徑流和地下水消耗份額(稀缺度)、地下水與地表水供給比例(脆弱度)以及頁岩用水與農業用水比例(競爭度)納入的水資源影響指數，並運用該指數評估新疆大規模頁岩開發的實際和潛在影響；(4)運用混合整數線性規劃制定長期優化的水資源管理策略，並為新疆大規模頁岩行業的水資源治理提供依據。 新疆在嚴重缺水條件下開發頁岩資源的案例並非特例，全球有38%的頁岩資源分布在乾旱或缺水地區。這突顯了隨著開發進程，研究可持續管理水資源的重要性，因為不同開發情景下都可能對農業到生態系統等其他用水部門產生影響。本研究的總體目標是為新疆及其他同樣面臨能源開發水資源挑戰的缺水地區的頁岩資源利用可持續規劃提供依據。 研究負責人已與新疆地區頁岩油氣資源主要開發者建立了合作關係，並於2018年完成了新疆吉木薩爾頁岩生產區的初步實地調研，為本項目研究奠定了基礎。

22611924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22611924.value: 插畫在東南亞作為一種參與性對話：為香港長者開拓插畫的轉化學習先導模式

22611924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22611924.value: Illustration enables learners to express themselves and communicate in diverse and versatile ways, leading to rich and dynamic learning experiences for individuals of all ages. In the Manifesto for Illustration Pedagogy, Fauchon and Gannon (2018) emphasize the importance of critical thinking, creative exploration, and interdisciplinary engagement within illustration pedagogy. In Drawing Thinking: Illustration as Pedagogy, Hirons and Brown (2019) explored the concept of Illustration Pedagogy within the framework of Transformative Learning Theory, which encourages students to move beyond being passive recipients of knowledge and take an active role in constructing knowledge by critically examining evidence, arguments, and alternative perspectives (Mezirow, 1997). Illustration Pedagogy as a transformative learning method is not limited to young adults in universities. Given the rapid increase in the aged population in Hong Kong (19.3% in 2021; projected to be 28% by 2031), it is urgent for us to address the social and mental needs of the million older adults in Hong Kong. By engaging in illustration learning, older adults can also benefit from personal development, decreased loneliness, increased happiness and well-being, and enhanced open-mindedness and mindfulness. The concept of transformative learning aligns with the goals of healthy ageing, as declared by the United Nations and World Health Organization, by optimizing older adults' functional ability. As an experienced illustrator, educator, and researcher in socially engaged art practices, The PI questions whether illustrators can act as facilitators and provide transformative learning opportunities for older adults. They seek to determine and design a suitable learning environment for older adults, potentially collaborating with social workers or service providers to meet their learning needs. To develop a pilot model of illustration pedagogy for older adults in Hong Kong, this research project aims to (1) collect and analyze illustration pedagogy practices in Hong Kong and the world through literature reviews and interviews with illustrators or artists; (2) develop 6-week experimental illustration workshops in 2 elderly centres for practice-based study of the subject matter; (3) conduct focus group interviews before and after the experimental illustration program to study the effectiveness of the workshops. The research outputs are expected to include (1) a conference paper; (2) public talks and sharing sessions among artists and illustrators in Hong Kong and overseas; (3) workshops with illustrators and social workers; (4) an online project archive and educational resources. 插畫能讓學習者以多元及多樣化的方式，表達自我及與他人溝通。不同年齡的人，均可從豐富且充滿活力的學習經驗中得益。Fauchon 和 Gannon (2018) 在 Manifesto for Illustration Pedagogy 一文中強調插畫教學法的批判性思考、創意探索及跨學科參與的重要性。Hirons 和Brown (2019) 在 Drawing Thinking: Illustration as Pedagogy 借用轉化學習理論（Transformative Learning Theory）的框架，探討了插畫教學法的概念；該理論鼓勵學生不再 被動地接受知識，而是透過批判性地檢視證據、論據和不同觀點，主動建構知識（Mezirow，1997）。 本人認為插畫作為一種轉化學習方法，並不限於入讀大學的年青人。鑒於香港老齡人口的快速增長（2021年佔全港人口19.3%；預計2031年將達28%），我們急需解決香港百萬老年人士的社會和精神需求。參與插畫相關的教學活動，老人亦可從個人發展、減少孤獨感、增加快樂和幸福感、開放思維和正念之中獲益。轉化學習的概念，亦與聯合國及世界衛生組織宣佈的「健康老齡化」（Healthy Ageing）的目標一致，可以改善老年人的功能能力。 身為一位經驗豐富的插畫家、教育工作者和社會參與性藝術的研究者，本計劃望能探討插畫家能否擔任促進者的角色，為老年人提供具有轉變性的學習機會。本計劃將研究並設計一個適合老年人的學習環境，並與相關的社會工作者、長者服務提供者合作，以滿足他們的學習需求。 為研發一套以香港長者為本的插畫教學先導模式，本研究項目旨在：(1) 透過文獻回顧、 訪問插畫師或藝術家，收集並分析香港及東南的插畫教學法實踐；(2) 在兩間長者中心發展為期六星期的插畫實驗工作坊；(3) 在插畫實驗工作坊前後，進行焦點小組訪談，研究工作坊的成效。 預計研究成果包括：(1) 會議論文；(2) 香港及海外藝術家及插畫師的公開講座及分享會；(3)提供予正在或有志服務長者的插畫師、社工的工作坊；(4) 網上資料庫及教育資源。

23100224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23100224.value: 環境DNA − 石珊瑚生態評估與保育的橋樑

23100224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23100224.value: 淺水珊瑚礁是生物多樣性熱點，具有高度的社會經濟價值。然而，氣候變遷和人類活動對這些生態系統造成嚴重衝擊，導致全球珊瑚覆蓋率及其相關海洋生物下降超過 50%。及時且全面的監測是評估珊瑚礁健康狀況和制定有效保育措施的關鍵。目前監測計畫過於依賴耗時目視調查，難以快速評估大範圍區域。近年來，環境 DNA (eDNA) 宏條碼技術被視為珊瑚群落生物監測的潛力工具。然而，針對造礁石珊瑚的 eDNA 研究仍舊有限，主要原因是缺乏可靠的引物和標準化的 eDNA 方法。為了解決這一知識空白，本項目旨在簡化一種可靠的 eDNA 方法，用於評估石珊瑚群落，並證明其在香港亞熱帶邊緣珊瑚群落的有效性，該群落擁有 84 種硬珊瑚和 350 種珊瑚相關魚類。本項目將利用增強的 DNA 參考數據庫開發新型石珊瑚特異性引物，涵蓋 100 多個石珊瑚屬，以實現更精準的分類評估。這些新引物的性能將與現有針對幾個珊瑚種群的引物進行比較。為了驗證石珊瑚 eDNA 方法的可靠性，我們將在海下灣海洋公園同時進行水樣採集和目視調查。海下灣以擁有香港水域最好的珊瑚群落而聞名，這將有助於我們比較兩種方法在珊瑚識別和基質覆蓋率估計方面的表現。此外，我們將在香港 33 個珊瑚礁檢查點應用簡化的 eDNA 方法，作為第一個本地石珊瑚 eDNA 研究。這將有助於我們了解石珊瑚的多樣性、群落組成的空間和時間變化，以及影響這些動態的潛在驅動力。總體而言，本研究將填補在珊瑚礁監測中應用 eDNA 方法的知識空白，特別是在具有挑戰性的後勤環境中。eDNA 數據將為基於證據的保育措施提供信息，並幫助我們預測珊瑚礁生態系統對全球氣候變遷和人類干擾的反應。

23100424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23100424.value: 校準混合營養譜：量化三種具有不同營養策略的珊瑚中的養分輸入和循環

23100424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23100424.value: Corals and the reefs they support provide critical ecological and economic services including high biodiversity, storm surge protection, and ecotourism. Corals are able to thrive in nutrient-poor tropical seas due to their nutritional partnership with algae; the algae harness autotrophic nutrients (inorganic carbon and nitrogen) through photosynthesis whereas the coral is a heterotrophic consumer that feeds on organic particles in seawater, including plankton. These partners exchange nutrients, maximizing their sources of nutrition and recycling carbon and nitrogen between them so that these nutrients are conserved. Given that corals have access to both autotrophic and heterotrophic forms of nutrition, they are defined as mixotrophs. However, mixotrophy is different across coral species, where some are more dependent on autotrophic nutrition whereas others are more dependent on heterotrophic nutrition. Further, evidence suggests that corals more reliant on autotrophy are more susceptible to bleaching in response to warming temperatures. My recent work developed a novel approach to rapidly assess the relative reliance on autotrophy vs heterotrophy across seven coral genera, the largest number in one study to date. I found that coral trophic strategies fall along a “mixotrophy spectrum” that ranges from high dependence on heterotrophy to high dependence on autotrophy. However, it is unknown if differences across species are a result of variation in the input of heterotrophic vs autotrophic nutrients or variation in the amount of nutrient recycling with algal symbionts. I will use a combination of conventional and cutting-edge approaches to determine which of these mechanisms underlies differences in coral trophic strategy and thus “calibrate” the mixotrophy spectrum. Using three coral species that span this spectrum (high heterotrophy, high autotrophy, and middle), I will first use classic measurements of feeding, respiration, and photosynthesis to quantify the contribution of heterotrophic and autotrophic nutrients to coral respiration. Second, I will use a stable isotope labeling technique to quantify the contribution of heterotrophic and autotrophic nutrients to coral and algal growth. Finally, I will conduct an elongated isotope labeling experiment to measure the amount of nutrient recycling between the coral and algae. This project will determine the physiological mechanism that underpins trophic strategy differences across corals, improving existing assessment approaches. Given the link between trophic strategy and bleaching resistance, this work has critical ramifications for the ability to predict bleaching responses, identify corals resilient to climate change, and implement effective conservation and restoration strategies to protect valuable coral reef ecosystems. 珊瑚礁對於生態系統和經濟發展都十分重要，包括提高生物多樣性、抵御 風暴潮和促進生態旅遊。透過與共生藻的共生關係 ， 珊瑚得以在營養貧乏的熱帶海域中生長，；共生藻通過光合作用獲取 自營營養(無機碳和氮 )，而珊瑚蟲則以海水中的有機物，包括浮游生物為食。珊瑚蟲和共生藻交換營養物質，以最大化它們的營養來源，並回收它們之間的碳和氮，從而達致養分循環 。由於珊瑚可以同時獲取自養和異養營養，它們被定義為混營性生物 。然而，不同的珊瑚品種的混營性存在差異，有些較依賴自營營養，而另一些則較依賴異營營養。此外，一些研究發現，較依賴自營營養的珊瑚在面對水溫上升時更容易產生白化。我們開發了一種新的方法，能夠快速評估七種珊瑚屬在自營與異營營養的相對依賴程度。這是至今為止涵蓋最多珊瑚屬的研究。我發現珊瑚的營養策略落在一個“混合營養譜”上，從高度依賴異營營養到高度依賴自營營養。然而，目前尚未了解各物種之間的差異是由於異營與自營營養輸入的變化，還是因為珊瑚與藻類共生體之間的營養回收量的變化。我將結合傳統與嶄新的方法來確定哪些機制使珊瑚有不同營養策略，從而“校正”混合營養譜。針對三種跨越該光譜的珊瑚物種（高異營類、高自營類和中間類），我會先測量餵食、呼吸和光合作用來量化異營和自營營養兩者對珊瑚呼吸的貢獻。其次，我將使用穩定同位素標記技術來量化異營和自營營養對珊瑚和藻類生長的貢獻。最後，我會進行一個延長的同位素標記實驗，以測量珊瑚和藻類之間的營養回收量。這項研究將查明造成珊瑚營養策略差異的生理機制，並改善現有的評估方法。鑑於營養策略與白化抗性有所聯繫，這項工作對於預測白化反應、識別對氣候變化有韌性的珊瑚，以及實施有效的保護和恢復策略以保護寶貴的珊瑚礁生態系統具有重要意義

23100524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23100524.value: 揭示暖化城市中的物種組成和相互作用：對基於自然的耐熱解決方案的影響

23100524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23100524.value: Extreme heat events and urban heat island effect, and their synergistic impacts, are increasingly influencing species diversity and interactions in cities. Such rapid increase in temperatures can filter out heat-sensitive species and rewire species interaction network, having direct implications on urban ecosystem functioning. Given that most of the global population is projected to reside in urban areas by 2030, it is crucial to create heat-resilient Nature-Based Solutions (Nbs) that addresses societal challenges while also supporting urban biodiversity and the associated ecosystem services. However, our current understanding of the combined effects of extreme heat event and urbanization on biodiversity and their interactions remains limited, especially in tropical Asia where rapid urbanization is expected. In this study, we will investigate the impact of urban heat on key insect pollinator (bee and wasp) diversity and their interaction networks in Hong Kong, given they are key in supporting urban ecosystem functions such as pollination and pest control. The complex cityscape of Hong Kong and its heterogeneity of building profiles offer a sharp rural-urban thermal gradient for investigating local climate effect. Moreover, Hong Kong's dense urban landscape serves as a future model for rapidly developing Asian cities and, as such, our study will allow for a broad implication and application in informing urban conservation in the region. Specifically, we will explore how urban heat affects insect pollinator species composition and their trait diversity in green spaces. Then, we will examine the effects of extreme heat events on plant-pollinator interactions through standardized interaction surveys and how such interactions are dependent on green space characteristics using structural equation models. Furthermore, we will also investigate how extreme heat affects food provisioning for larvae of solitary bees and wasps using a trap nest experiment. We hypothesize that urban heat will have multifaceted effects on pollinators and their ecological interactions. It will remove heat-sensitive species in local assemblages, with the magnitude of this effect varying along the thermal gradient and mediated by species traits. Then, the removal of heat-sensitive pollinators in local assemblages will disrupt the network structure and reduce its resilience. Moreover, urban heat will alter food provision and indirectly impact the development of pollinator larvae. By uncovering the direct and indirect urban heat-mediated processes on insect pollinator diversity from individual to ecosystem level, this project will provide vital information to guide the development of heat-resilient Nbs for biodiversity in Asian cities that are experiencing further warming. 極端高溫事件和城市熱島效應，以及它們的協同效應，日益對城市中的物種多樣性和相互作用產生影響。溫度的快速上升可能導致熱敏感物種的消失，重新塑造物種互動網絡，並直接影響城市生態系統的功能。考慮到預計到2030年，全球大多數人口將居住在城市地區，因此建立基於自然的耐熱解決方案（Nbs）至關重要。這些解決方案需要不僅應對社會挑戰，還要支持城市生物多樣性和相關的生態服務。然而，我們對極端高溫事件和城市化對生物多樣性的綜合影響以及它們之間的相互作用的了解仍然有限，特別是在預計將迅速城市化的熱帶亞洲地區。 這項研究旨在探究城市高溫對香港主要傳粉昆蟲（蜂類）多樣性及其與植物相互作用網絡的影響，因為它們對於支持傳粉和害蟲防治等城市生態系統功能至關重要。香港獨特而複雜的城市景觀和建築輪廓提供了明顯的城鄉熱梯度，為研究城市氣候影響提供了寶貴的資料。透過借鑑香港已發展的複雜城市景觀，我們的研究可為快速發展的亞洲城市提供未來發展藍圖的參考，具有廣泛的意義和應用價值。具體而言，我們將探討城市熱量如何影響傳粉昆蟲的物種組成及其在綠色空間中的性狀多樣性。然後，我們將透過標準化交互作用調查及結構方程模型研究極端高溫事件對植物與傳粉昆蟲相互作用的影響，以及這種相互作用如何被綠色空間特徵所調節。此外，我們亦將透過巢箱實驗研究極端高溫如何影響獨居蜜蜂幼蟲的食物供應。我們假設城市熱量將對傳粉昆蟲及其生態相互作用產生多方面的影響。它將消除城市中熱敏感的物種，這種影響程度將隨城鄉熱梯度的變化而變動，並由物種性狀所調節。進一步地，去除熱敏感傳粉昆蟲將破壞網路結構並降低其彈性。此外，城市高溫將改變食物供應，進而間接影響傳粉昆蟲幼蟲的發育。 這個計畫將透過揭示城市高溫對傳粉昆蟲從個體到生態系統層面的直接和間接影響，為指導耐熱自然基礎設施（Nbs）的開發提供重要資訊。在面臨進一步城市暖化的情況下，這對於亞洲城市的生物多樣性保育至關重要。

23100624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23100624.value: 預測物種表現時被忽略的重要關鍵：調節體溫的行為在高溫預警下的重要性

23100624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23100624.value: Being able to forecast ecological changes has become a major goal for scientists due to the impacts of climate warming on ecosystems and subsequent consequences for food security, natural resources and human livelihoods. A fundamental determinant for such forecasts is the performance of individual species, the basis of species interactions and community responses. Traditionally, species performances are estimated for environmental temperatures typically occurring in particular habitats. These measurements when applied to mobile species, however, fail to factor in a key "missing link", thermoregulatory decisions (e.g. behaviours to adopt thermal refuges) which can significantly buffer individuals from environmental extremes and therefore may result in unrealistic estimates of experienced temperatures and performances. Tropical intertidal species suffer from extreme and sometimes lethal thermal stress during low tide periods. During the short but critical window between just being emersed and completely exposed to air (typically < 2 h), mobile molluscs such as topshells, limpets and chitons need to make decisions to decide when and where to stop to best survive anticipated conditions. If individuals make "mistakes" and fail to locate refuges prior to the impending thermal stress, prompt retreat becomes impossible as movement is heavily constrained when the rock is hot and dry. As such, individuals making mistakes will be susceptible to near-future environmental fluctuations which can induce physiological costs or even mortality. Species performance is, therefore, ultimately determined by whether individuals are able to adopt timely behaviours in response to their thermal experience, which may function as early warning cues for potentially stressful conditions. This proposal investigates this critical role of behaviour by establishing the missing link between early warning thermal cues, anticipatory behaviours, and ultimately species performances using the highly dynamic intertidal environment as a well-studied model system. To achieve this, thermal cues will be identified using an extensive set of shore-based loggers recording temperatures at a resolution relevant to the organismal decision-making process. Secondly, on-shore behaviours of ecologically important species will be measured to assess whether and how they respond to these cues. This information will be integrated with the physiological costs of making thermoregulatory mistakes to compare performances between scenarios with or without behavioural thermoregulation, and hence quantify the importance of anticipatory behaviours. Ultimately, the study will establish a mechanistic link between the physical environment, individual behaviours and performance consequences, which is fundamental to strengthen our capacity to forecast and manage ecological changes in coastal ecosystems under future climates. 全球暖化無論對生態系統或人類社會，如食物安全和自然資源狀況，均有著重要的影響。是故，預測生態系統在全球暖化下的改變是科學家現時其中一個主要的研究目標。個體的表現、物種的互動和群落的反應皆為預測生態系統改變的基本元素。一般來說，科學家會測量生境溫度以預測個體在該環境的表現。然而，此等測量並非適用於可動的物種，甚至會得出不合理的結論。因為這些物種能夠以行為來調節自己的體溫，進以減少環境溫度對其的影響。然而，這種用以調節體溫的行為卻是一個常常被忽略了的重要關鍵。 熱帶的岩岸生物往往在退潮時承受極端甚至致命的溫度。在潮水沖刷期間和完全退潮之前（一般少於兩小時），可動的軟體動物如螺、帽貝和石鱉等須決定自身移動和將要停靠的位置，以在完全退潮時存活下來。如個體做了錯誤的決定，未能在高溫侵襲之前找到遮蔽處，則乾涸和高溫的石面會使其再不能移動至合適的地方。這些個體會更加受制於外在的環境改變，造成生理影響甚至死亡。因此，個體的表現往往視乎其可否以之前的經驗作為對未來的環境的預警，及時作出適當的行為以逃離高溫。 此計劃書將以此作為主要的研究題目，旨在以多變的潮間帶環境作為研究模型，釐清預警溫度、行為和個體表現的關係。首先，岩岸的生境溫度將會以大量的溫度記錄儀以頻密的間距記錄，反映個體在完全退潮前所經歷的溫度變化。然後，個體在岸上的行為會被測量，以研究其在溫度改變下的預警行為反應。這些資料將會與不同溫度下的生理表現結合，以比較個體在有否行為調節下的表現，進以量化此等預警行為的重要性。總的來說，此研究會以結合物理環境和個體的行為及表現，加強我們對未來生態系統變化的預測。

23502724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23502724.value: 风险的微观结构，技术，与保险

23600424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23600424.value: Production can be viewed as a process of defining and organizing various job tasks. How tasks are defined, especially the composition and evolution of the task content, received quite some attention in recent macroeconomic literature. However, the macroeconomic implication of how tasks are organized at the micro-level receives much less attention. This leads to a disconnect between the micro-level importance of task organization emphasized in the micro and business literature and the irrelevance of task organization at the macro level. This project seeks to bridge this gap by exploring the drivers of task organization within firms and their potential macroeconomic implications, and thus pave the way for further research in this area. The importance of task organization for the macro economy is well demonstrated in the COVID crisis and its aftermath, where a sizable labor shortage problem causes severe disturbances in the production process for many firms and organizations. In a recent empirical paper done by the PI with coauthors (Kuhn, Luo, Manovskii, and Qiu, 2023), it is revealed that large dispersion exists in the coordination of the production tasks even after controlling for observable differences across employers. Moreover, it is found that more coordinated employers, though being more productive on average, report more severe problems from unexpected worker shortfalls in the COVID crisis. In this proposed project, I first formalize the idea that firms face a trade-off in task organizations in the sense as follows. On one extreme, the firm can organize a highly coordinated production process so that every worker handles a rigidly specified task and the gain from such coordination and specialization is maximized. Such a production process, however, is exposed to high risk as the absence of a single worker can slow down the entire workflow and cause a significant output loss. On the other hand, the firm can let workers work independently and not interfere with each other, in which case both the gain (from specialization) and the risk due to worker absence is minimized. Secondly, I will explore the macro implications of such task organizations quantitatively, focusing on their interplay with technological and demographic changes: Task organizations react to long-term shifts in technology and demographics and this reaction will feed back to the labor supply and the labor market performance. This analysis, by connecting labor markets with firm organizations, will offer not only theoretical implications but also new insights into labor market policy designs. 生产可以被视为一个定义和组织各种工作任务的过程。任务如何被定义，特别是任务内容的构成和演变，近年来在宏观经济学文献中受到了相当多的关注。然而，微观层面任务组织方式的宏观经济学意义却很少受到关注。这导致了任务组织在微观和商业文献中的重要性与其在宏观层面上的无关性之间的脱节。本项目旨在通过探索企业内部任务组织的驱动因素及其潜在的宏观经济影响来弥合这一差距，从而为该领域的进一步研究铺平道路。 任务组织对宏观经济的重要性在COVID危机中得到了充分体现：大规模的劳动力短缺问题扰乱了许多企业和组织的生产过程。在PI与其合作者（Kuhn, Luo, Manovskii, 和 Qiu, 2023）共同完成的一篇最新实证论文中发现，即使在控制了雇主之间可观察到的差异后，生产任务的协调性仍存在很大的企业差异。此外，研究还发现，尽管协调性较高的雇主平均生产率更高，但在COVID危机中，他们报告了更严重的因工人短缺而导致的问题。 在本项目中，我首先将形式化以下观点，即企业在任务组织方面面临权衡取舍。在一个极端情况下，企业可以组织一个高度协调的生产过程，使每个工人处理严格指定的任务，从而最大化这种协调和专业化带来的收益。然而，这样的生产过程暴露于高风险中，因为一个工人的缺席就可能减缓整个工作流程并导致显著的产出损失。另一方面，企业可以让工人独立工作，互不干扰。此时，专业化带来的收益和因工人缺席带来的风险都将最小化。 其次，我将定量研究这种任务组织的宏观影响，重点关注其与技术和人口变化的相互作用：任务组织会对技术和人口的长期变化做出反应，而这种反应又会反馈到劳动力供应和劳动力市场的表现。这一分析通过将劳动力市场与企业组织联系起来，不仅提供理论上的意义，还能为劳动力市场政策设计提供新的见解。

23600724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23600724.value: 銀幕的產物：改革開放初期中國電影文化的物質性，1978-1989

23600724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23600724.value: This project assesses the development of a growingly commercialized Chinese film industry from the beginning of the “Reform and Opening” campaign (1978) to the outbreak of the Tiananmen Square Protest (1989). Adopting an interdisciplinary approach that combines oral history interviews with archival research in theater design, construction blueprints, and consumer goods, the main goal of this project is to provide a fresh account of 1980s Chinese film history with an emphasis on people’s consumerist practice of moviegoing. It argues that the rapid changes in film distribution, exhibition, and consumption illustrate the complex connections between the socialist state’s quest for modernization and the urban moviegoer’s everyday experience of public life in the wake of post-Mao China’s market turn. In a broad stroke, this project offers an alternative historiography of 1980s Chinese cinema based on intermedia explorations of the mode of exhibition, the process of audience formation, the paradigm of cultural consumption, and so on. To come to terms with 1980s Chinese cinema’s gradual shift toward a market economy using a historical-ethnographic approach, this project is divided into two interconnected parts. In the first part, the project explores the diverse film exhibition venues that emerged during this period in order to examine how the conception of cinema evolved during the 1980s. These venues ranged from the recently renovated socialist movie theaters of the time to the newly emerged video halls. Moving from analyses of the physical sites of film exhibition to the study of material objects, the second part delves into how the proliferation of cultural commodities helped reshape the public’s notions of cinema. It attends to a wide range of everyday items, including celebrity posters, photo albums, movie magazines, and more. The PI envisions this project to be the first scholarly account of 1980s Chinese film industry and film culture narrated from the perspective of the moviegoers, providing the film studies discipline with a new approach to understanding the multi-layered historical reality of Chinese cinema during the Early Reform Era. To amplify the findings of this project, the PI plans to submit two research papers for publication in top film studies journals. Furthermore, to enhance the project’s pedagogical applications in the classroom, the PI intends to make their collection of primary materials accessible to the public through the launch of a series of digital archives.

23600824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23600824.value: 幼兒空間技能的發展：家庭的影響因素及其與數字技能的關係

23600824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23600824.value: Mathematical ability is known to impact individuals’ future academic success, career choices, and income levels. Spatial skills—the ability to organize, manipulate, and reason with spatial information—have been shown to predict mathematical achievement in primary school students and teenagers. However, how different types of spatial skills contribute to young children’s early numerical skills, and whether these relations last over an extended period need more exploration. Moreover, less is known about how children’s space-related affects, such as interest in spatial activities and spatial anxiety, influence their use of spatial strategies in solving mathematical problems. Additionally, according to intergenerational transmission theory, children’s home spatial environment, which includes spatial learning materials, home spatial activities, and the quality of parent–child interactions, can influence their spatial skills and space-related affects. Most past research has focused on how home spatial activities influence children’s spatial skills, but the quality of parent–child interactions and spatial learning materials has been overlooked. To fill these gaps, we propose two studies. Study 1 proposes to recruit 215 children in Hong Kong and conduct follow-up assessments of their numerical skills over two years. The first study aims to understand how kindergarteners’ spatial skills contribute to their development of numerical skills over time, and whether affective factors, such as interest in spatial activities and spatial anxiety, impact this relation. Study 2 will explore the unique contributions of spatial learning materials, home spatial activities, and the quality of parent–child interactions to children’s spatial skills and space-related affects. This will involve self-reported questionnaires and observations of 264 children and their parents in Hong Kong over six months. By investigating the longitudinal relations between young children’s various spatial skills and numerical skills, we hope to shed light on potential spatial interventions for young children that can enhance their mathematical learning. Furthermore, by examining the independent contributions of different elements of the home spatial environment to children’s spatial skills and space-related affects, we aim to provide parents with guidance on which elements of the home spatial environment matter most for their children’s spatial development and how to foster children’s positive space-related affects. 眾多研究顯示數學能力會影響個體未來的學術成就、職業選擇和收入水平。空間技能——即組織、操縱和推理空間信息的能力——已被證明可以預測小學生和青少年的數學成就。然而，不同類型的空間技能如何影響幼兒早期數字技能，以及這些關係是否持續了較長時間，需要更多的探索。此外，關於兒童對空間技能的情感因素，如對空間活動的興趣和空間焦慮，如何影響他們在解決數學問題時使用空間策略，了解甚少。另外，根據代際傳遞理論，兒童的家庭學習環境，包括與空間技能有關的學習材料、家庭空間技能學習活動和親子互動質量，可以影響他們的空間技能和對空間活動的興趣。大多數過去的研究都集中在家庭空間學習活動的頻率如何影響兒童的空間技能上，但忽視了親子互動質量和空間學習材料。為了填補這些空白，我們提出了兩項研究。研究1計劃招募香港的215名兒童，並在兩年內對他們的數字技能進行跟踪評估。第一項研究旨在了解幼兒的空間技能如何隨時間推移影響他們數字技能的發展，並且情感因素，如對空間活動的興趣和空間焦慮，是否影響這種關係。研究2將探討空間學習材料、家庭空間技能學習活動和親子互動質量對兒童的空間技能和對空間活動的興趣的預測作用。這將涉及在香港對264名兒童及其父母進行為期六個月的自我報告問卷調查和觀察。通過研究幼兒各種空間技能和數字技能之間的長期關係，我們希望為幼兒提供可以增強其數學學習的干預措施。此外，通過研究家庭學習環境與兒童的空間技能和對空間活動的興趣的關係，我們旨在了解家庭學習環境中的哪些要素對子女的空間技能發展最為重要以及如何培養子女對空間活動的興趣，以期為家長提供指導。

23600924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23600924.value: 機器學習、腦電圖與兒童單詞閱讀：探索神經處理的本質及其超越認知語言技能識別母語中文讀寫困難的應用

23600924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23600924.value: Children’s word reading skills are important to academic, career, and life success. However, literacy difficulties are commonly misdiagnosed or missed due to the low reliability of relying on a single behavioral predictor (Wagner, 2018). Therefore, it is important to examine how neural markers can be utilized to improve the prediction of word reading difficulties. Research on utilizing the neural processing underlying Chinese character recognition for prediction is relatively rare. Most traditional electroencephalography (EEG) studies have focused on only univariate event-related potentials (ERPs). Our previous study (Lui et al., 2021b) used multivariate pattern classification analysis (MVPA), a more powerful multivariate technique, to examine the neural processing underlying Chinese character recognition. However, the nature and predictive power of the neural processing examined by MVPA remains largely unknown. The current project aims at examining the prediction power of the neural processing on Chinese word reading skills after controlling for important behavioral predictors such as nonverbal intelligence, rapid automized naming, and cognitive-linguistic skills. More importantly, to ensure good cross-validity of the model, the prediction model will be tested on data from an independent sample. In addition, the current project will explore the nature of the neural processing examined by MVPA. Firstly, we will examine whether the neural processing of different sub-processes underlying Chinese character recognition can be dissociated and mapped onto the three cognitive-linguistic skills: orthographic awareness, phonological awareness, and morphological awareness. Secondly, we will examine which visual skill is more important and to what extent each visual skill contribute to Chinese character recognition by examining the degree of overlapping in the neural processing underlying character recognition and object discriminations. The findings will (1) identify the most powerful, reliable, and cost-effective neural marker for word reading prediction, (2) contribute to the theoretical understanding of the neural processing examined by MVPA, and (3) provide important insights for designing behavioral intervention and neurofeedback training in the future. Finally, although MVPA has been suggested to be a more powerful technique, there has been little empirical evidence supporting this claim. This project will examine the claim by comparing the sensitivity of MVPA with univariance ERPs and topographic analysis of variance (TANOVA) in extracting the neural signatures of Chinese character recognition. The result of this part should be of great interest to neuroscientists as it will inform the sensitivity of each method in different contexts and provides insights on when to use which method in neuroscience research. 兒童的單詞閱讀能力對學術、事業和生活成功至關重要。然而，由於依賴單一行為預測因素的可靠性低，讀寫困難常常被誤診或漏診（Wagner，2018）。因此，研究如何利用神經標記來提高閱讀困難的預測是很重要的。然而，利用中文字符識別的神經處理進行預測的研究相對較為稀少。大多數傳統的腦電圖（EEG）研究僅關註單變量事件相關電位（ERP）。我們之前的研究（Lui et al., 2021b）使用了一種更強大的多變量技術–多變量模式分類分析（MVPA），來研究中文字符識別的神經處理。然而，MVPA所檢驗的神經處理的性質和預測力仍然在很大程度上未知。 本項目旨在在控製了非語言智力、快速自動命名和認知語言技能等重要行為預測因素後，檢驗神經處理對中文單詞閱讀能力的預測力。更重要的是，為了確保模型的良好交叉效度，預測模型將使用獨立樣本的數據進行測試。此外，本項目將探索MVPA所檢驗的神經處理的性質。首先，我們將檢驗中文字符識別所涉及的不同子過程的神經處理是否可以區分及映射到三個認知語言技能：正字意識、語音意識和語素意識。其次，我們將通過檢驗字符識別和物體辨別的神經處理重疊程度，來研究哪個視覺技能更重要以及每種視覺技能在多大程度上對中文字符識別作出貢獻。本項目研究結果將（1）找出強大、可靠和具有成本效益的單詞閱讀預測神經標記，（2）促進對MVPA所檢驗的神經處理的理論理解，（3）為未來設計行為幹預和神經反饋訓練提供重要見解。 最後，盡管MVPA被認為是一種更強大的技術，但支持這一主張的實證證據很少。本項目將通過比較MVPA與單變量ERP和地形方差分析（TANOVA）在提取中文字符識別的神經特征方面的敏感性，來檢驗這一主張。這部分結果對神經科學家來說應當非常感興趣，因為它將告知每種方法在不同情境下的敏感性，並提供關於在神經科學研究中何時使用哪種方法的見解。

23601924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23601924.value: 大型语言模型与劳动力市场竞争：一项实验研究

23601924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23601924.value: Large Language Models (LLMs), such as ChatGPT, have shown remarkable abilities in various fields, ranging from writing codes to communicating with humans empathically. Moreover, prior studies have found that LLMs substantially improve human workers’ productivity in different tasks. The potential of LLMs to help or even replace humans raises the public’s concern about job security. This project aims to investigate the impact of LLMs on labor market competition through two behavioral experiments. The Compete on Performance (CoP) experiment is designed to examine individuals’ uptake of and interaction with LLMs when facing different levels of competition. We will recruit experienced and college-educated professionals to perform writing tasks that are aligned with their daily jobs. Subjects will be randomly assigned to two groups. The control group guarantees performance-based wages for workers, while the treatment group requires workers to compete on performance to win the performance-based wages. In both groups, workers will perform two writing tasks. The first task has no access to ChatGPT and the second task allows assistance from ChatGPT. This design will provide observations to test, (1) whether the pressure of competition motivates uptake of and interaction with ChatGPT, (2) whether ChatGPT affects the competition consequence, and (3) who outperforms ChatGPT. The Compete on Wage (CoW) experiment is designed to examine whether and how LLMs affect workers’ reservation wage—the lowest wage rate at which a worker is willing to accept a job. Similar to the CoP experiment, professionals will be recruited to perform writing tasks and be randomly assigned to two groups. The control group involves no competition, while the treatment group involves competition whereby subjects with a lower reservation wage are more likely to get the job. Subjects will report reservation wages for two writing tasks, one without assistance from ChatGPT and one with assistance from ChatGPT. This design will allow us to test, (1) whether the access to ChatGPT reduces subjects’ reservation wage, and if so, (2) whether this reduction effect is stronger under competition. These two experiments capture distinct competition schemes observed in real-life job markets, which allow investigation on how LLMs influence workers' behavior and competition outcomes. This project will contribute to the literature on the impact of technology development on the labor market, experimental studies based on LLMs, and algorithm aversion. The findings of this project have the potential to provide insights for future labor regulations. 大型语言模型（LLMs），如ChatGPT，在各个领域展示了显著的能力，从编写代码到与人类进行充分交流。此外，先前的研究发现，LLMs在不同任务中显著提高了人类工人的生产力。LLMs帮助甚至取代人类的潜力引发了公众对工作保障的担忧。该项目旨在通过两个行为实验研究LLMs对劳动力市场竞争的影响。绩效竞争实验（CoP）旨在研究个人在面对不同水平的竞争时对LLMs的接受和互动情况。我们将招募有经验且受过大学教育的专业人士来完成与其日常工作相关的写作任务。受试者将被随机分配到两个组。控制组保证工人的绩效工资，而处理组要求工人通过竞争赢得绩效工资。在两个组中，工人将完成两个写作任务。第一个任务不允许使用ChatGPT，第二个任务允许ChatGPT的协助。这个设计将提供观察以测试，（1）竞争压力是否会激励对ChatGPT的接受和互动，（2）ChatGPT是否会影响竞争结果，以及（3）谁优于ChatGPT。 薪酬竞争实验（CoW）旨在研究LLMs是否以及如何影响工人的保留工资——工人愿意接受工作的最低工资率。与CoP实验类似，我们将招募专业人士进行写作任务，并随机分配到两组。控制组不涉及竞争，而处理组涉及竞争，其中保留工资较低的受试者更有可能得到工作。受试者将报告两个写作任务的保留工资，一个没有ChatGPT的协助，一个有ChatGPT的协助。这个设计将允许我们测试，（1）访问ChatGPT是否会降低受试者的保留工资，如果是，（2）这种降低效果在竞争下是否更强。这两个实验捕捉到现实生活中观察到的不同竞争模式，从而能够研究LLMs如何影响工人的行为和竞争结果。该项目将为技术发展对劳动力市场的影响、基于LLMs的实验研究以及算法规避提供文献贡献。该项目的研究结果有可能为未来的劳动法规提供见解。

23602424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23602424.value: 香港後殖民發展式新自由主義下的社運紀錄片，1997-2014

23602424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23602424.value: 本研究探討1997年至2014年間香港社運紀錄片的歷史和社會政治角色。本研究把這些電影置於香港後殖民發展式新自由主義快速金融現代化的背景下，分析社運紀錄片的製作、意義、傳播和接受情況。通過檔案研究、文本分析和訪談，本研究展示獨立製片人如何以他們作品反映社會議題和政治事件，包括從勞工權利到城市規劃的抗爭。從理論上來看，本研究在全球發展式新自由主義下，概念化香港的特殊特性，這種特殊特性以城市化、金融化、發展式政治、新自由化和後殖民主義為特徵。 本研究認為，香港的社運電影製作培養了一種參與社會的共同主體性，它提供了一種替代主體，有別於發展式新自由主義秩序中盛行的個人主義和資本主義自利主體。這種以社群為導向的主體催生了更具參與性質的電影製作方法，以及更多用於傳播這些作品的協作網絡。在本地，社區放映鼓勵居民和基層活動人士之間的對話，通過集體反思和動員，加強社會運動。在地緣區域上，香港紀錄片電影節和獨立電影節的興起為與台灣、日本、歐洲等地製片人之間的跨國傳播和交流提供了新平台。本研究指出，在香港主權移交中國大陸後，殖民統治的遺毒，加上金融化和城市化的加劇，阻礙了香港居民積極的社會和政治參與方式，而社運紀錄片則培養出有利政治參與的反文化空間。如此，熱衷社會參與的主體持續為爭取權利和自由努力奮鬥。 本歷史調查研究旨在對現實世界產生以下影響：（1）提高對香港社運紀錄片歷史的認識，以支授倡議和教育；（2）保存瀕危和被忽視的視覺圖像，並促進保存和修復工作；（3）創建分析本地文化和社會的概念理論，有利電影研究、媒體研究和社會學的跨學科學術研究；（4）激勵新的具社會意識的電影製作；（5）促進香港、東亞和世界之間的跨文化理解和交流；以及（6）為有效的媒體策略提供意見。 最終，通過凸顯社運電影製作如何參與社會，本研究旨在對從檔案管理實踐到公共論述等多個領域產生正面影響。揭示此文化歷史，不僅填補了學術空白，且對於社會運動、策展和公眾對本地歷史和電影文化的理解，都別具意義。本研究項目記錄了社運紀錄片如何促進權力結構、社群建設和人權運動的改革。

23603324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23603324.value: 冷戰時期的香港、女性寫作與全球英語文學的形成

23603324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23603324.value: This project weaves a history of multiple encounters — of individuals, cultures, ideologies, languages — that prompted two Chinese women writers to produce English-language fiction for a “global” audience during the Cold War. The English works of Eileen Chang and Han Suyin bring to light the histories and experiences of women at the intersection of European imperial decline and the rise of Communism in Asia, experiences often neglected because they do not easily fit the critical frames of either Western or postcolonial feminism. The present study recovers their works as bold attempts at crossing linguistic, cultural, and ideological divides, and in doing so challenges the national insularity of much global Anglophone scholarship. In examining the careers and general reception of Chang and Han as Anglophone writers, this project offers new insights into how the framing of non-Western women’s writing in the global cultural marketplace highlights larger systems of political rivalry between world powers. I draw on Cold War studies and theories of world literature to retrieve and assess Chang’s and Han’s understudied literary experiments with the English language, delineating the global forces that shape the production and circulation of these texts. In doing so, this project also highlights colonial outposts like Hong Kong as cosmopolitan spaces that are significant to the development of global English and the global Anglophone. A larger objective of this project is to recover an alternative genealogy of transnational feminism, situating it in the context of modern China’s transformation from semi-colonial feudal empire to socialist state. Driven partly by political and economic exigencies under the new Communist regime, but also inspired by their cosmopolitan upbringing in semi-colonial China, Chang’s and Han’s works were collaborations with a wide range of Western cultural institutions, from Hollywood to the United States Information Agency, which operated in tandem with the US State Department. I read their turn to the romance genre and writing in English as a strategy by which they navigated between the Western model of colonial modernity and Soviet and Maoist models of state socialism, all of which laid claims to women’s emancipation from traditional Chinese patriarchy. Their pivots towards global Anglophone literature avant la lettre, I contend, illustrate the conjunctures of race and gender that will make a significant contribution to transnational feminist criticism. 這項研究旨在透過解讀張愛玲和韓素音的英文作品，編寫一段結合個人、社會文化、意識形態、以及語言政治的冷戰文化歷史。張愛玲和韓素音雖為華裔女作家，但卻選擇以英語創作，志在躋身世界文學文壇。她們的英文作品揭示了中國女性在歐洲帝國衰落和亞洲共產主義興起時的歷史和經歷。這些經歷常常被忽視，因為它們並不容易符合西方或後殖民女性主義的批判框架。全球英語文學研究多認為英語文學發展皆受民族國界區隔而缺乏互動，但由於張愛玲和韓素音大膽嘗試跨越語言、文化和意識形態界限，她們的作品正可被視為對這些文學研究的一種挑戰。 透過探討張愛玲和韓素音作為英語作家的職業生涯及全球讀者對其作品的評價，這項研究亦揭示「非西方」女性寫作在全球文化市場的定位如何突顯出冷戰列強之間的系統性政治對立。我借用冷戰研究和世界文學理論來回顧和評價張愛玲和韓素音彷如文學實驗般的英語創作，並描繪一系列影響文本生產和流通的全球力量，從而強調香港等殖民地作為全球英語和全球英語文學發展中的重要國際空間。 本硏究的一個更大目標，是以現代中國從半殖民半封建帝國轉型向社會主義國家作為背景，勾劃出跨國女性主義的另一種譜系。張愛玲和韓素音既受二十世紀初中國趨於國際化和現代化的思潮啟發，又被新共產政權帶來的新政治經濟狀況所帶動，終於轉向以英語寫作，並與荷里活、美國新聞署等西方政治文化機構合作。我將其英語浪漫小說解讀為一種策略，用以游走於西方殖民現代性模式、蘇聯模式、和毛澤東思想下的國家社會主義模式之間，同時集中硏究她們如何批判評論這些聲稱要解放女性脫離傳統中國父權的主義及政治體系。張愛玲和韓素音轉向全球英語文學的踐行展示了種族和性別的多元交叉性，這將為跨國女性主義批評做出重要貢獻。

23607124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23607124.value: 為什麼不是知識菁英制。

23607124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23607124.value: Epistocracy is a form of government where the possession of political knowledge is a legal precondition for the possession of political power. Examples of epistocratic proposals include restricted suffrage (which grants voting privileges only to citizens who can pass a voter qualification exam), epistocratic councils (which grant limited powers of various kinds to highly knowledgeable citizens), and more. Such proposals are controversial, but they have been defended on the grounds that they are epistemically superior to competing democratic institutions -- that is, epistocratic institutions are better able to acquire and soundly use information necessary to make laws and policies benefitting everyone. The aim of this project is to advance the current debate between proponents and opponents of epistocracy. Many potential problems that epistocratic institutions might encounter have been identified. For example, many worry that epistocracy is more susceptible to corruption than democracy. For another, others claim that epistocracy would decrease levels of political stability. These are important problems. But existing work suffers from some important drawbacks. First, only a narrow range of epistocratic proposals have been considered. Moreover, those that receive some attention are often left vague and underdeveloped. Second, potential epistocratic solutions to the problems it faces have been unjustifiably dismissed or overlooked. This project will rectify these drawbacks. One of its goals is to highlight institutional possibilities that have been previously neglected. Such institutions will be outlined with a greater degree of detail than previous proposals, allowing a more fine-grained analysis of the overall costs and benefits of epistocratic institutions and their alternatives. Another goal is to clarify and address the various problems and challenges that epistocracy faces, such as the aforementioned difficulties related to political corruption and political instability. These are serious challenges, but their ultimate severity is unclear. More importantly, plausible mechanisms by which epistocracies could mitigate these risks should be considered. Overall, this project will improve our ability to make informed decisions about whether to pursue epistocratic reforms or not -- something deeply important for those interested in better political institutions and better governance. 知識菁英制（epistocracy）作為一種政府形式，將擁有政治知識作為獲得政治權利的法律前提。知識菁英制的提案包括但不限於1）限制選舉權（即僅授予能通過選民資格考試的公民投票權）、2）知識菁英制度委員會（即授予高知公民各種有限權力）。這些提案具有爭議性，但支持者認為它們在認知上優於民主機構──也就是說，知識菁英制機構能更好的獲取並合理運用那些對於制定有利於所有人的法律和政策所必須的信息。 這個研究項目的目的是推動當前對於知識菁英制理論支持者和反對者之間的辯論。學者們已經發現許多關於知識菁英制機構提案可能遇到的問題。例如，許多人擔心知識菁英制可能比民主制更容易受到腐敗的影響。有人聲稱知識菁英制會降低政治穩定性。這些都是重要的問題。然而，現有的研究存在一些重要的缺陷。首先，只有小範圍的一些知識菁英制提案在文獻中被討論。其次，那些獲得一些關注的提案往往被表述得模糊且不夠完善。最後，對於知識菁英制所面對的問題的潛在解決方案被不合理地忽視或排除。 這個項目將糾正這些缺陷。其目標之一是強調之前被忽視的制度的可能性。相較於之前的提案，這些制度將會被更詳細的描述。通過更為詳細的描述，我們可以對知識菁英制及其替代方案的總體成本和收益進行更細緻的分析。這個項目的另外一個目標是是澄清和解決知識菁英制所面臨的各種問題和挑戰，例如前面提到的關於政治腐敗和政治不穩定的問題。這些都是嚴重的挑戰，但是它們的最終的嚴重性尚不明。更重要是，我們還應該考慮那些可減輕上述風險的合理機制。總體來說，這個研究可以提高我們對是否追求知識菁英制做出明智決定的能力。對於那些感興趣與更好政治制度和更好政府治理的人來說，這個十分重要的。

24105724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24105724.value: 內鏡黏膜下層隧道肌肉切開術加內鏡胃底接疊術治療食道失馳緩症 - 國際多中心隨機對比研究

24105724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24105724.value: 引言 經口內鏡肌切開術(POEM)已成為治療食道失弛緩症的首選內鏡治療方式,其症狀緩解效果可與腹腔鏡肌切開術相媲美。POEM的主要擔憂在於術後胃酸反流(GERD)的發生率較高。為降低GERD的風險,一種新的內鏡下胃底摺疊術(POEM-F)已經發表,模擬外科前部分胃底摺疊術,可與POEM同時進行。對POEM-F進行的多中心回顧性隊列研究顯示,其技術成功率高,不良事件率與常規POEM相似。最重要的是,POEM-F後客觀GERD的發生率較低。目前尚缺乏POEM-F與常規POEM術後GERD的前瞻性對比數據。因此,我們設計了一項國際多中心單盲隨機研究,以評估POEM-F的療效。我們假設POEM-F可降低術後客觀GERD的發生率,與常規POEM相比。 方法 這是一項由香港、中國大陸、印度和美國等高量中心參與的國際多中心隨機對照試驗。確診為I-III型食道失弛緩症的成年患者將被隨機分配至POEM-F組或POEM組,由經驗豐富的POEM專家執刀。主要終點指標為術後1年時的客觀GERD發生率,根據更新後的里昂共識標準(Lyon Consensus),結合內鏡及24小時pH-阻抗監測結果,評估者對治療分組盲設。次要終點指標包括技術及臨床成功率、不良事件發生率,以及術後內鏡、24小時pH-阻抗監測、肌動力學檢查、內鏡超音波等結果,以及患者症狀評分。 樣本量計算 根據既往POEM-F和POEM的多中心隊列研究數據,採用保守估計,預計需要96例患者,以80%的統計功效和0.05的假陽性率,檢測術後客觀GERD發生率從50.0%降至22.2%的差異,並考慮5%的隨訪丟失。 目的和潛力 該研究可證明POEM-F較常規POEM在降低術後GERD發生率方面的優勢。還可展示該技術在全球專家中心的安全性和可重複性。POEM-F有潛力取代常規POEM,成為食道失弛緩症的首選微創內鏡治療方式。

24109024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24109024.value: 闡明INPP5B調控磷酸肌醇於肝癌幹性和腫瘤發揮的作用

24109024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24109024.value: 肝細胞癌（HCC）是原發性肝癌中最惡性、最致命的一種。 腫瘤內高度可塑性的細胞亞群，即腫瘤幹細胞（CSC），現在被認為是腫瘤發生和癌症進展的驅動因素。了解肝癌CSC的複雜生物學組成及其與致癌訊號通路的交叉將有助於發現能根除CSC的新分子靶點。 為了尋找在HCC中調節癌症幹性和腫瘤發生中發揮重要作用的臨床相關關鍵基因和途徑，我們採用了腫瘤幹性評分（TSS）來挖掘癌症基因組圖譜的HCC數据集（TCGA–LIHC數据集），該評分反影癌細胞幹性的程度（Malta et al., Nature 2018）。 TSS高和TSS低HCC患者轉錄組的基因富集分析表明，磷酸肌醇代謝和信號傳導與TSS呈負相關。在磷酸肌醇信號傳導中最受調控的基因中，肌醇多磷酸-5-磷酸酶B（INPP5B）的表達與幹細胞標誌物特徵密切相關。 初步功能實驗揭示了INPP5B在HCC中的腫瘤抑制作用。 通過RNA測序，INPP5B的過表達導致mTOR/PPARγ信號傳導失調，並重新連接脂質代謝。我們更發現在HCC患者樣本中，INPP5B在HCC樣本中經常下調，其表達下調與較差的生存率相關。我們提出的工作旨在闡明INPP5B下調在協調肝細胞癌中磷酸肌醇信號傳導和脂質代謝中的新機制。我們還將評估INPP5B的臨床意義，它可能成為預測臨床預後的新生物標誌物。

24110224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24110224.value: 高雄激素血症誘導的内臟脂肪功能異常的研究

24110224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24110224.value: Androgen excess (hyperandrogenism) causally leads to central obesity, a worse type of obesity characterized by hypertrophic (enlarged) adipocytes in visceral adipose tissue (VAT) and metabolic disorders. Using hyperandrogenic female mouse model, we found a malformation of extracellular matrix (ECM) in VAT upon hyperandrogenism, which is reported to ensue with adipocyte hypertrophy, central obesity and metabolic disorders. To characterize the link between hyperandrogenism and ECM malformation in VAT, single cell Sequencing (scSeq) was performed, which unexpectedly revealed the mesothelial cell showed the most prominent changes both in number and in expression profile, among all the cell types recovered. In particular, the number of mesothelial cells was reduced by 50% in VAT of hyperandrogenic female mice, coincided with downregulation of protein chaperones, and upregulation of ER stress and apoptosis related genes. Reductions in mesothelial cell number and ECM deposition were also observed in human VAT with hyperandrogenism. Importantly, in VAT organoid, ECM formation was compromised when mesothelial cell was depleted, and recovered by conditioned medium (CM) of mesothelial cell, demonstrating mesothelial cell is an indispensable contributor to VAT ECM formation. Mechanistically, decorin (DCN), a proteoglycan that plays an essential role in ECM assembly, was abundantly expressed in healthy mesothelial cells but was substantially downregulated upon hyperandrogenism. The effect of mesothelial CM to assist ECM formation was abolished upon neutralization of DCN. We hypothesize adipose mesothelial cell is a major caveat in hyperandrogenism-evoked VAT remodeling. Upon hyperandrogenism, ER stress and apoptosis are induced in mesothelial cells, leading to a reduction of mesothelial cell number in VAT; meanwhile proteoglycan DCN was downregulated in mesothelial cells. Together these two events cause a significant deficiency of DCN in VAT, leading to ECM malformation. This eventually culminates in adipocyte hypertrophy, central obesity and metabolic dysfunctions. In the current proposal we aim to (1) Complete the genome-wide profiling of AR binding sites in mesothelial cell and to clarify how androgen regulates ER stress, apoptosis and Dcn expression in mesothelial cell; (2) Elucidate the physiological and pathological functions of mesothelial cell and the androgen receptor (AR) signaling in mesothelial cell using mesothelial-selective Ar KO mice and mesothelial cell-ablated mice; (3) Address whether mesothelial cell contributes to VAT ECM formation via secreting DCN. The project will unravel the previously unrecognized function of mesothelial cells and AR signaling within it in determining VAT biology, and establish mesothelial cell as a new cellular target for central obesity and its related diseases. 女性長期的高雄激素水平會導致中心性肥胖，這是一種不健康的肥胖模式，主要特徵表現爲内臟脂肪（VAT）中脂肪細胞肥大及全身代謝紊亂。在高雄激素小鼠中，我們在内臟脂肪中檢測到了細胞外基質（ECM）畸形，並導致脂肪細胞肥大、中心性肥胖及代謝紊亂。通過單細胞測序發現，在所有非免疫細胞中，閒皮細胞的數量和表達譜在雄激素處理後變化最顯著。其中，内質網應激（ER stress）及細胞凋亡相關的基因均增加，閒皮細胞的數量也減少了50%，并且這種ECM和閒皮細胞的流失也在高雄激素血症患者的VAT中被檢測到。此外在VAT類器官模型中，閒皮細胞的缺失也會造成ECM的積纍異常，但可以通過添加閒皮細胞的分泌物來恢復。其中decorin是閒皮細胞的分泌物中調節ECM結構的主要成分，它是一種蛋白聚糖，幫助ECM完成組裝過程。 本研究假設在内臟脂肪中，閒皮細胞是高雄激素誘發VAT重塑的重要靶細胞，高雄激素誘導閒皮細胞ER stress並導致凋亡，造成VAT中閒皮細胞數量減少；同時，DCN在閒皮細胞中的表達下調。這兩方面同時造成了VAT中DCN水平的大幅下降，從而使ECM發育不良，最終導致脂肪細胞肥大、中樞性肥胖及代謝障礙。 目前本研究的下一步計劃主要為：（1）完成閒皮細胞中與雄激素受體（AR）結合位點的測序分析，闡明雄激素調節ER stress、細胞凋亡及DCN表達的機制；（2）利用閒皮細胞特異性AR敲除小鼠和閒皮細胞消融小鼠探究閒皮細胞中AR下游的信號通路及閒皮細胞的功能；（3）探討閒皮細胞分泌的DCN在VAT ECM形成中的作用機制。本課題主要聚焦之前未被研究過的閒皮細胞和AR信號在VAT中的功能，并且將閒皮細胞識別爲新的雄激素靶細胞，來調控中心性肥胖及相關疾病。

24112624.value: 大腸鏡檢查期間息肉表徵的電腦輔助診斷 (CADx) 的臨床和成本效益。一項多中心隨機對照試驗。

24112624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24112624.value: 研究目的：本研究旨在比較由即時人工智慧（AI）驅動的電腦輔助診斷系統和常規的人工光學診斷技術在評估息肉特徵的診斷準確性和成本效益。 研究背景：結腸鏡檢查時切除息肉可預防結直腸癌的發生。息肉切除後，標準的處理方法是將其進行組織學分析，以確定接下來的監測時間間隔。然而，大多數息肉較小，屬於非腫瘤性，發展為結直腸癌的風險較低。人工光學診斷技術已被證明可以用於區分腫瘤性和非腫瘤性息肉，因此可以節省組織學檢查費用，並避免不必要的息肉切除術。然而，值得注意的是，由於人工光學診斷較為主觀，它需要高度依賴于操作人員，這使得這項技術的實施具有一定的挑戰性。解決此難題的方法之一就是使用由AI驅動的電腦輔助檢查系統，它可以提供自動化、客觀和即時的息肉表徵。雖然一些小規模的臨床試驗已經證實了由AI驅動的電腦輔助檢查系統的有效性，這些試驗仍存在一些局限性。例如，之前的臨床試驗樣本量較小，主要集中在小型直腸乙狀結腸息肉，市面上產品的實用性和相容性有限，以及缺乏對成本效益的評估。研究者需要進一步評估由即時AI驅動的電腦輔助診斷系統，使其在臨床實踐中具有更廣泛的適用性和經濟可行性。 研究方法：將從中國內陸和香港的6個內鏡中心招募年齡至少為40歲，接受過結腸鏡檢查且至少發現一個息肉的患者。這些人將隨機接受由AI驅動的電腦輔助診斷系統（人工智慧組）或傳統的人工光學診斷技術（控制組）進行的結腸鏡檢查。在人工智慧組中，探測到的息肉將被劃分為非腫瘤性(窄帶成像國際結直腸內鏡一類)、腺瘤(窄帶成像國際結直腸內鏡二類)或侵襲性腫瘤(窄帶成像國際結直腸內鏡三類)。在控制組中，內窺鏡醫師將使用相同的窄帶成像國際結直腸內鏡分類進行人工光學檢查。所有探測到的息肉將被切除並送去做組織學分析，並以此作為參考標準。本研究主要關注的結果是結腸鏡檢查時息肉組織學診斷的即時準確性。次要結果包括敏感性、特異性、陽性和陰性預測值。亞組分析將會考慮到內窺鏡醫師的經驗、腸道準備、息肉大小、位置和形態等因素。我們將根據國際指南來評估並決定基於息肉切除術後的組織學檢驗結果的監測時間間隔。 我們將會計算由AI驅動的電腦輔助診斷系統的增量成本效益比，以評估其成本效益。 研究價值：本研究將明確由AI驅動的電腦輔助檢查系統的診斷準確性和成本效益，為制定由AI驅動的電腦輔助檢查系統的臨床指南提供依據。長遠來看，本研究還將通過消除不必要的息肉切除術和組織學檢查來降低醫療成本。

24122024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24122024.value: 動作表現技術與知覺動作訓練對肩袖疼痛的治療功效

24122024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24122024.value: 肩袖疼痛是常見肩痛之一。患有肩袖疼痛的患者會有神經及肌肉系統的缺失，包括肩關節生物力學、肌力及控制的改變。最新研究發現， 肩袖疼痛會令中樞神經系統功能改變，包括中樞疼痛處理缺失和大腦重組。 肩袖疼痛的傳統治療主要著重修復周邊機制的結構及功能障礙。然而，研究顯示，30% 的患者對於傳統物理治療是無效的; 而接受手術修復的患者中，有25%感到有限的功能改善。鑑於肩袖疼痛的中樞神經系統經歷塑性重組，因此治療方向需結合周邊及中樞機制以改善肩袖疼痛及功能。 知覺動作訓練是傳統運動訓練中可有效改善神經及肌肉系統。而「動作表現技術」是新的訓練形式，透過觀察（動作觀察訓練）、想像（運動想像）和視覺回饋（鏡像療法）將動作與想像結合在一起。研究發現「動作表現技術」可增加大腦運動皮質的皮質表徵和興奮性，從而促進動作學習和控制能力。因此，「動作表現技術」與知覺動作訓練，結合了周邊和中樞機制而改善療效。 本研究的主要目的是評估「動作表現技術」結合知覺動作訓練對肩袖疼痛的療效。此外，這項研究將探討中樞機制治療對肩袖疼痛的治療機制。 我們會進行一項隨機對照試驗。 122 名患有肩袖疼痛將被隨機分配接受「動作表現技術」與知覺動作訓練或傳統治療。治療前及治療後會為參加者測試疼痛指數﹑腦部運動皮質的變化﹑及其他中介變數包括神經肌肉表現及心理測試。

24202024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24202024.value: 軟體機器人的具身分佈式物理智能

24202024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24202024.value: 軟體機器人具有獨特的功能，包括出色的適應性和可擴展性、靈活的運動模式以及良性的人機交互，可廣泛應用於操縱和復健領域。然而，為了與外部環境交互，氣動軟機器人嚴重依賴傳統的機電一體化來形成「感測、控制和驅動」回饋迴路。這些機電一體化及其相關電路剛性、複雜，與軟材料不相容，無法在極端惡劣的環境（例如高溫、水和腐蝕性物質的環境）下運行，這限制了軟機器人的功能和外形尺寸。在這個專案中，受到基於體現和分散式物理智慧實現響應性的生物適應性結構的啟發，我們提出了新穎的控制策略來實現氣動軟機器人的自主性，其感測、控制和驅動都體現並分佈在其物理身體。具體來說，我們將開發基於多種3D列印刺激響應材料的功能控制模組和智慧閥門，例如液晶彈性體（LCE）、水凝膠和有機矽。這些材料使機器人能夠感知並回應各種不同的環境刺激（例如溫度、水和其他溶劑）。此外，儘管缺乏電子設備，但可以透過組合多種類型的控制模組和響應閥來實現基本邏輯閘和高級邏輯評估。最後，這些控制單元或智慧閥門將被具體化並分配給氣動軟機器人。氣動軟機器人的形態或壓力可以被控制和調節，導致機器人的行為（例如形狀、功能和軌跡）在外部刺激下發生理想的轉變。該計畫為在非結構化和動態環境中運作的氣動軟機器人的自主性提供了新穎的控制策略。它產生了基礎科學知識（例如，了解響應材料的能力和局限性、機械計算、響應閥門、多種響應材料的增材製造）和“無電子”自主軟機器人形式的實際應用，這些機器人可以利用嵌入體內的簡單但有效的物理智慧來感知並回應各種環境刺激。

24203724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24203724.value: 基於協同優化方法的微環諧振器集成光路和神經網絡的控制與訓練

24203724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24203724.value: Large-scale silicon photonic integrated circuits (SiPICs) play a crucial role in shaping the future of data communications, artificial intelligence, and quantum information processing, offering the potential to overcome the limitations arising from the demise of Moore's law. Among the different devices in SiPICs, microring resonators (MRRs) are widely adopted for large-scale integration due to their compact footprint, energy-efficient tuning and modulation, and high sensitivity. Nevertheless, the sensitivity also introduces challenges in their management and control amid non-ideal behaviors, such as fabrication-yield variations and dynamic thermal crosstalk. With the increasing complexity of SiPICs, programming such a system becomes overwhelmingly difficult. Meanwhile, power consumption rises significantly as the system scales. The heat generated may eventually surpass the thermal dissipation capacity of SiP chips and make the system vulnerable to environmental disturbances. As a result, the scalability of PIC, a critical factor for achieving functional complexity and integration density, continues to face severe limitations. This project aims to address the above challenges through a synergistic optimization framework. The proposed framework will facilitate precise and efficient control and programming of various MRR-based PIC systems. Furthermore, hardware performance-related objectives can be integrated into the programming process, enabling the system to autonomously find solutions for minimizing power consumption and enhancing resilience to environmental disturbances. In contrast to other approaches, our approach can control large-scale MRR systems using a gradient descent-based algorithm without requiring either extensive device calibration or a large-scale digital proxy model. The proposed optimization framework will be experimentally demonstrated on various MRR-based PIC systems for three distinct applications, including large-scale matrix-vector multipliers, reconfigurable microwave photonic filters, and photonic neural network training. We will develop and evaluate optimization algorithms together with the design and tapeout of SiP chips for the above applications. Our work takes an important step towards large-scale and reliable MRR-based PICs, enabling performance improvement for a wide range of applications. 大規模硅光子集成光路（SiPICs）在塑造未來數據通信、人工智能和量子信息處理方面起着關鍵作用，具有克服摩爾定律失效帶來的局限性的潛力。在SiPICs中的各種器件中，微環諧振器（MRRs）由於其緊湊的尺寸、能效調諧和調製以及高靈敏度而被廣泛採用於大規模集成。然而，這種高靈敏度也帶來了管理和控制方面的挑戰，如製造産量的變化和動態熱串擾。隨着SiPICs的複雜性增加，編程這樣一個系統變得極其困難。同時，隨着系統的擴展，功耗顯著增加。産生的熱量可能最終超過矽光子芯片的散熱能力，使系統容易受到環境幹擾。因此，實現功能複雜性和集成密度的關鍵因素——PIC的可擴展性，仍面臨着嚴峻的限制。 本項目旨在通過協同優化框架來解決上述挑戰。擬議的框架將有助於各種基於MRR的PIC系統的精確和高效控制與編程。此外，與硬件性能相關的目標可以集成到編程過程中，使系統能夠自主找到減少功耗和增強對環境幹擾的抵抗力的解決方案。與其他方法相比，我們的方法可以使用基於梯度下降的算法控制大規模MRR系統，而無需進行廣泛的設備校準或大規模數字代理模型。該優化框架將在各種基於MRR的PIC系統上進行實驗驗証，涵蓋三個不同的應用，包括大規模矩陣-向量乘法器、可重構微波光子濾波器和光子神經網絡訓練。我們將開發和評估優化算法，並爲上述應用設計和製造SiP芯片。我們的工作爲實現大規模且可靠的基於MRR的PICs邁出了重要一步，從而提高廣泛應用的性能。

24204924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24204924.value: 面向軟體機器人知覺/本體感知的傳感器設計與數位製造計算系統開發

24204924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24204924.value: Leveraging intelligent structural designs and the incorporation of soft materials, the evolution and success of soft robotic systems hinge on their ability to intelligently sense and adapt to the environment, with capabilities of perception and proprioception. While perception allows a robot to recognize and adapt to surroundings, proprioception endows it with self-awareness of configuration changes in robot bodies. The incorporation of specialized sensor arrays to support perception and proprioception has become an emerging research focus, given its potential to deliver interaction-aware feedback signals. However, the current development of these sensor systems is still not satisfying, with a primary reason being the lack of robust and effective computational tools. From the design perspective, the high dimensional configuration space of soft robots brings significant complexity to sensor optimization. In terms of fabrication, the limitation of prevalent methods - whether manually attaching off-the-shelf sensor or using planar-based multi-material 3D printing - constrains the seamless integration between sensor system and soft robot, which in turn narrows the design possibilities. In this proposal, I aim to revolutionize the computational design and digital manufacturing of advanced soft robot systems with integrated sensor arrays, enabling stable and high-precision perception and proprioception during autonomous interactions. Departing from traditional in-plane skin-based sensors, our approach emphasizes a three-dimensional design space. This enables the creation of curve-based 3D sensor arrays with enhanced sensitivity. To streamline computational complexity, we will employ data-driven techniques to analyze the deformation patterns of the soft robot under diverse actuation and autonomous interactions. By identifying a lower-dimensional latent space, we can more effectively guide the computation for sensor design and fabrication. Thereafter, we will introduce a gradient-based sensor optimization pipeline that centers on finding optimal sensor distribution to maximize sensitivity and enhance the precision in sensor-guided shape reconstruction. Simultaneously, to enable success in physical fabrication, we plan to employ multi-axis in-liquid direct soft material 3D printing technology. A field-oriented computational kernel for toolpath generation will be built, guiding accurate spatial alignment of both soft and sensor material in three-dimensional space. With utilized computational designs and digital manufacturing, case studies will be conducted to verify the effectiveness of developed soft robotic systems with integrated sensors, which show superior shape prediction ability and adapt to environmental interactions. This includes a cable-driven soft robot hand determining object shape and texture, a pneumatic soft manipulator navigating confined areas, and a walking robot adjusting its locomotion based on terrain softness. 軟體機器人系統通過結合先進的智能結構設計與軟材料，具備有感知和本體感覺的能力以適應各種複雜環境條件。感知能力使機器人能夠識別和適應周圍環境，而本體感覺則使機器人能夠自我意識到自身身體構型的變化。為了實現這些功能，傳感器陣列的融入已成為一個新興的研究熱點。然而，當前傳感器系統的發展仍面臨挑戰，特別是缺乏穩健且高效的計算工具。從設計角度看，軟體機器人的高維構型空間為傳感器優化帶來了複雜性；從製造角度看，無論是手動安裝傳感器還是採用基於平面的多材料3D列印技術，都存在局限性，阻礙了傳感器系統與軟體機器人之間的無縫集成，進而限制了設計創新的潛力。 本項目旨在通過計算設計和數字化集成製造技術，革新軟體機器人傳感器陣列系統，確保機器人在自主交互中實現穩定且高精度的感知和本體感覺。不同於傳統的平面皮膚傳感器，本項目採用三維設計空間，能夠創建基於曲線的三維傳感器陣列，顯著提升靈敏度。為簡化計算複雜性，我們將採用數據驅動技術分析軟體機器人在不同驅動和交互下的變形模式，並運用AI方法識別低維變形空間，以更有效地指導計算，優化傳感器陣列的幾何結構和分佈，確保傳感器與軟體機器人基體之間的高效無縫集成。此外，本項目還將開發一個綜合仿真平台，用於預測和優化傳感器在軟體機器人中的性能，並驗證設計在實際應用中的有效性。我們還將引入基於梯度的傳感器優化流程，尋找最優傳感器分佈，以最大化靈敏度並提升形狀重建的精度。在製造方面，本項目將採用矽膠直寫技術實現軟材料的空間增材製造，並構建面向場的計算流程來生成工具路徑，確保軟材料和傳感器材料在三維空間中的精確對齊。最後，我們將通過案例研究驗證所開發的集成傳感器軟體機器人系統的有效性。這些案例將展示系統出色的形狀預測能力和對環境交互的適應性，包括線驅動的軟體機器人手用於物體形狀和紋理識別、氣動軟體操縱器在受限區域導航，以及行走機器人根據地形軟硬度調整運動方式。通過這些案例，我們將充分展示集成傳感器陣列的軟體機器人在實際應用中的巨大潛力和顯著優勢。

24209224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24209224.value: 針對魯棒圖像處理構建的仿真環境

24209224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24209224.value: Camera systems are a critical component of AI-driven computer vision systems, including autonomous vehicles, medical imaging, manufacturing quality control, agricultural automation, VR, AR, and retail. In camera systems, raw sensor data undergo in-camera processing to enhance image quality before being forwarded to downstream AI modules, and thus the quality of the image greatly affects their performance, particularly in challenging conditions, like low light or bad weather. Recently, neural network-based image processing has shown potential to significantly enhance image quality under these conditions due to its capability to learn image priors. However, the performance of learning-based image processing is closely tied to the size and quality of the training dataset. Unlike other visual tasks, training an image processing pipeline requires training pairs with ground truth, which is difficult to collect. The labor effort and time costs on data collection are hundreds of times larger than other tasks, like object recognition. Moreover, active capturing systems, like auto-exposure, require online generated training images, while most datasets are generated offline. To address these limitations, we propose an innovative synthetic approach to large-scale datasets for imaging systems. To generate large-scale training images and support online image generation, we utilize images rendered by graphics engines, the latest powerful image generation model, and large image datasets based on Internet images. First, images rendered by graphics engines offer the advantage of an unlimited supply of training data with ground truth labels. To make rendered images more realistic, we further enhance them using generative models. Second, existing large-scale image datasets, like MS COCO or LAION, provide millions of unlabeled images and they often contain no degradations. To utilize them, we propose a novel synthetic degradation simulation pipeline that utilizes the existing depth and motion generation networks.
