Our approach will be foundational for AI-assisted imaging, as it can generate millions of diverse, high-quality training images, with different degradations, and supports real-time image creation. This dataset can improve the robustness of many image enhancements, including denoising, low-light enhancement, and reflection removal. The real-time image production will advance the training of dynamic camera control features, including auto-exposure, white balance, and auto-framing. Overall, our training creation method enhances the robustness of current imaging pipelines under demanding conditions and expands the possibilities of vision-assisted applications in fields like medical imaging, autonomous driving, smart cities, and smartphone camera technologies. 相機系統是基於AI的計算機視覺系統的關鍵組成部分，其應用包括自動駕駛汽車、醫學成像、製造業質量控製、農業自動化、虛擬現實(VR)、增強現實(AR)以及零售業。在相機系統中，最初的傳感器數據會被相機內部處理單元進行處理，以提高圖像質量，然後再傳遞給下遊的AI模塊。正因如此，圖像處理質量極大地影響了整個計算機視覺系統的性能，尤其是在如低光照或惡劣天氣等極具挑戰性條件下。而得益於其學習圖像先驗的能力，之前的研究發現基於神經網絡的圖像處理能在這些條件下顯著提升圖像質量的潛力。 然而，基於AI的圖像處理性能與訓練數據集的大小和質量密切相關。與其他視覺任務不同，訓練圖像處理流程需要具有很難收集的帶有真實處理結果的圖像對，其數據收集所消耗的勞動力和時間成本是其他任務的數百倍。此外，像自動曝光這樣的主動捕捉系統需要在線生成訓練圖像，而大多數數據集是離線生成的。 為了解決這些限製，我們提出了一種全新的利用仿真環境以及生成式AI來大規模生成成像系統的數據集。為了生成大規模訓練圖像並支持在線生成，我們提出的方案利用由圖形引擎渲染的圖像、最新的強大圖像生成模型、以及基於互聯網圖像的大型圖像數據集。首先，由圖形引擎渲染的圖像提供了海量帶有真實標簽的訓練數據。然後，我們進一步使用生成模型對其進行增強，提高渲染圖像的真實性。最後，我們利用現有的大規模圖像數據集，如MS COCO或LAION，提供了數百萬張未標記的圖像，並結合新的提出的、利用現有的深度和運動的合成退化模擬流程，進一步提高圖片的真實性。 我們提出的這套數據生成方案，將能極大推動基於AI的圖像處理，因為它能生成數百萬張多樣化、高質量、具有不同退化的訓練圖像，並支持實時圖像生成。這個數據集可以提高許多圖像增強的魯棒性，包括去噪、低光增強和反射去除。同時，實時圖像生成將推動在線相機控製功能的訓練，包括自動曝光、白平衡和自動構圖。我們的訓練創建方法提高了當前成像流程在各種極端條件下的魯棒性，並在醫學成像、自動駕駛、智慧城市和智能手機相機技術等領域有廣泛應用。

24210524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24210524.value: 保護時間敏感型無線通信的物理層：一個基於信道狀態信息的正交指紋嵌入框架

24210524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24210524.value: 目標 本項目旨在通過開發一個新的基於信道狀態信息(CSI)的指紋嵌入框架,增強時間敏感無線通信及其任務關鍵型應用的物理層安全性。 項目背景 工業4.0依賴於人、機器、生產線和材料之間無縫的持續互聯。在這方面,時間敏感網絡(TSN)作為一種最先進的有線工業通信技術,已經標准化。與此同時,WiFi和5G技術的增強使無線TSN的可擴展性日益增強,提供了諸如提高靈活性、可擴展性、降低成本和支持移動性等優點。英特爾和高通等業界巨頭最近的展示已經證明了通過WiFi或5G網絡擴展TSN的潛力。但是,無線介質的開放性使無線TSN比其有線對應物更容易受到威脅。在傳統的人與人通信中認為是輕微問題的物理層攻擊,可能會嚴重破壞對工業應用至關重要的時間敏感的機器對機器通信,可能導致財務損失、設備損壞甚至人員傷亡。因此,採取有效的安全措施來保護無線TSN的物理層具有至關重要的意義。 項目簡要描述 本項目提出了三個互相關聯的目標,為實際增強無線TSN的物理層真實性和完整性鋪平道路。該方法涉及將人工指紋嵌入接收器估計的CSI中。目標1努力建立一個有效的基於CSI的指紋嵌入機制。該機制將在接收端引入與多路徑信道失真正交的指紋及相應的指紋提取算法。目標2集中於開發和優化一個物理層認證方案,應用目標1中的指紋。此目標還包括通過創建一個綜合數據集來對所提出的認證方案進行全面性能評估。目標3致力於利用可用的軟件定義無線電平臺進行空中實驗,以評估本項目中開發的算法的實際性能。通過完成這些目標,我們旨在為保護無線TSN的物理層提供一個可靠的策略。 長期意義 本項目的成果將通過抵禦各種物理層攻擊有效增強無線TSN的安全性。這將增強最終用戶對無線TSN的信任,併加速其在智能工廠和倉庫中的採用,從而提高靈活性、可擴展性、效率和生產力。

24210924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24210924.value: 基於成本啟發的個人化補救推薦

24210924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24210924.value: An algorithmic recourse, also known as a prefactual recommendation, provides actionable guidance to an individual to overturn an algorithmic prediction at a minimal cost of efforts. Existing methods impose an explicit assumption on the cost function, but in reality, different individuals may possess diverse and unique cost preferences. Failing to adapt the recourse to an individual's cost preference can lead to irrelevant and inefficient recommendations. This project aims to build a reliable personalization of the recourse recommendation to the user’s cost function. To personalize the guidance to the individual cost, we propose a preference elicitation framework that learns the cost function from the individual's feedback on a small number of comparisons. This project will study at least two possible learning frameworks to identify the user’s cost: a deterministic region-based model and a Bayesian Wishart model. This project also put forth a robustification mechanism to hedge against the potential noise in the human response and against the misspecification of the cost metric in downstream tasks. The results of this project can assert strong implications on how we personalize human-machine sytems, from sequential decision-making to causal graph elicitation and information retrieval systems. 算法補救，也稱為事前建議，為個人提供可行的指導，以最小的努力成本推翻算法的預測。現有方法對成本函數有明確的假設，但實際上，不同的個體可能具有各自獨特的成本偏好。如果未能根據個體的成本偏好調整補救建議，可能會導致不相關且效率低下的建議。 此專案旨在為用戶的成本函數建立可靠的個性化補救建議。為了實現個性化指導，我們提出了一個偏好誘導框架，該框架通過從個人對少量比較的反饋中學習成本函數來實現。該專案將研究至少兩種可能的學習框架來識別使用者的成本函數：基於區域的確定性模型和貝葉斯 Wishart 模型。此外，該專案還提出了一種穩健性機制，以應對人類回應中的潛在噪音及下游任務中對成本指標的錯誤指定。 該專案的成果對如何個性化人機系統（從順序決策到因果圖啟發和資訊檢索系統）具有重要影響。

24211124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24211124.value: 連續時間下數據驅動的均值方差資產配置

24211124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24211124.value: 投資組合管理是金融業和金融工程學術研究中的核心議題。其目的是使用定量方法來確定投資組合內資產的最佳分配。這種分配服務於減少市場相關風險和最大化財務回報的雙重目標。這種框架在機構投資者中頗受歡迎，並被新興的自動投資管理服務採用，以提供給零售投資者。 在定量投資組合管理中，關鍵基礎在於計算技術的進步。傳統上，投資組合決策是基於對未來資產回報的預測來優化的。然而，許多研究已經證明，準確建模和預測金融市場是一項極具挑戰性的任務。理論洞見和現實證據都表明，基於不準確預測優化的投資組合，由於對這些模型和預測中的錯誤敏感，往往表現不佳。當我們需要做出動態交易決策時，這一挑戰變得更加明顯。因此，如何有效構建投資組合仍然是一個複雜且未解決的問題。 本提案採用數據驅動和無模型的方法來研究小投資者如何在有限的投資期間內，在保持給定期望回報的同時，最小化投資組合的波動性。我們探索了强化學習技術在解決金融工程領域既定挑戰方面的潛力。通過整合强化學習技術，我們的目標是設計出一種適用於動態交易市場的高效且有效的資產配置策略，並以理論嚴謹性和經驗驗證為基礎。理論上，我們的研究基於連續時間框架，這與傳統金融工程實踐中常用的模型一致。我們旨在分析以提供對所提出算法的理論性能保證。這一結果對於連續時間强化學習的最新發展也是新穎的。在經驗上，我們計劃進行廣泛的數值實驗，以驗證所提出算法在合成和實際市場數據上的性能，並與其他替代方法進行比較。 總而言之，本研究符合金融工程中數據驅動、無模型方法的當代轉變，通過提供對投資組合優化的全面調查，在理論和實踐上對該領域做出貢獻。

24300324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24300324.value: 岩牆擴展引起的留尼汪島富爾奈斯火山岩漿上湧過程

24300324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24300324.value: Dikes feed volcanic eruptions, causing devastating hazards and global impacts. Monitoring magma ascent via dike propagation can significantly enhance hazard assessment and mitigation. However, there is no direct observation of dike propagation. Among available data, dike-induced earthquakes best trace subsurface dike movement. Therefore, monitoring and analyzing the seismicity are crucial. Yet, few volcanoes are sufficiently monitored to record such events, and even for well-monitored volcanoes, diking events may not occur. The Piton de la Fournaise (PdF) volcano on Réunion Island is among the best-monitored volcanoes. Two well-recorded dike propagation events in 1998 and 2015 offer an excellent chance to study dike dynamics. These two events have never been systematically compared, so we propose creating a high-resolution earthquake catalog to explore the seismicity patterns during these events. We will also calculate the fault plane solutions of these earthquakes to constrain stress evolution—an analysis not previously conducted. Seismicity patterns alone cannot decipher dike propagation mechanisms. Earthquakes may facilitate dike propagation by damaging the rock or slow down the dike by releasing the accumulated stresses. Although the importance of rock damage is well-known, it has been considered only in modeling hydrofracturing processes or horizontal magma intrusions. Even in those studies, the relationship between earthquakes and rock damage has never been tested. To bridge this gap, we propose a numerical model based on damage mechanics to quantify seismicity’s effects on dike initiation, propagation, and arrest. Leveraging the advanced dike models, high-resolution seismicity data, and other observations, we will further apply the data assimilation to test the predictability of dike propagation. Widely used in weather forecasting, data assimilation has only recently been introduced into volcanology by the Principal Investigator and colleagues. If our data-model fusion technique successfully “hindcasts” the two diking events at PdF, it could potentially serve as a valuable method for mitigating volcanic hazards in similar volcanoes. With high-quality seismicity data from dike ascents and dike propagation models considering rock damage, we will gain insights into the fundamental controls of magma intrusions. Furthermore, our model will reveal the general relationship between damage and seismicity during fluid injections. These will inspire other fields, such as hydrofracturing and seismicity hazards associated with geothermal energy exploration and deep carbon storage —areas crucial for environmental sustainability. 岩牆為火山噴發提供了途徑，造成了毀滅性的災害和全球影響。 監測通過岩牆擴展導致的岩漿上升過程可以增強對災害的評估，進而減災。 然而，對岩牆擴展現象的直接觀測極其稀少。 在現有數據中，岩牆引起的地震最能指示地下岩牆活動。 因此，監測和分析地震活動至關重要。 但只有少數火山有足夠密集的監測網路能記錄此類事件，即使是對監測較好的火山，岩牆擴展也非時常發生。 留尼旺島的富爾奈斯火山是全球監測最好的火山之一。 1998和2015年發生的兩次岩牆事件有著非常好的記錄，為研究岩牆動力學提供了絕佳的機會。 而這兩個事件從未被系統比較過，因此我們擬創建高精度地震目錄，探索這些事件期間的地震活動模式。 我們還將計算這些地震的震源機制，以約束其應力演化情況——這是以前從未進行過的分析。 單憑地震活動模式無法闡明岩牆擴展機制。 地震可能通過破壞岩石來促進岩牆擴展，或者通過釋放累積應力來減緩岩牆運動。 雖然岩石損傷的重要性已被公認，但它僅在類比水力壓裂過程時被考慮過。 即使在那些研究中，地震與岩石損傷之間的關係也從未被驗證過。 為了彌補這一空白，我們擬基於損傷力學開發數值模型，量化地震活動對岩牆啟動、擴展和停止的影響。 利用先進的岩牆模型、高分辨率地震數據和其他觀測數據，我們將進一步應用數據同化技術來測試岩牆傳播的可預測性。 數據同化技術廣泛應用於天氣預報，但直到最近才被筆者和同事引入火山學領域。 如果我們的數據模型融合技術能成功"預測"富爾奈斯火山的兩次岩牆事件，它就有可能成為緩解類似火山災害的寶貴方法。 憑藉高品質的岩牆上升地震數據和考慮了岩石損傷的岩牆擴展模型，我們將深入瞭解控制岩牆上升過程的主要因素。 此外，我們的模型將揭示在流體注入過程中，損傷與地震活動之間的一般關係。 這將為其他領域提供借鑒，如壓裂和與地熱能勘探、深層碳儲存相關的地震危險性評估——這些領域對環境可持續發展至關重要。

24300924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24300924.value: 華南大灣區大氣活性氮收支評估：基於多源觀測和大氣化學模式的綜合分析

24300924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24300924.value: 大氣活性氮（Nr）包括除氮氣（N2）之外的所有含氮物種。大氣中過量的Nr會惡化空氣質量，透過大氣沉降破壞生態系統，並加劇氣候變化。粵港澳大灣區作為典型城市群，正面臨以臭氧和顆粒硝酸鹽空氣污染及過量大氣氮沉降為特徵的大氣Nr污染挑戰。大灣區大氣Nr既來自本地源排放也來自區域污染物輸送；本地及區域源均在過去十年發生了顯著的變化，且會在未來進一步變化。為有效緩解大氣 Nr污染，需評估包括排放、化學、輸送和沉降過程在內的大氣Nr收支。然而，此類評估目前仍存在較大的不確定性。特別是，目前仍沒有研究探討大氣Nr氣-粒分配及多種有機和無機物種分配對大氣Nr收支的影響。然而此類評估至關重要，因為不同Nr物種的大氣駐留時間不同（從幾小時到幾個月），其在大氣中可傳輸的距離差異明顯，且其物種分配在不斷變化的環境下也在發生著不斷地變化。 評估大氣 Nr 收支的挑戰之一在於缺乏多物種多維度的集合觀測數據，以及利用數值模式對此類集合觀測數據的綜合分析。本項目從公開觀測網及合作者處收集了地面、探空和衛星觀測數據，擬利用大氣化學模式對觀測數據集進行全面分析，從而綜合評估大灣區大氣Nr收支。我們對大氣Nr收支的評估將涵蓋典型污染過程、不同季節及多年趨勢。特別是，我們將從一個新的視角研究不斷變化環境下 Nr 在不同物種間的分配變化對Nr收支的影響。此外，我們將開創性的利用每日兩次的紅外線大氣探測干涉儀衛星過氧乙醯硝酸酯（PAN）對模式模擬的區域光化學污染物進行觀測約束；PAN是光化學污染的示蹤物。該衛星數據集跨越了自2008年至今15年多的時間尺度，且PAN是氮氧化物的重要氧化產物，因此可為評估大氣Nr收支長期趨勢提供觀測約束。總的來說，我們預計繪製第一幅大灣區大氣Nr定量收支圖，旨在更好地了解大氣Nr化學並有效解決大氣 Nr污染危機。

24301524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24301524.value: 高解析度模擬：再電離時期的暗物質和氣體

24301524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24301524.value: 在大爆炸之後的數百萬年，宇宙充滿了冰冷的中性氣體。後來，星星和星系開始形成，它們能發射紫外線。這些紫外線電離並加熱了周圍的中性氣體。當宇宙大部分中性氣體被電離，宇宙產生相變。這個相變過程我們稱為宇宙「再電離」。再電離對星系產生重大影響，因為它能抑制新恆星形成，以及影響星系的演變。 再電離時代現在是天文學研究的重點。眾多天文望遠鏡正在探索這個時代，例如詹姆斯·韋伯太空望遠鏡正在發掘這時代的星系。 21公分望遠鏡正在探測再電離時代的中性氣體分佈，包括Hydrogen Epoch of Reionization Array (HERA) 和 未來的Square Kilometer Array (SKA)。 但是我們仍有很多關鍵問題需要解答。第一，什麼光源產生再電離的光子？第二，再電離時代的持續時間是多少？電離氣體如何分佈？第三，什麼吸收再電離的光子？第四，X射線和暗物質對再電離有何影響？ 雖然天文學家得到大量再電離的觀測數據，巨大的挑戰仍然存在。甲：目前的望遠鏡無法觀測到早期的微小星系（比銀河系小 100 倍），但這些星系可能是再電離主要推手。乙：小尺度宇宙結構可以吸收輻射，但這些結構無法被直接觀察。 這些小尺度結構可能會增加再電離所需的光子數量並改變電離氣體的分佈。但是，我們可以結合觀察數據和電腦模型來解決這些問題。 在這研究項目，我們將使用超級電腦以高解析度模擬宇宙的小尺度結構。這電腦模擬可以幫助我們解決問題（一至四）和挑戰（乙）。我們將利用 SWIFT 模擬程式碼去模擬宇宙的暗物質和氣體的演化。我們也會使用SPHM1RT 來模擬輻射如何在宇宙中傳遞。我們將會分析這些小尺度結構以及它們對再電離的影響。 我們將發展一個有效模型來描述這些小尺度結構對再電離的影響。我們利用這些模型將這些影響納入大規模模擬或數值模型中。這些大規模模擬可以跟觀測數據比較。此外，我們將考慮不同類型暗物質的影響，例如暗物質和 X 射線如何影響小尺度結構和其電離。

24303324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24303324.value: 利用新型螢光標記加帽RNA探針進行病毒聚合酶實時酵素分析

24303324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24303324.value: 病毒RNA依賴的RNA聚合酶(RdRPs)在病毒複製和轉錄過程中發揮關鍵作用。準確地確定RdRP在特定的催化階段中的動力學特性對理解病毒複製機制和設計有效的抗病毒策略至關重要。 第一目標是建立利用螢光極化(FP)技術直接定量滑動動物病毒和蚊傳病毒RdRP在mRNA合成中的動力學特性的實時檢測法。我們將合成一個具有螢光標記的RNA探針,模擬病毒轉錄中RdRP引發過程中的宿主mRNA「頭截取」過程。FP的高時域解析度能連續監測探針的結合和引入,提供有價值的RdRP結合、引發和延伸方面的信息。我們在這個方案中的預實驗結果顯示,我們新的方法可以區分流感病毒RdRP在存在和不存在核糖核苷二磷酸時的動態特性,這支持實時監測不同的催化階段。 在第二目標中,我們將利用這種新方法來確定病毒啓動子的識別過程和藥物篩選。我們將確定病毒啓動子上哪個核苷酸位置對延伸的發生至關重要,同時存在核苷酸模擬物和錯誤的天然NTP庫。此外,我們將評估抗病毒藥物對動力學參數如引發率和延伸率的影響,以加快藥物發現過程。我們的預實驗結果表明,新的方法可以精細定量流感病毒RdRP延伸過程中模板序列和長度的差異,以及抗病毒藥物對RdRP的抑制作用。我們的工作可以定量病毒轉錄高解析度動力學特徵。 第三目標研究將研究調節mRNA加帽機制的帽結合蛋白以及影響病毒或宿主聚合酶複合物與病毒RNAs相互作用的其他病毒或宿主蛋白的相互作用。現在可以用高通量和實時的方法闡明病毒聚合酬對抓取蛋白(如PB2和NS)和其他病毒或宿主蛋白的相互作用。我們的預實驗結果表明,我們的新檢測方法可以確定導入素蛋白如何與RdRP相互作用但不影響流感病毒聚合酶的延伸速率。研究不同的加帽方式和病毒聚合酶-RNA複合物與其他病毒/宿主因子之間的相互作用,可能為我們提供有價值的見解,識別新型的抗病毒干預靶點。 總之,現有螢光探針與極化檢測法具有增強的通用性、敏感性、簡單性以及實用性,能夠定量各個催化階段的動力學過程。這種新方法可以為理解病毒複製機制和發現新的抗病毒藥物提供重要信息。

24305724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24305724.value: 多智能體強化學習的統計基礎研究

24305724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24305724.value: This project plans to explore the statistical foundations of multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) in Markov games, with the goal of learning Nash equilibria (NE) or coarse correlated equilibria (CCE) sample-optimally. The emerging domain of multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) studies how a group of agents interact with one another autonomously in a shared dynamic environment. The recent advancements in areas like game playing, autonomous vehicles, and multi-robot control exemplify MARL's real-world applications. In the MARL setting, the interacting agents often have conflicting goals, and they might have to compete with each other in order to promote their own benefits (possibly at the expense of one another). In light of the conflicting needs of individual agents, solutions of MARL frequently take the form of certain equilibrium states, with the Nash equilibrium being a prominent example. In contemporary applications, it is increasingly more common to encounter environments with prohibitively large state and action spaces. The surge in model dimensionality amplifies the difficulty of achieving efficient RL in scenarios with limited samples, especially when gathering data is costly, lengthy, or carries significant risks. Consequently, understanding and improving the sample efficiency of RL algorithms --- sometimes coupled with additional resource and system-level constraints --- inevitably lie at the core of cutting-edge RL research and are the key enabler for future advances. Despite a myriad of recent research dedicated to its statistical theory, how to achieve minimal sample complexity and optimal statistical accuracy in MARL remains elusive even for the most basic settings. For instance, the information limits for learning equilibria in tabular Markov games remain uncharted for most of the sampling mechanisms (e.g., simulator, online data collection, offline RL). Achieving efficient and robust learning in MARL requires an integrated approach that blends ideas from multiple fundamental disciplines, including game theory, high-dimensional and robust statistics, online learning, distributed optimization, and information theory. Through integrated consideration, this proposal aims to pursue the statistical optimal learning algorithms in the context of multi-agent Markov games by investigating: (i) optimal MARL with a generative model; (ii) offline Markov games under single-policy coverage; and (iii) information theoretic limits of online MARL. 這個項目計劃探索多智能體強化學習（MARL）在馬可夫遊戲中的統計基礎，目標是以採樣最優的方式學習納什均衡（NE）或粗略相關均衡（CCE）。多智能體強化學習（MARL）研究一組智能體如何在共享動態環境中自主相互作用。近期在遊戲、自動駕駛車輛、多機器人控制等領域的進展，例證了MARL在實際應用中的重要性。在MARL設定中，互動的智能體往往擁有相互衝突的目標，他們可能需要相互競爭，以爭取自己的利益（可能受益於其他智能體的損失）。考慮到每個智能體的衝突需求，MARL的解決方案經常採取某種均衡狀態的形式，其中一個主要的例子是納什均衡。在當代應用中，越來越常見的是遇到具有非常大的狀態和動作空間的環境。模型維度的激增加大了在樣本有限的情景中實現高效RL的難度，尤其是當數據收集成本高、時間長或帶來重大風險時。因此，理解和改進RL演算法的樣本效率——有時候還需要額外的資源和系統級限制——無疑處於尖端RL研究的核心，且是未來進步的關鍵推動者。 儘管近來有眾多研究致力於其統計理論，然而即使在最基本情形中，如何在MARL中達成最小樣本複雜性和最優統計精度仍然是不清楚的。例如，對於大多數採樣機制（例如模擬器、在線數據收集、離線RL），在表格式馬可夫遊戲中學習均衡點的信息極限仍然未知。在MARL中實現高效且魯棒的學習需要融合來自多個基礎學科的想法，包括博弈論、高維和魯棒統計、在線學習、分佈式優化和信息論。基於此，本項目旨在多智能體馬可夫遊戲領域追求統計上最優的學習算法，主要研究方向為：（i）生成模型下的最優MARL；（ii）單一策略覆蓋下的離線馬可夫遊戲；和（iii）在線MARL的信息極限。

24502124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24502124.value: 促進員工「在最需要的時候」尋求知識

24502124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24502124.value: Seeking knowledge is a crucial proactive work behavior for employees to succeed at work but they are often reluctant to ask when they need it the most. The reluctance to ask precludes employees from learning job-relevant knowledge needed to succeed at work, which can lead to a vicious cycle of decreased performance and increased hesitation to ask, resulting in withdrawal and exclusion. Prior research has demonstrated that the decision to engage in explicit knowledge seeking (i.e., actively asking others to obtain new knowledge and learn new skills) is driven by the perceived benefits (e.g., the utility of learning new knowledge or skills) and costs (e.g., appearing incompetent and losing face) to ask. Accordingly, if the perceived costs exceed the benefits, employees are reluctant to seek knowledge. But what if employees’ decision to remain silent is misguided by inaccurate perceptions of the actual benefits and costs to ask? We hypothesize that employees (a) underestimate the benefits (e.g., other’s appreciation and willingness to share knowledge), and (b) overestimate the costs (e.g., of how harmful asking is for their standing and reputation in the eyes of others) when they experience uncertainty due to a role conflict or unfulfilled role expectations (i.e., “when they need it the most”) because they are in an aversive psychological state that is called the behavioral inhibition system. Extending existing research, we first develop and test a novel and parsimonious theoretical model to explain the problem of why certain types of employees (e.g., non-prototypical managers, middle managers, minority employees, employees with low self-efficacy) are more reluctant to seek knowledge even though they could and should. Second, we apply our new model to two specific research contexts: horizontal age diversity (among coworkers) and vertical age diversity (between managers and subordinates). Using different study designs (i.e., experiments and field studies) and samples, we investigate underlying mechanisms and test interventions to identify strategies that help managers as well as individuals themselves to increase their active participation at work through engagement in knowledge seeking. 尋求知識是員工在工作上成功的關鍵主動工作行為，但他們往往在最需要的時候不願意詢問。不願意提出要求會妨礙員工學習在工作中取得成功所需的與工作相關的知識，這可能會導致績效下降和詢問更加猶豫的惡性循環，從而導致脫離和被排斥。先前的研究表明，參與明確知識尋求（即積極要求他人獲取新知識和學習新技能）的決定是由感知效益（例如學習新知識或技能的效用）和成本（例如顯得無能、丟面子）驅動的。因此，如果感知到的成本超過效益，員工就不願意尋求知識。但是，如果員工對實際效益和成本不準確認知而導致員工保持沉默，該怎麼辦？我們假設員工當他們由於角色衝突或未達到角色期望時（即「當他們最需要的時候」）而感到不確定會（ a）低估效益（例如，他人的欣賞和分享知識的意願），（b）高估成本（例如，詢問對他們在其他人眼中的地位和聲譽的危害程度）。這是因為他們處於一種稱為行為抑制系統的厭惡心理狀態。擴展現有研究，我們首先開發並測試一種新穎且簡約的理論模型，以解釋為什麼某些類型的員工（例如非典型經理、中階管理人員、少數族裔員工、自我效能感低的員工）當他們可以亦應該的時候更不願意尋求工作知識。其次，我們將新模型應用於兩個特定的研究背景：橫向年齡多樣性（同事之間）和縱向年齡多樣性（經理和下屬之間）。我們使用不同的研究設計（即實驗和實地研究）和樣本，調查潛在機制並測試幹預措施，以確定幫助管理者以及個人透過參與知識尋求來提高工作積極參與度的策略。

24502224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24502224.value: 雙邊市場網絡中的最優成長

24502224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24502224.value: For platform marketplaces, it is commonly understood that the efficient expansion of user bases is crucial for achieving success in growth models. However, two-sided platform marketplaces like Airbnb and Upwork face unique challenges due to the heterogeneous nature of their service providers and user groups. These differences give rise to diverse growth patterns and compatibility within the marketplace. Therefore, platforms need to go beyond temporal variations, and also account for spatial imbalances in supply and demand when aiming to grow their user bases. This nuanced approach recognizes the importance of addressing both temporal dynamics and spatial disparities in order to foster sustainable growth in two-sided platform marketplaces. In the proposed project, we consider the dynamics of a two-sided market, where the agent population on both sides experiences growth over time with heterogeneous retention and new adoption rates. The compatibility between buyers and sellers is captured by a bipartite network. The platform strategically employs commission structures to optimize its overall profit across T periods, taking into account the temporal variations and the spatial imbalances in supply and demand. 我們考慮一個雙邊平台的動力學,其中雙方的代理人群體隨時間經歷異質性增長率的增長。買家和賣家之間的兼容性由二分圖網絡捕獲。平台設置佣金以在T個期間內優化其總利潤,考慮短期利潤和增長之間的權衡以及供給和需求的空間失衡。我們設計了一個漸近最優的策略,其利潤損失上限為一個與T無關的常數,這與被證明任意差的近視策略形成對比。為獲得此策略,我們首先開發了一個單期基準問題,捕捉了平台的最佳穩態,然後在每個期間精心提高相對人口比例最低的代理人類型的增長。我們進一步研究了增長潛力和網絡結構對平台最佳利潤、代理人的支付/收入以及最佳穩態下的最佳佣金的影響。為實現這一目標,我們引入了創新指標來量化每種代理人類型的長期增長潛力。使用這些指標,我們首先表明,在所有細分市場中,賣家和買家的長期增長潛力相對比例與整個市場相同的"平衡"網絡,可使平台實現最大盈利能力。對於每種代理人類型,其兼容對應方的長期增長潛力與自身的比率越高,支付越低/收入越高。最後,相對長期增長潛力對子市場最佳佣金的影響取決於代理人價值分佈函數的凸性/凹性。我們的研究洞察了增長潛力和網絡結構如何共同影響增長過程和最佳穩態中的佣金政策。

24502324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24502324.value: 連結社群：在不連通和不均勻標注網絡上的半監督節點分類

24502324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24502324.value: 準確的機器分類取決於足夠的訓練數據。然而在實踐中，數據標籤往往是昂貴的（標籤是眾包的主要內容）、有時間延遲（無法即時觀察到長期結果）、容易出錯（策略舉動會導致人爲操縱），或只是簡單的不可用－數據遺失：例如，為保護客戶隱私，Apple iOS 14.5 上的App Tracking Transparency 禁止廣告平台在未經用戶許可的情況下采集數據以進行歸因和定位。有限標籤問題在不同商業環境中普遍存在，包括收集客戶反應、追蹤效果及利用私人數據。 半監督（而不是完全監督）分類技術的發展有助于解決低標記率問題。圖神經網路（GNN）及其許多變體是近年來成功的半監督任務學習架構；它探索數據間的連接性，構造圖，並在學習中利用該信息。 GNN 采用多層訊息傳遞：在每一層上，每個節點從鄰居節點接收訊息、在本地處理訊息、並產生要在下一層中傳播的訊息。這種透過節點連接的捲積緩解了標籤的短缺並提高了分類準確性。 然而，現實世界中存在著一個常見的環境使樸素的 GNN 可能無法正常運作。除了有限標籤問題之外，許多情況下，數據網路為不連通的社群（例如，城鎮中的村莊、學校中的班級），且標籤僅來自其中的子集。在這些不連通且標記不均勻的圖上，半監督分類更加困難。 在本研究中，我們嘗試提高 GNN 在這個有限標籤問題上的表現。我們展示了 GNN 在標記率較小的全連接圖上的優越性，然後展示了當圖斷開連接和標記錯誤時其性能下降的情況。為了改善 GNN 分類，我們考慮兩種方法：（1）特徵選擇，優先考慮有效的節點特徵，（2）邊緣增強，用社區間邊緣補充圖。 我們採用三種想法來提出新連結：（1）利用節點特徵進行連結預測，（2）直接增大圖特徵值，（3）引導隨機邊緣重新佈線。我們將該技術應用於兩個常用數據集和我們收集的新數據集。我們研究不同方法在不同標籤分佈、圖拓撲和節點特徵條件下增強 GNN 的有效性。 這項研究將吸引管理科學的不同受眾。緩解有限標籤問題有助於進階數據分析和商業實踐。

24502524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24502524.value: 論「藍天法」的重要性——來自對沖基金撤銷註冊的證據

24502524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24502524.value: This study examines the effect of blue sky laws (i.e., state securities laws) on hedge funds. U.S. fund advisers with assets under management (AUM) greater than or equal to 100 million dollars are required to register with the SEC. If the AUM of a fund falls below 100 million dollars, it deregisters from the SEC and registers with state regulators. Using a sample of the SEC-deregistered funds, I examine if blue sky laws in domiciled states of those funds play a role in shaping their reporting practices. Specifically, I focus on two dimensions of the blue sky laws—legislation and enforcement—and identify their variations across states. I conjecture that there is a larger decline in the reporting quality for deregistered funds in states where legislation is lax and/or enforcement is weak, compared with funds located in states where legislation is strict and/or enforcement is strong. In addition, I examine if deregistered funds are more (or less) likely to survive when they are in states that maintain higher legislative standards and/or stronger enforcement requirements. To the best of my knowledge, this study is the first one that examines the economic consequences of blue sky laws. 本文旨在研究「藍天法」（也被稱作州級證券法）對於對沖基金的影響。在美國，從事顧問業務的基金公司若擁有一億美金及以上的資產管理規模，通常都需要向證監會進行登記註冊。如果一家基金公司的資產管理規模跌至一億美金以下，則其需要向證監會申請撤銷註冊並向所在州的證券監管機構進行登記註冊。本文以從證監會撤銷註冊的對沖基金為樣本， 研究了州級證券法對於基金公司披露行為的影響。具體而言，本文重點關注「藍天法」在不同州立法以及執行層面的區別，並做出以下主要假設。若州級證券相關的立法或執行較為薄弱，撤銷註冊基金公司的信息披露質量（相較於所在州立法或執行更為嚴格的撤銷註冊基金公司）會有更大幅度的下降。此外，本文還檢驗州級證券立法和執行的嚴格程度對於撤銷註冊的對沖基金在行業長期生存的影響。據作者所知，本文為「藍天法」經濟影響相關的首篇實證研究。

24503524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24503524.value: 勞動力市場兩極化與結構轉型：勞動者技能的影響

24503524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24503524.value: 主要經濟體的勞動力市場在近幾十年中經歷了顯著的變化，其中最為關鍵的兩個變化是勞動力市場的兩極化（中等技能職業就業減少，而高技能和低技能職業就業增加）以及結構轉型（製造業職業就業減少，而服務業職業就業增加）。研究人員認為這兩種現象之間存在一定聯繫，可能由相同的因素驅動，並且具有重要的政策含義。現有研究主要將勞動力市場的兩極化和結構轉型歸因於技術變革，例如自動化技術的產生和進步同時導致了對中等技能勞動力和製造業勞動力需求的減少。然而，很少有研究關注勞動供給方，即勞動者及其技能在勞動力市場變化中所起的作用。本研究旨在通過研究美國勞動力市場來了解勞動力市場兩極化和結構轉型之間的聯繫，研究過程中特別強調勞動者技能在跨行業和職業中所起的作用。研究方法將會兼顧實證和理論，以期更加深入地理解主要經濟體勞動力市場的變化，並提出相關政策建議。

24504924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24504924.value: 基於數量的貨幣政策工具如何影響中國的信貸供給

24504924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24504924.value: While the U.S. utilizes a price-based monetary policy, China predominantly uses quantity-based tools, which may result in an imbalance of funding within the banking system. A critical aspect of monetary policy transmission is the systematic redistribution of funds between banks. In this study, our goal is to explore this redistribution within the Chinese banking system and its subsequent effects on real economy lending. The perceived conservative lending practices of state banks could potentially obstruct full interbank lending substitution, thereby hindering the redistribution of funds to non-state banks. Our methodology involves tracking a shift in the roles of state banks in the interbank market, from lenders to borrowers, to analyze the impacts of this redistribution on the economy. Following such a shift, we forecast an increase in 1) the use of funds by state banks, 2) the lending growth and excess reserves of non-state banks compared to state banks, 3) lending growth in cities with a high reliance on non-state bank lending, and 4) the percentage of companies borrowing from non-state banks. 與西方國家基於價格的貨幣政策不同，中國主要依賴基於數量的工具，這些工具並未消除銀行系統內的資金失衡。因此，系統性的資金再分配對貨幣政策的傳導和資源分配至關重要。本文研究了再分配機制及其對信貸供應的影響。在貨幣政策干預後的資金再分配中，同業存單（NCD）市場起著主要作用，而傳統的批發資金市場則起著次要作用。國有銀行的保守傾向阻止了他們在同業存單市場的貸款，但並未阻止他們的借款。對於信貸供應的影響，我們發現，當國有銀行在同業存單市場上從貸款方轉為借款方後，非國有銀行相對於國有銀行的貸款增加，企業從非國有銀行借款的比例增加。我們檢驗了這些結果並非由其他機制驅動。

24506224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24506224.value: 無法到達的屋頂：高房價何時以及如何使非房主減少儲蓄並增加支出

24506224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24506224.value: 從香港、首爾到舊金山和溫哥華，世界各地的大城市都在努力應對驚人的高房價問題。例如，在香港，房價中位數已超過 100 萬美元。這樣的房價會如何影響無房者（即非房主）的消費者看法、動機和行為？ 我提出，諷刺的是，高房價可能會導致非房主的儲蓄減少和支出增加，例如在一系列產品中購買更優質或豪華的選擇。即使控制了收入和租金等變量，這種效應仍可能存在。那麼，哪些心理過程可以解釋這種效應呢？根據目標脫離理論，我認為，當面對非常高的房價時 （相比於沒有那麽高的房價），非房主可能會認為為購房儲蓄是徒勞無功的。這種徒勞感可能會導致非房主放棄他們的最高儲蓄目標，進而削弱其為未來存錢的整體動力，最終導致儲蓄減少和支出更加奢侈。 為了揭示高房價帶來的心理影響，我計劃研究這些影響可能發生的具體條件。例如，這些影響可能在無子女的非房主（即不打算生孩子的人）中出現，但在計劃組建家庭並生育子女的人（或已經有孩子的人）中可能會減弱。這是因為撫養孩子和養家通常需要長期儲蓄，從而保護了為未來儲蓄的動機。 這項研究旨在做出幾項關鍵貢獻。我計劃通過揭示高房價作為一個未被充分探索且日益相關的環境因素來促進消費者行爲研究， 這個因素可能會阻攔消費者進行儲蓄。預測結果對消費者福祉也有重大意義。先前的研究表明，負擔不起的住房與非房主的身心健康狀況不佳有關。我的研究旨在透過強調高房價的另一個隱患來提供新穎的見解：非房主財務健康狀況的潛在惡化。高房價導致非房主儲蓄減少、支出增加，長期來看可能會導致財務脆弱。

24506524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24506524.value: 公司不當行為和醜聞對貿易關係的影響

24506524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24506524.value: Firm misconduct and scandals hurt a firm’s reputation substantially. Karpoff et al. (2008) find that the penalties imposed by the market for SEC enforcement actions are much larger than those imposed on firms by the legal system. They estimate that, for every dollar of inflated market value, a firm loses $2.71 of value from reputational damage and $0.36 due to expected legal penalties. The source of reputational damage is still under-investigated. In this project, I will examine the effects of firm misconduct and scandals on trade relationships. Specifically, I plan to test whether public announcements of firm misconduct and scandals significantly affect the number of trade partners and the value of trade along the supply chain. I also plan to assess whether a firm’s retail customers opt to buy its competitors’ products following public announcements of scandals. On the one hand, reputational damage, after the public disclosure of misconduct and scandals, may affect a firm’s trade partners’ opinions of the firm. Trade partners may be concerned about the firm’s corporate culture and may be unsure about its long-term performance. Consequently, they may stop trading with the firm after a scandal or decrease their amount of trade. On the other hand, suppliers, unlike investors, may care more about whether a firm can pay cash on time than about scandals. Customers may care about the quality of a firm’s products than its misdeeds. If only a firm can fulfill the trade contract, its trade partners might continue trading with it. In summary, it is an empirical question whether and to what extent public announcements of misconduct and scandals would significantly affect the number of trade partners and total trade value. Although some papers have examined customer-supplier relationships (e.g., Bowen et al. [1995], Hui et al. [2012], Costello [2013]), to date, few studies have addressed the impact of earnings quality on trade relationships, due to limited data on these relationships and the value of trade between customers and suppliers. For example, SFAS 131 requires the disclosure of only customers that account for more than 10% of total revenue, and there are no required disclosures of suppliers. To my knowledge, there is no data recording the value and the quantity of transactions between firms in the domestic market. 公司不當行為和醜聞會嚴重損害公司的聲譽。 Karpoff et al（2008年）發現，市場對美國證券交易委員會（SEC）執法行動施加的懲罰遠大於法律體系對公司的懲罰。他們估計，每增加一美元的市場虛增價值，公司的聲譽損失就會導致價值下降2.71美元，預期的法律懲罰則會導致價值下降0.36美元。聲譽損害的來源尚未充分研究。在本計畫中，我將研究公司不當行為和醜聞對貿易關係的影響。具體來說，我計劃測試公司不當行為和醜聞的公開聲明是否顯著影響貿易夥伴的數量以及供應鏈上貿易的價值。我還計劃評估，在醜聞公開後，公司零售客戶是否會選擇購買競爭對手的產品。

24506624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24506624.value: 政府機構對財務報告的內部控制是否影響採購合同？

24506624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24506624.value: Government agencies expend a substantial amount of funds on procurement contracts every year. While corporate studies suggest that the effectiveness of internal control over financial reporting of a contracting party plays an important role in the contracting process, little empirical evidence exists regarding such a role in the government contracting process. We aim to shed light on this question by investigating how potential government contractors respond to a government agency’s internal control weakness. We first explore whether and how firms’ contracting incentives change when an agency discloses an internal control weakness. We hypothesize that firms are less willing to contract with an agency with an internal control weakness for two reasons. First, such an agency is likely to have poor internal information for contract planning and management, which increases the risk of contracting problems, such as unilateral contract termination, for contractors. Second, such an agency may have unreliable financial reporting, which increases the risk of politicians cutting the agency’s budgets and causing contracting problems. Our preliminary analyses find that the number of bidders for a contract decreases when an agency discloses an internal control weakness, suggesting that firms are less willing to contract with such an agency. We also find that such an agency is more likely to unilaterally terminate contracts, corroborating the risk of contracting problems. Next, conditional on a firm entering the contract, we plan to explore how contract terms are negotiated to alleviate the firm’s concerns over the agency’s internal control weakness. We predict that contracts signed with such an agency have a shorter duration, a higher likelihood of requiring the government to furnish equipment for contract execution, and a higher likelihood of requiring the government to provide contract financing. This study will be the first to explore the role of federal government agencies’ internal control systems in contracting. It will contribute to the literature on the role of financial reporting in contracting, as well as to the literature on government contracting. Our findings highlight contractors’ concerns over the government’s ineffective internal control. In this regard, our study has practical implications for how to improve government contracting. Moreover, we can contribute to the broad supply contracting literature by documenting suppliers’ concerns over customers’ ineffective internal control, as suggested by contracting incentives and contract terms. 政府機構每年在採購合同上花費大量資金。儘管企業研究表明，契約一方的財務報告的內部控制效力在契約過程中起着重要作用，但在政府採購過程中，關於這一角色的實證證據很少。我們旨在通過調查潛在的政府承包商如何應對政府機構的內部控制弱點來闡明這個問題。 我們首先探討當政府機構披露內部控制弱點時，公司的承包動機是否發生變化，以及如何變化。我們假設公司會出於兩個原因不願與內部控制薄弱的機構簽訂合同。首先，這樣的機構可能在合同計劃和管理方面缺乏內部信息，從而增加了承包商單方面終止合同等合同問題的風險。其次，這樣的機構可能存在不可靠的財務報告，從而增加了政治家削減機構預算並引發合同問題的風險。我們的初步分析發現，當機構披露內部控制弱點時，合同的投標人數減少，這表明公司不太願意與這樣的機構簽訂合同。我們還發現，這樣的機構更有可能單方面終止合同，從而證實了合同問題的風險。 接下來，在企業進入合同后，我們計劃探討如何進行合同條款的談判，以減輕企業對政府機構薄弱的內部控制的擔憂。我們預測與此類機構簽訂的合同持續時間會較短，更有可能要求政府提供合同執行所需的設備，並更有可能要求政府提供合同融資。 這項研究將首次探討聯邦政府機構內部控制系統在合同中的作用。它將為財務報告在契約中所起的角色以及政府合同的文獻做出貢獻。我們的研究結果突顯了承包商對政府無效內部控制的擔憂。在這方面，我們的研究對於如何改進政府合同具有實際意義。此外，我們可以通過記錄供應商對客戶無效內部控制的擔憂，為更廣泛的供應鏈契約文獻做出貢獻，正如簽合同的動機和合同條款談判的實證結果所將暗示的。

24507224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24507224.value: 審計師是否過度勞累？來自紐約市出租車出行的證據

24507224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24507224.value: 加班一直是審計業長期存在的現象。此外，審計專業人員普遍免收加班費，也沒有獲得足夠的與加班相關的年度獎金。在審計業面臨人才短缺的背景下，加班現象進一步升級。雖然文獻在理解審計師工作量狀況方面取得了很大進展，但大多數研究中用於得出推論的加班衡量標準要麼基於公司自我報告的審計時間，要麼基於受訪/調查從業者的看法等間接指標。本文提出了一種新的衡量標準，可以客觀、直接地捕捉審計師的加班情況，並實證檢驗其現狀及其對審計行業的影響。

24508224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24508224.value: 房地產開發商在房地產週期中的中介作用

24508224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24508224.value: Financial intermediaries, such as banks and mutual funds, play an important role in the financial markets. To discipline their behaviors due to concerns arising from information asymmetry and moral hazard, the capability of financial intermediaries to raise external funds is constrained by their own capital. Such constraints can, for example, limit the responsiveness of banks' credit supply to credit demand and lead to the effect of intermediaries' balance sheet on asset prices. In the real estate market, home developers also function as intermediaries between land suppliers and home buyers. As developers need to finance land acquisition and home construction before delivering homes to buyers, their financial constraint can affect how new home supply responds to home demand. Because the boom-and-bust cycles of the real estate sector should be limited under elastic home supply, the balance sheet of developers can have an important effect on the duration and magnitude of housing booms and busts by affecting home supply. In this project, we aim to provide the first analysis on the role of home developers' balance sheet in the housing boom and bust cycles. We use data from China, where detailed information of each land transaction has been made publicly available since 2007. We first estimate the average responses of local land supply to exogenous home demand shocks due to population inflow triggered by income shocks at the origin cities. Next, We show at the developer level, how developers' borrowing constraint affects their land purchases, and then at the city level, whether the responses of land supply to demand shocks depend on the borrowing constraint of local developers. We conjecture that following positive demand shocks, land supply increases less in cities where local developers are more financially constrained, which shall amplify the magnitude of the boom. Finally, we evaluate land supply relative to demand after the boom ends. Housing booms, even triggered by non-speculative demand, are usually accompanied by speculative demand that can cause over-supply of homes when the boom is over. Therefore, the financial constraint of developers can counteract the speculative demand and lead to either less over-supply or under-supply of homes. Overall, our project highlights the importance of the balance sheet of developers as intermediaries connecting home demand and land supply and its interaction with the housing boom and bust cycles. 房地產市場的繁榮與蕭條週期取決於住房需求到土地供應的傳遞. 基於中國房地產市場的數據分析發現, 這種傳遞依賴於開發商的資產負債表. 我們發現當出現外生的住房需求增長的衝擊時, 本地開發商的資產實力越強, 土地供應的增加就越多, 導致房價上漲較小、住房存貨增加越多. 而當這種房地產繁榮結束時, 更多的庫存給房價帶來更大的下行壓力, 進一步加劇市場的蕭條.

24601924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24601924.value: Analytic philosophy of religion has a rich tradition of applying innovative philosophical tools to age-old questions within the field. While modal logic and first-order logic have been extensively employed, the untapped potential of higher-order logic in the philosophy of religion remains largely unexplored. This project, titled "Higher-order Logic and Theism," seeks to bridge this gap and usher in a new era of inquiry into the nature of God and theism-related concepts. In recent years, higher-order metaphysics and logic have gained prominence in philosophical discourse. The use of higher-order variables and quantifiers allows for a more nuanced understanding of properties, modality, and universality. This project aims to leverage the expressive power of higher-order logic to address two central research questions: 1. Theism and Higher-order Realism about Properties: The project explores how higher-order realism concerning properties can shed light on traditional theological debates. It examines the contrast between first-order and higher-order conceptions of properties and delves into the implications for the doctrine of divine simplicity. By offering fresh perspectives on longstanding theological issues, this research contributes to the evolving field of philosophical theology. 2. Theism and Higher-order Modal Metaphysics: The project investigates how higher-order logic can reshape discussions on modal metaphysics in the context of theism. It engages with the debate between necessitism and contingentism, offering a novel perspective on the nature of necessity and possibility. In particular, it addresses Timothy Williamson's objection to contingentism and its implications for theistic accounts of divine freedom and individual essences. The research methodology employed in this project centers around higher-order logic, which provides the necessary tools for addressing these complex philosophical questions. The higher-order logical framework allows for higher-order quantification into predicate positions, sentence positions, and other complex expression positions. This capability is essential for formalizing and exploring intricate concepts such as properties and modality in the context of theism. By delving into the untapped potential of higher-order logic within the philosophy of religion, this project promises to deliver fresh insights and perspectives on fundamental theological issues. It enhances our comprehension of key concepts in the philosophy of religion, enriching the ongoing dialogue on the nature of God and divine attributes from a higher-order logical perspective. 分析宗教哲學家經常應用如邏輯、貝式機率等新工具來回答傳統上難解的問題。儘管模態邏輯和一階邏輯已被廣泛應用在宗教哲學的討論中，但高階邏輯在此領域的潛力仍未被充分探索。本計畫《高階邏輯與有神論》旨在填補這一空白，開創對於有神論相關概念、議題的新研究方向。 近年來，高階形上學/邏輯在哲學討論中越來越受到重視。使用高階變元和量詞可以更細緻地理解並分析性質、模態和普遍性等形上學議題。本計畫將利用高階邏輯的表達能力來解決以下兩個核心研究問題： (1)有神論與性質的高階實在論： 本研究探討性質的高階實在論如何能夠影響傳統宗教哲學討論。它檢視了一階與高階性質概念的對比，並深入研究其對神聖簡單性這個主張可能蘊含。此研究將由此對傳統神學問題提供新的觀點。 (2)有神論與高階模態形上學： 本研究聚焦於高階邏輯如何能夠重塑有神論背景下的模態形上學討論。它將涉及必然主義與偶然主義之間的辯論，提供對必然性和可能性本質的新視角。 本計畫採用的研究方法以高階邏輯為核心，這提供了解決這些複雜哲學問題所需的工具。高階邏輯框架允許對謂詞、句子和其他複雜語詞進行高階量化。這種更強的能力對於形式化和探索有神論背景下的性質和模態等複雜概念至關重要。 藉由深入發掘高階邏輯在宗教哲學中的潛力，本計畫有望在基本神學問題上提供新的見解和視角。它將增進我們對宗教哲學關鍵概念的理解，並從高階邏輯的角度豐富傳統神學以及哲學間對話。

24603524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24603524.value: 紙上生戲：晚明傳奇中文字、音樂與舞臺之跨媒介關係

24603524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24603524.value: 本計劃希冀發掘晚明時期戲曲文化的多媒介體驗。晚明的戲曲活動極為繁榮，「傳奇」這一長篇戲曲形式充斥著社會的各個角落，寺廟祠堂、秦樓教坊、園林書房無處不有傳奇的搬演、歌唱與寫作。然而，當代學者在研究晚明戲曲時，往往因為與舞臺、音樂相關之記載的匱乏而不得不將傳奇目為一文學形式進行討論。有鑒於此，本計劃通過關注晚明不同型態之傳奇出版物，將書籍研究、音樂研究、表演研究等領域的研究方法與文學研究方法融合，構建一跨媒介方法論，從傳奇相關的文本材料中重現傳奇的非文本面向，由此闡明晚明傳奇集文本、音樂、舞臺於一體的多媒介性，並強調這三種媒介之間的相互連通。本計劃的研究成果包括一篇英文期刊論文、一篇專著提案以及一系列中英文學術會議上的發表。

24605724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24605724.value: 邊界聆聽: 香港視界中的西方藝術音樂解殖

24605724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24605724.value: Western art music has long been seen through Eurocentric lenses with the assumption that European analytical models and ways of listening are universal. While music studies has recently embraced musical traditions from across the globe, the way that Western art music is understood, analyzed, and performed is still rarely opposed. The unchallenged knowledge basis for Western art music demonstrates the universalization of Western models of interpreting the world as part of the legacy of European colonialism. Invoking 'border thinking' from decolonial studies, which advocates the right to interpret the world independently from Western intellectual governance, I propose to write the first scholarly monograph to develop the concept and praxis of 'border listening.' 'Border listening' decolonizes the modes of musical knowledge production for Western art music from Hong Kong—an understudied locale in music studies—in light of the processes of challenging and subverting the dominant Western knowledges that have historically shaped the understanding of Western art music. The project engages with issues of translation, emotions, historiography, and music analysis to explore what paradoxes and ambivalence may arise from decolonizing Western art music from postcolonial Hong Kong, while also navigating the increasing intellectual influence of China on a global scale. In this exploration, nineteenth-century Austrian composer Gustav Mahler and his music serve as a lodestar for thematic consistency within the context of Western art tradition. The project aims to introduce an auditory world where Western knowledge no longer dominates the understanding of Western art music, and where the non-Western does not only produce culture for or reception of the genre, but also knowledge. Drawing on archival research, ethnography, music analysis, and textual analysis, the project questions the language used, displaces the embedded meaning of sensations in Western cultures (e.g., 'joy'), and employs Chinese theories and philosophies in the discourse of Western art music, while remaining critical of reproducing the logic of Western coloniality in the process. It seeks to open avenues for dialogue, reflection, and critical engagement with broader issues of knowledge production, cultural identity, and geopolitics with a wide range of academic disciplines in the humanities, and speaks to a broad audience who struggle to win acceptance for modes of thinking different from or marginalized by the established frameworks of Western art music. As a whole, this project will illuminate how Western art music might be radically reimagined from postcolonial Hong Kong's cosmopolitan perspectives. 長久以來,西方藝術音樂一直從歐洲中心主義的視角出發, 而此視角假設歐洲分析模型和聆聽方式具有普遍性。儘管近年音樂研究已經接納了來自全球各地的音樂傳統,但是卻很少質疑或挑戰對西方藝術音樂的理解、知識基礎、分析和演奏方式。 本項目將借鑒解殖研究中的"邊界思維",倡導獨立於以西方知識解釋世界的權利,提出"邊界聆聽"的概念與實踐, 從後殖民時期香港視角探討解殖西方藝術音樂的知識生產模式,挑戰和顛覆塑造西方藝術音樂理解的主導知識體系。本項目將涉及翻譯、情感、史學和音樂分析等問題,探討從後殖民香港解殖西方藝術音樂所可能產生的悖論和矛盾。十九世紀奧地利作曲家馬勒及其音樂將作為探索的主題。 本項目將以檔案研究、民族誌、音樂分析和文本分析, 在西方藝術音樂的話語中運用中國的理論和哲學,同時保持對再生產西方殖民性邏輯的批判。項目旨在為知識生產、文化認同和地緣政治等更廣泛的議題開闢對話、並與那些被主流西方藝術音樂知識體系所邊緣化的受眾對話。總的來說,本項目將揭示西方藝術音樂如何從後殖民香港的國際視野中被重塑。

24606324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24606324.value: 住房補貼對親密伴侶暴力的影響：來自家庭選擇研究的證據

24606324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24606324.value: Intimate partner violence (IPV) affects individuals worldwide. According to the World Health Organization (WHO) analysis across 161 locations, one-third of women reported experiencing some form of violence from their intimate partners. The repercussions of IPV extend to various aspects of women's lives, including physical and mental health, labor market outcomes, and overall economic security. While IPV affects all individuals, specific groups face a higher risk due to social and structural conditions in their living environments. This research project aims to investigate the influence of one crucial social and structural factor, housing, on the incidence of IPV. Existing literature has primarily focused on the effect of labor market shocks on the incidence of IPV (Aizer, 2010; Anderberg et al., 2016; Bhalotra et al., 2021). Yet there is limited evidence on how housing subsidies affect the incidence of IPV. This project contributes to existing work by investigating the effect of housing subsidies on the incidence of IPV. It furthers our understanding of how housing subsidies affect IPV by analyzing the various channels that drive these observed effects. First, housing subsidies could help IPV victims leave abusive relationships. With housing subsidies, IPV victims can afford to live independently and break free from their abusers, reducing IPV through the dissolution of abusive relationships. Second, housing subsidies could impact IPV by altering bargaining power. When housing subsidies are available, abusers are no longer paying for housing, resulting in a reduction of power inequalities within a relationship and a decrease in IPV. Third, housing subsidies can influence IPV by empowering victims to achieve economic security, i.e., increasing labor market attachment or facilitating participation in welfare programs, thereby reducing their economic reliance on abusers. Finally, housing subsidies may alleviate the mental stress experienced by victims and their partners, contributing to a reduction in the incidence of IPV. While most existing research on IPV relies on cross-sectional data, the panel structure of the data we will adopt in this project (Family Options Study, FOS) allows us to examine the dynamic channels mentioned above that are often overlooked in current literature. In addition, the FOS research design is a Randomized Control Trial, wherein housing subsidies are randomly assigned to the homeless population. This approach furnishes causal estimates of housing subsidies' effects on IPV, bolstering the robustness of our findings. Our project has important policy implications on how housing subsidies could reduce IPV incidence and contribute to improved gender equality. 親密伴侶暴力（IPV）影響著全球各地的人們。根據世界衛生組織（WHO）對161個地點的分析，三分之一的女性報告經歷過來自親密伴侶的某種形式的暴力。IPV的影響延伸到女性生活的各個方面，包括身心健康、勞動市場結果和整體經濟安全。雖然IPV影響所有個體，但由於其生活環境中的社會和結構條件，特定群體面臨更高的風險。本研究項目旨在探討一個重要的社會和結構因素——住房——對IPV發生率的影響。 現有文獻主要關注勞動市場衝擊對IPV發生率的影響（Aizer, 2010; Anderberg et al., 2016; Bhalotra et al., 2021）。然而，關於住房補貼如何影響IPV發生率的證據有限。本項目通過研究住房補貼對IPV發生率的影響，為現有研究作出貢獻。我們將通過分析推動這些觀察到的影響的各種渠道，來加深對住房補貼如何影響IPV的理解。首先，住房補貼可以幫助IPV受害者離開虐待關係。有了住房補貼，IPV受害者可以負擔獨立生活的費用，擺脫施虐者，通過解除虐待關係來減少IPV。其次，住房補貼可能影響IPV的談判權力的變化來影響IPV的發生。當有住房補貼時，施虐者不再需要支付住房費用，這會減少關係中的權力不平等，從而降低IPV。第三，住房補貼可以通過增強受害者的經濟安全感來影響IPV，即增加勞動市場參與或促進參與福利計劃，從而減少他們對施虐者的經濟依賴。最後，住房補貼可能緩解受害者及其伴侶所經歷的心理壓力，有助於減少IPV的發生。雖然現有大多數關於IPV的研究依賴橫斷面數據，但我們在本項目中採用的數據（家庭選擇研究，FOS）的面板結構使我們能夠檢查上述經常被忽視的動態渠道。此外，FOS的研究設計是一個隨機對照試驗，住房補貼隨機分配給無家可歸者。這種方法提供了住房補貼對IPV影響的因果估計，增強了我們研究結果的穩健性。我們的項目對於住房補貼如何減少IPV發生率並促進性別平等具有重要的政策啟示。

24607424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24607424.value: 動盪時期的母職－利用穩定同位素分析重塑中世紀和早期現代義大利的母乳哺育與斷奶實踐

24607424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24607424.value: The process of breastfeeding and weaning is a critical developmental stage for all human infants. The detail of such a process, however, is far from universal, but dependent on a host of environmental, biological, socio-cultural, economic, and personal factors. Thus, archaeologists have long realised the enormous potential of studying weaning practices to help us to understand this specific and crucial aspect of motherhood in past societies. For example, longer breastfeeding periods usually indicate larger birth spacing, which in turn suggest smaller overall family/population sizes. In addition, early weaning “frees” up the mothers so they may participate in other socio-economic roles. Therefore, when combined with other archaeological and historical evidence, breastfeeding/weaning practices can provide valuable insights into understanding the dynamic roles women played in the past. Despite its importance, this aspect of motherhood is relatively understudied in archaeology, as the process of breastfeeding and weaning typically leaves little trace in archaeological records. Fortunately, recent scientific development has provided new opportunities to detect breastfeeding/weaning activities in past populations. Stable isotope analysis is arguably one of the most reliable and well-established methods used in archaeology to help identify breastfeeding/weaning in individuals. The principle is that as breastfeeding individuals are essentially “feeding on” their mothers, they occupy a higher trophic level than most adults, therefore distinguishable in their isotopic compositions. Moreover, newer sampling (e.g., serial sampling), analytical (e.g., analysis of the isotopic compositions of single amino acids), as well as statistical approaches (e.g., Bayesian modelling) are currently being developed and improved to provide higher resolution of the breastfeeding/weaning processes in archaeological populations. Focusing on northern Italy, this project aims to examine the changes in breastfeeding/weaning practices through times of intense social instability, including invasions, the spread of “Black Death”, and urbanisation. Hence, the key question this project seeks to examine is how the notion and practice of motherhood has changed in response to larger societal changes. Ultimately, the project hopes to illuminate the intricate interplay between motherhood and the larger biological, socio-cultural, economic, political, and historical realities. This proposed project will involve at least five archaeological assemblages from northern Italy. In addition to original data produced from these assemblages, previously published data from related sites and neighbouring regions will also be included for meta-analysis. It is expected that this project will culminate in at least three peer-reviewed journal publications. 母乳餵哺和斷奶的過程是所有人類嬰兒發育必經的關鍵階段。然而，這一過程遠非普遍一致，而是取決於諸多環境、生物、社會文化、經濟和個人因素。考古學家亦早已意識到研究斷奶實踐對於理解過去社會中母職的重要性。例如，較長的母乳哺育期通常表示較大的妊娠間隔，這反過來又表明較小的家庭組織和社會規模。此外，斷奶亦意味著母親得以「解放」去參與其他社會經濟活動。因此，當與其他考古和歷史證據相結合時，母乳餵養/斷奶實踐可以為理解女性在過去所扮演的社會角色提供極有價值的證據和見解。然而，由於母乳餵哺和斷奶可留存的考古痕跡極少，相關考古學研究並不充分。幸運的是，近年的科學技術發展為檢測古代的母乳哺育/斷奶過程提供了新的可能性。穩定同位素分析可以說是考古學中用來識別母乳哺育/斷奶最可靠的方法之一。其原理是，由於母乳餵養的嬰兒本質上可理解為「以母為食」，因此它們在食物鏈上比大多數成年人佔據更高的營養級，從而在穩定同位素成分上有所區別。目前，考古學家正在開發和改進更完善的採樣技術（例如順序採樣）、分析手段（例如單一氨基酸的同位素組成分析）、以及統計方法（例如貝葉斯建模），以更有效地重塑古代的母乳餵養/斷奶過程。本項目將通過分析義大利北部在社會嚴重不穩定時期（包括戰亂、「黑死病」傳播、和城市化）母乳餵養/斷奶實踐的變化，研究探討育兒的觀念和實踐如何隨著更大的社會變遷而發生改變。本項目還希望進一步審視和揭示「母親」這一角色與更廣泛的自然環境、社會文化、經濟、政治、和歷史現實之間複雜的相互關係。本研究將涵蓋至少五個來自義大利北部的考古遺址。除了從這些遺址中收集的原始數據之外，還將納入來自相關地點和鄰近地區的已發表數據進行多元分析。預計該項目將最終發表至少三篇期刊論文。

24611824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24611824.value: 英文授課大學中的策略性聽課：跨學科視角下學生自主調控聆聽策略的縱貫性研究

24611824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24611824.value: 在全球高等教育領域，使用英文進行學科課程的授課现象(EMI)正日益普及。然而，對於英語非母語的學生而言，通過英文理解專業的學科知識會造成認知過載，繼而影響他們對學科知識的深入理解。尤其在剛剛過渡到英文授課的大學中時， 聽課過程更為困難，因為學生不僅需要適應新的授課語言亦須學習高等教育中更具挑戰性的學科知識。因此，學生亟需培養自主調控聆聽能力以便更加策略性地規劃、監控、及調整自己的聽課過程，提高理解程度。研究學生的聽課策略尤其需要採用跨學科視角，以此比較和理解不同學科的知識共建過程如何影響聆聽策略的使用。 本研究旨在理解學生在英文授課大學中的自主調控聽課策略，以及在大學過渡階段策略的縱貫性變化和跨學科間的異同。目前關於英文授課的研究大多採用橫向研究方法，缺乏縱向研究設計來理解策略的動態變化。對學生的策略研究也較為籠統，亟需更為情境化、與學科特徵緊密結合的細緻理解。本研究以社會認知視角下的自主調控學習理論為框架，通過結合學科項目特點理解學生使用的聆聽策略，並探究促發他們使用策略的動機。研究採用縱貫混合研究設計，在學生初入大學第一年的前、中、後期採集數據，以全面理解學生在大學過渡階段的動態變化。 在每個時間點，本研究將收集定量和定性資料以進行三角互證。定量方面，我們將通過分層式隨機抽樣的方式從不同學科院系招收約800名學生進行問卷調查，以了解學生在不同學科和不同時期的聆聽策略使用和動機方面是否存在統計上的顯著差異。定性方面，我們將對20名學生進行提示性回憶訪談以探索每個學科中的具體策略，和半結構化訪談以研究策略使用和動機的學科間異同及縱貫性變化背後的原因。在宏觀層面，這項研究將為培養學生在英文授課高等教育中的策略性、自主調控聆聽能力這一核心學術素養提供實證數據。研究結果將拓展我們對於學生不斷發展的、學科相關的策略使用的理解，並在此基礎上設計有實證數據支持的英文授課大學的語言培训項目，以幫助學生成功過渡、適應英文授課的大學課程。

24615524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24615524.value: 高技術跨國移民的不穩定特權：香港南亞裔女性外籍人士的民族誌

24615524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24615524.value: Highly skilled migrants, such as expatriates, are often called “privileged.” Unlike refugees and migrants driven by economic precarity or political conflict, expatriates are perceived to cross borders for experience, fun, and an even better quality of life. But how exactly different are they from other migrants within the structures of inequality? What does “privilege” mean in the context of transnational mobility? Although expatriates are well-paid today, their contracts and visas are not guaranteed to be renewed tomorrow. While most expatriates are welcomed by governments, they may be marginalized by the local population because of ethnicity, skin color, or religion. In other words, privilege itself can be precarious. Through the concept of precarious privilege, this project seeks to understand the conditionality of privilege by focusing on highly skilled women of South Asian backgrounds in Hong Kong. In Hong Kong, expatriate is a term that can refer to both individuals transferred by multinational corporations and self-initiated migrant entrepreneurs, academics, and artists. Academic literature, government policies, and public discourse in Hong Kong tend to represent expatriates as Western and white, whereas even highly skilled South Asians are commonly viewed as “ethnic minorities.” Although the term “ethnic minorities” officially includes all non-Chinese residents of Hong Kong (including whites, Japanese, Koreans), in practice it designates South Asians as racialized, working-class subjects. Moreover, expatriates are typically imagined as men, while expatriate women are described as dependents, “incorporated wives,” or “trailing spouses,” even though there is a growing number of highly skilled women with transnational careers. By focusing on women expatriates of South Asian backgrounds, this project contributes to migration theories by challenging dominant representations and destabilizing the links between expatriation, whiteness, and masculinity. Expanding the concept “precarious privilege,” I will explore how class privilege in mobility is inflected by the local structures of gendered and racial difference. Through mutisited ethnographic work, I will analyze the precarity of privilege and its implications for visibly othered women expatriates in terms of work, leisure, social networks, romance, and future migration. The outcomes of this project will be both academic and public: peer-reviewed journal articles, conference papers, a newspaper opinion piece, and a public talk. It will also result in mentorship workshops, an exhibition, and a website to display the participants’ migration stories and highlight the diversity of highly skilled talent in Hong Kong. 高技術移民，例如外籍人士（expatriate），通常被稱為「有特權的」。與受經濟不穩定或政治衝突驅使的難民和移民不同，人們認為外籍人士跨越國界，是為了體驗、樂趣，甚至更好的生活品質。然而，在不平等的結構之中，他們與其他移民到底有何不同？在跨國流動的背景下，「特權」意味著什麼？今天，外籍人士的薪水很高；明天，他們的合約和簽證卻不能保證獲得續簽。雖然大多數外籍人士受到政府的歡迎，但他們可能因種族、膚色或宗教而被當地居民邊緣化。換句話說，特權本身可能是不穩定的。透過不穩定特權的概念，該研究旨在關注香港南亞背景的高技術女性來了解特權的條件性。在香港，外籍人士一詞既可以指跨國公司調派的個人，也可以指自發性移民的企業家、學者和藝術家。香港的學術文獻、政府政策和公共話語往往將外籍人士描述為西方人和白人，而即使是高技術的南亞人也通常被視為「少數族裔」。儘管「少數族裔」一詞在官方上包括所有香港非華裔居民（包括白人、日本人、韓國人），但實際上它將南亞人指定為種族化的、勞工階層的主體。此外，外籍人士通常被想像為男性，而外籍女性則被描述為家屬、「協作妻子」或「隨行配偶」，即使現時有越來越多的高技術女性從事跨國職業。該研究關注南亞背景的女性外籍人士，透過挑戰主流的呈現，並鬆動外籍人士、白人和男性氣質之間的聯繫，為移民理論做出貢獻。擴展「不穩定特權」的概念，我將探討流動性中的階級特權如何受到當地性別和種族差異結構的影響。透過多點民族誌工作，我將分析特權的不穩定性及其對作為視觉他者的外籍女性在工作、休閒、社交網絡、浪漫關係和未來移民等方面的影響。該計畫的成果將是學術的和公共的：同行評審的期刊文章、會議論文、報紙評論文章和公開演講。該研究還計劃舉辦導師工作坊、展覽和網站，展示參與者的移民故事，強調香港高技術人才的多樣性。

24616924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24616924.value: 中美僱主對勞動者技能專業性和學位聲譽的感知如何影響水平教育分層

24616924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24616924.value: 中美兩國的高等教育系統與勞動力市場之間的聯繫較為鬆散，導致了大學教育與僱主專業需求之間的不匹配。這種不匹配性可能是造成高失業率的原因之一，廣泛影響著就業情況嚴峻的青年群體。先前的研究認為，大學畢業生缺乏適當的技能，不願意從事藍領工作。然而，很少有研究探討僱主如何看待受過大學教育的求職者的技能，尤其是那些畢業於職業對口程度較低的大學專業的求職者。在這些大學專業中，畢業生並沒有接受特定職業的培訓，這使得僱主更難確定他們的適應性。 上述求職者的劣勢，其成因可能源於兩種不同的機制：第一，畢業於職業對口程度較低的大學專業的求職者確實缺乏適當的技能；或者，僱主對這些員工擁有的技能不夠瞭解，即使他們實際上具備了適當的技能。除非我們可以從實證角度描述和測量僱主對每個學科培養的技能的瞭解程度，否則這兩種機制究竟何種在起作用的問題無法解開。 我使用了兩項研究來回答上述問題。在這兩項研究中，我使用招聘廣告作為僱主直接向潛在員工傳達技能需求的實證數據。第一項研究分析了美國的招聘廣告，描述僱主感知的學科 - 技能映射，並創建了一組學科 - 技能變量，描述了每個學科中不同技能的共現頻率。這些變量代表了僱主對每個領域技能組成和技能水平的感知。將這些學科 - 技能變量與美國普查數據中，受過大學教育的勞動者的調查數據合併，則可以研究僱主感知的該領域技能集如何在收入不平等方面起到中介作用。在第二項研究中，我將對中國的招聘廣告和調查執行相同的分析，尋找僱主感知的技能集在學科與收入不平等的關係中所起到的中介作用。 本研究的結果將為社會學經典的一組相對立的理論假設，即“教育作為技能獲得機制”和“教育作為身份地位信號”，提供新的驗證。如果僱主將求職者的學科視為生產力或技能的體現，控制了僱主所感知的技能集後，收入模型可能會出現實質性的中介效應。相反，如果僱主將學科視為不能代表實際技能的一紙文憑，中介效應將較小。中美之間的比較可以為年輕員工從學校到職場的過渡提供信息，並減少失業和收入不平等。

24618124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24618124.value: 眼睛隨著節拍點擊：通過行為和神經鏡頭探索音樂聆聽中的跨模態主動感知

24618124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24618124.value: 傳統上被視為被動接收的感知，越來越被視為'主動感知'，在這種感知中，感官系統主動與其環境互動，以實現有效的感官取樣。一個關鍵領域是跨模式主動感知，其中一種感官模式，如視覺線索，引導另一種的主動感知取樣，例如觀看唇動來幫助取樣關鍵的語音信息。這種最近的範式轉變具有理論和實踐的重要性。從理論上講，它改變了對感官系統的基本理解。從實踐上講，它為精神障礙的潛在診斷途徑提供了可能，這些障礙經常以非典型的主動感知行為為特徵。然而，主動感知的行為標記和神經基礎仍然在很大程度上未被探索。 我們的提議以音樂聆聽期間的眼睛閃爍為主，這是一種跨模式的主動感知。眼睛的活動與如警覺和注意等複雜的認知過程相關，為神經調查和潛在的診斷工具提供了標記。我們的初步測試揭示了一種有趣的現象：不自主的，自發的眼睛閃爍與音樂節拍同步，被稱為'眨眼節拍'。這暗示音樂節奏可能影響周邊視覺系統，可能引導視覺感官取樣。基於這些發現，我們的研究旨在：1）研究由眼睛敲擊影響的視覺感官取樣的動態，並建立一種新的跨模式主動感知的行為範式，以及2）揭示潛在的神經機制，以闡明感知系統的一般原則。 所提議的研究包括一項行為研究和一項神經影像學調查。初步實驗將行為上研究眼睛敲擊如何基於音樂節奏引導節奏視覺感官取樣。為了實現這一點，我們將一個既定的聽覺框架—動態關注理論—適應到由音樂節奏引導的跨模式語境。同時，利用我的神經影像學專長，我們進行一項腦磁圖研究，以深入研究支撐眨眼節拍的大腦皮層-腦皮下結構交互機制。這種多方面的研究策略豐富了我們對音樂體驗期間的多感官參與的理解，並為跨模式主動感知提供了機制性的見解。 這項提議的影響是多方面的。從經驗上講，我們希望建立一種新的行為範式 - 音樂節拍的眨眼節拍。從理論上講，我們尋求增強對主動感知和多感官交互背後的神經框架的理解。值得注意的是，周邊眼睛的運動經常揭示出精神疾病患者的認知缺陷。自發的眨眼節拍的缺陷可能表明感官挑戰，提示診斷措施，特別是對嬰兒或無反應的病人。總的來說，這項提議旨在推進科學理解，並為香港公眾的福祉提供有益的工具和見解。

24618724.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24618724.value: 永不放棄！發掘第二/外語學習中的韌性心理資源：中美第二語言學習者的跨文化調查探索

24618724.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24618724.value: In recent years, there's been a growing interest in integrating positive psychology in second/foreign language (L2) learning (Chen and Padilla 2019; Dewaele et al. 2019; MacIntyre et al. 2016; Oxford and Cuéllar 2014). Resilience, a key facet of positive psychology, denotes an individual's capacity to adapt to life challenges and rebound from adversities (Dent & Cameron 2003). Learning a new language is daunting, especially with unfamiliar grammar, pronunciation, and vocabulary. Studies highlight resilience's vital role in L2 learning, aiding learners in overcoming difficulties and reducing stress, ultimately enhancing the learning experience (Hiver & Solarte, 2021; Kim & Kim, 2017). Resilience is now more crucial than ever, not only in L2 learning but also for overall well-being, especially in times of rapid change, like the COVID-19 pandemic, demanding swift coping strategies (Ungar et al., 2008). Despite interest in resilience, the L2 literature lacks an exploration of resilience's conceptualization, contributors, and outcomes across countries. Framed by positive psychology, this project delves into resilience in L2 learning in Chinese and American contexts across three dimensions: positive traits, experiences, and institutions. It employs a mixed-methods approach in 3 phases. First, development and validation of a Resilience in Second Language Learning Scale (RSLLS) involving adolescent Chinese L2 learners (N=600). Next, a cross-cultural validation study of the RSLLS with adolescent American L2 learners through a new round of surveys (N=200). The final phase involves a quantitative study of the use of RSLLS with L2 learners (N=200) and qualitative interviews with learners and teachers from both groups (N=20). The goal is to develop a resilience scale with cross-cultural validity, to examine the levels of resilience in L2 learning, its contributors, and related outcomes in both Chinese and American L2 learners. This will provide vital insights for L2 researchers and teachers, guiding professional development and classroom practices. This research promises substantial contributions. Empirically, it offers an operational definition and measurement of resilience in L2 learning, paving the way for future research. The study promises to broaden our understanding of positive factors in L2 learners. Theoretically, previous research primarily centers on one of the three pillars of positive psychology theory (i.e., positive experiences), this project encompasses all 3 pillars, including personal traits and supportive environments. It offers fresh perspectives on successful language acquisition, enriching theories in L2 learning and psychology with a tailored resilience model. Educationally, the study promotes L2 learning and equity by developing psychological resources. 近年來，人們對將正向心理學融入第二/外語（L2）學習越來越感興趣（Chen & Padilla 2019；Dewaele et al. 2019；MacIntyre et al. 2016；Oxford & Cuéllar 2014）。韌性（又稱回彈力、回復力、心理彈性等）是正向心理學的關鍵元素，是指個人適應生活挑戰和從逆境中恢復的能力（Dent & Cameron 2003）。學習新語言是令人畏懼的，尤其是面對不熟悉的文法、發音和詞彙。過去的研究強調了韌性在第二語言學習中的重要作用，例如幫助學習者克服困難和減輕壓力，最終提升學習體驗（Hiver & Solarte，2021；Kim & Kim，2017）。 如今，韌性比以往任何時候都更加重要，不僅對於第二語言學習，而且對於整體福祉也如此，尤其是在快速變化的時期，例如COVID-19 大流行，需要迅速的應對策略（Ungar 等， 2008）。儘管人們對韌性很感興趣，但二語文獻缺乏對跨國韌性的概念、相關原因和結果的總體探索。 本研究以正向心理學為框架，從正向特質、經驗和組織三個維度深入研究中美背景下第二語言學習的韌性。它採用混合方法分三個階段進行。首先，針對以中文為第二語言的青少年學習者（N=600）為對象，開發並驗證第二語言學習彈性量表（RSLLS）。接下來，透過新一輪調查 (N=200) 對美國青少年二語學習者進行 RSLLS 的跨文化驗證研究。最後階段涉及對二語學習者 (N=200) 使用 RSLLS 的定量研究以及對兩組學習者和教師 (N=20) 的定性訪談。目標是開發一個具有跨文化、有效的韌性量表，以檢驗中國和美國第二語言學習者的二語學習韌性程度、其相關原因以及結果。這將為第二語言研究人員和教師提供重要的見解，指導專業發展和課堂實踐。 這項研究有望做出相當的貢獻。從經驗上看，它能提供第二語言學習韌性的操作定義和測量，為未來的研究鋪平道路。這項研究有望拓寬我們對第二語言學習者正向因素的理解。從理論上講，先前的研究主要集中在正向心理學理論的三大支柱之一（即正向體驗），本計畫涵蓋所有三個支柱，包括個人特質和支持性環境。它提供了成功語言習得的全新視角，透過創立的韌性模型豐富第二語言學習和心理學的理論。在教育方面，該研究透過開發心理資源來促進第二語言學習和公平。

24619224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24619224.value: 走向國際化的內在殖民主義量表

24619224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24619224.value: This proposal outlines a comprehensive study aimed at exploring the enduring impacts of colonialism on formerly colonized societies, focusing specifically on the Chinese and Indian populations in Hong Kong, Malaysia, and Singapore. The primary aim is to develop and validate a novel empirical instrument, the International Scale of Internalized Colonialism (ISIC), expanding on the integrative model of colonial mentality by David and Okazaki (2006). This project aims to advance our understanding of the manifestations of internalized colonialism, a concept that has been under-studied yet holds significant implications for individual and collective identities, mental health, and culture. To ensure robustness, the ISIC's concurrent, discriminant, and incremental validity will be rigorously tested against established measures such as the Internalized Racism in Asian Americans Scale, the People of Color Racial Identity Attitudes Scale, and the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale, among others. The research will also explore the ISIC's ability to predict key outcomes such as depression and self-esteem. This could potentially uncover new avenues for mental health interventions in the context of post-colonial societies. Given the complexity of the construct, a large sample size of at least 720 participants per society will be recruited, providing sufficient statistical power and ensuring the generalizability of the findings. Furthermore, the study will investigate differences in the prevalence of colonial mentality across the three countries as a function of economic attainment, controlling for ethnicity. In addition to self-report scales, a photo selection task will be included to unobtrusively assess implicit biases related to ethnicity, thus enhancing the study's ecological validity. This task will require participants to select potential job applicants from a series of photos, providing additional insights into the real-life implications of internalized colonialism. This multi-method approach aims to yield reliable and nuanced insights into the nature and impacts of internalized colonialism. By filling a critical gap in the literature, this research carries the potential to shed light on the deeper psychological and societal repercussions of colonial history. The findings could inform policies and interventions aimed at promoting mental health and social justice, thus producing far-reaching benefits for individuals and communities grappling with the legacies of colonialism. 這項提案概述了一項全面的研究，旨在探討殖民主義對曾被殖民社會的持續影響，特別是香港、馬來西亞和新加坡的華人和印度人口。主要目標是開發和驗證一種新的實證工具，即國際內在殖民主義量表（ISIC），擴展了David和Okazaki（2006）的殖民心態整合模型。這項研究旨在提升我們對內在殖民主義表現的理解，這是一個尚未充分研究但對個人和集體身份、心理健康和文化具有重要意義的概念。為了確保穩健性，ISIC的同時、區別和增量效度將嚴格測試，與已有的衡量標準如亞裔美國人內在種族主義量表、有色人種種族身份態度量表和羅森伯格自尊量表等進行比較。 研究還將探討ISIC預測關鍵結果如抑鬱和自尊的能力。這可能揭示在後殖民社會背景下心理健康干預的新途徑。考慮到構念的複雜性，每個社會將招募至少720名參與者，以提供足夠的統計力量並確保研究結果的普遍性。此外，研究將調查三個國家之間殖民心態的差異，作為經濟成就的函數，並控制種族因素。 除了自我報告量表，還將包括一個照片選擇任務，以不引人注目地評估與種族相關的隱性偏見，從而增強研究的生態效度。這項任務要求參與者從一系列照片中選擇潛在的求職者，提供對內在殖民主義現實影響的進一步洞見。這種多方法的研究方法旨在產生可靠且細緻的見解，揭示內在殖民主義的本質和影響。 通過填補文獻中的重要空白，這項研究有潛力揭示殖民歷史的深層心理和社會後果。研究結果可以為促進心理健康和社會正義的政策和干預提供指導，從而為應對殖民遺產的個人和社區帶來深遠的益處。

24622224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24622224.value: 高強度間歇訓練對香港智障青少年身體健康、認知和心理健康的影響: 隨機對照試驗

24622224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24622224.value: 智障青少年的身體健康水平普遍低於一般發展中的同儕，並且容易遭受身體不活躍所帶來的多種負面後果。高強度間歇訓練(HIIT)被認為是比傳統運動方案更優勝、更具時間效率的訓練方法，可改善兒童和青少年的健康和健身狀況。然而，過去很少有以學校為基礎的HIIT干預措施被設計和評估，因此關於HIIT與傳統持續性運動方法(通常用於學校體育課)在智障青少年群體中的療效尚不清楚。本研究擬成為首個隨機對照試驗，比較HIIT干預與傳統持續性運動方案對智障青少年身體健康、認知和心理健康的影響。本研究亦會同時評估HIIT干預中間的實施過程。根據統計功效分析，120名智障青少年將被隨機分配到為期4個月的HIIT干預組或傳統持續性運動對照組，然後由受過培訓的體育老師每週進行3次指導性運動課，而HIIT方案將會按智障學童的需要進行適當調整。身體健康、認知和心理健康的評估將分別在基線、干預後立即、干預後4個月這三個時間點進行。干預完成後參與者亦將進行質性評估，以瞭解參與學生和老師對HIIT運動的觀點和經歷。研究分析將採用混合效應模型，比較兩組在干預後的變化，並會控制基線健康水平、性別和社經地位等潛在影響因素。本研究的結果將惠及體育教育工作者、教育心理學家和醫療政策制定者，為提高智障青少年的身體健康和健康水平提供有效策略,並幫助在學校環境中針對智障群體實施健康促進實踐。這研究與聯合國可持續發展目標(SDGs)中的良好健康與福祉(SDG 3)、優質教育(SDG 4)和減少不平等(SDG 10)等目標高度相關。總括而言，本研究旨在為智障人士提供更好的生活質量，賦予他們與一般發展中同儕一樣充實的生活。

25124024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25124024.value: 瑜伽和經顱直流電結合治療對慢性思覺失調患者認知功能的作用：一項隨機對照臨床試驗

25124024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25124024.value: Cognitive deficits are common in individuals with psychosis, affecting almost all individuals at different stages of the illness. The substantial impacts on social functioning and quality of life underscore the need to find ways to improve cognitive functioning in this population. Yoga is a popular mind-body intervention that can be effective in improving neurocognitive function. However, the promising benefits of yoga on chronic psychosis may be limited due to the progressive cognitive impairments in these individuals. Transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) is emerging as a promising therapy for improving cognitive function by modulating the excitability of cortical regions. This will be the first study to evaluate the impact and neurophysiological mechanisms of a combined intervention of yoga and anodal (facilitatory) tDCS on improving cognitive function in individuals with chronic psychosis. Based on both theory and our preliminary findings, we hypothesize that individuals with chronic psychosis in the active tDCS + yoga or sham tDCS + yoga intervention groups will show improved cognitive function (primary outcome measured by Verbal Fluency Test) compared with the waitlist control group; while individuals in the active tDCS + yoga group will show greater improvements than those in the sham tDCS + yoga group. We also hypothesize that the beneficial effects of the combined intervention on cognitive function is mediated through treatment-induced changes in prefrontal neural activity and connectivity as measured by functional Near-infrared Spectroscopy (fNIRS). To test these hypotheses, we will recruit 135 individuals with chronic psychosis from clinical sites and community-based psychiatric rehabilitation centers. The study will be a three-arm double-blind randomized sham and waitlist-controlled trial design (N = 45 per arm). The study will compare the effects of a 6-week active tDCS + yoga intervention, a 6-week sham tDCS + yoga intervention, and a 6-week waitlist control on cognitive function, and then examine the mediating effects on prefrontal neural activity and connectivity. Assessments will be conducted at baseline (T0), after 6 weeks of treatment (T1), and at the 3-months follow-up (T2). If the hypotheses are supported, the study findings will provide novel evidence and empirical support for tDCS combined with yoga as an alternative treatment for improving cognitive function and rehabilitation in chronic psychosis. Moreover, by identifying the neurophysiological mechanisms underlying the beneficial effects, the findings will highlight process variables that could be specifically targeted to make the combined intervention even more effective in this patient population.

25124924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25124924.value: 高清經顱直流電刺激對工作記憶衰退的效果及其時間進程

25124924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25124924.value: Introduction: As we age, we often struggle to remember an 8-digit mobile number given to us by a new friend while we try to input it into our mobile phone’s address book. This is an example of working memory, which can be affected by ageing. Is there a way to enhance or at least maintain working memory capabilities? One of the methods gaining popularity is high-definition transcranial direct current stimulation (HD-tDCS). HD-tDCS is a safe technique that uses electrical current and scalp electrodes to stimulate the brain. This neuro-stimulation method renders the brain more responsive to external stimuli. However, questions remain about the timing of its peak effect and whether older adults respond to the technique as positively as young adults do. Methods: In this proposed project, we will invite 30 young adults, 30 middle-aged and 30 older adults who will participate in six sessions of HD-tDCS (2 mA, 10 minutes) applied over the left frontal scalp area, with a 1-week interval between sessions. In the first three sessions, participants will receive either positively charged, negatively charged or sham stimulation. Before and after the electrical stimulation, we will assess brain reactivity at the stimulated site using magnetic stimulation to trigger the brain and measure brainwaves. This process will be repeated multiple times in intervals of 5–15 minutes. During the next three sessions, participants will receive one of the electrical stimulation conditions (anodal, cathodal or sham stimulation). Brainwave recordings will be taken before and after the stimulation when the participants are at rest and during the 30 minutes following the stimulation when the participants will engage in a memory task. The brainwaves recorded during the first three sessions will be analysed to determine the timing of peak brain responsiveness after electrical stimulation. The task performance and brainwave recordings from sessions 4–6 will be analysed to assess whether middle-aged and older adults respond as positively as young adults and to understand the mechanisms underlying responsiveness after brain stimulation. 随着年龄的增长, 如果一個新朋友給我們一個八位數的電話號碼，要我們一邊記住號碼，一邊輸入我們的手機電話簿，還真是有點困難。這是工作記憶隨著年齡衰退的一個例子。那麽，有沒有辦法提高或者至少維持我們工作記憶的能力呢？近年來獲得普及的一種方法是高清經顱直流電刺激（HD-tDCS），是一種使用電流透過頭皮刺激大腦的非侵入、安全的技術。透過電流刺激神經，是大腦對於外在的活動或環境刺激有更好的反應。然而，人們還沒對與HD-tDCS的效果全然瞭解，例如其效果的高峰時段、其效果對於老年人和年輕人是否相同等。這個研究項目將分別邀請年輕人，中年人士和年長者各30位進行研究。參與者將接受6次HD-tDCS （2安倍，10分鐘），每次間隔一周。電流刺激的腦區是左前額。在首三次的實驗中，我們將在電流刺激前後使用磁刺激來評估大腦反應并且收錄腦電波，以此探研電流刺激效果的高峰時段。後三次的實驗中，參與者將在接受電流刺激前後進行一個電腦操作的工作記憶活動並收錄腦電波，以此評估電流刺激的效果并且探研年齡是否影響電流刺激的效果。

25129224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25129224.value: 疟原虫穿孔素蛋白PLP2成孔的分子机制研究

25129224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25129224.value: 疟疾是疟原虫引起的一种可致命的传染病，在世界热带和亚热带地区仍然对公众健康构成主要的威胁。疟原虫有着复杂的生命周期，涉及两个宿主，通过蚊子叮咬进入人体内，并侵入和感染多种宿主细胞类型。由于疟原虫穿梭于不同的细胞，使得从宿主细胞中的逃逸成为其生命周期的重要组成部分。疟原虫侵入宿主红细胞进行无性繁殖或者分化成雄性和雌性配子细胞，这两者都在红细胞内的寄生泡（PV）中发育并随后释放。无性子细胞和配子的高效释放对于进一步发育十分关键。全面了解疟原虫传播过程中各种生物膜的破裂机制对于寻找潜在的疟疾控制靶点至关重要。 疟原虫类穿孔素蛋白2（PLP2）在红细胞膜穿孔中起着关键的作用，帮助寄生虫配子从红细胞中逃逸。作为五种保守的疟原虫PLPs之一，PLP2包含一个保守的膜攻击复合物/穿孔素（MACPF）结构域，一个独特的顶复门虫PLP C端β折叠片（APCβ）结构域和一个可变的N端结构域。顶复门虫PLPs（ApiPLPs）中MACPF结构域的存在表明ApiPLPs可能在膜破坏中发挥作用，以促进细胞感染和疾病发生。尽管已经通过冷冻电镜解析了几种MACPF成孔蛋白成员的结构，但到目前为止，顶复门虫中的这些PLPs尚未解析。PLP2如何被招募到红细胞内膜并寡聚化形成功能性孔洞的分子机制仍然不清楚。 在这项工作中，我们将综合生化实验、生物物理表征和结构生物学方法，在体外研究PLP2孔形成的分子机制。通过整合冷冻电子显微镜单颗粒分析（SPA）和最先进的冷冻电子断层扫描和子断层平均技术，我们将在生物膜上（脂质体和和红细胞）原位解析PLP2寡聚体的结构，阐明PLP2在红细胞内膜上的招募、寡聚化和向功能性孔结构转变的机制。对疟原虫生命周期中PLPs的机制性理解对探究抗疟药物新靶点的开发具有重要意义。抑制PLP2成孔活性可能会将寄生虫困在宿主细胞内，从而防止其传播并降低疟疾感染的严重程度。

25200424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25200424.value: 深度學習驅動的可重構磁性微納機械人集群自主導航系統

25200424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25200424.value: 微納機械人的超小尺寸和無線驅動使其能夠以微創或無創方式導航到人體內難以到達的區域，超出了傳統醫療器械的能力範圍。在實際應用中，如何同時導航一群微納機械人是一項關鍵技術，從而發揮治療功能並實現醫學成像下的有效跟蹤。最近的研究證明，微納機械人集群（MSs）的分佈重構能力可以增強其環境適應能力，使其能夠通過狹窄的通道，並將更多的微納機械人輸送到目標位置。然而，手動導航需要操作人員對微納機械人集群的重構和運動控制機制具有深厚的專業知識和豐富的操作經驗；否則，導航很容易失敗，導致微納機械人的丢失。目前，我們領域還缺乏可重構微納機械人集群（尤其是在真實環境中）自主導航的範例，需要解決幾個基本問題：(i) 非結構化複雜環境中的實時分佈/運動規劃；(ii) 強幹擾環境（如流動和傾斜表面）中的運動控制；(iii) 在醫學成像模式（如 X 射線成像）引導下的可行自主導航方案。 本項目利用我們團隊在MS控制/導航、深度學習和醫學成像方面的專業知識，旨在為可重構磁性MS開發一種集成X射線熒光鏡的自主導航系統。為了克服傳統分析和數值方法在MS運動/分佈規劃中的局限性，我們將建立基於深度學習（DL）的方案：為MS運動規劃設計了深度強化學習（RL）方案，其中角色批判網絡架構可實現MS運動的連續規劃；為MS分佈規劃設計了具有多級訓練的DL方案，其中深度殘差網絡可提高複雜X射線反饋圖像的訓練效率/性能；面向真實環境，訓練數據集將從X射線成像反饋的人體胎盤血管中收集。關於強幹擾下的 MS 運動控制，我們提出了基於磁力矩和力的混合方案，其中磁力被額外用於增強 MS 的運動能力。我們將構建系統硬件和軟件，然後進行大量實驗來驗證和微調所提出的導航方案。 該項目的成功將引入新的規劃和控制範例，為微納機械人界做出基礎性貢獻。同時，使用 X 射線成像的數據集和實驗結果可以為我們的同行提供寶貴的開放資源和基準。

25201624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25201624.value: 研究和評估考慮安裝效果和飛行條件下的城市空中交通飛行器的氣動噪聲

25201624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25201624.value: Urban air mobility (UAM) using multi-rotors is an emerging transport mode for goods and people in urban settings. Low-altitude flights of UAM can cause noise pollution, and the features are affected by the installation effect of the closely placed rotors and airframe components. Large gaps exist in our understanding of the flow and acoustic processes and capabilities in efficiently predicting noise generation, motivating this project with comprehensive numerical, experimental, and analytical studies. First, we will conduct anechoic wind tunnel experiments to understand the aeroacoustics of rotor-rotor and rotor-supporting arm interactions using scaled models. The aerodynamic forces and sound signals will be measured using high-accuracy load cells and a linear microphone array. The transient noise sources will be studied using a wavelet-based beamforming method. The experimental results can also validate the high-fidelity numerical simulations for the scaled models, yielding detailed flow structures. Once validated, the numerical tool will be employed for systematic simulations for larger UAM rotor blades that cannot be tested in the wind tunnel. Second, a new sound extraction method will be developed to identify the acoustic modes in the evolving aerodynamic flows. The key measure is filtering out the non-acoustic fluctuations using a differential operator, and the primitive sound pressure is reconstructed from the resulting indirect acoustic variable. The result can provide insight into the near-field sound patterns. Third, efficient noise prediction methods will be developed to account for the aerodynamic performances and unsteady loadings due to the installation effect and flight flows, which will be validated by the experiments and high-fidelity simulations. Finally, an advanced Gaussian beam tracing method incorporating the atmosphere flow and flight motion will be developed for efficient computation of long-distance noise propagation. A phase-ray-centred orthogonal system is proposed to track the ray motion, and the issues related to the inconsistency of the phase and group velocities of the sound wave will be analytically addressed. In preparing the proposal, the PI conducted initial studies. The numerical simulations showed the complex flow and acoustic processes, and the sound extraction method identifies the propagating waves in a canonical problem of mixing layer noise generation. The proposed Gaussian beam tracing method can yield comparable accuracy to the finite element solution. The PI has experience in studying co-axial rotor aeroacoustics, contributing to the likely success of the prediction model. The research outcome will benefit the low-noise design of UAM vehicles and low-emission path planning. Urban air mobility (UAM) is an emerging transport mode for goods and people in urban settings. Low-altitude flights of UAM can cause noise pollution, and noise features are affected by the installation effect of the closely placed rotors and airframe components. Large gaps exist in understanding the associated flow and acoustic processes and our capabilities in efficiently predicting and estimating the noise impact, motivating the current project to conduct a comprehensive numerical, experimental, and analytical study. First, we will conduct anechoic wind tunnel experiments to understand the aeroacoustics of rotor-rotor and rotor-supporting arm interactions using scaled models. The aerodynamic forces and sound signals will be measured using high-accuracy load cells and a linear microphone array. The transient noise sources will be studied using a wavelet-based beamforming method. High-fidelity numerical simulations will be conducted to yield more detailed flow structures and compare with wind tunnel tests for validations and complementary analysis. Then, systematic numerical investigations will be conducted for larger rotor blades for UAM applications. Second, a new sound extraction method will be developed to identify the acoustic modes in the evolving aerodynamic flows. The key measure is filtering out the non-acoustic fluctuations using a differential operator, and primitive sound pressure is reconstructed from the resulting indirect acoustic variable. The result can provide an insightful view of the near-field aerodynamic noise generation and propagation processes. Third, efficient noise prediction methods account for the aerodynamic performances, and unsteady loadings due to the installation effect will be developed. The prediction accuracy will be validated by the experiments and high-fidelity simulations. Finally, an advanced Gaussian beam tracing method incorporating the atmosphere flow and flight motion will be developed for efficient computation of long-distance noise propagation. A phase-ray-centered orthogonal system will be proposed to track the ray motion, and an analytical method will be developed to address the inconsistency of the phase and group velocities of the sound wave. In preparing the proposal, the PI conducted initial studies. The numerical simulations showed the complex flow and acoustic processes, and the sound extraction method identifies the propagating waves in a canonical problem of mixing layer noise generation. The proposed Gaussian beam tracing method can yield comparable accuracy to the finite element solution. The PI has successful experience in predicting the coaxial rotor noise, which can benefit the development of prediction models. The research outcome will benefit the low-noise design of UAM vehicles and low-emission path planning. 城市空中交通是一种新興的交通模式，但是其低空飛行會造成嚴峻的噪聲並受到機身部件安裝的影響。我們在理解和預測相關的流動和聲學過程等方面仍然存在不足，需要開展綜合研究。首先，我們將使用縮比的旋翼和部件組合模型進行靜音風洞實驗測量。我們將使用高精度稱重傳感器和線性傳聲器陣列來進行氣動力和噪聲測量，使用基於小波變換的波束形成方法進行聲源定位。我們還將進行高保真數值模擬以產生更詳細的流動結構，並與風洞測試結果對比以進行驗證及補充分析。然後將對實際飛行器旋翼葉片進行參數化數值研究。我們還將開展理論研究，提取複雜流動中的噪聲成分。主要方法為使用一個微分算子濾除非聲脈動，並根據所得過濾結果重建原始聲壓。第三，我們將開發考慮了部件安裝效應對於旋翼空氣動力性能和噪聲的高效預測方法，並與實驗及高保真結果相對比。最後，我們將開發一種結合大氣流動和飛行運動的先進高斯束追蹤方法以計算聲波的長距離傳播。將提出一種以相射線為中心的正交系統來追蹤射線運動，並將開發一種分析方法來解決聲波的相速度和群速度的不一致問題。對於幾個研究問題，申請人均開展了初步研究。數值模擬顯示了複雜的流動和聲學過程，聲音提取方法識別了混合層發聲及傳播，所提出的高斯束追蹤方法計算精度與有限元結果精度相當。此外，申請人還具有預測共軸對轉旋翼噪聲的成功經驗。研究成果將有利於城市空中交通車輛的低噪音設計和低排放路徑規劃。

25206524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25206524.value: 无需人工注释的点云与图像间多层级中间特征描述与对齐

25206524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25206524.value: 准确理解点云和图像之间的内在互补性对于机器有效感知周围环境至关重要，而建立两种模态之间稳健且一致的关联是其中的关键。现有方法通常将此任务处理为全监督度量学习或姿态优化问题，因而在网络训练过程中严重依赖于密集的人类标注。尽管这些方法在特定场景中表现出色，但其高昂的成本以及在面对未见的真实世界场景时的泛化能力不足，限制了其实际应用。此外，这些方法通常采用相对简单的对齐策略，固有地忽视了在存在显著变化或复杂结构的情况下，多层级对齐所需的特征粒度。 本项目旨在探索无需依赖人工标签的点云与图像对齐方法，这一挑战在快速发展的全监督方法中仍然未被充分研究。项目的主要难点在于如何弥补中间特征的缺乏。为此，我们计划从原始点云和图像中提取语义和几何信息，并将这些信息转化为模态内和跨模态的一致性信号，用于监督神经网络的训练。本项目将提出多项创新性技术。首先，我们将设计一种新的任务无关框架，旨在构建用于群体级别点云和图像对齐的统一特征。该框架将作为两种模态的桥梁，利用任务无关、群体一致的语义和几何线索，识别和构建统一特征。其次，我们将开发一种新的自监督学习框架，在无需人工标注的情况下，学习用于补丁级对齐的可迁移特征。该框架将结合模态内和跨模态的可迁移性，以推断点云和图像补丁之间的特征不变性。第三，我们将提出另一种自监督架构，旨在通过共识驱动的特征识别点-像素对应关系。这一架构将利用全局和跨模态的一致性特征，实现自适应的点-像素对齐。 本项目有望在多模态和自监督学习技术的发展方面做出重要贡献，特别是在点云和图像的解释与关联上。我们的方法旨在学习通用的中间特征，而非仅仅适应现有的人工标注标准，因而具有潜力彻底改变机器跨模态信息感知和整合的方式。本项目的成功将为需要综合场景理解的领域带来重要的突破，预计在自动驾驶、机器人操作和增强现实等前沿应用中产生深远影响。

25207224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25207224.value: 針對隱私數據統計的聯邦分析

25207224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
