25207224.value: 聯邦學習利用個體的模型梯度而非要求上傳原始數據，該種模式已被廣泛采用，用以解決數據隱私和模型訓練成本的問題。此後，聯邦分析也逐漸成為研究的焦點，其是由Google在2020年首次提出，用以衡量聯邦學習模型對實際數據的質量。聯邦分析的目標是學習統計數據，而不是學習預測/生成模型，它關註的查詢包括統計查詢、集合查詢和矩陣轉換查詢。自從首次亮相以來，聯邦分析已在醫療保健、金融和智能家居等數據敏感的領域得到廣泛部署。英國國家衛生服務體系最近宣布投資1億英鎊與DeepMind合作，建立她的聯邦數據平臺，這是世界上最大的醫療保健數據平臺。 然而，聯邦分析並非萬能藥，與聯邦學習一樣，它面臨著通信代價、數據異質性和隱私問題的挑戰。本地化差分隱私（LDP）是一種先進的用戶隱私保護模型，雖然能用於解決聯邦分析中的隱私問題，但同時加劇了其它兩個挑戰的難度。 本項目中，我們提出了一個基於LDP的可擴展聯邦分析系統，該系統從分布式數據中學習統計特征，並同時考慮了橫向和縱向的聯邦分析場景。為了解決上述挑戰，我們將設計新的聯邦查詢處理策略和LDP方案，以確保該系統的高效率、魯棒性和準確性。 憑借我們在差分隱私、分布式數據管理和聯邦學習方面的廣泛研究經驗，我們相信這個項目的成果將為大數據和AI的蓬勃發展的行業的隱私基礎做出貢獻。相關研究結果對學術界、以數據驅動的各行業以及香港市民均帶來益處。

25210924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25210924.value: 香港電動汽車充電即服務的公衆接受度

25210924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25210924.value: Electric vehicles (EVs) have been attracting attention around the world as an environmental-friendly alternative to petrol vehicles by reducing carbon dioxide emissions from road traffic and reducing dependence on oil. In this background, the Hong Kong government has announced a roadmap to promote EVs. The roadmap includes a major goal that no new registrations of petrol vehicles, including hybrids, will be allowed after 2035. To achieve this goal, the government has launched a series of incentive policies, including tax breaks, since 2018 to encourage the purchase of EVs. Although the incentive policies were welcomed by Hong Kong citizens, they have faced challenges after purchasing EVs due to the lack of charging facilities. The difficulty could hinder the realization of the roadmap to replace petrol vehicles. The Charging-as-a-Service (CaaS) is a state-of-the-art charging technology and service to overcome the issue. The CaaS provides EV drivers with integrated charging services. EV drivers send a charging request to the platform using the app on their smartphones, and the CaaS would then return an optimal real-time charging schedule with discounted electricity costs to the drivers. In this way, EV drivers can alleviate their anxiety about finding charging stations and avoid long queues. This will be particularly beneficial for EV drivers in Hong Kong, providing flexible charging options in urban areas where charging stations are difficult to secure. It will also greatly improve access to charging in rural areas where charging stations are hard to find. The successful implementation and use of the CaaS in Hong Kong depends on public adoption. Therefore, it is essential to explore the adoption preferences of Hong Kong citizens for the CaaS to understand/predict its public adoption. In this regard, this project aims to investigate the adoption preferences of Hong Kong citizens for the CaaS. Based on the understanding of EV market in Hong Kong, a sophisticated sequential stated preference survey will be designed to collect the preferences of Hong Kong citizens in terms of the CaaS adoption and charging behavior. Advanced regret-based discrete models will be developed to represent the decision-making of Hong Kong citizens under different dimensions of service uncertainty in the CaaS, then will be applied to the survey data. Comparative analysis and sensitivity analysis will be conducted to understand the adoption preferences better. The results of this project will help policy-makers and system operators to plan the CaaS in Hong Kong. 電動汽車（Electric Vehicles, EVs）作爲汽油車的環保替代品，通過減少道路交通中的二氧化碳排放和降低對石油的依賴，正受到全球關注。在此背景下，香港政府已宣布了壹項推廣電動汽車的路線圖。該路線圖包括壹個主要目標，即自2035年起，將不再允許新注冊汽油車（包括混合動力車）。爲實現這壹目標，政府自2018年起推出了壹系列激勵政策，包括稅收減免，以鼓勵購買電動汽車。雖然這些激勵政策受到了香港市民的歡迎，但由于充電設施不足，他們在購買電動汽車後仍面臨挑戰。這壹難題可能會阻礙替代汽油車路線圖的實現。 充電即服務（Charging-as-a-Service, CaaS）是壹項先進的充電技術和服務，旨在解決這壹問題。CaaS爲電動汽車駕駛員提供綜合充電服務。電動汽車駕駛員可通過智能手機應用程序向平台發送充電請求，CaaS隨後會向駕駛員提供最佳的實時充電計劃，並享受折扣電價。這樣，電動汽車駕駛員就可以緩解尋找充電站的焦慮，避免長時間排隊。這將對香港的電動汽車駕駛員特別有利，爲他們在充電站難以保障的城區提供靈活的充電選項。同時，這也將極大改善農村地區充電站的難尋問題，提高充電便利性。 香港CaaS（充電即服務）的成功實施和使用取決于公衆的接受度。因此，爲了理解和預測公衆對CaaS的接受度，探索香港市民對CaaS的接受偏好至關重要。鑒于此，本項目旨在調查香港市民對CaaS的接受偏好。基于對香港電動汽車市場的了解，將設計壹項複雜的順序選擇偏好調查，以收集香港市民在CaaS采用和充電行爲方面的偏好。將開發基于後悔理論的離散模型，以代表香港市民在CaaS中不同服務不確定性維度下的決策過程，並將這些模型應用于調查數據。此外，還將進行比較分析和敏感性分析，以更深入地了解接受偏好。本項目的成果將有助于政策制定者和系統運營商規劃香港的CaaS。

25211424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25211424.value: 用於時尚內容生成的融合時尚知識的多模態模型

25211424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25211424.value: 本项目旨在通过开发涵盖数据集的构建以及对比学习、图像反演、提示学习和通过特征适应的迁移学习等新颖理论和算法，来创建一个准确、可控且灵活的多模态时尚内容生成系统。 在学术研究中，尽管近期的基础生成模型取得了令人印象深刻的进展，但其往往难以在不同的领域持续生成高质量内容。这是由于整合不同领域的复杂的视觉和文本特征非常具有挑战性。例如，时尚领域由于涉及多个层面的属性和文化的细微表示而加剧了模型学习有效的数据表示对时尚内容生成的难度。一个直观的解决方案是重新训练一个专门的基础模型。然而，这种方法对大多数研究人员来说在经济上是不可行的。最近的工作主要集中在微调基础模型上，但这些尝试仍处于初始阶段。目前，这些工作仅专注于特定风格或对象，而不能够处理时尚领域中复杂多样的风格以及对象。此外，准确区分语义特征的强大潜在空间的缺失也为实现准确和可控的时尚内容生成带来了挑战。 在工业领域，全球越来越强调可持续的背景下，数字时尚的重要性显著上升。尽管对这个领域的兴趣日益增加，目前最先进的解决方案在实施阶段仍面临挑战。例如，最先进的模型在生成精细设计的属性或复杂时尚概念的内容时经常遇到困难。设计模型使其具备如细节设计的编辑或为同款式不同图像域转换等复杂能力仍然是一个重大难题。 初步实践表明，系统地将专业时尚知识纳入基础生成模型是将通用模型适应到特定领域上下文的一种可行的方法。因此，该项目提出构建精心策划的多模态数据集。该数据集将涵盖包括相关文化背景在内的多样化时尚知识。为了利用这些丰富的领域知识，该项目将引入对比学习方法，提高在时尚领域内多模态生成任务的准确性。此外，知识增强的基础模型将进一步促进研究人员在图像反演、基于文字提示的学习以及迁移学习等领域的探索，从而实现灵活、可控、准确的时尚图像编辑和转换。具体来说，该项目将解决三个关键问题： 1. 开发利用丰富和全面时尚知识的方法，构建知识增强的基础大模型。 2. 开发精确高效的图像反演技术和潜在空间操作方法，专注于时尚图像的精细编辑。 3. 通过微调机制或专门的训练策略，开发基于文字提示的学习方法，旨在实现时尚图像在多个域的灵活转换，包括草图、插图和产品图像。 该项目是将大型预训练模型整合到专业领域的有效范例。这些提出的理论和算法有潜力缩小目前时尚内容生成中的研究差距。它们能够简化专业人员的设计流程，激发专业人员的创造力并促进时尚行业及相关领域的创新。

25213424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25213424.value: 单调可加偏好下的动态投资组合

25213424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25213424.value: Monotonicity and additivity are two commonly discussed properties of individuals’ preferences. Monotonicity ensures that a decision maker prefers a larger payoff, while additivity can be justified by its connection to other properties such as stationarity, separability, and invariance to background risk. This project aims to apply the monotone additive preferences to dynamic portfolio selection in a stochastic factor market. The monotone additive preference is appealing because it has an axiomatic foundation and a tractable representation and can display a behavior that is neither risk-averse nor risk-seeking. However, this preference can lead to time-inconsistent behavior in a dynamic setting. To address the issue of time inconsistency, we follow the literature to consider intra-personal equilibrium strategies that can be consistently implemented by the agent. Preliminary analysis shows that in the Black-Scholes model, the equilibrium portfolio strategy depends on the distribution of the risk-attitude parameter only via its mean. This result, however, does not hold in a stochastic factor market due to the presence of hedging demands. In this research project, we shall investigate equilibrium portfolio strategies in stochastic factor markets and explore how hedging demands depend on the investors’ risk attitudes. The proposed research will also offer insights into group decision-making problems and contribute to the stochastic control theory with objectives involving weighted averages of nonlinear transformations of expectations. 单调性和可加性是两个常见的个体偏好性质。单调性确保了决策者倾向于更高的回报，而可加性可通过其与稳定性，可分性，以及背景风险下恒定性的关联加以佐证。本项目旨在将单调可加偏好应用于随机因子市场下的动态投资组合。单调可加偏好具有公理化基础和易处理的表达式，可以展现出既非规避风险也非寻求风险的行为，因此极有研究价值。然而，在动态优化框架下，这种偏好可能导致时间不一致的行为。为解决时间不一致性问题，我们按照文献的方法考虑个体间均衡策略。初步分析表明，在Black-Scholes模型中，个体间均衡投资策略仅仅取决于风险态度参数分布的均值。然而，对冲需求导致这一结果在随机因子市场中不成立。在此项目中，我们将研究随机因子市场中的均衡投资策略，并探讨对冲需求如何受投资者风险态度的影响。本项目的研究还将为群体决策问题提供思路，并为优化期望的非线性变换下加权平均做出理论贡献。

25213824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25213824.value: 調控PEM反應器的酸性介面高效製備雙氧水的研究 調節酸性界面以實現 PEM 電解槽中高效的過氧化氫生產 調節酸性界面以實現 PEM 電解槽中高效的過氧化氫生產

25213824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25213824.value: 雙氧水，又稱過氧化氫 (H2O2)，是日常生活和工業生產中的一種重要化學品。目前，工業製備 H2O2 的方法主要依賴於蒽醌法，但這種方法存在高能耗和高碳排放等問題。相比之下，利用清潔電能驅動質子交換膜 (PEM) 反應器將氧氣 (O2) 還原成 H2O2 具有顯著的經濟和環保優勢。然而，在實際操作中，由於 PEM 的強酸性質使得膜/陰極介面處質子濃度較高，從而導致 H2O2 過度還原並產生副反應，使得 PEM 反應器製備 H2O2 的選擇性低、穩定性差。因此調節膜/電極介面、降低介面處質子濃度對提升 O2 到 H2O2 的轉化效率至關重要。基於此，本項目擬圍繞 PEM 陰極電極修飾和製備展開探索，通過修飾傳統陰極電極製備能夠調節催化介面的功能化電極，降低電化學反應介面處的質子濃度，從而提升 O2 到 H2O2 的轉化效率。我們將結合先進的表徵技術和理論建模，理清質子在電極/膜介面的傳導機制，並進一步組裝 PEM 反應器，實現大電流密度下 H2O2 的連續生產。具體研究內容包括以下幾個方面：（1）陰極電極的功能修飾與性能研究：我們利用陽離子有機鏈對商業碳基電極進行修飾和改性，使其具備陽離子特性，以提升 O2 到 H2O2 的轉化效率。初步研究結果顯示，咪唑修飾的功能化碳電極在這方面表現出色，表明該方法具有很好的可行性。（2）電極對質子傳輸和 H2O2 製備機理的研究：研究電極對局部質子分佈和反應中間體的影響，並開發理論模型，準確類比質子和離子在反應過程中的分佈和傳輸行為，深入瞭解其作用機制。（3）質子膜反應器的設計與組裝：利用所設計的電極，組裝 PEM 電解槽，實現H2O2的高效連續生成，並評估其在實際運行過程中的性能。該項目旨在通過電極修飾調節電催化反應介面的質子分佈和傳輸，實現 H2O2 的高效連續生產。這將為電化學連續製備 H2O2 的技術發展奠定基礎，同時也為 PEM 的多功能化提供了可能。

25217524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25217524.value: LiDAR 辅助 GNSS 多路径/NLOS 建模和缓解，用于城市峡谷中的机器人定位

25217524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25217524.value: Global navigation satellite system (GNSS) is an indispensable positioning technique for autonomous robotic systems, such as autonomous driving vehicles (ADV) and unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV). With the corrections from reference stations, centimeter-level positioning accuracy can be obtained from the GNSS real-time kinematic, also well-known as GNSS RTK, in open areas. The accuracy of GNSS is significantly degraded in densely populated urban cities, such as Hong Kong and New York. However, these cities introduce the greatest need for the arrival of unmanned autonomous systems (UAS) at the same time. The challenge of GNSS urban positioning is due to the GNSS signal blockage, reflections, and diffraction from buildings. The reception of the GNSS reflected signal will introduce an extra delay on the ranging measurement, known as non-line-of-sight (NLOS) receptions and multipath effects. A recent work innovatively proposed to employ a 3D light detection and ranging (LiDAR) sensor to actively reconstruct the environment to mitigate the NLOS error, assuming that only a single reflection occurs. However, little progress has been made in the modeling of the multipath effects and NLOS receptions with multiple reflections (e.g. two reflections). How can the 3D LiDAR assist in inferring the attenuation of received GNSS signal strength caused by multipath effects? Moreover, multiple reflections are common in complex scenarios. How is the transmitted GNSS signal reflected inside a city? The GNSS signal blockage, meaning only limited measurements can be received, is another challenge to GNSS RTK due to the non-convex nature of the integer ambiguity resolution (AR) for GNSS carrier-phase measurements. How to reliably resolve the AR in urban canyons, with the presence of poor satellite geometry and non-convexity introduced by the nonlinear measurement model? With the real-time environment model digitally constructed by 3D LiDAR equipped on UASs, this project aims to investigate the mechanism of the attenuation of GNSS signal strength caused by multipath effects, NLOS receptions with multiple reflections, and GNSS AR of the carrier-phase measurement in urban canyons. The experimental and numerical data will be analyzed in detail to help address the aforementioned questions. The lead applicant has proposed and developed the LiDAR-aided GNSS positioning method since 2018. We are confident the outcome of this project would lead to 20-centimeter level GNSS RTK positioning in urban canyons, for unlocking a series of applications of UAS robotic systems, such as contactless parcel delivery with UAV and robot-taxi with ADV. 全球導航衛星系統（GNSS）是自動駕駛車輛（ADV）和無人機等自主機器人系統不可或缺的定位技術。借助參考站的修正信息，GNSS即時運動學定位（也稱為GNSS-RTK）可在開闊區域獲得厘米級的定位精度。然而，在香港和紐約等存在密集建築群的城市，GNSS定位的精度會大大降低，儘管這些城市對無人自主系統應用有著巨大的需求。 GNSS城市定位的挑戰在於信號被建築物阻擋、反射和繞射。經過反射的信號會為測距測量帶來額外的延遲，導致所謂的非視距（NLOS）接收或多路徑效應。最近的一些研究創新地提出了採用三維激光雷達來主動重建環境預測反射路徑，在單次反射的假設下減少NLOS誤差。然而，目前的研究在多路徑效應和多次反射（如兩次反射）的NLOS接收建模方面進展甚微。其中有若干科學問題亟待探究。例如，三維激光雷達如何幫助推斷多路徑效應造成的 GNSS 接收信號強度衰減？此外，對於多次反射，如何探究GNSS信號在複雜城市場景中的反射路徑？另外，決定GNSS-RTK性能的載波相位測量整數模糊度估計具有非凸性質。那麼，如何在城市峽谷中可靠地解決衛星幾何形狀不良和非線性測量模型帶來的非凸性問題？ 利用無人機上配備的三維激光雷達建構的實時環境模型，本項目旨在研究城市峽谷中多路徑效應引起的GNSS信號強度衰減的機理、信號多次反射的路徑預測和複雜環境下GNSS-RTK載波模糊度估計等問題。本項目將根據實驗和實際數據進行詳細分析研究，以幫助探索上述問題。主要申請人自2018年起提出並開發了激光雷達輔助GNSS定位方法。我們相信，該項目的成果將實現城市峽谷中20公分級別的GNSS-RTK定位，從而開啟基於無人自主系統的一系列應用，例如基於無人機的非接觸式包裹快遞和基於ADV的機器人出租車等。

25223524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25223524.value: 研製一種高效連續水動能收集裝置

25223524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25223524.value: Exploiting renewable and green energy sources with a minimal carbon footprint is vital for shifting the fossil fuels-dominating energy structure to a green one in the era of intensifying energy crises. Among various strategies, harvesting energy from low-frequency and decentralized water has gained increasing attention owing to its ubiquity and eco-friendliness. The past several years have witnessed extensive accomplishments in water energy harvesting based on the intricate interplay between water and interfacial materials. Despite the high diversity, a common mechanism underlying current water energy harvesting is leveraging temporary contact between water and charged surface with a dynamic variation of the liquid-solid interfacial area to achieve reversible charge transfer. However, current approaches face challenges to efficiently harvest energy from continuous water-solid relative motion such as water sliding that is more widespread, primarily owing to the stable water-solid interface that leads to irreversible charge transfer. We propose an unexplored type of water-based generator that features a charge-patterned surface and a transistor-like electrode architecture, referred to as CP-TEG, to overcome the limitations encountered in current designs. With a continuous water motion on the surface, the charge pattern enables fully reversible charge transfer without the need for time-varying liquid-solid interfacial area, whereas a transistor-like electrode architecture can maximize the utilization of surface charge for continuous and efficient electricity generation. Our design builds upon breakthrough technologies recently developed by us, including a general, efficient energy harvesting technology (Nature 2020, Sci. Adv. 2022, The Innovation 2022), and surface molecular engineering (Proc. Natl. Acad. Sci. 2021, Sci. Adv. 2023). Our preliminary work has demonstrated that a 100-μL sliding water droplet on the generator surface can continuously produce peak voltage outputs of 120 V without decline, even over long sliding distances. In this project, we will first design, fabricate, and characterize the proposed generator. We will also develop theoretical models, coupling with hydrodynamics and equivalent electrical circuits, to advance our fundamental understanding and to guide experimental optimization. Building upon this foundational research, we will demonstrate the performance optimization and generality of CP-TEG. Furthermore, we will explore cross-scale applications of CP-TEG, including flexible electronics, blue energy, and integration with other energy harvesting devices such as solar panels. We envision that the newly designed water energy generator will enrich and extend our fundamental understanding of interfacial water-electrical energy conversion and will open up a new avenue for the design of energy devices in a wide range of applications. 在能源危機日益加劇的時代，開發碳足跡最小的可再生能源和綠色能源是實現以化石燃料為主導的能源結構向綠色能源結構轉變的關鍵。在各種策略中，從低頻和分散的水中收集能量由於其無處不在和生態友好性而受到越來越多的關註。在過去的幾年裏，基於水和界面材料之間復雜的相互作用，水能收集取得了廣泛的成就。盡管種類繁多，當前水能收集的共同機製是利用水和帶電表面之間的短暫接觸以及液固界面面積的動態變化來實現可逆電荷轉移。然而，目前的方法面臨著從更為普遍得連續的水-固相對運動中有效收集能量的挑戰，這種滑動更為普遍，主要是由於穩定的水-固界面導致不可逆的電荷轉移。 本項目中，我們提出一種未開發的水基發電機，其特點是具有電荷圖案表面和晶體管狀電極結構，稱為CP-TEG，以克服當前設計中遇到的局限性。由於水在表面上連續運動，電荷模式可以實現完全可逆的電荷轉移，而不需要隨時間變化的液固界面面積，而類似晶體管的電極結構可以最大限度地利用表面電荷進行連續有效的發電。我們的設計建立在我們最近開發的突破性技術的基礎上，包括一種通用的、高效的能量收集技術(Nature 2020, Sci. Adv. 2022, The Innovation 2022)，以及表面分子工程(Proc. Natl. Acad. Sci. 2021, Sci. Adv. 2023)。我們的初步工作已經證明，即使在很長的滑動距離上，發電機表面的100 ul滑動水滴也可以連續產生120 V的峰值電壓輸出而不會下降。在這個項目中，我們將首先設計、製造和表征所提議的發電機。我們還將建立理論模型，結合流體力學和等效電路，以推進我們的基本理解並指導實驗優化。在此基礎上，我們將展示CP-TEG的性能優化和通用性。此外，我們將探索CP-TEG的跨規模應用，包括柔性電子，藍色能源，以及與其他能量收集設備(如太陽能電池板)的集成。我們設想新設計的水能發生器將豐富和擴展我們對界面水電能量轉換的基本認識，並將為廣泛應用的能源裝置設計開辟新的途徑。

25227524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25227524.value: 基於雪崩光電二極管的光通信相干接收機的理論與實驗研究

25227524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25227524.value: The developing of economy and society is heavily relying on fast and reliable exchange of data and information in today’s world. Fiber optical communication system, as one of the most important communication systems, provide enormous bandwidth to meet the modern society’s needs for massive amounts of data transportation from crossing continents long-haul information transmission to short reach interconnects for data centers. With the recent emergence of new applications such as augmented/virtual reality, internet of things, cloud computing, industry 4.0 and generative AI, huge demand for optical interconnects with bit rate up to 800Gbit/s or even Tbit/s are erupted to fulfil interconnects inside and between data centers. Optical coherent technology by using phase and amplitude modulation, polarization multiplexing, space division multiplexing, coherent detection, digital signal process (DSP) for linear and nonlinear effect compensation, and high-performance feed-forward error correction (FEC) is the most promising candidate for next generation high-speed optical interconnects. However, limited by the high-cost and high-power consumption of current optical coherent systems, they cannot directly be deployed for data center interconnects. Low-cost and power efficient optical coherent technique is highly desired. In this project, we propose a systematic and comprehensive research plan to explore low-cost and power-efficient optical coherent transmission system by using avalanche photodiode (APD) based coherent receiver. First, we will build the analytical and simulation model of the APD based coherent receiver. The analytical and numerical simulations will be performed. Second, we will develop, manufacture and assemble coherent receiver by hybrid integrating SiON chip, APD and TIA. The key parameters of developed APD based coherent receiver chip will be characterized in detail. Third, we will propose to mitigate the nonlinear distortion raised by APD by using a look up table (LUT) based equalizer, which will enable high order modulation formats up to 64QAM for APD based coherent receiver. Fourth, we will carry out comprehensive experiments to evaluate the performance of propose APD based coherent receiver in coherent optical transmission system with bit rate from 400Gbit/s to 1Tbit/s and transmission distance from 10km to 80km. The proposed APD coherent receiver potentially has a breakthrough of up to14dB reduction in terms of laser power, which will significantly reduce the overall cost and power for the whole coherent transmission system. It is believed that the success of this project will promote the accelerate Hong Kong’s research and innovation in optical communication and photonics related fields. 當今世界經濟和社會的發展很大程度上依賴快速、可靠的數據和資訊交換。光纖通訊系統作為最重要的通訊系統之一，提供龐大的頻寬，可以滿足現代社會從跨洲長途資訊傳輸到數據中心短距離互連的海量資料傳輸的需求。近年來，隨著增強/虛擬實境、物聯網、雲端運算、工業4.0、生成式人工智慧等新應用的出現，對傳輸速率高達800Gbit/s甚至Tbit/s的光互連的巨大需求全面爆發。填充內部和資料中心之間的互連。利用相位和幅度調製、偏振復用、空分複用、相干檢測、數字信號處理技術（DSP）進行線性和非線性效應補償以及高性能前饋糾錯（FEC）的相干光通信技術是下一代高速光互聯的首選方案。然而，受限於目前傳統相干光傳輸系統的高額成本和高功耗，它們無法直接部署與數據中心。因此，低成本及高能效的相干光傳輸技術的研究顯得尤為重要和急迫。 在本項目中，我們提出了一個系統和全面的研究計劃，透過使用基於雪崩光電二極管APD）的光相干接收機來探索低成本和高能效的相干光傳輸系統。首先，我們將建立基於APD的光相干接收機的理論和仿真模型，理論和仿真分析基於APD的光相干接收機性能。其次，我們將透過光電混合集成技術實現基於APD的光相干接收機的製造和組裝。基於APD的相干接收機的關鍵參數將得到仔細測試與分析。第三，我們將開發基於查表 (LUT) 的均衡器來減輕 APD 引起的非線性失真，這將使得基於 APD 的相干接收器能夠支持 64QAM 等高階調製碼型。第四，我們將進行全面的實驗來評估所提出的基於APD的相干接收機在速率從400Gbit/s到1Tbit/s、傳輸距離從10km到80km的相干光傳輸系統中的性能。本項目提出的基於APD的光相干接收機將有望實現激光器功率高達14dB的降低。這將顯著降低整個相干傳輸系統的整體成本和功耗。本項目的成功將推動香港在光通訊及光子學相關領域的研究和創新。

25233024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25233024.value: 基于耦合非线性微腔的克尔光频率梳的理论及实验研究

25233024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25233024.value: 基于高品质、结构紧凑微腔产生克尔光频率梳推动了基础研究及工程应用的发展。平衡单个微腔的增益和损耗、色散和非线性等多种技术已经被用来产生光频率梳、提高泵浦的转化效率和优化输出光谱。研究人员还对光频率梳产生的非线性动力学包括调制不稳定性、图灵卷、混沌、单孤子和多孤子进行了系统地研究。然而，光频率梳的产生仍然很困难，因为在单个微腔中可以操纵的物理参数数量有限，从而限制了克尔频率梳的实际应用。耦合微腔系统具有更大的灵活性和自由度，可以突破单腔的限制，有望突破目前的瓶颈。利用耦合微腔系统，可以在正常色散区产生克尔频率梳；同时也可以让泵浦转化效率接近1，并实现任意色散调控。迄今为止，已经有部分研究人员对耦合微腔进行了理论和实验研究，但仍然需要对耦合微腔的特性进行系统地研究，探究耦合微腔体系的物理机制，优化耦合微腔的设计等。 在本项目中，我们将系统地研究耦合微腔中克尔频率梳的产生及非线性动力学。两个或多个微腔的耦合、时针和逆时针模式之间的耦合等耦合方式可以为耦合微腔体系提供更多的自由度。根据耦合微腔系统的参数包括尺寸、色散、增益、损耗等建立相应的物理模型及方程，分析耦合系数、耦合的调谐速度以及不同的耦合方式对克尔频率梳产生的动力学和性能的影响。研究两个不同参数的物理耦合微腔、Sagnac耦合环、光子晶体微腔、多个耦合微腔等耦合系统产生光频率梳的过程及动力学，并优化色散、非线性、增益和损耗等提升光频率梳的转化效率及输出光谱，并拓展到多泵浦方式和多耦合微腔系统。最后，对优化设计的耦合微腔进行加工和表征，并将实验测试结果进行分析，进一步修正理论仿真模型及加工设计，最终实现高质量的光频率梳。

25233824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25233824.value: 視而不見？減少遠程數碼塔台中的注意力盲視以提升空管的安全性和警覺性

25233824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25233824.value: 遠程數碼塔台是航空業中迅速發展的一大趨勢，允許對多個低流量機場進行遠程空中交通管制。這項技術具有減少人員和運營成本，以及避免建造高大且佔用空間的塔台結構的優勢。然而，它也對需要監控大量複雜界面的動態空中交通的人類操作員構成了重大挑戰。主要風險之一是注意力盲視（IB），即即使空管員直接看著某區域也未能注意區域內意外但顯著的事件。 本研究項目的目標是減少遠程數碼塔操作中的IB風險，並提高空中交通管制的效率、安全性和警覺性。考慮到複雜的工作環境、干擾警告、生物信號的顯著變化以及遠程數碼塔操作中對可解釋性的高要求，我們提出了兩個創新解決方案：自適應情境IB警告和動態空域分區。情境IB檢測器可以識別需要密切注意的關鍵視覺線索，而動態空域分區則根據情境開啟和關閉區域，以最小化空管員出現IB風險。該項目包括三個相互關聯的部分：（i）基於眼動追踪和腦電圖（EEG）數據分析的IB理論模型，（ii）基於多模態數據融合和生物信號圖像生成的跨被試IB檢測模型，以及（iii）自適應IB警告和動態空域分區以減少IB風險。 本項目的關鍵特徵是使用因果推斷來指導IB檢測和減少的可解釋性。因果關係是穩定且易於理解的。我們將進行三個用戶實驗來收集經驗數據，並通過分析視覺和認知注意力之間的互動或中斷來揭示IB的基本機制。基於這些因果關係，我們將開發IB警告和動態空域分區策略。 本項目的結果不僅將有助於更深入地理解IB，還將提高航空的安全性和效率。IB在其他安全關鍵領域（如道路交通和核電廠操作）中也是一種常見現象。本項目的發現和解決方案可以擴展並應用到這些領域，從而提高它們的安全性並減少潛在的經濟和人員損失。

25236824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25236824.value: 基於物理模型增强衛星立體摄影测量的森林結構信息提取

25236824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25236824.value: 使用超高分辨率（<2米）影像進行衛星立體攝影測量以高效方式表徵森林冠層表面的潛力，利用現有數據仍然未被廣泛探索。此外，對於未來衛星在此特定背景下的最佳設計配置也缺乏徹底的探索。當前超高解析度立體攝影測量的應用在尋求獲取森林表面高程結構的精確信息時常遇到困難。森林結構的複雜性以及其表面反射的各向異性特徵對傳統立體算法提出了相當大的挑戰。如立體卷積神經網絡（StereoCNN）和深度神經網絡（DNN）等新型立體算法有潛力解決這些挑戰。然而，它們的有效性在很大程度上依賴於有代表性的穩定狀態參考的大量穩健訓練數據集的可用性。不幸的是，由於現象學和森林砍伐導致的結構變化頻繁，以及超高解析度衛星獲取的時間分辨率和雲層覆蓋限制，這些數據集在森林地區的缺乏成為主要原因。這些障礙不僅限制了立體攝影測量在分析森林結構方面的全部潛力，而且也阻礙了對數據的後續解釋和應用。 為了克服這些障礙，本研究旨在通過整合立體攝影測量和基於物理的輻射傳遞模型，增強森林表面結構信息的提取。這種整合有可能顯著提高我們解釋和理解捕獲數據的能力。利用從公開可用的機載激光雷達數據重建的3D森林模型，我們計劃模擬大規模（高達3公里幅寬）的高解析度遙感影像，並使用真實的相機模型。主要目標是使用這些模擬來更好地理解影響紋理匹配的因素，並增強立體卷積神經網絡和深度神經網絡在森林立體攝影測量中的使用。 通過改進目前和未來衛星中的立體攝影測量處理，這個項目有潛力顯著貢獻於現有數據的重新處理以及指導未來旨在增強全球植被結構產品的衛星任務。這些成果，包括模擬數據和處理流程，將公開提供，以吸引學術界和商業實體的興趣。

25238324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25238324.value: 一石二鳥：同步去除污水中的氮和溶解甲烷

25238324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25238324.value: In seeking sustainable management, wastewater is now being considered more as a resource than as a waste. Consequently, wastewater management infrastructures across the world are in a paradigm shift motivated by two primary movements: a need to transform wastewater treatment from energy consumer to exporter; and a drive towards net-zero emission of greenhouse gases. One of the most promising configurations is the recovery of organics in wastewater as methane. However, to do this, a crucial fact is that only 60% of methane generated can be recovered, while the rest 40% remains dissolved in the wastewater, which is not only a dissipation of energy but also a significant amount of greenhouse gas emissions. This dissolved methane can represent more than half of the estimated carbon footprint of a wastewater treatment plant. Capitalizing on the latest scientific discoveries and engineering principles, this project will develop an innovative solution to overcome these challenges. This solution is based on the implementation of a novel gas-delivery membrane module for both Anoxic and Oxic (A/O) tanks in wastewater treatment plants, thus named as the dual-membrane A/O process. This innovative technology will be systematically demonstrated from bench scale to semi-pilot scale through specific research objectives: • Develop an innovative dual-membrane A/O process, which simultaneously achieves bioenergy recovery, cost-efficient nitrogen removal, and mitigation of greenhouse gas emissions in wastewater treatment. • Gain a fundamental understanding of the in-biofilm processes, the microbial community involved and their interactions, and develop effective strategies to manipulate this community and to achieve the required functions. • Demonstrate and optimise the technology in a semi-pilot scale system, to enable the technology uptake and translation by the wider water industry following the completion of the project. The project outcomes will bring significant social, economic, and environmental impacts and benefits, closely aligning with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals SDG 6 "Clean Water and Sanitation", and SDG 13 "Climate Action". Through the execution of large-scale demonstrations in the practical context of water industries, the technology’s effectiveness and scalability will be showcased. This will also enable the development of benchmarks for the wider adoption by wastewater treatment facilities globally. The anticipated benefit is to enable water utilities to realise energy- and carbon-neutral wastewater services as early as 2030. With a strong educational and pertinent research background in both wastewater management and environmental engineering, the PI is well-positioned to lead this ECS project to success. 在尋求可持續管理的過程中，廢水現在被更多地視為一種資源而非廢棄物。因此，全球的廢水管理基礎設施正在經歷由兩個主要驅動力推動的範式轉變：一是將廢水處理從能源消費者轉變為能源出口者的需求，二是推動實現溫室氣體零排放。其中最具潛力的其中一種配置是將廢水中的有機物轉化為甲烷。然而，所產生的甲烷中只有60%能夠被回收，餘下40%則溶解在廢水中，這不僅是能源的流失，還會導致大量溫室氣體排放。這部分溶解的甲烷可能佔廢水處理廠碳足跡預算值的一半以上。基於最新的科學發現和工程原理，本項目將開發創新解決方案，以克服這些挑戰。該解決方案基於一種新型的氣體輸送膜模組的實施，適用於廢水處理廠的厭氧（Anoxic）和好氧（Oxic）池，因此被稱為雙膜A/O工藝。 這一創新技術將通過以下具體研究目標，從實驗室小規模到半試驗規模系統地進行展示： 1. 開發創新的雙膜A/O工藝，同時實現生物能源回收、成本效益高的氮去除以及廢水處理中的溫室氣體減排。 2. 深入瞭解生物膜中的過程、涉及的微生物群落及其相互作用，開發有效的策略來操縱這一群落以實現所需功能。 3. 在半試驗規模系統中展示並優化該技術，以便在項目完成後，推動更廣泛的水工業領域採用並轉化該技術。 項目成果將帶來顯著的社會、經濟和環境影響與效益，密切符合聯合國可持續發展目標SDG 6「清潔飲水和衛生設施」以及SDG 13「氣候行動」。通過在水工業實際背景下進行的大規模示範，技術的有效性和可擴展性將得到展示。這也將為全球廢水處理設施的廣泛採用制定基準。預期的益處是使水務公司能夠在2030年之前實現能源和碳中和的廢水服務。

25301524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25301524.value: 低成本二維鎳(II)基-石墨炔：合理設計、合成、表徵和催化應用

25301524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25301524.value: 2010年通過自下而上方法大面積製備且成功分離了石墨炔（GDY）薄膜材料，它是一種新的二維碳同素異形體。通過其豐富的雙炔鍵（-C≡C-C≡C-）將金屬單原子錨定於石墨炔框架中，並由此產生了獨特多孔結構可以調節其電子分佈，拓寬其在催化中的應用。然而，由於此結構不均匀和活性位點不穩定，其可控製備仍然是一個巨大的挑戰。因此，對於原子級催化機制的全面理解仍然缺乏。在此，金屬單原子作爲新的功能單元通過金屬-炔鍵（-C≡C-M-C≡C-）引入至GDY的框架中，從而製備成金屬化石墨炔（MGY），這將結合催化活性金屬中心和可調節電荷轉移的石墨炔框架雙重優勢，并實現金屬單原子的精準分佈。我們最近首次報道了基於Hg（II）的大面積石墨炔材料用於光學器件和光電催化，證明了具有各種特定結構MGY的製備及其多功能性的可行性。 本項目中，基於d8 Ni(II)-(PR3)2（R = 烷基鏈）單元形成綫性結構-C≡C-Ni(PR3)2-C≡C-，將設計和合成低成本和低毒性的二維Ni(II)基石墨炔，通過Ni(II)的d軌道和多炔有機配體中-C≡C-的p軌道匹配效應形成同金屬或異金屬骨架。根據界面輔助方法和一鍋法，分別生成這類材料的少層和多層納米片及塊體材料。通過使用具有不同電子和光學性質的有機配體，製備具有不同拓撲結構、孔徑、比表面積和功能性的二維納米片，因爲配體結構可以根據HC≡C-與中心核之間的間隔長度、中心髮色團以及配位位點的數量進行調整。將評估Ni(II)基石墨炔的性能並闡明納米結構之間的關係，主要研究Ni(II)-(PR3)2和有機配體在激活其CO2還原反應（CO2RR）光催化及其壓電效應驅動光催化的潛在性能。基於我們嘗試的優選結果，通過實驗技術和理論建模，將闡明和理解原子級催化機制。本項目可以產生一類新的二維富碳材料，并爲開發高效的CO2RR光催化劑和壓電光催化劑提供新的設計概念。

25305424.value: 用於高效求解非凸優化問題的基於篩法的割線算法及其在處理帶噪聲觀測數據的結構化機器學習模型中的應用

25310224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25310224.value: 解析巨噬細胞的極化：一種用於優化疾病治療干預的化學生物學方法

25310224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25310224.value: Macrophages, specialized white blood cells, are pivotal in various biological activities, encompassing immune system orchestration and influencing cancer dynamics. Renowned for their adaptability, these cells can switch between the pro-inflammatory (M1) and anti-inflammatory (M2) states, each crucial for different medical scenarios, including cancer, chronic inflammation, and autoimmunity. Their functional versatility, however, extends beyond a mere M1/M2 dichotomy; in real-world conditions, macrophages exhibit a spectrum of behaviours, underscoring their intricate nature. These cellular transformations hold immense significance for healthcare, paving the way for advanced diagnostics, prognosis prediction, and precision therapies. While current macrophage polarization analysis techniques offer a wealth of data, they often miss capturing the real-time transition dynamics. To bridge this gap, we aim to re-engineer a proven 'ticker tape' technology, originally designed for neural applications, to the study of macrophages. Utilising an inert and self-assembling protein fibre that grows linearly with time, and the HaloTag—a self-labelling protein designed to capture synthetic ligands conjugated to fluorescent tags—the ticker tape system can correlate the intracellular clock with the external physical world's time scale. In addition, a reporter construct is coupled to an activity marker, incorporating the activity in the form of colour bands into the ticker tape. This allows for the chronological recording of cellular activity that can be later interpreted using confocal microscopy. Its efficacy has been established in neuronal studies. Our research goal is to adapt the ticker tape methodology from neurons to real-time tracking of macrophage polarization. This integration could offer insights into the precise moments and causes of macrophage transitions, revealing potentially ground-breaking therapeutic avenues. As we further examine the therapeutic responses on macrophage dynamics, this method could vastly refine our perception of macrophage roles in health and disease scenarios. Structured around this pioneering vision, our research is defined by three key objectives: customizing the ticker tape tool for macrophage application, validating the approach with recognized markers like LPS and IL-4/IL-13, and probing the therapeutic ramifications of macrophage shifts in cellular environments. This exploration aims to unlock deeper layers of macrophage understanding, setting the stage for novel strategies in disease control and treatment. 巨噬細胞是一種在多種生命過程中發揮關鍵作用的白血球細胞，涵蓋免疫系統調控以及癌症動態。巨噬細胞的一個顯著特徵是其適應性：它們能在促炎症的M1狀態和抗炎症的M2狀態之間切換，這些狀態對於包括癌症、慢性炎症和自體免疫在內的多種醫療場景至關重要。然而，巨噬細胞的功能多樣性並不僅限於這些狀態的切換：在生理系統中，巨噬細胞表現出多樣化的行為，進一步突顯其複雜性。這些細胞狀態轉變對治療策略具有重大意義，為高級診斷、預後預測以及精準治療鋪平了道路。儘管現有針對巨噬細胞極化的分析技術提供了豐富的數據，但它們往往難以捕捉實時的轉變動態。為了填補這一空白，我們計劃改造一種在神經元中經過驗證的“時間條帶”技術，將其應用於巨噬細胞研究。該技術基於一種能在細胞內自組裝成線性纖維的惰性蛋白，並結合HaloTag（一種可以捕捉合成熒光配體的自標記蛋白），為細胞活動打上“時間戳“，從而將細胞內部時鐘與外部物理世界的時間尺度相聯繫。此外，神經元活性相關的啟動子被用於驅動荧光報告分子的表達，實現將細胞活性歷史以顏色帶的形式記錄到時間條帶上相應的位置，從而可以被荧光共聚焦顯微鏡讀出細胞活動的時間順序。該技術的有效性已在神經研究中得到證明。我們的目標是將時間條帶技術從神經元改裝應用於巨噬細胞，以實現對巨噬細胞極化狀態變化的實時追蹤。這一整合可能揭示巨噬細胞轉變的確切時刻和原因，從而開創潛在的突破性治療途徑。隨著我們進一步研究治療反應對巨噬細胞動態的影響，這一方法可能極大地改善科研人員對巨噬細胞在健康和疾病情境中角色的理解。我們的研究圍繞這一開創性願景展開，並確立了三個關鍵目標：1）為巨噬細胞應用定制時間條帶工具；2）利用已知誘導因子如LPS和IL-4/IL-13驗證該方法；3）探討巨噬細胞轉變在細胞環境中的治療影響。這一探索旨在深入理解巨噬細胞，為疾病控制和治療提供全新的策略基礎。

25504524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25504524.value: 生态系统动态与资源竞争：解析初创公司策略与颠覆性酒店业格局

25504524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25504524.value: In the dynamic hospitality landscape, startups like Airbnb have introduced game-changing innovations, challenging conventional norms. Despite their prominence, limited research delves into the critical success factors of these emerging businesses in the hospitality and tourism domain. This study seeks to bridge this gap, with an emphasis on the pivotal external resources startups tap into for growth, an area also underexplored in general management research. The study presents the "Startup Ecosystem Resource Reservoir" (SERR) framework. In this model, resources are categorized based on accessibility: some are endowed to startups, while others require strategic efforts for exploitation. This categorization gives a holistic view of the resource environment, shedding light on the dynamic relationship between startups and their surroundings. This research employs a mixed-method approach comprising four studies to validate the SERR model within the hospitality industry and to examine the competition among startups for both endowed and exploited resources. Initial inquiries involve structured interviews with startup players in the Great Bay Area, complemented by a quantitative analysis of global SERRs hosting successful hospitality startups. A focal point of this quantitative study is the comparative resource landscape pre and post-COVID-19, using a quasi-experimental design. Subsequent studies investigate how startups obtain ecosystem resources. For endowed resources, a simulation will analyze the strategic games startups play for financing, while for exploited resources, a panel data model will explore benefits from knowledge spillovers and co-location strategies. Beyond academia, this research has far-reaching implications. Entrepreneurs and investors gain a strategic roadmap for resource utilization, informing decisions on market entry and expansion. Established hospitality businesses can derive insights into startup strategies, informing their competitive stances. Policymakers benefit by understanding the SERR's vital external resources, guiding them to create policies promoting a favorable startup ecosystem, especially in potential innovation hubs like the Great Bay Area. 在动态的酒店业格局中，像Airbnb这样的初创公司引入了颠覆性的创新，挑战了传统规范。尽管它们备受关注，但针对这些新兴业务在酒店和旅游领域中的关键成功因素的研究却相对有限。本研究旨在弥补这一空白，重点关注初创公司为增长而利用的关键外部资源，这是一般管理研究中也未深入探讨的领域。 本研究提出了“初创生态系统资源库”（SERR）框架。在该模型中，资源根据可获取性进行分类：有些资源是赋予初创公司的，而另一些则需要通过战略努力进行开发。这种分类提供了资源环境的全貌，揭示了初创公司与其环境之间的动态关系。 本研究采用混合方法，包含四项研究，以验证SERR模型在酒店行业中的有效性，并考察初创公司在获取赋予和开发资源方面的竞争。初步调查包括对大湾区初创公司参与者的结构化访谈，并辅以对全球SERR中成功的酒店初创公司的定量分析。本定量研究的焦点是使用准实验设计比较COVID-19之前和之后的资源环境。后续研究探讨了初创公司如何获得生态系统资源。对于赋予资源，将通过模拟分析初创公司在融资方面的战略博弈；对于开发资源，将通过面板数据模型探讨知识溢出和共址策略的收益。 本研究不仅在学术界具有深远影响。企业家和投资者可以获得有关资源利用的战略路线图，帮助决策市场进入和扩展。已建立的酒店企业可以从初创公司的策略中获得见解，调整其竞争立场。政策制定者通过理解SERR中的关键外部资源，可以制定促进有利初创生态系统的政策，特别是在大湾区等潜在创新中心。

25506924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25506924.value: 香港作为教育目的地：国际学生的旅行体验作为信息传递工具

25506924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25506924.value: The proposed research focuses on the nexus of travel experiences and the actual or digital word of mouth of the international students at Hong Kong top universities, in the context of internationalization of universities. Top universities have been competing for years to attract the most talented students from across the globe. However, simply enticing international students to enroll in their degree programs can hardly be considered an end goal. Without a doubt, the key factor associated with university/destination choice for the most qualified students is the quality of education. Meanwhile, international students are additionally likely to seek a package of experiences that extends beyond their academic focus. The overall travel experience is critical for long-term student satisfaction. Yet, there is no concrete criterion in the major global university rankings that is associated with international students’ living experiences in host countries. Messages delivered by current international students enrolled at universities in Hong Kong are likely to significantly influence decisions made by their acquaintances as well as social media users exposed to them. Their recommendations allow potential international students to make their education decisions based on trustworthy opinions expressed by those with actual prior experiences. Therefore, leveraging current international students from local universities as informants makes the project executable and of practical relevance. To delve deep into the satisfaction of current international students in Hong Kong, the study investigates the following via qualitative and quantitative approaches: the decision-making process they went through before beginning their studies in Hong Kong, their perceptions about their overall experiences in Hong Kong, whether their expectations were fulfilled, and if their overall satisfaction level with Hong Kong as an education destination is positive or negative. Thereby this study will on the one hand, evaluate the message they may deliver to potential (international) applicants and on the other hand, develop the underlying foundation of “education destination competitiveness index” to gauge their overall satisfaction. If Hong Kong, as an education destination, succeeds in exceeding the expectations of international students, its education system will significantly benefit from its corpse of alumni as lifelong intuitive ambassadors worldwide (without the title or the certificate of being an ambassador). Eventually, the results can contribute to combating brain drain as well since when satisfied with their student lives, many are likely to choose Hong Kong as their second home.

25509324.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25509324.value: 人工智能面試官與人類面試官下的應聘者應對策略研究

25509324.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25509324.value: Asynchronous video interviews (AVIs) are becoming a popular tool among companies seeking to broaden their candidate pool. However, to improve accuracy and efficiency in screening large numbers of candidates while saving on human resources, companies may need to contemplate the use of artificial intelligence (AI) agents to evaluate recorded responses instead of human agents. Prior research on organizational justice, signaling theories, and algorithmic aversion suggests that applicants may respond negatively to AI judgment, perceiving it as unfair and less acceptable. These studies often portray applicants as passive participants with limited influence over the AVIs. Yet, recent anecdotal evidence indicates that some applicants might strategically adapt their responses to exploit the inherent vulnerabilities in how AI systems operate. Unfortunately, most previous studies fall short in addressing why applicants might be more prone to strategically create an inaccurate portrayal of their abilities and personality when faced with AI agents (compared to human agents), potentially undermining companies’ initiatives of enhancing accuracy and reducing costs with this innovative screening method. Therefore, my goal in this proposal is to expand the current understanding of applicants' strategic adaptations from traditional interviews to AVIs, examining why their adaptive responses to AI agent judgments differ from those to human agent judgments. I draw from the similarity contingency model to propose that applicants evaluated by AI agents are more likely to resort to algorithmic exploitative tactics, including keyword stuffing, the use of competence-specific words, and the exaggeration of achievements and qualifications. I also explore how individual differences in the lay beliefs about the inferiority of algorithms might amplify the impact on the use of these algorithmic exploitative tactics. I plan to test these hypotheses over the course of a scenario-based pilot experiment (Study 1) and a mock interview experiment (Study 2). 隨著視頻面試在招聘領域的廣泛應用，越來越多公司開始採用異步視頻面試(AVIs)的方式。這種方式能幫助企業接觸到更廣泛的候選人群。然而，為了提高篩選的準確性和效率，同時減少人力投入，公司也考慮使用人工智能(AI)系統代替人類面試官來評估應聘者的錄制視頻。以往的研究表明，應聘者可能會對AI面試官產生負面反應，認為這種方式不公平且難以接受。這些研究往往將應聘者描述為被動參與者。但最近出現的一些實際案例顯示，有些應聘者可能會利用AI系統的內在弱點，採取策略性方法來應對AI面試官。遺憾的是，以往大部分研究無法解釋為什麼應聘者在面對AI面試官時，更容易採取策略性地誇大自己的能力和性格，從而導致企業招聘準確性和降低成本的目標未能實現。因此，本研究旨在深入理解應聘者從傳統面試轉向AVIs時的策略性適應行為，探討他們對AI面試官和人類面試官的反應有何不同。我將借鑒相似性依賴模型，提出面對AI面試官的應聘者可能會採取算法利用策略，如堆砌關鍵詞、使用特定於能力的詞彙，以及誇大自己的成就和資格。我還將探討個人對算法缺陷的看法如何放大這些算法利用策略的使用。我計劃通過一個基於場景的試驗研究(研究1)和一個模擬面試實驗(研究2)來驗證這些假設。

25509624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25509624.value: 消費者對服裝廢料回收的意識和實踐調查：香港服裝廢料回收的挑戰和個案研究

25509624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25509624.value: 消費者舊衣垃圾是一個嚴重的全球性問題。每年有超過9200萬噸的舊衣被棄置於垃圾填埋區。由於衣服需要很長的時間分解, 這產生溫室氣體排放, 以及土壤和水污染, 導致環境惡化。雖然約90%的服裝廢料都是可重複使用和可回收的, 但實際上少於一半的舊衣會被收集用於重複使用或回收。當中僅有1%被轉化為新衣服。這反映有迫切需要提高回收率以改善舊衣垃圾問題。然而, 提高回收率需要消費者在購買服裝、重複使用和回收方面的態度作出改變。因此, 這項研究旨在解決提高消費者舊衣回收效率及了解當中所面臨的挑戰和考量。 消費者在決定如何處理舊衣垃圾時可以先透過重複使用和回收來延長衣服的使用壽命, 從而減低對環境的影響。儘管許多消費者對環境保護持積極態度, 但研究發現他們仍不願改變固有的丟棄舊衣習慣。這種態度/行為偏差導致了很低的舊衣回收率, 從而加劇了垃圾棄置問題。然而, 儘管有大量研究探討消費者對各種舊衣處理方式的動機和態度, 但很少有研究探討消費者對回收選擇的認知、了解和實踐 。這些都窒礙更多的舊衣回收參與。由於衣服包含多種材料、多層結構, 和各種配件, 使得衣服回收更加複雜。因此需要更多了解適當的舊衣分類和分類過程, 以便實踐。解決舊衣垃圾回收至關重要, 以緩解舊衣垃圾棄置問題, 並減少最終被棄置於垃圾填埋區的舊衣垃圾。 因此,這項研究將和一所香港可持續時尚慈善機構Redress合作進行。項目旨在探討消費者對舊衣垃圾回收的認知、了解和實踐。儘管Redress每年都和超過120所學校和公司舉辦舊衣回收活動, 但由於公眾參與度低和回收基礎設施不足, 當中約40%收集的舊衣仍未得到利用。本研究將通過問卷調查、回收衣服材料分析,以及與相關業內人仕方進行訪談, 旨在了解消費者的舊衣垃圾回收偏好和挑戰。研究收集的數據分析和結果將有助於制定有效提高舊衣垃圾回收的措施,從而促進香港及其他地區時尚產業的可持續性和循環發展。

25510224.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25510224.value: 新员工知识分享行为、同事归因、及其对于新人职业发展的影响

25510224.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25510224.value: 新員工常常被稱爲組織的“新鮮血液”。組織與管理者們視他們爲新知識的關鍵來源之一，期待他們主動與現有員工分享獨特的知識。然而，儘管員工知識分享對組織的創新和績效有積極影響，但關於新員工主動與同事分享知識如何影響他們自身的入職體驗和職業成功的研究卻知之甚少。這是一個重要的疏漏，原因有二。首先，已有研究表明現有員工（即新員工同事）在新員工融入過程中會産生非常關鍵的影響。在知識分享場景中，作爲知識接收者，同事如何解讀和回應這些行爲將極大地影響新人融入團隊的過程。其次，如果沒有對於新員工主動知識分享時所可能麵臨的挑戰的全麵理解，從短期來看新員工將難以渡過這一過程，從長期來看組織也難以激勵這種努力。 本研究旨在回答三個關鍵問題：（a）同事如何看待新員工主動的知識分享，並會如何反應？（b）新員工主動與同事分享知識是否有助於他們的職業成功？（c）新員工可以採取哪些策略來避免潛在的不利影響？爲了解決這些問題，我提出，儘管主動的知識分享展示了新員工希望爲團隊其他成員帶來好處的善意，但是新員工的低團隊地位也使這種行爲看起來像是爭取更高地位的嚐試。因此，同事可能會同時將新員工主動的知識分享歸因於他們的利他動機以及爭取高地位的動機。隨後，這種歸因會影響同事在多大程度上願意接納新員工並與他們分享自己的見解，最終影響新人的職業成功。我的理論模型進一步建議，如果新員工在知識分享的同時表現出謙遜，他們的知識分享行爲更可能被視爲受利他動機驅動，從而更有利於新員工的職業成功。

25511924.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25511924.value: 搜索優秀的企業戰略：社區邏輯如何影響企業社會績效與外部CEO接任的關係

25511924.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25511924.value: The proposed research project aims to improve our understanding of the process underlying how institutional logics influence organizational actions by shedding light on corporate governance—especially, the decision of the board of directors about whether to hire a new CEO from inside versus outside an organization. We propose outsider CEO succession as an important corporate governance mechanism by which the board of directors makes a discontinuous change in corporate objectives and strategies. Institutional logics facilitate the board’s decision about CEO selection by providing cognitive heuristics with which the board can evaluate current top management teams’ leadership and by offering normative grounds whereby the board of directors can justify its CEO selection decisions. Using data on the U.S. Fortune 500 companies during the period of 2010-2019, we examine this mechanism in the context of corporate social responsibility (CSR). CSR initiatives represent a stakeholder logic, which has recently risen undermining the prominence of a shareholder logic. Given that a stakeholder logic is relatively new and has not firmly entrenched in the business field, one can expect community-level variations in the degree to which a stakeholder logic and its related CSR initiatives are embraced and espoused. Therefore, the present study will examine how community-level logics moderate the relationship between CSR and outsider CEO succession. And we consider two types of communities: geographic communities and industrial communities. We propose four hypotheses. The first hypothesis is that poor CSR performance increases the likelihood of outsider CEO succession. With the rise of stakeholder logic, firms are expected to satisfy a variety of stakeholders and show good CSR performance. A deviation from this expectation will lead the board to doubt the CEO’s leadership quality and to hire an outsider CEO as a measure to make a firms’ strategies and practices aligned with such expectations from the audience. Second, the relationship between poor CSR performance and outsider CEO succession will be strengthened when geographic or industrial communities impose greater pressures for corporate stakeholder orientation. Third and fourth hypotheses concern post-succession CSR performance. Firms with new outsider CEOs are more likely to engage in CSR compared to firms with new insider CEOs. This tendency will be more pronounced in geographic or industrial communities with greater expectations for corporate stakeholder orientation. 這個研究項目旨在加深我們對制度邏輯如何影響組織行為的理解，特別關注企業治理 - 董事會是否選擇從內部或外部聘任新CEO。我們提出,外部CEO接任是董事會實現企業目標和戰略重大轉變的一個重要治理機制。制度邏輯通過為董事會提供評估現有高管領導力的認知啓發，以及為董事會CEO選擇決策提供規範性依據，促進了董事會的決策過程。 我們將使用2010-2019年間美國Fortune 500強企業的數據，在企業社會責任(CSR)的背景下探討這一機制。CSR倡議代表了一種利益相關方邏輯，最近崛起並削弱了股東至上邏輯的地位。由於利益相關方邏輯較新且在商業領域尚未根深蒂固，我們可以預期不同社區在接受和倡導該邏輯及相關CSR舉措方面存在差異。因此，本研究將考察社區層面的邏輯如何調節CSR與外部CEO接任之間的關係，包括地理社區和行業社區兩種類型。 我們提出四個假設:1) 較差的CSR業績會增加外部CEO接任的可能性。隨著利益相關方邏輯的興起，企業被期望滿足各利益相關方並展現良好的CSR業績。偏離這一預期會令董事會質疑CEO的領導能力，從而選擇外部CEO以使企業策略與實踐與社會期望相符。2) 當地理或行業社區對企業利益相關方導向施加更大壓力時，較差的CSR業績與外部CEO接任的關係會更加強化。3-4) 相比內部CEO接任，外部CEO接任後企業更可能展開CSR活動，這種傾向在對企業利益相關方導向有更大期望的地理或行業社區中會更加明顯。

25512124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25512124.value: 培养销售还是销售员？销售线索的分配

25512124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25512124.value: In many industries, firms encounter a substantial volume of potential sales leads. Their objective is to transform these potential leads into actual customers - a conversion process that requires careful assignment of leads to salespeople. This study explores the process of sales lead assignment and aims to understand how firms balance immediate sales growth with the long-term development of salespeople's skills. Using data from Beike, a leading real estate agency in China's housing market, the investigation will analyze how lead assignment, in terms of quantity and quality, relates to the varying abilities of salespeople, and its impact on sales success and skill accumulation. I will develop a structural model of both housing demand and salespeople's skill accumulation and explore the impact of lead assignment. Additionally, the study seeks to identify alternative assignment strategies that could simultaneously boost sales performance and foster skill development among salespeople. 在許多行業中，公司都會遇到大量的潛在銷售線索。他們的目標是將這些潛在銷售線索轉化為實際客戶——這個轉換過程需要仔細地將銷售線索分配給銷售人員。本研究探討了銷售線索分配的過程，旨在了解公司如何平衡即時銷售成長與銷售人員技能的長期發展。調查利用中國房地產市場領先的房地產仲介公司北科的數據， 分析潛在客戶分配在數量和品質方面與銷售人員不同能力的關係，及其對銷售成功和技能累積的影響。我將發展一個住房需求和銷售人員技能累積的結構模型，並探討領導分配的影響。此外，該研究還試圖找出可同時提高銷售績效並促進銷售人員技能發展的替代分配策略。

25514824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25514824.value: 了解环境相关态度与行为之间的差距及其影响因素

25514824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25514824.value: Behavioral change is increasingly recognized as a pivotal countermeasure against climate change. However, the mere presence of positive attitudes towards climate preservation doesn't necessarily translate into sustainable lifestyle choices achieving sustainability. Despite heightened awareness, the shift towards food consumption practices more sustainably remains elusive. While theoretical discussions have highlighted potential barriers causing this discrepancy between environmental attitudes and sustainable actions, empirical evidence quantifying this gap remains scant. This project will endeavor to ascertain both the existence and magnitude of the discrepancy between environmental attitudes and actions, to investigate variations of this discrepancy across different demographics, and to explore underlying factors that might influence this gap. Our approach harnesses a unique dataset detailing household-level carbon emissions from total food purchases of over 80,000 U.S. households from 2018 to 2021. This is complemented by a comprehensive national survey that probes attitudes towards climate change, encompassing beliefs, risk perceptions, and policy support across 3,147 U.S. counties from 2018 to 2021. By offering a holistic perspective on the relationship between climate-related attitudes towards and actual behaviors, this study aims to provide significant contributions to discussions on sustainability and pro-environmental behaviors. It seeks to furnish insights beneficial to marketers, policymakers, and the general public, all committed to advancing sustainable consumption and advocating eco-friendly actions. The subsequent sections of this proposal delve deeper into the research background, posed queries, literary contributions, and employed methodologies. 行为改变越来越被认为是应对气候变化的关键措施。然而，仅仅拥有积极的环境保护态度并不一定能转化为实际的, 可持续生活方式。虽然人们对气候变化的意识已经提高，但在日常食品购买上做出更环保的选择仍然很困难。学术界已经指出了可能导致环保态度与实际行动之间不一致的潜在原因， 但仍然缺少具体的实证分析。这个项目将旨在了解环保态度和实际行动之间的差距，并探讨这种差距的大小和在不同人群中的变化，同时了解影响这种差距的潜在因素。我们将利用一个独特的数据集，数据集中记录了2018至2021年间80,000多户美国家庭的食品碳排放数据。我们还将结合一项全国性调查，研究2018至2021年间3,147个美国县对气候变化的态度，包括人们的环保理念、风险感知和对相关政策的支持。 通过提供关于气候态度与实际行为之间关系的全面视角，本研究旨在对可持续性和环保行为的讨论做出重要贡献。同时，研究结果将为市场营销人员、政策制定者和公众提供有价值的见解，帮助他们推动可持续消费和环保行动。提案的后续部分将深入讨论研究背景、提出的问题、相关文献和研究方法。

25600624.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25600624.value: 針對基於區塊鏈的眾包平台之對抗性韌性研究

25600624.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25600624.value: 在Web 2.0領域的平台和Web 3.0的去中心化自治組織（DAOs）已經展示了眾包商業模式的強大潛力。新興的基於區塊鏈的眾包系統作為一種強健的機制，促進了這些平台之間的合作，展現出數位領域中眾包力量的進化和融合。然而，目前的系統大多依賴過時的任務分配策略，無法有效辨識並對抗惡意行為者，這無意中危及了任務分配的完整性。此外，這些系統在用戶數據保護方面存在嚴重缺陷，容易受到非法活動的威脅，包括電信詐騙和勒索。同時，這些平台的有限吞吐量也使其容易受到惡意攻擊，交易量的激增可能輕易超過系統的處理能力。 鑑於這些挑戰，我們的項目旨在提高基於區塊鏈的眾包系統的吞吐量、加強對抗惡意行為者的防禦，並維護區塊鏈的完整性。我們的研究將聚焦於以下幾個關鍵領域： 重新定義任務分配：我們將設計一種能有效評估用戶可信度的對抗性任務分配機制，防止惡意行為者以低成本操控其聲譽。並將探索創新的聲譽感知算法，以優化任務分配和提升系統效益。 強化隱私保護：我們認識到用戶數據保護的重要性，將引入一種方案，隱藏用戶的主要身份，同時保證其行動可追蹤。通過應用零知識證明和環簽名等加密技術，確保用戶資料符合任務要求且不洩露其身份。我們也將研究如何確保用戶假名不可追蹤或鏈接，以抵禦惡意攻擊。 優化區塊鏈架構：我們將設計高效的混合區塊鏈系統，強調高吞吐量，並確保多個集群中分佈的授權節點之間的協調和容錯性。我們還將探討用戶如何創建個人化的鏈下網絡以進行即時交易。 我們的目標是通過應對基於區塊鏈的眾包系統的現有挑戰，促進其轉型，創造更安全、高效且以用戶為導向的系統。本項目不僅基於研究團隊的豐富經驗，特別是在與香港特區政府機電工程署（EMSD）的合作中積累的實踐經驗，也旨在為產業提供切實可行的解決方案，並鞏固一個強有力的理論基礎。

25601424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25601424.value: 晚年生活事件對違法軌跡的影響：混合質性研究

25601424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25601424.value: With the global aging population, the percentage of older criminal offenders is increasing, including in Hong Kong. However, most domestic criminological studies and rehabilitation programs focus on younger people. Whether current theorization of criminal behavior and rehabilitation programs adequately reflect and address the needs of older offenders remains unclear. Strategies that reduce the seriousness and quantity of their criminal behaviors and ultimately encourage their desistance are also urgently needed. This study addresses this gap by examining the criminal behaviors of adults transitioning into young-old and middle-old. This study adopts the age-graded theory of informal social control (age-graded theory) and insights from aging studies as the conceptual framework. The age-graded theory has been widely used to explain how positive or negative age-graded life events, such as marriage and employment versus divorce and unemployment, could lead to an increase or decrease in informal social control, thereby affecting the criminal trajectories - whether they start, change in the seriousness and quantity of, or stop criminal behaviours. Current studies focus mainly on younger individuals in a non-Chinese context. However, aging studies indicate that older adults could experience life events very differently from younger ones. By incorporating these insights from aging studies on later life events, this study examines (1) different criminal trajectories of older offenders in Hong Kong, (2) how these trajectories are affected by later life events (defined as life events that happen throughout the process of aging), and (3) how (1) and (2) are affected by the macro social and policy contexts in Hong Kong. A topical life history approach with two methods will be used for data collection: (1) ethnography in locations like parks, tunnels, and streets where older street offenders openly commit crimes, and (2) in-depth interviews with 80 offenders aged between 50 and 75 years (with 40 transitioning into young-old and another 40 into middle-old). Finally, to enhance the trustworthiness and vigor of this study, life diagrams, photo elicitation, and member validation will be used to facilitate data collection and analysis. This project will be the first to focus on older offenders in the Hong Kong context. The theoretical significance of this study lies in enriching the age-graded theory by widening its investigation to offenders transitioning into older age beyond the Western context. Finally, this understanding will inform frontline offender rehabilitation practitioners in governmental organizations and NGOs regarding the development of strategies that encourage positive changes among older offenders. 隨著全球人口老齡化，老年犯罪者的比例正在上升，香港也不例外。然而，大部分本地犯罪學研究和康復計劃都集中於年輕人。這意味著現有的犯罪行為理論和康復計劃不一定能充分反映和滿足老年犯罪者的需求。社會急需可行的方法來減少這些老年犯罪者的犯罪行為，並最終鼓勵他們終止犯罪。 為了填補這一研究空白，本項目研究中老年人在年齡增長過程中的犯罪行為。本項目結合“非正式社會控制的年齡分層理論”（age-graded theory）和現有老齡研究的成果作為概念框架。這一理論被廣泛用於解釋各種年齡分層生活事件（例如婚姻和就業 vs 離婚和失業）如何導致非正式社會控制的增加或減少，從而影響犯罪軌跡（開始犯罪、增加或減少犯罪行為的嚴重性和數量，或是終止犯罪）。 現有相關研究主要集中在非華人背景的年輕人身上。然而，老齡研究表明，老年人與年輕人對於生活事件有截然不同的體驗。 通過融入老齡研究中關於晚期生活事件的研究成果，本項目將探討：(1) 香港老年犯罪者的不同犯罪軌跡，(2) 這些軌跡如何受到晚期生活事件（定義為整個老齡化過程中發生的生活事件）的影響，以及 (3) (1) 和 (2) 如何受到香港宏觀社會和政策背景的影響。 本研究將採用主題性生活史方法中的兩種數據收集方法：(1) 在公園、隧道和街道等老年街頭罪犯公開犯罪的地點進行民族誌觀察，(2) 對50-75歲的80名犯罪者進行深入訪談。 最後，為提高研究的可信度和嚴謹性，我們將使用生活圖、照片引導和成員驗證等方法來促進數據收集和分析。這個項目是香港首個專注於老年犯罪者研究的計劃。其理論意義在於通過將年齡分層理論的研究範圍擴展至西方以外的老年犯罪者，從而豐富該理論。最終，這項研究的成果將為政府和非政府組織的前線康復工作者提供參考，幫助他們更好地制定鼓勵老年犯罪者實現積極變化的策略。

25605524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25605524.value: 近代全球航運技術變革與川江基礎設施轉型

25605524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25605524.value: From the 1870s to the 1930s, steam navigation developed on the Upper Yangzi River, which had long been formidable because of its rapids, rocky obstructions, and turbulent variations. Existing scholarship has examined several aspects of this important transformation, such as the global expansion of steam technology and intensified contestations over the inland penetration of global trade. However, one important dimension of this hydro-technic transformation has rarely been analyzed: transformations of the infrastructures along the Upper Yangzi River that undergirded the daily operation of steam navigation and, more broadly, the much more expanded global economy in the early twentieth century. This project offers the first integrated history about the infrastructural remaking of the Upper Yangzi River against the backdrop of global steam revolution. Synthesizing new archival and fieldwork materials, this project asks how the relations among humans, technical constructions, and natural environments along the Upper Yangzi River were reorganized to sustain the steam shipping networks in this peculiar inland waterscape. This project emphasizes that it is important to recognize the ecological, technical, and social complexities on the ground for fully explaining the intensification of global connectivity and the integration of global economy during the modern period. This project employs “infrastructural remaking” as the central framework to analyze the transformation of the Upper Yangzi River during the steam century. By foregrounding “infrastructural remaking,” this project attends to how new practices propel the reorganization of the relations among humans and natural conditions (e.g., currents), technical constructions (e.g., signal station), and other non-human elements in a situated environment. The PI will employ this framework to produce two articles in reputed journals in Asian Studies and History of Science, Technology, and Environment. The first article is about the synthesis of knowledge of “rapids” and the reconstruction of rapids as the nexuses of measurement, navigation, and communication infrastructures in the Upper Yangzi River. The second one investigates how the environmental complexities of the Upper Yangzi River reshaped international regulations and infrastructures that were established to enforce maritime navigation security in the early twentieth century. This project will also generate an exhibition about the multifaceted exchanges of knowledge during the active infrastructural remaking of the Upper Yangzi River, along with public lectures and forums. By delivering findings through diverse formats, this project aims to initiate timely academic and public conversations on the relations among infrastructures, environments, community-based knowledge, and socio-economic sustainability.

25616024.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25616024.value: 声调适应的神经相关性研究：以粤语和英语口音的普通话言语为例

25616024.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25616024.value: Understanding how listeners adapt to accented speech is a key question in research on spoken language comprehension. One often overlooked feature of accented speech is so-called bad maps, when a second language (L2) speaker regularly swaps one L2 sound for another. For instance, in a tonal language, an L2 speaker might produce a high tone instead of a falling tone. Bad maps are theoretically important because they require that listeners adapt their expectations to better comprehend L2 speech. They are practically important because they reflect typical characteristics of natural L2 speech. The present study leverages existing patterns in L2 Mandarin to investigate whether and how native listeners adapt to different types of bad maps. Bad maps exist on a continuum from highly consistent to highly inconsistent. Native Cantonese speakers who learn Mandarin often swap the falling Mandarin tone with the high tone. In contrast, native English speakers who learn Mandarin often produce bad maps that have no obvious patterns, with any tone replacing any other tone. With sufficient experience, listeners should be able to adapt to consistent bad maps by adjusting their expectations about the tones an L2 speaker will produce. It is less certain that listeners can adapt to inconsistent bad maps. Using the event-related potential technique, I will conduct three experiments measuring native Mandarin listeners’ neural responses as they experience different patterns of bad maps in L2 Mandarin speech. The experiments use an exposure-test paradigm. In the first experiment, during exposure trials, listeners gain experience with the different patterns of tonal consistency of two Cantonese-accented speakers. One speaker is fully accurate; the other produces consistent falling-to-high tonal bad maps (nàozhōng ‘alarm clock’ produced as nonword nāozhōng). During test trials, which are surreptitiously interspersed among exposure trials, both L2 speakers produce the same proportion of words with correct tones and falling-as-high bad maps. By comparing neural responses (N400s, LPCs) during test trials, we can determine whether and how listeners adapted their expectations to each speaker’s pattern of bad maps. A second experiment contrasts English-accented L2 Mandarin speakers producing consistent/inconsistent bad maps. A third experiment contrasts groups of listeners with more/less previous experience with L2 Mandarin speech. This project contributes to speech comprehension research by focusing on bad maps, utilizing neurophysiological methods in an adaptive context, and extending accent research to tonal languages. It also has pedagogical implications. 了解听者如何适应带有口音的言语是口语理解研究中的一个关键问题。其中，错误映射(“bad maps”) 作为一个口音特征至今很少被虑到。错误映射指的是二语者经常会混淆二语中的语音。例如，在声调语言中，二语可能会用高平的一声代替降调。错误映射有重要理论意义，因为它要求听者调整他们的预期以更好理解二语口语。它也有重要实践价值，因为它反映了自然二语的典型特征。本研究利用现有的二语普通话模式，探讨普通话为母语的听众是否以及如何适应不同类型的错误映射。 错误映射是一个从高度一致到高度不一致的连续统。粤语为母语者经常将普通话的第四声与第一声互换。相比之下，英语为母语者的错误映射大都没有明显模式，任何声调都可能被其它声调替换。我们假设：经验足够的话，听众应该能够通过调整他们对二语说话者产生的声调的期望来适应一致的错误映射。但对于不一致的错误映射，听众不一定能适应。 利用事件相关电位（ERP）技术，本研究将进行三个实验，测量母语为普通话的听众在对于二语普通话言语中不同错误映射模式的神经反应。这些实验使用暴露-测试范式。在实验一中，在暴露试验期间，听众会体验两位带粤语口音说话者声调一致性的不同模式。一位说话者完全准确；另一位产生一致的四声到一声的错误映射。例如，nàozhōng（闹钟）对应的错误映射是nāozhōng （假词）。测试试验会在不告知被试的情况下嵌入在暴露试验中。测试实验中，两位L2说话者产生相同比例的带有正确声调和一声到四声错误映射的词。通过比较测试试验期间的神经反应（N400s，LPCs），我们可以确定听众是否以及如何适应每位说话者的错误映射模式。实验二将对比一致的和不一致的错误映射，所有材料均由英语为母语、普通话为二语的被试产出。实验三则会对比两组二语普通话言语经验不同的听众群体。 项目通过关注错误映射、在自适应环境中利用神经生理学方法，将口音研究扩展到声调语言，将为言语理解研究做出理论和教学法上的贡献。

26103524.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26103524.value: 動態環境變化下的細菌細胞命運調控

26103524.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26103524.value: Bacteria living in their natural habitats routinely face environmental fluctuations that are different from standard lab growth conditions. Transitioning between alternative cellular states is an effective strategy to contend with environmental variations and uncertainties without resorting to genetic changes. For many bacterial species, we have a qualitative understanding of the genes and proteins involved in these transitions, but are uncertain about how they collectively shape the timing, scope and reversibility of these events, especially in the presence of external fluctuations. Given that cell-fate transitions are key to environmental adaptations for bacteria, especially in isogenic populations, it is only fitting that their physiological relevance and mechanisms are investigated in the context of dynamically changing environments. However, undertaking this task has traditionally been challenging for several reasons. First, bacterial cell-fate transitions are often transitory and rare, which necessitates sensitive single-cell solutions that work reliably over extended periods of time. Second, controlling the extracellular environment in a precise and automated manner requires specialized instruments. Third, mechanistic dissections of cell-fate transitions are often conceptually difficult since they are triggered by the combined actions of multiple biochemical processes. How these processes work in concert to enable cell-fate transitions, despite the fact that their individual reaction kinetics are susceptible to external perturbations, can be unintuitive to grasp. This proposal takes a systems biology approach to investigate bacterial cell-fate transitions under changing conditions, focusing on the roles of gene regulatory networks (GRNs) and the dynamical properties they enable. Using stress response GRNs in Bacillus subtilis as model systems, I seek to understand how temporal variations of the external world are modulated and relayed by GRNs to influence downstream cellular decision-making. Each proposed project thus serves a dual purpose: to unveil previously concealed strategies bacteria use to adapt to changing environments, and to characterize the information-processing capabilities of the underlying GRNs. Consequently, the implications of the findings from the proposed studies are two-fold. First, given that cell-fate transitions are so widely adopted among bacterial species, and are the primary means by which a clonal population optimizes growth, develops phenotypic diversity and acquires stress tolerance, a quantitative understanding of their regulations under non-constant conditions will inspire novel strategies to control bacterial growth in biomedical and industrial settings. Second, by elucidating the functions of GRNs in the context of dynamical information processing, it will shed light on their design principles that can be leveraged to improve synthetic gene circuit design. 生活在自然環境中的細菌經常面臨不同於標準實驗室的培養條件和環境波動。細胞狀態之間的轉換是一種有效的、且無需依賴改變基因來應對外界環境變化和不確定性的策略。對於許多細菌物種，我們已經對參與這些轉換的基因和蛋白質有了定性的理解，但對它們如何共同影響細胞狀態切換的時間、範圍和可逆性，尤其是在外部環境波動的情況下，仍然不甚瞭解。鑑於細胞命運轉換是細菌，尤其是同基因菌落（isogenic community）裡的細菌適應環境的關鍵，在動態變化環境中研究細胞命運調控的生理意義和機制是十分必要的。然而，由於若干原因，使用傳統手段對其研究一直具有挑戰性。首先，細菌的細胞命運轉換通常是短暫且罕見的，這需要靈敏的、能長時間可靠工作的單細胞分析平台。其次，以精確和自動化的方式控制細胞外部環境時常要依賴於特別定製的儀器。第三，細胞命運轉換的機制和原理通常難以用簡單的概念來解釋和歸納，因爲它們是由多種生化過程的共同作用所引發的。例如，儘管單個生化反應的反應動力學容易受到外部環境變化的干擾，但作為一個整體的生化反應網絡，它們如何免受外界干擾協同工作以實現細胞命運轉換往往難以用定性的描述來解釋。本提案採用系統生物學的方法，定量研究細菌在變化條件下的細胞命運轉換，其重點關注在基因調控網絡（GRNs）及其所賦予的動態特性。以枯草芽孢桿菌中的應激反應基因調控網絡爲模型系統，我旨在瞭解外部環境的動態變化如何通過基因調控網絡進行調製並傳遞，以影響下游的細胞決策。這個提議的每個項目都有雙重目的：揭示細菌在適應環境變化時使用的、尚未被發現的策略，以及闡明相關過程所依賴的基因調控網絡的信息處理能力。因此，這項研究帶來的新發現的影響也是雙重的。首先，鑑於細胞命運轉換在各類細菌中如此廣泛採用，並且是同基因菌落群體優化生長、發展表型多樣性（phenotypic diversity）和獲得應激耐受性的主要手段，對其在非恆定條件下的調控進行定量理解，將激發在醫療和工業環境裡控制細菌生長的新策略。其次，通過闡明基因調控網絡在動態信息處理中的功能，將有助於理解其設計原理，並可用於改進現有的合成基因迴路（synthetic genetic circuits）。

26104824.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26104824.value: 性信息素的水平基因轉移的久遠起源：一個感官利用的例子？

26104824.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26104824.value: Mating signals are very important in species-species interactions, especially in the aquatic environment. Sex pheromones are chemical compounds used as mating signals to attract the other members of the same species. To efficiently convey the signal, sex pheromones should be highly specific. However, being directly linked to reproductive isolation—the diversity of life, sex pheromones are predicted to be fast-evolving. Indeed, tremendous pheromone diversity has been recorded, revealing an important conundrum: how can a system with a strong stabilizing selection have such a high diversity? One leading model implies that pheromones evolve by “saltational” shifts. Some examples of the “saltational” shifts have shown to involve novel genes. Lateral gene transfer (LGT) may possibly be a novel genetic source for such shifts. In the mollusc Aplysia californica, the temptin protein has been shown to be an essential component of sex pheromone blend. Surprisingly, this gene has an unexpected patchy distribution in the tree of life: within the Metazoa, this gene is only found in spiralians and Placozoa. In addition, this gene is found in some single-cell eukaryotic microorganisms such as algae. The phylogenetic and molecular evolution analysis from our preliminary study strongly support that the spiralian temptin gene has an origin of LGT. Since algae (LGT donor) is a plausible food for spiralians (LGT recipient), we hypothesize that temptin could be an example of sensory exploitation: the spiralian recruited temptin gene and transformed this pre-existing food cue into its own sex pheromone. 交配信號在物種間的相互作用中非常重要，尤其是在水生環境中。性信息素是用作交配信號的化學化合物，用於吸引同物種的其他成員。爲了有效傳遞信號，性信息素應該具有高度特異性。然而，因爲性信息素與生殖隔離-生物多樣性直接相關，使得性信息素被預測爲快速進化。確實，目前已記錄了巨大的信息素多樣性，這揭示了一個重要的難題：在受強穩定自然選擇的系統中，如何能保持如此高的多樣性？一個主要模型表明，信息素通過“跳躍性”變化進化。一些“跳躍性”變化的例子涉及新基因。橫向基因轉移（LGT）可能是新基因的來源。在軟體動物加州海兔（Aplysia californica）中，temptin蛋白被証明是性信息素混合物的一個重要組成部分。有趣的是，這個基因在生命樹中具有意想不到的分散化分佈：在後生動物中，這個基因僅在冠輪動物超門和扁盤動物門中發現。此外，這個基因還存在於一些單細胞真核微生物中，如藻類。我們初步研究的系統發育和分子進化分析強烈支持冠輪動物的temptin基因來源於LGT。由於藻類（LGT供體）是冠輪動物超門（LGT接受者）的食物，我們假設temptin可能是感官利用的一個例子：冠輪動物通過LGT獲得了temptin基因，並將這一預先存在的食物吸引轉化爲其自身的性信息素。

26200124.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26200124.value: 熱帶氣旋風暴潮風險評估 – 快速，誤差校準，量化不確定性的數字範式

26200124.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26200124.value: Tropical cyclones (TC) have caused significant financial losses and jeopardized the lives of millions of people who live along the world's coastlines. With rising coastal population and climate change, the coastal community worldwide is becoming more vulnerable to TCs. Asia has witnessed 9 out of its top 10 historically costliest TC disasters in the last 25 years. Among different TC impacts, storm surge -- the wind-driven rise of water above astronomical tide levels during landfalling events -- has been repeatedly proven to be especially destructive. There is a pressing requirement to offer well-informed tropical cyclone-induced storm surge risk assessment for public and private sectors: decision makers can make better emergency response and land use planning; insurance firms can offer enhanced risk profiling. TCs are intrinsically uncertain, due to the complexities of atmospheric and oceanic systems and our limited knowledge (data and computing capabilities). It is vital to conduct Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) when assessing the storm surge risk. Traditional statistical-based approaches are fast-to-execute but too simplified to be accurate. Ideally, we would like to comprehensively characterize hazard-associated uncertainties and harness high-fidelity numerical codes to faithfully simulate the hazard phenomena. Nonetheless, such an idealized UQ implementation poses significant challenges: it is difficult to model uncertainties associated with TC tracks (high-dimensional spatiotemporal sequences); powerful simulators take days to execute, making real-time predictions and long-term risk assessment computationally infeasible. It is imperative to develop novel UQ approaches that are rapid, scalable to describe complex uncertainties, and accurate for risk estimation. This project aims to develop a family of innovative UQ techniques to rapidly and accurately account for uncertainties into the TC storm surge risk, empowered by deep learning. It includes four coherent tasks. A neural probability model will lay the groundwork by accurately describing the high-dimensional TC track uncertainties and generating realistic synthetic TCs for risk assessment. A multi-fidelity data-driven surrogate model will learn from numerical simulators to predict the storm surges for arbitrary (potentially complex) TC tracks. Both surrogate models and simulators will be validated and calibrated using observations, and their complementary strengths will be combined to provide rapid and reliable risk assessment. Overall, our contributions will further the state-of-the-art UQ for TC storm surge risk assessment. They will provide comprehensive risk assessment and actionable insights to coastal resilience, leading to more informed disaster preparedness and response efforts to safeguard the lives and properties of residents along the coastal area. 熱帶氣旋(颱風)造成巨大的破壞，威脅到世界海岸線上數百萬人的生命安全，颱風造成的損失佔所有"十億美元級天氣災難"的一半。由於沿海人口的增加和氣候變化，包括香港在內的全球沿海社區正面臨越來越大的颱風風險。美國史上前20最嚴重的颱風災難有90%發生在過去25年内。颱風引發的風暴潮是造成災難性破壞的主要原因。因此，提供準確的颱風風暴潮災害風險評估對於防災準備和減輕風險至關重要。 颱風風暴潮本身難以預測，量化其中的不確定性至關重要。然而，傳統的數值模擬方法並不適用於該不確定性量化任務。模擬器經常依賴高維輸入/輸出，需要對相關不確定性進行複雜描述；精確模擬需要長達數天運行，計算成本高昂。因此,迫切需要開發高運算效率、高維度擴展性，並能靈活考慮颱風風暴潮複雜不確定性的創新不確定性量化方法。近年來，深度學習對處理高非線性和高維度問題取得了巨大成功。然而，現成的深度學習方法由於缺乏可靠性、泛化性以及對不確定性量化問題的考慮而存在固有的局限性。為了充分發揮深度學習的潛力，我們必須克服這些關鍵障礙。 本計畫目標是利用新穎的深度學習技術開發可擴展、靈活、運算效率高的颱風風暴潮風險評估工具。首先，基於 深度學習的相關性模型將準確描述與颱風相關的高維度複雜不確定性。然後，深度學習和傳統代理模型的有效組合將建立可擴展、靈活的颱風風暴潮代理模型，最大限度地減少計算資源消耗。利用真實歷史颱風數據，我們將校準傳統物理模型和深度學習模型的誤差，並設計一種混合抽樣技術，結合代理建模的高效性和基於物理模擬的穩健性，量化不確定度。所有工具將開源,為未來的自然災害風險評估提供堅實的框架。總的來說，這項工作彌合了前沿深度學習方法與風暴潮風險評估之間的鴻溝，提供精確預測和可行的沿海恢復力洞見。

26204424.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26204424.value: 可重構數字存算一體智能芯片的處理器-宏單元協同優化敏捷設計方法

26204424.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26204424.value: As the size and computation of neural network (NN) models increase, conventional digital artificial intelligence (AI) processors face the Von Neumann bottleneck due to separation of compute and memory, which lowers energy efficiency. Computing-in-memory (CIM) eliminates this bottleneck by integrating compute into memory, and is becoming a promising architecture for energy-efficient NN acceleration. However, CIM-based AI processors suffer from three limitations, one related to the architecture paradigm and two related to the design methodology. 1) Most CIM processors are based on analog CIM, which has two inherent drawbacks in accuracy and flexibility: Accuracy loss is caused by non-ideality issues, like signal margin and process variation. The fixed in-memory data path limits the functionality. 2) Current CIM macro design heavily relies on manual efforts. To meet user requirements, designers create a CIM macro from basic memory cells to the entire array through careful layout optimization. The time-consuming manual design process makes it challenging to quickly apply CIM to diverse AI scenarios. 3) Designing a CIM processor requires expertise and comprehensive exploration of the design space. Failure to do so can result in a significant performance and energy efficiency gap between the CIM macro and processor. This project will propose the reconfigurable digital CIM (DCIM) AI processor with an agile design methodology to address the three limitations. Reconfigurable DCIM is a new architecture paradigm that balances efficiency and accuracy with DCIM, and strengthens flexibility with reconfigurable computing. The agile design methodology realizes processor-macro co-optimization through an automated generator for reconfigurable DCIM macros and a design space exploration (DSE) framework for reconfigurable DCIM AI processors. The project will complete three research tasks: 1) [Agile CIM Macro Design] Develop an automated generator that designs reconfigurable DCIM macros according to user-defined multiple CIM functions and macro specifications. 2) [Agile CIM Processor Design] Develop a DSE framework that explores the vast hardware architecture and workload mapping space to minimize the performance and energy efficiency gap between the CIM macro and processor. 3) [Chip Implementation] Design and fabricate a reconfigurable DCIM AI processor based on the agile design methodology, so as to verify the efficiency, accuracy, and flexibility capabilities of reconfigurable DCIM. The completion of the proposed project will open up a new dimension for AI chip design with reconfigurable DCIM. The agile design methodology will play a crucial role in accelerating the ecosystem development for the new architecture paradigm, enabling the rapid evolution of AI computing. 隨着神經網絡（NN）模型的規模和計算量增加，傳統的數字人工智能（AI）處理器由於計算和存儲的分離而遇到馮·諾依曼瓶頸，導致能效降低。存算一體技術（Computing-in-memory, CIM）通過將計算邏輯集成到存儲器中來解決這一瓶頸，是一種極具前景的高能效NN計算架構。 然而，基於CIM的AI處理器存在一個關於架構範式的限制，和兩個關於設計方法的限制。1）大多數CIM處理器是基於模擬CIM技術的，在精度和靈活性兩方面存在固有缺點：精度損失由信號裕度、工藝偏差等非理想因素引起。固定的存內數據路徑限制了功能的靈活性。2）當前的CIM宏單元設計嚴重依賴於人工設計。為了滿足用户需求，設計人員需要從基本存儲單元到整個陣列，並通過仔細的佈局優化來創建CIM宏單元。耗時的人工設計過程使得將CIM技術快速應用於各種AI場景變得極具挑戰性。3）設計CIM處理器需要專業知識和對設計空間的全面探索。否則將會導致CIM宏單元和處理器之間存在顯著的性能和能效差距。 本項目將研究可重構數字CIM（DCIM）AI處理器及其敏捷設計方法，來解決以上三大限制。可重構DCIM是一種新的AI處理器架構範式，通過DCIM技術兼顧能效和精度，並通過可重構計算增強靈活性。敏捷設計方法通過自動生成器設計可重構DCIM宏單元，以及設計空間探索（DSE）框架設計基於可重構DCIM的AI處理器，實現處理器-宏單元的協同優化。本項目將完成三項研究任務：1）【敏捷CIM宏單元設計】開發一個自動生成器，根據用户定義的多個CIM功能和規格設計可重構DCIM宏單元。2）【敏捷CIM處理器設計】開發一個DSE框架，探索廣闊的硬件架構和工作負載映射空間，以最小化CIM宏單元和處理器之間的性能和能效差距。3）【芯片實現】基於敏捷設計方法實現一個基於可重構DCIM的AI處理器，以驗證可重構DCIM的效率、精度和靈活性能力。 該項目的完成將為基於可重構DCIM的AI處理器芯片設計打開一個新的維度。敏捷設計方法將在新架構範式的生態系統發展中發揮關鍵作用，促進AI計算的快速演進。
